6fc6bd90e42336b6.description:
About Pivotal Health

Pivotal Health is the leading technology platform that helps healthcare providers get paid fairly in an increasingly complex reimbursement landscape.

Today, many providers face persistent underpayment from health insurance companies, despite delivering high-quality care. While processes like IDR (Independent Dispute Resolution) were designed to promote fairness, theyâre often administrative-heavy, time-consuming, and difficult to navigate without the right tools.

Pivotal Health combines software, data, and service into a seamlessly integrated, AI-driven platform that simplifies these complex reimbursement workflows. We help providers efficiently dispute underpaid claims, reduce administrative burden, and recover the reimbursement theyâre entitled to; without adding more work to already stretched teams.

Our full-service IDR solution is just the starting point. Weâre building solutions that enable providers to operate with clarity, control, and confidence across the reimbursement journey.

About the Role

We're hiring a Senior Software Engineer to join Pivotal's Case Execution team. This team owns critical parts of the case execution workflow, including eligibility, batching, submissions, ops workflows, and claim orchestration. These systems sit at the operational core of how Pivotal delivers outcomes for providers.

This is a strong fit for an engineer who enjoys solving complex, workflow-driven backend problems and working through data-heavy decision logic. The most technically demanding areas for this team are eligibility and batching, and the right person is energized by that kind of work rather than looking to avoid it.

What You'll Do

  • Build and improve core case execution systems: Own backend development across eligibility, batching, submissions, ops workflows, and claim orchestration. These are the systems that determine how cases move through Pivotal's platform and reach resolution.

  • Tackle complex, data-driven backend problems: Work through the decision logic and data-heavy workflows that make eligibility and batching hard, understanding not just how individual systems work, but how they interact across the broader platform.

  • Contribute to workflow orchestration: Build and improve the systems that coordinate how cases are staged, routed, and executed end to end, with a clear eye toward correctness and reliability.

  • Collaborate cross-functionally: Work closely with the Integrations team, Case Strategy team, and other engineering and product partners to ensure systems are well-connected and aligned with how the broader platform operates.

  • Contribute to front-end and admin workflows where needed: The role is primarily backend-focused, but you'll contribute to internal-facing UI and ops tooling where the product requires it.

Who You Are

  • 5+ years of software engineering experience with a strong backend focus

  • Strong engineering fundamentals with hands-on experience building data-heavy, workflow-oriented systems

  • Experience working on complex, data-driven decision logic or orchestration problems: you're comfortable with systems where correctness and sequencing both matter

  • Comfortable operating in a collaborative, fast-moving startup environment where ownership and requirements evolve

  • Python experience; able to work effectively in a Python-based backend environment

  • Self-directed and proactive: you identify problems and drive them to resolution without heavy oversight

  • Strong communicator who collaborates well across engineering, product, and adjacent teams

Extra Credit If You Have

  • Experience with healthcare-specific data or HealthTech systems

  • Exposure to data-heavy architectures or problems adjacent to data engineering without being a pure data engineer

  • Familiarity with tools like Snowflake, dbt, or Databricks

  • Some front-end experience to support admin workflow contributions

Why Youâll Love Working Here

Weâre a collaborative, low-ego team on a mission to make healthcare reimbursement fairer for providers. While we primarily hire around our core hubsâLos Angeles and New Yorkâwe remain open to exceptional talent outside those regions. Remote and hybrid flexibility varies by role and team, and is outlined in each job description.

If youâre excited by solving complex problems and making a real-world impact, weâd love to hear from you.

Benefits Include:

  • Competitive compensation, including equity

  • Full health, dental, and vision coverage

  • Retirement savings plan through 401(k)

  • Flexible time off

  • Opportunities for company-wide connection and events

Ready to Make an Impact?
Weâre building something meaningful; and we want you on the team.

Bring your ideas, curiosity, and drive, and letâs transform healthcare reimbursement together.

Employment Information

Work Authorization

Candidates must be authorized to work in the United States without current or future employer sponsorship.

Equal Employment Opportunity

Pivotal Health is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other legally protected status.

Reasonable Accommodations

Pivotal Health provides reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities in accordance with applicable laws. If you need assistance during the application or interview process, please let us know.

Background Checks

Employment is contingent upon successful completion of applicable background checks, where permitted by law.

At-Will Employment

Employment with Pivotal Health is at-will and may be terminated by either party at any time, with or without cause or notice, in accordance with applicable law.

c2a7c731bfe0b9f6.description:
Tremendous is the global platform built for businesses to send payoutsâgift cards and moneyâto anyone, anywhere, instantly. We're trusted by 20,000+ organizations, from startups to giants like Atlassian, MIT, and United Way, to reach millions of recipients worldwide.

We're profitable and growing without outside investors. We're fully remote, with a high-documentation, low-meeting culture that leaves more time for the work that mattersâand for your life outside it. Our employee NPS sits in the high 80s.

We move billions of dollars through our systems. That makes security existential, and it's why we're making our first dedicated security hire.

About The Role

You'll be our first Head of Security. There's already a real foundation hereâbug bounty, pen tests, automated code and configuration scanning on the production and code side, phishing simulations on the people side. Youâll add to it across access and identity, SecOps and monitoring, incident response, vendor security, employee security practices, and policy. You'll own the whole posture.

This is a player-coach role. Early on, you'll do the scoping and the hands-on work yourself; this is not a role where you direct from above. As the work demands it, we're fully prepared to build a team hereâand we're looking to you to define what that team should be and when.

You'll report to the VP of Engineering, Tremendous' most senior technical leader. We've deliberately placed security with Engineering so you're set up to drive real implementation fastâembedded with the people whose work you're securing, not siloed in a compliance function. As the security function matures, we'll revisit this.

What You'll Do

  • Own Tremendous' security posture end-to-end, partnering with our engineering team on production infrastructure and code security.
  • Assess where we have gaps, prioritize them, and tackle our highest-leverage gaps first. Weâll have opinions, but you own the prioritization and implementation.
  • Treat incident response as core, not afterthought. We may not be able to prevent a breach, but your job is making sure it's small, contained, and that we know exactly what to do.
  • Drive security as a cultural shift across the companyâintroducing controls incrementally, working with teams rather than over them. "Yes, and," not "no."
  • Lead our AI-security posture. We invest heavily in AI tooling; your job is to manage that risk and enable it, not to ban it.
  • Define when and how to staff up the security function, and hire your own team.

What You'll Bring

  • Real, hands-on security experience at a company that scaledâideally as an early security hire who grew with the business through high growth.
  • Deep experience in at least one core security domainâproduct/production security, security operations, or access/identity and policyâwith enough range to reason across the others. You defined the security posture, not just executed someone elseâs playbook.
  • An engineer's mindset. You reach for code to solve problems and can read our codebase and understand our infrastructure (Ruby on Rails; TypeScript + React; PostgreSQL; Google Cloud). You won't write much day-to-day, but you're not lost in the code.
  • Judgment over checklists. You can explain the actual risk of a given decision, hold a firm line where it matters, and give ground where "best practice" doesn't apply to us or real business need pulls the other way. You can hold your own in a debate about whether to open up broad data access for AI tooling.
  • Bedside manner. You drive hard change by bringing the team around to your point of view, rather than just telling them no. Engineers and the rest of the company want to work with you.
  • Experience building or co-building a small security team is a plus.
  • Fintech, payments, or regulated-industry experience is a plus.

What's Cool About The Role

  • You define the function. First security leader, with the budget for the required tools and team.
  • A real mandate. The push for this hire comes straight from the founders.
  • We invest in your tools. Everyone has a $5k/month budget for AI tools. Use it.
  • Competitive pay and equity. Base salary $250,000â$330,000, plus meaningful equity.
  • Fully remote. Work from anywhere in the Americas.
  • Great culture. Read more about how we work in our public handbook.

ad4a6bd1260cf8ed.description:
About Lemon.io

Lemon.io is a profitable, growing talent marketplace that connects vetted senior engineers with companies that need them. We’ve been in business for 10 years, have 60 people across Ukraine, Europe, Canada, and the US, and process over $16M in annual GMV. We compress the traditional 2–5 week hiring timeline down to 24–48 hours through a curated, pre-vetted supply of developers.

Hiring is still broken. Recruiters spend weeks building candidate pipelines on traditional platforms, burning energy on unqualified leads. We’re building the product that changes that. Giving recruiters qualified, vetted candidates within 24 hours without the grind. This is a pivotal moment: we’re transitioning from a services-driven marketplace to a technology-driven platform. We need an engineering leader who can drive that transformation.

 

The Role

You will own engineering at Lemon.io. You’ll lead a growing team of engineers, make critical architecture and prioritization decisions, and be directly accountable for the speed and quality of what we ship. This is not a management-layer role. You’ll be hands-on, deeply involved in product decisions, and working side by side with the founder.

 

What You’ll Do:

  • Own the technical roadmap and make sure every engineering effort maps directly to business impact. No features for features’ sake.

  • Lead and grow an engineering team that ships fast, iterates constantly, and treats complexity as a cost.

  • Tackle the hard, multi-layered problem: automated vetting, intelligent matching at scale, demand-side bottlenecks. And figure out where the real leverage is.

  • Make hard prioritization calls. Decide what we build, what we skip, and what we kill.

  • Work directly with the founder and product team to define what success looks like before writing a single line of code.

  • Build the engineering culture: high ownership, high speed, low bureaucracy.

Who You Are:

  • Product-minded, business-first

  • Obsessed with simplicity

  • First principles thinker

  • Fast. Bias toward action

Experience:

  • You’ve led engineering teams (5–30+ people) at a startup or high-growth company.

  • You have hands-on experience with modern stacks and are comfortable with AI/ML tooling.

  • You’ve worked in a distributed, async-first team.

Why Lemon.io:

  • Profitable and growing. No fundraising pressure, real business fundamentals.

  • A pivotal moment: you’re not maintaining an engine, you’re building one. The product roadmap is wide open.

  • Direct access to the founder. No layers. Your decisions ship.

  • A massive, unsolved problem: hiring is still broken. We’re building the product that makes it radically faster for companies to find qualified engineers.

  • A team of 60 people who move fast, care deeply, and have survived the hard years together.

0659567c8460a4bf.title: Software Engineer, AI Coding Tasks
0659567c8460a4bf.description:
We're looking for experienced software engineers to build AI coding tasks from a codebase they know well. US$1,000 per task, and you can do as many tasks as you want.

 

You turn a real change from a repository you know into a task that today's best AI coding models struggle with: hard for the models, but fair for a skilled engineer. Your tasks are used to measure and train AI coding models.

 

Remote, any location. US$1,000 per task that passes review. Minimum of one task a week, about 10 hours a week.

 

How it works

 

  1. Apply. Complete a short screener interview and upload your resume.
  2. Propose. Once you're selected, pick a change from a repository you know and submit a short proposal. We approve it or suggest a better candidate.
  3. Build. In our platform, set up the repository as it was before the change, then write the brief, the correct solution and the grading checks.
  4. Stress-test. Try lazy, incorrect and shortcut solutions and make sure your checks catch them.
  5. Model testing. Run your task against leading AI models until strong models often fail but a skilled engineer can clearly solve it.
  6. Review. A reviewer checks your task and you revise it. Most tasks take more than one round.
  7. Next task. Once your task is accepted, start another.

 

Requirements

 

  • 2+ years of professional software engineering
  • Code merged into a public open-source repository, ideally one you know well. A private codebase you own may also qualify (not employer or client code)
  • Strong in at least one of Python, TypeScript, Go, Rust, Java or C++
  • Solid with Docker, Linux, Git and automated testing
  • Regular use of an AI coding tool
  • Experience writing tests, rubrics or evaluation criteria, ideally for AI models
  • You can explain a change clearly and concisely, in your own words
  • At least 10 hours a week, starting now
  • A secure personal or work computer (no public or shared machines)

 

Nice to have

 

  • Deep expertise in one area, such as databases, compilers, distributed systems, security or infrastructure
  • Experience building agent tasks or RL environments

 

Terms

 

  • US$1,000 for each task that passes our quality review, paid directly to you
  • Once your proposal is qualified, you sign Askable's contract and accept its terms
  • The work is used for AI training. The change and your solution must be your own, and you must be free to license them to us
  • Don't publish the work anywhere: no public pull request or public fork

 

Apply at https://www.askable.com/experts/roles/senior-software-engineer

We are looking for talented and diligent candidates who perform well on our skills assessments. Strong skills test performance may be considered even if a candidate does not meet every preferred experience or educational background requirement.

Remote Work Environment

Coalition Technologies is a fully remote company. For candidates outside of California, New York, Washington, and Colorado, compensation may fall outside the listed range.

b0ef5b7d6dfa69d7.title: Senior Product Manager, App o11y | Spain | Remote
b0ef5b7d6dfa69d7.description:
Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale. Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs. We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.

You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.

This is a fully remote position and we're considering candidates in Spain.

About Product Management:

As a Product Manager at Grafana Labs, you'll develop a vision and strategy for your product domain. You will own your product’s roadmap, collateral, and market research, and you will collaborate with Grafana leadership on fine-tuning your product’s goals. You will be the primary advocate and expert in your area, with a strong ability to communicate needs, functionality, and details effectively both to external customers and internal stakeholders. The teams and people you will be interacting with will be 100% remote and globally distributed, so strong and proactive communication is essential.

Product Managers are the bridge that connect Engineering, Design, and UX to GTM. You are a facilitator who ensures the free flow of information across these teams and are expected to be technically proficient when representing our products to our customers.

The opportunity:

As the Product Manager for Application Observability (App O11y), you’ll be responsible for helping application developers and SREs understand how their applications are performing, what’s affecting their users, and where to focus when something goes wrong. You’ll continue to build App O11y on top of the Knowledge Graph and fully integrate high-fidelity signals like traces and profiles, making all three first-class parts of the product experience. You’ll bring these capabilities together into our full-stack observability experience, alongside our Drilldown products, while building AI-first workflows that help customers investigate issues, understand root cause, and take action beyond static experiences.

Your primary responsibility will be to define the vision and roadmap that takes App O11y into its next wave of adoption and revenue growth. This will require heavy customer discovery, using product data to understand where users get stuck, and working with your engineering and design partners to turn those needs into clear priorities. You’ll balance new product opportunities with the depth, performance, and reliability customers need from tracing and profiling, while working across R&D to ensure App O11y is tightly woven into our broader Grafana Cloud suite.

You’ll also work closely with PMM and GTM to help customers understand the value of App O11y. This includes shaping pricing and packaging that make it easy to get started and grow with the product. You’ll regularly review customer feedback and usage data to understand what’s working and where people get stuck, and then be accountable for turning what you learn into stronger adoption and revenue growth.

As a Product Manager at Grafana Labs, you will:

  • Transform ideas and feedback into a product vision and roadmap
  • Empathize with customer problems in order to collect user needs, requirements, and pain points
  • Curate and properly represent user feedback to Engineering, while providing evidence to support tradeoffs and priorities
  • Work closely with PMM to enable GTM on product differentiation, including creating and updating presentations, documentation, website content, datasheets, and whitepapers.
  • Use your deep product expertise to make decisions about our go-to-market strategies, pricing, packaging, licensing and tiering.

What You’ll Be Doing:

  • Transform ideas and feedback into a product vision and roadmap
  • Empathize with customer problems in order to collect user needs, requirements, and pain points
  • Curate and properly represent user feedback to Engineering, while providing evidence to support tradeoffs and priorities
  • Work closely with PMM to enable GTM on product differentiation, including creating and updating presentations, documentation, website content, datasheets, and whitepapers.
  • Use your deep product expertise to make decisions about our go-to-market strategies, pricing, packaging, licensing and tiering

What makes you a great fit:

  • A BS/BA in Computer Science, a related field, or equivalent work experience
  • 5+ years of experience in Product Management
  • 5+ years of experience in a B2B SaaS product
  • Experience using or building observability products, telemetry databases, and/or developer tools, either as a practitioner or for external customers
  • A strong understanding of application architectures and distributed systems, with the ability to discuss tradeoffs in telemetry ingestion, storage, querying, and the workflows built on top
  • Experience working with Engineering and Design teams to build delightful products and features with sound UX in a fast-paced environment
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to influence cross-functional stakeholders

Bonus Points:

  • Experience with OpenTelemetry, application instrumentation, SDKs, and telemetry collectors
  • Experience with distributed tracing or continuous profiling systems, such as Grafana Tempo or Grafana Pyroscope
  • Experience with eBPF and/or automatic instrumentation
  • Experience with open source software and/or commercial open source companies
  • Experience defining or evolving pricing and packaging for consumption-based or product-led SaaS offerings
  • Experience operating applications in production, being on call, or troubleshooting performance and reliability issues

In Spain, the base compensation range for this role is EUR 85,478 - EUR 102,573. Actual compensation may vary based on level, experience, and skillset as assessed throughout the interview process. All of our roles include Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), giving every team member ownership in Grafana Labs' success. We believe in shared outcomes—RSUs help us stay aligned and invested as we scale globally.

*Compensation ranges are country specific. If you are applying for this role from a different location than listed above, your recruiter will discuss your specific market’s defined pay range & benefits at the beginning of the process.

Why You’ll Thrive at Grafana Labs:

  • 100% Remote, Global Culture - As a remote-only company, we bring together talent from around the world, united by a culture of collaboration and shared purpose.
  • Scaling Organization – Tackle meaningful work in a high-growth, ever-evolving environment.
  • Transparent Communication – Expect open decision-making and regular company-wide updates.
  • Innovation-Driven – Autonomy and support to ship great work and try new things.
  • Open Source Roots – Built on community-driven values that shape how we work.
  • Empowered Teams – High trust, low ego culture that values outcomes over optics.
  • Career Growth Pathways – Defined opportunities to grow and develop your career.
  • Approachable Leadership – Transparent execs who are involved, visible, and human.
  • Passionate People – Join a team of smart, supportive folks who care deeply about what they do.
  • In-Person onboarding - We want you to thrive from day 1 with your fellow new ‘Grafanistas’ to learn all about what we do and how we do it.
  • Balance is Key - We operate a global annual leave policy of 30 days per annum. 3 days of your annual leave entitlement are reserved for Grafana Shutdown Days to allow the team to really disconnect. *We will comply with local legislation where applicable.

Equal Opportunity Employer:Grafana Labs is an equal opportunities employer. We welcome applications from everyone regardless of race, colour, nationality, origin, caste, sex, gender reassignment identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, religion or belief, disability, veteran status, genetic information, pregnancy, maternity, marital, family or carer status, or any other characteristic which is protected by local law. We believe that equality and diversity build a strong organisation, and we work hard to ensure that is the foundation of our organisation as we grow.

Grafana Labs may utilize AI tools in its recruitment process to assist in matching information provided in CVs to job postings. The recruitment team will continue to review inbound CVs manually to identify alignment with current openings.

For information about how your personal data is used once you’ve applied to a job, check out our privacy policy.

30c0251fff52f936.title: Freelance of vast - Functioneel Analist Utilities en MIG6 (Medior)
30c0251fff52f936.description:
📋 Taken en verantwoordelijkheden

Voor een organisatie die energie levert aan publieke klanten zoeken we een Functioneel Analist Utilities. In deze rol verbind je de energiemarkt met de business en IT. Je vertaalt marktprocessen naar functionele vereisten en bewaakt dat gegevens over toegangspunten, meetwaarden, allocatie en reconciliatie correct doorstromen van marktbericht tot boekhouding.

De energiebalans omvat wat wordt ingekocht, geleverd en op elk toegangspunt gemeten en gealloceerd. MIG6-marktberichten via Atrias sluiten aan op het leveringsplatform Cogenius en het ERP-systeem Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central. De organisatie ondersteunt daarnaast publieke klanten met energiediensten en projecten rond energie-efficiëntie.

  • Je analyseert MIG6-marktprocessen, waaronder leverancierswissels, verhuizingen, meteropnames, de levering van meetdata, allocatie en reconciliatie, en beoordeelt hun impact op de energiebalans.
  • Je brengt de datastromen in kaart tussen MIG6-berichten, Cogenius, Business Central en de rapportering over de energiebalans.
  • Je onderzoekt afwijkingen tussen ingekochte, gealloceerde, gemeten en gefactureerde volumes en werkt structurele oplossingen uit.
  • Je vertaalt businessrequirements naar IT-requirements en werkt die uit in functionele analyses, user stories, datamapping en acceptatiecriteria. Daarbij werk je samen met Cogenius en de Business Central-partner.
  • Je bent het functionele aanspreekpunt voor vragen over marktberichten van distributienetbeheerders en Atrias.
  • Je stelt testscenario's op, begeleidt acceptatietesten en ondersteunt de ingebruikname.
  • Je documenteert processen en analyses, zodat het interne team de kennis nadien kan overnemen.

📝 Jouw profiel

Kennis en ervaring

  • Je hebt minstens 2 jaar ervaring als functioneel analist of businessanalist in de energie- of utilitiessector. Een deel van die ervaring deed je op in een sleutelrol bij MIG6-implementaties of vergelijkbare marktprojecten.
  • Je hebt aantoonbare ervaring als functioneel analist met kleine bedrijfskritische of grotere niet-bedrijfskritische toepassingen.
  • Je hebt ervaring in technische omgevingen die aansluiten bij de projecten waarin je actief was.
  • Je kent de MIG6-processen en -berichten en hebt hiermee hands-on ervaring opgedaan bij een leverancier, netbeheerder of dienstverlener.
  • Je begrijpt de Belgische energieleveringsmarkt, inclusief de rollen van leverancier, distributienetbeheerder en evenwichtsverantwoordelijke (BRP), evenals allocatie, reconciliatie en de link met facturatie.
  • Je werkt vlot met data. Ervaring met SQL of een vergelijkbare tool is een troef.
  • Ervaring met energiebalansen, portfoliobeheer of energie-inkoop is een sterke plus.
  • Kennis van Cogenius en/of Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central is een troef.
  • Je hebt kennis van en ervaring met OO-, data- en procesmodelleringstechnieken en bijbehorende tools.
  • Je hebt ervaring met requirementanalyse en designconcepten voor OO-, multi-tier- en web-enabledomgevingen en/of UML-omgevingen.

Competenties

  • Je denkt analytisch en structureert complexe processen tot heldere specificaties.
  • Je werkt vanaf dag één zelfstandig, adviseert proactief en legt onderbouwde keuzes voor aan het management.
  • Je communiceert helder met business, IT en externe partners.
  • Je werkt nauwkeurig en neemt eigenaarschap over je dossiers.
  • Je spreekt en schrijft vlot Nederlands op Europees CEFR-niveau C2.

💼 Aanbod

Je zal deel uitmaken van een groeiende KMO met ruimte voor initiatief en persoonlijke ontwikkeling. Wij zorgen ervoor dat je in een uitdagende maar aangename werkomgeving terecht komt met leuke collega's. Samen met jou stippelen we een carriereplan uit, met aandacht en budget voor bijkomende opleidingingen / certificaties. Je kan rekenen op een motiverend salaris, aangevuld met extralegale voordelen, inclusief bedrijfswagen (of alternatieve vergoeding).

(Freelance is ook mogelijk)

cf6abc44a602314d.description:
About Integrated Specialty Coverages

Integrated Specialty Coverages, LLC (ISC) is a growth stage technology and data-driven commercial MGA and insurance wholesaler leading innovation in the market.

Backed by one of the leading private equity firms, Onex Partners, and led by a forward-thinking management team, ISC is combining the worlds of insurance and technology to create an Insurtech powerhouse. As a leading online distributor of insurance products for a range of industries and “Main Street USA”, we are looking for the right people to help us in our mission of achieving exponential growth. We strive to be the number one place to go for brokers and agents to source insurance. To accomplish this, we’re building a digitally focused team that deeply understands the intersection between user experience, data, and AI/ML to optimize the way we engage with our customers and partners.

Job Summary

The Strategic Partnerships Manager drives revenue and expands the company's reach by growing relationships with current partners and winning new ones. Target partners include aggregators, networks, associations, and other organizations, including affinity and embedded insurance opportunities. The role centers on relationship building, clear communication, and negotiation. It works closely with sales, marketing, legal, finance, and product teams.

Position Responsibilities

  • Partnership strategy: Build and carry out long-term partnership plans (channel, technology, co-selling, and ecosystem partners) that support company revenue and expansion goals.
  • Business development and sourcing: Find, research, and pitch new strategic partners through networking, outreach, and market analysis. Identify new alliances, co-selling opportunities, and expansion channels.
  • Negotiation and structuring: Lead negotiations on deal terms, revenue-sharing models, integrations, contracts, and service-level agreements (SLAs). Draft, negotiate, and close agreements with the legal and finance teams.
  • Cross-functional collaboration: Work with sales, marketing, product, and leadership to run joint go-to-market plans, co-marketing campaigns, joint product integrations, and referral programs.
  • Partner lifecycle and relationship management: Oversee each partner from onboarding through day-to-day engagement. Keep executive-level contact with key partners and make sure both sides meet their commitments.
  • Performance tracking and reporting: Monitor key performance indicators (KPIs), track partner-generated revenue and other impact measures, and improve or restructure underperforming partnerships.
  • Relationship Management: Maintain executive-level contact with key partners and track performance metrics

Minimum Qualifications

  • Preferred: 7-10 years insurance experience in commercial insurance, especially the excess and surplus (E&S) lines market.
  • Bachelor’s Degree.
  • Familiarity with third party insurance distribution including clusters and aggregators.
  • Strategic thinking and planning: Spot potential partnerships, judge their value, and build a plan to start and grow them.
  • Relationship building: Strong people skills for building lasting relationships with partners and internal teams.
  • Communication: Excellent verbal and written communication. Able to explain the company's value clearly and present to executives.
  • Negotiation: Consultative selling and deal negotiation that produces agreements that work for both sides.
  • Networking: An existing network in relevant industries and the ability to build new connections.
  • Market and industry knowledge: Solid grasp of the market and industry trends, with the ability to find new partnership opportunities.
  • Project management: Able to manage several partnerships and projects at once, and to balance internal and external expectations.
  • Financial acumen: Understands financial metrics and can judge the financial impact of a partnership using data.
  • Cross-functional leadership: Able to lead teams across departments without direct authority.

This role also offers bonus pay. Your ISC Talent Acquisition representative will share more details about the bonus component should you advance in the interview process.

0c37b4e4f6a2db09.description:
IMPORTANT NOTICE FOR INTERNAL APPLICANTS ONLY:

Internal applicants MUST apply to the internal job posting through the Mattress Firm Workday system. To view the list of current internal Job Postings, type “Jobs Hub” into the Workday search bar and click on the link. If you are unable to view the job posting, don't hesitate to get in touch with your Talent Acquisition representative.

Is your current job a nightmare? Make it a dream job at Mattress Firm®!

Join Mattress Firm and have the job of your dreams!

Helping people sleep well so they live well is at the core of what we do. The right mattress matters, and so does the right career.

We work hard and sleep hard—and embrace the fact that each of us has our own way of getting our best, most efficient work done. For our corporate team members, whether you work in a hybrid schedule at our Houston BedQuarters (BQ) or are fully remote, we trust you with the freedom to decide how best to contribute and collaborate in your role.

Job Details:

The (REMOTE) Real Estate Coordinator II provides administrative, transactional, and project coordination support for Mattress Firm's retail real estate activities. This role is responsible for supporting lease transactions, coordinating Real Estate Committee (REC) processes, managing transaction workflows, maintaining portfolio records, and facilitating communication among internal stakeholders, external counsel, landlords, brokers, and third-party partners. The coordinator plays a critical role in ensuring lease transactions, new store approvals, amendments, and portfolio initiatives are organized, documented, and executed efficiently. This position serves as a central resource for transaction administration, document management, reporting, and process coordination across the Real Estate department.

Essential Responsibilities

  • Coordinate lease transaction administration for new stores, renewals, relocations, amendments, and other real estate initiatives.
  • Prepare and manage Real Estate Committee (REC) materials, approval documentation, and transaction proformas.
  • Partner with internal stakeholders to gather project budgets, signage estimates, and other information required for transaction review and approval.
  • Manage transaction workflow from approval through lease execution, including legal coordination, document tracking, and contract administration.
  • Coordinate document execution activities and maintain complete and accurate transaction records.
  • Track portfolio metrics, third-party asset management savings, invoices, and recurring reporting requirements.
  • Support cross-functional communication and process execution among Real Estate, Legal, Finance, Construction, Operations, and external partners.
  • Identify and implement process improvements that enhance transaction management, reporting accuracy, workflow efficiency, and operational effectiveness.
  • Support special projects and additional Real Estate initiatives as assigned.
  • Oversee communications regarding the general Real Estate email boxes.
  • Complete all required training modules and certifications prior to the due date.
  • Ensure all safety policies and procedures are followed for a safe work environment for all.
  • Communicate professionally with all internal and external contacts.
  • Follow all Company policies and execute Company standards on appearance and functionality as well as appropriate brand representation.
  • Communicate any concerns or issues to leadership to ensure proper efficiency of department and Company operations.

Non-Essential Responsibilities

  • Develop and maintain templates, tracking tools, and standard operating procedures.
  • Research historical lease transactions, portfolio information, and documentation as requested.
  • Participate in department projects and continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Miscellaneous filing for Real Estate.
  • Execute Company initiatives and other activities requested by Supervisor.
  • Update job knowledge by participating in educational opportunities.
  • Contribute ideas on ways to optimize or improve the team, the department, and the Company.

Education

  • Bachelor's Degree in Business, Real Estate, Finance, Operations, Project Management, or related field: Required OR
  • Equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.

Professional Experience

  • 3+ years of experience in Commercial Real Estate, Lease Administration, Portfolio Administration, Project Management, Transaction Management, or related field: Required
  • Experience supporting a large multi-unit retail portfolio: Preferred
  • Experience coordinating projects and managing multiple stakeholders across functions: Preferred
  • Experience maintaining databases, trackers, reporting tools, or contract administration systems: Preferred
  • Experience preparing executive presentations and recurring management reporting: Preferred
  • Experience supporting lease renewals, closures, relocations, dispositions, or portfolio initiatives: Preferred.

Skills List

  • Advanced Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint proficiency
  • Exceptional organizational and project management skills.

d32aabf7973991ab.title: Senior Technical Product Owner - AI Native
d32aabf7973991ab.description:
Overview

The Senior Technical Product Owner – AI Native is responsible for defining, prioritizing, and validating AIenabled products and solutions that align with business objectives, customer needs, and company strategy. This role combines strong technical understanding with product ownership expertise to translate business needs into clear requirements, feature briefs, story specifications, and prioritized backlogs. Working closely with engineering, data science, business stakeholders, and customers, this role provides product intent, grounding context, and acceptance boundaries that guide both human and AI-assisted development. The role also performs high-fidelity epic and requirements validation to reduce ambiguity, minimize rework, and support faster, higher-quality delivery. The Senior Technical Product Owner – AI Native ensures teams build the right capabilities, at the right scope and time, while coaching Technical Product Owners, Business Analysts, and other product practitioners on product definition, backlog management, and validation practices. The role does not require deep AI or ML specialization but does require an understanding of how AI-enabled development changes delivery speed, iteration cycles, and product discovery.

Responsibilities

Product Ownership and Prioritization

  • Author Feature Briefs and shape upcoming features in partnership with the Product Owner and Tech Lead.
  • Co-author Story Specs with the Tech Lead and ensure stories are ready for fast, iterative delivery.
  • Own one or more Product or Team Key Results and make day-to-day scope and sequencing decisions to minimize delivery friction and rework.
  • Coach Technical Product Owners and establish AI-native product ownership standards, practices, and delivery frameworks across the organization.
  • Lead resolution of complex product(s), delivery, and business risks that extend beyond a single team.
  • Drive continuous improvement in product definition practices to improve product quality, predictability, outcome realization, and the effectiveness of AI-assisted engineering workflows.

Requirements & Solution Definition

  • Conduct interviews and requirements workshops with business and technical stakeholders to elicit, clarify, and validate business needs.
  • Translate business needs into clear, well-structured, testable requirements that account for architectural, regulatory, operational, and business constraints.
  • Coordinate dependencies and requirement priorities across multiple teams and stakeholder groups to support solution clarity and delivery readiness.
  • Maintain precise documentation that enables efficient, accurate implementation and minimizes downstream ambiguity.

Product Intent & Grounding Context

  • Establish and evolve standards for product intent, grounding context, and high-fidelity validation across AI-native delivery teams.
  • Define clear product intent by articulating the problem being solved, desired outcomes, constraints, and acceptance boundaries.
  • Provide grounding context for engineers and AI-assisted workflows, including domain assumptions, user behaviors, system invariants, and relevant business or technical constraints.
  • Keep intent and context current as requirements evolve and serve as the primary source of truth for what success looks like at the epic, feature, and story level.

Validation and Outcome Alignment

  • Perform high-fidelity validation of epics before decomposition, ensuring they are precise, well-scoped, actionable, testable, grounded in product intent, aligned with architectural constraints, and free of unresolved assumptions or gaps that could create downstream rework.
  • Clarify requirements during delivery, validate work against product intent, and accept increments as they emerge as AI-assisted workflows iterate rapidly (in-flight validation).
  • Ensure delivered functionality is usable, extensible, and aligned with domain constraints, system boundaries, and quality expectations (outcome-level quality assessment) rather than ceremony milestones.
  • Evaluate opportunities to accelerate discovery, validation, and delivery through AI-enabled product management practices and influence the outcome.

Stakeholder Communication

  • Communicate progress, scope tradeoffs, risks, and delivery outcomes to stakeholders.
  • Act as the primary product point of contact for one or more AI-Native teams, ensuring alignment between business intent and engineering execution.
  • Detect gaps between intended and actual outcomes early and drive corrective action before scale or automation amplifies defects.
  • Identify risks and drive resolution of issues impacting delivery or quality.
  • Complete all responsibilities as outlined in the annual performance review and/or goal setting.
  • Complete all special projects and other duties as assigned.
  • Must be able to perform duties with or without reasonable accommodation.

This job description is intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed and is not to be construed as an exhaustive list of responsibilities, duties and skills required. This job description does not constitute an employment agreement and is subject to change as the needs of Cotiviti and requirements of the job change.

Qualifications

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, information technology, or a relevant field preferred
  • 10+ years’ experience in product ownership, product management, or business analysis roles within Agile delivery environments.
  • Experience with cloud-based AI platforms e.g. (AWS, Azure, GCP)
  • Prior success in launching AI driven products or features
  • Knowledge of data privacy, security, and compliance in the context of AI
  • Strong experience translating business problems into clear, testable products and technical requirements.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Proven analytical and problem-solving skills, with experience in systems modeling, workflow analysis, or solution design
  • Ability to learn complex domains quickly; healthcare experience preferred
  • Experience with systems modeling, user interface design, and prototyping, decision trees, data flow
  • A wide degree of creativity and latitude is expected

Cognitive / Mental Requirements

  • Problem-solving and critical thinking — navigating competing priorities, capacity constraints, staffing questions, dependencies, and unexpected issues.
  • Judgment and decision-making — determining how Design resources should be allocated and making timely decisions when there isn’t a clear answer.
  • Planning and prioritization — managing multiple concurrent workstreams and determining what needs attention when.
  • Information synthesis — taking in information from multiple sources and perspectives and forming a clear understanding of priorities, risks, and needs.
  • Pattern recognition — identifying trends in workload, capacity, team capability, and organizational needs.
  • Adaptability and learning — quickly learning new tools, technologies, and ways of working and applying them to changing circumstances.
  • Communication and collaboration — processing and communicating information effectively with people across Design, Product, Engineering, and leadership.
  • Coaching and interpersonal judgment — understanding individual strengths, development needs, and team dynamics and responding appropriately.

Physical Requirements and Working Conditions

  • Remaining in a stationary position, often standing or sitting for prolonged periods.
  • Communicating with others to exchange information.
  • Repeating motions that may include the wrists, hands and/or fingers.
  • Assessing the accuracy, neatness and thoroughness of the work assigned.
  • No adverse environmental conditions expected.
  • Must be able to provide a dedicated, secure work area.
  • Must be able to provide high-speed internet access / connectivity and office setup and maintenance.

Base compensation ranges from $135,000 to $148,000 per year. Specific offers are determined by various factors, such as experience, education, skills, certifications, and other business needs. This role is eligible for a discretionary bonus.

Cotiviti offers team members a competitive benefits package to address a wide range of personal and family needs, including medical, dental, vision, disability, and life insurance coverage, 401(k) savings plans, paid family leave, 9 paid holidays per year, and 17-27 days of Paid Time Off (PTO) per year, depending on specific level and length of service with Cotiviti. For information about our benefits package, please refer to our Careers page.

Since this job will be based remotely, all interviews will be conducted virtually.

Date of posting: 11/10/2026

Applications are assessed on a rolling basis. We anticipate that the application window will close on 2/10/2026, but the application window may change depending on the volume of applications received or close immediately if a qualified candidate is selected.

f34a33b66bf3f69d.title: Cloud Customer Success Manager - Remote US Only
f34a33b66bf3f69d.description:
The Customer Success Manager, Channel Partner Portfolio is a senior individual contributor responsible for the strategic success, retention and expansion of Blue Mantis's most complex channel partner relationships, with an initial focus on a key national channel partner and the private equity–backed portfolio companies it serves. The role provides executive-level customer leadership, establishes scalable engagement and governance practices, and orchestrates cross-functional resources across Cloud, Security, Digital and Managed Services to drive measurable customer and commercial outcomes.

This role sits at the center of a three-way relationship between Blue Mantis, our channel partners, and their end customers. Some customers purchase cloud through our CSP program, while others contract directly and are supported through partner-led programs. Across both groups, the CSM’s mandate is the same: be a trusted and consistent presence, understand each customer’s business priorities, and widen Blue Mantis’s services footprint across Cloud, Security, Digital, and Managed Services.

The role is a hybrid of a Customer Success Manager and a Cloud Services Account Manager (CSAM). The Blue Mantis CSAM team continues to deliver FinOps analysis and recommendations, while the CSM understands cloud financial management, CSP billing, and FinOps readouts well enough to lead monthly business reviews with confidence, interpret the findings for business stakeholders, and connect them to opportunities for additional value. The CSM is a generalist rather than a subject matter expert, bringing in the right Blue Mantis specialists as each customer’s needs emerge.

The CSM is sales-adjacent, listening for opportunities in every interaction and acting as a feedback loop to the Sales and Pre-Sales teams. Success is measured through Net Promoter Score (NPS), Net Retention, the number of partner customers actively engaged, services pipeline sourced or influenced, and growth in Blue Mantis services beyond CSP.

Key Responsibilities


The CSM is also responsible for prioritization, escalation management, and the resolution of contract and operational issues for assigned customers. The role calls for a calm, clear-headed approach and a high level of emotional intelligence when working with customers, partners, and internal stakeholders.
  • Serves as the primary customer success contact for an assigned strategic channel partner and its end customers, delivering an exceptional client experience across every interaction
  • Owns the customer success strategy and operating model for assigned strategic channel portfolios, establishing governance, engagement cadence, success measures and escalation frameworks.
  • Collaborates effectively with subject matter experts and cross-functional teams to drive operational efficiency, consistency, and standardization.
  • Partners with the Blue Mantis CSAM team to present FinOps and CSP findings, translating cost and consumption insights into business terms and clear next steps for client stakeholders.
  • Develops executive-level relationships with channel partners and priority portfolio-company stakeholders, serving as a strategic advisor on technology, cloud optimization and services strategy.
  • Leads Executive Business Reviews and strategic planning sessions with channel partners and their customers connecting customer business priorities to Blue Mantis capabilities and multi-year services roadmaps.
  • Partners with Sales leadership to shape expansion strategy and materially influence qualified services pipeline across the portfolio, acting as a continuous feedback loop on customer needs
  • Owns portfolio health, retention and expansion strategy, using NPS, Net Retention, consumption, service performance and pipeline indicators to identify risk and growth opportunities.
  • Brings the right specialists into each customer conversation, such as Solution Architecture, Security, or Disaster Recovery and Business Continuity, rather than relying on specialists to attend every review.
  • Manages the partner rules of engagement, including relationship ownership and the different engagement models for CSP and non-CSP customers.
  • Serves as a key liaison across Sales, Pre-Sales, Solution Architecture, the CSAM team, Technical Support, and Operations to provide a seamless end-to-end customer experience.
  • Manages and coordinates customer escalations, partnering with internal teams and stakeholders to address service delivery, quality, and customer experience concerns.
  • Proactively engages clients to understand emerging and evolving business requirements and coordinates with internal stakeholders to develop solutions for new or expanded services.
  • Collaborates closely with channel partner account teams to develop and execute account plans for each portfolio company, aligning business priorities and opportunities with Blue Mantis services to strengthen customer satisfaction, retention, and growth.
  • Influences without direct authority, mobilizing internal teams and partners to deliver high-quality results in a fast-paced environment.
  • Maintains current knowledge of industry trends and evolving technologies across Cloud, Security, Digital, and FinOps, including Microsoft CSP programs and licensing.
  • Evaluates business and operational processes and partners with support and operations teams to identify and implement continuous improvement opportunities.
  • Minimum of five years of experience in Customer Success Management, Service Delivery Management, Account Management, or a comparable client-facing role, including at least three years with or within a Managed Services Provider (MSP).
  • Experience working in a channel, partner, or distributor model, including managing relationships where a partner sits between the service provider and the end customer.
  • Working knowledge of FinOps principles and cloud financial management, sufficient to understand and present CSP and FinOps readouts to business stakeholders.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and business judgment skills, including the ability to interpret financial and operational data, assess complex situations, and translate findings into practical recommendations.
  • Strong business acumen and strategic thinking, with the ability to understand client objectives, identify priorities, and align services with business needs.
  • Demonstrated experience partnering with clients to develop business solutions, both during steady-state operations and through escalations or complex service issues.
  • Proven experience optimizing workflows, identifying operational efficiencies, and implementing process improvements.
  • Familiarity with Microsoft Cloud Solution Provider (CSP) programs, Microsoft licensing, and the Azure and Microsoft 365 ecosystem.
    Strong interpersonal, communication, and presentation skills, with the executive presence to lead business reviews and engage colleagues, clients, and stakeholders at all levels.
  • Demonstrated ability to prioritize initiatives, manage competing demands, and operate effectively in a fast-paced environment.
    Proven track record of growing client accounts through consultative, value-based conversations that uncover new services opportunities.

    Qualifications Preferred
  • A bachelor’s degree in Business, Technology, or a related field; FinOps Certified Practitioner, ITIL Foundation, or Microsoft fundamentals certifications (such as AZ-900 or MS-900); and experience supporting private equity–backed companies or multi-entity customer portfolios.
  • Work Environment:
  • Approximately 25% travel, including visits to partner and customer sites.
  • Remote position based in the United States or Canada, with some office visits required.
  • No physical requirements
Base Salary Range: $140,000 to $165,000

However, individual salaries are determined by a variety of factors including, but not limited to business considerations, local market conditions, and internal equity, as well as candidate qualifications, such as skills, education, and experience.We consider all qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or protected veteran status.

d12c8ac640b03fce.title: Career Coach (Part-time/Contract/US Remote)
d12c8ac640b03fce.description:
The Company

At Springboard, we’re on a mission to bridge the world’s skills gap, offering transformative online education in data science, UI/UX design, machine learning, and coding. Our courses may be tech-enabled, but we're ultimately human-centric: each student taps into a vast community throughout their time with us, engaging with fellow students, industry-expert mentors, student advisors, and career coaches, the goal of which is to successfully transition students into their dream job. Through this hybrid approach, we’ve helped thousands of learners revamp their careers and, by extension, their lives, with hundreds of top-notch job offers received every year and a near-perfect placement rate for our program graduates.

The Opportunity

Career Success plays a key role in executing on our mission: our personalized approach has given thousands of people access to more relevant roles. As a Career Coach, you will work 1:1 or in groups with Springboard students on all aspects of their job search and career goals, to produce great career outcomes for all Career Track graduates. Working closely with a dynamic and empathetic Career Success team, you’ll play a significant role in each student’s journey as you support them in revamping their careers and, by extension, their lives.

You must be available to offer a minimum of 12, and no more than 25 hours of coaching time a week. Note that the range of 12-25 hours only includes coaching calls, and does not include any additional admin-related work and is billed separately.

While the hours you provided are at your discretion and may include weekend hours, it is important to consider how the demographics of our students (full-time working, families, etc) impact their scheduling needs, which can in turn impact how your hours get booked.

Responsibilities:

  • Provide 1:1 and/or group career coaching regarding job search in technical fields with students in a high-volume, online, coaching environment
  • Respond promptly and supportively to student career concerns and questions via email and to manager’s inquiries about students’ progress
  • Track outcomes of coaching calls via our student CRM, providing detailed notes and information that evaluate risk factors, track success, and predict future performance as outlined in the resources and protocols by the Springboard Career Success Team.
  • Implement effective coaching strategies to ensure that students are competitive candidates to land a job within their support window including staying up to date on current trends in technical hiring and job search tactics that work
  • Hold students accountable to the policies designed to ensure we are meeting placement rate goals and the integrity of our Job Guarantee program.
  • Support career curriculum and resource development as needed; support development of career webinars and owning administration and facilitation of them
  • Escalate and develop intervention plans for students of concern
  • Attending weekly/monthly meetings/training is strongly encouraged and, at minimum, the expectation is to review recordings of missed meetings and training to stay up to date on changes at Springboard, team and coaching updates, etc.

You bring:

  • 2+ years’ experience in coaching, advising, or workforce/employee development in a 1:1 capacity, specifically supporting individuals’ job search and career goals for technical roles
  • Comfortability with and ability to coach from both an empathetic and accountable perspective
  • Knowledge of the hiring process and how to conduct an effective job search in tech
  • A track record of producing measurable results, meeting deadlines, and balancing multiple priorities and constituencies; you are proactive, agile, and flexible
  • Knowledge and willingness to learn new technology and systems (e.g., Hubspot, LMS, Zoom, Google Docs/Slides)
  • Outstanding customer service mentality and strong attention to detail (in recording student progress and following up on questions).
  • Strong communication skills, especially in listening, coaching, advising, and large group presentations, and the ability to build rapport and credibility with students and colleagues across the company

Bonus Point if you have:

  • Formal coaching education through courses or certifications
  • Knowledge of working with job seekers with various visas and work authorization requirements
  • Knowledge of working within Canadian job market contexts
  • Knowledge of the hiring process and how to conduct an effective job search in tech
  • Knowledge of the software engineering, cybersecurity, data analytics, data science, design, and tech sales fields and their recruiting/hiring practices

Pay is $24 per hour for the first year.

If you are an enthusiastic and dedicated professional who is eager to contribute to the growth and development of our students, we invite you to apply and join our team of passionate Career Service Professionals. Together, we'll help bridge the world’s skills gap!

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We welcome applications from all backgrounds, and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

California Privacy Rights Notice for Job Applicants
Under the California Consumer Privacy Act (“CCPA”), Springboard is required to inform California residents who are job applicants about the categories of personal information we collect about you and the purposes for which we will use this information. This notice contains disclosures required by the CCPA and applies only to personal information that is subject to the CCPA.

c6bbb8a027151f8a.title: Product Engineer (PM)
c6bbb8a027151f8a.description:
Location: Fully Remote
Compensation: $23.08 to $34.62 USD/hour
Benefits: 15 days PTO. Christmas Day and New Year's Day paid off.

Fair warning: the pace is intense and the ambiguity is real. But you'll feel yourself growing every single week, even the rough ones, and you'll be doing it next to people who actually celebrate your wins and have your back.

We're the all-in-one agentic marketing platform. AI-native from day one. We're not joining a category, we're defining it.

We're looking for a Product Engineer to own a pod's output end-to-end: strategy, specs, QA, and enough technical depth to unblock engineers or write the code yourself when that's the fastest path forward. If you want real ownership, move fast, and raise the bar every week, keep reading. If you've been waiting for a PM role that doesn't ask you to leave your technical background at the door, this is it.

What you'll own

  • Own the roadmap for your pod: define what gets built, kill low-leverage work, and protect your engineers' time and focus

  • Write specs that start with the problem, not the solution, and ship every brief with a clear success criterion

  • Participate technically: read the codebase, debug independently, and ship small things when it's faster than context-switching an engineer

  • Own QA end-to-end: test plans, regression passes, release sign-off, and post-deploy monitoring in Sentry and Grafana

  • Keep the pod moving: fast decisions, async-first communication, and zero ambiguity about what's next

  • Close the feedback loop between customers, data, and product direction, and hold yourself accountable to the KPIs you define

You'll thrive here if...

  • You've shipped production code before and you're honest with yourself about your technical depth

  • You treat a spec as a hypothesis to pressure-test, not a document to execute against

  • You don't wait to be told what to do. You see the gap and you move.

  • Deadlines don't rattle you. Ambiguity doesn't either.

  • You're an AI power user, not someone who's "open to learning it someday."

  • You communicate clearly, especially when things are unclear.

  • You have opinions and you're not afraid to bring them.

  • You can laugh at a chaotic week on Friday and mean it.

What we're looking for

  • 3+ years of product management experience in B2B SaaS, startup or high-growth environment

  • A hands-on technical background: production code, a bootcamp, or demonstrable ability to navigate a full-stack codebase

  • Comfortable reading Python and JavaScript/TypeScript; able to write SQL, reason about REST contracts, and follow frontend state

  • Proven QA ownership: test cases, regression cycles, structured bug reports, release sign-off

  • Daily fluency with Claude Code or equivalent. Not "open to it." Actually using it.

  • Strong written communication. Your specs are clear and complete on the first read.

  • Available in EST

What working here actually looks like

High expectations. Real ownership. Things change fast and we don't apologize for it. You'll work with smart people who push you, a product that keeps getting better, and a team that's genuinely building something new.

The boundary between product and engineering is intentionally blurred here. The best product decisions are inseparable from technical reality, and we hire people who understand that.

We'll probably give you more to own than you expected. That's on purpose.

We use AI every day, across every function. That's just how we work.

What we stand for

  • We are obsessed with our customers, and making them obsessed with us

  • We figure it the f**k out

  • We go to war on our problems quickly

  • We are strategic. We work smart, not just hard.

  • We're fun AF

About Search Atlas

Search Atlas helps marketing teams move faster, make smarter decisions, and do more with less. We're a $30M+ ARR company, 215 people, bootstrapped, and building the infrastructure for the next era of marketing. No outside funding. No fluff. Just product.

Who we need

Emerging Travel Group is a global travel-tech company that builds and operates online travel products and booking platforms for travelers, travel professionals, and accommodation partners across international markets. Working at the intersection of technology and travel, the team is focused on delivering reliable booking experiences and strong partner connectivity across the platform.

As a Middle Combi QA Engineer on the International CRM team, you'll work on our internal CRM — the central workspace for the entire customer support and business teams, where they communicate with clients, resolve requests, and manage their daily work.   • English at B2 level or higher.
  • Flexibility, openness to change, and a desire to grow.

86b9bea6eb3943b4.description:
In a world of possibilities, pursue one with endless opportunities. Imagine Next!At Parsons, you can imagine a career where you thrive, work with exceptional people, and be yourself. Guided by our leadership vision of valuing people, embracing agility, and fostering growth, we cultivate an innovative culture that empowers you to achieve your full potential. Unleash your talent and redefine what’s possible.

Job Description:

In a world of possibilities, pursue one with endless opportunities. Imagine Next!


When it comes to what you want in your career, if you can imagine it, you can do it at Parsons. Imagine a career working with intelligent people sharing a common quest. Imagine a workplace where you can be yourself. Where you can thrive. Where you can find your next, right now. We’ve got what you’re looking for.


Parsons is looking for an organized, curious, and motivated Early Talent and Operations Specialist to join our Talent Acquisition Operations team.

This position reports to the Recruiting Programs Manager within Talent Acquisition Operations and is a remote opportunity.


What you’ll be doing:


  • Coordinate and execute internship program initiatives and engagement activities, including but not limited to culture sessions, professional development workshops, the Intern Mentorship Program, and the AI Design Thinking Challenge
  • Support preparation for incoming intern classes including onboarding, communications, and stakeholder training
  • Support the Core School Program and related efforts such as the Campus Ambassador Program, fall recruitment strategy, intern recruitment processes, etc.
  • Serve as the liaison for core university relations and oversees a series of university recruitment activities such as career fairs, information sessions, targeted newsletters, etc.
  • Enhance & deliver intern hiring and pre-event trainings to key stakeholders
  • Streamline communication and standards to promote Parsons’ internship program and university relations efforts across Parsons’ business segments
  • Analyze internship program and university data to determine successes, opportunities for improvement, and overall return on investment.
  • Support global career event process and related logistics
  • Manage candidate travel reimbursement process and related logistics
  • Support the administration of event management platform Yello and Talent Acquisition Resource Site
  • Support Talent Acquisition teams with day-to-day processes, programs, and operational activities
  • Prepare basic reports and analyses to help the Talent Acquisition team monitor activity, identify trends, and support decision-making
  • Support the creation and maintenance of Talent Acquisition process documentation, training materials, standard operating procedures, and user guides
  • Look for opportunities to improve processes through standardization, automation, reporting, and effective use of technology
  • Maintain accurate records, trackers, documentation, timelines, and project updates in support of TA Operations
  • Participate in special projects and continuous improvement initiatives across Talent Acquisition Operations

What required skills you’ll bring:


  • Bachelor's Degree in Business Administration, Communications, Human Resources, or a related field
  • 5+ years of professional work experience; experience in Talent Acquisition, Human Resources, operations, or project management is preferred.
  • Strong attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, evolving environment
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office, including Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Teams, and Outlook
  • Experience working collaboratively across teams and following through on deliverables on time
  • Ability to organize information, identify trends, document processes, and clearly communicate findings and recommendations for best practices
  • Demonstrated ability to exercise sound judgment and maintain confidentiality while managing sensitive recruiting, and organizational information

Preferred Skills & Experiences:


  • Experience working with career centers or in student affairs
  • Experience developing and executing campus recruiting and university engagement strategies, with a demonstrated ability to build and maintain talent pipelines while measuring and communicating program impact and return on investment (ROI)
  • Strong verbal communication and presentation skills, including experience facilitating trainings and presenting to leadership audiences
  • Interest in and familiarity with AI-powered tools and emerging technologies, with a willingness to explore innovative solutions that enhance program delivery, engagement, and operational efficiency
  • Reporting and analysis using Excel, pivot tables, lookups, dashboards, or data visualization tools such as Power BI
  • Experience with automation tools such as Power Automate to improve processes and workflows
  • Project management, meeting facilitation, task tracking, or cross-functional program support

1485013dcd8d3a5c.title: Director of Engineering
1485013dcd8d3a5c.description:
From empowering entrepreneurs to build successful businesses, to supporting their clients to arrange 'me time' moments, we're in the business of elevating people - helping them to thrive and feel fantastic. Lifting others up can be hard, heavy work, and we passionately believe that the sense of purpose and personal satisfaction this brings are worth it.

What started in Poland is now an international, cloud-based marketplace that's scaling rapidly. We bring independent business owners together with their customers on a product that connects creative communities and opens up worlds of opportunities.

For our providers, our products offer services for getting booked, paid, and building a loyal client base. For their clients, we're where they can find their favourite spots, discover new businesses and book appointments in an instant.

Working in a rapidly growing, ever-changing scale-up comes with its own set of opportunities and challenges. If you prefer a stable environment, with clear processes and structures then, we've got to be honest, you won't always find that here. However, if you enjoy inventively solving problems with others, helping create clarity when things get confusing, and prioritising your own path within ambiguity, then the chances are that you'll love the opportunities available to grow your career at Booksy.

The people you'll like to work with and things you'll enjoy impacting:

As a Director of Engineering reporting to the Chief Technology Officer in our Provider Domain, your purpose will be to own the technical strategy and delivery for the systems hundreds of thousands of independent businesses run on every day. You will:

  • Own end-to-end delivery across 4–5 cross-functional teams, leading through Engineering Managers and Staff+ Engineers in a deliberately flat structure with no layers in between.
  • Set the engineering standard for the domain — building the frameworks for architecture decisions, technical proposals and how teams work.
  • Lead our AI transformation of the engineering lifecycle, and define the measures that prove it worked.
  • Partner with Product to turn commercial strategy into engineering strategy, and back it with experimentation and data.
  • Build a team of exceptional density, coaching leaders who can operate autonomously.

Requirements

Essentially, to ensure you succeed in this role you're going to need…

  • To think like a product owner, not a ticket-deliverer — you understand unit economics, funnels and growth mechanics, and the commercial impact of what your teams ship.
  • Experience personally establishing engineering rigor: architecture decision records, technical proposals and standardised ways of working that teams actually adopted.
  • Practical experience embedding AI tooling into the day-to-day engineering lifecycle — and a clear view on how to measure the impact and protect code quality.
  • To have led multiple squads through Engineering Managers and Staff Engineers in a high-growth scale-up or high-transaction marketplace or SaaS business, while staying close to the work.
  • At a minimum we require conversational level English language skills. Why? English is our company language and is used for any business-wide communications, so we need you to be able to speak English to feel like an integrated part of Booksy.

It will also help you to have…

  • Experience with two-sided marketplaces or booking platforms.
  • Exposure to growth engineering or growth experimentation.
  • B2B SaaS experience at scale.

Benefits

  • We're proudly distributed across the globe, with each market being remote-first.
  • Depending on which market you're joining, you might have office access or be fully remote - either works. All we ask is that you're based in the country/region this role is advertised in.
  • Additional benefits that might differ depending on the location. You shall be provided with the benefits details during or after your first conversation with one of our TA Specialists.


How AI helps us find great people

Think of our AI tool as a really smart assistant for our recruitment team. Its job? To help us move faster, stay consistent, and make sure no great candidates are overlooked. Every application goes through the same AI review to help us spot skills that match the role - but don't worry, AI never makes the decisions. Real people do. Our recruiters and hiring managers handle every final call. And we regularly review how the tool is used to keep things fair, ethical, and compliant with data protection laws. Curious about how it works? You can always ask how AI was used in your application - it won't affect your chances in any way.

Our Diversity and Inclusion Commitment:

We work in a highly creative and diverse industry so it goes without saying that we strive to create an inclusive environment for all. We welcome people from all backgrounds and are committed to fair consideration in our hiring process. If you have any accessibility needs or require reasonable adjustments during the interview process, please contact us at , so we can best support you.

Kindly submit your application and CV in English to ensure it is successfully reviewed.
