cadf21d160179509.title: Marketing Operations
cadf21d160179509.location: Paris, France; Bordeaux, France; Lyon, France; Marseille, France; Biarritz, France; Nantes, France; Annecy, France; Madrid, Spain; Barcelona, Spain
cadf21d160179509.description:
Health can’t wait.

Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t.

Alan exists to end the wait.

Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way.

So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience.

We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.

Marketing Ops is one of Alan's highest-leverage functions.

It sits at the intersection of marketing strategy, data, and technology — turning systems into growth engines and ensuring every touchpoint with prospects and members is timely, relevant, and scalable.

Alan is growing fast across France, Belgium, Spain, and Canada. But today we're leaving value on the table. On the prospect side, we drive more traffic but can't convert it properly: no scoring, no intelligent routing, no nurturing that adapts to buying intent. On the member side, messaging is one of our primary touchpoints for engagement, retention, and trust — yet nobody operates it strategically. Personalization stays shallow, communication pressure goes unmonitored, and shipping a message often means filing an engineering ticket.

We need Marketing Ops leaders who can architect scalable systems, operate them strategically, and progressively embed AI into workflows — to raise quality, reduce manual execution, and unlock growth without scaling headcount linearly.

⭐️ The Marketing Ops job ⭐️

We are hiring two Marketing Operations Managers, each embedded in a different crew:

  • Growth Infrastructure — focused on prospect acquisition: building a unified lead engine that captures, scores, routes, and nurtures across all channels

  • Product Platform — focused on member lifecycle messaging: operating Alan's messaging stack as a scalable service across 1.7M+ profiles

Both roles share the same DNA: strong marketing ops fundamentals, data fluency, a product mindset, and the ability to be both hands-on and strategic. Crew placement will be determined based on the candidate's experience, interests, and fit during the hiring process.

Why is this role interesting?

  • Speed: marketing, product, and sales teams ship campaigns and messages confidently — Marketing Ops turns bottlenecks into force multipliers across every crew

  • Trust: clean data, governed attributes, proper segmentation, and enforced rules mean the right person gets the right message at the right time

  • Scale: as we grow to millions of members across multiple countries, we need operators who keep our platforms clean and the user experience protected — without scaling headcount linearly

  • AI at the frontier: this isn't a maintenance role — you'll identify high-priority use cases for AI agents, train and refine them to a senior marketer's quality bar, and drive real adoption

What will you do with us?

You'll be a partnership with marketers — not a service desk. You'll partner closely with engineers, data, designers, and cross-functional stakeholders (PMMs, sales, growth, product) within a PM-Tech duo crew model.

Regardless of crew, you will own a core set of capabilities:

  • Marketing Automation & CRM: own and optimize our marketing stack (Customer.io, CRM integrations); build automations that enable marketers to launch campaigns independently, at scale, across all geos

  • Data Model & Governance: maintain CRM data quality, attribute/event design, and database hygiene as a sustained practice

  • Segmentation & Lifecycle Design: design and maintain lifecycle stages, segmentation logic, routing rules, and re-engagement flows across multiple audiences and geos

  • Nurturing Infrastructure: own the nurturing stack and campaign processes; make launches autonomous and compliant

  • AI-First Operations: identify, build, and refine AI agents for email copywriting, lead scoring, next-best-action recommendations, and content generation — making marketers AI-powered, not replacing them

  • Performance Monitoring: track the full funnel from first touchpoint to conversion; identify leakage and prioritize from data

  • Documentation & Enablement: create playbooks, train teams on tools and processes, reduce the marginal cost of new campaigns

Then, depending on your crew:

Growth Infrastructure — you'll build a unified lead engine (no more tool-by-tool silos), design lead scoring and routing models, crack multi-channel activation (email, WhatsApp, Voice AI), build AI agents that pre-qualify and enrich leads, and maintain a live feedback loop with BDRs, AEs, and Inbound Sales.

Product Platform — you'll operate Customer.io and back-end triggered emails as one governed system, monitor communication pressure and enforce channel rules, define and enforce recipient lifecycle paths, drive 100% Design Studio adoption, and co-own outbound messaging strategy with PMMs and product teams.

By your first year, we'll know it worked when:

  • At least one AI agent is in production on a key use case (email nurturing, lead categorization, content generation), with a second scoped or live, and adoption is real

  • Any marketer or product Alaner can launch a campaign or ship a message without bottlenecking through ops or engineering

  • CRM data model, attributes, and segments are properly owned, documented, and clean — the data we see is data we can act on

  • Every contact has a documented path through our messaging — segmentation is sharp, messaging is relevant, and pressure is monitored

  • Marketing's contribution to acquisition and engagement is visible and quantifiable, from first touch to conversion


⭐️ Is it you we are looking for? ⭐️


You'll be a great fit for this opportunity if you:

  • Have 5+ years in Marketing operations, growth ops, CRM ops, lifecycle marketing, or lead generation in a tech environment (B2B, B2C, or B2B2C)

  • Have hands-on experience managing marketing automation platforms at scale (Customer.io, Braze, Iterable, HubSpot, Marketo, Pardot, Salesforce, or equivalent)

  • Have a strong understanding of CRM data models — attribute/event design and data hygiene as a sustained practice

  • Can frame and implement processes for lead scoring, nurturing, segmentation, and personalization

  • Have a product knack: you can define what's not working, identify what to build next, and see problems as opportunities to bring more value

  • Bring data fluency and analytical rigor: you read platform and campaign data, surface anomalies, and draw business insights

  • Can be both hands-on and think strategically — you drive the big picture while staying close to execution

  • Have strong stakeholder management skills — you'll partner daily with engineering, product, sales, and marketing teams

  • Can manage multiple projects simultaneously in a fast-moving environment

  • Communicate with excellent written and spoken English

  • Are impact-driven with a strong bias towards improving processes

For this opportunity, we are aiming to hire within the C0-D level range.

🙌 Perks & Benefits

At Alan, we believe that being in good health is a basic need, and it starts with our employees. This is why Alaners are provided with a stimulating environment and perks ensuring they are happy, efficient and spend only high-quality time with co-workers.

Therefore, we offer:

  • Fair rewards. Generous equity packages complement your base salary, for permanent contracts only.

  • Flexible office with hybrid setup. Amazing office space at our Paris HQ or sponsored co-working hubs in Bordeaux, Lyon, Marseille, Nantes, Biarritz, Annecy, Brussels, Madrid or Barcelona.

⭐ Sales Team Lead (mid-market) ⭐

We're opening Sales Team Lead roles in France to lead some of our growing crews of Account Executives and scale some of our Mid-Market segments addressing companies of 30–300 employees.

In this role, you will own acquisition on one of the Mid-Market segments in France and run the business end-to-end. You'll be hands-on in the field while coaching and scaling a crew of Account Executives to win the associated market.

This position sits at the heart of our growth ambition. We have just passed the one million member milestone, and this is only the beginning. We're accelerating acquisition in France, and Mid-Market is one of the core pillars of that plan.

Why mid-market is exciting at Alan:

  • A large market with real momentum. You'll lead growth on a big B2B segment where our offer is already winning. We have strong references to build on.

  • Faster cycles, real stakes. Deals typically involve HR, Finance and the CEO, and sometimes a broker. Cycles are shorter than in Enterprise, so you see the results of your decisions quickly.

  • A strong product story. Companies in this range want a modern, digital health experience with fair pricing. They also want simple HR administration. This is where Alan stands out against traditional insurers and brokers.

  • Attractive economics. The segment has solid margins and is a key pillar of Alan's path to profitability in France.

⭐ What you will do ⭐

You will be the Sales leader of one of the Mid-Market crews in France, responsible for both hitting the numbers and building the machine. More precisely, you will:

  • Own the associated Mid-Market acquisition plan in France. Design and execute the go-to-market strategy for 30–300 employee customers, from targeting to closing, to reach ambitious acquisition targets.

  • Lead a team of Account Executives:

    • Drive hiring, onboarding and career development as we scale the crew.

    • Help each team member reach their targets with clear expectations, rigorous follow-up, and ongoing coaching on methodology, deal execution and pipeline management.

    • Be in the field with the team: joining key meetings, supporting tough negotiations, and owning strategic opportunities to maximize win rates.

  • Empower every member of the crew. Create the conditions for everyone to reach and exceed their goals: a strong feedback culture, clear ownership and autonomy.

  • Ensure market fit and remove blockers. Surface customer expectations, patterns and blockers. Make sure they're addressed through the right plans (product, pricing, ops, marketing, etc.).

⭐ Is it what you are looking for? You may be a great fit at Alan if you... ⭐

  • Have at least 6 years of experience in B2B sales, with a proven track record of hitting and exceeding targets as an Account Executive and Sales Leader

  • Have experience leading and coaching sales teams, with the ability to set a high bar, give clear direction and help people grow

  • Have full working proficiency in French, and an advanced level of English for internal communication

  • Have a very hands-on mentality: you love being in the field with your team, joining customer meetings, helping on tough negotiations and sharing what works

  • Have experience selling to mid-market companies (30–300 employees) in multi-stakeholder deals

  • Are comfortable operating in fast-paced, ambiguous environments, and can prioritize ruthlessly

  • Are data-driven and analytical: you know how to use KPIs to drive performance, run analyses and make decisions

  • Have strong cross-functional collaboration skills and an appetite for building things with others (sales ops, marketing, etc.)

  • Are based in (or willing to relocate to) Paris, Bordeaux, Marseille, Lyon, Nantes, Biarritz or Annecy

Nice-to-have:

  • Experience selling to HR, Finance and C-level stakeholders

  • Having already opened or scaled a new segment or market in a fast-growing company

  • Experience selling insurance, benefits, HR tech or SaaS

For this opportunity, we are aiming to hire within the D-F level range.

🙌   Perks & Benefits

At Alan, we believe that being in good health is a basic need, and it starts with our employees. This is why Alaners are provided with a stimulating environment and perks ensuring they are happy, efficient and spend only high-quality time with co-workers. 

Therefore, we offer:

  • Fair rewards. Generous equity packages complement your base salary, for permanent contracts only.

  • Flexible Office. Amazing office space at our Paris HQ or sponsored co-working hubs in Bordeaux, Marseille, Lyon, Annecy, Nantes or Biarritz.

  • All the tools you need. Top of the range equipment: Macbook Pro, keyboard, laptop stand, monitor, and Bose noise-canceling headphones.

🐼 Pourquoi Prévenir

Prévenir est un nouveau Service de Prévention et de Santé au Travail Interentreprises (SPSTI) en Île-de-France.

Notre ambition est de repenser la santé au travail pour améliorer l'impact sur la vie des salariés et l'expérience des professionnels de santé, en s'appuyant sur les moyens technologiques d'Alan.

Notre premier centre médical a ouvert ses portes au 117 Quai de Valmy (Paris 10ᵉ) et ce n'est que le début !

👉 Pour en savoir plus sur le quotidien chez Prévenir, c'est ici

💉 Le poste, concrètement

Vous êtes Assistant(e) Social(e) au sein d'une équipe pluridisciplinaire (médecins du travail, ASST, IPRP) avec laquelle vous co-construisez la pratique de Prévenir. Votre temps se répartit entre :

  • Accompagnement des salarié(es) dans leurs démarches sociales : retour d'arrêt, difficultés budgétaires, aidants, addictions, orientation vers les dispositifs

  • Participation aux cellules pluridisciplinaires de prévention de la désinsertion professionnelle (PDP) et construction des solutions de maintien dans l'emploi

  • Mobilisation du réseau institutionnel : MDPH, RQTH, Cap Emploi, Sameth, CAF, CPAM, Carsat

  • Conduite des actions collectives et des sensibilisations (aidants, retraite, budget, RPS)

  • Utilisation et enrichissement de nos outils numériques et d'IA, contribution à la construction du métier chez Prévenir

     

Ce qui change vs. un SPSTI classique :

  • Une équipe pluridisciplinaire à co-construire. Vous ne rejoignez pas un service figé : vous participez à dessiner la place du Psychologue du Travail chez Prévenir, les protocoles de délégation avec les médecins, et les passerelles avec Assistant Sociaux et IPRP

  • Des outils numériques co-construits avec vous. Une équipe d'ingénieurs et de designers Alan développe avec les soignants les outils dont ils ont besoin, DMST, parcours de prévention, supports de webinaires, expérimentations IA

  • Le mix présentiel / distanciel pensé comme un atout métier. Vous voyez les salariés et les entreprises sur le terrain quand c'est utile, et vous gardez le temps et les outils pour faire de la prévention de qualité à distance le reste du temps

  • DEASS (diplôme d'État d'assistant·e de service social, Bac+3) : obligatoire

  • 3 ans d'expérience, idéalement en santé au travail

  • Connaissance des dispositifs de maintien dans l'emploi, du handicap et de l'invalidité

  • Écoute, sang-froid, indépendance et sens de l'équipe pluridisciplinaire

  • Basé·e en Île-de-France ; à l'aise avec un fonctionnement hybride et les outils numériques

  • Lieu : 117 quai de Valmy (Paris 10ᵉ) - dans un centre tout neuf, pensé pour la qualité de l'exercice médical

864fafdbf565a42c.title: Marketing Operations
864fafdbf565a42c.description:
Health can’t wait.

Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t.

Alan exists to end the wait.

Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way.

So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience.

We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.

Marketing Ops is one of Alan's highest-leverage functions.

It sits at the intersection of marketing strategy, data, and technology — turning systems into growth engines and ensuring every touchpoint with prospects and members is timely, relevant, and scalable.

Alan is growing fast across France, Belgium, Spain, and Canada. But today we're leaving value on the table. On the prospect side, we drive more traffic but can't convert it properly: no scoring, no intelligent routing, no nurturing that adapts to buying intent. On the member side, messaging is one of our primary touchpoints for engagement, retention, and trust — yet nobody operates it strategically. Personalization stays shallow, communication pressure goes unmonitored, and shipping a message often means filing an engineering ticket.

We need Marketing Ops leaders who can architect scalable systems, operate them strategically, and progressively embed AI into workflows — to raise quality, reduce manual execution, and unlock growth without scaling headcount linearly.

⭐️ The Marketing Ops job ⭐️

We are hiring two Marketing Operations Managers, each embedded in a different crew:

  • Growth Infrastructure — focused on prospect acquisition: building a unified lead engine that captures, scores, routes, and nurtures across all channels

  • Product Platform — focused on member lifecycle messaging: operating Alan's messaging stack as a scalable service across 1.7M+ profiles

Both roles share the same DNA: strong marketing ops fundamentals, data fluency, a product mindset, and the ability to be both hands-on and strategic. Crew placement will be determined based on the candidate's experience, interests, and fit during the hiring process.

Why is this role interesting?

  • Speed: marketing, product, and sales teams ship campaigns and messages confidently — Marketing Ops turns bottlenecks into force multipliers across every crew

  • Trust: clean data, governed attributes, proper segmentation, and enforced rules mean the right person gets the right message at the right time

  • Scale: as we grow to millions of members across multiple countries, we need operators who keep our platforms clean and the user experience protected — without scaling headcount linearly

  • AI at the frontier: this isn't a maintenance role — you'll identify high-priority use cases for AI agents, train and refine them to a senior marketer's quality bar, and drive real adoption

What will you do with us?

You'll be a partnership with marketers — not a service desk. You'll partner closely with engineers, data, designers, and cross-functional stakeholders (PMMs, sales, growth, product) within a PM-Tech duo crew model.

Regardless of crew, you will own a core set of capabilities:

  • Marketing Automation & CRM: own and optimize our marketing stack (Customer.io, CRM integrations); build automations that enable marketers to launch campaigns independently, at scale, across all geos

  • Data Model & Governance: maintain CRM data quality, attribute/event design, and database hygiene as a sustained practice

  • Segmentation & Lifecycle Design: design and maintain lifecycle stages, segmentation logic, routing rules, and re-engagement flows across multiple audiences and geos

  • Nurturing Infrastructure: own the nurturing stack and campaign processes; make launches autonomous and compliant

  • AI-First Operations: identify, build, and refine AI agents for email copywriting, lead scoring, next-best-action recommendations, and content generation — making marketers AI-powered, not replacing them

  • Performance Monitoring: track the full funnel from first touchpoint to conversion; identify leakage and prioritize from data

  • Documentation & Enablement: create playbooks, train teams on tools and processes, reduce the marginal cost of new campaigns

Then, depending on your crew:

Growth Infrastructure — you'll build a unified lead engine (no more tool-by-tool silos), design lead scoring and routing models, crack multi-channel activation (email, WhatsApp, Voice AI), build AI agents that pre-qualify and enrich leads, and maintain a live feedback loop with BDRs, AEs, and Inbound Sales.

Product Platform — you'll operate Customer.io and back-end triggered emails as one governed system, monitor communication pressure and enforce channel rules, define and enforce recipient lifecycle paths, drive 100% Design Studio adoption, and co-own outbound messaging strategy with PMMs and product teams.

By your first year, we'll know it worked when:

  • At least one AI agent is in production on a key use case (email nurturing, lead categorization, content generation), with a second scoped or live, and adoption is real

  • Any marketer or product Alaner can launch a campaign or ship a message without bottlenecking through ops or engineering

  • CRM data model, attributes, and segments are properly owned, documented, and clean — the data we see is data we can act on

  • Every contact has a documented path through our messaging — segmentation is sharp, messaging is relevant, and pressure is monitored

  • Marketing's contribution to acquisition and engagement is visible and quantifiable, from first touch to conversion


⭐️ Is it you we are looking for? ⭐️


You'll be a great fit for this opportunity if you:

  • Have 5+ years in Marketing operations, growth ops, CRM ops, lifecycle marketing, or lead generation in a tech environment (B2B, B2C, or B2B2C)

  • Have hands-on experience managing marketing automation platforms at scale (Customer.io, Braze, Iterable, HubSpot, Marketo, Pardot, Salesforce, or equivalent)

  • Have a strong understanding of CRM data models — attribute/event design and data hygiene as a sustained practice

  • Can frame and implement processes for lead scoring, nurturing, segmentation, and personalization

  • Have a product knack: you can define what's not working, identify what to build next, and see problems as opportunities to bring more value

  • Bring data fluency and analytical rigor: you read platform and campaign data, surface anomalies, and draw business insights

  • Can be both hands-on and think strategically — you drive the big picture while staying close to execution

  • Have strong stakeholder management skills — you'll partner daily with engineering, product, sales, and marketing teams

  • Can manage multiple projects simultaneously in a fast-moving environment

  • Communicate with excellent written and spoken English

  • Are impact-driven with a strong bias towards improving processes

For this opportunity, we are aiming to hire within the C0-D level range.

🙌 Perks & Benefits

At Alan, we believe that being in good health is a basic need, and it starts with our employees. This is why Alaners are provided with a stimulating environment and perks ensuring they are happy, efficient and spend only high-quality time with co-workers.

Therefore, we offer:

  • Fair rewards. Generous equity packages complement your base salary, for permanent contracts only.

  • Flexible office with hybrid setup. Amazing office space at our Paris HQ or sponsored co-working hubs in Bordeaux, Lyon, Marseille, Nantes, Biarritz, Annecy, Brussels, Madrid or Barcelona.

You'll be joining the Sales Effectiveness team, whose mission is to make our sales organization run at its best across France, Belgium, Spain, and Canada. This team is a key lever on one of the company's most watched metrics: our customer acquisition cost.

You'll evaluate new tools and technologies, run tests, and roll out what works.

You'll mostly work with low-code tools (like Zapier or n8n), AI, Salesforce, SQL via Metabase, and whatever else the job calls for. Enablement is a key part of the role: you'll shadow, train, measure adoption, and iterate until change sticks.

10f957413a16e582.title: Sales Team Lead (Small / Mid-market)
10f957413a16e582.description:
Health can’t wait.

Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t.

Alan exists to end the wait.

Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way.

So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience.

We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.

⭐ Sales Team Lead (Small or mid-market) ⭐

We're opening Sales Team Lead roles in France to lead some of our growing crews of Sales:

  • Mid-market teams, covering companies with 30–300 employees.

  • A very small businesses team, covering companies with fewer than 10 employees, run fully inbound.

In this role, you will own acquisition on one of the Small / Mid-Market segments in France and run the business end-to-end. You'll be hands-on in the field while coaching and scaling a crew of Sales to win the associated market.

This position sits at the heart of our growth ambition. We have just passed the one million member milestone, and this is only the beginning. We're accelerating acquisition in France, and Mid-Market is one of the core pillars of that plan.

Why mid-market is exciting at Alan:

  • A large market with real momentum. You'll lead growth on a big B2B segment where our offer is already winning. We have strong references to build on.

  • Faster cycles, real stakes. Deals typically involve HR, Finance and the CEO, and sometimes a broker. Cycles are shorter than in Enterprise, so you see the results of your decisions quickly.

  • A strong product story. Companies in this range want a modern, digital health experience with fair pricing. They also want simple HR administration. This is where Alan stands out against traditional insurers and brokers.

  • Attractive economics. The segment has solid margins and is a key pillar of Alan's path to profitability in France.

⭐ What you will do ⭐

You will be the Sales leader of one of the Small / Mid-Market crews in France, responsible for both hitting the numbers and building the machine. More precisely, you will:

  • Own the associated Mid-Market acquisition plan in France. Design and execute the go-to-market strategy for 30–300 employee customers, from targeting to closing, to reach ambitious acquisition targets.

  • Lead a team of Sales:

    • Drive hiring, onboarding and career development as we scale the crew.

    • Help each team member reach their targets with clear expectations, rigorous follow-up, and ongoing coaching on methodology, deal execution and pipeline management.

    • Be in the field with the team: joining key meetings, supporting tough negotiations, and owning strategic opportunities to maximize win rates.

  • Empower every member of the crew. Create the conditions for everyone to reach and exceed their goals: a strong feedback culture, clear ownership and autonomy.

  • Ensure market fit and remove blockers. Surface customer expectations, patterns and blockers. Make sure they're addressed through the right plans (product, pricing, ops, marketing, etc.).

⭐ Is it what you are looking for? You may be a great fit at Alan if you... ⭐

  • Have at least 6 years of experience in B2B sales, with a proven track record of hitting and exceeding targets as an Account Executive and Sales Leader

  • Have experience leading and coaching sales teams, with the ability to set a high bar, give clear direction and help people grow

  • Have full working proficiency in French, and an advanced level of English for internal communication

  • Have a very hands-on mentality: you love being in the field with your team, joining customer meetings, helping on tough negotiations and sharing what works

  • Have experience selling to small or mid-market companies (30–300 employees) in multi-stakeholder deals

  • Are comfortable operating in fast-paced, ambiguous environments, and can prioritize ruthlessly

  • Are data-driven and analytical: you know how to use KPIs to drive performance, run analyses and make decisions

  • Have strong cross-functional collaboration skills and an appetite for building things with others (sales ops, marketing, etc.)

  • Are based in (or willing to relocate to) Paris, Bordeaux, Marseille, Lyon, Nantes, Biarritz or Annecy

Nice-to-have:

  • Experience selling to HR, Finance and C-level stakeholders

  • Having already opened or scaled a new segment or market in a fast-growing company

  • Experience selling insurance, benefits, HR tech or SaaS

For this opportunity, we are aiming to hire within the D-F level range.

🙌   Perks & Benefits

At Alan, we believe that being in good health is a basic need, and it starts with our employees. This is why Alaners are provided with a stimulating environment and perks ensuring they are happy, efficient and spend only high-quality time with co-workers. 

Therefore, we offer:

  • Fair rewards. Generous equity packages complement your base salary, for permanent contracts only.

  • Flexible Office. Amazing office space at our Paris HQ or sponsored co-working hubs in Bordeaux, Marseille, Lyon, Annecy, Nantes or Biarritz.

  • All the tools you need. Top of the range equipment: Macbook Pro, keyboard, laptop stand, monitor, and Bose noise-canceling headphones.

  • Flexible vacation policy and flexible working hours. Organize your time as you wish.

  • Delightful healthcare insurance. Extremely comprehensive health insurance - 100% of the contribution covered by Alan for you and your family, for permanent contracts only.

  • Transport. Country-specific commuter benefits.

  • Learning & Training opportunities. A highly flexible Training policy free books and budget to attend and speak at conferences if the opportunity arises.

  • Parental leave. Extended parental leave for all new parents, for permanent contracts only.

Important note: we hire people not roles. 

After reading this job description, if you feel like you don’t have all the necessary prerequisites but that it matches where you are now or what you'd like to grow into in your next position, we encourage you to apply!

Not everybody will enter our recruitment process, but all, no matter how underrepresented, should feel free to apply as it can only bring learnings or success.

🔖 Check out our About Alan and Career pages, as well as our Medium, blog and Glassdoor page for more info.

You will be part of the Business Strategy & Operations (BSO) team, whose goal is to

  • Define an ambitious strategy to achieve our business objectives and translate this into an actionable plan

  • Monitor and explain our performance towards our business objectives

  • Enable our Sales and Account Management teams to achieve these business objectives and become the most effective commercial teams in the tech industry (i.e., Sales and AM effectiveness, tools, analytics and training)

Across all these areas we work very closely with the Senior Leadership, the Sales, Account Management and Go-to-Market teams. The scope is Global (France, Belgium, Spain and Canada for the time being).

🎯 Your mission

You will be owning medium to large scale/complexity projects (depending on your skills and experience) on the Business Planning and Strategy area. These would include:

  • Business Strategy

    • Work closely with senior business leaders (Business leads, Insurance Lead, Marketing lead, CFO, CEO, etc.) to define Alan’s business plan

    • Frame business and resource allocation decisions (e.g. where to accelerate/slow down in terms of segments or products, where to deploy sales and marketing resources, how to optimize for short vs. long term, what are is the impact on metrics such as payback, LTV, CAC)

    • Propose adjustments to the plan on a quarterly basis and support Board preparation

  • Sales & Account Manager Planning

    • Translate the plan into actionable sales & Account Management objectives, ensuring their quality, scalability and accuracy

    • Build & improve the infrastructure to track these targets (dashboard, models) hand in hand with the data team

  • Performance monitoring & Steering

    • Lead or support strategic explorations (e.g. new segment, new distribution models) to frame strategic decisions

    • Monitor closely results and execution to gather learnings and adjust where necessary, sharing key learnings with the community and the company on a monthly basis

    • Work on transversal topics that allow us to gain insights & better steer the team performance (competition analysis, implementation & monitoring of pricing strategies, ...)

🧐 Skills we are looking for

We look above all for exceptional people motivated and committed in building one of the most effective Strategy and Planning team.

At least 3 years of experience within either:

  • Business strategy, sales strategy & operations, revenue operations or business finance/ strategic finance departments in a B2B company (preferably)

  • Management consulting, investment banking or private equity

Critical thinking and problem solving skills:

  • Ability to deal effectively with ambiguity, bringing structure to ambiguous areas of opportunity

  • Deep analytical rigour, bringing clarity on complex topics through deep insights

  • Great Excel skills and moderate SQL knowledge. Experience with AI tools and building moderate to complex flows.

  • Ability to handle workload & short turnaround time, with a high degree of adaptability and flexibility, when some topics are top priority for the company

Business sense:

  • At ease with B2B operational and financial metrics

  • Passion for getting close to the business and Sales/Marketing teams and understanding the operational details of their work, not just the strategic ones

Communication and presence:

  • Ability to communicate effectively with senior leadership and align multiple stakeholders in a collaborative way

  • Ability to build successful relationships with a broad range of stakeholders across Sales, Marketing, Product and Finance and be seen as a trusted contributor/advisor

  • Ability to work well under pressure, with a high degree of adaptability and flexibility

  • Great written and oral structure and communication

  • Fluency in English (French is a strong plus)

  • Being based in (or willing to relocate to) the Paris or Barcelona area

Nice to have

  • Experience with BI and visualization tools (Metabase, Tableau) and Salesforce

  • Experience in the SaaS/Tech sectors

  • Exposure to large sales teams (100+)

For this opportunity, we are aiming to hire within the C1-D level range.

Therefore, we offer:

  • Fair rewards. Generous equity packages complement your base salary.

  • Flexible Office. Amazing office space at our Paris HQ or Barcelona office

  • All the tools you need. Top of the range equipment: Macbook Pro, keyboard, laptop stand, monitor, and Bose noise-canceling headphones.

  • Flexible vacation policy and flexible working hours. organize your time as you wish.

  • Delightful healthcare insurance: Extremely comprehensive health insurance - 100% for you and your children, 90-100% for partners depending on your country (permanent contracts only).

  • Transport. Country-specific commuter benefits.

  • Learning & Training opportunities. A highly flexible Training policy free books and budget to attend and speak at conferences if the opportunity arises.

  • Personal growth through coaching: At Alan, coaching isn't just a perk - ****it's core to who we are. Every Alaner is paired with a dedicated coach from day one, who helps maximize their impact, nurture engagement, and navigate Alan's values to develop their full potential. Learn more about our coaching culture.

  • Parental leave. Extended parental leave for all new parents.

8f99c88efadf93dc.title: Psychologue du travail
8f99c88efadf93dc.description:
🐼 Pourquoi Prévenir

Prévenir est un nouveau Service de Prévention et de Santé au Travail Interentreprises (SPSTI) en Île-de-France.

Notre ambition est de repenser la santé au travail pour améliorer l'impact sur la vie des salariés et l'expérience des professionnels de santé, en s'appuyant sur les moyens technologiques d'Alan.

Notre premier centre médical a ouvert ses portes au 117 Quai de Valmy (Paris 10ᵉ) et ce n'est que le début !

👉 Pour en savoir plus sur le quotidien chez Prévenir, c'est ici

💉 Le poste, concrètement

Vous êtes Psychologue du Travail au sein d'une équipe pluridisciplinaire (médecins du travail, ASST, IPRP) avec laquelle vous co-construisez la pratique de Prévenir. Votre temps se répartit entre :

  • Analyses RPS (dans le cadre de la PDP) individuels et entretiens, dans le respect de la déontologie des psychologues et du secret professionnel

  • Accompagnement des situations de travail dégradées et participation aux cellules de prévention de la désinsertion professionnelle (PDP)

  • Conception et animation des ateliers collectifs et des formations auprès des salariés et des employeurs

  • Conduite des interventions collectives complexes (crises, réorganisations), contribution au projet Prévenir, tutorat et construction des outils et programmes RPS / QVCT

  • Restitution d'analyses de façon claire et neutre aux entreprises et à l'équipe pluridisciplinaire (IDEST, Médecins, IPRP, Assistants Sociaux)

  • Utilisation et enrichissement de nos outils numériques et d'IA, contribution à la construction du métier chez Prévenir

     

Ce qui change vs. un SPSTI classique :

  • Une équipe pluridisciplinaire à co-construire. Vous ne rejoignez pas un service figé : vous participez à dessiner la place du Psychologue du Travail chez Prévenir, les protocoles de délégation avec les médecins, et les passerelles avec Assistant Sociaux et IPRP

  • Des outils numériques co-construits avec vous. Une équipe d'ingénieurs et de designers Alan développe avec les soignants les outils dont ils ont besoin, DMST, parcours de prévention, supports de webinaires, expérimentations IA

  • Le mix présentiel / distanciel pensé comme un atout métier. Vous voyez les salariés et les entreprises sur le terrain quand c'est utile, et vous gardez le temps et les outils pour faire de la prévention de qualité à distance le reste du temps

 

👤 Le profil recherché

  • Master 2 de psychologie, idéalement psychologie du travail et des organisations

  • Aisance sur l'individuel, le collectif et l'organisationnel ; posture indépendante face aux employeurs

  • Sang-froid dans les situations dégradées, pédagogie, esprit d'équipe

  • Basé·e en Île-de-France, à l'aise avec un fonctionnement hybride

 

💚 Ce qu'on offre

  • Lieu : 117 quai de Valmy (Paris 10ᵉ) - dans un centre tout neuf, pensé pour la qualité de l'exercice médical

  • Rémunération de 47 300 € à 57 200 € par an, selon profil

  • Plan d'intéressement

  • Télétravail partiel possible

  • RTT

  • Prise en charge du transport quotidien

  • Restaurant d'entreprise

  • Formation linguistique offerte

  • Événements d'équipe réguliers

Pour en savoir plus sur notre politique salariale, c'est ici !

92e529b122ca6fc0.title: Stage - Chef de projet Supply Chain & Data (Paris ou Barcelone)
92e529b122ca6fc0.description:
Qui sommes-nous ?
SPRiNG est une marque innovante de lessive et de produits d’entretien, créée en 2020 pour proposer une nouvelle manière de consommer tout en réduisant l’effet des produits d’entretien sur la santé et sur l’environnement. Nous sommes en pleine croissance et cherchons un Chef de Projet Supply Chain & Data pour renforcer notre équipe Opérations.

Ton rôle
Nous recherchons notre futur·e Chef·fe de projet Supply Chain & Data. Ta mission : garantir à nos clients le meilleur niveau de service possible sur l'ensemble de nos produits, en pilotant nos opérations et en t'appuyant sur la data pour les améliorer en continu.

Opérationnel et amélioration continue

Analyses stratégiques et gestion de projet

  • Vivre de l'intérieur le développement d'une start-up en pleine croissance

  • Autonome, proactif·ve, positif·ve et débrouillard·e

d15a137a73dcfd16.title: Principal Product Manager, Acute Care CT
d15a137a73dcfd16.description:
The Principal Product Manager, Acute Care CT owns the DeepHealth Acute Care CT Suite end to end, with primary accountability for what to build and shared accountability for getting it shipped. DeepHealth is building the Acute Care CT Suite from the ground up to cover detection, care coordination, and reporting for emergency CT, starting with head CT and expanding to chest and abdomen, where minutes saved in stroke, bleeds, and trauma directly affect patient outcomes. The Principal Product Manager, Acute Care CT shapes the suite from day one: owning the roadmap, translating clinical needs into ML and product work, and driving cross-functional delivery on a subset of the suite from data through customer activation. The role does not write code or own technical software design.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

Product Strategy and Roadmap

  • Own the Acute Care CT Suite roadmap and define what to build, defer, or stop based on evidence.

  • Define suite scope across pathology detection modules, software capabilities such as alerting and care coordination, and comprehensive draft reporting.

  • Work with emergency radiologists and neuro/stroke teams to distinguish stated requests from real clinical needs, including time-to-treatment, triage, missed findings, and care coordination.

  • Translate clinical problems into ML work and set model metrics that reflect clinical value, including sensitivity versus false-positive burden.

  • Track the acute care market (including Aidoc, Viz.ai, RapidAI, Nicolab, and peers) and position products with Sales and Marketing.

  • Delivery and Cross-Functional Execution

  • Own delivery end to end on a subset of the Suite, from data to customer activation, including planning, coordination across data, ML, software, QARA, and Support, tracking, and escalation.

  • Run squads for new devices (typically 3 to 9 months), such as ASPECTS detection.

  • Coordinate with QARA on the regulatory impact of each release, including EU MDR and FDA 510(k).

  • Cut scope or move dates when needed, and escalate further as required.

  • Partner with engineering and technical leads without writing code or carrying technical software design.

PLEASE NOTE: This is not an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities and requirements of the position described above. Other functions may be assigned and management retains the right to add or change duties at any time.


Minimum Qualifications, Education and Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in a technical, scientific, clinical, business, or related field, or equivalent experience (required).

  • 8+ years in product or delivery for medical devices or medical imaging software, with products shipped end to end (required).

  • Knowledge of radiology and emergency department workflows (required).

  • Knowledge of machine learning in Clinical AI (required).

  • Experience running cross-functional delivery across data, ML, software, and QA/RA to fixed dates (required).

  • Fluent English (required).

  • Hands-on use of AI tools (Claude Code, ChatGPT, or similar) in current work (required).

  • Preferred: French language skills.

  • Preferred: Acute care, stroke, or emergency imaging background.

  • Preferred: Experience with SaMD and regulated environments (EU MDR, FDA 510(k)).

  • Quality Standards

  • Communicates, cooperates, and consistently functions professionally and harmoniously with all levels of supervision, co-workers, visitors, and vendors.

  • Demonstrates initiative, personal awareness, professionalism and integrity, and exercises confidentiality in all areas of performance.

  • Follows all local, regional and country laws concerning employment.

  • Follows all DeepHealth policies and procedures.

  • Follows data privacy, compliance, safety and confidentiality standards at all times.

  • Practices universal safety precautions.

  • Promotes good public relations on the phone and in person.

  • Adapts and is willing to learn new tasks, methods, and systems.

  • Reports to work regularly as scheduled; consistently punctual with respect to working hours, meal and rest breaks, and maintains satisfactory personal attendance in accordance with DeepHealth guidelines.

  • Completes job responsibilities in a quality and timely manner.

Travel

This position requires domestic / international travel up to 10%.

Unsere Mission

Photovoltaik wirtschaftlich, einfach und sorglos machen. Wir bringen die Energiewende ins Gebäude – mit intelligenten Lösungen für Eigenverbrauch & Elektromobilität, die sich für alle lohnen: Investor:innen, Nutzer:innen und unsere Zukunft.

Als ZEV-Pionierin ist Smart Energy Link (SEL) heute die führende Schweizer B2B-Plattform für Abrechnung und intelligente Steuerung dezentraler Energieinfrastruktur. Mit einem Team von rund 35 Mitarbeitenden haben wir bereits über 700 Projekte erfolgreich realisiert und betreuen mehr als 20'000 Wohneinheiten im Bereich ZEV und Metering.

Deine Rolle

SEL wächst vom Start-up zum Scale-up. Du sorgst dafür, dass man uns sieht, versteht und vertraut. Du schreibst gerne und erklärst komplexe Themen wie ZEV, vZEV, LEG und Energiemanagement verständlich, in Texten und Geschichten, die man mit Freude liest.

Der CEO gibt die Leitplanken für Marke und Kommunikation vor, du setzt sie eigenverantwortlich um. KI nutzt du selbstverständlich als Werkzeug. Bei uns erwarten dich kurze Wege, schnelle Entscheidungen und viel Raum für eigene Ideen.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Markenauftritt: Du achtest darauf, dass SEL in allen Texten, Bildern und Kanälen einheitlich und wiedererkennbar auftritt.

  • Medien: Du schreibst Medienmitteilungen, bereitest Referenzprojekte und Produktneuheiten für Fachmedien auf und pflegst den Kontakt zu Redaktionen.

  • Kund:innen und Partner:innen: Du informierst klar und verständlich über neue Funktionen, Änderungen oder Anlässe.

  • Employer Branding: Du vermittelst unsere Mission und unsere einzigartige Kultur glaubwürdig an zukünftige Mitarbeitende.

Content & Kanäle

  • Content Marketing: Du planst und erstellst Inhalte, von Referenzstorys über News bis zu Fachwissen, als Text, Bild und Video, und spielst sie kanalspezifisch auf Website, LinkedIn und Newsletter aus

  • Kanäle betreuen: Du bespielst die Website (CMS), LinkedIn und Newsletter und führst den Redaktionsplan.

  • Wissensbeiträge: Du baust unseren Content Hub laufend aus und schreibst so, dass man uns in Suchmaschinen und KI-Assistenten findet.

  • Wirkung: Du wertest Reichweite und Klicks aus und leitest daraus Verbesserungen ab.

Unterstützung & Anlässe

  • Unterlagen: Du aktualisierst Kundenunterlagen, die Unternehmenspräsentation und Kampagnenmaterial für unsere Fachbereiche.

  • Anlässe: Du unterstützt Messeauftritte, Partneranlässe und Webinare mit Unterlagen und Beiträgen, vor, während und nach dem Anlass.

Das bringst du mit

  • Du hast eine abgeschlossene Ausbildung in Kommunikation oder Marketing und bringst idealerweise Erfahrung mit im B2B-Marketing.

  • Du schreibst gerne, formulierst überzeugend, einfach und elegant.

  • Im Online-Marketing bist du zu Hause: CMS, SEO/GEO, Paid Ads, E-Mail-Marketing und Analytics.

  • Du arbeitest gerne selbständig, bist neugierig und probierst gerne Neues aus.

  • Du bist Optimist:in und willst etwas für eine erneuerbare Energiezukunft bewegen.

  • Erfahrung mit Bewegtbild, etwa kurzen Social-Media-Videos, ist ein Plus.

Was wir bieten

  • Bei SEL arbeitest du an etwas, das zählt: Du prägst die Zukunft des Schweizer Energiesektors mit. Tag für Tag.

  • Wir nehmen uns Zeit für deinen Start: Du wirst sorgfältig eingearbeitet und übernimmst die Stelle mit einer persönlichen Übergabe.

  • Du bringst dich ein und gestaltest SEL aktiv mit, inklusive Mitarbeitendenbeteiligung.

  • Wir fördern dein Lernen & Wachstum und beteiligen uns an Kursen, Aus- und Weiterbildungen.

  • Wir leben Flexibilität: Du gestaltest deinen Arbeitsalltag weitgehend selbst.

  • Wir arbeiten mit Jahresarbeitszeit und einer 40-Stunden-Woche.

  • plus: NIKIN-Hoodie, Füürabe-Aareschwumm und Glace im Gfrüürfach

Wir sind ein junges, agiles Team, das sich gegenseitig schätzt, fordert und weiterbringt. Offen, direkt und auf Augenhöhe. Wenn du Lust hast, wirklich etwas zu bewegen: Werde Energiepionier:in Kommunikation & Content bei SEL.

So geht's weiter

Bewirb dich direkt – wir melden uns innerhalb weniger Tage bei dir. Unser Prozess: ein kurzes Kennenlerngespräch per Telefon oder Video, ein ausführliches Interview vor Ort sowie Erarbeitung und Präsentation einer kurzen Fallstudie. Wir freuen uns, von dir zu hören.

9e935c4ef6d13a3c.title: AI-ready Solutions Architect - Workplace & Security
9e935c4ef6d13a3c.description:
Alle wollen Copilot und AI-Agents. Aber ist das Fundament überhaupt bereit dafür?

Wer Copilot auf einem chaotischen Tenant ausrollt, liefert seinen Mitarbeitenden einen sehr schnellen Weg zu Daten, die sie nie sehen sollten. Plötzlich findet jemand die Lohnliste der Geschäftsleitung oder den Entwurf zur Reorganisation. Du sorgst dafür, dass das nicht passiert: Du machst Workplace- und Cloud-Umgebungen von Schweizer Unternehmen bereit für AI, sicher und sauber aufgesetzt, hands-on und mit eigener Handschrift.

Wir bei Epic Fusion sind ein AI-native Team: unkompliziert, kurze Wege, viel Gestaltungsspielraum. Wir probieren Neues aus, ganz im Sinne von «Learn it over Know it», und bauen es direkt in unsere Prozesse ein. Nicht alles funktioniert auf Anhieb, aber wir lernen schnell und bauen auf dem auf, was sich bewährt. Ein fertiges Prozesshandbuch für jede Situation gibt es bei uns nicht. Wenn du das brauchst, sind wir nicht die Richtigen. Wenn du es lieber selbst schreibst, schon.

Das gestaltest du bei uns:

  • Fundament legen: Du entwirfst Zielarchitekturen für Modern Workplaces mit Intune, Entra ID, Defender, Windows 365 und Azure Virtual Desktop.

  • AI-ready machen: Du räumst Identitäten, Berechtigungen und Datenklassifizierung auf, damit Copilot und Agents nur sehen, was sie sehen dürfen.

  • Absichern: Du entwickelst Security- und Governance-Konzepte mit Defender, Purview und Agent 365.

  • Automatisieren: Was zweimal von Hand passiert, löst du mit Graph API, PowerShell oder Infrastructure as Code.

  • Richtung geben: Du analysierst Kundenumgebungen, setzt klare Prioritäten und erklärst sie so, dass Technik und Management wissen, was als Nächstes passiert. Neue Microsoft- und AI-Features testest du, bevor sie beim Kunden ankommen.


Du passt zu uns, wenn …

  • du Intune, Entra ID und M365 konfigurieren kannst und auch erklären kannst, warum etwas so sein muss. Azure und Defender sind dir nicht fremd.

  • du mehrere Jahre im Microsoft-Cloud- oder Security-Umfeld gearbeitet hast und weisst, wie Tenants in der Realität aussehen.

57cbf2bdd0bbe169.description:
Build Everest with us. Find exceptional businesses, lead acquisitions and help secure the capital to grow.

About Everest

Everest is building an AI-native holding company. Our ambition is to acquire profitable, established businesses and strengthen them through exceptional people, disciplined operations and Everest Core, our shared operating, data and AI backbone. We are developing the team and acquisition strategy for this next chapter, with a particular interest in durable service businesses.

Your role

We are looking for an entrepreneurial dealmaker to work directly with the founder and help build Everest for the long term. You will shape where we invest, build relationships with owners and capital partners, and lead transactions from the first conversation through closing and handover. The ambition is to build the capabilities and capital base for progressively larger acquisitions.

What you will own

  • Define our acquisition criteria and priority sectors, focusing on profitability, durable demand, recurring or repeat revenue and capable management.

  • Build and own dealflow through relationships with business owners, intermediaries, investors and operators.

  • Lead underwriting, valuation, financial modelling, diligence, negotiation and transaction execution, coordinating specialist advisers.

  • Work with the founder on fundraising, lender relationships and acquisition financing, including equity, debt and seller participation.

  • Develop an operating and integration case with company leaders and the Everest Core team, then track performance against the investment thesis.

Your first priorities

  • Translate the strategy into a focused acquisition profile and a realistic capital plan.

  • Build a qualified pipeline and assess the first serious opportunities.

  • Develop investment cases and financing relationships that support an executable first acquisition.

The opportunity

A founding leadership role with substantial responsibility for Everest's direction and growth. We want to explore a long-term partnership with equity participation for the right person. Compensation, equity, working arrangements and any formal co-founder position will be agreed individually before joining.

Location

Amsterdam

Apply

Apply through Recruitee with your CV and a short introduction. In your introduction, please cover the points below using anonymised examples where needed. Do not share confidential deal materials.

  • Describe one or two completed transactions, your exact role and what you learned.

  • Which type of profitable business would you prioritise for Everest, and why?

  • What experience do you bring with acquisition financing or fundraising, and why do you want to build a company?

  • Your location, availability and compensation expectations.


  • Direct responsibility for completed acquisitions, with clear examples of your personal contribution to sourcing, underwriting, financing or closing.

  • Strong commercial and financial judgment, including cash flow, business quality, debt capacity and downside risk.

  • The ability to earn trust with business owners, investors, lenders and advisers, and build relationships from scratch.

  • A hands-on, entrepreneurial approach and the ambition to build an enduring company, team and acquisition capability.

  • Experience in private equity, corporate development, investment banking, acquisition entrepreneurship or a comparable transaction role. Practical interest in using AI to improve research, diligence and operations.

33b53cf9b8925c55.description:
Customer Operations Director 

Do you know how to combine customer focus, commercial awareness and operational excellence? 

 

As Customer Operations Director, you will lead our customer service, order management and sales support teams across our international Building Automation markets.

Your goal is to make sure customers and partners get fast, reliable and consistent service, from their first question to final delivery. 

This role is for a leader who sees the bigger picture and knows how to turn it into effective day-to-day operations. 

 

What will you do? 

You are responsible for the full customer journey after first contact. That covers answering customer questions and requests, processing orders, following up on quotes, and coordinating deliveries and service. You work closely with Sales, Technical Support, Supply Chain and Finance. 

 

You will: 

  • Lead and develop teams across multiple countries: set clear roles, coach team leaders, and manage capacity and service levels. 

  • Bring customer service, order management and sales support together into one way of working, with clear ownership and smooth handovers between teams and countries. 

  • Support Sales: handle incoming requests, follow up on quotes and orders, and keep customer data in the CRM accurate. Sales keeps ownership of accounts, pricing and targets. 

  • Set up a clear process for technical customer questions with our Technical Support team, from first response to escalation. 

  • Work with Supply Chain on product availability and delivery dates, and keep customers and Sales informed when issues come up. 

  • Simplify processes, reduce manual work, and standardize ways of working across countries while respecting local language and market needs. 

  • Work with IT to improve how teams use our CRM, order management system and customer portals. 

  • Use customer feedback and data to improve service, and share insights with Sales and Product. 

  • Lead the organization through change together with HR and country managers, while keeping service levels high. 

 

In addition: 

  • You have 10+ years of experience in customer service, order management and/or sales support in a B2B environment. 

  • You have 5+ years of leadership experience, including managing team leaders and being responsible for service performance. 

  • You have a proven track record of improving processes and leading change, ideally across multiple countries. 

  • You combine commercial awareness with operational discipline. 

  • You have experience with CRM and order management systems, and you know how to turn data into practical improvements. 

  • Experience in building automation, technical products or subscription services is a strong plus. 

  • You are fluent in Dutch and professionally proficient in English. German is a plus. 

  • You are willing to travel regularly between teams and markets. 

 

What you get   
In numbers  

  • A competitive salary based on your experience;  

  • We find a healthy work-life balance important: working flexible hours combined with 30 vacation days a year and the option to buy more;  

  • 8% holiday allowance;  

  • Travel allowance of € 0,23/km with a daily maximum of 150 kilometers.  

  

For your own sustainability  

  • Be secured with our pension plan;  

  • Feel engaged and join our participation plan; 

  • Keep on learning with your personal education possibilities and budget;  

  • Be happy and fit by using our healthy cafeteria, our free on-premises fitness where you can participate in CrossFit, Pilates and Spinning classes or play table tennis or table football. 

 

Ready to make an impact? 

Do you want to take Customer Operations within Building Automation to the next level and build a strong, scalable and customer-focused organization for our customers and partners? 

Then we would love to meet you. Apply for the position of Customer Operations Director and discover how you can make an impact at Priva.

17e60500ea1e9ac3.description:
Headquarters: Texas, United States
URL: http://betterhelp.com/linkedin

BetterHelp is a technology-enabled mental health marketplace that connects patients with therapists and psychiatric providers covered by their insurance plans. By bringing patients, providers, and insurers together, we aim to remove barriers to care and help more people find the right support for their needs.

Why Join BetterHelp

  • Competitive earning potential: Estimated effective hourly earnings of $119–$242 per hour*, based on modeled assumptions for a 60-minute period that may include patient visits and applicable CPT codes.
  • Expand access to mental healthcare: Provide psychiatric care to individuals who may otherwise face barriers to finding an available provider who accepts their insurance.
  • Deliver collaborative care: Work alongside BetterHelp’s network of licensed therapists to provide thoughtful, evidence-based treatment.
  • Spend more time on patient care: BetterHelp supports credentialing, payer enrollment, and platform operations so you can focus on your patients.
  • Work from anywhere: Deliver care 100% remotely through BetterHelp’s telemedicine platform.
  • Build a schedule that works for you: This is a flexible, part-time 1099 contract opportunity.

What You’ll Do

You’ll provide compassionate, evidence-based psychiatric care in a convenient virtual setting including:

  • Conduct video consultations and communicate with patients through telemedicine.
  • Assess, screen, diagnose, and prescribe medication when clinically appropriate.
  • Develop individualized treatment plans based on each patient’s needs.
  • Coordinate treatment planning and care delivery with BetterHelp’s network of licensed therapists.
  • Deliver empathetic, high-quality care while upholding BetterHelp’s clinical and service standards.
  • Share feedback with BetterHelp’s product, engineering, and operations teams to help improve the provider and patient experience.

Who We’re Looking For

We’re looking for psychiatrists who are passionate about expanding access to mental healthcare and comfortable delivering high-quality care virtually.

You’ll be a strong fit if you have:

  • At least one year of experience as a licensed Psychiatrist.
  • An active medical license (MD/DO) in good standing.
  • Experience prescribing medication when clinically appropriate and permitted by applicable state law.
  • Confidence using technology and online tools to deliver virtual care.
  • Strong communication skills and a patient-centered approach.

Even better if you have:

  • Previous telemedicine experience.
  • Active medical licenses in multiple states.
  • Fluency in additional languages.

Important to Know

  • This is a part-time, independent contractor (1099) position, not a salaried employee role.
  • BetterHelp will support credentialing and enrollment with multiple health plans to help expand access to insured patients.
  • All patient care is delivered remotely through BetterHelp’s telehealth platform.
  • Licensed providers make all clinical decisions independently and in accordance with applicable state telehealth laws, regulations, and professional standards.

License/Certification

  • Medical License (Required)

Location

  • United States (Required)
  • Work location: Remote

*Estimated effective hourly earnings of $119–$242 are illustrative estimates for licensed Psychiatrists and are not a guaranteed hourly rate, wage, or salary. Estimates are derived from modeled assumptions regarding the number of completed visits per hour, CPT code mix, and utilization of add-on codes (such as 90833) when clinically appropriate and properly documented. Actual earnings will vary based on individual clinical decisions, case mix, scheduling availability, payer reimbursement, licensure, geographic market factors, and other applicable considerations.

a564b772bdb3d5bf.title: Form Health: Endocrinology Physician (Remote)
a564b772bdb3d5bf.description:
Headquarters:
URL: http://formhealth.co

Form Health is a virtual obesity medicine clinic delivering multi-disciplinary evidence-based obesity treatment through telemedicine. Obesity impacts more than 40% of the US adult population, and although historically only about 1% of patients received medical treatment for their disease, the field of Obesity Medicine is entering a period of rapid growth. Form Health provides high-quality expert care and leverages technology to enhance the patient experience. All Form Health patients work closely with their care team, which includes board certified physicians, advanced practice professionals and Registered Dietitians. Through our proprietary mobile app patients engage in regular video visits, as well as text messaging, photo journaling, digital data transmission, and customized educational materials. We hold ourselves to the highest standards of clinical care, and to treating every individual with empathy and respect. 

Founded in 2019, Form Health is a venture-backed innovative startup with an experienced clinical and leadership team. Our mission is to empower patients and be leaders in Obesity Medicine driving impact at a national scale. We are deeply invested in our core value to put patients first, and also deeply committed to creating a culture where every employee is valued and we learn and improve together.

 

About the Role:

We are seeking Physicians specialized in Endocrinology and Obesity Medicine to join our innovative, multidisciplinary chronic disease management team. A valid medical license to practice and prescribe legally in any US state is required, and eligibility to obtain additional state licenses as needed is required.

This role is designed for an American Board of Internal Medicine (ABIM) certified Endocrinologist with demonstrated expertise in obesity medicine, comprehensive diabetes management, and a strong interest in working collaboratively with Endocrine Advanced Practice Providers (APPs) in providing high-quality patient care.

A critical aspect of this role is ensuring the safe and effective management of patients with complex co-morbidities, including Chronic Kidney Disease (CKD), End-Stage Renal Disease (ESRD), and Cardiovascular conditions. The physician will help enhance the consistency, safety, and effectiveness of patient care across the team, specifically integrating the use of Continuous Glucose Monitors (CGMs) and insulin pump therapy.

This is a fully remote W-2 position (US-based), with flexible scheduling options: 32 total hours per week, 36 total hours per week, or 40 total hours per week. From the total working hours, 80% will be clinical/patient-facing care, and 20% administrative time.

What You Will Do:

  • Provide direct patient care in a telemedicine clinical setting, focusing on evidence-based treatment for obesity and comprehensive diabetes management, including insulin titration and care of patients who may already be using insulin pumps and/or continuous glucose monitors (CGMs)
  • The role could involve having your own panel of patients, or collaborating with APPs and Registered Dietitians specializing in diabetes treatment, primarily Type 2 Diabetes. This role could involve APP collaboration and supervision, as needed
  • Review charts and conduct initial and return visits to ensure quality, continuity of care, and appropriate management of CKD/ESRD and CAD/CV conditions
  • Provide advanced treatment planning and medical management support for complex endocrinology cases, escalated concerns, and patients requiring specialized management protocols.
  • Prescribe non-controlled medications, including those for obesity and diabetes, for patients under both direct care and in coordination with APPs
  • Ensure clinical documentation, protocols, and treatment pathways are followed consistently within the team, with a focus on guidelines for managing complex diabetic populations
  • Assist in the professional development of colleagues by fostering clinical growth, offering feedback, and supporting continuing education in both endocrinology and obesity medicine
  • Participate in team-based care initiatives and contribute to a culture of collaboration and high-quality care
  • Attend relevant departmental meetings and contribute to quality improvement efforts within the diabetes and obesity medicine program

About You:

  • Must have an MD or DO degree
  • Required: Valid and current Board certification in Endocrinology by the American Board of Internal Medicine (ABIM)
  • Highly Preferred: Certification by the American Board of Obesity Medicine (ABOM) 
  • 2 years of clinical experience and pharmacotherapy (older generation oral and newer injectable medications) in obesity medicine or endocrinology, post residency OR completed an accredited Fellowship program in Endocrinology or Obesity Medicine, in lieu of years of experience
  • Required: Active and unrestricted Medical State License in any US State, and eligibility to obtain additional state licenses (IMLC preferred, but not required)
  • Must be currently opted-in with Medicare
  • Demonstrated competency and comfort in managing patients with complex co-morbidities, including CKD, ESRD, and CAD/CV conditions
  • Expertise in advanced diabetes management, including the use of CGMs, insulin pumps, and complex insulin regimens
  • Interest in mentoring, teaching, and collaborating with Endocrine-Specialized APPs and Registered Dietitians specializing in diabetes, as needed
  • Demonstrated experience working with APPs, medical residents, or trainees in a clinical academic setting
  • Adherence to evidence-based treatments, behavioral interventions, nutrition, and pharmacotherapy for both endocrine disorders and obesity
  • Open to working one of the following W2 roles: 32hrs/week, 36hrs/week or 40hrs/week
  • Committed to delivering patient-centered, culturally competent care
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
  • Experience providing synchronous patient care in a telehealth setting is preferred
  • Bilingual candidates with medical fluency in Spanish are desired, but not required

Form Health’s benefits:

  • Competitive salary 
  • Comprehensive health benefits. Medical, dental, vision: from day 1
  • 401k program
  • Flexible work schedules and paid time off
  • Paid parental leave
  • Ability to participate in Form4Form, Form Health's weight loss program available to all employees and their dependents
Base Annual Salary
$210,000—$250,000 USD

Form Health’s commitment to building a diverse, equitable, and inclusive work environment:

Form Health is committed to creating a culture and environment that celebrates diversity and inclusion, while fostering safety and belonging. This extends from our remote patient care to our corporate offices and everywhere in between. We are looking for team members who want to help us further our Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion (DEI) efforts and who share our attitudes for creating an inclusive, safe, and positive work environment. 

Work Authorization: Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States by their start date. Form Health does not provide employment-based immigration sponsorship for this position.

  • Independently Licensed in Massachusetts as a Licensed Independent Clinical Social Worker (LICSW), Licensed Marriage & Family Therapist (LMFT), Licensed Mental Health Counselor (LMHC), or Licensed Psychologist (PhD or PsyD). 
  • Willing and motivated to become licensed in other states. We'll cover the entire cost. 
  • 2+ years of clinical experience with adults (18+), 6+ months of teletherapy experience, proficiency with clinical assessments (e.g., PHQ-9), and comfort with EHR systems.

About the Role

  • Deliver remote, evidence-based therapy to adult clients (18+), practicing modalities like CBT, DBT, ACT, MBCT, TLDP, IPT, EFT, and MI.
  • Schedule & Caseload:
    • Maintain a client caseload of 7-20 sessions per week, with a commitment of 8-24 total hours of weekly availability Monday - Friday, 8:00 a.m. - 9:00 p.m. EST. 
    • Approximately 85% of total time will be dedicated to direct client care, including ongoing therapy sessions and new client assessments.
    • Available for manager check-ins (1 hour/week during your first 6 weeks, followed by 30 minutes/month.
  • Use data to drive effective treatment and adjust your approach based on client progress.
  • Collaborate with other mental health providers as needed and refer clients when appropriate.
  • All documentation to be completed, signed, and locked in EMR within 48 hours of client contact.

About Two Chairs

Two Chairs is setting a new standard in mental health care with seamlessly integrated therapy and psychiatry delivered by highly trained clinicians, powered by smart technology, and measured for real impact. By combining timely access, personalized care, and proven outcomes — we’re creating a system that works — for patients, providers, health plans, and clinicians alike. With that, we're excited and honored to have been recognized as a 2025 Great Place to Work and 2025 Fortune’s Best Workplaces in Healthcare.

One of our company values is "Embrace Differences" and diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging are the principles guiding how we build our business and teams. We encourage interested candidates from all backgrounds to apply, even if you don't think they meet some expectations of the role.

What to Expect After Applying: Our Interview Process

Once you complete your interviews and sign your offer, you can begin onboarding in as little as 7 days!

56f95839291438d8.title: Parallel: Speech-Language Pathologist – Kentucky (Part-Time, Remote) – 2026–27
56f95839291438d8.description:
Headquarters: United States
URL: http://surterra.com

Parallel is hiring a Kentucky-licensed Speech-Language Pathologist for a 17.5-hour-per-week remote assignment with a Kentucky school district partner. The role covers direct speech therapy for an elementary caseload, starts in November 2026, and runs through the end of the school year (May 2027).

Are you a dedicated clinician driven to make a meaningful difference in the lives of children with learning differences? Join a team where providers are treated as part of the school community, not as a stopgap, and help students build the communication skills they need to thrive.

Assignment at a Glance

Detail This role Location Remote, serving a Kentucky school partner Hours 17.5 hours per week Caseload Elementary caseload, shared with another Parallel SLP; a mix of speech-only students and some case management Dates November 2026 (ASAP) – May 28, 2027 Schedule 3:1 model: three weeks of direct therapy each month, plus a set “district week” for evaluations, reports, IEP meetings, and make-ups Time zone Weekday school hours, Central Time Classification 1099 independent contractor

What You’ll Do

  • Provide student-centered, IEP-aligned virtual speech therapy to elementary students.
  • Use the monthly district week for evaluations, report writing, IEP meetings, and make-up sessions.
  • Serve as case manager for a portion of the caseload, coordinating IEP timelines and paperwork.
  • Partner with school teams to monitor and refine IEP goals, and join IEP meetings as needed.
  • Track session data and student progress, and write quarterly progress reports.
  • Document services in Infinite Campus and log Medicaid billing in EZ ED MED.
  • Collaborate with the district’s special education team and the other Parallel SLP serving this caseload.

What You’ll Need

  • Current ASHA Certificate of Clinical Competence (CCC-SLP).
  • Active Kentucky SLP licensure.
  • At least 1 year of school-based experience delivering IEP-directed therapy after your clinical fellowship.
  • Solid knowledge of the IEP process, goal writing, case management, and progress monitoring, plus the ability to ramp up quickly on a mid-year start.
  • Availability for 17.5 hours per week during weekday school hours, Central Time.
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to build rapport with students, families, and school staff.
  • Comfort with virtual telehealth platforms and digital documentation.
  • Experience with Infinite Campus or Medicaid billing is a plus.

Compensation

Pay starts at $52/hour and varies depending on state and experience. This is a 1099 role only. A Clinical Recruiter can walk you through the full breakdown and answer any questions you may have about compensation.

If you’re seeking flexible, rewarding work with a team that truly supports its clinicians, we’d be excited to hear from you.

👋 About Parallel

Parallel is the first tech-forward provider of care for learning and thinking differences across the United States. We believe learning differences are parallel ways of thinking that should be celebrated. Our mission is to provide students with the resources and encouragement to succeed in the classroom and beyond by helping them build confidence in their unique strengths and create strategies to work around their challenges.

Parallel simplifies the process of getting support for learning differences by consolidating providers and resources on a single platform. We connect students with qualified professionals while significantly reducing waiting times, costs, and confusion.

Our core services include:

  • Psychological Assessment
  • Counseling
  • Speech-Language Services
  • Special Education
  • And more

Learn more at parallellearning.com.

Our Commitment to Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion

At Parallel, we believe in celebrating differences. This belief extends from schools into our workplace and through the ways we work together toward our mission. We are committed to fostering a diverse, accessible environment that represents many different cultures, backgrounds, viewpoints, and abilities by championing diversity, equity, and inclusion.

We are committed to building and fostering a diverse workforce, including individuals from historically marginalized groups, and creating a workplace where employees’ strengths are championed, differences are celebrated, and no one is discriminated against based on age, race, ancestry, religion, sex, gender identity and expression, sexual orientation, pregnancy, marital status, physical or mental disability, military or veteran status, national origin, or any other protected characteristic.

We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer committed to building a diverse, equitable, and inclusive organization where different learners and thinkers can thrive.
