d45802860cf0d670.title: Project Specialist, Operations
d45802860cf0d670.description:
Job Description

We have an exciting opportunity for a Project Specialist at UL Research Institutes. This is a remote Opportunity.


The Project Specialist supports accurate, timely, and compliant financial administration across the organization. This role manages expense and invoice processing, purchase order creation, vendor onboarding, expense tracking, and financial reporting through Workday while providing dependable support to managers and the Education Director


UL Research Institutes:

At UL Research Institutes (ULRI), we expand the boundaries of safety science to create a more secure and sustainable world. For more than a century, we have studied the unintended consequences of innovation, designed solutions to mitigate risk and shared our findings with academia, scientists, manufacturers, and policymakers across industries. We identify critical safety and sustainability issues, asking the tough questions because we believe a safer world begins with knowledge.


Build a safer, more secure, and sustainable future with us. Join us and work with our Research Experiences & Education teams who conduct the research required to produce that knowledge and put into practice.


IREE:

The Institute for Research Experiences & Education advances UL Research Institutes’ public safety mission by bringing ULRI safety science research and UL Standards & Engagement standards to students and educators across the education continuum through open-access platforms and resources shaped by educational research. Embracing a model in which the expertise of educators and researchers inform each other, our institute engages educators and youth in rigorous learning and educational experiences that build awareness, knowledge and skills, and critical thinking so everyone can see themselves as part of the safety sciences.


What you’ll learn and achieve:

As the Project Specialist, you will play a key role in the rapid growth of ULas you:

  • Enter and maintain financial information for expense reports and invoices, ensuring transactions are accurately coded, properly documented, and processed in a timely manner.
  • Create purchase orders and coordinate required legal and administrative processes to support vendor engagements and business purchases.
  • Set up and maintain records for new vendors in Workday, ensuring required information and documentation are complete and accurate
  • Monitor and maintain expense tracking tools, follow up on outstanding submissions, and ensure expense reports are submitted and processed according to established procedures. Prepare and submit expense reports on behalf of leaders, ensuring supporting documentation is complete and expenses are accurately recorded.
  • Review financial information and identify discrepancies in reporting, timelines, and required documentation, following up as appropriate to support accurate and timely processing. Maintain organized financial records and follow applicable organizational policies and procedures related to purchasing, expenses, vendor management, and financial reporting.
  • Collaborate and communicate effectively with internal teams, leaders, vendors, and other stakeholders to support accurate and timely financial administration.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

What you’ll experience working at UL Research Institutes:We have pursued our mission of working for a safer, more secure, and sustainable world for nearly 130 years, embedding conscientious stewardship into everything we do.

  • People: Our people make us special. You’ll work with a diverse team of experts respected for their independence and transparency and build a network, because our approach is collaborative. We collaborate across disciplines, organizations, and geographies to build the global scientific response that today’s global challenges require.
  • Interesting work: Every day is different for us here. We see what’s on the horizon and use our expertise to build the foundations of a safer future. You’ll have the opportunity to push the boundaries of human understanding as part of a team working to advance the public good.
  • Grow and achieve: We learn, work, and grow together through targeted development, reward, and recognition programs.
  • Values. Four core values guide our work: collaboration, respect, integrity, and beneficence. By living our values, we inspire the trust essential to fulfilling our mission and foster the partnerships that enable us to pursue a beneficent future in which we all can thrive.
  • Total Rewards: All employees at UL Research Institutes are eligible for bonus compensation. We offer comprehensive medical, dental, vision, and life insurance plans and a generous 401k matching structure of up to 5% of eligible pay. Moreover, we invest an additional 4% into your retirement saving fund after your first year of continuous employment. Depending on your role, you may be able to discuss flexible working arrangements with your manager. We also provide employees with paid time off, including vacation, holiday, sick, and volunteer days.

What makes you a great fit:

While no one candidate will embody every quality, the successful candidate will bring many of the following professional competencies and personal attributes:

  • Strong attention to detail with a commitment to accuracy and quality.
  • Highly organized and skilled in managing multiple tasks, priorities, and deadlines.
  • Effective problem-solving skills with the ability to identify discrepancies and resolve routine issues.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to exercise sound judgment and discretion when handling confidential or sensitive information.
  • Strong interpersonal and collaboration skills with the ability to work effectively across teams and with internal and external stakeholders.
  • Demonstrates accountability and consistent follow-through on assignments and responsibilities.
  • Ability to adapt to changing priorities and respond effectively to time-sensitive assignments.

Professional education and experience requirements for the role include:

  • Bachelor's degree in business administration, finance, accounting, or a related field.
  • Minimum 4 years of experience in financial administration, bookkeeping, accounts payable or expense administration.
  • Working knowledge of expense reporting, invoice processing, purchase orders, and vendor administration.
  • Experience using Workday or a similar financial management system.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office and other relevant business applications.

About UL Research Institutes and UL Standards & Engagement

UL Research Institutes and UL Standards & Engagement are nonprofit organizations dedicated to advancing safety science research through the discovery and application of scientific knowledge. We conduct rigorous independent research and analyze safety data, convene experts worldwide to address risks, share knowledge through safety education and public outreach initiatives, and develop standards to guide safe commercialization of evolving technologies. We foster communities of safety, from grassroots initiatives for neighborhoods to summits of world leaders. Our organization employs collaborative and scientific approaches with partners and stakeholders to drive innovation and progress toward improving safety, security, and sustainability, ultimately enhancing societal well-being.

To learn more, visit our websites and ULSE.org.

233cb30bb7c74e71.description:
We’re seeking a HR Product Manager Performance to lead the simplification and modernization of our performance management concept. This role requires superb communication skills to craft clear, motivating, and actionable messages for both leaders and employees. It also demands user-centered design thinking to streamline processes and develop materials that resonate with real needs. You’ll be at the intersection of performance management, storytelling, and product thinking to align our approach with organizational goals, while ensuring that it’s engaging, clear, and practical.

  • Simplify & Streamline Processes: Reimagine and redesign performance management workflows to align with employee needs, business goals, and modern practices.
  • Craft Motivational Messaging: Develop clear and compelling communications that inspire both employees and leaders to take ownership of performance conversations and goals.
  • User-Centered Design: Apply UX and customer experience principles to make performance management easy to understand, practical, and actionable for all stakeholders.
  • Align with Organizational Goals: Ensure that performance management processes are aligned with strategic objectives and other HR initiatives.
  • Link Performance & Reward: Develop a clear and transparent connection between performance management and compensation in close collaboration with Compensation & Benefits, ensuring alignment with reward principles and business goals.
  • Collaborate with HR, IT, and Leadership Teams: Work closely with cross-functional teams to ensure the integration of performance management tools and processes with other HR systems and platforms.
  • Measure Impact: Use analytics and feedback loops to track effectiveness and continuously improve the performance management experience for all employees.
  • Lead Change Management: Support the successful adoption of new processes and messaging, working with leadership to drive cultural and behavioral change.

You have a completed university degree with a focus on Business Administration, Human Resources, Psychology or a comparable qualification and already have minimum 5 years of professional experience in the field of performance management.

Furthermore, you distinguish yourself through the following knowledge and skills:

  • Superb Communication Skills: A storytelling mindset with the ability to create compelling messages, simplify complex concepts, and inspire action from leaders and employees.
  • User-Centered Design Expertise: Strong background in UX design, customer experience, or service design. You know how to tailor processes and content based on user needs and feedback.
  • Performance Management Knowledge: A solid understanding of modern performance management principles (e.g., continuous feedback, goal setting, competency frameworks) and how to link them to organizational performance.
  • Digital & Product Mindset: Experience in applying digital tools, product thinking, and iterative design processes to improve performance-related processes and materials.
  • Strategic Alignment: Ability to align performance management systems with broader organizational objectives and integrate them with other HR processes.
  • Your English is on the highest level.
  • You are flexible for business travels.

Benefits

We believe in balance between work and personal life. An attractive and extensive work-life balance portfolio guarantees lasting motivation for employees and thus a better quality of life, promotes physical and mental well-being and contributes to a positive work environment. All this with the aim of providing more freedom in reconciling work, career growth, private life and individual lifestyle. Therefore we offer to our employees over 25 different benefits to improve their personal and professional life in these areas:

  • Financial benefits
  • Benefits with focus on learning and development
  • Benefits with focus on health and sport
  • Benefits with focus on family and work – life balance
  • Other benefits

For more information about our benefits click to Benefits

Salary

Final salary is negotiable.

We are offering base salary depending on seniority level and previous experience of candidate. In addition to base salary we provide variable part and other financial benefits. Base salary will not be lower than 1820 € /brutto.

Additional information

* Please be informed that our remote working possibility is only available within Slovakia due to European taxation regulation.

Our brand Deutsche Telekom IT Solutions Slovakia entered the life of Košice region in 2006 under the name of T-Systems Slovakia and ever since has been inextricably linked with the region when became one of the founding members of Košice IT Valley. We have managed to grow from scratch to the second largest employer in the eastern part of the country with more than 3900 employees. Our goal is to proactively find new ways to improve and continuously transform into the type of company providing innovative information and communication technology services.

7279f40d83192e51.title: Oracle SCM Solution Architect (Presales)
7279f40d83192e51.description:
Maini Consulting is seeking an experienced Oracle Fusion SCM Pre-sales and Solutions Manager to lead Oracle SCM Cloud solutioning and presales initiatives. This client-facing leadership role requires deep SCM domain expertise, strategic thinking, and strong relationship management skills.

You will play a key role in defining, shaping, and delivering Oracle SCM Cloud solutions aligned with client supply chain transformation goals. Working closely with sales, delivery, and technical teams, you will ensure client requirements are translated into scalable, innovative, and business-driven SCM solutions. This is an exciting opportunity for an SCM expert passionate about supply chain transformation, operational excellence, and cloud-enabled digital innovation.

Key Responsibilities

Presales Leadership

  • Lead presales engagements across Oracle Fusion SCM Cloud modules including Procurement, Inventory, Order Management, Manufacturing, Planning, Logistics, and Warehouse Management.
  • Deliver impactful product demonstrations, solution presentations, and executive briefings tailored to client business needs.

Solution Design & Architecture

  • Design end-to-end SCM solutions using Oracle Fusion SCM Cloud aligned with client operational and supply chain transformation initiatives.
  • Ensure solutions follow industry best practices, scalability standards, and process optimization frameworks.

Client Engagement

  • Collaborate with Supply Chain leaders, CIOs, Procurement heads, Operations leaders, and business stakeholders to understand strategic objectives and operational challenges.
  • Translate complex supply chain and operational requirements into cloud-enabled SCM solutions delivering measurable business outcomes.

Collaboration

  • Work closely with internal sales, delivery, offshore teams, and Oracle solution consultants to develop winning strategies and aligned solution approaches.
  • Support smooth transition from presales to implementation teams to ensure delivery continuity and customer satisfaction.

Thought Leadership

  • Lead discovery workshops, roadmap discussions, and value assessment sessions to position Oracle SCM Cloud as the preferred transformation platform.
  • Stay current with Oracle SCM product innovations, AI-driven automation, analytics, and supply chain optimization capabilities.

Proposal & RFP Management

  • Own SCM solution strategy and responses for RFPs, RFIs, and client proposals.
  • Develop differentiated solution narratives highlighting operational efficiencies, cost optimization, and business value.

Quality Assurance & Oversight

  • Provide advisory oversight during early implementation phases to ensure alignment between proposed and delivered solutions.
  • Support project teams and act as a trusted advisor for strategic SCM accounts.

Qualifications

Experience
  • 10+ years of experience in Oracle Fusion SCM Cloud solution architecture, implementation, and/or presales roles.
  • Proven experience leading large-scale SCM transformation and presales engagements.


SCM Expertise
  • Deep functional knowledge across Oracle SCM Cloud modules including:
Procurement & Self-Service Procurement
Inventory Management
Order Management
Supply Chain Planning
Manufacturing
Warehouse Management (WMS)
Logistics & Transportation Management
Product Lifecycle Management (PLM)
Strategic & Business Acumen
  • Skilled in articulating ROI and TCO for Oracle ERP Cloud transformations.
  • Ability to engage business and IT stakeholders in value-driven conversations around finance and operational transformation.

Leadership
  • Experience leading cross-functional, global teams in complex sales and solutioning environments.
  • Strong customer focus and executive presence.

Communication
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to explain complex concepts to both business and technical audiences.

Preferred
  • Oracle Cloud certifications.
  • Experience in multi-pillar Oracle Cloud deals (e.g., ERP + SCM or ERP + EPM).
  • Familiarity with industry-specific needs (e.g., manufacturing, public sector, higher education, healthcare).


What do we offer?
  • Competitive compensation
  • Comprehensive health benefits package
  • Holidays and PTO
  • 401K with match

801ce90b022ef37f.title: Social Media & Content Specialist
801ce90b022ef37f.description:
Consertus is an AI-native global capital program management and advisory firm that combines deep human expertise with advanced digital tools to deliver smarter, faster, and more sustainable outcomes. Headquartered in Miami, Florida, and supported by more than 1,500 professionals worldwide, we help clients plan, execute, and optimize large-scale capital programs.


Our integrated services span digital, advisory, engineering and design, and delivery. We serve aviation, transportation, transit, water, healthcare, energy, education, government, commercial, life sciences, and technology markets.


We celebrate individual strengths, foster strong relationships, and promote flexibility in how and where we work. Learn more at .


About this Role:


Consertus is seeking a creative, strategic, and highly organized Social Media & Content Specialist to manage our social media presence and translate brand, corporate communications, and marketing initiatives into compelling content that strengthens awareness, credibility, and engagement.

Reporting to the Vice President of Brand & Corporate Communications, this hands-on specialist will manage social editorial planning, content creation, publishing, community engagement, analytics, and optimization. The role will also support executive thought leadership, industry awards, campaigns, company announcements, and other marketing and communications initiatives.

The ideal candidate brings 4 to 7 years of experience, excellent writing and editorial judgment, a strong understanding of B2B audiences, and experience working with senior leaders and subject-matter experts. This person should be comfortable helping executives leverage LinkedIn to share their perspectives, strengthen their professional presence, and create visibility for Consertus' services, expertise, and AI solutions.


Key Responsibilities

Social Media Strategy & Channel Management


  • Develop and manage social media plans across relevant platforms, including monthly and quarterly editorial calendars, publishing schedules, and platform-appropriate messaging.
  • Manage day-to-day channel publishing and operations, with attention to audience needs, brand consistency, and timely execution.
  • Monitor platform trends, emerging formats, competitor activity, and industry conversations to identify opportunities for visibility, engagement, and audience growth.
  • Build efficient processes for content intake, creative requests, approvals, and publishing.

Content Creation & Editorial Development


  • Proactively source stories and content opportunities from project milestones, client successes, employee experiences, events, industry insights, company news, and awards.
  • Write and edit engaging, on-brand social copy and adapt articles, webinars, customer stories, presentations, announcements, and thought leadership into compelling social content.
  • Develop creative briefs and direction for graphics, video, and digital assets; collaborate with the Brand Creative Team and outside creative resources as needed.
  • Work with executives and subject-matter experts to translate complex business, technical, and AI topics into accessible, compelling content while maintaining an authentic voice and consistent brand positioning.
  • Support senior leaders in using LinkedIn effectively, including developing content, identifying opportunities to engage their networks, and sharing Consertus' expertise, services, and AI solutions.
  • Apply sound editorial judgment and coordinate appropriate client, project, legal, and confidentiality approvals before publication.

Content Marketing & Corporate Communications


  • Support website copy, articles, employee and project spotlights, campaign messaging, and other branded marketing communications materials.
  • Coordinate industry award submissions, including information gathering, drafting, stakeholder input, and deadline management.
  • Assist with executive perspectives, thought leadership, conference communications, event promotions, company milestones, and post-event recaps.
  • Organize and maintain marketing content and assets to keep materials accurate, current, and accessible.

Community Engagement, Analytics & Optimization


  • Monitor social comments, questions, brand mentions, and relevant industry conversations; respond or escalate as appropriate.
  • Identify opportunities to strengthen engagement with customers, prospects, partners, employees, and industry communities and support executive visibility and employee advocacy.
  • Track reach, engagement, traffic, audience growth, and other relevant performance indicators, sharing regular reports and actionable recommendations.
  • Test messaging, formats, and approaches, using audience insights and performance data to continuously improve results.

Collaboration & Execution


  • Partner with Marketing, Sales, Corporate Communications, leadership, the Brand Creative Team, and subject-matter experts to support marketing and business objectives.
  • Coordinate deadlines, deliverables, stakeholder reviews, and approval workflows to ensure timely, accurate, high-quality content.
  • Operate independently, recommend new ideas, and help establish scalable, repeatable content management practices.

Minimum Qualifications


  • 4 to 7 years of experience in social media, content marketing, digital marketing, corporate communications, or a related field.
  • Experience independently managing professional social media channels, publishing schedules, and content calendars.
  • Excellent writing, editing, storytelling, and editorial judgment, including the ability to simplify complex subject matter.
  • Strong understanding of B2B social media and content marketing, particularly LinkedIn.
  • Experience working with senior executives or business leaders to develop social content, thought leadership, or executive communications.
  • Experience with social media management and analytics platforms and the ability to translate performance data into actionable recommendations.
  • Strong organization, project management, stakeholder management, and deadline management skills.
  • Ability to balance strategic thinking with hands-on execution and collaborate effectively with executives, subject-matter experts, and creative teams.
  • Portfolio or work samples demonstrating social media writing, campaigns, content development, or channel management.

Key Competencies


  • Strategic and creative content thinker with excellent editorial instincts.
  • Self-directed executor who can manage competing priorities and establish effective workflows.
  • Analytical marketer who translates performance insights into content improvements.
  • Confident communicator who is comfortable working with senior executives and helping them translate their expertise into effective social content.

Preferred Qualifications


  • Experience in B2B technology, professional services, engineering, infrastructure, or other complex industries.
  • Experience supporting executive LinkedIn presence, thought leadership, or employee advocacy programs.
  • Experience communicating AI, technology, digital transformation, or complex solutions to business audiences.
  • Basic graphic design or video-editing capabilities and familiarity with Canva, Adobe Creative Cloud, HubSpot, Hootsuite, Sprout Social, Buffer, or comparable tools.
  • Curiosity about emerging social formats and AI-enabled content tools.

Working Hours & Location:


This full-time position is open to candidates nationwide within the United States. Remote work is available for candidates who are not within reasonable commuting distance of a Consertus office; candidates near a Consertus office may work on a hybrid basis. Occasional flexibility may be required for time-sensitive announcements, campaigns, and events.


Compensation:


The expected base salary range for this position is $68,000–$80,000 annually. Actual compensation will be based on experience, skills, qualifications, location, and other relevant factors. Additional benefits and/or incentive compensation may apply under Consertus programs.


What’s In It for You:


  • Comprehensive health coverage, including medical, dental, and vision.
  • Optional benefits including pet insurance, legal insurance, and supplemental health plans.
  • 401(k) with day-one eligibility, including a 100% company match on the first 3% of eligible compensation and a 50% match on contributions between 3% and 5%.
  • 10 paid company holidays.
  • PTO starting at 15 days annually and growing to up to 25 days.
  • Access to Consertus Academy for ongoing professional development and learning.

Why This Role Matters


You will help define how Consertus shows up across social channels and turn the expertise of our people into stories that resonate with clients, prospects, partners, employees, and industry audiences. Your work will strengthen the brand, elevate thought leadership, support executive visibility, and build a more consistent and measurable social media and content program.


How to Apply:


If you are a strategic, hands-on social media and content professional interested in helping shape Consertus’ voice, apply through the Consertus Careers portal and upload your most recent resume (PDF preferred). Please include relevant portfolio or work samples.


Equal Employment Opportunity Statement:


Consertus is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and identities, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, disability, age, veteran status, or any other protected status.

7fbff6034ac5a0ac.title: SDR Manager
7fbff6034ac5a0ac.description:
We're on the lookout for an experienced SDR Manager to lead and grow our global Sales Development team. HeroDevs is the leading provider of Never-Ending Support for sunsetted open source software, helping organizations in government, healthcare, education, technology, and finance stay secure and compliant on frameworks that have reached end-of-life.

Reporting to the Director of Sales, you'll lead a team of 3–5 SDRs and own the engine that creates pipeline for our Account Executives. You'll build outbound programs around real buying signals, run a tight inbound process with Marketing, and coach SDRs into future AEs. This is a global role: you can be based anywhere (US preferred), and you'll support pipeline across all of our markets.

What You'll Do

  • Lead, coach, and develop a team of 3–5 SDRs, running weekly 1:1s, call reviews, and team pipeline meetings
  • Own SDR targets for meetings booked, opportunities created, and pipeline generated, and report on them to sales leadership
  • Build and run signal-based outbound programs targeting accounts on end-of-life frameworks, open CVEs, and upcoming audit or compliance deadlines
  • Design, test, and optimize multi-channel sequences/flows (email, phone, LinkedIn) in Gong, using data to improve reply and conversion rates
  • Partner with Marketing on inbound lead routing, speed-to-lead, and MQL qualification standards
  • Work with Account Executives and Customer Success to define handoff criteria and rules of engagement, and improve meeting-to-opportunity conversion
  • Maintain clean pipeline and activity data in Salesforce, and use call recordings to coach messaging and objection handling
  • Working with Revenue Operations to ensure systems
  • Recruit, hire, and onboard new SDRs, and build a clear career path from SDR to AE
  • Help refine our ICP, personas, and messaging with Sales, Marketing, and Product as we expand our product lines

Skills and Experience Required

  • Minimum 3–5 years of experience in a sales management role, leading SDR/BDR or inside sales teams
  • Track record of hitting team targets for meetings, pipeline, and revenue contribution
  • Experience building outbound programs from ICP definition through sequencing and reporting
  • Deep, hands-on experience with Salesforce (critical), including pipeline reporting, dashboards, and activity tracking
  • Strong understanding of sales performance metrics and funnel conversion
  • Experience hiring, onboarding, and coaching reps, including promoting SDRs into closing roles
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience selling to technical buyers (engineering, security, or IT leaders)
  • Experience in the software security, open source, or developer tools industry
  • Experience with Gong (strongly preferred), Clay, Nooks, MeetAlfred, and Claude AI
  • Experience building SDR programs in a fast-growing, remote-first company

At HeroDevs, we believe in the power of diversity, equity, and inclusion to drive innovation, creativity, and success. We are committed to creating a workplace that embraces and celebrates individual differences. We encourage people of all backgrounds and experiences to apply.

We offer a flexible, innovative environment where your ideas matter and your career can thrive.
Regnology is a global leader in regulatory reporting, helping financial institutions, regulators, and tax authorities improve data quality, efficiency, and cost savings. Our mission: to safeguard financial markets through smarter, future-ready solutions.

What you'll do


This is a Customer Success–embedded systems role focused on designing scalable support workflows, automation, tooling, AI-enabled process improvements, and integrations.


Key Responsibilities


  • Partner with Customer Success leadership to understand operational needs and translate them into scalable system solutions.
  • Design and improve workflows for ticket management, alerts, escalations, SLA tracking and handling, and collaboration between teams.
  • Identify where AI can meaningfully support or automate parts of a workflow, and help implement practical AI-supported solutions.
  • Use AI tools confidently for analysis, workflow design, automation, documentation, and operational improvements.
  • Own and continuously improve tools such as Jira Service Management and Microsoft 365.
  • Use data from tools such as Power BI as an input for automation, triggers, monitoring, and operational workflows rather than as a reporting-only function.
  • Identify opportunities to reduce manual work through workflow automation, system integrations, AI, and data-driven triggers.
  • Collaborate with IT and technical teams on solution architecture, integrations and APIs, data flows, governance, and system dependencies.
  • Lead or support system integrations and migrations.
  • Document tooling, workflows, automation logic, and system configurations.
  • Continuously identify opportunities to simplify and improve the CS/support operating model.

Why we should decide on you


  • 2+ years of experience in areas such as support operations, business systems, workflow automation, service management, or similar.
  • Hands-on experience with workflow automation and Jira Service Management.
  • Good understanding of SLAs, including how SLA logic, priorities, statuses, and escalations interact within support workflows.
  • Good understanding of ITIL concepts, especially incident, request, and change management.
  • Comfortable working with AI tools and able to recognize where AI can add value within operational processes.
  • Ability to work with data from tools such as Power BI, APIs, exports, or system databases and use that data within automations or workflow logic.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to translate relatively vague business requirements into practical cross-team solutions.
  • Strong stakeholder management and collaboration skills.
  • Bonus: experience with scripting, low-code tools, APIs, webhooks, Power Automate, or similar integration technologies.
  • Familiarity with AI concepts and its potential application in a business environment

Why you should decide on us


  • Market Leadership: Join a global leader where our agile culture and innovative spirit allow you to shape the future of financial stability.
  • International Scope: Take ownership of high-profile international projects and benefit from our global internal mobility initiatives.
  • Growth & Mentorship: Access a wide range of our technical and functional training opportunities.
  • Culture of Inclusion: We foster a supportive, transparent atmosphere with frequent team events and a commitment to diversity.

To get a first impression, we only need your CV and look forward to meeting you in a (personal/virtual) interview!

8b0ad1a0012ace55.title: NEN Solution Engineering – Sr. Voice Engineer
8b0ad1a0012ace55.description:
We are seeking a seasoned, hands-on Senior VoIP, VTC, and Telephony Solution Engineer to support the design, integration, validation, deployment, and sustainment of enterprise Unified Communications and Collaboration solutions.

Reporting to the Voice/VTC Manager, this position will serve as a senior technical contributor and may act as the technical lead for assigned projects, workstreams, or engineering efforts. The engineer will be responsible for developing solutions to complex technical problems that span multiple systems or disciplines and for helping ensure assigned solutions are secure, resilient, supportable, and operationally ready.

The engineer may provide technical direction, coordinate the work of engineers supporting an assigned project, review engineering products, and mentor less-experienced team members, but will not be responsible for employee performance management, staffing decisions, or organizational workforce planning.

The successful candidate will remain actively engaged in requirements analysis, alternatives analysis, solution architecture, detailed design, laboratory validation, implementation planning, system integration, testing, and Tier 3/Tier 4 engineering escalations. The position will work closely with Transport Engineering, Network Operations, Cybersecurity, program leadership, customers, telecommunications carriers, and technology vendors.


Key Responsibilities


1. Technical Project and Workstream Leadership

  • Technical Execution: Lead the technical planning and execution of assigned VoIP, VTC, telephony, and collaboration projects or workstreams.
  • Project Coordination: Coordinate engineering activities across multiple technical areas, identify dependencies, track technical milestones, and support the timely completion of project deliverables.
  • Technical Direction: Provide technical guidance to engineers assigned to a project, review engineering work products, and help resolve technical issues that could affect cost, schedule, performance, or operational readiness.
  • Risk Management: Identify technical risks, constraints, assumptions, and dependencies and recommend practical mitigation approaches to project and engineering leadership.
  • Estimating and Planning: Support the development of engineering estimates, bills of material, staffing assumptions, implementation schedules, and levels of effort.

  • VTC and Collaboration: Design and integrate multi-vendor VTC and audiovisual collaboration environments, including Cisco Room Series and Webex devices, Poly, Microsoft Teams Rooms, Crestron, Zoom Rooms, and comparable technologies.
  • Cloud and Hybrid Integration: Develop integrations between on-premises voice infrastructure and cloud collaboration platforms such as Microsoft Teams Phone, Direct Routing, Operator Connect, Webex Calling, and comparable services.
  • Availability and Resiliency: Develop technical requirements and designs for high availability, geographic redundancy, survivability, disaster recovery, capacity management, and service continuity.
  • Technology Evaluation: Conduct product evaluations, proof-of-concept activities, interoperability testing, and technical risk assessments for new or replacement voice, video, and collaboration technologies.
  • Technical Roadmaps: Contribute technical analysis, lifecycle data, recommendations, and implementation considerations to technology-modernization and product-roadmap activities.

4. Hands-On Engineering and Technical Escalation

  • Session Border Controllers: Configure and troubleshoot enterprise SBC technologies, including AudioCodes, Ribbon, Cisco CUBE, Oracle Communications Session Border Controller/Acme Packet, or comparable platforms.
  • Complex Troubleshooting: Resolve complex voice and video problems involving call routing, signaling, media negotiation, interoperability, packet loss, jitter, latency, one-way audio, call quality, and service availability.
  • Root-Cause Analysis: Perform detailed technical investigations, identify underlying causes, develop corrective actions, and document lessons learned.
  • QoS and Transport Integration: Collaborate with Transport and Network Engineering to design and validate end-to-end Quality of Service, including DSCP and Layer 2 Class of Service marking, queuing, shaping, policing, call-admission control, bandwidth planning, and class-of-service mapping.
  • Network Analysis: Evaluate routing, switching, VLAN, firewall, Network Address Translation, DNS, certificate, and transport conditions that affect voice and video services.
  • Monitoring and Service Assurance: Support monitoring, alerting, call-quality analytics, call-detail records, capacity reporting, and trend analysis for enterprise voice and video services.

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work with Transport Engineering, Network Operations, Cybersecurity, program management, customers, and operations personnel to align technical solutions with infrastructure, security, and operational requirements.
  • Technical Communication: Explain technical issues, risks, alternatives, and recommendations to engineers, project leaders, client team members, and other stakeholders.
  • Design Reviews: Lead or participate in technical interchange meetings, peer reviews, architecture reviews, test-readiness reviews, and implementation-readiness reviews.
  • Vendor Coordination: Coordinate technical activities with equipment manufacturers, software providers, telecommunications carriers, SIP service providers, subcontractors, and system integrators.
  • Technical Influence: Develop well-supported technical recommendations and work with project and engineering leaders to gain acceptance of proposed designs, processes, or corrective actions.

Required Experience and Education

  • Professional Experience: Typically requires a bachelor’s degree and 8–12 years of relevant experience, or a master’s degree and 6–10 years of relevant experience. Equivalent relevant education, certifications, and practical experience may be considered.

  • Engineering Lifecycle: Experience performing requirements analysis, solution design, alternatives analysis, integration, testing, implementation planning, documentation, and transition to operations.
  • Technical Mentoring: Experience providing technical guidance, peer review, training, or mentoring to other engineers. Formal supervisory or people-management experience is not required.
  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Telecommunications, Electrical Engineering, Systems Engineering, or a related field.

Preferred Technical Proficiencies

  • Cloud and Hybrid Voice: Experience integrating on-premises telephony with cloud collaboration services, including Microsoft Teams Direct Routing, Operator Connect, Webex Calling, or comparable platforms.
  • Network and QoS Analysis: Strong working knowledge of IP networking, routing, switching, VLANs, firewalls, Network Address Translation, SIP and media traversal, packet analysis, QoS policy design, and bandwidth planning.
  • Security and Identity: Working knowledge of SIP TLS, mutual TLS, SRTP, certificates and PKI, directory services, identity integration, secure configuration baselines, vulnerability remediation, and configuration management.
  • Troubleshooting Tools: Demonstrated ability to use Wireshark, platform traces, SBC logs, call-detail records, monitoring systems, and other diagnostic tools to isolate signaling, media, network, and interoperability problems.

Leadership and Communication Skills

0de7fdc82af91832.title: Account Executive
0de7fdc82af91832.description:
About Whistic:

Whistic is an agentic risk operations platform that helps security and compliance teams assess, monitor, and manage third-party vendor risk. By combining automated assessments, continuous vendor monitoring, and compliance controls in one platform, Whistic replaces slow, manual risk processes with intelligent workflows, giving teams audit-ready visibility and letting them move faster.

We're a values-driven company: Extreme Ownership, Customer Focused, Driven by Results, and Do What's Right, Speak Up guide everything we do.

The Role:

As an Account Executive at Whistic, you'll drive revenue growth through both new customer acquisition and strategic account expansion.

You'll own the sales process from initial engagement through close, while also building relationships with existing customers to identify new opportunities across business units, stakeholders, and platform capabilities.

You'll engage with security, risk, compliance, IT, and executive stakeholders to understand their business priorities and demonstrate how Whistic can help them work more efficiently, reduce risk, and achieve better outcomes.

Success in this role requires strong business acumen, consultative selling expertise, technical curiosity, and the drive to consistently deliver results.

What You’ll Do:

Drive New Business Growth

  • Own the full sales cycle, from prospecting and discovery through demonstrations, proposals, negotiations, and close.
  • Build and manage a healthy pipeline through inbound opportunities, strategic partner referrals, and proactive outbound prospecting.
  • Engage business and technical stakeholders to understand their challenges and develop compelling business cases.
  • Navigate complex, multi-stakeholder buying processes, including security evaluations, procurement, and legal negotiations.
  • Develop and execute account strategies that create opportunities and accelerate deal progression.

Grow Strategic Customer Relationships

  • Build trusted relationships with existing customers, including executive sponsors and key decision-makers.
  • Identify and pursue expansion opportunities through additional use cases, platform capabilities, and business units.
  • Develop strategic account plans that align Whistic's capabilities with customers' evolving priorities.
  • Collaborate with Customer Success to understand customer objectives, identify growth opportunities, and support long-term account success.
  • Lead commercial conversations for upsell, cross-sell, and expansion opportunities.

Sell Value and Deliver Results

  • Lead consultative discovery that connects customer challenges to measurable business outcomes.
  • Deliver compelling product demonstrations and presentations tailored to technical practitioners and executive audiences.
  • Articulate Whistic's value in operational efficiency, risk reduction, compliance readiness, and business agility.
  • Maintain accurate pipeline visibility, forecasting, and CRM discipline.
  • Consistently meet or exceed revenue targets through disciplined execution and thoughtful account management.

Help Shape How We Grow

  • Partner with Sales Engineering, Marketing, Partnerships, Customer Success, and Product to deliver an exceptional customer experience.
  • Share customer feedback, competitive insights, and market trends to help improve our products and go-to-market strategy.
  • Develop a strong understanding of cybersecurity, third-party risk management, and the evolving technology landscape.
  • Leverage AI and modern sales tools to improve productivity, uncover insights, and create better customer experiences.

What Success Looks Like:

We care about what you've accomplished, how you approach challenges, and what you're capable of achieving next.

You'll likely thrive at Whistic if you bring:

  • A track record of winning. You've consistently delivered results in a quota-carrying B2B SaaS sales role, with demonstrated success in new business acquisition and account growth.
  • A growth-oriented mindset. You enjoy the challenge of landing new customers and the strategic work of expanding relationships with existing accounts.
  • Consultative selling expertise. You ask thoughtful questions, uncover business challenges, and help customers connect technology investments to measurable outcomes.
  • Strong business acumen. You understand how organizations evaluate technology investments and can articulate value to both technical and business decision-makers.
  • Strategic account management skills. You can develop account plans, build executive relationships, identify whitespace opportunities, and expand relationships across complex organizations.
  • Strong deal execution. You can navigate multiple stakeholders, manage competing priorities, and maintain momentum through complex buying processes.
  • Technical curiosity. You enjoy learning new technologies and can quickly develop the expertise needed to engage sophisticated buyers.
  • Operational discipline. You take forecasting, qualification, pipeline management, and CRM accuracy seriously because you understand their connection to results.
  • An ownership mentality. You're accountable, adaptable, coachable, and comfortable taking initiative in an evolving environment.
  • A collaborative approach. You're competitive about results but generous with knowledge, feedback, and support for your teammates.

What You’ll Need:

  • 3+ years of successful B2B SaaS sales experience, including ownership of new business opportunities.
  • Demonstrated success achieving or exceeding sales quotas.
  • Experience selling complex technology solutions to multiple stakeholders, including technical and executive buyers.
  • Experience managing and expanding strategic customer accounts through upsell and cross-sell opportunities.
  • Experience selling into security, IT, compliance, risk, or other enterprise business functions.
  • Familiarity with structured sales methodologies such as MEDDPICC, MEDDICC, or similar frameworks.
  • Experience developing pipeline through outbound prospecting, inbound opportunities, and strategic relationships.
  • Experience selling cybersecurity, GRC, third-party risk management, compliance, or adjacent enterprise technology solutions is a plus.
  • Proficiency with CRM platforms and modern sales technology.

You don't need to check every box. If you're a strong seller with a history of results, a willingness to learn, and the drive to make an impact, we encourage you to apply.

Benefits:

  • Stock options
  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance
  • Company paid life insurance
  • Internet and wellness stipend
  • Mental health benefit
  • Paid parental leave
  • 18 Paid Holidays
  • 15 Days PTO (All available your 1st day) + 2 additional days each year of employment!
  • 3 Whistic DNA Days - Company-paid "Family Day", "Self Day", & "Community Day"
  • Whistic Fridays- Work ends at 3:00 PM every Friday
  • A world-class culture and employee experience!

Whistic's DEIB Commitment:

Whistic is a place where you can be you.

It’s impossible to separate what you do from who you are, and we don’t want you to. In fact, we want just the opposite. When Whisticians share the richness of their experiences, personal connections are deepened, new levels of collaboration are unleashed, and our product innovation accelerates. We become unstoppable.

Whistic is committed to growing diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging across three key dimensions:

  • Workforce Representation: Hiring and retaining a diverse team
  • Fairness: Equitable rewards, recognition, and opportunities based on merit
  • Inclusive Culture: Fostering an inclusive culture where differences are celebrated

8fe603bd0b051ab2.title: Staff Decision Scientist, Direct Revenue (AI Native)
8fe603bd0b051ab2.description:
About Life360

Life360’s mission is to keep people close to the ones they love. Our category-leading mobile app, Tile tracking devices, and Pet GPS tracker empower members to protect the people, pets, and things they care about most with a range of services, including location sharing, safe driver reports, and crash detection with emergency dispatch. Life360 serves approximately 107.7 million monthly active users (MAU), as of September 30, 2026, across more than 180 countries.

Life360 delivers peace of mind and enhances everyday family life with seamless coordination for all the moments that matter, big and small. By continuing to innovate and deliver for our customers, we have become a household name and the must-have mobile-based membership for families (and those friends who are basically family).

Life360 has more than 500 (and growing!) remote-first employees. For more information, please visit .

Life360 is a Remote First company, which means a remote work environment will be the primary experience for all employees. All positions, unless otherwise specified, can be performed remotely (within the US and Canada) regardless of any specified location above.

We are AI Native

We are building an AI native company where AI is an integral part of how we build and operate. AI tool usage during interviews varies by role. You may be asked to demonstrate proficiency with AI tools, discuss how you leverage AI, or complete interview exercises without AI assistance. Your Recruiter will provide clear guidance as you move through the interview process.

Undisclosed use of AI not previously discussed with or approved by your Recruiter may impact your candidacy.

About The Team

No other team at Life360 touches every product decision, every experiment, and every revenue lever. Data & Analytics is a 60+ person organization spanning data engineering, analytics engineering, data science, and ML. We're building it to be AI-native, where automation handles the volume so our people can focus on understanding why users behave the way they do, establishing what actually causes what, and turning those findings into action.

About the Job

Tens of millions of families use Life360 every month. Turning that trust into a durable subscription business, without breaking what makes members love the product, is one of the most consequential problems at the company. This role sits at the center of it.

As the Staff Decision Scientist for Direct Revenue, you'll be the analytical partner to the leaders who run our subscription business. You'll work on the questions that set the direction of the company: how we package and price membership, which new offerings are worth building, where and how we expand internationally, and what drives a member to subscribe, stay, or leave. Your analysis will go straight to the people making those calls, and you'll be in the room when they're made.

That means more than answering the questions you're given. You'll reframe the ones that are off, push back when the evidence points somewhere leadership doesn't want to go, and set honest expectations about what the data can and can't tell us. You'll also be a senior voice on the team, mentoring Decision Scientists and raising the bar for how we tell stories with data across the org.

This is not a production ML role (we have a dedicated Data Science / MLE team for that). Your primary tools are statistical inference, clear thinking, and the judgment to know which question matters most.

You'll report into the Data & Analytics leadership team and work alongside data engineers, analytics engineers, data scientists, and ML engineers.

For candidates based in the US, the salary range for this position is $118,500 to $218,500 USD. For candidates based out of Canada, the salary range for this position is 164,000 to 193,500 CAD. We take into consideration an individual's background, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience in determining final salary. Base pay may also vary based on geographic location, with US work locations falling into one of three geographic tiers.

Total compensation is inclusive of equity compensation in the form of Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), as well as a comprehensive benefits package, including medical, dental, vision, financial, and other benefits.

What You’ll Do

  • Be leadership's thought partner on monetization. Work directly with the executives who own subscription revenue. Bring them a point of view on where the next dollar of revenue comes from, and the evidence to back it.
  • Shape how we package, price, and sell membership. Lead analysis on tiers, pricing, paywalls, trials, and upgrade and downgrade paths, balancing near-term revenue against long-term member value.
  • Size and test new revenue opportunities. Build the case for (or against) new offerings and bundles across the app (Tile, Pet GPS, etc.) from first sizing through test design and post-launch read.
  • Guide international expansion. Help decide which markets to prioritize and how to adapt pricing and packaging by market, using local willingness-to-pay, conversion, and retention data.
  • Tell stories that change decisions. Turn complex analysis into a clear narrative with a recommendation. A great insight that nobody acts on is a failed insight.
  • Go beyond predictive correlation to causation. Use A/B tests, pricing experiments, and causal inference to measure what actually moves conversion, retention, and LTV.
  • Shape the AI-native analytics stack. Lead adoption of tools and agent workflows that make monetization analysis faster and more self-serve, so the team spends its time on judgment, not plumbing.
  • Push back and manage expectations. Say no to the wrong question, reset unrealistic targets with data, and keep stakeholders aligned on what we know, what we don't, and what it'll take to find out.
  • Mentor and multiply. Coach Decision Scientists on framing, causal rigor, and executive communication. Review their work, help them prepare for leadership readouts, and grow the next generation of strategic analysts.

What We’re Looking For

Core Expectations

  • Executive presence: You're credible with senior leaders. You can hold a room, handle hard questions in real time, and disagree without damaging the relationship.
  • Storytelling and clarity: You lead with the answer, cut what doesn't matter, and adapt the message to the audience, whether that's a CEO, a PM, or an engineer.
  • Courage to push back: You'll tell leadership what the data says even when it's not what they hoped. You do it directly and with respect.
  • Stakeholder judgment: You manage competing asks, set realistic expectations, and protect focus for the work that matters most.
  • Ownership mentality: You take responsibility from framing the question through delivering the recommendation and tracking its impact. You're accountable for decisions changed, not analyses delivered.
  • Commitment to mentorship: You get real satisfaction from making other people better, and you have a track record of doing it.
  • AI-native working style: You use AI tooling (Claude Code or equivalent) as a genuine development partner: delegating discrete tasks, reviewing outputs critically, and running parallel workstreams.

Required Experience & Qualifications

  • 8+ years in an analytics, data science, or decision science role at a consumer tech company.
  • Direct experience with subscription monetization: pricing, packaging, paywalls, conversion, or churn.
  • Advanced degree in a quantitative field (economics, statistics, quantitative social science, operations research) or equivalent practical experience.
  • Demonstrated experience with causal inference methods in applied settings (e.g., difference-in-differences, instrumental variables, regression discontinuity, synthetic controls, propensity score matching).
  • A track record of partnering with executives and influencing major revenue or strategy decisions, with specific examples.
  • Experience designing and analyzing pricing or monetization experiments, using platforms such as Statsig, Optimizely, or similar.
  • Experience formally or informally mentoring other analysts or data scientists.
  • Proficiency in SQL and Python/R for statistical analysis.

Nice to Have Qualifications

  • Experience with freemium or multi-tier subscription models.
  • Experience with international pricing or multi-market launches.
  • Familiarity with pricing and marketplace analytics.
  • Experience building dbt models or contributing to analytics engineering workflows.
  • Experience with hardware-plus-subscription bundles.

Experience with LTV modeling or willingness-to-pay research (e.g., conjoint, Van Westendorp).

AI-Native Expectations

We expect everyone on Data & Analytics to work with AI every day. For this role, that looks like:

  • Daily use: You use Claude Code or an equivalent tool as a working partner for SQL, Python/R analysis, experiment readouts, and first drafts of leadership memos. You delegate well-scoped tasks, run parallel workstreams, and can describe which parts of your last analysis AI handled and which you did yourself.
  • Judgment and ownership: You review AI output critically before it reaches anyone. You check the queries, the statistical assumptions, and the causal claims. You are accountable for every number and recommendation you deliver, whoever or whatever drafted it.
  • Velocity: You use AI to cover more ground. Sizing an opportunity, building a test design, or reading out a pricing experiment should take days, not weeks. You spend the time you save on framing the question and on the decision.
  • Team leadership: You share what works with the Decision Scientists you mentor and with the wider team, such as prompts, agent workflows, and review checklists. You help raise the team’s AI fluency, not only your own.
  • Continuous learning: You keep up with new tools and techniques for experimentation, causal inference, and monetization analytics, and you bring concrete recommendations to the team about what to adopt and what to skip.

Our Benefits

  • Medical, dental, vision, life and disability insurance plans (100% paid for US employees). We offer life and disability as well as supplemental plans for medical and dental for Canadian employees.
  • 401(k) plan with company matching program in the US and RRSP with DPSP plan for Canadian employees.
  • Paid parental leave.
  • Mental Wellness Program & Employee Assistance Program (EAP) for mental well-being.
  • Generous time off: flexible PTO, companywide holidays throughout the year plus summer and winter shutdowns.
  • Learning & Development programs.
  • Equipment, tools, and reimbursement support for a productive remote environment.
  • Free

401b0c046952d042.location: Canada, France, Germany, India, Netherlands, Singapore, United Kingdom, United States
401b0c046952d042.description:
IMPORTANT: after you apply, please check your email. We sendyou a link to complete your application — it is not considered until that laststep is done. If you do not see it, check your spam folder.

This is a fully remote position, open to candidates based in 55 countries, including United States, United Kingdom, Canada, Germany, India, France, Netherlands, Singapore.

Pay: $90–$130/hr

Role Title: Education Practitioner - Learning & Assessment Specialist

Role Type: Contractor

Location: Remote - USA Preferred

We are engaging Education Practitioner - Learning & Assessment Specialists to contribute expertise to a customer’s innovative education project. In this role, you'll apply your expertise to help train next-generation AI systems. Your work will shape how models learn, reason, and perform through high-quality, real-world input. No prior experience in AI is required — your domain knowledge is what matters.

Scope of Work

cf6255af4dbaec7d.description:
Our Client

Our client is a global leader in Human Experience Management (HXM), enabling companies to hire, onboard, and pay talent in over 160 countries—without the need to set up legal entities. Through their own cloud-based platform and direct Employer of Record (EOR) model, they’re changing how businesses approach international expansion. With a truly global, diverse, and remote-first team, they are committed to making the future of work borderless, inclusive, and impactful.

About the Project

As a Senior Engineer on the Data Systems & Platform team, you'll build the data systems behind a global HR tech platform, in code. This is a software engineering role with a data mindset: you'll own pipelines, storage and the AI features built on top of them, end to end, and work directly with product and business stakeholders to turn their needs into simple, well-tested, cost-efficient systems.

Responsibilities

  • Design, build and maintain data systems and services in Python, TypeScript and SQL.
  • Tune relational databases (Azure SQL / PostgreSQL): indexing, query plans, slow-query optimization.
  • Build ingestion and storage on column-store and lakehouse formats (Parquet, Iceberg), with an eye on cost.
  • Build serverless and streaming ingestion pipelines (e.g., Cloudflare Pipelines to R2).
  • Build AI/LLM features on top of company data: RAG, embeddings, vector stores, evals and agentic workflows.
  • Own CI/CD, data testing, monitoring and data-quality alerting for your systems.
  • Work directly with stakeholders to scope problems and ship solutions to production.

Requirements

  • 5+ years building production software in SQL, Python and TypeScript (or similar).
  • Deep knowledge of relational database internals and query performance.
  • Experience with Parquet, Iceberg or similar lakehouse formats.
  • Hands-on AI/LLM work on top of data (RAG, embeddings, vector stores, evals).
  • Daily use of AI coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot).
  • Experience with CI/CD, testing and monitoring for data systems.
  • A forward-deployed mindset: comfortable owning problems end to end and talking with non-technical stakeholders.
  • Clear English communication skills.
  • Nice to have: PostHog, DuckDB, Terraform, Snowflake or Databricks.

Perks and Benefits

  • 100% remote – work from anywhere in LATAM.
  • Competitive USD-based compensation.
  • Join a truly global company with a diverse and inclusive team.
  • 10 days of PTO per year
  • Opportunities to shape infrastructure and engineering practices at scale.
  • A mission-driven culture focused on global growth, sustainability, and social impact.

580b1e1f5f774e9a.title: Junior Product Manager, Intakes & Conversion
580b1e1f5f774e9a.description:
About Bask Health

Bask Health provides a full-service SaaS platform that enables doctors, entrepreneurs, and healthcare businesses to build, manage, and grow direct-to-consumer telehealth businesses.

We're an entrepreneurial, product-focused team that values ownership, speed, and exceptional execution. We work in small teams, tackle complex problems, and expect everyone to take an active role in building and improving our products.

About the Role

We're looking for a Junior Product Manager, Intakes & Conversion to help improve how patients move through intake questionnaires, eligibility screening, and checkout across Bask Health's telehealth platform.

You'll work closely with product managers, engineers, designers, and clinical operations teams to identify friction in the patient journey and help build experiences that are clear, reliable, and easy to complete.

This role combines technical product management with user experience and conversion optimization. You'll help investigate where patients abandon questionnaires, understand why certain steps create confusion, and support improvements that make the journey from initial intake to completed checkout more effective.

You'll gain hands-on experience with product discovery, technical requirements, testing, analytics, and feature launches while taking ownership of smaller product improvements.

We're looking for someone with practical coding experience, strong analytical skills, and an interest in building software that solves real problems.

What You'll Do

  • Support product development across Bask's patient intake questionnaires, eligibility workflows, and checkout experiences.
  • Help identify friction and abandonment points throughout the patient intake and purchase journey.
  • Work with product managers to define priorities and deliver improvements to intake and conversion workflows.
  • Gather feedback from patients, merchants, customer-facing teams, and clinical operations to understand recurring problems.
  • Help improve questionnaire navigation, conditional questions, form validation, and the clarity of patient instructions.
  • Support improvements to eligibility screening and treatment selection experiences while maintaining required clinical safeguards.
  • Assist with optimizing checkout steps, payment-related messaging, and the transition from intake to purchase.
  • Translate user problems and business needs into clear product requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria.
  • Collaborate with engineers and designers to evaluate technical solutions and implementation tradeoffs.
  • Investigate questionnaire and checkout issues, reproduce bugs, and document findings.
  • Support product experiments and A/B testing to evaluate changes to forms, messaging, and user flows.
  • Help analyze funnel metrics, step completion rates, abandonment rates, and checkout conversion.
  • Work with clinical and compliance stakeholders to ensure proposed improvements preserve necessary patient information and eligibility requirements.
  • Support usability testing across browsers, devices, and different patient scenarios.
  • Assist with quality assurance, feature validation, and product launches.
  • Research e-commerce checkout experiences, onboarding flows, and consumer applications to identify opportunities for improvement.
  • Maintain product documentation, testing results, and project updates.
  • Take ownership of smaller intake and conversion improvements from initial investigation through testing and release.

Requirements

Requirements

  • Hands-on experience contributing to software products through coursework, personal projects, internships, or professional work.
  • Foundational understanding of software development, web applications, and how digital products are built.
  • Practical coding experience with JavaScript, TypeScript, Python, or another programming language.
  • Ability to read code, understand basic technical concepts, and communicate effectively with engineers.
  • Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to identify user friction, investigate problems, and recommend practical improvements.
  • Interest in product management, user experience, and conversion optimization.
  • Ability to translate user needs and business requirements into clear, actionable product specifications.
  • Strong attention to detail, particularly when testing multi-step forms and conditional workflows.
  • Ability to organize feedback, document technical issues, and communicate findings clearly.
  • Familiarity with basic data analysis and interpreting product performance metrics.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to collaborate with engineers, designers, product managers, and cross-functional teams.
  • Willingness to learn new technologies and take ownership of assigned responsibilities.

Nice to Have

  • Previous internship or early-career experience in product management, software engineering, or a related technical role.
  • Experience working on onboarding flows, questionnaires, forms, checkout experiences, or other multi-step user journeys.
  • Familiarity with conversion funnels, A/B testing, or experimentation.
  • Experience with e-commerce platforms, subscription products, or consumer-facing applications.
  • Familiarity with JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Next.js, or frontend development.
  • Experience with form validation, conditional logic, APIs, or payment integrations.
  • Familiarity with product analytics tools, SQL, or funnel analysis.
  • Experience conducting usability testing, user research, or analyzing customer feedback.
  • Experience writing user stories, acceptance criteria, or product requirements.
  • Familiarity with Figma, ClickUp, Jira, Linear, or similar development tools.
  • Experience testing applications across browsers and devices.
  • Understanding of healthcare privacy, patient eligibility, or regulated software workflows.
  • Interest in telehealth, digital health, or healthcare technology.
  • A portfolio, GitHub profile, or examples of projects demonstrating technical ability and product thinking.

f8a8519f2008b5ed.description:
Headquarters: National Capital District, Philippines
URL: https://smartsuites.com.au

About the Company

Smart Suites manages a portfolio of over 100 rooms for short-term vacation rentals across Rocklea, Sunnybank, Acacia Ridge, Carina, and Kuraby in Queensland, Australia. Guided by our core values of Customer Obsession, Ownership, Curiosity, Humility, Efficiency, and Teamwork (COCHET), we are committed to delivering exceptional hospitality experiences to every guest.

Smart Suites is an AI-driven company that continuously adopts and integrates advanced technology, automation, and digital tools to improve efficiency, decision-making, and customer satisfaction. We are looking for team members who are equally passionate about using AI tools, data-driven insights, and digital systems to strengthen operations and service delivery.

At Smart Suites, we aim to ensure every guest stay is not only clean and comfortable, but also thoughtfully managed and personalized in a way that leaves a lasting impression.

Know how to spot a good used-car deal?

We are looking for an experienced automotive professional to find vehicles overseas, primarily in Japan, and coordinate their import, preparation and resale in Australia.

You will work remotely from the Philippines, partnering with auction agents, exporters, shipping providers and Australian mechanics and service providers.

What you will do

  • Find vehicles through auctions, dealers and exporter networks.
  • Assess vehicle condition, repair needs and resale potential.
  • Calculate total costs and recommend a maximum buying price.
  • Coordinate imports, repairs, transport and preparation for sale.
  • Manage listings, buyer follow-up and local handover arrangements.
  • Track costs, progress and profit for each vehicle.

What we are looking for

  • Experience in used-car buying, vehicle appraisal, automotive purchasing or vehicle trading.
  • Practical knowledge of mechanical issues, accident damage and repair costs.
  • Ability to interpret auction sheets and recognize risky purchases.
  • Strong commercial judgement, organization and communication skills.
  • Confidence working independently with spreadsheets and online tools.

Japanese auction experience is highly valued. Australian import knowledge is an advantage. Japanese fluency is helpful but not essential if you can reliably interpret and verify vehicle information.

What is on offer

  • Full-time work from home in the Philippines.
  • Fixed monthly pay of 1,300 – 1,500 AUD, depending on experience.
  • Commission equal to 5% of realized net profit per qualifying completed vehicle sale, subject to agreed terms.
  • Opportunity to help build and grow an international vehicle trading operation.

Agreed availability during Australian and Japanese business hours is required.

To apply

Send your CV and a short example of a vehicle you sourced, valued or purchased. Explain how you assessed its condition, buying price, expected costs and resale potential. You may email us at recruitment@smartsuites.com.au﻿

To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/smart-suites-vehicle-sourcing-import-operations-manager

About the Company

Koru UX Design is a leading UX design agency specializing in HealthTech. We partner with clients to deliver user-centered design solutions that drive innovation and enhance user experiences. Our design teams work as an integrated extension of our client’s teams, deeply embedding ourselves into their processes to create seamless, impactful products.

About the Role

We’re looking for a Senior UX Researcher who thrives on complex problem spaces and is comfortable driving research in ambiguity. At Koru, your insights won’t just sit in reports—they’ll directly influence real enterprise products across healthcare, automation, and finance.

You’ll plan and execute end-to-end research studies, work closely with product owners, and help define experiences used by thousands of professionals in the US.

Location: Pune / Remote

Experience: 3–6 years

Type: Full-time

What You’ll Do
  • Own and lead UX research activities across discovery, concept validation, and usability phases
  • Plan, conduct, and synthesise user interviews, usability testing, stakeholder interviews, and journey mapping

  • Translate research insights into product opportunities and design inputs
  • Collaborate with UX designers, product managers, and front-end teams throughout the design process
  • Help shape our research practice as we scale, including mentoring junior team members when needed

What We’re Looking For
  • 3–6 years of hands-on UX research experience (not internships or academic)

  • Comfort working with US-based users and stakeholders, and ability to adapt research communication accordingly
  • Strong system-level thinking: you can map workflows, identify gaps, and untangle complex journeys
  • Ability to handle open-ended, ambiguous briefs—you’re someone who finds ways to start and drive the process
  • Familiarity with creating journey maps, service blueprints, or ecosystem maps
  • Excellent verbal and written communication, with a knack for explaining research to cross-functional teams

Bonus Points If You Have

  • Opportunities for growth and continuous learning (LinkedIn learning & professional trainings).
  • Flexible working hours and remote options.

  • Opportunity for career growth and leadership roles.

Koru UX Design is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.
