c3e250702222c3ea.title: Sezzle: Data Engineer II, Credit Reporting
c3e250702222c3ea.description:
Headquarters: Turkey
URL: https://sezzle.com

The salary range for this role is $2,800 - $4,500 per month (Gross in USD)

About Sezzle:

With a mission to financially empower the next generation, Sezzle is revolutionizing the shopping experience beyond payments, blending cutting-edge tech with seamless, interest-free installment plans that make shopping smarter and more accessible. We’re not just transforming payments; we’re redefining how people discover, interact with, and purchase the things they love while driving real impact on merchant sales through increased conversions and higher order values. As we continue to shape the future of fintech and retail, we’re building an innovative, dynamic team passionate about creating more than just a transaction but a truly unique shopping journey. If you’re excited about pushing boundaries in tech and delivering a game-changing experience for consumers and merchants alike, come join us at Sezzle and help create the future of shopping!

About the Role: 

We are seeking a talented and motivated, best-in-class Data Engineer II. This role presents an exciting opportunity to thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment within a rapidly growing team, with abundant prospects for career advancement. This position will own the data pipelines, transformations, and reporting processes that support accurate, complete, and timely furnishing of customer account information to credit bureaus.

This role presents an opportunity to work in a fast-paced, high growth environment while taking hands-on ownership of a critical customer-facing data function. You will dig into account data and code, debug SQL and Python workflows, and carry issues from investigation through verified resolution. You will partner with Customer Service to resolve technical dispute escalations, with Compliance to apply approved reporting requirements, and with Engineering when a fix is needed in production services or the consumer app. We are looking for an independent problem solver who can manage recurring reporting operations while improving the systems behind them.

What You’ll Do: 

  • Own recurring credit bureau furnishing operations, including data preparation, validation, submissions, bureau feedback, exception resolution, and reconciliation  
  • Build, maintain, and debug SQL transformations, Python scripts, and data pipelines that produce credit reporting data
  • Trace discrepancies from account activity and source records through transformation logic to furnished outputs; identify root causes and implement lasting fixes  
  • Investigate escalations from Customer Service, explain what happened to account data and what should be reported under approved policies, and provide evidence to support their dispute responses  
  • Identify all accounts affected by reporting defects, implement corrections and  controlled reprocessing, and verify the resulting reporting outcomes  
  • Develop automated tests, reconciliations, monitoring, and alerts to catch inaccurate, incomplete, duplicate, or unexpected reporting before submission  
  • Partner with Engineering on defects in production services or the consumer app, providing reproducible examples, affected-account analysis, and clear requirements; validate fixes through the reporting pipeline  
  • Work with Compliance to translate approved reporting requirements into technical rules and escalate ambiguous reporting scenarios  
  • Document reporting logic, data lineage, procedures, and incident resolutions so the process is repeatable and can be supported by others  

What We Look For: 

  • Degree in computer science, engineering, data science, or a related quantitative discipline
  • 3+ years of relevant experience in data engineering or software engineering, including hands-on ownership of production data pipelines and operational workflows
  • Advanced SQL skills, including complex joins, account-level reconciliation, data profiling, and troubleshooting transformation logic
  • Strong Python skills, including the ability to read unfamiliar code, debug existing scripts, and implement maintainable fixes
  • Demonstrated ability to independently investigate ambiguous problems, prioritize recurring operations and incidents, and carry issues through to verified resolution 
  • Experience with version control, code review, automated testing, monitoring, and safe deployment and reprocessing of data workflows
  • Excellent problem-solving skills, with a track record of tracing data defects across systems and preventing recurrence
  • Strong business judgment and communication skills; able to explain technical findings to Customer Service and Compliance and work effectively with Engineering 
  • Fluent in English
  • Demonstrated experience working with Claude or equivalent large language model tools is required; candidates must be comfortable leveraging AI to enhance productivity, research, and communication.

Preferred Knowledge and Skills:

  • Experience with credit reporting dispute workflows, e-OSCAR, Metro 2 format, and investigating escalations from customer support teams
  • Experience with dbt, Redshift, PostgreSQL, AWS, and workflow scheduling or orchestration tools
  • Experience in consumer lending, servicing, payments, financial services, banking, fintech, or BNPL

The Tech You’ll Work With:

  • Python
  • Redshift, PostgreSQL
  • Data build tool (dbt) 
  • WS, G Suite, Mac
  • Coding agents Claude, ChatGPT

Interview Process:

  • Application submitted (you are here)
  • Wonderlic test (30-40 min)
  • Interview with recruiters (30 min)
  • Online coding assessment focused on SQL, Python, and debugging
  • Verbal case study interview. Walk through a credit reporting discrepancy, trace the data and code, and explain how you would correct and prevent the issue.
  • Verbal behavioral interview. Share examples of independently resolving data incidents, improving reliability, and partnering with Engineering and Customer Service.
  • Offer

About You: 

  • You have relentlessly high standards - many people may think your standards are unreasonably high. You are continually raising the bar and driving those around you to deliver great results. You make sure that defects do not get sent down the line and that problems are fixed so they stay fixed.
  • You’re not bound by convention - your success—and much of the fun—lies in developing new ways to do things
  • You need action - speed matters in business. Many decisions and actions are reversible and do not need extensive study. We value calculated risk-taking.
  • You earn trust - you listen attentively, speak candidly, and treat others respectfully.
  • You have backbone; disagree, then commit - you can respectfully challenge decisions when you disagree, even when doing so is uncomfortable or exhausting. You have conviction and are tenacious. You do not compromise for the sake of social cohesion. Once a decision is determined, you commit wholly.
  • You deliver results - you focus on the key inputs and deliver them with the right quality and in a timely fashion. Despite setbacks, you rise to the occasion and never settle.

What Makes Working at Sezzle Awesome? 

At Sezzle, we are more than just brilliant engineers, passionate data enthusiasts, out-of-the-box thinkers, and determined innovators; we are skilled musicians, yogis, cyclists, chefs, golfers, dog-lovers, and rock-climbers. We believe in surrounding ourselves with not only the best and the brightest individuals, but those that are unique and purpose-driven in all that they do. Our culture is not defined by a certain set of perks designed to give the illusion of the traditional startup culture, but rather, it is the visible example living in every employee that we hire.

#Li-remote #Full-time

8fe274b1e6c1344d.title: Sezzle: Senior Data Engineer, Credit Reporting
8fe274b1e6c1344d.description:
Headquarters: Turkey
URL: https://sezzle.com

The salary range for this role is $4,500 - $6,000 per month (Gross in USD)

About Sezzle:

With a mission to financially empower the next generation, Sezzle is revolutionizing the shopping experience beyond payments, blending cutting-edge tech with seamless, interest-free installment plans that make shopping smarter and more accessible. We’re not just transforming payments; we’re redefining how people discover, interact with, and purchase the things they love while driving real impact on merchant sales through increased conversions and higher order values. As we continue to shape the future of fintech and retail, we’re building an innovative, dynamic team passionate about creating more than just a transaction but a truly unique shopping journey. If you’re excited about pushing boundaries in tech and delivering a game-changing experience for consumers and merchants alike, come join us at Sezzle and help create the future of shopping!

About the Role: 

We are seeking a talented and motivated, best-in-class Senior Data Engineer. This role presents an exciting opportunity to thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment within a rapidly growing team, with abundant prospects for career advancement. This position will own the data pipelines, transformations, and reporting processes that support accurate, complete, and timely furnishing of customer account information to credit bureaus.

This role presents an opportunity to work in a fast-paced, high growth environment while taking hands-on ownership of a critical customer-facing data function. You will dig into account data and code, debug SQL and Python workflows, and carry issues from investigation through verified resolution. You will partner with Customer Service to resolve technical dispute escalations, with Compliance to apply approved reporting requirements, and with Engineering when a fix is needed in production services or the consumer app. We are looking for an independent problem solver who can manage recurring reporting operations while improving the systems behind them.

What You’ll Do: 

  • Own recurring credit bureau furnishing operations, including data preparation, validation, submissions, bureau feedback, exception resolution, and reconciliation  
  • Build, maintain, and debug SQL transformations, Python scripts, and data pipelines that produce credit reporting data
  • Trace discrepancies from account activity and source records through transformation logic to furnished outputs; identify root causes and implement lasting fixes  
  • Investigate escalations from Customer Service, explain what happened to account data and what should be reported under approved policies, and provide evidence to support their dispute responses  
  • Identify all accounts affected by reporting defects, implement corrections and  controlled reprocessing, and verify the resulting reporting outcomes  
  • Develop automated tests, reconciliations, monitoring, and alerts to catch inaccurate, incomplete, duplicate, or unexpected reporting before submission  
  • Partner with Engineering on defects in production services or the consumer app, providing reproducible examples, affected-account analysis, and clear requirements; validate fixes through the reporting pipeline  
  • Work with Compliance to translate approved reporting requirements into technical rules and escalate ambiguous reporting scenarios  
  • Document reporting logic, data lineage, procedures, and incident resolutions so the process is repeatable and can be supported by others  

What We Look For: 

  • Degree in computer science, engineering, data science, or a related quantitative discipline
  • 5+ years of relevant experience in data engineering or software engineering, including hands-on ownership of production data pipelines and operational workflows
  • Advanced SQL skills, including complex joins, account-level reconciliation, data profiling, and troubleshooting transformation logic
  • Strong Python skills, including the ability to read unfamiliar code, debug existing scripts, and implement maintainable fixes
  • Demonstrated ability to independently investigate ambiguous problems, prioritize recurring operations and incidents, and carry issues through to verified resolution 
  • Experience with version control, code review, automated testing, monitoring, and safe deployment and reprocessing of data workflows
  • Excellent problem-solving skills, with a track record of tracing data defects across systems and preventing recurrence
  • Strong business judgment and communication skills; able to explain technical findings to Customer Service and Compliance and work effectively with Engineering 
  • Fluent in English
  • Demonstrated experience working with Claude or equivalent large language model tools is required; candidates must be comfortable leveraging AI to enhance productivity, research, and communication.

Preferred Knowledge and Skills:

  • Experience with credit reporting dispute workflows, e-OSCAR, Metro 2 format, and investigating escalations from customer support teams
  • Experience with dbt, Redshift, PostgreSQL, AWS, and workflow scheduling or orchestration tools
  • Experience in consumer lending, servicing, payments, financial services, banking, fintech, or BNPL

The Tech You’ll Work With:

  • Python
  • Redshift, PostgreSQL
  • Data build tool (dbt) 
  • WS, G Suite, Mac
  • Coding agents Claude, ChatGPT

Interview Process:

  • Application submitted (you are here)
  • Wonderlic test (30-40 min)
  • Interview with recruiters (30 min)
  • Online coding assessment focused on SQL, Python, and debugging
  • Verbal case study interview. Walk through a credit reporting discrepancy, trace the data and code, and explain how you would correct and prevent the issue.
  • Verbal behavioral interview. Share examples of independently resolving data incidents, improving reliability, and partnering with Engineering and Customer Service.
  • Offer

About You: 

  • You have relentlessly high standards - many people may think your standards are unreasonably high. You are continually raising the bar and driving those around you to deliver great results. You make sure that defects do not get sent down the line and that problems are fixed so they stay fixed.
  • You’re not bound by convention - your success—and much of the fun—lies in developing new ways to do things
  • You need action - speed matters in business. Many decisions and actions are reversible and do not need extensive study. We value calculated risk-taking.
  • You earn trust - you listen attentively, speak candidly, and treat others respectfully.
  • You have backbone; disagree, then commit - you can respectfully challenge decisions when you disagree, even when doing so is uncomfortable or exhausting. You have conviction and are tenacious. You do not compromise for the sake of social cohesion. Once a decision is determined, you commit wholly.
  • You deliver results - you focus on the key inputs and deliver them with the right quality and in a timely fashion. Despite setbacks, you rise to the occasion and never settle.

What Makes Working at Sezzle Awesome? 

At Sezzle, we are more than just brilliant engineers, passionate data enthusiasts, out-of-the-box thinkers, and determined innovators; we are skilled musicians, yogis, cyclists, chefs, golfers, dog-lovers, and rock-climbers. We believe in surrounding ourselves with not only the best and the brightest individuals, but those that are unique and purpose-driven in all that they do. Our culture is not defined by a certain set of perks designed to give the illusion of the traditional startup culture, but rather, it is the visible example living in every employee that we hire.

#Li-remote #Full-time

93fe6b636057aeb4.description:
Headquarters: Nigeria
URL: https://uopeople.edu

INTRODUCTION: 

University of the People (UoPeople) is the first non-profit, tuition-free, American, accredited, 100% online university. Today, UoPeople has over 270,000 students enrolled from more than 200 countries and territories, including 50,000 students who are refugees. UoPeople is accredited by the WASC Senior College and University Commission (WSCUC).

We believe that higher education is a basic human right and that it can transform not only the lives of students, but also their families' lives, their communities, their nations, and, by extension, the world. See President Reshef’s TED talk when he announced the founding of the University. [ TED talk ]

 

UoPeople is an innovative university, and we welcome team members who bring creativity and innovation to their roles. We’re a fast-paced organization with remote teams all around the globe. If you’re a self-starter who wants to succeed alongside a passionate team, we’d love to hear from you!

 

UoPeople is supported by the generosity of individuals and foundations, including the Gates, Hewlett, Ford Foundations, Fondation Hoffmann, and others. The University has been covered by the New York Times, BBC, NPR, Times Higher Education, US News and World Report, and more. President Reshef’s TED Talk and Nas Daily interview about the University have 30 million views combined.

 

Role: 

Adjunct Instructor

 

Teaching Mode:

Remote/Online

Compensation: 

The University will provide compensation to Adjunct Instructors at a rate of USD 250 per undergraduate course and USD 300 per graduate course, in recognition of their valuable contributions and commitment to advancing the University’s mission.

 

Position Description:  

University of the People (UoPeople) is currently seeking Adjunct Instructors to teach undergraduate and graduate level courses in following disciplines:

  1. Computer Science

  2. Mathematics and Statistics

  3. History and Art History

  4. Economics

  5. Political Science

  6. Law

  7. Sociology

Your service as an Adjunct Instructor will support UoPeople’s global mission to offer affordable, quality, online, degree-granting educational programs to any qualified student. UoPeople Adjunct Instructors must make a weekly commitment of about 15 hours to course-related activities, which consist of responding to student emails and messages, engaging with students in discussion forums, grading assignments and discussion forum posts. Each UoPeople course is nine weeks long and is taught fully online in the learning management system. Instructors must be able to teach in an online world and understand the needs of a very diverse student population.

  

Essential Responsibilities:

  • Devote approximately 15 hours per course per week.

  • Maintain an instructor presence in the course with frequent check-ins and responsiveness to students.

  • Communicate effectively with diverse student populations and an international administration.

  • Teach course subject matter to ensure every student can master learning outcomes.

  • Regularly check in with Academic Affairs and/or Office of Academic Operations administrators regarding any course issues.

  • Monitor course grades and finalize grades by deadlines.

  • Model sensitivity to a diverse student population, representing the full spectrum of cultural, political, socio-economic, and religious backgrounds.

 

Qualifications:

  • Expertise in the subject area of the course.

  • The minimum degree requirement is a master's degree in the discipline. A doctoral degree in the area is preferred.

  • Online teaching experience preferred, but not necessary.

  • Fluency in English.

  

UoPeople is an equal opportunity employer and seeks applicants who share its values of quality, opportunity and access and who are representative of its diverse student body. More information about the institution can be found at https://www.uopeople.ed

27d45c1b044098af.title: Changing Lives Productions LLC: Assistant Editor
27d45c1b044098af.description:
Headquarters: India
URL: https://dharmannstudios.bamboohr.com/careers

ABOUT CHANGING LIVES PRODUCTIONS:

Changing Lives Productions is the in-house video production company of Dhar Mann Studios, the #1 creator of scripted positive content online. With over 163 million followers and 82+ billion views across YouTube, Facebook, Instagram, and TikTok, our videos receive more than 1 billion views each month.


We produce several hours of original content weekly with messages of compassion, kindness, and altruism that resonate with viewers of all ages. Our stories tackle real-life challenges and deliver powerful life lessons that resonate with global audiences.

Founded by Dhar Mann, named the “Moral Philosopher of YouTube” by The New York Times, a Time Top 100 Creator, and ranked #2 on Forbes’ 2025 Top Creators list—our founding principle is simple but ambitious: We’re not just telling stories. We’re changing lives.

BIG PICTURE:

We’re looking for an Assistant Editor who keeps our post-production pipeline organized and moving. You’ll collate and prep project files for our VFX and color teams, and manage the digital assets behind every episode we produce.

This is a hands-on support role. You’ll make sure editors, VFX artists, and colorists get clean, complete, correctly structured files on time, and that every piece of footage, project file, and finished master is ingested, organized, backed up, and archived.

Why this role matters

We deliver several hours of original content every week. Missing media, broken links, or poorly prepped turnovers cost our VFX and color teams hours they don’t have.

A well-run library, with clear naming, accurate metadata, and reliable archives, means faster turnarounds, easy re-versioning, and no lost work. You’ll be the person who makes handoffs between editorial, VFX, and color seamless.


HOW YOU’LL SPEND YOUR TIME:

Assistant editorial: file collation and handoffs

  • Collating all project files, media, graphics, music, and SFX for each episode into a complete, correctly structured package
  • Relinking offline media, consolidating projects, and making sure nothing is missing before a handoff
  • Organizing project bins, sequences, and timelines so editors can pick up work without delays
  • Syncing audio and video, and building stringouts or selects when requested
  • Tracking each episode’s status and flagging missing assets or technical issues early

VFX prep

  • Preparing VFX turnovers: exporting plates with handles, reference clips, and EDL/XML files to spec
  • Naming and numbering VFX shots consistently and logging them in the VFX tracker
  • Packaging shot notes, reference frames, and editor instructions with each turnover
  • Bringing returned VFX shots back into the timeline and checking them for sync, frame accuracy, and version

Color prep

  • Preparing locked cuts for color: simplifying timelines, flattening tracks, and removing unsupported effects
  • Exporting XML/AAF/EDL files and reference videos for the colorist
  • Confirming all source media is linked and accessible for the grade
  • Conforming and patching graded media back into the edit, then QC’ing against the reference

Digital asset management

  • Ingesting and verifying camera footage, audio, graphics, and music using checksum-verified offloads
  • Maintaining folder structures, file-naming conventions, and version control across raw footage, projects, and deliverables
  • Logging and tagging assets with accurate, searchable metadata (series, episode, talent, shoot date, usage rights)
  • Uploading all working files and backups to the server in the agreed path, so any editor can pick up a project
  • Creating proxies, transcodes, and alternate versions (textless, clean, localized) as needed
  • Exporting and QC’ing final masters to spec (resolution, codec, aspect ratio, captions, loudness)
  • Archiving completed projects to long-term cloud and offline storage, and retrieving archived media on request
  • Monitoring storage capacity and keeping drives and servers clean per retention guidelines
  • Keeping asset trackers, delivery logs, and archive records up to date


WHAT YOU HAVE:

  • 3–5+ years of experience as an assistant editor, media manager, or in post-production operations
  • Strong proficiency in Adobe Premiere Pro, including Project Manager, consolidating and relinking media, and proxy workflows
  • Hands-on experience preparing VFX turnovers and color handoffs (EDL, XML, AAF, plates with handles)
  • Working knowledge of codecs, formats, frame rates, resolutions, and export settings, and the ability to spot technical issues during QC
  • Exceptional organization and attention to detail, with the discipline to keep naming, folder structures, and metadata consistent under tight deadlines
  • An understanding of backup and archival best practices (3-2-1 rule, checksum verification with tools like Hedge or ShotPut Pro, cloud and LTO storage)
  • Proficiency with Google Sheets, Excel, or Airtable for tracking assets, turnovers, and deliveries
  • Clear, proactive communication, especially when flagging missing files or delays


Nice to have

  • Familiarity with DaVinci Resolve and After Effects
  • Experience with DAM/MAM and review platforms (Frame.io, Iconik, Air, CatDV, or similar) and shared storage (Google Drive, Dropbox, LucidLink)
  • Basic understanding of music licensing, clearances, and usage rights
  • Experience in a high-volume content studio or episodic workflow


WHO OVERSEES YOU:

The Assistant Editor reports to the Jr. Post Production Manager.

WHO YOU OVERSEE:

No direct reports at this time.

WHERE IT ALL GOES DOWN:

You’ll work remotely from home or a personal office and log hours in Dhar Mann Studios’ time-tracking software.

WHEN THE MAGIC HAPPENS:

The typical schedule is 40 hours per week. Specific hours and shift overlap with the US team will be discussed during interviews

1cd07450430a5883.title: ProArch: Data Platform Architect
1cd07450430a5883.description:
Headquarters: India
URL: https://jobs.workable.com/company/u8TybTAE2YbYgRVFYov9t4/jobs-at-proarch

ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS:

•    Lead the definition and evolution of the enterprise data platform strategy by developing, maintaining, and continuously evolving architecture standards, reference architectures, and design patterns aligned with business priorities, analytical requirements, and AI/ML enablement across data and ETL/ELT platforms. 

•    Develop, maintain, and steward enterprise architecture artifacts and documentation—including current and target state designs, diagrams, standards, and decision records—ensuring accuracy, consistency, and accessibility within the architecture repository.

•    Evaluate, recommend, and govern the selection of data platforms and ETL/ELT tools, balancing scalability, performance, security, cost, and operational maturity while reducing unnecessary platform sprawl.

•    Review and guide data platform and pipeline designs to ensure consistency with enterprise standards, scalability requirements, and architectural best practices.

•    Provide technical leadership and guidance to data engineering teams, analytics teams, platform product owners to translate architecture standards into implementable solutions and influence technical direction across the organization.

•    Define architectural guardrails that ensure data platforms can scale reliably, meet performance expectations, and support high availability and disaster recovery requirements. 

•    Establish architectural standards for platform operations, environment management, reliability, observability, deployment automation, and lifecycle management to ensure data platforms are production-ready and supportable. 

•    Ensure data platform architectures incorporate security controls, data privacy requirements, and regulatory compliance (e.g., access controls, encryption, data lineage, and retention) by default.

•    Define and standardize ETL/ELT and data integration patterns, including batch, streaming, and event driven approaches, to support analytics, operational reporting, and downstream consumption.

•    Participate in enterprise architecture governance forums, providing clear architectural guidance and decision support for data platform and integration initiatives.

•    Incorporate financial discipline into platform architecture by guiding cost efficient design, platform right sizing, and lifecycle management in partnership with FinOps and platform teams.

•    Continuously assess emerging data platform and ETL technologies, recommending updates to standards and strategy as capabilities and business needs evolve.

a2a6275604b837a3.description:
Headquarters: Manila, Metro Manila, Philippines
URL: https://jobs.workable.com/company/1nymCf9inBKe5zuHe44hHE/jobs-at-showmojo

About PropertyTek

PropertyTek is a private equity-backed holding company transforming property management through a growing portfolio of SaaS brands. Our products power leasing automation for single- and multifamily residential property managers.

We're looking for a Marketing Automation Specialist who thrives in a fast-paced, growth-oriented environment. This is a role that will build the systems that move leads through our marketing funnel, directly supporting Sales and our mission to transform the property technology landscape.

Role Overview

We're hiring a Marketing Automation Specialist to own HubSpot workflow architecture across our property management SaaS portfolio (ShowMojo and Tenant Turner). This is not an execution-only role: the person in this seat designs and builds the automation logic that drives lifecycle marketing, not just runs pre-built workflows.

This is a contractor position, remote, Philippines-based preferred.

Key Responsibilities

Workflow Architecture

  • Design and build multi-branch HubSpot workflows from scratch, not just editing existing sequences
  • Architect lead scoring models tailored to property management buyer behavior
  • Build segmentation logic specific to the property management vertical (portfolio size, unit count, market, product line — ShowMojo vs. Tenant Turner)
  • Design lifecycle-stage email flows: lead nurture, trial/onboarding, activation, upsell/expansion, renewal, win-back

Hubspot Execution

  • Set up campaigns in HubSpot, bringing together the emails, landing pages, forms, and assets for each one
  • Build and send emails in HubSpot, including newsletters, one-off sends, and nurture emails
  • QA every email before it goes out
  • Own the marketing email calendar: keep it current, keep every team informed of what's going out and when, and make sure sends stick to the schedule
  • Coordinate email sends with Customer Success
  • Keep HubSpot organized with consistent naming and foldering for emails, lists, and campaigns
  • Own UTM tracking on every email and campaign link, so each click gets credited to the right campaign

Content & Landing Pages

  • Write email copy for automated email workflows sequences
  • Build and publish landing pages in HubSpot's CMS/page tools to support campaigns and lifecycle flows
  • Publish blog posts and pages in WordPress
  • Ensure workflows, content, and landing pages work as one connected system

Ongoing Optimization

  • Run and maintain our lead nurture flows: keep emails, offers, and links current, and test changes that improve engagement and conversions
  • Monitor email performance and revise logic accordingly; share the results and make regular optimization recommendations to the team
  • Maintain clean data hygiene practices within workflows (list membership, enrollment/re-enrollment logic, suppression rules)

Required Qualifications

  • Demonstrated HubSpot workflow architecture experience — must be able to design multi-branch automation from a blank canvas, not just configure templates
  • Hands-on experience building lead scoring models
  • Experience building segmentation strategies (behavioral, firmographic, or lifecycle-based)
  • Experience designing lifecycle-stage email flows (nurture through renewal)
  • Experience building landing pages in HubSpot's CMS or page builder tools
  • Hands-on HubSpot Marketing Hub experience: building emails, landing pages, and campaigns
  • 3+ years in marketing automation, ideally with at least 1–2 years focused specifically on HubSpot
  • Strong B2B email copywriting skills, with samples you can share
  • Experience publishing content in WordPress
  • A sharp eye for QA: you catch broken links, wrong personalization tokens, and rendering issues before anything goes out
  • Comfortable reading email performance data (opens, clicks, conversions) and turning it into clear recommendations
  • Organized and proactive, with the communication skills to keep multiple teams aligned on a shared calendar
  • Comfortable working independently in a remote, asynchronous, US-hours-adjacent environment

Preferred Qualifications

  • Prior experience in property management, real estate, or a related vertical (rental software, PropTech, or landlord/tenant-facing products)
  • HubSpot certification(s) — Marketing Software, Email Marketing, or Reporting
  • Experience working across multiple product lines or brands within one HubSpot portal
  • Experience with A/B testing email sequences and using results to refine workflow logic
  • Experience running or maintaining lead nurture and lifecycle email flows
  • Experience with UTM tracking and campaign attribution

Schedule and Availability

This role is a full-time equivalent of about 160 hours a month. Your working day should overlap consistently with US Eastern morning hours, when our standups, Sales syncs, and most async requests happen.

Rate starts at $15 per hour

What We Do:

Cybercrime is growing, and more businesses are getting hit by threats that used to target only the biggest organizations. That pushes defenders like us to operate at the highest level, and it deepens our need for good people who want to make a meaningful impact.

Founded in 2015 by former NSA cyber operators, Huntress is a remote-first team working to make enterprise-grade cybersecurity accessible to businesses of all sizes. We work closely with security teams and service providers protecting complex environments, often without the time or headcount to handle it all. Company: AllCare.ai | Healthcare Technology

The Mission

AllCare.ai is an AI-powered healthcare delivery platform that acts as the easy button for accessing care. We combine advanced artificial intelligence with compassionate care delivery to remove friction from healthcare — bringing healthcare and pharmacy services directly to the communities and patients we serve. We don’t just coordinate care — we deliver care.

About the Role

We're hiring a Sales Specialist to support AllCare.ai's growth by developing referral relationships with healthcare providers, hospice agencies, senior living communities, and skilled nursing facilities throughout Southern California.

In this remote role, you will be responsible for conducting outbound outreach, identifying new referral opportunities, building trusted relationships with healthcare professionals, and educating referral partners on hospice services and eligibility.

This is a relationship-driven healthcare sales role that requires strong communication skills, confidence in conducting outbound outreach, and the ability to navigate sensitive healthcare conversations with empathy and professionalism.

Your primary goal is to expand our hospice referral network, establish new partnerships, and drive patient referrals and admissions through consistent outreach and relationship development.

What You'll Do
  • Conduct outbound calls to physicians, discharge planners, hospice agencies, senior living communities, and skilled nursing facilities throughout Southern California
  • Introduce AllCare.ai and our services to prospective referral partners
  • Identify key decision-makers and develop relationships with healthcare professionals and facility administrators
  • Educate referral partners on hospice eligibility, available services, and comfort-care options
  • Identify opportunities to establish new hospice partnerships and expand the company's referral network
  • Build and maintain relationships with referral sources through consistent communication and follow-up
  • Schedule qualified meetings and coordinate with the U.S.-based team to support partnership development
  • Collaborate with internal teams to facilitate referrals and support the patient admission process
  • Maintain accurate records of outreach activities, referral relationships, partnership development, and patient referrals
  • Monitor referral activity and work toward improving referral-to-admission conversion rates
  • Consistently work toward established sales, partnership development, and patient admission KPIs
Must-Haves
  • Bachelor's degree in Pharmacy or PharmD required
  • Previous professional experience in healthcare, pharmacy, or a related healthcare setting
  • Strong English verbal communication skills with a clear, professional phone presence
  • Confidence conducting outbound sales calls and engaging healthcare professionals
  • Excellent interpersonal skills with the ability to establish trust and build professional relationships
  • Warm, empathetic, and professional communication style, particularly when discussing sensitive healthcare topics
  • Comfortable handling objections and navigating challenging conversations
  • Self-motivated, goal-oriented, and comfortable working toward measurable sales and referral targets
  • Organized, reliable, and able to manage outreach activities and follow-up independently
Nice-to-Haves
  • Previous hospice, home health, healthcare sales, or business development experience
  • Experience conducting outbound sales calls or developing healthcare referral relationships
  • Existing knowledge of Southern California senior living communities, skilled nursing facilities, or healthcare providers
  • Familiarity with Medicare hospice benefits and hospice eligibility requirements
  • Previous experience working with U.S.-based healthcare organizations
Compensation & Schedule
  • Base Compensation: $600 USD per month
  • Performance Bonus: Opportunity to earn additional compensation based on established bonus structures and achievement of role-specific KPIs
  • Schedule: Monday–Friday, 9:00 AM – 5:00 PM PST
  • Location: Remote (Egypt-based candidates only)

592543cdb2608ac4.description:
Headquarters: United States
URL: https://wisetechglobal.com

Company Description

WiseTech Global is a leading developer and provider of innovative software solutions for the logistics, global trade and supply chain industries worldwide. We serve more than 22,000 logistics companies across 193 countries, 23 of the 25 largest global freight forwarders worldwide. With the acquisition of e2open, we have expanded our network to encompass over 500,000 connected enterprises across manufacturing, logistics, channels and distribution. With the vision to be the operating system for global trade and logistics, we are creating a multi-sided marketplace connecting carriers, logistics providers, importers, exporters and shippers.

Job Description

A Pivotal Moment — Why Join E2open Now

In August 2025 WiseTech Global, developer of the world's leading logistics execution software CargoWise, completed its strategic acquisition of e2open. This acquisition represents one of the most significant strategic moves in global supply chain technology in recent years, and it creates an extraordinary moment to join this business.

WiseTech's CargoWise platform has historically focused on logistics service providers such as freight forwarders, carriers, and customs brokers. The e2open acquisition brings a deep, complementary product suite and customer base on the other side of the supply chain: the buyers, importers, exporters, shippers, manufacturers and brand owners who generate the freight in the first place.

Together, the two businesses create something that has never existed before: a truly end-to-end, multi-sided global trade and logistics marketplace connecting demand, planning, supply, channel, transportation and execution in one ecosystem, all underpinned by AI and data at scale.

The Opportunity

We are seeking an experienced and driven Area Sales Director to join our growing US sales organization. Each Area Sales Director owns a portfolio of approximately 20-30 enterprise accounts within our CPG business unit.

This role sits at the intersection of sales and professional services, with our most successful team members acting as strategic consultants and trusted advisors to our clients to help drive wider adoption of our existing product suite. This role covers the full spectrum of client engagement, from identifying opportunities and closing deals to staying involved throughout implementation to ensure successful delivery.

What You'll Do

  • Build and grow a portfolio of enterprise accounts, driving cross-sell, upsell and new logo revenue.
  • Develop trusted, senior-level relationships across your accounts through engaging stakeholders beyond the primary sponsor and maintaining a regular meeting cadence.
  • Act as a strategic advisor, helping clients understand the full value of e2open's platform and keeping satisfaction high.
  • Create and maintain detailed account plans and close plans at the opportunity level.
  • Partner with Solutions Consulting, Legal, Professional Services and other internal teams to progress and close deals.
  • Accurately maintain Salesforce CRM and report on pipeline, activities and performance metrics.
  • Represent e2open at industry events to stay current on market trends and generate new business opportunities.

Salary: $100,000-$150,000 Base + Uncapped Commission

Qualifications

What You'll Bring

  • 8–10+ years in supply chain and logistics, whether in consulting, operations, solution architecture, or enterprise B2B SaaS sales (exposure to S&OP, demand planning or inventory optimization in a CPG environment is highly preferred).
  • Experience selling supply chain, logistics, ERP or adjacent enterprise software.
  • Proven ability to close and manage complex, multi-stakeholder deals across long sales cycles.
  • Confident presenting to C-suite and VP-level executives, with strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Consultative, value-based selling approach with genuine curiosity about customer challenges.
  • Ability to articulate technical solutions clearly in business terms.
  • Excellent organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple accounts and opportunities concurrently.
  • Proficiency in Salesforce or equivalent CRM; strong working knowledge of Microsoft Office.

Additional Information

When you join WiseTech, you’re joining a team of passionate problem solvers who are committed to changing the world of logistics, one innovation at a time. At the heart of WiseTech’s success lies our exceptional team of people, whose diverse talents and unwavering dedication drive the company forward. Our team’s broad mix of experiences and backgrounds is not merely a feature but a cornerstone of our vibrant and dynamic culture.

Creativity is in our DNA. We favor principles over policy, encourage open communication, and prioritize results over busywork. Our global team is united by our mission: to change the world by creating breakthrough products that enable and empower those that own and operate the supply chains of the world. Join us in shaping the future of logistics.

Before You Apply 

From time to time, WiseTech Global may use external service providers to assist us with assessing applications, including testing and background checks, on our behalf. Accordingly, by applying for this role and providing your personal information to WiseTech Global, you consent to WiseTech Global providing this information to our external service providers who are required to treat such information with strict confidentiality in line with privacy and data protection laws and regulations.

  • Compensation: USD 100000 - USD 150000 - yearly

54024b577830dda2.description:
Headquarters: Canada
URL: http://www.leaptools.com

About us
At Leap Tools, we are building the world's most advanced solutions for the interior décor industry. With customers in 80+ countries, our clientele includes Fortune 500 companies such as Home Depot, local retailers such as Alexanian's, and everything in between. We have been recognized as one of the fastest-growing tech companies by Deloitte for multiple years in a row, and we are looking for ambitious challenge-seekers to fuel our momentum and help us create an iconic global tech company.

About our product
Our technology lets you preview products in your own room before you buy them. Imagine you want to redesign your home and have been searching for new tiles for your kitchen, or a new rug for your living room. You definitely want to make sure it will look good in your space. We enable you to do that through our proprietary cutting-edge technology, presented in an extraordinarily simple and accessible way. Try our rug demo now! Simply upload a picture of your room using your mobile phone, and slide the rug under your coffee table: https://www.roomvo.com/rugdemo4r

About you
We are looking for a versatile, growth-minded Product Marketing Manager to lead our strategic expansion into the furniture segment. You will develop and lead a go-to-market plan that includes deploying novel launch tactics, identifying winning streaks, building high-impact relationships, and providing our sales team the wedge they need to penetrate new markets.

You will be responsible for turning our product’s value into aggressive market traction, focusing on tactical adoption of successful industry strategies over theoretical benchmarking.

We hire humans, not job descriptions. You should apply even if this role and salary range don't align with your experience. We’re happy to create unique roles and compensation for the right talent.

What You'll Do
  • GTM Orchestration & Market Penetration: Design and execute a strategy for the furniture segment to drive immediate revenue and market traction. Lead the end-to-end orchestration of product launches, ensuring the sales team has a clear, defined path to closing deals.
  • Tactical Industry Analysis: Monitor competitors and industry shifts (e.g., tariffs, trade news) to identify successful tactics we can rapidly adopt. Focus on actionable insights that improve our immediate market positioning.
  • Networking & Relationship Building: Actively build industry relationships and conduct customer interviews to increase brand visibility and press coverage. Act as the bridge between marketing and sales to ensure networking activities translate into high-impact business drivers.
  • Sales Enablement & Strategic Messaging: Develop tailored messaging for major accounts that differentiates the Roomvo offering in visual-first, design-centric industries. Equip sales with strategic talk tracks and tools that prioritize high-impact revenue activities over secondary training materials.

Remote · Full-time · $19.00/hr base + uncapped bi-weekly bonuses, 40 hours weekly within 8 AM–9 PM CST

Tired of a paycheck that’s the same no matter how hard you work? Good. So are we.

Intellipet helps dog owners get the training their dogs need: in-home sessions with professional trainers, virtual coaching, and programs for everyday manners up to service-dog work. People call us because something isn’t working at home, and they need someone to help them fix it.

That’s you.

  •     Paid training on our products, scripts and sales process, with coaching from top performers.
  •     A product people actually want. You’re helping families keep their dogs, not selling something nobody needs.

  •     Benefits: Remote work, Medical, Dental, Vision, and Life insurance, 401k/Roth IRA, FSA and more!

What we’re looking for:

  •     Sales experience phone sales, retail, call center, or anything where you had a number to hit.
  •     Confidence asking for the sale.
  •     Clear, friendly communication, and reliable attendance.
  •     A love of dogs helps. A love of winning is required.

Ready to get paid what you’re worth? Apply today and tell us, in one sentence, about the best sale you ever made.


Hiring Process

 Applicants complete a short online assessment through TestGorilla before interview consideration. Candidates who advance should be prepared to discuss specific examples of quota performance, persistence, objection handling, and successful closes.

Intellipet is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds.

afc4c9ab68e8c51b.description:
Headquarters: Taguig, Metro Manila, Philippines
URL: http://getmagic.com

Client Account Specialist

Department: Support

Employment Type: Full Time

Location: Philippines

Reporting To: Andrea Santisteban

Compensation: ₱38,000 / month



Description

For over 10 years, Magic has connected top remote talent with fast-growing businesses — backed by Y Combinator and Sequoia Capital, with thousands of remote workers worldwide.

When a business brings on a Magic assistant, the relationship doesn't run itself. That's where you come in.

This is a post-sale, account-first role. You'll carry a book of client-assistant pairings and be accountable for how well each one works — from day one of onboarding through every milestone after. Inbound requests will come in, but fielding requests isn't the core of the job. The core is knowing your accounts well enough that you can spot what's about to go wrong before it does, get on a call, and fix it.

Shift: Monday–Friday, 10 PM–7 AM PHT. Training runs 4 weeks across two phases — Product & Skills (shadowing, live-call listening) then Immersion (live tickets and onboarding under supervision, KPIs measured from day one). Zero absences during training, documented medical emergencies only, 80%+ required on daily assessments and mock calls to continue.


Key Responsibilities

  • Manage a portfolio of client accounts — track the health of each pairing, flag risks early, and keep every relationship on track
  • Lead onboarding sessions, 30-day account reviews, and recurring check-ins that keep clients and their assistants aligned
  • Advocate for assistants internally — coaching conversations, feedback loops, and surfacing what they need to leadership
  • Own retention conversations — identify accounts at risk and lead win-back efforts before the client decides to leave
  • Handle 30+ inbound account requests daily with fast, personalized responses that reflect actual knowledge of that account
  • Maintain clean, detailed HubSpot records for every client interaction — useful to anyone who touches the account after you
  • Coordinate across Operations, Finance, and Engineering when an account issue goes beyond your direct scope


Qualifications & Technical Requirements

  • 3+ years of client-facing experience in account management, account support, or B2B customer success — US accounts strongly preferred
  • Demonstrated ability to manage multiple active client accounts simultaneously without losing thread or detail
  • Fluent written and verbal English — equally sharp in a written account update and a live escalation call
  • Reliable night-shift availability (10 PM–7 AM PHT) with documented history of night-shift work
  • CRM proficiency, HubSpot preferred
  • Proactive by default — you identify account risks and act on them before anyone has to ask

After 90 days, your accounts run smoothly not because nothing went wrong — but because you caught the problems early and handled them. You know your client portfolio without having to look everything up. You're as comfortable on a direct call with a frustrated client as you are writing a clear, concise account note at 3 AM. You've worked night shift before, and you know how to pace yourself through a shift that gets busy fast when US business hours kick in.
This isn't the role if you've never managed a real account portfolio before, if "account ownership" means something different to you than being personally responsible for how each relationship turns out, or if your default is to wait for issues to escalate before you move.

Application + Pre-Qualifying Questions → HR Interview (30 min) → Skill Assessment (Written Case Study) → Second-Level Interview with Support Management → Mock Feedback Call → Final Interview with Head of Sales → Job Offer → 4-Week Training Program


Compensation & Benefits

Gross package ₱32,000–₱38,000/month, total potential ₱38,000–₱40,000/month · Night shift (10 PM–7 AM PHT) · Full training program included
We're ambitious, driven, and unapologetically the type to plow through obstacles instead of waiting for perfect conditions. Our work dynamic is genuinely different — dynamic, friendly conversations, zero politics, and no hierarchy standing in your way. You can talk to anyone, on any team, about anything, because we respect each other's time and actually like working together. Y Combinator and Sequoia-backed, thousands of remote workers strong, and growing.

About the Company

The client is a New Zealand-based wellness brand specialising in nutritional supplements and wellness products. The company is committed to developing high-quality, science-led products that support everyday health and wellbeing. With a growing presence across New Zealand and Australia, they continue to expand its e-commerce, wholesale, and retail operations while maintaining a strong focus on product quality and customer experience.

About the Role

We are looking for a highly organised and proactive E-commerce & Operations Coordinator to support the day-to-day operations of a growing wellness brand across New Zealand and Australia.

This is a broad, hands-on role suited to someone who enjoys working across multiple areas of a business, including e-commerce, customer experience, wholesale account management, supply chain, inventory coordination, and project administration.

Working closely with the Head of Operations, you will play an important role in keeping business operations running smoothly, coordinating with customers, retailers, suppliers, manufacturers, and logistics partners, and ensuring that operational processes, documentation, and reporting are maintained accurately.

The ideal candidate is commercially minded, detail-oriented, resourceful, and comfortable taking ownership of tasks in a fast-paced, growing business.

Key Responsibilities

1. E-commerce & Customer Experience

  • Manage customer enquiries across email, live chat, helpdesk, website, and social media channels.
  • Oversee online order processing, tracking, amendments, cancellations, refunds, returns, and subscription changes.
  • Coordinate with couriers and third-party logistics (3PL) providers to resolve delivery issues and fulfilment discrepancies.
  • Monitor customer feedback, identify recurring issues, and prepare monthly customer insights reports.

2. Brand & Influencer Coordination

  • Manage day-to-day communications across Instagram, Facebook, and TikTok, following established brand guidelines.
  • Coordinate influencer and UGC creator outreach, applications, product gifting, campaign timelines, and deliveries.
  • Maintain creator databases, campaign trackers, usage rights, posting schedules, and partnership documentation.
  • Support PR activities, brand collaborations, and monthly influencer reporting.

3. Wholesale & Retail Operations

  • Coordinate new wholesale account enquiries, onboarding, and ongoing retailer relationships.
  • Process wholesale orders, confirmations, and invoicing using Unleashed.
  • Maintain wholesale pricing, product information, retailer documentation, and promotional materials.
  • Coordinate with distributors, retail partners, warehouses, and logistics providers to ensure timely order fulfilment.
  • Support wholesale reporting, sales performance tracking, and retailer re-order activities.

4. Supply Chain & Inventory Coordination

  • Assist with production scheduling, purchase orders, supplier follow-ups, and import/export logistics.
  • Monitor stock levels, inventory movements, batch tracking, expiry dates, and warehouse accuracy.
  • Liaise with manufacturers, suppliers, freight providers, and 3PL partners across New Zealand and Australia.
  • Track production timelines, warehouse transfers, delivery documentation, and supplier milestones.
  • Support demand forecasting, inventory reporting, and monthly supply and operations planning.

5. Project & Business Operations

  • Coordinate new product development activities, including product documentation, specifications, costing records, and production timelines.
  • Support product launches, packaging readiness, and operational project administration.
  • Maintain operational trackers, master data, dashboards, SOPs, and shared documentation.
  • Assist with business-wide projects, process improvements, system integration, and operational reporting.

This is a customer-focused position that requires excellent communication skills, empathy, confidence on outbound calls, and strong attention to detail.


Key Responsibilities

  • Make outbound calls to existing veterinary clinic clients whose pets are overdue for wellness visits and preventive care.

  • Handle objections, hesitations, and questions professionally while maintaining a positive customer experience.
  • Accurately document calls, client responses, appointment bookings, and follow-up requirements in the designated systems.
  • Respect client communication preferences and honor requests not to be contacted.

Schedule flexibility is important.


Compensation

Applicants must have:

  • Windows 11 computer (Macs NOT accepted)
  • Minimum 16 GB RAM
  • i5 processor or higher
  • Webcam & wired USB headset
  • Additional monitors
  • Reliable wired high-speed internet connection (Ethernet cable)
  • Backup power solution

Applications that do not meet the minimum technical requirements may not be considered.

Applicants selected to move forward will complete:

  1. English Resume Review

Important

  • Comfortable making frequent outbound calls and speaking confidently with customers.

  • Reliable, accountable, punctual, and able to work independently.
  • Ability to follow scripts, procedures, and quality standards while adapting naturally to conversations.

Preferred Experience

  • Veterinary clinic or animal care environments.

Veterinary or healthcare experience is an advantage, but it is not mandatory.

054daa40b946b367.title: Internship Strategy M&A (m/f/d)
054daa40b946b367.description:
Empower every Employee

AI has changed how office workers get things done. For the 80% of the global workforce that doesn’t sit at a desk, it has barely arrived. Flip AI is changing that.

Flip AI is the #1 Frontline Agentic Operating System (OS) to build, automate, and orchestrate any frontline use case on a foundation of secure identity and comms with strong UX. In practice, that means one app where frontline workers in retail, manufacturing and logistics access their systems, run their processes, and use AI.

More than 1,000 brands trust Flip AI, and over two million people use it worldwide, at companies like Bosch, REWE, FORVIA HELLA and Greif. In August 2026, Notion Capital and HV Capital doubled down with a new $25M round, bringing our total funding to more than $85M.

Our mission: Connect every employee to everything they need in one touch.


About the Role

You work directly with the SVP Strategy & Growth and the senior leadership team. You turn data into recommendations on strategy, go-to-market, product focus and M&A. You will gain C-level exposure: as your work goes directly to the CEO and the Board.

 
 

What awaits you with us

Strategy & Growth: Run analyses and turn insights into strategic shifts

  • Assess market size, growth and trends to identify new opportunities.

  • Analyze competitors’ products and go-to-market strategies.

  • Define customer segments and ideal customer profiles.

  • Review product strategy, differentiation, strengths and gaps.

  • Analyze personas and buyer journeys to inform positioning and messaging.

  • Examine go-to-market metrics such as pipeline coverage and win rates.

  • Prepare board and leadership materials together with the C-level.

M&A: Take the lead in end-to-end M&A processes, from screening to integration.

  • Screen potential M&A targets.

  • Support due diligence, build preliminary valuation models with assumptions and sensitivities and early in-depth reviews.

  • Take a leading role in post-merger integration efforts.

AI: Use AI every day and take it further.

  • Build your own tools with AI: automate analyses and build dashboards and workflows.

  • Build AI skills and Agents to automate processes together with our internal AI Enablement team.

 

What you bring to the table

  • A Master’s or an advanced Bachelor’s in Business, STEM, Economics or a related field.

  • Availability for at least 3 months.

  • A structured, hypothesis-driven way of working with a focus on execution.

  • AI literacy: you use AI tools every day, leverage them for productivity and you check their output critically.

  • Strong analytical skills, and you can create visually compelling presentations for management and the board that get straight to the point.

  • Fluent German and English, written and spoken and you’re clear and persuasive in both speaking and writing.

  • Ideally experience in strategy consulting, business development, M&A or as a Founder’s Associate.

Nice to have

  • Industry Knowledge of software, SaaS or tech.

  • You have already vibecoded something. Send us the link.

What we offer you

  • AI is how we work: Access to frontier AI tools is standard here, not something you request. We actively encourage heavy use across content, design, analysis and reporting.

  • Work mode: We’re remote-first, giving you flexibility to work from home. At the same time, we deeply value the power of in-person collaboration. Depending on the role, you’ll join occasional team events, workshops, or meetings in our Berlin or Stuttgart offices, always with plenty of notice. The exact balance will be discussed during your interview.

  • Time off: 30 days of vacation plus public holidays.

  • Work-life balance: We don’t want you to grow roots to your desk chair. Choose between a Wellpass membership and a Givve card.

  • A team you’ll actually meet: The whole company gets together twice a year, plus regular team events and culture days.

  • Working abroad: After your probation period, you can also work from abroad within the European Union. Let’s talk about remote work in the interview.

At Flip AI, everyone is welcome – no matter what gender you identify as or how old you are. Sexual identity, origin, religion, world view and disabilities do not influence your potential job at Flip AI. The most important thing is that YOU fit in!

fd21c134d4951ae3.title: Director AI Platform Engineering
fd21c134d4951ae3.description:
Our client is building a new AI Engineering & Platform team in Germany to support the next generation of AI-powered media, localization, automation, and workflow capabilities. The Director, AI Engineering & Platform will lead this team and will be responsible for building, operating, and evolving the technical foundation for production AI services across our client.

This is a senior hands-on leadership role for someone who can build and run a high-performing engineering team, deliver complex AI platform and integration projects, and provide technical direction across cloud infrastructure, model deployment, AI services, agentic workflows, and production operations. The role will lead a hybrid engineering team based primarily in Germany while also managing and collaborating with engineers in other our client locations, including the United States.

In addition to leading delivery and operations, this person will continuously evaluate emerging AI technologies, model providers, open-source frameworks, agentic workflow patterns, and industry capabilities. They will be expected to make clear recommendations on where our client should build, buy, partner, or integrate in order to improve speed, quality, cost, automation, and product differentiation.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Build, lead, mentor, and develop a distributed AI engineering team across Germany and other our client locations. Experience recruiting, hiring, and standing up the full AI/ML engineering organization from scratch: applied ML engineers, MLOps/platform engineers, data engineers, integration engineers, etc.

  • Lead development, hosting and ongoing improvement of our client’s cloud-native training and inference platform (compute, storage, orchestration, model serving, monitoring, cost management) for our client’s NLP technology for MT, ASR, and TTS in production.

  • Own technical delivery for our client’s AI platform, model-serving, workflow automation, and applied AI engineering initiatives.

  • Lead architecture,execution, deployment and SLA performance for scalable AI services, including inference platforms, training environments, deployment pipelines, observability, and operational support.

  • Own infrastructure cost efficiency (GPU utilization, training vs. inference cost trade-offs, autoscaling) as a first-class, ongoing responsibility rather than a one-time setup task.

  • Evaluate internal and external AI technologies on an ongoing basis, including commercial models, open-source models, agentic frameworks, orchestration tools, and vendor platforms.

  • Recommend when our client should build, buy, partner, or integrate with third-party AI capabilities.

  • Guide teams responsible for cloud infrastructure, DevOps, AI platform operations, applied AI engineering, and model integration.

  • Establish engineering standards, operating rhythms, delivery practices, documentation expectations, and technical review processes.

  • Establish and drive MLOps practices: continuous improvement across AI engineering practices, reproducible training pipelines, model versioning and registry, automation, CI/CD, monitoring, automated quality evaluation, testing, and release management.

  • Support adoption of AI capabilities across our client applications and workflows through reusable platforms, services, APIs, and technical patterns.

  • Create clarity around priorities, risks, technical tradeoffs, delivery timelines, and resourcing needs.

  • Ensure the team can operate production AI systems independently through strong documentation, runbooks, monitoring, incident response, and knowledge sharing.

  • Partner with U.S. and European stakeholders across engineering, product, operations, localization, media workflows, and business leadership. Partner closely with the leaders of our client’s localization business lines to understand where current MT/ASR/TTS quality falls short and translate that into a prioritized technical roadmap.

  • Ensure AI systems are reliable, secure, maintainable, cost-conscious, and aligned with production business needs.

  • Represent AI/ML technology capability and constraints to executive leadership; contribute to the company's overall technology and product strategy.

QUALIFICATIONS:

  • [10+] years in software/ML engineering, including [4+] years in a technical leadership role owning both people management and architecture/system-design decisions.

  • Direct, hands-on experience with model training/fine-tuning, evaluation methodology, and production deployment (not solely API-consumer experience).

  • Proven experience designing and operating production ML infrastructure at scale: training pipelines, model serving/inference, GPU resource management, and MLOps tooling, on at least one major cloud provider (AWS, GCP, or Azure). Experience in distributed training, Slurm/HPC, Kubernetes, Docker, Terraform, or similar infrastructure technologies.

  • Track record of building a technical team from scratch to a functioning, multi-workstream organization, including recruiting, leveling, and distributed team design across locations and time zones.

  • Demonstrated ability to translate business/product requirements from non-technical stakeholders into a technical roadmap, and to communicate technical trade-offs to executives in business terms.

  • Significant experience leading engineering teams responsible for cloud platforms, AI/ML systems, data platforms, workflow automation, or production software systems.

  • Strong technical background in cloud architecture, software engineering, platform engineering, DevOps, or AI/ML engineering.

  • Experience with agentic workflows, LLM orchestration, model evaluation, RAG patterns, or AI-enabled automation platforms.

  • Experience evaluating commercial and open-source AI models or vendor platforms.

  • Experience delivering production systems that require reliability, monitoring, automation, security, and operational ownership.

  • Strong understanding of modern AI architectures, model-serving patterns, APIs, data pipelines, and applied AI integration.

  • Ability to evaluate technical options, make pragmatic recommendations, and communicate tradeoffs to both technical and non-technical audiences.

  • Experience leading complex technical programs from planning through production deployment and ongoing operations.

  • Ability to work effectively with U.S.-based leadership while operating independently from Germany.

PREFERRED EXPERIENCE:

  • Experience with speech, language, localization, dubbing, media workflows, ASR, MT, TTS, or content-processing systems.

  • Prior experience in media, localization, entertainment technology, or a related content-production industry — direct exposure to subtitling, dubbing, or content compliance workflows is a strong plus.

  • Familiarity with content-security frameworks used by major studios and broadcasters (e.g., MPA content security best practices, Trusted Partner Network) and what they require of vendor/internal systems.

  • Prior experience taking over or migrating away from a third-party AI/ML vendor relationship, including contract wind-down and knowledge-transfer.

  • Experience in media, entertainment, localization, post-production, or content supply chain environments.

4402b88ac090f68e.title: Staff Fullstack Engineer
4402b88ac090f68e.description:
Deep Tech Recruitment is partnering with a Speedinvest venture-backed European AI company building the modern software backbone for specialist pharmaceutical and chemical manufacturers.

Its mission is to strengthen the resilience of essential European supply chains by helping manufacturers overcome skilled labour shortages, respond faster to disruption and reduce the operational risk created by ageing ERP systems, spreadsheets and fragmented knowledge. The business is developing an AI-native operating environment that provides consistent data and intelligent workflows across order management, production planning, materials planning and procurement, while retaining the human oversight required in regulated industries.

The company

The company is building an AI native software backbone for specialist manufacturers, initially across mission critical pharmaceutical and chemical supply chains. Many of these businesses still run critical order, planning and procurement processes through ageing ERP systems, spreadsheets and knowledge held by a small number of experienced employees.

The product combines workflow automation, AI agents and human approval to help operational teams respond faster while maintaining accuracy, traceability and compliance. The engineering team works close to customers, including visits to operational environments, to understand how work happens and turn it into dependable software.

The role

As an early staff engineering hire, you will help shape the platform from its first production versions. This is a hands on full stack role with strong backend ownership. You will work directly with the founders, influence architecture and engineering standards, and stay close to the users whose workflows you are improving.

Why consider it

You will have meaningful influence over the architecture, product and early engineering culture.

The technical work combines AI enabled systems, enterprise integration and demanding operational constraints.

The product supports essential European industries where software reliability and human judgement both matter.

The package includes a competitive base salary and meaningful early stage equity through a VSOP.

What you will do

  • Build end to end product features with TypeScript, Node.js, React and Next.js.

  • Design and evolve backend services, APIs and system architecture for complex operational workflows.

  • Model and optimise data in PostgreSQL, with attention to reliability, performance and auditability.

  • Develop multi step AI agent workflows with validation logic, evaluations, monitoring and human approval points.

  • Integrate with enterprise systems including ERPs, communication tools and document platforms through REST APIs and other interfaces.

  • Support cloud and on premises deployments, working directly with customer IT teams where required.

  • Build secure, traceable workflows suitable for regulated environments and contribute to audit readiness and compliance documentation.

  • Join customer conversations, understand real operating constraints and translate them into product and technical decisions.

  • Help establish the engineering culture, technical bar and practical ways of working for the team as it grows.

What AI native means here

The company uses external language models and coding agents to build and ship software faster. The role involves engineering reliable AI enabled workflows around those models. It does not involve training foundation models or conducting AI research. Strong software engineering judgement remains central, particularly around evaluation, failure modes, observability and human oversight.

What you bring

  • Around 3 to 5 or more years of experience building and operating production software.

  • Strong backend engineering skills with Node.js, API design and system architecture.

  • Solid PostgreSQL experience, including data modelling and query optimisation.

  • Experience integrating REST APIs and external systems.

  • The ability to work across the stack using JavaScript or TypeScript and React or Next.js.

  • A hands on approach. You can reason about architecture and still write, test and ship production code.

  • Fluent English for technical collaboration and customer conversations.

  • The willingness to work with the team from the Berlin office five days a week.

Useful additional experience

  • Enterprise software or products built for regulated, high security environments.

  • LLM integrations using providers such as OpenAI, Anthropic or Google, including evaluation and monitoring.

  • ERP integrations such as SAP, Microsoft Dynamics 365 or Infor.

  • Cloud infrastructure, DevOps and connections to on premises or legacy systems.

  • German language skills for direct customer communication.

  • Strong product and UX instincts, or experience working with design systems.

How the team works

  • High ownership and direct access to the founding team.

  • Fast iteration informed by customer workflows and operational reality.

  • Clear expectations, practical decision making and space to shape how engineering is done.

  • A long term product build with the opportunity to grow into broader technical leadership as the team expands.

Interview process

The process combines founder & engineering conversations with practical technical assessment. You should expect an architecture discussion and a hands-on coding exercise focused on how you think, communicate and build with modern engineering tools, including AI-assisted development.

Inclusion and accessibility

Our client is committed to an inclusive environment in which people of every gender identity, sexual orientation, race, religion, age, neurotype and disability can belong and contribute. Diverse teams make better decisions, and equity is treated as a condition for innovation.

If you need reasonable adjustments during the application or interview process, including assistive technology, additional time or another format, tell your Deep Tech Recruitment contact and we will support you.

BUILD THE IMPOSSIBLE. WE’LL FIND THE PEOPLE.

Deep Tech Recruitment connects ambitious technology companies with the engineers and leaders who can turn difficult ideas into products that perform in the real world.
