0a8df353b9d133ac.title: Infrastructure Engineer
0a8df353b9d133ac.location: London or remote within the UK
0a8df353b9d133ac.description:
About Griffin

Hi, we’re Griffin. We’re a fully regulated UK bank that powers the accounts and payments offerings of product-led fintechs and platforms like Uber, Yonder, Prosper, and Sidekick. By doing the heavy lifting behind the scenes, our customers can focus on what they do best - delivering amazing customer experiences.

We’ve grown rapidly since our launch in 2024, and today provide the banking backbone behind products in remittance, payroll, wealth, insurance, proptech, payments, neobanking and more.

We’re moving into card issuing, stablecoin infrastructure, and agentic finance next as we continue to support the next generation of product-led companies.

Learn more about what we do

Our culture

We believe that smart, motivated, conscientious people thrive in high-trust, high-autonomy environments and have done our best to create such an environment at Griffin. People who thrive here don’t require much hand-holding, and go out of their way to figure out how to contribute in the most valuable way possible.

We've been remote-first since we were established in 2017 and we remain so today. Work here is asynchronous and fully flexible - because we want to be a part of your life in a way that helps you to get the most out of both your work and home life.

We understand that our culture and ways of working aren’t for everyone, and we’re very intentional about our hiring process as a result. We won't hire people who don’t seem like a strong fit for our core values, even if they're otherwise extremely qualified.

Our strong culture has helped us to remain a mission-driven company as we have scaled, and gives our people a clear, explicit operating framework and the space to focus on delivering real value for our customers.

Learn more about our culture.

The team

Infrastructure sits within the Craft function. We’re a small team of three - two engineers and an engineering manager - who work closely with our CTO and Founder, Allen Rohner. It’s our job to build the foundations that everything else at Griffin runs on: the systems, the tooling, the automation that helps us run a highly resilient and reliable platform and lets other teams ship fast. We're a software engineering team as much as an infrastructure team: we write the code that runs our platform, not just the configuration around it.

When we start work, we explore multiple solutions before picking one. We write RFCs, build proof-of-concepts, and run experiments to validate approaches. Once we commit to building something, we care about maintainability more than cleverness, observability more than hoping it works, and scalability over premature optimisation. We take the necessary time to ship quality solutions rather than hitting arbitrary deadlines. Once something goes live, we refactor the rough edges rather than polish what's already working.

The opportunity

Day to day, you'll build and manage the infrastructure the bank runs on - both in the cloud and on our own hardware in third party data centres. This means running FoundationDB clusters and writing the software and tooling for hitless upgrades, managing Kubernetes, writing infrastructure as code in Pulumi and CDK, running the Bazel build farm, and owning the deployment pipeline from CI to production.

Operational resilience is a big part of the job: replica clusters, multi-region failover, and chaos engineering to test how systems handle failures. Security access, CircleCI pipelines, DataDog integration, and cloud spend all fall under infrastructure too.

On our roadmap currently is: building out our self-hosted infrastructure to support a hybrid-cloud setup and remove single-vendor reliance, improving how Kubernetes scales, improving the build farm, and building out our PKI infrastructure. We also have plans for a global HTTP routing layer to allow seamless failover between sites. Much of this is software we built ourselves, and you'll shape it from the first design through to production.

Our infrastructure as code is written in TypeScript. Where it makes sense, tooling gets written in Clojure. There's some Rust too.

What success looks like

Infrastructure problems become production problems fast. Success here means thinking ahead - identifying issues with scale, security, or compliance before they affect services.

You've eliminated an entire class of incidents by fixing the underlying architectural issue. You've proven the database and compute platform can handle 10x current traffic volumes by working with backend teams to stress-test it. You've cut deploy times in half by rethinking how the pipeline works. You've tested multi-region failover under realistic failure scenarios and it worked.

You've shipped well-tested software that turns risky manual operations, like database upgrades, into routine, hitless ones that the whole team maintains with confidence.

You've redesigned service discovery to remove networking issues that used to cause weekly firefights. When new FCA requirements dropped, you were already compliant because you'd built the infrastructure to handle it months earlier.

To do this, you'll own

  • Infrastructure architecture decisions - how we structure our systems, what approaches we take, what tools we build

  • Production reliability - keeping the database, compute, build farm, and deployment pipelines running and improving them

  • What other teams depend on to ship - CI/CD, security access, monitoring integration, and the infrastructure that lets engineers deploy safely

  • Infrastructure cost and efficiency - managing spend and resource usage across AWS and DataDog

  • Infrastructure software - the code behind our database control plane, operational tooling and automation, from design and implementation through to testing, code review and maintenance

Stack: FoundationDB, Kubernetes, Bazel, Pulumi, CDK, CircleCI, DataDog, Clojure, TypeScript

Your background

You'll fit in well here if you have:

  • Solid systems experience - you've run container orchestration in production, written infrastructure as code, and understand IP networking well enough to debug it when things go wrong

  • Cloud infrastructure experience - you've built and managed production environments, worked with networking, identity management, and compute at scale

  • Strong software engineering fundamentals - you write code to solve problems, and you're as comfortable designing, testing and reviewing production software as you are configuring infrastructure. TypeScript, Python, Go, or functional languages are all fine. If your experience only extends to Bash scripting and YAML, we probably aren't a good fit for you

  • Comfort with startup environments - small teams, shifting priorities, high autonomy

We write a lot of our tooling in Clojure - our database control plane, operational scripts, and automation. You don't need Clojure experience coming in, but you'll need to learn it once you're here. If you've worked with functional languages before, that helps.

Regardless, you should be comfortable picking up new languages and approaches as we do find ourselves reading through the codebases of open-source systems and tools we use to understand their behaviour, and they are written in a diverse range of languages we don't use ourselves.

What can we offer you?

We are an early stage startup and we're working hard to expand our benefits package. We're planning to add to this list in the future.

  • Remote-first flexibility: Work from anywhere in the UK

  • Work from abroad: Up to 20 days a year

  • Time off: 28 days’ holiday + bank holidays

  • Share options: Own a part of what we’re building together

  • Pension: Auto-enrolment into our Penfold scheme

  • Insurance: Private medical with Bupa (including family cover) and life insurance with AIG

  • Wellbeing: 1:1 coaching and therapy session available through Oliva

  • Family leave: Enhanced parental leave with up to 6 months on full pay after two years’ service

  • AI tools: Everyone has a Claude subscription on us and access to other premium tools

  • Your setup: We’ll support you in creating a comfortable and effective WFH environment.

As a bank, we’re committed to maintaining the highest standards of security. This means that the successful candidate will need to complete background screening, and our offer will be conditional upon satisfactory review of these checks. This would include verification of right to work, criminal record, credit history, social media and professional reference checks.

How do I apply?

Are we your next move? Apply via the link below, if there's a match our Talent team will reach out to schedule an initial conversation and talk you through what happens next.

We don’t work with recruitment agencies, so please don’t send us speculative CVs.

Under representation

At Griffin, we’re looking for people who instinctively vibe with our values, behaviours and mission. You’re encouraged to apply, even if your experience doesn’t tick every box. Careers, like life, can take many twists and turns. Your technical expertise and path to where you are today will stand out. We're committed to creating a place where everyone belongs and we welcome diverse perspectives, backgrounds and people who are ready to build a global platform for programmable finance

96b7a15ee36b574d.description:
Building the Future of Open Finance

Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system.

The team

Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients.

Consumer Growth builds mobile and web experiences that help people become Kraken customers, fund their accounts, invest, earn, access new products, build wealth and stay lifelong clients. Product, engineering, design, data, and lifecycle marketing build together.

 

The opportunity

  • Own growth in viral, KOL- and creator-referred new transacting users (NTUs). Set aggressive NTU targets backed by a credible growth model, then beat them. Build and scale sharing, referral, and creator systems that drive 10x, then 50x growth while hitting payback targets.

  • Build sharing people find useful. Create natural reasons to pass on product value, and referral programs with modeled payback incentives, and without relying on aggressive incentives to hit targets. Make both work for the sender, recipient, and business.

  • Own the audience-to-customer journey. Build and test paths from recommendations and creator audiences to product value and a first transaction. Partner with the teams that own onboarding and core product experiences on shared journeys.

  • Own Consumer features and updates for the KOL Platform. Set the Consumer roadmap, ship features and ongoing improvements, and make measurement and commercial tools trustworthy and easy to use. Work with the teams that own KOL and affiliate relationships.

  • Build creator tools across Kraken’s app and web. Help creators, key opinion leaders (KOLs), and power referrers invite their followers and turn their audiences into valuable new transacting customers. Understand their different motivations and build with core product teams.

  • Make acquisition economics work. Own acquisition cost and gross-margin payback against clear targets, including fully loaded incentive, partner, operating, and fraud costs. Use downstream retention and revenue to judge what deserves more investment.

  • Increase virality per new transacting user and per returning user. Test ways to improve send conversion, invites per sender, and invite-to-first-transaction conversion. Improve repeat sharing and loop speed, and prove the gains create incremental valuable new transacting customers.

  • Build measurement you can trust. Validate instrumentation, define hypotheses and guardrails, and run tests that can detect meaningful effects. Separate attributed activity from incremental growth, interpret uncertainty honestly, and check that gains persist as you scale.

 

What you bring

  • You’ve personally built a product, tool, feature, or experience that spread beyond its initial audience. You can explain why it spread, your contribution, and how it acquired valuable customers.

  • Repeated success beating acquisition targets through referrals, product virality, or creator-led growth. Show the baseline, target, result, timeframe, component rates you improved, and your personal contribution. Bring evidence the gains lasted.

  • Strong growth product sense. You understand sharing psychology and the different motivations of customers, creators, KOLs, and power referrers. You combine customer research, creative product instincts, and strong UX and copy to give people a reason to participate.

  • Analytical independence. You independently investigate behavior with SQL and product analytics, validate instrumentation, and build funnel, cohort, and growth models.

  • Experimentation and commercial judgment. You design reliable tests, interpret uncertainty honestly, and distinguish attribution from incremental growth. You understand acquisition cost and payback, including downstream retention, revenue, and fully loaded incentive and fraud costs.

  • Senior ownership and hands-on execution. You set strategy, make hard priority calls, align teams without relying on reporting lines, and deliver autonomously. You use AI and working prototypes to turn original ideas into experiences people can try.

 

Nice to haves

  • Experience building self-service creator or affiliate tools, revenue-share systems, or reliable partner payouts.

  • Consumer fintech, crypto, payments, or experience designing financial promotions and fraud controls.

  • Experience adapting growth journeys across markets, cultures, and regulatory environments.

c1d7d04e87131f6b.description:
Building the Future of Open Finance

Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system.

The team

Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients.

We are looking for a Security GRC Lead to own security governance, risk, and compliance across Payward's acquisitions. You will be the accountable owner for bringing each acquired company from its own control environment into ours, working with the M&A Technology Team from diligence through to either full platform migration or steady-state coverage under our central program.

Payward acquires and integrates companies continuously, across multiple jurisdictions and regulatory regimes. Every target arrives with its own controls, its own maturity level and its own audit history, and every one enters our financial statement audit scope on a timeline set by the deal rather than by readiness. Today that work competes for the same people who run controls for the parent company. This role exists so that it has a dedicated owner.

This is a build role to uphold the repeatable process for assessing an acquired company against our security baseline, mapping its controls into our compliance frameworks,and setting remediation milestones a newly acquired team can realistically hit. You will then run it, deal after deal, and you are accountable for the work getting done.

 

The opportunity

  • Assess each acquisition target against Payward's security baseline, during diligence where deal timelines allow and immediately post-close otherwise

  • Map the acquired company's existing controls to Payward's control framework, and identify gaps against the external frameworks the entity falls under once in scope

  • Score control maturity at the entity level and document the basis for each score

  • Define remediation milestones that are achievable for the acquired team's size and maturity, sequenced by risk reduction rather than by framework order

  • Track milestones to closure and report status to Security GRC leadership and the M&A Technology Team

  • Recommend the endpoint for each entity: full migration onto Payward platforms, or uplift to a maturity level the central program can absorb

  • Load acquired-entity risks into the enterprise risk register and keep them current

  • Prepare acquired entities for inclusion in external audit scope, including evidence collection and walkthrough support

  • Act as the Security GRC point of contact for acquired-entity leadership, finance, and internal audit

  • Maintain policy coverage for acquired entities, including building entity-specific policy libraries where the parent policy set does not apply cleanly

  • Feed recurring findings back into the diligence process, so later deals are assessed against known patterns

  • Document the onboarding process so that it is repeatable and not dependent on one person

 

What Will you Do

  • Target Assessment

    • Review target security posture during diligence: control environment, identity and access management, infrastructure, third-party dependencies, and prior audit or examination history

    • Produce a written assessment of each target against the Payward security baseline, separating the risks that matter to the deal from those that matter to steady-state operations

    • Give the M&A Technology Team and deal sponsors a clear read on what integration will cost in control remediation terms

  • Control Mapping and Framework Onboarding

    • Map acquired controls to Payward's framework and to the external frameworks the entity becomes subject to

    • Identify which parent-company controls extend to the entity as they are, which need an entity-specific variant, and which have no equivalent at all

    • Build the entity's policy library where the parent policy set does not cover it

  • Remediation and Milestones

    • Set milestones the acquired team can meet, each with a date, an owner, and a stated risk reduction

    • Sequence work so that the highest-risk gaps close first rather than the easiest ones

    • Run the cadence for tracking remediation and escalating overdue or material risks Prepare proposed risk acceptances, including the rationale and compensating controls, and present them to leadership for decision

  • Program Integration

    • Prepare entities for external audit inclusion and support fieldwork

    • Keep acquired-entity risk visible in the enterprise risk register and in Security GRC reporting

    • Hand each entity over to central GRC coverage once its maturity supports it, with the handover documented

    • Integrate 3rd parties and vendors into Payward

What you bring

  • 5-7+ years in security governance, IT risk, or compliance, including regulated financial services, fintech, or virtual asset environments

  • Direct experience onboarding an acquired company into an existing controls or compliance program. This is the core of the role

  • Working knowledge of SOX/ICFR IT general controls and what external auditors accept as evidence

  • Experience with at least two of ISO 27001, SOC 1, SOC 2, and PCI DSS, including mapping controls across frameworks

  • Ability to assess control maturity and set remediation plans the receiving team completes, including teams below Payward's maturity level

  • Hands-on delivery: you write the scope, collect the evidence, and close gaps yourself when needed

  • Sound judgment on priorities with incomplete information, and the sense to escalate decisions that need leadership

  • Ability to build working relationships with control owners in IAM, infrastructure, and engineering

  • Ability to translate control gaps into risk language that deal teams and executives can act on

  • Strong project management across cross-functional, distributed teams

  • Preferred

    • CISA, CRISC, CISM, CISSP, or ISO 27001 Lead Implementer

    • M&A or post-merger technology integration experience

    • Familiarity with PKM

 

Why This Role

  • You will own a domain end to end rather than supporting someone else's. There is no incumbent process and no one else doing this work today

  • Acquisitions are one of the fastest-moving parts of the business, and security integration sits on the critical path for each one

  • You will work directly with deal teams, acquired-company leadership, external auditors, and Security GRC leadership, with visibility into how acquisitions are evaluated and closed

  • Payward is preparing for public company reporting, which means the controls you put in place at acquired entities are the ones external auditors will test

  • The scope of this role grows with the acquisition pipeline, across jurisdictions and regulatory regimes

  • You will join a remote-first, international team

f93bf768ff0be493.description:
Building the Future of Open Finance

Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system.

The team

Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients.

Kraken’s world-class Security Team is growing. As we continue to scale and mature our information technology controls program, we are seeking a senior professional with a strong background in risk management to help build and operate a program designed for enterprise scale.

Kraken is seeking a Senior Risk Analyst to join the Security Governance, Risk, and Compliance (SecGRC) team. Reporting to the Senior Manager of Security Risk Management, this role is a key contributor to the execution and maturation of Kraken's Security Risk Management program. You'll conduct rigorous risk assessments, produce high-quality analysis, and help build the operational infrastructure that makes the program run — all in close partnership with program leadership. This role offers the opportunity to make a meaningful and lasting impact both within Kraken and across the broader industry.

The ideal candidate is deeply analytical, process-minded, and energized by turning ambiguous risk signals into clear, repeatable, and scalable workflows. Entrepreneurial spirit and comfort with iterating quickly is a must. This is a fully remote role.

6231bf15a7d91a9d.description:
Building the Future of Open Finance

Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system.

The team

Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. Offering spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients.

Kraken Pro is where serious traders work. Tight spreads, deep books, an API people actually build on. The people who use it are demanding, opinionated, and allergic to marketing.

We want someone who belongs in that room. Not a brand account with a person behind it, but a trader's trader who happens to be very good at building community.

Come here to build and grow this Community for us.

The opportunity

  • Live in the trenches. Discord, Telegram, X, TradingView, Reddit, the group chats you're already in at 3am. You're not "monitoring channels". You're a participant, with standing.

  • Be the fastest voice in the room. When a chain halts, a listing drops, or the market goes vertical, you're posting before the screenshots start circulating. Speed with accuracy, not vibes.

  • Build the inner circle. Stand up an ambassador and power-user program: the market makers, quant desks, and high-volume traders who'll tell you the truth about the product. Give them a reason to stay loud.

  • Run the room in public. AMAs, live trading sessions, feature launches, competitions, post-mortems when we get something wrong. Own the format, don't just attend it.

  • Close the loop with Product. You'll be the first to hear that the order entry flow is broken. Your job is to get it to the PM with receipts, then go back and tell the community what happened.

  • Write things people screenshot. Threads on microstructure, teardowns of new features, release notes that don't read like release notes.

  • Prove it worked. Sentiment, share of voice, community-sourced signups, retention of the accounts that matter. You bring the numbers to the table before anyone asks.

What you’ll bring

  • You trade. Actual positions, actual scars. You can hold a conversation about funding rates, maker/taker economics, slippage, and latency without reaching for a glossary.

  • 3+ years running community or social for a product with a technical, skeptical audience. Crypto, fintech, gaming, or dev tools all count.

  • You write fast and well. Short-form that lands, long-form that holds up under scrutiny from people smarter than the average follower.

  • You have thick skin and good instincts. Crypto community management means getting yelled at with an audience watching. You de-escalate without going corporate and you know when to push back.

  • You've built something from a standing start, not just maintained an existing account.

  • You operate without a brief. Markets don't wait for approval chains, and neither should you… because you know where the line is and you don't need a committee to find it.

  • You're comfortable with the ambiguity of a company that ships constantly and reorganizes around opportunity.

560159d5d19eab3a.description:
About Us

Condukt is the next-generation compliance platform for financial services, offering an agentic solution powered by real-time data for business identity.

Always-on and policy-aware, Condukt enables financial institutions and fintechs to gain actionable insights into business verification - unlocking growth, increasing efficiency, and strengthening compliance.

We were founded by former operators and builders with deep experience in banking, payments, and lending. Today, our team spans across London and Porto, bringing together engineers, product owners, and operators from companies like Revolut, Meta, Block (Square), SumUp, American Express, Yandex, and OakNorth.

Trusted by leading regulated entities, including Wise, Tide, Mollie, Shift4, Flatpay, and myPOS, Condukt is backed by top investors, including Lightspeed Venture Partners and MMC Ventures.

 

Position Overview

As a GTM Associate, you’ll sit at the centre of Condukt’s commercial engine, generating new pipeline across financial services and working hand in hand with our Account Executives to turn it into revenue.

You’ll build opportunities from the ground up: reaching high-growth fintechs and financial institutions with well-researched outreach, qualifying inbound interest quickly, and running first discovery conversations. Your work doesn’t end at the first meeting. You’ll stay on the deal with our Account Executives, help build the customer relationship and, as you grow, lead smaller deals end to end alongside an AE.

As an early-stage, fast-growing company, we value people who take ownership, move with urgency, and are excited to help build both a market-leading product and a repeatable enterprise sales motion. You’ll work closely with our AI Deployment Strategists, Product, Engineering, and Leadership to shape how we sell, who we sell to, and how we win.

If you’re at the start of your commercial career, energised by meeting new people, and keen to take on more responsibility fast, this role is for you.

 

What you’ll do:

  • Own early-stage pipeline creation with fintechs and financial institutions that match our ideal customer profile

  • Research and map target accounts, identifying the right C-level Risk & Compliance, Operations, and Product leaders to engage

  • Help build and run our outbound motion, with sharp, well-researched messaging across email, LinkedIn, phone and events. Test creative formats beyond the usual sequences, and turn what works into a repeatable playbook

  • Respond fast to inbound interest and qualify every lead on fit, urgency and decision-makers

  • Lead discovery calls, support AEs on live deals and, as you grow, lead smaller deals end to end

  • Bring what you hear from the market back to Product and Leadership, helping shape who we sell to and spot new market opportunities

  • Pick up whatever the business needs next: priorities will shift as we scale, and you’ll help shape where we go

What you bring:

  • 1-3 years in a client-facing or target-carrying role, with a proven record of booking net-new meetings

  • Genuine energy for meeting people, and the confidence to pick up the phone, walk into a room of strangers and start the conversation

  • Resilience in the face of rejection, and the drive to keep going for the wins

  • Ability to learn fast, handle ambiguity and change course when priorities shift

  • Hands-on attitude, with a focus on outcomes rather than titles

  • Intellectual curiosity about the compliance space

  • Fluency with AI and data tools to work faster and smarter

  • Strong organisation across follow-ups, sequences and your CRM

  • Low-ego, collaborative approach and openness to feedback

  • Genuine interest in fintech and how financial institutions onboard customers and manage risk

  • Excellent written and spoken English

  • The right to work in the UK

Bonus:

  • Sales experience preferred, but not required for the role

  • Background in fintech, banking, payments, or lending ecosystems

  • Second language proficiency (German, French, and Dutch, especially valued)

 

Our offer:

  • Tackle meaningful problems with real-world impact

  • Competitive salary and equity package

  • Flat hierarchy with direct access to the founders

  • Hybrid, 3 days a week in our London office

  • Top-of-the-line equipment

  • Private health insurance, plus sick and compassionate leave as needed

ec91f842c5d8fd7f.description:
Partner Solutions Engineer

At Phrase, we help open the door to global business by providing the world's leading Language Intelligence Platform.

The Phrase Platform combines AI, agentic orchestration, and a headless, API-first architecture in one composable system. Beyond translation, it orchestrates and adapts content to culture, audience, channel, brand voice, and intended outcome in any language, for every audience. It applies the context that makes content perform in every market: quality standards, glossaries, prior translations, and cultural nuance. Every team, in every region, can ship content that is on-brand, on-point, and ready for any audience.

Phrase gives enterprises the intelligence to automate workflows, the freedom to connect their own tools and engines, and the control to govern global content at scale.

With a global team based in our offices, and remote colleagues across Europe, the UK, the US, and the APAC region, Phrase offers an international environment built on collaboration, innovation, and shared purpose.

Partner Solutions Engineer is a new role in Solutions Engineering, built to help agencies make AI useful in their clients' global content workflows. You will lead the solutions side of partner-led deals from the first conversation to close, working alongside Partnerships, who lead on commercials. The people you meet are production and technology teams in agencies, language service providers and martech and AI platforms, who work in content operations and want answers quickly. You will report to the VP, Solutions Engineering, and work exclusively on partner-led deals, helping to shape how the role works as it grows.

This is a global role: we would ideally like you based in the UK or Western Europe and working on UK time, but we are flexible for the right person.

What you'll be responsible for:

  • Lead the solutions side of partner-led opportunities from first conversation to close, while Partnerships leads on commercials

  • Find the business problem a partner and their client are trying to solve before showing the product, explain where Phrase fits and be clear about trade-offs

  • Turn Phrase's technical detail into a clear value case that a senior marketer would buy and an agency would pitch

  • Run demos and hands-on co-innovation sessions with partners using Phrase integrations across CMSs and DXPs, CRM and marketing platforms, creative tools and developer tools

  • Show how Phrase works inside AI assistants and agentic workflows through the Phrase MCP Server and Phrase Atlas, and help partners build on Phrase through our APIs

  • Work with Product to co-design differentiated integrations with partners, and bring what you hear from agencies and platforms into the roadmap so those integrations are adopted, stay in use and drive revenue

  • Run workshops that take a partner team from no knowledge of Phrase to confident in a single session, at partner offices, our events and theirs

  • Build working relationships with production, technology and practice leads inside partner organisations

  • Work alongside Solutions Engineering, Forward Deployed Engineering and Product, and bring them in early for deep technical or build work

  • Share what you learn from partners with Product and Partnerships so that our integrations and partner programme keep improving

  • Present the whole Phrase Language Intelligence Platform: projects, vendors and workflows in Phrase TMS with Phrase Orchestrator automating the steps in between; brand terms and tone of voice across markets; developer access through our APIs, Phrase Strings and the Phrase MCP Server; and transcription, subtitling and dubbing in Phrase Studio

What you need:

  • At least three years in solutions consulting, solutions engineering or similar pre-sales in martech (CMS, DXP, marketing automation or content platform), or leading technology conversations at an agency

  • Deep experience in at least one CMS, DXP, content or marketing platform, and the ability to map a client's stack and explain the choices to agency and marketing teams

  • High emotional intelligence and conversational skill, so that one-to-one and group meetings feel fluid with you in them, and the habit of asking great questions and reading the room as the conversation moves

  • The ability to walk into an agency meeting with little or no customer context and still make it a great conversation, as ambiguity and last-minute briefings are normal in this work

  • The ability to lead a room: whiteboard a session, ask good questions about the business problem, and frame technical detail as outcomes a senior marketer cares about

  • Confidence running live demos and adapting them to the people in the room

  • An understanding of how agencies and holding companies staff, sell and deliver work for their clients, and how generative AI is changing that work

  • Working knowledge of APIs and webhooks, the ability to sketch a workable integration and explain the trade-offs to non-technical people, and an understanding of where AI agents and MCP fit

  • Clear, friendly written and spoken English

  • Willingness to travel up to 25% of the time for partner meetings and events, sometimes across time zones

  • Experience in localisation, transcreation or language technology (desirable). We are just as open to people from martech, or from agency and martech, who pick up new technology quickly and want to learn the language side with us

  • Experience at a headless CMS or content platform, in an agency technology role, or at or closely with a holding company's production arm, a systems integrator or a language service provider (desirable)

  • Hands-on experience with an MCP client or with building on LLM APIs (desirable)

  • A second language, or experience speaking at events or running training sessions (desirable)

Our current tech stack in this role:

  • Phrase TMS

  • Phrase Orchestrator

  • Phrase Strings

  • Phrase Studio

  • Phrase MCP Server

  • Phrase Atlas

  • Phrase APIs and webhooks

  • Phrase integrations with CMSs and DXPs, CRM and marketing platforms, creative tools and developer tools

What you'll get:

  • Work experience in a successful and growing global SaaS company

  • Be part of an international team in Europe, APAC, and the Americas

  • Expert colleagues in their field who are determined to build the best localization platform on the market, creating a world where language never limits opportunity

  • An agile work environment, where it is encouraged to take smart risks

  • Take part in a culture full of trust, support and loyalty, where respectful and open feedback is valued, and diversity is fully embraced

  • A positive, open-minded, and innovative atmosphere

  • Support in your professional development and personal career goals

What's on top:

  • 4 Company holidays additional to your regular holidays (1 day per quarter where the entire company is off to celebrate our achievements).

  • In addition, the company also provides employees with a Christmas break to allow you to spend time with family and friends without use of your vacation allocation.

  • Your birthday is off because it is important to celebrate you as well.

42b1c8cfdb004761.description:
Digital Marketing Executive – Premier League (12-Month FTC)

Location: London
Contract: 12-Month Fixed-Term Contract
Working Arrangement: Hybrid – 2–3 days per week onsite at the Premier League offices, with attendance at the Beyond Sports office every two weeks.


The Role

We are looking for a Digital Marketing Executive to join our team at Beyond Sports, playing a key role in supporting one of our major clients, the Premier League. This is an exciting opportunity to deliver marketing activity across digital platforms used by millions of sports fans globally. Working across email, push notifications, in-app messaging and native promotional activity, you will create targeted communications that increase fan engagement, support retention and deliver value for Premier League clubs, broadcasters and partners.

The role combines campaign delivery, audience targeting, copywriting and performance analysis, working closely with stakeholders across both Beyond Sports and the Premier League.

You will report to the Head of Marketing at Beyond Sports and the Direct Marketing Manager at the Premier League.


Key Responsibilities

Journey Orchestration

  • Deliver personalised fan engagement through automated marketing, multi-step customer journeys and real-time activations.

  • Support the development and execution of targeted communications across the fan lifecycle.

Messaging & Content

  • Write, edit and proofread engaging copy for outbound marketing channels, including email, push notifications and in-app messaging.

  • Ensure communications are accurate, consistent and aligned with brand guidelines.

Campaign Ideation

  • Develop and present creative ideas and strategies for direct-to-fan marketing communications.

  • Identify opportunities to improve engagement through innovative digital marketing approaches.

Email Design & Production

  • Collaborate with technical and graphic design specialists to deliver engaging, visually impactful communications.

  • Support the development and execution of email marketing campaigns.

Campaign Execution

  • Support the Direct Marketing Manager in producing and delivering digital marketing communications using Adobe platforms.

Campaign Management

  • Process expenses and handle day-to-day admin for the leaders you support.

Run meetings and events

  • Coordinate internal & external stakeholder meetings, and visits from customers and partners.

  • Organise team offsites & workshops, managing logistics, budgets, and vendors from planning through delivery.

Keep things running

  • Be the first point of contact for leadership enquiries, handling them with care and discretion.

  • Work with People, Ops and the office team on onboarding new leaders, office logistics and suppliers.

  • Cover for the Executive Assistant to the CEO when required.

  • Improve how we work: templates, processes and tools that save everyone time.

Qualifications:

  • Help coordinate and run core HR cycles: performance reviews, compensation planning, and engagement surveys, for the London office.

  • Draft, review and interpret employment contracts, variations and restrictive covenants.

  • Own the review and update of people policies and the employee handbook, keeping them compliant and easy to use.

  • Track legislative changes, including the Employment Rights Act reforms, and lead their implementation.

  • Maintain accurate employee records and HR systems, and help build out People processes and documentation as the team grows.

 

Compliance

 

  • Help ensure compliance with employment law and best practice across the UK, Europe and the US, in consultation with the HRBP and external counsel as needed.

  • Compliance and risk. Make sure People processes meet UK employment law, data protection requirements, our ISO requirements and Radiant's own policies. Ensure the team keeps policies and manager guidance up to date as legislation changes.

Immigration and visas

  • Manage Skilled Worker and other visa applications from assessment to approval, partnering with our external immigration lawyers.

  • Advise on global mobility as we expand into Europe.

Workforce planning

  • Partner with leaders to build headcount plans aligned to business priorities and budget.

  • Advise on organisation design, team structures and spans of control as teams scale.

  • Use people data from HiBob and Ashby to inform hiring, retention and capacity decisions.

Performance

  • Help design and run the performance reviews and calibration process.

  • Support managers to set clear goals, give regular feedback and manage underperformance through fair, well-documented processes.

  • Link performance outcomes to development, promotion and reward decisions.

What you'll bring

  • 5+ years in a People Partner, HR Business Partner or senior generalist role, ideally in a scaling tech or high-growth business.

  • Deep, current knowledge of UK employment law and confidence applying it to real situations.

  • CIPD Level 5 or 7, or an employment law qualification.

  • Confident and knowledgeable enough to manage employee relations issues independently, with sound judgement on when to escalate.

  • A proactive, solutions-oriented approach and a track record of taking initiative.

  • Exposure to multi-jurisdiction employment matters is an advantage.

  • Strong technical capability and data literacy, and comfort using data and technology to inform decisions and drive efficiency

dcb481b63c35a375.title: Datacentre Operations Engineer
dcb481b63c35a375.description:
About Us

Radiant is powered intelligence, delivering scalable, high-performance compute infrastructure purpose-built for AI and HPC workloads. Operating across global data centres, we run mission-critical environments where uptime, throughput, and ultra-low latency are non-negotiable.

Role Overview

We are seeking a deeply technical, hardware-passionate Datacentre Operations Engineer to execute on-the-ground operations for our new East London deployment—Radiant's newest AI infrastructure site. This role focuses on delivering precise, repeatable physical practices—including advanced smart-hands support, complex cabling, and hands-on operation of high-density, air-cooled compute systems—to guarantee world-class SLAs on next-generation hardware architecture.

Working closely with Infrastructure (HPC) SRE, Network Engineering, and Datacentre Strategy teams, you will uphold uncompromising standards across East London's data centre floor, spanning multiple data halls. You will live and breathe the hardware, maintaining elite facility reliability through hands-on deployment, proactive maintenance, rapid incident response, and structured break/fix execution across high-density air cooling systems, busbar-based power distribution, and next-generation GPU compute platforms. The role centres on technical execution and optimised output.

You will turn global engineering standards into flawless, repeatable daily routines, continually honing on-the-ground practices to keep our most advanced hardware running at peak performance. East London's hardware platform is NVIDIA B300-class, fully air-cooled compute, delivered through a new OEM partner being onboarded to Radiant's fleet; while the interfaces and overall architecture closely align with other OEM platforms you may already know, you'll be one of the first teams operating it on the ground, so a fast learning curve and strong first-principles troubleshooting matter more than prior exposure to this specific vendor.

You will be part of the founding team standing up 24x7x365 on-site coverage at East London to meet tight customer SLAs, and as Radiant expands its EMEA footprint, your relentless drive for hardware perfection and proven field expertise with high-density environments will serve as the operational blueprint to scale execution models efficiently across the region.

What’s in it for you?

Join a team operating some of the world’s most advanced high-performance computing infrastructure. As a Datacentre Operations Engineer, you’ll work hands-on with cutting-edge GPU and CPU platforms — including the latest NVIDIA architectures — powering dense, large-scale compute environments used for AI, machine learning, and next-generation workloads.

This is an opportunity to build expertise at the forefront of modern infrastructure, where reliability, scale, and performance matter every day. You’ll collaborate with experienced engineers across a globally distributed organisation that values openness, inclusion, technical excellence, and continuous learning.

We move quickly, solve meaningful challenges, and give people the space to make an impact. If you thrive in fast-paced environments, enjoy working with advanced technology, and want to help shape the future of high-performance compute, you’ll find both challenge and opportunity here.

You can also expect:

  • Exposure to industry-leading GPU and AI infrastructure

  • Opportunities to grow alongside a rapidly scaling global business

  • A collaborative, inclusive, and supportive engineering culture

  • Real ownership and the ability to influence operational excellence

  • Work that sits at the intersection of people, performance, and technology

  • A modern, flexible, globally connected workplace with ambitious goals

Key Responsibilities

Hardware Operations & Break/Fix

  • Quickly diagnose and resolve hardware and network issues to maximise uptime; execute structured fault isolation methodologies to drive rapid resolution

  • Respond to critical hardware alerts via our monitoring and observability platform; contribute to ongoing service improvement to improve monitoring capability and alert quality

  • Deploy and maintain HPC and AI hardware for uninterrupted operations, including hardware troubleshooting, firmware updates, and component replacement

  • Execute break/fix procedures for advanced hardware platforms, including GPU module exchange, component-level fault isolation, and firmware-level diagnostics

  • Execute or support break/fix operations on ultra-high-density compute systems including NVIDIA B300-class chassis or equivalent platforms, including GPU/fan module exchange, chassis-level fault isolation, and busbar connection/disconnection—under the direction of the Lead where qualification is in progress

Air Cooling Operations

  • Operate, monitor, and maintain high-density air cooling infrastructure in conjunction with our datacentre partner, including CRAC/CRAH units, in-row and containment cooling, and associated airflow management systems

  • Facilitate in conjunction with our datacentre partner, routine and corrective maintenance on air cooling systems: monitoring supply/return temperatures and airflow rates, maintaining hot-aisle/cold-aisle containment and blanking, and performing scheduled filter and component inspections

  • Follow and contribute to SOPs for safe working around high-density, air-cooled compute platforms

  • Monitor thermal performance and raise anomalies before they escalate into incidents

Capacity Management

  • Contribute to site-level capacity management operations, maintaining accurate records of power, space, and cooling utilisation

  • Support capacity planning activities by providing accurate as-built data and flagging infrastructure changes to the Lead and relevant teams

  • Manage on-the-ground assets from point of purchase and delivery through lifecycle management and disposal, owning asset management within Radiant's CMDB system

Infrastructure & Facilities

  • Handle RMAs and support requests within Radiant's Service Level Objectives (SLOs) to meet customer contract SLAs

  • Contribute to ongoing maintenance, fostering compliance and leveraging strong vendor partnerships

  • Operate cooling, power distribution (including busbar and PDU infrastructure), and other critical data centre technologies to maintain high operational standards

  • Develop and maintain datacentre/hardware management SOPs, ensuring continual alignment with Radiant's governance and compliance requirements

Service & Operational Excellence

  • Apply ITSM frameworks: Incident, Major Incident, Change Management, and service improvement

  • Operate and support services 24x7x365 for production environments as part of a structured on-site shift rotation—working 12-hour shifts across a 4-team pattern with two engineers on shift at all times—to meet tight customer SLAs

  • Prioritise and triage incident and smart-hands workload ensuring tight SLA coverage is maintained with a small on the ground team

  • Contribute to Incident postmortem analyses, root cause analysis, document learnings, and automate remediations

  • Communicate technical decisions clearly to stakeholders and customers

  • Champion a culture of: do, document, automate

  • Willing to cross train and upskill in Infrastructure/Platform SRE practices

  • Willing to travel across EMEA to support future datacentre onboarding and train in new technologies

Essential Skills & Experience

  • Degree in Computer Science/Electrical Engineering, or 5+ years of directly relevant industry experience in data centre operations

  • 3+ years of experience in data centre operations, HPC, or related roles

  • Passion for hardware and upholding the highest operational standards on the ground

  • Strong communication skills in English

  • Proven hands-on experience with HPC/NVIDIA GPU platforms or equivalent high-density compute systems, high-performance storage, and networking

  • Practical knowledge of high-density air cooling systems—CRAC/CRAH operation, airflow and thermal monitoring, containment management, and associated maintenance—or strong related cooling infrastructure experience

  • Experience with, or demonstrable willingness and aptitude to train on, ultra-high-density compute platforms such as NVIDIA B300, busbar-based power distribution, or equivalent systems

  • Experience with and passion for management of compute at massive scale

  • Comfort operating a newly-onboarded OEM hardware platform, applying transferable knowledge from other high-density GPU/HPC OEM systems to ramp up quickly without direct prior exposure to this specific vendor

  • Familiarity with structured break/fix practices for complex hardware platforms, including module-level component exchange and firmware fault isolation

  • Expertise in hardware installation, network configuration, and low-level system maintenance, including firmware management

  • Knowledge of data centre environment technologies, including cooling and high-density power distribution

  • Understanding of capacity management principles: power, space, and cooling tracking

  • Strong understanding of hardware and spares management; ability to handle RMAs within defined SLOs

  • Understanding of HPC and AI workloads at a high level

  • Strong problem-solving abilities and resilience in a fast-paced environment

  • Strong grasp of ITSM and service operation best practices

  • Excellent communication skills and ability to collaborate with cross-functional, internationally dispersed teams

6055031cc0afe29d.title: Senior Onboarding consultant
6055031cc0afe29d.description:
Our Purpose

Scheduling isn’t simply filling shifts. It’s finding the sweet spot that enables businesses to grow and team members to enjoy the perfect work/life balance.

At Planday from Xero, we aim to use Agentic AI to build a future where managers seamlessly can free up invaluable time for their business and teams. We’re not just building software; we’re on a mission to make shift work more human, to change work/life balance from a luxury to a reality for all shift workers. We’re using advanced technology to help humans reach their full potential. At work and in life.

Founded in 2004, Planday is headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark and helps create perfect schedules for hundreds of thousands of users across the world. Planday was acquired by Xero in 2021.

How you’ll make an impact

As a Senior Onboarding Consultant, you will drive the success of Planday by leading new customers through a comprehensive onboarding and implementation journey tailored to their business size, operational complexity, and technical requirements.

You will own more complex and strategic onboarding engagements, bringing a high degree of autonomy, strong implementation discipline, and a consultative mindset to every customer interaction. You will combine deep product expertise with strong technical aptitude to help customers design scalable ways of working, manage change effectively, and realise value quickly.

You will play a key role in helping customers successfully implement Planday within their business, especially where workflows, stakeholder groups, system configuration, and integration requirements are more advanced. Your ability to lead technically credible conversations, guide customers through implementation decisions, and proactively manage risks will be critical to achieving strong adoption, smooth go-lives, and long-term customer success.

What you’ll do

  • Project manage end-to-end onboarding and multi-site implementation for upper mid-market and enterprise customer portfolios, with full ownership of strategic, technically complex, and high-value customer engagements.

  • Act as the primary implementation lead for customers with more advanced operational or technical requirements, including complex workflows, multi-site setups, and tailored rollout plans

  • Run high-quality discovery to understand customer goals, business processes, operational challenges, and implementation risks, and translate these into a clear onboarding plan

  • Guide customers through solution design and configuration decisions, ensuring Planday is implemented in a way that aligns with their business needs and supports long-term success

  • Lead implementation conversations with a broad range of stakeholders, including operational, commercial, technical, and executive contacts

  • Deliver a high-quality onboarding experience through a consultative, structured, and customer-centric approach

  • Proactively identify delivery risks, technical blockers, and adoption challenges, and drive them through to resolution

  • Support customers through change management and go-live planning to ensure successful launches and strong early adoption

  • Partner cross-functionally with Sales, Support, Product, and other internal teams to deliver a seamless customer experience and smooth handover across the customer lifecycle

  • Maintain strong implementation governance, accurate CRM records, and disciplined use of internal processes, systems, and onboarding best practices

  • Use data, customer insight, and frontline experience to identify opportunities to improve onboarding playbooks, implementation processes, and customer outcomes

  • Act as a senior member of the team by sharing knowledge, raising the bar on execution, and contributing to continuous improvement across onboarding.

What you’ll bring with you

  • Proven experience in onboarding, implementation, customer success, or a similar customer-facing SaaS role, with experience owning more complex customer engagements

  • Strong SaaS implementation experience, with the ability to lead customers through structured rollout and change processes from kickoff to go-live

  • Strong technical aptitude and confidence discussing system configuration, implementation requirements, workflow design, and integration-related considerations with customers

  • Experience managing multiple stakeholders across operational, technical, and leadership audiences

  • Ability to run excellent discovery, uncover customer needs, and translate them into practical implementation plans and business outcomes

  • Strong communication skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to simplify complex topics and build credibility with a wide range of stakeholders

  • Excellent project, time management, and prioritisation skills across multiple concurrent customer journeys

  • A proactive, self-directed approach with strong ownership, sound judgment, and comfort operating with autonomy and accountability

  • Empathy, patience, and a solutions-focused mindset, paired with the confidence to challenge constructively when needed

  • Confidence using CRM systems and customer engagement tools, with strong process discipline and attention to detail

  • High professionalism, integrity, and a collaborative, low-ego approach

  • Experience in workforce-intensive industries such as hospitality, retail, healthcare, or shift-based environments is preferred

  • Experience working on technically involved implementations, including integrations, data considerations, or more complex business process design, is highly desirable

Success looks like

  • Customers successfully go live on time with strong adoption and clear alignment to their business goals

  • Complex onboarding and implementation projects are managed effectively, with risks identified early and handled proactively

  • Customers feel confident in their solution design, implementation approach, and path to value

  • Strong stakeholder relationships are built across customer teams, including more senior and technical contacts

  • High customer satisfaction, strong implementation quality, and minimal escalations

  • Consistent achievement of onboarding goals and KPIs, with strong ownership of outcomes

  • Positive contribution to team culture, capability uplift, and continuous improvement across the onboarding function

This position description is intended merely as a guideline of the responsibilities involved in the position. The employee is expected to perform any other duties as reasonably required by their Manager.

At Planday, we offer you

  • Benefits like pension, health insurance, inclusive support for new parents and generous vacation

  • On top of your annual base salary, you are offered to be part of an Employee Share Plan

  • Growth and progression opportunities – we want you to grow with us

  • Flexible remote work

  • Strong social culture with lots of team and company activities

  • Meaningful work – everyone at Planday contributes to improving the lives of shift workers around the globe

  • Healthy work-life balance and autonomous approach to work. We trust in you and your abilities

Finally, our offices are not just workplaces (although they are pretty nice and well-located, we have to say!). Plandayers are open and welcoming and at Planday, everyone has the freedom and support to show their true self at work.

At Planday, we firmly believe that diversity and inclusion are the cornerstones of innovation and a vibrant workplace culture, and we highly value the strength that diverse backgrounds offer.

As an equal opportunity employer, we strive to create an equitable experience for all our candidates throughout the process. Please let us know if you need reasonable accommodation during the application or interview process.

All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to any personal characteristics.

2f0563c8f6e42d17.title: AI Product Engineer
2f0563c8f6e42d17.description:
The Role

We're looking for an AI Engineer to build the agentic core of our product. You'll work closely with our CTO and own LLM-based features and agentic workflows end to end, from the agent framework through to the tooling that connects it to a customer's ERP. You’ll ship the cutting edge models and paradigms to Fortune 500 procurement teams.

Procurement is a demanding domain for agents: long-running workflows over messy data, where a wrong answer costs a customer real money. You'll decide how multi-agent collaboration works here, and how we benchmark it for performance, safety and behaviour.

We're building next-generation agentic systems that can manage entire procurement workflows, with a mission to make global manufacturing supply chains more resilient to an ever-changing world. That's a $3tn market opportunity.

We're backed by world-class investors including Sequoia Capital, and you'll be joining a team bringing together experience from OpenAI, Meta, Revolut, NASA and McKinsey.

What You’ll Do

  • Own development and deployment of LLM-based features and agentic workflows end-to-end

  • Develop new agentic frameworks to handle multi-agent collaboration.

  • Benchmark LLMs across performance, safety and behavioural monitoring.

  • Operationalise AI features by building tools to connect them to customer systems

  • Collaborate with customers and internal teams to understand customer problems and design optimal solutions

You Might Be a Great Fit if You

  • Have engineering experience at tech and product-driven companies, so you know what great code looks like

  • Have experience shipping LLM-based solutions to production

  • Have a deep understanding of the core technology behind language models, as well as computer science fundamentals

  • Have built features end-to-end in Python

  • Enjoy communicating with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Compensation and Benefits

At Magentic, we recognise and reward the talent that drives our success. We offer:

  • Competitive Equity: play a real part in Magentic’s upside

  • A salary of £90,000 - £110,000 per annum

  • Enhanced parental leave

  • 25 days holiday exc bank holidays, plus an extra day for our Christmas shutdown

  • In-office lunches provided

  • Salary sacrifice pension and nursery schemes

  • Hybrid London HQ (3 days per week, with flex if you have appointments etc)

  • Annual team retreat—a fully-funded off-site to recharge, bond, and build

Our Interview Process

We can move quickly through these stages, so let us know if you have any timelines we need to meet.

  1. Initial call (30 mins): this first step is an opportunity for you to hear more about Magentic and the role, and for us to learn more about how your experience aligns with the role.

  2. Skills interview (45 mins): in this step, we'll ask you to prepare a presentation and take Q&A.

  3. In-person interview (half-day, paid): for the final step, we invite you to come meet the team in-person. We find this is the best way for candidates to get a sense of what working at Magentic is like. This day will include a culture interview, founder interview and a presentation task / discussion with the team.

Equal Opportunities and Accommodations Statement

At Magentic, our mission is to build AI that helps solve some of the world's most complex real world problems. We believe building a diverse workforce will be the key to solving this for our customers.

 

Magentic is committed to creating a truly inclusive team and we’re proud to be an equal-opportunity employer. As we grow, we're intentional about building teams with a broad range of backgrounds, experiences and viewpoints, recognising that this leads to better ideas, stronger collaboration and better outcomes for our customers therefore we strongly encourage applications from all backgrounds and cultures to apply.

 

We recognise that some groups remain underrepresented within the industry and are committed to creating an environment that celebrates and supports everyone.

 

Everyone works differently, and we want to ensure our interview process gives you the best chance to show us what you can do. If you require any reasonable adjustments or accommodations, please let us know and we'll work with you to make the process accessible.

 

Responsible AI Statement
At Magentic, we are committed to developing artificial intelligence that benefits humanity. We push the limits of AI's capabilities and are dedicated to its responsible and safe deployment. Recognising the profound impact of AI, we ensure that its development is centred around human needs and safety, incorporating a wide array of perspectives to fulfil our mission.

7021624ce398f820.title: Account Executive
7021624ce398f820.description:
We’re looking for a Account Executive to join Magentic and help build how we engage with enterprise customers from the ground up.

At Magentic, we’re building AI agents that can automate complex procurement and supply chain workflows for some of the world’s largest companies. We’re operating at the cutting edge of agentic AI and human computer interaction, building systems that can manage work that historically required entire teams.

Our mission is to make global supply chains more resilient in an increasingly unpredictable world. It’s a huge market opportunity and one that is still massively underserved from a technology perspective.

We’re backed by Sequoia Capital and building a small, high calibre team with experience from OpenAI, Meta, Revolut, NASA and McKinsey.

This is an opportunity to play a key role in shaping how we take Magentic to market. You’ll work closely with the founders to help define our sales motion, build relationships with enterprise customers, and turn early traction into a scalable commercial engine.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys ambitious environments, likes building from scratch, and wants a high level of ownership and impact.

What You’ll Do

  • Own the full sales cycle from outbound prospecting through to close

  • Build relationships with enterprise customers across procurement, operations and supply chain functions

  • Partner closely with founders on go to market strategy, messaging and customer feedback

  • Help define and improve our sales processes, tooling and playbooks as we scale

  • Lead complex discovery conversations with senior stakeholders and enterprise buyers

  • Work cross functionally with product and engineering to relay customer insights and shape roadmap priorities

  • Manage pilots, commercial negotiations and procurement processes with enterprise organisations

  • Represent Magentic externally across customer meetings, events and industry conversations

What We’re Looking For

  • Experience in an Account Executive or Senior Account Executive role within a B2B SaaS company

  • Experience selling into enterprise customers and navigating complex buying processes

  • Comfortable operating in an early stage or high growth environment where things move quickly and priorities evolve

  • Strong commercial instincts with the ability to build trust and credibility with senior stakeholders

  • Confident running discovery and understanding operational problems in depth

  • Able to work independently and thrive with a high level of ownership

  • Excellent communication skills and naturally consultative in approach

  • London based and excited to work closely with the team in person

Nice to Have

  • Experience selling AI, workflow automation, procurement, supply chain or operational software

  • Previous experience within an early stage startup environment

  • Exposure to technical products or working closely with product and engineering teams

What We Offer

At Magentic, we recognise and reward the talent that drives our success. We offer:

  • Competitive Equity: play a real part in Magentic’s upside

  • A salary of £100,000 - £130,000 per annum

  • OTE - £200,000 - £260,000 per annum

  • Hybrid London HQ (3 days in the office).

  • Company provided meals at the office

  • Monthly “Social budget” to spend getting to know your colleagues (coffee, food, activities, etc.)

  • Salary sacrifice pension and nursery schemes

  • Annual team retreat—a fully-funded off-site to recharge, bond, and build.

  • 4 weeks work from anywhere per year.

Our Interview Process

We can move quickly through these stages, so let us know if you have any timelines we need to meet.

  1. Initial call (30 minutes)
    An opportunity for you to learn more about Magentic and the role, and for us to understand how your experience aligns with what we're looking for.

  2. Culture interview (30 minutes)
    You'll meet with our Chief of Staff to learn more about our culture and values, while we get to know you beyond your experience.

  3. Skills interview (60 minutes)
    You'll meet with our CEO and our Account Executives to take a deeper dive into your experience, sales approach, and how you think about enterprise opportunities.

  4. Meet one of our investors (30 minutes)
    A chance to meet one of our investors, hear more about Magentic's journey, and ask any questions you may have.

  5. Final stage: In-person interview
    We'll invite you to spend time with the team at our office and deliver a presentation. We find this is the best way for candidates to get a real feel for what it's like to work at Magentic. The day will include:

    A presentation

    A meet-the-team session

    An interview with our Technical Success team

    A final conversation with our CEO

Equal Opportunities and Accommodations Statement

At Magentic, our mission is to build AI that helps solve some of the world's most complex real world problems. We believe building a diverse workforce will be the key to solving this for our customers.

 

Magentic is committed to creating a truly inclusive team and we’re proud to be an equal-opportunity employer. As we grow, we're intentional about building teams with a broad range of backgrounds, experiences and viewpoints, recognising that this leads to better ideas, stronger collaboration and better outcomes for our customers therefore we strongly encourage applications from all backgrounds and cultures to apply.

 

We recognise that some groups remain underrepresented within the industry and are committed to creating an environment that celebrates and supports everyone.

 

Everyone works differently, and we want to ensure our interview process gives you the best chance to show us what you can do. If you require any reasonable adjustments or accommodations, please let us know and we'll work with you to make the process accessible.

 

Responsible AI Statement
At Magentic, we are committed to developing artificial intelligence that benefits humanity. We push the limits of AI's capabilities and are dedicated to its responsible and safe deployment. Recognising the profound impact of AI, we ensure that its development is centred around human needs and safety, incorporating a wide array of perspectives to fulfil our mission.

df9930b0339f1e90.title: D365 Senior Systems Specialist
df9930b0339f1e90.description:
Please note that this vacancy is being managed directly by our internal Talent Acquisition team. We are not seeking recruitment agency support for this role and will not accept unsolicited CVs or candidate submissions from recruitment agencies.

About the Role

We are currently looking for an experienced D365 Senior Systems Specialist to join an international organisation and take ownership of a complex Microsoft Dynamics ERP landscape.

This is a senior technical role offering the opportunity to oversee and shape a multi-country ERP environment, working across Microsoft Dynamics AX, Dynamics 365 Business Central, Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations and legacy NAV platforms.

The successful candidate will play a key role in ensuring the stability, scalability, integration and continuous evolution of the organisation's ERP architecture.

Key Responsibilities

  • Take technical ownership of a multi-country, multi-entity Microsoft Dynamics ERP landscape covering AX, Business Central, Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations and NAV.

  • Define and maintain ERP architecture, technical standards and platform strategies, including modernisation and migration roadmaps.

  • Manage complex ERP architectures involving Microsoft base applications, localisations, third-party ISVs, custom extensions and integrations.

  • Review technical designs and code, ensuring compatibility, maintainability and upgrade readiness across different ERP layers.

  • Design and govern integrations using REST/OData APIs, data entities, web services and Azure integration services.

  • Lead ERP upgrades, platform updates, ISV releases, migrations and deployment activities.

  • Establish and manage release strategies, CI/CD pipelines and automated testing processes using Azure DevOps.

  • Monitor ERP performance, troubleshoot complex technical issues and lead root cause analysis.

  • Ensure appropriate security, access management, data protection and compliance standards across ERP environments.

  • Coordinate external vendors, Microsoft partners and ISV providers, ensuring technical quality and delivery standards.

  • Provide technical leadership, guidance and mentoring to internal ERP specialists.

Required Experience & Skills

  • Extensive experience supporting, designing or managing complex, multi-country and multi-entity ERP environments.

  • Strong Microsoft Dynamics background across Dynamics AX, Dynamics 365 Business Central and Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations, with deep expertise in at least one platform.

  • Experience managing complex ERP architectures involving multiple ISVs, localisations, custom developments and integrations.

  • Good understanding of AL/C-AL and X++ technologies, with the ability to review technical solutions and collaborate with developers.

  • Proven experience with ERP upgrades, migrations, platform updates and release management.

  • Strong knowledge of REST/OData, APIs, web services, OAuth and Azure integration technologies, including Logic Apps, Azure Functions and API Management.

  • Experience with Azure DevOps, CI/CD, automated testing and deployment processes.

  • Good SQL Server and database troubleshooting skills.

  • Understanding of multi-country ERP requirements, including legal entities, taxation, statutory requirements and data residency.

  • Experience managing third-party vendors, ISVs and external technical partners.

  • Strong knowledge of ERP security, identity management, permissions and compliance requirements.

  • Excellent analytical, problem-solving and stakeholder management skills.

Nice to Have

  • Experience within Engineering, Construction, Energy, Industrial Services or other project-driven industries.

  • Knowledge of industry-specific ISV solutions within Microsoft Dynamics environments.

  • Experience with Power Platform, including Power Apps, Power Automate and Dataverse.

  • Familiarity with Azure Data Factory, Microsoft Fabric, Databricks and modern data platforms.

  • ITIL or Agile delivery experience.

  • Relevant Microsoft Dynamics 365, Azure or Power Platform certifications.
