7e1143d50d51c89b.title: AWS AI Solution Architect
7e1143d50d51c89b.description:
AWS AI Solutions Architect

Location: London

Travel: Travel across Europe (Germany, Denmark, Netherlands, France, Spain, Switzerland)

Full time- Permanent

Role Overview

As an AWS AI Solutions Architect, you will be a key member of Europe Account and Go-To-Market teams, responsible for shaping, selling, and demonstrating modern cloud and AI-led solutions for strategic customers. This is a highly customer-facing role spanning solution architecture, RFP ownership, PoC creation, and executive-level demonstrations, with a strong emphasis on AWS AI services and modern application architectures.

This a delivery and pre-sales mix role with strong hands-on expertise.

Core skillset is Full Stack architect with React + Java Spring Boot + AWS + GENAI (AWS Bedrock, Strands SDK and Agent core).

Key Responsibilities

Customer Engagement & Pre-Sales

- Act as a trusted technical advisor, leading deep architectural discussions across cloud, data, and AI.

- Partner with sales and account teams to articulate the value of AWS and AI offerings.

- Build strong relationships with senior customer architects, engineering leaders, and CIO/CTO stakeholders.

Solution Architecture & AI Innovation

- Design end-to-end AWS solutions covering AI/ML/GenAI, cloud-native applications, data platforms, and modernization.

- Lead PoC and demo creation including GenAI, Copilot-style, and agentic AI demonstrations.

- Define scalable, secure, high-performance architectures aligned with AWS best practices.

RFPs, Proposals & GTM Assets

- Own and lead RFP responses for AWS, AI, and cloud transformation initiatives.

- Create proactive propositions and solution POVs for strategic accounts.

- Conduct customer workshops and design sessions to co-create high-impact solutions.

Alliance & Ecosystem Collaboration

- Work closely with AWS Alliance Managers and partner teams.

- Align solutions with AWS reference architectures, funding programs, and industry best practices.

- Collaborate with internal practices to accelerate customer outcomes.

Required Skills & Experience

- 8+ years of experience in cloud architecture and solution design.

- Strong hands-on expertise in AWS (compute, storage, networking, security, serverless, containers).

- Proven experience with AWS AI/ML services such as Agent Core, Amazon Bedrock, SageMaker, Comprehend, Textract, and GenAI patterns (RAG, copilots, agents).

- Strong development experience in Java and/or Python, with frontend exposure to React or modern JavaScript frameworks.

- Experience in application modernization, cloud migration, DevSecOps, and Infrastructure as Code.

- 5+ years of customer-facing experience in consulting or pre-sales roles.

- Strong presentation, communication, and executive storytelling skills.

Nice to Have

- AWS Certifications (Solutions Architect – Professional preferred).

- Experience in Manufacturing, Automotive, BFS, or Utilites.

- Multi-cloud exposure (Azure/GCP).

- Additional European language skills.

ee18ad9af1fd471d.title: Data & People analytics Intern - January 2027
ee18ad9af1fd471d.description:
About Mirakl:

Founded in 2012, Mirakl has been at the forefront of marketplace innovation, empowering every business to compete in the platform economy.

Today, Mirakl's operating system combines an enterprise marketplace solution (Mirakl Platform) that enables retailers and B2B organizations to launch, scale, and operate marketplaces and dropship, AI-powered multichannel selling (Mirakl Connect), retail media (Mirakl Ads) and an agentic commerce infrastructure (Mirakl Nexus).

With dual headquarters in Boston and Paris, Mirakl helps a global ecosystem of 450+ marketplaces (B2C and B2B) and a network of over 100k third-party marketplace sellers. Brands like Macy's, Decathlon, Carrefour, Asos, and Airbus Helicopters use Mirakl to grow their businesses in new and remarkable ways.

For more information, visit www.mirakl.com.

Mirakl in Numbers:

  • 🗓️ Founded in 2012 | Member of French Tech Next40
  • 👥 750+ employees in 9 offices worldwide: Paris, Barcelona, Bordeaux, Boston, London, Munich, New York, Sydney, Tokyo

Our Values:

Working at Mirakl means accelerating your career alongside ambitious, passionate, and supportive colleagues. We're proud of the diversity of backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences that make our teams unique.

Our 5 values guide how we collaborate:

  • 💡 Work Hard Together: Teamwork and collaboration are the foundation of our success
  • 🏆 Get Things Done:  We prioritize action and efficiency for impactful results
  • 🚀 Go Above & Beyond:  We tackle challenges proactively and always aim for excellence
  • 🎓 Succeed Through Expertise: Knowledge sharing and continuous learning are core to our culture
  • 🤝 Satisfy & Empower Clients: We're committed to our clients' success

 

1. The Team You'll Join

You'll be part of our People team at Mirakl, a global team of around 30 people covering the full employee lifecycle across all of our offices worldwide. Together, you'll be contributing to building an exceptional employee experience and shaping the future of how Mirakl grows, learns, and develops its talent.
 

2. Your Impact

  • Coordinate learning events — Organise Manager Days, hackathons, bootcamps, lunch & learns and show-and-tell sessions, owning logistics, invitations, materials and post-event follow-up from start to finish.
  • Track participation and feedback — Manage attendance, collect feedback and synthesise key learnings and improvement opportunities to continuously raise the bar on our learning programmes.
  • Curate learning content — Audit and structure existing AI, enablement and learning resources into clear, audience-specific learning paths that make it easy for every Miraklian to grow.
  • Create practical resources — Develop guides, FAQs, checklists and quick-reference materials that support learning adoption and make knowledge accessible across the organisation.
  • Support AI fluency initiatives — Gather and document AI use cases, design surveys and knowledge checks, and organise assessment data to help the People team make informed decisions.
 

3. What You'll Bring to the Role

Experience:
  • Currently pursuing a Bachelor's or Master's level degree in HR, from a business school or university
  • Experience in HR or learning is a plus, but not a prerequisite. Hybrid profiles combining analytical skills and project management are welcome.
  • Comfortable organising events and facilitating sessions, in connection with the projects mentioned.
  • Availability for a 6-month internship starting in January 2027 is required.
Skills:
  • Rigorous and autonomous, with strong tracking and reporting capabilities
  • Genuine interest in AI
  • Appetite for project management, data analysis and cross-functional collaboration
  • Strong communication skills in French and English
 

4. Tools Used

  • Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, PowerPoint)
  • Collaborative tools (e.g. Notion, Google Workspace, or equivalent)
 

5. Languages

  • French: Fluent (C2 level required)
  • English: Professional proficiency (B2 minimum, C1 preferred)
 

6. Compensation, Perks & Benefits

  1. Pay Range: €1,200 – €1,400 per month, based on your level of study.

  2. Perks & Benefits:

    • A workplace that supports well-being and balance: breakfasts, fitness and yoga classes, after-work events, game nights
    • Mentoring from senior technical experts and regular feedback to support your growth
    • Immersion in a collaborative, international team passionate about sharing knowledge
    • 2 remote work days per month
    • Access to Works Council discounts (tickets, etc.)
    • Gymlib pass for your well-being
    • Modern offices in the heart of Paris (near the Eiffel Tower)
    • Swile meal vouchers
    • Transportation covered (50% Navigo, bike, etc.)
 

7. Our Hiring Process

We warmly encourage you to apply to any of our roles, even if you think you're not an exact match.
Please click the "Apply" button to submit your application — this helps us make the best possible assessment and get back to you as quickly as possible.
  1. Manual screening of your CV by a recruiter, followed by an AI-powered screening conversation (10 min) with Emma, Mirakl's AI Talent Ambassador, to explore your background and motivation for the role. You will need to complete this step within 3 days, otherwise we won't be able to move forward with your application.
  2. Interview with our recruiter to discuss your profile and expectations
  3. Interview with your future manager
  4. Structured interview using the STAR method to ensure transparency and fairness
  5. Welcome to Mirakl! 🎉

We welcome collaborators with their diverse perspectives and experiences to power us forward. These often far exceed conventional job requirements and help us create a culture of continuous learning. If you're ready to join a global leader powering digital transformation for 450+ of the world's most innovative retailers and B2B organizations.

As part of our recruitment process, Mirakl processes your personal data to review and manage your application and, where appropriate, to consider your profile for future opportunities. You can exercise your data protection rights at any time, and as further detailed in our policies. For more information about how we process your personal data and your rights, please consult our Recruitment Privacy Notice, here in English and here in French.

3af8eb70db8a7c11.title: Chargé.e d'études - Référent.e informatique
3af8eb70db8a7c11.description:
Descriptif du poste

Rattaché.e au responsable développement informatique, le.a Référent.e Technique Informatique :


  • Prend en charge et suit la réalisation d’un ou plusieurs projets R&D logiciel depuis sa conception jusqu’à son achèvement, en respectant les normes en vigueur, les processus internes de conception, de développement et de lancement d’un produit
  • Coordonne le travail d’une équipe de développement de logiciels.


Dans le détail, les missions :


  • Participer au chiffrage de nouveaux projets avec l’équipe commerciale,
  • Planifier, coordonner et suivre des projets de développement de logiciels pilotant un dispositif,
  • Définir le contour, les exigences et les spécifications techniques du projet en relation avec les partenaires concernés (client directement et/ou chef de projet interne du produit),
  • Organiser le travail d’une équipe technique logiciel dans le respect des plannings et du budget, selon les spécifications requises par le client,
  • Être l’interface privilégiée des clients sur le ou les projets pris en charge pour les sujets logiciels,
  • Contribuer à la structuration documentaire des projets (cahiers des charges, architecture, spécifications, rapports, etc.),
  • Assurer la coordination avec le reste de l’équipe R&D et le client,
  • Participer à la réalisation des développements (architecture, codage en appoint des développeurs)
  • Spécifier, concevoir et réaliser les tests,
  • Participer à la gestion des fournisseurs et sous-traitants impliqués dans les projets
  • Veiller au respect des réglementations en vigueur (IEC 62304) avec le support de l’équipe qualité/réglementaire.


♂♀ Et toi dans tout ça ?

Tu es ingénieur.e de formation ou équivalent, et tu disposes d’une expérience réussie (environ 10 ans) dans la gestion de projets techniques, idéalement dans un environnement réglementé ou dans le secteur des dispositifs médicaux.

Tu possèdes une bonne compréhension des systèmes pluridisciplinaires (robotique, mécatronique, automatisme) et tu maîtrises les méthodologies de développement logiciel ainsi que les approches Agile. Tu es également à l’aise avec les outils DevOps et tu maîtrises le développement en C# ou en C++.

Tu sais piloter un projet de bout en bout (planning, budget, jalons, reporting), coordonner des équipes aux expertises variées et arbitrer les sujets complexes avec pragmatisme. Une connaissance des normes applicables aux dispositifs médicaux (IEC 62304, IEC 62366, ISO 13485, ISO 14971) est un véritable plus.

Au-delà de tes compétences techniques, nous recherchons avant tout une personnalité. Curieux.se et passionné.e par la technologie, tu aimes innover et relever des défis.

Tu fais preuve de rigueur, d’organisation et d’autonomie, tout en appréciant le travail collectif. Ton sens de l’écoute, tes qualités de communication et ton orientation client te permettent de créer des relations de confiance et de faire avancer les projets dans un esprit de collaboration.

Enfin, tu es à l’aise en anglais, aussi bien à l’écrit qu’à l’oral.

458666dc81336fcf.title: People Ops (HR & Recruitment) - Intern
458666dc81336fcf.description:
ScorePlay is the AI-powered media infrastructure for sports, built to automate the content operations behind the world’s biggest sports organizations. We work with 350+ leagues, competitions, teams and broadcasters – including NBA and NFL teams, Premier League, LaLiga and Ligue 1 clubs, leading bodies like UEFA and FIBA, the Tour de France, and the Australian Open – helping them turn every moment on and off the field into high-value, structured content. Our platform brings all their media into one place and makes it effortless to find, produce and share in seconds.

Founded in 2021, we’re a 65-person team based between New York, Paris, and 10+ other countries, growing 2x year over year with 97% retention. We’ve raised $20M+ from top investors including Alexis Ohanian and Harry Stebbing’s 20VC and elite athletes like Kevin Durant, Raphaël Varane, Mario Götze, Nico Rosberg and Giannis Antetokounmpo.

If you thrive in fast-paced environments and you want to help shape how the next generation of fans experience sports, you’re in the right place. We’re on track to become the global leader in sports media, and this is definitely the best time to join our adventure.

💡 Overview

As our People Ops Intern, you'll work at the heart of the People team, supporting both People Operations and Talent Acquisition. You'll own real projects end to end, be trusted to bring your own ideas, and see how a fast-scaling international startup actually runs behind the scenes, across HR admin, office life, employer brand, tech events and AI automation.

🧠 What you'll work on:

People Operations & HR admin

  • Support the day-to-day of an international team across France, the US, remote Europe, as well as parts of Asia and Australia: employment contracts, policies, employee benefits, onboarding and offboarding logistics.

  • Become our go-to expert on Deel (our global HR platform): research country-specific rules, maintain workflows and chase down answers.

  • Help handle individual employee cases that require research - dig into policies, employment contracts or local labour law and summarise what you find into something actionable.

Office, community & culture

  • Take ownership of our Paris office: visitors, room bookings, day-to-day logistics.

  • Manage tech equipment and assets: ordering laptops, tracking inventory, and keeping our internal records aligned with our compliance requirements.

  • Plan initiatives that make the office a place people enjoy: events, community moments, small things that build culture.

AI & automation

  • Audit our recurring admin processes, identify what can be automated, and build the automations yourself with Claude.

  • Elevate the role over time: the goal is that the manual work you do in month one no longer exists by month six.

  • Experiment freely. We'd rather you try ten things and ship five than wait for instructions.

Talent Acquisition & employer brand

  • Help organize tech events in Paris

  • Push the referral policy

  • Support employer brand content and research alongside our Talent acquisition lead.

  • Help with sourcing research when we open new roles or new markets: mapping companies, building talent pools, filtering candidates.

🧩 What we're looking for:

  • 6 months availability, starting January to March 2027

  • Based in Paris, fully comfortable working in English.

  • Thorough and reliable - you follow up, you don't let things slip, and the details matter to you.

  • Autonomous and adaptable. You'll juggle very different topics in the same day and figure things out without a manual.

  • Curious about AI, or already experimenting with it. No technical background needed, but genuine appetite to learn is a must.

  • You bring ideas. We're a small team and good suggestions get implemented fast, whoever they come from.

We know many people hesitate to apply if they don’t meet every single requirement on a job description. If you’re interested in ScorePlay but not sure you tick all the boxes, we’d still love to hear from you, this could be the start of a great long-term collaboration.

Compensation: €1.5K per month

  • • €1.5K per month

Our Mission

Prose is truly custom hair and skin care made-to-order—just for you. Our line of custom products are made by an in-house, Paris-based R&D team of gifted chemists who combine natural ingredients in innovative ways alongside dermatologists, giving consumers clean skin care, hair care and impeccable results.

At the heart of Prose’s success is Singular, its proprietary AI-powered beauty-tech platform, which has revolutionized personalized beauty at scale. Marrying a technology-driven approach with an apothecary-style concept, all Prose hair and skin care products are personalized to your one-of-a-kind hair, skin, goals and environment.

We’re a company that wants to change beauty practices, so we’re changing the way beauty companies practice. As a certified B Corporation, a Public Benefit Corporation and Climate Neutral, we’re proving that good business is always sustainable. With Prose, there’s nothing sacrificed to bring you great products—not trees, materials, wages, or performance.

Prose & Singular in Numbers

  • Founded in 2017, with hubs in Paris, New York, and Los Angeles

  • 10M+ consultations completed

  • 2M customers and 350K active subscribers

  • 21M custom products made, with 1M+ unique formulas

  • 350+ team members across disciplines

  • $600M+ in lifetime sales, with $165M+ revenue in 2024

  • Profitable since 2024

Discover our Company Culture on Welcome to the Jungle here

Discover our Company Mission & Vision in video here

Prose, c’est une start up de beauty tech “born in Paris, made in New York” qui révolutionne l’industrie cosmétique. Chez Prose, nous créons des produits de beauté sur-mesure, totalement personnalisés : nos clients remplissent une consultation en ligne, puis nos algorithmes se basent sur ces données pour créer une formule unique à chacun, que nous fabriquons puis livrons depuis notre usine à Brooklyn : https://prose.com/ 

Nous recherchons un(e) Assistant(e) Chef de Produit pour rejoindre notre équipe Innovation & Brand Marketing et nous aider à développer notre portefeuille de produits. Vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec les Chefs de Produit et contribuerez au suivi de l'ensemble du processus de développement produit, ainsi qu'à la stratégie d'activation 360° en collaboration avec d'autres départements (R&D, Data Science, Social, Growth, Ops, etc.) pour assurer la forte croissance de la marque.

 

Missions :

  • Réalisation d’études ad hoc et actualisation de l’étude de la concurrence et du marché (veille concurrentielle, positionnements prix, tendances, claims…) pour nourrir les concepts et contribuer aux lancements

  • Aide à la préparation des lancements produits (formule, packaging…) en collaboration avec les différentes équipes internes et externes (laboratoire R&D à Paris, usine aux US...) pour assurer le succès des lancements et l'alignement avec la stratégie marketing

  • Organisation et pilotage des tests consommateurs des innovations futures

  • Contribution à la réalisation de campagnes marketing 360° et de supports de communication

 

Profil recherché :

  • Actuellement en formation supérieure Bac +5 (Ecole de Commerce, Université…), vous avez une première expérience en Marketing, idéalement dans l’univers cosmétique

  • Vous avez un esprit créatif et une sensibilité à l’univers des cosmétiques et du digital 

  • Vous disposez d’un sens de la rigueur, de l’organisation et de l’esprit d’équipe

  • Français et Anglais (écrit et oral) courants requis

  • Convention de stage obligatoire


Dates : Stage de 6 mois à commencer en Janvier 2027

Lieu : Paris 2ème 

Conditions et avantages :

  • Stage rémunéré (1200€/mois)

  • 50% Pass Navigo ou Forfait mobilités durables

  • Tickets resto (carte Swile)

 

Prose Values

Intentional Inclusivity

  • We know the best ideas come from open minds and willingness to listen. While our products cater to the individual, an invitation into our process is always open to our community.

  • We value our differences and diverse backgrounds by communicating openly, managing with transparency and striving to understand one another’s perspective. It’s a key ingredient to our innovation.

Connected Collaboration

  • Our strength as a group will outlast our efforts as individual contributors. With offices across countries, staying inventive and agile deepens our clear vision and consistent communication.

  • We stay in a spirit of entrepreneurial collaboration: We do not have consensus at all times, but we trust one another to work toward our common goals. Our success is an expression and result of our progressive and gratifying teamwork.

Driven, Together

  • We value ownership and coaching that encourages employees to think constructively and creatively about the business. We view employees as leaders and individuals who are accountable, resourceful and responsible. Anyone and everyone is encouraged to lead.

  • We recognize that in order to continue thinking one step ahead, we will need to try new things. We strive to provide an open environment that accepts this truth, making space for new ideas to emerge.

Humanity Always

  • We assume good intentions in every interaction, keeping ourselves accountable for the climate we create. We seek to understand our co-workers through this lens of conscious benevolence, authenticity and fellowship.

  • We operate with the intention of preserving resources, creating an environment we can all live in – for our business and the world. Sustainable care is essential to our ethos as an organization. We take a mindful approach to how we think about our people (employees) and our planet.

ccc341b55aeb9608.title: Product Marketing Manager
ccc341b55aeb9608.description:
About Nabla

Nabla delivers a unified clinical AI platform used by healthcare organizations across specialties and care settings. The platform includes:

Ambient AI documentation that captures clinical conversations and generates structured notes.

AI-powered dictation and clinical workflow tools embedded directly within EHR systems.

Agentic AI capabilities that support multi-step clinical and administrative tasks.

Enterprise-grade infrastructure built for secure deployment across health systems.

About the Role

The Product Marketing Manager will own how Nabla positions, launches, and drives adoption of the product with clinicians across their entire journey — from onboarding and activation through engagement and retention.

This is product marketing where the message ships directly to the user. You own the narrative for every new feature launch, then own the in-app and email programs that turn that narrative into activation.

You'll define the segmentation, write the positioning, ship the campaigns, and measure whether they actually moved adoption.

Userpilot is in place, but everything around it still needs to be built: the activation and adoption strategy, in-app and email templates, segmentation, cohort analysis, the process with Product Marketing peers, CSM, PM, and Design, and the campaign calendar.

This is a hands-on, highly operational PMM role. We need someone who lives in the tools, is data-driven, can test fast, structure the process, and turn usage insights into concrete positioning and messaging decisions.

Userpilot is the first step. Over time, this person will take ownership of the full communication stack across email, in-app, and other channels. The role works extremely closely with Product Marketing peers, Design, PM, Data, and Product Ops.

Nabla serves two distinct audiences, and lifecycle programs must work for both:

  • Self-serve clinicians, who discover, activate, and adopt the product largely on their own. Here, automated email and in-app communication carries most of the relationship — your messaging is the go-to-market motion.

  • Mid-market and enterprise health systems, managed by CSMs. Here the human relationship leads, and your programs must arm and reinforce the CSM — giving them timing, context, and content, never working around them.

You'll design each lifecycle so the right channel leads for each segment. On top of this, healthtech is a highly regulated industry with demanding clients: every communication must meet a high bar for accuracy, security, and professionalism, while still feeling personal and useful to busy clinicians.

Responsibilities

Feature Launch Positioning & Activation

  • Own weekly in-app launch communication for new features, end to end and at a fast cadence

  • Define the positioning and messaging for each release — what it is, why a clinician should care, what changes in their day

  • Design the in-app experience (placement, format, flow) for each launch

  • Validate messaging with Product Marketing peers, PM, and Design before shipping

  • Launch on time and coordinate across the relevant teams

  • Track performance (reach, engagement, adoption) for every launch and iterate quickly on results

  • Stay highly reactive to the product roadmap, turning new releases into clear, well-timed clinician communication

Lifecycle Strategy and Execution

  • Own the full lifecycle strategy across onboarding, activation, engagement, and retention, ensuring each stage of the practitioner journey is intentional, personalized, and measurable

  • Tailor segmentation, messaging, and cadence to the distinct needs of each segment:

    • For self-serve, build automated email and in-app programs that drive activation, adoption, and retention with minimal human touch

    • For mid-market and enterprise, build programs that complement and support CSMs

  • Direct and execute creative strategy for lifecycle channels — briefing, reviewing, and optimizing copy and design for brand consistency and message effectiveness

  • Build and maintain a clear campaign calendar across functions

Experimentation and Analytics

  • Lead a rigorous experimentation roadmap: A/B and multivariate testing of messaging, creative, cadence, segmentation, and value propositions

  • Define and own lifecycle KPIs, building reporting frameworks and sharing regular performance insights with marketing and cross-functional leadership

  • Partner with Data and Analytics on audience segmentation, behavioral signals, and AI-driven insights to enhance personalization at scale

  • Turn cohort and usage insights into concrete messaging and product-marketing actions

Cross-functional Collaboration

  • Collaborate with Product Marketing peers, Design, PM, Data, Product Ops, Clinical, and Brand to align lifecycle programs with broader business goals and the practitioner experience

  • Establish a clear, repeatable process across Product Marketing, CSM, PM, and Design for planning and shipping campaigns

  • Ensure all programs are developed and executed in compliance with HIPAA and applicable federal and state laws, partnering with Legal and Compliance as needed

Operations and Tooling

  • Take ownership of the full communication stack, starting with Userpilot

  • Evaluate and manage lifecycle marketing technology partnerships, recommending optimizations as we scale

  • Build and maintain process documentation, campaign playbooks, and training materials on internal platforms

  • Leverage AI tools as a core part of daily work (drafting, research, iteration) to improve efficiency, quality, and decision-making

What We Are Looking For

  • 3-5 years in B2B product marketing, lifecycle marketing, or product-led growth marketing, including hands-on ownership of in-app channels

  • Proven ability to craft positioning and messaging for product launches and to ship it yourself, not hand it off

  • Deep expertise across the full post-signup funnel (onboarding, activation, engagement, retention)

  • Strong Product DNA, with sharp attention to user workflows and the details that shape the product experience

  • Strong strategic and analytical thinking, with the ability to translate complex data into clear hypotheses, actionable insights, and business recommendations

  • Strong cross-functional collaboration skills; ability to manage stakeholder expectations, influence without authority, and build alignment across diverse teams

  • Track record of building and scaling programs that drove measurable growth in adoption, engagement, and retention

  • Comfortable in a highly regulated, high-stakes industry (healthtech) with demanding clients, where accuracy, security, and compliance are non-negotiable

Nice to have:

  • Hands-on experience with Userpilot and HubSpot

  • Familiarity with Looker, Tableau, Mixpanel, Amplitude, or similar

  • Experience in a regulated industry: healthcare, behavioral health, or health-adjacent

  • Experience with AI-powered personalization, segmentation tools, or ML-informed campaign optimization

  • Experience marketing to a professional or clinical end user

Life at Nabla

When you join Nabla, you join a team that is driven by excellence, curiousity, and kindness. Together, we’re committed to making clinicians’ lives easier and improving healthcare experiences for everyone. We believe clinicians should be able to focus on what they were trained to do, caring for their patients, and that no patient should feel their visit was rushed.

We work hard and make time to have fun, too. Our #nablabla channel is just as active as #feature-show-off. We support well-being with workday activities at least three times a week; choose from yoga, running, Pilates, or HIIT. We also host regular off-sites, meet up across New York, Paris, San Francisco, and other cities, and keep the chocolate and nuts well stocked.

If this sounds like an environment where you’ll thrive, we look forward to reading your application.

Our Values at Nabla

Joining Nabla means being part of a team that shares a commitment to excellence, humility, growth, and inclusion.

Every day is a new chance to excel

We aim for nothing less than the best and are willing to put in the effort and dedication required to exceed standards. We learn from yesterday’s failures and do better every day.

Stay humble

There’s no place for ego in our team. Our collective success is more important than individual achievements. We see humility as wisdom — keeping focus on the bigger picture.

Feedback is a gift

We embrace feedback and foster a culture of trust and respect that helps everyone grow. We communicate openly about both achievements and challenges, and we actively involve each other in finding solutions.

Committed to diversity

About Pelico

Traditional industrial manufacturing systems were built for predictability. Supply chains no longer are. Today, real-time data is buried in legacy tools that weren't designed for constant disruption. By the time an issue surfaces, it has already snowballed, sending everyone into firefighting mode. Pelico exists to close the gap between production plans and the daily reality on the factory floor.

We've built the manufacturing orchestration platform trusted by the world's most complex industrial operations : companies like Airbus, Boeing, Safran, Eaton, and Cartier. Our AI connects fragmented supply chain, production, and quality data into a single live operational picture — then puts AI agents to work anticipating disruptions, simulating recovery options, and keeping every team aligned before small problems become expensive ones.

Founded in 2019 and backed by General Catalyst, 83North, and Serena, we've raised $72M and are growing fast — 300% year-over-year revenue growth, deployed in 15+ countries, and supporting factories worldwide. We're headquartered in Paris, with offices in Miami, London and Amsterdam, and we're just getting started.

This is a rare chance to join a company that's redefining an industry that hasn't been disrupted in decades — from the inside.

About the Role

In your capacity as a Senior DevOps / Site Reliability Engineer, you will be instrumental in architecting the orchestration layer that drives Pelico across all fronts, spanning our global SaaS infrastructure to the most restricted, air-gapped enterprise environments.

Your core mission is ensuring Pelico remains effortless to install, manage, and expand, irrespective of the underlying host. Operating at the crossroads of system architecture, product engineering, and field operations, you will tackle intricate technical hurdles and help define the future of AI-driven industrial infrastructure.

 

What You’ll Do

Build

  • Design and evolve Pelico's deployment architecture across Azure, GCP, AWS, single VM, air-gapped and private cloud environments, using Terraform, Helm and Ansible.

  • Standardize installation, upgrades and tooling to enable true one-click deployment for enterprise customers.

  • Standardize CI/CD pipelines and infrastructure practices to improve engineering productivity, security and reliability company-wide.

  • Support Pelico's enterprise and federal growth, including GovCloud and FedRAMP readiness for regulated aerospace and defense customers.

  • Use agentic engineering and AI-assisted workflows to automate infrastructure operations, deployment and diagnostics.

Run

  • Own production infrastructure (primarily Azure) and internal systems (GCP, OVH — GCP being our main internal tooling environment).

  • Troubleshoot production incidents: load spikes, data-sync issues, network problems, cloud provider outages, security issues and end-of-life components.

  • Build monitoring, diagnostics and runbooks so customer IT teams can operate Pelico independently.

  • Participate in on-call, pushing automation further — target is ~80% automated / 20% manual.

  • Occasional customer-facing support as IT teams deploy and operate Pelico.

 

About You

  • 5+ years of experience in DevOps, Site Reliability Engineering, or Infrastructure Engineering roles in high-growth or production environments.

  • Solid depth in at least one major cloud provider (Azure, AWS or GCP), with the ability to pick up and work across others — our environment spans multiple clouds.

  • Comfortable with containers (Docker) as the core deployment abstraction.

  • Deep understanding of CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code, observability and modern deployment practices.

  • Solid software engineering background, ideally with Java, and an automation-first mindset.

  • Comfortable participating in an on-call rotation, troubleshooting production incidents, and continuously improving platform reliability.

  • Comfortable operating in ambiguity — you enjoy solving complex infrastructure challenges without waiting for perfect specifications.

  • Strong communication skills, able to collaborate across Engineering, Product and customer IT teams.

  • You actively embrace AI tools as part of how you work, and adopt new ways of working smarter and faster.

  • Hands-on experience with AI-assisted workflows for coding, infrastructure automation, troubleshooting or engineering productivity.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with Kubernetes and Helm specifically.

  • Experience supporting enterprise or industrial environments (manufacturing, aerospace, defense or supply chain).

  • Exposure to security, compliance or regulated infrastructure environments (e.g. GovCloud, FedRAMP or air-gapped deployments).

  • Experience in customer-facing or forward-deployed engineering roles.

 

What we offer

  • Work on a highly impactful product that users love!

  • Office locations: In the heart of Paris (75011) and Miami, USA.

  • Stock Options: Available for every employee.

  • Hybrid flexibility: 3 days a week at the Paris office

  • Premium Health Coverage: Up to 70% covered by Pelico (Alan Healthcare).

  • Meal Allowance: €10/day worked, covered at 50% (via Swile card).

  • Transportation Support: 50% public transportation coverage or an equivalent sustainable mobility package.

  • Wellness Benefit: Access to discounted subscription plans for fitness, wellness, and beauty experiences through our partnership with ClassPass.

  • Collaborative Environment: We foster a vibrant, growth-focused workplace where professional development and team connections thrive.

 

Your interview experience

  1. Intro call with Talent Acquisition call (30 min)

  2. Hiring Manager Interview (1h)

  3. Technical Test onsite: 1h30

  4. Leadership conversation + founders (CEO/CTO)

  5. Offer + References, run in parallel

Pelico is an equal opportunity employer. We're committed to building a diverse team and an inclusive environment where everyone can do their best work.

3612b93d03cb719a.description:
About Pelico

Traditional industrial manufacturing systems were built for predictability. Supply chains no longer are. Today, real-time data is buried in legacy tools that weren't designed for constant disruption. By the time an issue surfaces, it has already snowballed, sending everyone into firefighting mode. Pelico exists to close the gap between production plans and the daily reality on the factory floor.

We've built the manufacturing orchestration platform trusted by the world's most complex industrial operations : companies like Airbus, Boeing, Safran, Eaton, and Cartier. Our AI connects fragmented supply chain, production, and quality data into a single live operational picture — then puts AI agents to work anticipating disruptions, simulating recovery options, and keeping every team aligned before small problems become expensive ones.

Founded in 2019 and backed by General Catalyst, 83North, and Serena, we've raised $72M and are growing fast — 300% year-over-year revenue growth, deployed in 15+ countries, and supporting factories worldwide. We're headquartered in Paris, with offices in Miami, London and Amsterdam, and we're just getting started.

This is a rare chance to join a company that's redefining an industry that hasn't been disrupted in decades — from the inside.

About the Platform squads

Pelico is a configuration-driven, AI-native platform: a field engineer stands up a running factory application by authoring YAML — schema, algorithms, widgets, actions, agents — instead of writing code. The Platform squads build the reusable blocks that make that possible, and we run them as a product: our customers are other engineers — the Solution squads, our Regional Solution Engineering pods, and customer AI teams building on top of us.

You'll lead one squad — the configurability framework, the compute layer, the widget surface, the agent-development substrate (MCP/LSP/harness/BYOM), the integration layer, or the end-user Copilot — owning a capability cluster the whole company builds on.

Your mission

You'll own a platform capability end to end — and ship it yourself:

  1. Build the substrate. Author the framework, SPI, runtime, or AI tooling other squads depend on, and review the rest at architectural depth.

  2. Run it as a product. Own the roadmap, the contracts your consumers rely on, the adoption metric, and the deprecation policy that keeps the surface clean.

  3. Set the bar. Author specs, run the spec-driven workflow, and stand up the eval and review gates that make agent-authored code trustworthy.

  4. Harvest the field. Turn recurring customer patterns into platform capabilities, so learning compounds instead of fragmenting into bespoke forks.

  5. Lead by example. Write the load-bearing code, pair with your engineers, raise their craft, and grow the squad as the leverage you ship earns it.

Your impact

Every Solution squad and every customer deployment is only as strong as the platform underneath it. Own a capability cluster well and you create leverage the entire company compounds on — the difference between a platform that scales and a pile of one-off forks.

What we're looking for

This is a lead-by-example role for a senior engineer who builds platforms other engineers love. You're excited by deep, high-blast-radius problems, you measure yourself by what others build on your work, and you lead by being among the best engineers in the room.

You'll need:

  • A track record of shipping production platform / framework / infrastructure that other engineers build on (SPIs, libraries, runtimes, dev tooling, or AI substrate)

  • Deep, current hands-on coding — we build in Kotlin / Java 25 (TypeScript/React for the experience squads); strong here, or a fast learner

  • Real API / SPI / abstraction-design judgment, with a feel for performance and correctness at scale (up to hundreds of millions of records)

  • A platform-as-product mindset — you optimize for adoption and others' leverage, and you're comfortable deprecating

  • A track record of leading senior engineers by example, not by leaving the keyboard

Nice to have:

  • Running a team as an internal platform (adoption metrics, internal NPS, deprecation, roadmap)

  • Squad-relevant depth — codegen/annotation processors, Kubernetes/IaC/observability, React/design systems, MCP/LSP/agent harnesses, ERP/connectors, or end-user agent UX

  • AI-native ways of working (agentic workflows, eval harnesses, spec-driven development)

  • Aerospace / defense / discrete-manufacturing context

  • French is a plus, not a requirement

If you bring the essentials and a strong mix of the rest, we want to hear from you — we're hiring the person who'll make this real, not a checklist.

What we offer

  • A real ownership mandate over a capability cluster, with equity in a category-defining scale-up

  • Deep, high-leverage problems with real customers and real scale

  • An AI-native engineering culture and a small, elite squad — be challenged, learn, and have fun

  • Hybrid working from our Paris HQ, an international team of 36+ nationalities

Your interview experience

  1. Intro call with Talent Acquisition (30 min)

  2. Hiring manager conversation with the VP Engineering (45 min)

  3. Case Study onsite 1h30 / 2h

  4. Leadership conversation + founders (CEO/CTO)

  5. Offer + References, run in parallel

Pelico is an equal opportunity employer. We're committed to building a diverse team and an inclusive environment where everyone can do their best work.

Traditional industrial manufacturing systems were built for predictability. Supply chains no longer are. Today, real-time data is buried in legacy tools that weren't designed for constant disruption. By the time an issue surfaces, it has already snowballed, sending everyone into firefighting mode. Pelico exists to close the gap between production plans and the daily reality on the factory floor.

Founded in 2019 and backed by General Catalyst, 83North, and Serena, we've raised $72M and are growing fast — 300% year-over-year revenue growth, deployed in 15+ countries, and supporting factories worldwide. We're headquartered in Paris, with offices in Miami, London and Amsterdam, and we're just getting started.

This is a rare chance to join a company that's redefining an industry that hasn't been disrupted in decades — from the inside.

About the Role

Pelico's customers feel one pain above all: missing parts that block delivery. The Solution squads are where we turn Pelico's platform into a product that fixes it. Each squad owns one solution surface — Material Coverage & inventory, Quality, Supplier & customer Collaboration / AI Buyer, MRO & Aftermarket, Program Management, or Strategic Account Support — composing our platform's building blocks into workflows that work across many customers. You'll lead one surface end to end: ship it fast, keep it configuration-first, and feed real customer patterns back into the platform — while our Regional Solution Engineering pods carry the day-to-day customer relationship.

What You'll Do

You'll own a solution surface — and build it yourself:

  • Ship the surface. Compose configuration, compute, widgets, connectors, and agents into customer-facing workflows that pass a real acid test on real customers.

  • Stay configuration-first. Solve in Phoenix YAML wherever you can, reach for code only when it's worth it, and never let the surface fragment into per-customer forks.

  • Set the bar. Author specs, run the spec-driven workflow, and put eval and review gates on anything AI-assisted that touches a customer.

  • Harvest the field. Spot the patterns that recur across accounts and turn them into platform capabilities, so the next customer is faster.

  • Lead by example. Write the code, pair with your squad and the engineers deploying at customer sites, raise the bar, and grow the team as the impact you ship earns it.

Your impact: Customers buy outcomes — shortages caught, deliveries recovered, quality exceptions resolved. Your squad is where the platform becomes those outcomes. Own a surface well and you make Pelico's revenue engine both faster and more defensible — and you keep it from collapsing into bespoke work that can't scale.

About You

This is a lead-by-example role for a senior full-stack engineer with real product and customer judgment. You're energized by shipping outcomes under real constraints, you decide what not to build, and you lead by being in the code with your team.

You'll need:

  • A track record of shipping customer-facing product software end to end, full-stack, under real delivery pressure

  • Strong, current hands-on coding — we build in Kotlin / Java 25 (backend) and TypeScript / React (frontend); strong in one and credible across, or a fast learner

  • Product and customer judgment — scope to outcomes, cut to MVP under deadline, decide what not to build

  • A configuration-first, anti-bespoke instinct — you build for many customers, not one fork at a time

  • A track record of leading engineers by example, not by leaving the keyboard

  • You actively embrace AI tools as part of how you work — curious about what's possible and quick to adopt new ways of working smarter and faster.

  • Hands-on experience with AI-assisted workflows — whether for writing, research, analysis, coding, or productivity — and a genuine interest in staying at the frontier of what these tools can do.

Nice to have:

  • Aerospace / defense / supply-chain / discrete-manufacturing context (MRP, BoM, coverage, MRO/TAT, program management, procurement)

  • Forward-deployed / solutions-engineering / customer-embedded experience, feeding learnings back into a platform

  • Configuration- or low-code-driven product experience (YAML/DSL, composable UI, workflow authoring)

  • AI-native ways of working (agentic workflows, eval on AI output, spec-driven development)

  • French is a plus, not a requirement

If you bring the essentials and a strong mix of the rest, we want to hear from you — we're hiring the person who'll make this real, not a checklist.

Why Pelico

We're building something genuinely hard and genuinely important. Here's what that comes with:

  • Meaningful equity — you're building this with us, so you'll own a piece of it

  • Competitive salary benchmarked to your market

  • Flexible, hybrid work model — we care about output, not face time

  • Health, dental, and vision coverage

  • Learning & development budget — we invest in people who invest in themselves

  • Opportunity to work with some of the world's most complex and fascinating manufacturing operations

  • A team that takes the work seriously without taking themselves too seriously

  • Work at the frontier of applied AI, with exposure to cutting-edge AI tooling and operational challenges inside a high-growth startup

Your interview experience

  1. Intro call with Talent Acquisition (30 min)

  2. Hiring manager conversation with the VP Engineering (45 min)

  3. Case Study Onsite 1h30 / 2h

  4. Leadership conversation + founders (CEO/CTO)

  5. References, run in parallel

We move fast and we're transparent at every step.

Pelico is an equal opportunity employer. We're committed to building a diverse team and an inclusive environment where everyone can do their best work.

About Pelico

About the Role

Pelico is hiring a Senior Product Manager — Core Platform to own one or more of the shared components that every Pelico product is built on.

Pelico is moving from features built per use case to a platform of configurable components: the data model and the engines that compute on it, the configuration layer, UI building blocks, workflows and actions, and the platform services around them. Solution teams, forward deployed engineers and AI agents combine these components to deliver a use case for a customer. The quality of that base decides how fast Pelico delivers, how well it scales and whether customers trust what they see.

You will own part of that base and run it as a product. Its users are internal teams and agents as much as planners and buyers at customer sites. The exact scope depends on your profile and the team's needs. The role is technical: you need to discuss data structures, APIs, performance and configuration models as easily as user workflows.

What You'll Do

  • Own one or more platform components end to end. Depending on the team's needs, this can be the data model and how customer data maps into it, the computation engines, the configuration layer, configurable UI building blocks (tables, detail views, dashboards), the action library and write-back to customer systems, or platform services such as access control and notifications.

  • Treat internal teams as your customers. Understand what solution PMs, forward deployed engineers and the agent team need, and turn repeated requests into reusable components instead of one-off builds.

  • Make components configurable, not custom. Decide what is configured, at which level (common, solution, customer), and where custom code is still acceptable. Cut the time it takes to deliver a new use case.

  • Design for agents as well as people. Give components clear interfaces so workflows and AI agents can call them as tools, with audit, limits and approvals.

  • Hold the bar on scale, reliability and trust. Enterprise data volumes, near real-time updates, on-prem and sovereign deployments, security reviews. Performance, correctness and explainability are product requirements.

  • Stay close to customers. Spend time with users and deployment teams at strategic accounts to see where the platform helps them and where it gets in the way.

  • Keep the platform coherent. Work with the other platform PMs and with design on shared vocabulary, data contracts and dependencies, so components fit together.

  • Run the roadmap. Write specs, set priorities with the tech lead, ship on the release train, and measure how other teams adopt your components and what it changes for customers.

About You

  • Product management: 5+ years as a PM in B2B software, including time owning a platform, infrastructure or developer-facing product used by other teams.

  • Technical fluency: comfortable with data models, APIs, configuration systems and performance trade-offs. You can read a technical design, challenge it and write acceptance criteria engineers can test.

  • Platform judgment: you know when to generalize and when not to, and you can turn down a one-off request while keeping the requester on your side.

  • Data rigor: you can query data, trace an odd output back to its source and size the impact of a change across customers.

  • Enterprise B2B experience: you know what large customers require on security, deployment and change management.

  • Domain curiosity: interest in manufacturing, supply chain or industrial operations, and the will to learn how a plant runs.

  • Cross-functional leadership: you lead engineers, designers and other PMs through decisions without formal authority.

  • Clear writing: specs, decision memos and release notes that engineers, customers and executives understand.

  • Education: a degree in engineering, computer science or a related field.

  • Experience with AI agents, LLM tool use or human-in-the-loop workflows

Nice to have

  • Experience on a platform whose components other teams combine: low-code or configuration platforms, data platforms, workflow engines, developer tools

  • Experience in supply chain, manufacturing, ERP or planning software

  • Background in data modeling, ontologies or large-scale data processing

  • Experience with on-prem or sovereign deployments at enterprise customers

  • Aerospace, defense or industrial customers

Why Pelico

We're building something genuinely hard and genuinely important. Here's what that comes with:

  • Meaningful equity — you're building this with us, so you'll own a piece of it

  • Competitive salary benchmarked to your market

  • Flexible, hybrid work model — we care about output, not face time

  • Alan health coverage — up to 70% covered by Pelico

  • Learning & development budget — we invest in people who invest in themselves

  • Opportunity to work with some of the world's most complex and fascinating manufacturing operations

  • A team that takes the work seriously without taking themselves too seriously

  • Meal allowance: €10/day worked, 50% covered via Swile

  • Transport: 50% public transit coverage or equivalent sustainable mobility package

72c5a243790216ab.title: Senior Account Executive - Hospitals
72c5a243790216ab.description:
Build something monumental for Healthcare!

At Tandem Health we’re reimagining healthcare by putting clinicians first. Our platform - designed by clinicians, for clinicians - is built on deep insight into real-world pain points, with intuitive medical notes and workflows that truly support patient care.

We’re a fast-scaling health-tech company backed by top investors and expanding globally. We move fast, stay curious, and believe building something that matters starts with an extraordinary team. If you're passionate about impact and innovation, we'd love to meet you!

About the Role

We’re looking for an Senior Account Executive to grow our footprint across France. You’ll be at the forefront of introducing Tandem’s clinician copilot to providers, partners, and health systems - shaping how we scale across France

This is a pivotal role where you’ll forge high-impact partnerships across the care ecosystem, from provider networks and EHR vendors to resellers and health insurers. You’ll act as a market expert, relationship builder, and operator all in one.

What you will do

  • Identify, initiate, and manage key relationships across the healthcare landscape in France.

  • Open doors with provider groups, EHR vendors, system integrators, payors, and commercial resellers to accelerate Tandem’s reach and adoption.

  • Pitch, negotiate, and close deals that deliver strategic value, working closely with legal, product, and commercial teams to get contracts across the line.

  • Represent Tandem externally in meetings, events, and conferences, positioning us as a trusted digital health partner.

  • Bring the voice of the market back into Tandem, sharing insights that inform product development, regulatory priorities, and local go-to-market strategy.

  • Help build the customer success and support infrastructure that ensures our partners thrive with Tandem.

What You Bring

  • Proven experience with healthcare partnerships, sales, or business development - ideally in health-tech, med-tech, with familiarity of the hospital ecosystem

  • A strong track record of closing strategic partnerships in complex, regulated environments with providers, EHRs, or pharmaceutical companies.

  • Deep knowledge of the French hospital ecosystem - from payors and providers to health IT vendors and regional nuances.

  • A strong local network and ability to build trusted relationships across stakeholder groups.

  • Comfortable navigating clinical, commercial, and technical conversations.

  • Fluent in French and English, with excellent communication skills.

  • Independent operator with the ability to collaborate closely with cross-functional teams.

  • Passion for improving healthcare delivery through thoughtful, impactful innovation.

Bonus Points

  • Experience working with or selling into EHR providers, health systems, or care delivery platforms.

  • Background in medtech, digital health, healthcare

  • Familiarity with EU/French regulatory and compliance environments.

  • Experience in startup or high-growth environments, especially launching new markets.


What we offer

  • Competitive salary, reviewed as you grow, plus stock options

  • 30 days of holiday

  • Paid parental leave

  • €1,000 annual health & wellbeing budget, plus mental-health support whenever you need it

  • A real learning budget and internal growth paths - build your career without leaving Tandem

  • Fully AI native company - let our agents do the grunt work

  • Two company off-sites a year, plus a team budget for the things that bring you closer

  • State of the art office in the heart of Paris, and your choice of IT equipment

Location

We believe the best ideas happen when we’re together. This is a full-time role based in Paris, France. You’ll travel regularly - either to meet clinicians around France or to collaborate with our team in Stockholm.


How to Apply

We adopt a continuous selection process, so please make sure to apply with your CV in English.

Our interview process consists of 4 stages:

  1. Screening interview with Talent Acquisition

  2. First interview with our Country Director in France

  3. Working Day - Join us in the Paris office for a day to experience our culture firsthand, collaborate with our team, and see how you work in action.

Culture at Tandem

At Tandem, we move fast, think big, and take ownership. We're a high-performing, diverse team with a shared drive to change the future of healthcare - and we’re just getting started.

Our culture is built on action, ambition, and learning. You'll be trusted to take the lead, challenge yourself, and make an impact from day one. We believe real growth happens when you're stretched, supported, and surrounded by smart, passionate teammates who want to win together.

Even though we’re spread across countries, we come together often in Sweden for team meetings, social events, and offsites - blending global reach with real human connection.

We hire for talent, potential, and attitude - valuing different backgrounds and fresh perspectives. Great ideas come from everywhere, and we’re building a team that reflects the world we want to change.

Tandem handles sensitive patient data and will conduct a background check before hiring any candidate.

68602f075243c91b.title: Engineering Manager - Design System (x/f/m)
68602f075243c91b.description:
Your mission

At Doctolib, we're building digital health solutions used by more than 90 million patients and 520,000 healthcare professionals across Europe. The quality, consistency, and accessibility of our interfaces are critical to that mission. That's exactly what our Design System team makes possible.

As Engineering Manager of the Design System team, you will lead the engineering efforts behind Oxygen, Doctolib's design system. Oxygen goes far beyond a component library: it is the infrastructure that ensures design quality at scale and delivers our brand identity consistently across an AI-first development environment. With over 50 designers and several hundred engineers building across multiple markets and product surfaces, your work directly shapes the experience of every user who interacts with Doctolib.

Working at the intersection of Design and Engineering, you will partner with designers, product managers, and engineers to turn our Design System vision into scalable technical solutions that power consistent, high-quality user interfaces across all Doctolib products.

What you'll do

  • Define your team's vision, strategy, and roadmap alongside your Product partner, bringing strong technical perspectives to shape and challenge priorities, and take end-to-end ownership of engineering delivery and quality.

  • Lead the technical design, development, and evolution of Oxygen, ensuring its components and foundations are accessible, robust, reusable, and scalable across our products.

  • Champion an AI-first approach, exploring and scaling AI-powered tools and workflows that help designers and engineers build high-quality user interfaces more efficiently.

  • Establish and promote UI and accessibility engineering best practices, working closely with designers, product teams, and our accessibility specialist to drive adoption across the organization.

  • Drive technical alignment across engineering teams, fostering collaboration and ensuring the Design System integrates seamlessly across our web and mobile ecosystems.

  • Coach, mentor, and develop your engineers, fostering a culture of ownership, collaboration, technical excellence, and continuous improvement.

Who you are

If you don’t meet all the requirements below but believe this opportunity matches your expectations and experience, we still encourage you to apply!

You could be our next teammate if you:

  • You have at least 8+ years of software engineering experience, combined with 2-3 + years of management experience

  • Have experience leading, coaching, and developing engineers, helping them grow while fostering a strong engineering culture.

  • Understand the value of design systems and have experience creating, maintaining, or contributing to component libraries that scale across multiple teams

  • Have a strong understanding of UI engineering principles and experience building consistent, high-quality user interfaces across web and mobile platforms, working closely with designers.

  • Adapt quickly to change, embracing uncertainty and consistently solving problems to achieve meaningful outcomes.

  • Are committed to accessibility and understand the importance of building inclusive user experiences that comply with WCAG guidelines

  • Have proven experience developing maintainable and secure products with a focus on code quality, testing, and documentation

  • Your English skills allow you to have high quality daily interactions with the team. German or French are a plus.

     

Now, it would be fantastic if you:

  • Have experience improving developer experience and driving the adoption of shared UI components and tooling across engineering teams.

  • Have worked with cross-platform design systems, understanding the challenges of maintaining consistency across web and native mobile applications.

  • Know how to implement frontend monitoring and observability to improve UI reliability and performance.

  • Have contributed to open source or maintained internal tools/libraries

 

Life at Doctolib Tech

  • Our solutions are built on a single fully cloud-native platform that supports web and mobile app interfaces, multiple languages, and is adapted to country and healthcare specialty requirements.

  • Our stack is composed of Rails, TypeScript, Java, Python, Kotlin, Swift, and React Native.

  • We leverage AI ethically across our products to empower patients and health professionals. Discover our AI vision here.

Want to learn more about our tech culture and environment? Visit the Doctolib Tech site.

What we offer

  • Free comprehensive health insurance (basic package) for you and your children

  • 25 days of paid vacation per year, plus up to 14 days of RTT

  • Free mental health and coaching services through our partner Moka.care

  • Work from abroad for up to 10 days per year thanks to our flexibility days policy

  • Lunch vouchers (Swile card) worth €8.50 per working day, with €4.50 covered by Doctolib

  • A subsidy from the work council to refund part of the membership to a sport club or a creative class

  • 50% reimbursement of your public transport subscription

  • ParentCare Program: Enjoy full salary coverage (100%) during your first month of birth leave and 75% during the second, covered by Doctolib

  • Enrollment in Doctolib's long-term employee value sharing plan called DoctoGrowth

  • For caregivers and workers with disabilities, a package including an adaptation of the remote policy, extra days off for medical reasons, and psychological support

  • Relocation support in case of international mobility

  • Access to the best AI tools for coding, development and dedicated training

The interview process

  • Recruiter Interview

  • System Design interview

  • Behavioral Interview

  • EM Case study Interview

  • Reference Check

  • Offer!

Job details

  • Permanent Position 

  • Full time 

  • Location: Levallois or Berlin or Nantes

  • Start Date: As soon as possible

  • Remote Policy: Hybrid

If you would like to find out more about tech life at Doctolib, feel free to read our latest Medium blog articles! 

At Doctolib, we believe in improving access to healthcare for everyone - regardless of where you come from, what you look like. This translates into our recruitment process: Doctolib is an equal opportunity employer. We don't just accept diversity at Doctolib, we respect and celebrate it!

The more diverse ideas are heard, the more our product will truly improve healthcare for all. You are welcome to apply to Doctolib, regardless of your gender, religion, age, sexual orientation, ethnicity, disability, or place of origin. If you have a disability, let us know if there's any way we can make the interview process smoother for you!

787a84ca38378868.description:
Vos missions

Vous recherchez un stage dans l’une des start-ups les plus ambitieuses d’Europe ? L’équipe B2B Marketing cherche justement sa future recrue pour une durée de six mois à partir de janvier 2027. 

Vous aurez pour objectif de contribuer au travail de l’équipe Events de Doctolib, qui gère la présence de Doctolib sur plus de 50 Congrès et Salons professionnels chaque année mais aussi des évènements propriétaires (live demo, Keynote, live Q&A…). Vous réfléchirez avec la team sur la meilleure stratégie et les plans de communication les plus efficaces pour ces évènements, et vous aurez l’occasion de travailler en collaboration avec de nombreux acteurs internes et externes.

Nos objectifs: fournir un maximum de contacts qualifiés aux équipes commerciales, rassembler des communautés de professionnels de santé, fidéliser. 

Une opportunité d’apporter votre pierre à l’édifice dans une équipe pleine de challenges !

Si vous nous rejoignez, vous pourrez : 

  • Piloter la gestion administrative et logistique de certains événements en relation directe avec les équipes commerciales 

  • Travailler étroitement avec toutes les équipes marketing, nos partenaires et les organisateurs de salons pour assurer le bon déroulement de la logistique des événements et leur bonne exécution

  • Sélectionner et superviser les prestataires lors de nos événements propriétaires

  • Apporter un support aux Event Marketing Managers dans la promotion des événements au travers des campagnes  de communication.

  • Analyser la performance de nos évènements avec des KPIs précis en fonction des différents objectifs et cibles

 

Les qualités attendues pour ce poste

Vous pourriez être le(la) prochain(e) membre de notre équipe si :

  • Vous êtes en année de césure ou en dernière année d’une école de commerce ou d’événementiel

  • Vous êtes structuré(e) et rigoureux(se)

  • Vous avez l’esprit entrepreneurial : Vous êtes curieux(se), enthousiaste et force de proposition

  • Vous avez d’excellentes capacités d’écoute et de communication, et vous aimez travailler avec un grand nombre d’interlocuteurs et d’équipes

  • Vous faites preuve d'autonomie et n’avez pas peur de mener plusieurs projets de front

 

Notre offre

  • Une carte Swile et de nombreuses offres de restauration au sein de nos locaux

  • Un programme d'intégration complet incluant la Doctolib Academy et diverses formations (langues, soft skills, compétences techniques)

  • Une subvention du comité d'entreprise pour le remboursement partiel d'adhésions à des activités sportives ou de loisirs

  • Un remboursement à 50 % de l'abonnement aux transports en commun

  • De nombreux bureaux offrant des espaces de collaboration et de bien-être

  • Une politique de travail flexible avec un mode hybride et au bureau

 

Le processus de recrutement

  • Un entretien RH avec Flore, notre Talent Partner (15 minutes)

  • Un entretien opérationnel d’une heure avec Laurianne, Senior Events Manager (1 heure)

  • Un dernier entretien avec Judith, Field Marketing Senior Team Manager (20 minutes)

 

Les détails du poste 

  • Stage conventionné à temps plein 

  • Durée : 6 mois

  • Début souhaité : Janvier 2027

  • Lieu de travail : Levallois-Perret

  • Rémunération : A définir selon niveau d’études

 

Chez Doctolib, nous sommes convaincus que nous devons améliorer la santé pour tout le monde. Cela se reflète dans notre processus de recrutement. Nous évaluons les candidatures uniquement sur la base des qualifications et de la motivation, sans aucune forme de discrimination.

Plus les idées sont diverses, plus notre produit améliorera véritablement la santé pour tout le monde. Vous pouvez postuler chez Doctolib, quel que soit votre genre, religion, âge, orientation sexuelle, origine ethnique ou handicap.

Afin de garantir l'égalité des chances, nous vous invitons à exclure les informations personnelles (par exemple : photos, âge) de vos candidatures. Si vous avez besoin d'aménagements particuliers, merci de nous en informer pour que nous puissions adapter le processus de recrutement. Rejoignez-nous pour construire la santé dont nous rêvons tous !

3646d0782a1db2f4.title: Finance Transformation Project Manager
3646d0782a1db2f4.description:
Join Qonto as a Finance Transformation Project Manager, based in Paris, and take full ownership of high-impact, cross-functional initiatives — from analyzing current gaps to selecting providers, implementing new processes, and driving adoption across Finance. Your work will directly shape how Qonto’s Finance functions at scale.

You will work closely with your Finance Transformation peers and Core Finance, Strategic Finance, Product and Tech teams. You will be in the details of our processes and tools, while keeping the big picture in sight.

➡️ What you'll do

  • Own your projects end to end: frame the scope, build the plan, governance and risk tracking, and coordinate the delivery.

  • Diagnose our current processes and tools: in relation to your project scope, map the flows end to end, use data to find pain points and compliance risks, and turn them into a prioritized roadmap within your project plan.

  • Choose the right solution: define requirements, run build-or-buy analysis, run RFPs or assess our existing tools when relevant, and recommend the best option, whether that means improving what we have, building in-house or selecting a new solution.

  • Build and roll out hands-on: work shoulder to shoulder with the business teams, Product Owners and system experts on configuration, integrations and testing, then drive adoption across the teams concerned.

  • Steer cross-functional stakeholders without formal authority: run the project rituals, anticipate risks, arbitrate trade-offs and keep leadership updated on progress and blockers.

➡️ What we're looking for

  • Project leadership: you have led finance transformation or systems projects end to end (framing, delivery, adoption) for 6+ years, and you drive Finance and Tech teams within your project scope without hierarchy.

  • Hands-on and systems-minded: you map processes yourself, analyze data and test solutions with Tech instead of only writing specs. You are comfortable with finance tools and data flows (ERP, purchase-to-pay or procurement tools such as Coupa).

  • Finance process know-how: you can map finance flows from purchasing to payment and accounting, spot dependencies and design pragmatic, compliant solutions.

  • Structured problem-solving: you diagnose with data, run tool selections or RFPs, and turn recommendations into changes that stick.

  • Clear communication & stakeholder management: you are able to influence across teams and present complex topics simply to any audience.

  • Qonto fit: you connect with our culture and with how we work: autonomy, customer satisfaction at the core, and collaboration across teams. You are fluent in English (French is a plus).

➡️ What we can offer you

  • Cross-functional exposure: work closely with teams across Finance, Product, Tech and Growth, giving you a 360° view of how finance operates in a fintech at scale.

  • A high-impact roadmap: participate in the transformation our current processes, tools and people into a best-in-class Finance function ready for our next stages of development.

  • A playbook to build: help create and refine our finance transformation playbook, challenge existing processes and shape how we work.

  • How we work: a data-driven, hands-on culture, with high autonomy and access to senior leaders when needed.

  • Tools we use: our Finance stack includes SAP ERP Cloud, Coupa, Kyriba, Amelkis, and Anaplan.

➡️ Your future manager

Your manager will be Marie Pouzin, Head of Finance Transformation. Marie has led multiple successful finance transformation projects across very different environments (audit, large corporation, small start-up, scale-up). She combines a strategic vision with a hands-on approach, so you get both the guidance and the support you need to make a real impact.

37959eacea682513.description:
[OUR MISSION AND CUSTOMERS] We are creating the freedom for SMEs to succeed by delivering Europe's leading finance workspace with banking at its core, augmented by financial tools. We are proud to be rated 4.7 on Trustpilot, based on 60,000 reviews. Our culture puts customer satisfaction at the core of what we do (more about our culture here).

 

[OUR JOURNEY] Founded in 2016 and launched in 2017 by Alexandre and Steve, Qonto has grown to 1,700 Qontoers serving over 750,000 customers across 8 European countries. We have been profitable since 2023, and we are just getting started.

 

[OUR BELIEFS] We hire for skills and potential. With 80+ nationalities, 45% women, and 56% of women in our leadership team, diversity isn't a program; It's who we are. We've built a discrimination-free hiring process because the best teams are built on merit.

 

[AI AT QONTO] AI is deeply embedded in how we work (here) - Every Qontoer gets unlimited access to the best AI tools. We want people who experiment without waiting for permission, push AI beyond the obvious, know when to trust it, and when to question it.

 

Join us as a Strategic Project Manager – Country Support (Italy) to help shape Qonto’s strategy in Italy and turn local priorities into action. Working with Fanny, our Strategy Director, and Italy’s country leadership, you’ll combine market insights, strategic planning and hands-on project leadership to support growth in the Italian market.

You’ll join a Strategy talent pool where you can learn quickly, collaborate across teams and potentially grow into another function over time, such as Growth, Operations, Product or Tech.

➡️ What you’ll do

  • Understand the Italian market: Analyze market trends, customer needs, regulation and competition to anticipate their impact on Qonto and identify opportunities for growth.

  • Shape the country strategy and plan: Work with Italy’s country leadership to identify opportunities and define and refresh the country strategy and priorities, connecting local opportunities with Qonto’s wider strategic plan. Track progress against the plan with the Finance Business Partner.

  • Develop the strategy per segment: Analyze the market and customer base to define and refresh strategies for different customer segments and identify new business opportunities.

  • Drive strategic projects from framing to execution: Assess the potential, scope, business case and strategic rationale of key initiatives supporting Italy’s priorities and OKRs. Lead or coordinate execution where needed, and hand projects over to country teams when ready. Projects will vary with country priorities and could include exploring a company-creation offering. Strong stakeholder management is essential.

➡️ What we’re looking for

  • Experience: You have around 4–5 years or more of relevant experience in strategic project management, consulting and/or a hands-on role in a startup or company. Consulting experience is useful but not required; experience in banking, payments or fintech is a plus, not a prerequisite.

  • Analytical mindset: You enjoy exploring complex questions, researching markets and turning insights into clear, structured recommendations and action plans.

  • Communication & synthesis: You communicate clearly in writing and in conversation, and can structure and present your ideas to a range of stakeholders.

  • Project & stakeholder management: You can lead cross-functional projects, build alignment across teams and break down silos to move priorities forward.

  • Ownership & pragmatism: You’re proactive, detail-oriented and hands-on. You take responsibility for your projects, from planning through execution, and follow through on delivery.

  • Collaboration: You’re a team player who builds constructive relationships and energizes the people you work with.

  • Curiosity & AI: You’re interested in financial services and eager to learn and experiment with AI in your work. Advanced AI expertise is not required.

  • Languages: Fluency in Italian and English is required.

➡️ What we can offer you

  • Team & impact: Join the Strategy team and play a key role in shaping Qonto’s strategy and driving strategic projects in Italy.

  • Exposure & collaboration: Work closely with country leadership, senior management and international teams across Growth, Product, Tech, Finance, Operations and Compliance.

  • From strategy to execution: Stay close to the business, with opportunities to move from market analysis and strategic decisions to concrete local initiatives and outcomes.

  • Learning & growth: Benefit from coaching and exposure to different areas of Qonto, with opportunities to grow within the Strategy team and potentially explore roles in other functions over time.

  • AI & ways of working: Experiment with AI on projects and exchange practices with the team during strategy office hours.

➡️ Your future manager

Your manager will be Fanny De Vesinne-Larüe, our Strategy Director.

  • Her background: Fanny has been at Qonto for four years, spotting new opportunities and driving key projects to help Qonto accelerate. Before joining Qonto, she held roles across strategy, marketing, venture and e-business at financial institutions including AXA and BNP Paribas, working with fintechs and startups.

  • What she brings to the team: Fanny supports team members through coaching, exposure to different functions and conversations about their development and potential future moves within Qonto.
