d8ec00646181ed9e.title: Psychologue | Operations & Community Manager (FR)
d8ec00646181ed9e.description:
Starting position designed to grow fast in a Mental Health Startup | Psychology background | French & English must | Join a mission driven Team | Passion needed | 100% | Office in the heart of Zurich with potential day trips to Romandie, remote only not possible

Why we do what we do

We see the world through the lens of our psyche — like looking through a window that casts the outside world in shades of gray or vibrant colors. Every day, each of us has the power to shift our perspective and experience reality in a new way. When people gain access to this insight, mental barriers transform into opportunities for personal growth, leading to a more fulfilling and happy life. And because happiness is contagious, society changes—one mind at a time.

You studied psychology. Now what?

You love psychology. You've spent years learning how people think, feel and change. But you don't see yourself in a therapy room every day, and the other doors everyone points you to don't feel quite right either.

There is another one. At Aepsy, you'll work with psychologists instead of patients: finding them, supporting them, growing a community together and helping them build a practice they love. Your psychology background isn't a nice-to-have here. It's the reason psychologists will trust you.

The role

As Community Manager Romandie, you own our community of French-speaking psychologists in Switzerland, as part of our Community & Operations team in Zurich alongside the leads for our German-, Italian- and English-speaking communities. You find and onboard psychologists, you are their first point of contact, help them with administrative and everyday questions, and look out for new opportunities so they can bloom. Together, we will shape the role around your strengths and passions. This is a starting position designed to grow fast, with real ownership from your first weeks.

Be their voice inside Aepsy

  • Bring psychologists' feedback into our product, processes and operations

  • Work closely with our marketing, product & design, sales and insurance partnerships teams

  • Help with client support, translations and content in French

  • Spot what's not working yet and come up with better ways to do it

Key things we are looking for

  • You enjoy reaching out to people, finding out authentically what the right path is for them. When something gets in their way, you don't just take it away, you want to make it better. This role needs both: the courage to reach out and the heart to take care.

  • You're structured and at the same time full of ideas you want to push for. You're proactive, see opportunities in challenges, and thrive in a team where everyone supports each other and grows for something bigger.

  • If you hear about Aepsy's mission, your heart should beat faster, and your hand should instinctively reach out — because you won't want to miss the opportunity to be part of it. We need people who are crazy enough to believe that their actions can change the world.

In a nutshell

  • Full-time position (100%) on-site in Zurich, with potential day trips to Romandie

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Psychology

  • Work experience or projects that demonstrates your dedication (customer-facing, sales, student association…)

  • Structured, proactive and independent, and a natural relationship builder

  • Native or bilingual proficiency in French (spoken & written)

  • Good English (spoken & written) to work and communicate with our team every day

Together with us

We are a vibrant team with diverse backgrounds and beliefs, and we genuinely love what we do. We love conversations about the big picture as much as the smallest details. We work hard to make the world a slightly better place.

At the same time, we are mothers, fathers, husbands and wives, wine lovers, stand-up comedians, musicians, dancers, yoga practitioners, and Zen monks who appreciate and enjoy life.

Ready to join?

Sleep on it, take another look at this job ad. Read it again, believe that you belong at Aepsy, take a deep breath, and send us a personal application letter. (Yes, we will read it carefully, so please don’t send us generic templates, ChatGPT building blocks, or anything similar—there are so many better things to do.) Include your resume, and we look forward to hearing from you!

Du liebst Social Media, hast kreative Ideen, bist KI-affin und weisst, wie man mit einem spannende Inhalte produziert? Dann suchen wir genau dich!

Die Hüsser & Palkoska AG ist ein vielseitiges Automobilunternehmen mit Standorten in Baar und Neuheim. Von der klassischen Werkstatt über Elektromobilität und Fahrzeughandel bis hin zu unserer neuen Carrosserie- und Lackiererei bieten wir ein breites Spektrum rund ums Automobil.

Wir möchten unsere Geschichten, unser Fachwissen und die Menschen hinter unserem Unternehmen noch stärker sichtbar machen. Dafür suchen wir eine kreative und selbstständige Persönlichkeit, die unseren digitalen Auftritt aktiv mitgestaltet.

Bei uns musst du keine aufwendigen Filmproduktionen erstellen. Wir setzen auf authentische Inhalte, gute Ideen und eine unkomplizierte Umsetzung mit Smartphone.

Was erwartet dich?

  • Selbstständige Ideenfindung und Entwicklung spannender Inhalte rund um unseren Betrieb

  • Planung, Produktion und Veröffentlichung von Videos

  • Filmen mit dem Smartphone an unseren Standorten

  • Durchführung von kurzen Interviews mit unseren Mitarbeitenden und Fachpersonen

  • Videoschnitt inklusive Musik, Untertiteln und passenden Effekten

  • Erstellung von Blogs die GEO und SEO

  • Optimierung der Blogbeiträge für Google und KI-basierte Suchmaschinen (SEO/GEO)

  • Erstellung und Pflege eines Marketing- und Redaktionsplans

  • Regelmässige Abstimmung der Marketingplanung mit der Geschäftsleitung

  • Beobachtung aktueller Social-Media-Trends und Einbringen neuer Ideen

  • Einfache Auswertung der veröffentlichten Inhalte und ihrer Reichweite

Was wünschen wir uns von dir?

  • Freude an Social Media

  • Erfahrung mit CapCut

  • Sicherer Umgang mit dem Smartphone für Video- und Fotoaufnahmen

  • Kreativität und ein gutes Gespür für interessante Geschichten

  • Erfahrung mit KI-Tools und grosses Interesse diese effizient einzusetzen

  • Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse und Freude am Schreiben

  • Grundkenntnisse in Online-Marketing, SEO und Website-Pflege von Vorteil

  • Selbstständige, strukturierte und zuverlässige Arbeitsweise

  • Organisationstalent und die Fähigkeit Inhalte vorausschauend zu planen

  • Offene und kommunikative Persönlichkeit die gerne auf Menschen zugeht

  • Eigeninitiative: Du erkennst spannende Themen und setzt deine Ideen selbstständig um

  • Pragmatische Einstellung, du möchtest gute Inhalte produzieren, statt alles unnötig kompliziert zu machen

  • Wohnort vorzugsweise in der Region Zug

Wir glauben: Guter Schlaf ist pure Lebensqualität und beginnt mit der richtigen Ausstattung.

Deshalb haben wir uns vor über 5 Jahren auf die Entwicklung und den Verkauf qualitativer Bettwaren, wie Bettdecken, Kissen und Bezüge spezialisiert. Heute sind wir ein aufstrebendes E-Commerce-Unternehmen im Bereich hochwertiger Bettwaren, sind international auf Marktplätzen wie Amazon, Otto und eBay aktiv und haben dort bereits eine starke Marktposition aufgebaut.

Welldora steht für durchdachte Produkte, hohe Qualitätsstandards und ein kompromissloses Kundenerlebnis. Unser Anspruch ist es nicht, einfach nur zu verkaufen, sondern echte Lösungen für besseren Schlaf zu schaffen – effizient, datengetrieben und mit einem klaren Blick auf nachhaltiges Wachstum.

Dabei verbinden wir strategisches Denken mit operativer Umsetzung. Wir arbeiten pragmatisch, zielorientiert und mit echter Verantwortung für Ergebnisse.

Als 100% remote Unternehmen basiert unsere Kultur auf Vertrauen, Ownership und Selbstorganisation. Wir folgen dem Prinzip „Hire for attitude, train for skill“ und bilden dich in allen relevanten Dingen aus!

Wenn du Lust hast, nicht einfach nur im E-Commerce zu arbeiten, sondern unser Amazon Account Management aktiv voranzutreiben und unsere Supply Chain eigenverantwortlich zu betreuen, dann bist du bei Welldora genau richtig.

62f64420456532da.title: Customer Success Manager
62f64420456532da.description:
Warum wir tun, was wir tun

Unsere Psyche ist das Fenster, durch das wir die Welt sehen – mal grau, mal hell. Wer lernt, dieses Fenster zu verstehen, kann jeden Tag eine neue Perspektive gewinnen. Aus psychischen Herausforderungen können Chancen zum Wachsen werden. Und weil Glück ansteckend ist, verändert sich so die Gesellschaft: one mind at a time.

Warum es diese Rolle braucht

Immer mehr Arbeitgebende und Versicherungen machen Aepsy für ihre Mitarbeitenden zugänglich – vom KMU bis zum Grossunternehmen. So erhalten mehr Menschen frühzeitig Zugang zu passender psychologischer Unterstützung.

Doch ein Angebot allein reicht nicht. Mitarbeitende müssen Aepsy kennen, verstehen und ihm vertrauen. Sie müssen wissen, wie sie das Angebot nutzen können, wenn sie Unterstützung brauchen.

Genau hier kommst du ins Spiel: Du betreust dein eigenes Portfolio an Partnerunternehmen und sorgst dafür, dass aus Partnerschaften echte Wirkung entsteht. Dafür entwickelst du Aktivierungsmassnahmen, koordinierst Projekte und arbeitest eng mit HR-Verantwortlichen sowie unseren Teams aus Sales, Marketing, Operations und Product zusammen.

Was du bewegen wirst

  • Partnerschaften gestalten: Du betreust dein eigenes Portfolio an Partnerunternehmen, baust langfristige Beziehungen auf und verstehst, was deine Ansprechpersonen bewegt.

  • Menschen erreichen und aktivieren: Du entwickelst Kommunikations- und Aktivierungsmassnahmen, die Mitarbeitende auf Aepsy aufmerksam machen und zur Nutzung motivieren.

  • Projekte ins Rollen bringen: Du planst und koordinierst Projekte von der Idee bis zur Umsetzung, behältst Deadlines im Blick und bringst alle Beteiligten zusammen.

  • Wirkung sichtbar machen: Du analysierst Aktivierungs- und Nutzungszahlen und leitest daraus konkrete Verbesserungsmassnahmen ab.

  • Dinge besser machen: Du hinterfragst Abläufe, bringst eigene Ideen ein und entwickelst unsere Partnerschaften, Prozesse und das Produkt weiter.

Was du mitbringst

Du musst nicht bereits alles können. Viel wichtiger ist uns, wie du denkst, wie du mit Menschen umgehst und was dich antreibt.

  • Erste Berufserfahrung in Customer Success, Account Management, Sales, HR oder einem verwandten Bereich. Einen Hintergrund in Psychologie oder Gesundheitsförderung ist ein Plus aber kein Muss.

  • Freude am Aufbau von Beziehungen, Begeisterungsfähigkeit und ein ausgeprägtes Verantwortungsbewusstsein

  • Selbstständige, strukturierte Arbeitsweise und die Fähigkeit, auch bei mehreren parallelen Projekten den Überblick zu behalten

  • Analytisches Denken, Interesse an Zahlen und Freude daran, Prozesse zu hinterfragen und zu verbessern

  • Freude an einem dynamischen Umfeld, in dem nicht immer alles vorgegeben ist und Eigeninitiative gefragt ist

  • Sehr gute Deutsch- sowie Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift.

  • Bereitschaft, in einem 100-%-Pensum zu arbeiten und mehrheitlich vor Ort in unserem Büro im Herzen von Zürich tätig zu sein. Eine reine Remote-Tätigkeit ist nicht möglich.

Was wir dir bieten

  • Arbeit, die etwas bewirkt. Deine Arbeit hilft Menschen, psychologische Unterstützung zu finden, wenn sie sie brauchen. Du trägst dazu bei, mentale Gesundheit zugänglicher zu machen.

  • Ein Team, das dich stärkt. Du arbeitest eng mit Sales, Marketing, Product und unserer Psycholog:innen-Community zusammen. Unterschiedliche Perspektiven, viel Know-how und eine gemeinsame Mission prägen unseren Alltag.

  • Raum, Dinge zu bewegen. Wir wachsen und entwickeln uns weiter. Deine Ideen sind willkommen, deine Verantwortung ist real und du kannst direkt mitgestalten, wie wir unsere Partner betreuen und Mitarbeitende erreichen.

Gemeinsam mit uns

Wir sind ein ambitioniertes Team mit unterschiedlichen Hintergründen und Überzeugungen. Wir lieben Gespräche über das grosse Ganze genauso wie über die kleinen Details. Wir glauben an das, was wir tun, und arbeiten hart für eine etwas bessere Welt.

Gleichzeitig sind wir Mütter, Väter, Ehemänner und Ehefrauen, Weinliebhaber, Stand-up-Comedians, Musiker, Tänzer, Yoga-Begeisterte und Zen-Mönche, die das Leben schätzen und geniessen.

Bereit, etwas zu bewegen?

Schlaf darüber. Lies das Inserat nochmals. Und wenn du das Gefühl hast, dass du zu Aepsy passen könntest, freuen wir uns auf deinen Lebenslauf und ein persönliches Bewerbungsschreiben. Erzähl uns, was dich antreibt, warum dir unsere Mission wichtig ist und weshalb dich genau diese Rolle anspricht. Wir lesen jedes Schreiben aufmerksam.

4371dcd2708b91b0.title: Implementation Manager - Bilingual
4371dcd2708b91b0.description:
We are rebuilding biotech for the AI era.

When a breakthrough is delayed, the world waits. Getting a molecule from discovery to patients, or a crop from lab to field, involves thousands of slow, manual, disconnected steps. AI has the potential to change this, compressing decades of R&D work into years. But that only happens when clean, structured scientific data and AI are built into how science gets done.

Benchling is the AI platform for biotech R&D. Scientists use Benchling to design experiments, capture structured data, and run AI agents and models directly in their workflows. Over 200,000 scientists around the world trust Benchling to power their most important work, from academic labs to Sanofi, Moderna, and more than half of the world's top 50 biopharma.

We’re building an AI scientist for our customers. We can’t do that if we haven’t built the muscle ourselves. AI fluency is the foundation we build on; it's core to how we work, and we're committed to helping every new hire integrate it into their day-to-day. As part of our interview process, you'll complete a brief AI-focused exercise or discussion so we can understand how you think about and use AI to drive impact in your role. Feel free to reference any tools, platforms, or workflows you use today.

ROLE OVERVIEW

Benchling is building a world-class Professional Services team to drive implementations for our rapidly expanding customer base. Implementation Managers work with our customers, from small Biotech startups to the largest BioPharmas in the world to develop a deep understanding of their R&D Processes, and roll out solutions that transform how their research teams work together.

To be successful in this role, you will leverage your scientific background, project management skills, and product expertise to drive successful implementations of the Benchling platform. You will work hand in hand with the research scientists at our customers, and teams throughout Benchling to implement our solutions, and ensure our customers are successful. Implementation Managers lead all aspects of customer rollouts from requirements analysis and solution design, to configurations, testing, training, and onboarding users onto the system. Fluent or native French or German, plus experience supporting French- or German-speaking customers.

 

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Manage initial rollouts for new Benchling customers as well as expansion projects with new teams or for new processes at existing customers

  • Own implementation success from project kickoff to go-live, leveraging strong project management skills, scientific expertise, and deep product knowledge.

  • Build and execute detailed project plans, own project activities, work with other team members to execute on project deliverables to ensure on time, on budget, high quality deployments.

  • Understand customers' scientific workflows and determine how Benchling can best be leveraged to meet their key business needs.

  • Lead requirements and design workshops, perform data modeling & application configuration, develop test plans and guide UAT execution, train and onboard users.

  • Act as a trusted advisor for customers, guiding them through the implementation ensuring they leverage and apply Benchling Best Practices.

  • Understand and document customer pain points, advocate for them internally to influence product changes.

  • Identify and work with sales on opportunities for account expansion post go-live.

 

QUALIFICATIONS

  • MS or Ph.D. in Molecular Biology, Biochemistry, Biotechnology, Immunology, Bioinformatics, Biological Engineering or a related field.

  • At least 2 years of experience in a lab or R&D setting, ideally in antibody discovery or strain engineering or process development. You must be able to empathize with scientists and quickly understand complicated scientific concepts.

  • Software Implementation experience, preferably with a SaaS software company.

  • Strong communication skills. You must be able to quickly and effectively connect with a range of stakeholders, including scientists, IT project leads, and executives.

  • Self-starter with the ability to be successful in a startup environment.

  • Curious, creative, and tenacious. You should be excited to collaborate with customers and other Benchling teammates as a thought partner.

  • Ability to travel up to 25% based on customer and project needs.

  • Fluent or native proficiency in French or German

  • Experience using Benchling, especially if you’ve been a Benchling administrator, is preferred but not required.

 

HOW WE WORK

We offer a flexible hybrid work arrangement that prioritizes in-office collaboration. Employees are expected to be on-site 3 days per week (Monday, Tuesday, and Thursday).

#LI-Hybrid

#BI-Hybrid

Benchling welcomes everyone.

We believe diversity enriches our team so we hire people with a wide range of identities, backgrounds, and experiences.

We are an equal opportunity employer. That means we don’t discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. We also consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law, including but not limited to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance.

This role encompasses guiding organizations through digital transformation, leading technical implementation projects, overseeing solution architecture, and establishing best practices and data architecture standards to ensure long-term success.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Partner with biotechnology organizations at the forefront of innovation to assess their IT landscape, understand strategic objectives, and architect solutions that enable mission-critical outcomes.

  • Lead end-to-end implementation projects from discovery through successful go-live and adoption.

  • Provide ongoing strategic guidance, best practice education, and product engagement recommendations to maximize customer value realization.

09ea0a28d068069a.title: SMB Account Executive
09ea0a28d068069a.description:
We are rebuilding biotech for the AI era.

When a breakthrough is delayed, the world waits. Getting a molecule from discovery to patients, or a crop from lab to field, involves thousands of slow, manual, disconnected steps. AI has the potential to change this, compressing decades of R&D work into years. But that only happens when clean, structured scientific data and AI are built into how science gets done.

Benchling is the AI platform for biotech R&D. Scientists use Benchling to design experiments, capture structured data, and run AI agents and models directly in their workflows. Over 200,000 scientists around the world trust Benchling to power their most important work, from academic labs to Sanofi, Moderna, and more than half of the world's top 50 biopharma.

We’re building an AI scientist for our customers. We can’t do that if we haven’t built the muscle ourselves. AI fluency is the foundation we build on; it's core to how we work, and we're committed to helping every new hire integrate it into their day-to-day. As part of our interview process, you'll complete a brief AI-focused exercise or discussion so we can understand how you think about and use AI to drive impact in your role. Feel free to reference any tools, platforms, or workflows you use today.

ROLE OVERVIEW

We are seeking a motivated and results-driven SMB Account Executive to join our team. In this role, you will be responsible for driving new business within the EMEA territory, focusing on building and maintaining strong relationships with key stakeholders across various personas within small and medium-sized accounts. You will play a crucial role in expanding our customer base and ensuring successful sales outcomes through effective pipeline generation and accurate sales forecasting.

 

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Pipeline Generation: Enthusiastically creating and driving your own pipeline by identifying new business opportunities and engaging multiple personas from scientists to C-suite. Utilize various strategies and tools to generate leads and move them through the sales cycle.

  • Sales Forecasting: Develop and maintain accurate sales forecasts (+/- 10 of goal), leveraging data to inform decision-making and ensure predictable revenue outcomes with the goal of consistent attainment of revenue targets.

  • Solution Selling: Effectively communicate the value of our platform, tailoring presentations and proposals to meet the specific needs of each prospect.

  • Platform Demonstrations: Running Benchling platform demonstrations aligned to a clear customer problem statement and a Benchling proven solution to potential clients to help clients understand the value of Benchling to them specifically.

  • Negotiation and Closing: Lead negotiations with potential clients, by thoughtfully addressing key stakeholders including multiple personas and CxO in the buyer journey, while navigating organizational complexities, addressing objections and securing new business agreements.

  • Account Engagement: Work across multiple personas within an account to understand their unique needs and align Benchling’s solutions with their business objectives.

  • Collaboration: Partner with internal teams (marketing, product, customer success, etc) and Channel to ensure a seamless experience for clients and drive long-term customer satisfaction.

  • Continuous Learning: Stay informed about industry trends, competitors, and emerging technologies to maintain a competitive edge in the market.

  • Process: Drive the sales process through Pipeline Generation (PG), 3 Why’s, Champion Building, MEDDIC, Command of the Message, etc. Maintain account integrity and opportunity data within company systems; Salesforce 

QUALIFICATIONS

You are drawn to our mission and you want to help Benchling win new business. You are committed to working in a collaborative environment, working together as a team. You have a love for working in a fast-paced environment and taking the initiative to get stuff done and try new things. You are passionate about powering new possibilities in biotech faster.

  • Bachelor’s degree - life sciences major is required.

  • 1-3 years of experience as an Account Executive, Field Application Scientist, Account Manager. Sales Development Background highly appreciated.

  • Demonstrable history of consistently achieving or exceeding ambitious sales targets.

  • Knowledge of the life sciences industry, including: R&D, and/or IT functions is required.

  • Curiosity, creativity, and persistence. You should be excited to collaborate with customers as a thought partner.

  • Dynamic communication skills and the versatility to connect effectively with a range of stakeholders, including scientists, team project leads and executives in industry. 

HOW WE WORK

We offer a flexible hybrid work arrangement that prioritizes in-office collaboration. Employees are expected to be on-site 3 days per week (Monday, Tuesday, and Thursday).

SALARY & BENEFITS

Full-time employees outside the U.S. enjoy a comprehensive benefits program tailored to their region of residence.

38ec881f4583b3a8.description:
Imagine building intelligent systems that don’t just work in perfect lab conditions, but

perform reliably in the real world, where uncertainty is the norm and failure is not an

option. As a Machine Learning Engineer, you will push the limits of computer vision by

designing, training, and validating neural networks that operate in complex, safety-critical

environments. Your work will directly influence how autonomous systems perceive and

interact with the world, combining deep learning, simulation, and rigorous verification into

one seamless pipeline.

At Destinus, we are shaping the future of defense through high-speed, autonomous flight

technologies. We develop next-generation unmanned aerial systems that deliver greater

speed, precision, and efficiency, supporting governments and defense organizations in

mission-critical operations worldwide. Daedalean AG, the AI and autonomy hub of the

Destinus Group, plays a key role in this vision. Developing safety-critical AI systems at the

intersection of advanced research and real-world aviation. Enabling machines to perceive,

understand, and make decisions in real time. Together, we combine aerospace

engineering and artificial intelligence to build the next generation of autonomous flight

systems, driving innovation where it matters most.

What You´ll Do

• Design, train, and optimize deep learning models for computer vision tasks in highly

dynamic and safety-critical environments

• Manage the development lifecycle of ML capabilities, from early-stage data

collection to the operational deployments of mature systems

• Develop robust evaluation pipelines to ensure models meet strict reliability and

safety requirements

• Leverage transfer learning and simulation to scale training and testing beyond realworld data limitations

• Collaborate closely with software, systems, and flight teams to integrate ML models

into real-world applications

• Continuously push model performance across edge cases, environmental

variability, and operational constraints

Requirements

Strong programming skills in C++ or Rust

• At least 5 years of hands-on experience in deep learning for computer vision

• Experience across the full ML stack, including model design, distributed training

frameworks, evaluation pipelines and resource-constrained inference platforms

• Experience with simulation environments or synthetic data generation is a strong

plus

• Experience with working with integrated sensors, including infrared cameras

• Master’s degree or PhD in computer science, physics, mathematics, or a related

technical field- or equal proven practical experience

About the Role

The Destinus Industralization team is seeking an Industralization Engineer to help brining products from R&D to full scale production. The role requires expertise in balancing process and product optimization throughout the development cycle of the project as well as sound and realistic assessment where the improvements will bring the most impact in the given timeline.

The ideal candidate takes ownership of their work, leads by example and understands that approach to industrialization should be agile to fit best the fast-paced projects.

What You'll Do

• Enable R&D team to implement DFX from the beginning of the project.

• Review and optimise existing and new processes of assembly and manufacturing to assure repeatable quality of products.

• Find and audit suitable suppliers and manufacturers.

• Set up suppliers and manufacturers as partners.

• Establish and maintain communication with suppliers to enable manufacturing R&D, Batch Zero and Full Scale Production quantities.

• Be a link between R&D, production and qualification department, with thorough understanding how design choices impact assembly line.

• Perform material flow and value chain analysis

• Design assembly lines which comply to safety and quality requirements to assure repeatable processes and quality of the final product.

• Assemble prototypes and assure the product maturity necessary to pass review gates

• Write, maintain, and follow SOPs for assembly, integration, and testing operations, ensuring safety and repeatability at every step.

• Support troubleshooting and corrective actions in collaboration with engineering and QA teams.

• Contribute to continuous improvement of assembly workflows while maintaining compliance with safety and quality requirements.

Requirements

What You'll Need

• Several years of industrialization experience with maintaining full R&D to Production workflow

• Excellent hands-on engineering

• Experience with various manufacturing methods; milling, turning, plastic injection moulding, casting, 3D printing.

• Experience or willingness to work with energetic, pyrotechnic, or otherwise hazardous materials; knowledge of relevant safety requirements is a strong advantage.

• Experience with quality control, functional testing, and documentation standards in a production or engineering environment.

• Ability to write and execute SOPs in a detail-driven, safety-critical environment.

• High attention to detail and a disciplined, methodical approach to assembly and testing.

• Willingness to travel when setting up a suppliers and manufacturers

• Fluency in English and German required; any other language is a plus.

e75f9ed0083b89be.title: ML Hydrologist, Flood Forecasting
e75f9ed0083b89be.description:
About the Role
Global ML flood models now outperform traditional approaches on large rivers, but they still break down in the small, fast catchments where flash floods happen. Riverkin, a VC-backed ETH Zürich Spin-off, is closing that gap. We start from hydrological models trained across thousands of catchments worldwide and make them accurate locally, using a sensor network we deploy ourselves in exactly the places public datasets don't reach.

We are looking for an ML hydrologist to own that work. You will report to the CTO and work directly with our other hydrologist, who covers rainfall radar and short-term nowcasting.

Why this is interesting

  • Data nobody else has: Our own field-deployed sensors give you live streamflow observations in small, previously ungauged catchments.

  • An open problem: Whether large-sample models can be made reliable at flash-flood scale is unsolved, and you would be working on it with real data and real users.

  • Built to protect lives and critical infrastructure: Your models will power early flood warning systems safeguarding hydropower plants and giving first responders more time to protect communities

  • Publishing and open source: We encourage publishing results and contributing to open tools such as NeuralHydrology and Caravan.

  • Compute: GPU resources are available for training and experimentation.

What You'll Do

  • Bring global flood models to the local scale

  • Take state-of-the-art hydrological ML models (LSTMs, Transformers) trained on large-sample datasets and adapt them to the catchments our customers care about.

  • Use our own sensor data alongside public gauge, reanalysis and radar data to fine-tune and validate those models locally.

  • Tackle prediction in ungauged and data-scarce basins through transfer learning and regionalisation.

  • Own hydrological modelling end to end: set the technical direction, decide when to adapt pre-trained models or train our own, and lead the work from experimentation through validation to production.

  • Work as one modelling team

  • Make practical trade-offs between forecast accuracy, model complexity and development effort to build a reliable product that meets customer needs.

  • Work side by side with our hydrologist specialising in rainfall radar and nowcasting to directly integrate rainfall nowcasts into your flood models.

  • Work with software engineers to put models into production and monitor their performance.

  • Identify and test advances in ML flood forecasting, turning promising research into more accurate and reliable forecasts for our customers.

  • Stay close to the real world

  • We believe the best modellers understand the world behind their models. We encourage you to join field deployments and customer conversations to build that understanding firsthand.

  • You are an opinionated contributor to key technical decisions.

Who You Are

  • You’ve built and validated hydrological ML models across many catchments and have experience taking modelling work into real-world use.

  • You combine scientific rigour with product judgement: you test assumptions, understand uncertainty and focus on improvements that matter to customers.

  • You take ownership from an open question to a working solution. You set priorities, make decisions and keep moving without waiting for perfect information.

  • You care deeply about the quality of your work. You dig into why models fail, follow problems through and stay invested in how your forecasts perform after deployment.

  • You communicate clearly in writing and in person, can explain your reasoning and trade-offs, and work closely with people across hydrology, software, hardware and field operations.

Technical Requirements

  • Hands-on experience training or fine-tuning ML streamflow or flood models across many catchments at once (regional, continental or global), for example on CAMELS or Caravan. Experience with single-catchment models alone is not sufficient.

  • Experience transferring such models to new or data-scarce catchments through fine-tuning, regionalisation, or prediction in ungauged basins.

  • Strong understanding of rainfall-runoff processes and the limitations of hydrological observations and input data.

  • Experience validating models across unseen catchments and time periods, including assessing flood-peak magnitude, timing and predictive uncertainty.

  • Strong Python skills, with experience writing maintainable code for data processing, modelling and reproducible experiments.

  • Practical depth in deep learning for time series, including developing, training and debugging models in PyTorch or a comparable framework.

  • MSc or PhD in hydrology, water resources, atmospheric sciences, machine learning, or equivalent.

Nice to Have

  • Publications or open-source work on large-sample hydrology, transfer learning, or ungauged-basin prediction.

  • Experience with NeuralHydrology, ERA5 or similar global forcing datasets.

  • Experience with sub-daily or event-based flood modelling.

  • Experience processing large hydrometeorological datasets with tools such as xarray and Dask, and formats such as Zarr.

  • Previous early startup experience.

Role Details

  • Contract: Permanent, full-time (100% FTE).

  • Start date: immediately

  • Reports to: CTO.

  • Compensation: Commensurate with experience + equity

  • Growth: a key early hire with the opportunity to shape Riverkin's flood modelling as the team grows.

  • Location: Four days per week in our Zurich office and one day working from home.

  • Work authorisation: Swiss or EU/EFTA citizenship, or a valid Swiss work permit, is required.

  • Working language: English. German is not required.

About Riverkin
We are a well-capitalized Swiss startup building real-time sensing and data infrastructure for rivers. Our own field-deployed sensors collect live water-level and sediment data, while our platform turns that data into decision-ready insights for customers. We work directly with the hydropower sector, where predicting flash floods is needed for daily operations. As we prove ourselves in this field, we will move towards the first responders market. We are a small, hands-on team working across hydrology, hardware, field engineering, software and market development.

Apply with the button on this page. Links to papers or code are welcome.

  • Offene Unternehmenskultur und ein freundliches, aufgeschlossenes Team
  • Ein modernes Produktions- und Technologiezentrum für Thermische Beschichtung ab 2027 in Hausen (AG)

Oerlikon ist weltweit führend in Material Science Engineering. Mit der richtigen Kombination aus Oberflächentechnologien, Advanced Materials, Beschichtungsanlagen, Komponenten und Advanced Manufacturing helfen wir Kunden, die Leistung, Effizienz, Langlebigkeit und Nachhaltigkeit ihrer Produkte und Prozesse zu verbessern. 4492c3652eb9fec6.title: IT Reliability Engineer
4492c3652eb9fec6.description:
Du möchtest Verantwortung übernehmen, moderne IT-Umgebungen zuverlässig betreiben und den Bereich IT Reliability Engineering aktiv mit aufbauen?

Als IT Reliability Engineer bist du Teil unseres Engineering-Teams und übernimmst die Verantwortung für die Stabilität, Überwachung und kontinuierliche Verbesserung bestehender Kundenumgebungen.

Du sorgst dafür, dass Systeme zuverlässig betrieben werden, technische Risiken frühzeitig erkannt werden und Monitoring-, Backup-, Update- sowie Lifecycle-Prozesse nachhaltig funktionieren. Dabei leistest du einen wichtigen Beitrag zur Servicequalität und zur langfristigen Stabilität unserer Kundenumgebungen.

Die Themen Monitoring, Betriebsstabilität, Lifecycle-Management und technische Qualitätsstandards haben bei MDigital bereits heute einen hohen Stellenwert und werden aktiv durch unser Engineering-Team gelebt. Aufgrund des Unternehmenswachstums und der zunehmenden Bedeutung dieser Aufgaben investieren wir nun gezielt in eine spezialisierte Rolle innerhalb des Engineering-Teams.

Da diese Position neu geschaffen wird, hast du die Möglichkeit, die zukünftige Ausgestaltung der Rolle aktiv mitzuprägen. Mit dem weiteren Wachstum des Unternehmens besteht zudem die Perspektive, den Bereich IT Reliability Engineering langfristig weiter auszubauen und zusätzliche Mitarbeitende in diesem Umfeld zu etablieren.

Aufgaben

Monitoring & Infrastruktur

  • Überwachung sämtlicher Kundensysteme über unsere Monitoring-Plattformen
  • Analyse, Priorisierung und Nachverfolgung von Warnmeldungen
  • Sicherstellung der vollständigen Integration produktiver Systeme ins Monitoring
  • Überwachung von Verfügbarkeit, Diensten, Hardware- und Storage-Zuständen
  • Frühzeitige Erkennung technischer und sicherheitsrelevanter Risiken
  • Eskalation kritischer Ereignisse
  • Kontinuierliche Verbesserung und Weiterentwicklung bestehender Monitoring-Prozesse
  • Identifikation und Umsetzung von Verbesserungen zur Erhöhung der Betriebsstabilität
  • Förderung von Standardisierung und Automatisierung im täglichen Betrieb
  • Analyse wiederkehrender Incidents und Erarbeitung nachhaltiger Lösungen

Backup & Recovery

  • Sicherstellung funktionierender Backup- und Recovery-Prozesse
  • Nachverfolgung fehlerhafter Sicherungen
  • Integration neuer Systeme in bestehende Backup-Konzepte
  • Planung, Durchführung und Dokumentation regelmässiger Restore-Tests

Client-, Server- & Update-Management

  • Überwachung des Update- und Sicherheitsstatus von Clients und Servern
  • Sicherstellung aktueller Sicherheits- und Systemstände
  • Standardisierung und Automatisierung von Update-Prozessen
  • Verwaltung von Serversystemen über Microsoft Azure Arc
  • Verwaltung von Clients über Microsoft Intune und bestehende Endpoint-Management-Lösungen
  • Förderung einer möglichst zentralisierten und automatisierten Systemverwaltung

Evergreen & Lifecycle Management

  • Überwachung von EOL- und EOS-Systemen
  • Kontrolle von Firmware-, Software- und Security-Ständen
  • Identifikation technischer und sicherheitsrelevanter Altlasten
  • Erarbeitung von Handlungsempfehlungen für Engineering und Management
  • Unterstützung von Standardisierungsinitiativen

Lizenz-, Zertifikats- & Vertragsüberwachung

  • Überwachung von SSL-Zertifikaten und Laufzeiten
  • Kontrolle von Softwarelizenzen und Wartungsverträgen
  • Frühzeitige Meldung bevorstehender Verlängerungen
  • Vermeidung betrieblicher Risiken durch ablaufende Lizenzen oder Zertifikate
  • Nachvollziehbare Dokumentation relevanter Informationen

Dokumentation & Betriebsqualität

  • Pflege und Weiterentwicklung technischer Kundendokumentationen
  • Erstellung und Aktualisierung von Betriebsanleitungen
  • Dokumentation neuer Systeme und Änderungen
  • Sicherstellung eines nachvollziehbaren und professionellen Betriebsstandards
  • Unterstützung bei der Kommunikation kritischer technischer Ereignisse

Pikettdienst und Team-Integration

Als Teil unseres Engineering-Teams beteiligst du dich am rotierenden Pikettdienst und hilfst mit, den stabilen Betrieb unserer Kundenumgebungen auch ausserhalb der regulären Arbeitszeiten sicherzustellen. Die Teilnahme am Pikettdienst wird entsprechend geplant und vergütet.

Bei Bedarf unterstützt du zusätzlich das Engineering-Team bei Rollouts, technischen Umsetzungen oder klar definierten Projektaufgaben was zusätzliche Abwechslung mit sich bringt. Der Schwerpunkt bleibt jedoch bewusst auf der Sicherstellung eines professionellen Betriebs unserer Kundenumgebungen ausgerichtet.

Qualifikation

Das zeichnet Dich aus

  • Du übernimmst gerne Verantwortung und möchtest aktiv etwas aufbauen und mitgestalten.
  • Du arbeitest strukturiert, zuverlässig und nachhaltig.
  • Du erkennst Risiken frühzeitig und kommunizierst diese verständlich.
  • Du hast Freude daran, Systeme stabil und sicher zu betreiben.
  • Du interessierst dich für Monitoring, Automatisierung und Prozessverbesserungen.
  • Du schätzt klare Standards und professionelle Betriebsprozesse.
  • Du arbeitest gerne selbstständig und denkst unternehmerisch.

Fachliche Qualifikationen

  • Erfahrung im Bereich System Engineering, IT-Betrieb, Managed Services, Monitoring oder Infrastruktur
  • Gute Kenntnisse in Microsoft 365, Microsoft Azure, Windows Server und Netzwerktechnologien
  • Grundlegendes Verständnis von IT-Security und Cyber-Risiken
  • Erfahrung mit Monitoring-Lösungen von Vorteil
  • Kenntnisse im Bereich Backup- und Recovery-Lösungen
  • Erfahrung mit Microsoft Intune oder vergleichbaren Endpoint-Management-Lösungen
  • Kenntnisse von Microsoft Azure Arc von Vorteil

a28b63eedb902178.title: Senior AI Engineer - VLA Foundation Model
a28b63eedb902178.description:
RIVR, part of Amazon is a robotics company pioneering Physical AI through real-world doorstep delivery. Founded in 2024 as an ETH Zurich spin-off, RIVR developed wheeled-legged robots designed to operate in complex, unstructured environments such as stairs, gates, doors, and uneven urban terrain. We believe that achieving general physical intelligence requires solving real customer problems in the real world, where robots can learn from rich operational data at scale.

Following our acquisition by Amazon in March 2026, we are continuing this mission with greater reach and speed. By combining custom robot hardware, onboard autonomy, and cloud-based coordination, RIVR, part of Amazon is building the next generation of safe, reliable autonomous robots for last-mile delivery


Job Description
 
Our fleet of delivery robots operates globally today, generating vast amounts of robotic real-world data. By utilizing state-of-the-art Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models, large-scale generalist models (like Transformers), generative AI, and similar methods, we can leverage this pool of data to significantly enhance its autonomy, navigation, and manipulation skills. In this role, you will develop multi-modal models that enable robots to autonomously generate actions from demonstrations, real-time sensor data, and natural language commands. We are seeking an expert in VLA models, imitation learning, and generative AI techniques with a deep knowledge of supervised, and self-supervised learning algorithms. If you are passionate about pushing the boundaries of AI we invite you to join us in shaping the future of intelligent robotics.
 
 

What you’ll be doing
  • Develop and implement cutting-edge Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models, generalist robot transformers, and imitation learning algorithms (e.g., diffusion policies) to enable robots to autonomously execute complex tasks.
  • Design, test, and refine your algorithms to meet the demands of complex real-world autonomy and navigation tasks, with a focus on spatial reasoning and generalization.
  • Streamline the data collection and training workflow to efficiently expand model capabilities with new tasks and data sources.
  • Collaborate with the reinforcement learning team to innovate methods that leverage both simulated and real-world data.
  • Optimize and distill networks for real-time deployment on the edge (e.g. Nvidia Jetson Thor).
  • Build, lead and mentor an exceptional team of software engineers.
  • Provide expert guidance to product managers and executives for strategic decision-making.
  • Create and maintain documentation, guidelines, and best practices to streamline knowledge sharing.

    • What you must have
  • Master’s degree or higher in a relevant field such as Engineering, Robotics, or Machine Learning.
  • A minimum of three years of industry or research experience, with PhD experience applicable.
  • Strong deep learning fundamentals including supervised learning, self-supervised learning, Transformer-based architectures, policy optimization algorithms, imitation learning, and generative AI techniques (including Diffusion Models).
  • Proven experience in developing Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models or large-scale generalist robot models (e.g., RT-2, Octo, etc.).
  • Strong background in robotics including autonomy, navigation.
  • Experience with deploying artificial neural networks on hardware platforms.
  • Ability to prototype algorithms and train deep neural networks in Python (Pytorch)

    • Get some bonus points
  • PhD degree in Robotics, Engineering, Computer Science, Machine Learning or a similar discipline, or an equivalent amount of research experience.
  • Publications at top-tier conferences.
  • Experience in managing a software team.
  • Ability to write production-level code in modern C++
    • RIVR, part of Amazon is committed to building a diverse and inclusive team that values every perspective. If you’re passionate about driving innovation in robotics and creating meaningful impact, we encourage you to apply and bring your unique self to our team.
     
    We believe the best work is done when collaborating and therefore require in-person presence in our office locations.

1d68e8ae96e714d6.description:
We're on a mission to become the go-to destination for students across Europe to find a trusted home away from home. We make every step of the rental journey simple and seamless, so students can focus on what really matters: studying, exploring, and growing.

With HousingAnywhere, Kamernet, and Studapart under our roof, we're Europe's largest student rental platform. You'll find us in Rotterdam, Paris, and Cergy, always guided by our four core values: Ownership, We are enablers, We are changemakers, and We are connectors.

 

Your role

Help people feel at home, beyond the booking.

Booking a place is only the beginning. Moving to a new country means navigating unfamiliar processes, managing payments, and building a relationship with a landlord—all while settling into a new life. At HousingAnywhere, we want people to feel supported throughout their stay, with the confidence that comes from knowing what happens next and where to turn when they need help.

We are looking for a Senior Product Designer to own the Post Booking experience, with a strong focus on our mobile app. You will shape how tenants and landlords use HousingAnywhere throughout a tenancy: from preparing for move-in and managing payments to getting support and extending a stay.

You'll bring strong mobile app design experience and product thinking to make these everyday interactions feel simple, intuitive, and reliable—helping turn HousingAnywhere into a trusted companion throughout the rental journey.

  • Shape the long-term vision for the journey beyond the booking, making HousingAnywhere a trusted part of everyday renting.
  • Design experiences that help tenants and landlords prepare for move-in, manage payments, communicate clearly, and navigate issues with confidence.
  • Explore how we can provide ongoing value throughout a tenancy, including renewals and longer stays.
  • Lead projects from early discovery through launch and iteration.
  • Use qualitative research, behavioural data, and experimentation to make decisions, not opinions.
  • Define success, measure impact, and continuously improve your solutions—connecting customer trust and satisfaction with adoption, retention, and business value.
  • Raise the quality bar across the design team through thoughtful critique and craft.
  • Contribute to our design principles, design system, and the way we build the product.

 

Your team

Collaborate deeply. Design with absolute purpose.

You'll work alongside Product, Engineering, Research, and Data as an equal partner to challenge assumptions, validate ideas, and turn ambiguity into a product that genuinely improves people's lives. You'll also collaborate closely with our operational teams to understand where the digital experience meets the realities of moving in and renting a home.

We move fast, we think ahead, and we focus on what our audience truly needs. You'll have the freedom to influence your team's strategy in an environment that values:

  • Elegant interaction design and meaningful micro-interactions
  • Clear design principles and consistent systems
  • Accessible experiences
  • Quality over shortcuts

Shipping fast matters. Shipping something we're proud of matters even more. If you thrive on autonomy and solving complex puzzles, we want to hear from you.

 

Your profile

  • At least 7+ years of experience designing complex digital products.
  • Proven experience designing native mobile apps for iOS and Android.
  • Strong product thinking and problem framing skills.
  • Excellent interaction and visual design craft.
  • Experience in marketplaces, search or discovery products.
  • Experience running discovery and validating ideas.
  • Confidence working with data, metrics and experiments.
  • Experience collaborating closely with engineers and product managers.
  • A portfolio showing not only what you designed – but why.

 

What's in it for you

  • Unlimited paid holidays, minimum-based not maximum!
  • Position based in our Rotterdam office with hybrid working policy (2 office days).
  • Flexibility to work remotely for up to 2 months per year!
  • 1,000 EUR personal development budget.
  • Complete coverage for commuting.
  • Personal equipment, including laptop and ergonomic setup.
  • Gym membership discount with GoVital or OneFit.
  • Dutch/English classes budget.
  • Variable pension scheme.
  • Diverse international community (46+ nationalities).
  • Pet-friendly office in Rotterdam city centre. 
  • Team-building events and after-work drinks every Friday.

6b1d64f95eb89516.title: Senior Product Designer - Listing & Finding experience
6b1d64f95eb89516.description:
We're on a mission to become the go-to destination for students across Europe to find a trusted home away from home. We make every step of the rental journey simple and seamless, so students can focus on what really matters: studying, exploring, and growing.

With HousingAnywhere, Kamernet, and Studapart under our roof, we're Europe's largest student rental platform. You'll find us in Rotterdam, Paris, and Cergy, always guided by our four core values: Ownership, We are enablers, We are changemakers, and We are connectors.

Your role

Help people find their next home with absolute certainty.

Moving to a new country is an adventure, but finding a home shouldn't be the hardest part. At HousingAnywhere, we're revolutionizing renting by building a platform that helps people confidently rent a home abroad.

Design isn't here to polish screens. It's here to shape the product. We are looking for a Senior Product Designer to own the Listing & Finding experience. You will define what discovering a home feels like: fast, relevant, trustworthy, and human.

As the design owner for one of the most important journeys in our marketplace, you will:

  • Shape the long-term vision for the search and discovery experience.
  • Lead projects from early discovery through launch and iteration.
  • Use qualitative research, behavioural data, and experimentation to make decisions, not opinions.
  • Define success, measure impact, and continuously improve your solutions.
  • Raise the quality bar across the design team through thoughtful critique and craft.
  • Contribute to our design principles, design system, and the way we build the product.

 

Your team

Collaborate deeply. Design with absolute purpose.

You'll work alongside Product, Engineering, Research, and Data as an equal partner to challenge assumptions, validate ideas, and turn ambiguity into a product that genuinely improves people's lives.

We move fast, we think ahead, and we focus on what our audience truly needs. You'll have the freedom to influence your team's strategy in an environment that values:

  • Elegant interaction design and meaningful micro-interactions
  • Clear design principles and consistent systems
  • Accessible experiences
  • Quality over shortcuts

Shipping fast matters. Shipping something we're proud of matters even more. If you thrive on autonomy and solving complex puzzles, we want to hear from you.

 

Your profile

  • At least 7+ years of experience designing complex digital products.
  • Strong product thinking and problem framing skills.
  • Excellent interaction and visual design craft.
  • Experience in marketplaces, search or discovery products.
  • Experience running discovery and validating ideas.
  • Confidence working with data, metrics and experiments.
  • Experience collaborating closely with engineers and product managers.
  • A portfolio showing not only what you designed – but why.

 

What's in it for you

  • Unlimited paid holidays, minimum-based not maximum!
  • Position based in our Rotterdam office with hybrid working policy (2 office days).
  • Flexibility to work remotely for up to 2 months per year!
  • 1,000 EUR personal development budget.
  • Complete coverage for commuting.
  • Personal equipment, including laptop and ergonomic setup.
  • Gym membership discount with GoVital or OneFit.
  • Dutch/English classes budget.
  • Variable pension scheme.
  • Diverse international community (46+ nationalities).
  • Pet-friendly office in Rotterdam city centre. 
  • Team-building events and after-work drinks every Friday.

44c56e99f9d077d3.title: Data Platform Manager
44c56e99f9d077d3.description:
About the role

As Data Platform Manager you will own Destinus's company data platform. Built on Microsoft Fabric, it brings together data from our different systems, and it serves the reporting and data agents that production, supply chain, program management, and finance work from every week.

You will own its architecture: how OneLake and our lakehouses are structured, how data lands in them from the systems we run, and how it holds up as more of the business comes to depend on it. You will lead a small team of data engineers — setting direction, reviewing their work, growing them — and you will keep building yourself. You are also the person who makes our AI ambitions possible: the foundation behind our data agents and our Company Brain is yours to design and deliver.

At Destinus we are redefining the future of aerospace manufacturing, building advanced Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs) across three European plants. The data you will work with is physical — parts, build progress, shortages, non-conformances — and the questions asked of it get harder each year as we grow. If you want a platform you can still shape rather than one already set in concrete, this is a good moment to arrive.

What You'll Do

  • Own the architecture of our Microsoft Fabric estate end to end — OneLake, our lakehouses and their bronze, silver, and gold layers, workspace and domain structure, naming conventions, and the standards that keep it coherent as it grows.
  • Lead, mentor, and grow a small team of data engineers: set priorities, review code, raise the technical bar, and develop the people.
  • Stay hands-on. You will build pipelines, notebooks, and Delta tables yourself, not only direct others who do.
  • Own the integrations that land data in OneLake from our source systems — ERP, HR, shopfloor, quality, and the business applications that come after them — choosing sensibly between Data Factory pipelines, dataflows, shortcuts, and mirroring for each source.
  • Own the gold layer and the semantic models built on it, so that Power BI reads from one governed source rather than from copies scattered around the business.
  • Work closely with our Business Operations & Data Specialists, who represent the business owners of each domain: turn their requirements into the right gold tables, agree definitions with them, and give them a platform they can query, validate, and explain to the business with confidence.
  • Own lineage across the estate: know what feeds what, be able to prove it to an auditor, and make dependencies visible rather than tribal knowledge.
  • Build the data foundation for our AI programme — the lakehouse structures, pipelines, and knowledge graph behind our Fabric data agents and our Company Brain — and deliver it to a standard that can be trusted with a real question.
  • Design and maintain the OneLake security and access model together with your team: workspace roles, access groups, and the controls that decide who sees what in the lake.
  • Keep the platform reliable, observable, and cost-aware: monitoring, alerting, recovery, and disciplined use of our Fabric capacity — including knowing what a runaway notebook costs us.

Requirements

What You’ll Need

Requirements

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Engineering, or a related field.
  • 5-8 years of data engineering experience, including real ownership of a lakehouse architecture rather than only delivering against someone else's.
  • Hands-on Microsoft Fabric experience is strongly preferred — OneLake, lakehouses, Delta tables, the SQL analytics endpoint, Data Factory pipelines, Spark notebooks, and semantic models in Direct Lake mode. If your depth is in Azure Synapse, Databricks, or Data Lake Storage Gen2 and you have since moved onto Fabric in earnest, we will take that seriously.
  • Strong command of the medallion pattern and of Delta Lake in practice: partitioning, schema evolution, table maintenance, and why a gold table behaves the way it does.
  • Genuinely hands-on. Strong SQL, solid PySpark, and comfort building and orchestrating pipelines yourself. This is not a role that stops at diagrams.
  • Practical understanding of Fabric capacity: how workloads consume it, how to spot what is burning it, and how to keep the platform inside its envelope.
  • Experience leading engineers — formally, or as a technical lead who set direction and mentored others. A first step into people management is welcome if the technical leadership is already there.
  • Proven integration experience with ERP systems such as Microsoft Dynamics 365 / MSD, as well as APIs, flat-file landings, and change data capture from operational databases.
  • Solid data modelling skills, including dimensional modelling and an understanding of how a semantic layer serves Power BI.
  • Working knowledge of lineage, data governance, and access control in a cloud platform; exposure to Microsoft Purview is a plus.
  • Interest or experience in the data foundations behind AI assistants — retrieval, knowledge graphs, and preparing data so that an agent can answer with it.
  • Aerospace or another regulated industry is an advantage; so is experience in a start-up or scale-up.
  • Fluent in English; additional European languages are a plus.

Who You Are

You are an architect who never stops building. You have strong opinions about how a platform should be structured, and you earn the right to them by being in the code. You would rather make a design decision explicit and documented than let it live in one person's head.

You care more about reliability than novelty. You know that the measure of a data platform is whether people trust the numbers that come out of it on a Monday morning, not how modern the stack looks on a slide. When something breaks, you want to know why it was possible, not just how to patch it.

You enjoy growing engineers, and you understand that leading a small team means doing the work alongside them. Above all, you want to build something durable — a foundation that holds while the company scales on top of it.

4581498e930e6ad2.title: Business Operations & Data Specialist (Production & Quality)
4581498e930e6ad2.description:
About the role

Behind every well-run plant is a shared understanding of how it is performing — and that understanding has to be built. As a Business Operations & Data Specialist focused on Production & Quality at Destinus, you are the bridge between the people who run our plants and the data that describes them. Plant managers, production leads, and quality engineers own the processes; our lakehouse holds the data those processes create. Your job is to connect the two, so that every production and quality figure, from the shopfloor to the leadership team, is defined by the business, built on the lakehouse, and trusted by both.

This is as much an operations role as a reporting one. You will translate what the business needs to know into what the data platform has to deliver, working with our Data Engineers on the production and quality data in the lakehouse and turning it into the reporting used across three European plants, including our Digital Shopfloor Management Solution, relied on by more than 300 people. You will also go to where the data is created and make it better there — improving how it is captured, automating what is still manual, and helping three plants work to one standard.

At Destinus, we are redefining the future of aerospace manufacturing — bringing speed, precision, and innovation to every process that powers our advanced Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs). Our operations span multiple plants and teams, and your work will directly support the reliability, efficiency, and excellence required for mission-critical production. Join us in shaping the next era of aerospace operations.

What You'll do

  • Be the go-to contact between the business owners of production and quality data — plant managers, production leads, and quality engineers — and our lakehouse: turn their questions into clear data requirements, and the data back into answers they can act on.
  • Own the production and quality portfolio end to end: define the KPI, improve the process behind it, build the dashboard, and stand behind the number.
  • Own the production and quality domain in our lakehouse: know which tables and fields hold what, where each comes from, and who owns it at source — and keep that knowledge documented rather than in your head.
  • Partner with our Data Engineers on the curated (gold) layer for production and quality: specify the tables, fields, and business rules the business needs, and validate the result against what actually happens on the shopfloor before anyone relies on it.
  • Set and monitor data quality checks for your domain, and route each issue to the right owner — the person entering the data, the system configuration, or the pipeline — until it is fixed.
  • Maintain and continuously improve Power BI dashboards tracking production and quality performance across all three plants, built on certified lakehouse data rather than side spreadsheets.
  • Describe production and quality data in plain business language — what each field means, who owns it, and how sensitive it is — for our shared meanings layer, so that colleagues and our AI assistants can use it correctly without having to ask you first.
  • Automate what is manual today: recurring reports, data collection, and the preparation behind daily and weekly performance routines.
  • Support the standardisation of ways of working across the three plants, partnering with our Lean Operations Specialist so that measurement and improvement pull in the same direction.

Requirements

What You’ll Need

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Industrial Engineering, Manufacturing, Operations, Quality Management, or a related field.
  • Experience in a production or quality environment; aerospace or another regulated industry is highly preferred.
  • Solid understanding of manufacturing and quality metrics — throughput, cycle time, OEE, scrap and rework, first-pass yield — and of quality processes such as non-conformance handling, customer complaints and field returns, root cause analysis, and corrective actions.
  • Strong expertise in Power BI (data modeling, DAX, dashboard design, troubleshooting), complemented by advanced Excel skills.
  • Comfortable querying data with SQL and working in a lakehouse or data warehouse environment; experience with Microsoft Fabric or a medallion (bronze/silver/gold) architecture is a plus. You will not build the pipelines — you need to know what to ask for and how to check what comes back.
  • Able to explain data to non-technical colleagues and business needs to technical ones — and to get both sides to agree on one definition.
  • Knowledge of ERP systems such as Microsoft Dynamics 365 / MSD, and familiarity with shopfloor or MES systems.
  • A track record of improving or automating a process, not only reporting on it. Exposure to continuous improvement methods is a plus.
  • Comfortable working across multiple sites and collaborating with production teams, quality engineers, and leadership alike.
  • Fluent in English; Spanish, German or Dutch is a strong plus given our plant locations.
  • Experience in a start-up or scale-up environment is preferred.

Who You Are

You are equally comfortable on a shopfloor and in a data model, and you speak both languages — the plant's and the lakehouse's. You know that the fastest way to fix a reporting problem is often to walk to the place where the data is created and ask how it gets entered — and then change it.

You are structured and persistent, because aligning three plants on one way of working takes more than a good spreadsheet; it takes patience and conversations. You enjoy the detail of a root cause but stay focused on whether performance actually improved, and when something is manual or repetitive you would rather automate it than live with it.

You turn numbers into stories, stories into priorities, and priorities into measurable change. Above all, you take ownership, challenge assumptions, and stay committed to operational excellence.

d2681c3f55465d7d.title: Business Operations & Data Specialist (Finance)
d2681c3f55465d7d.description:
About the role

Every number that reaches our leadership team, our board, and our auditors has to be right the first time — and that is where you come in. As a Business Operations & Data Specialist focused on Finance at Destinus, you are the bridge between the owners of our financial data, the CFO, and the wider finance team and the data in our lakehouse. You own how finance data is defined, where it comes from, how it is produced, and how it reaches the people who make decisions with it.

This is as much an operations role as a reporting one. You will translate what finance needs to know into what the data platform has to deliver, working with our Data Engineers on the finance data in the lakehouse and building the dashboards the CFO and the finance team rely on. You will also improve the processes and systems that create the numbers in the first place, automate the manual work that eats the month, and make our finance data understandable to everyone who needs it, including our AI assistants.

At Destinus, we are redefining the future of aerospace manufacturing — bringing speed, precision, and innovation to every process that powers our advanced Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs). We are a fast-growing international group operating across several European entities, and the standards we hold our financial data to are rising just as quickly. Join us in building a finance reporting foundation that is accurate, traceable, and ready for any question asked of it.

What You'll Do

  • Be the go-to contact between the business owners of finance data — the CFO, accounts payable and receivable, and treasury — and our lakehouse: turn their questions into clear data requirements, and the data back into answers they can act on.
  • Build and maintain Power BI dashboards covering cash flow, receipts and collections, payables, and spend across the group, built on certified lakehouse data.
  • Partner with our Data Engineers on the curated (gold) layer for finance: specify the tables, fields, and business rules — entities, currencies, financial dimensions, intercompany — and validate the result against the ledger before anyone relies on it.
  • Prepare and quality-check entity-level data extractions from our lakehouse and ERP in support of the external audit, and keep audit requests tracked from request to delivery.
  • Define and document finance KPI definitions in our KPI catalog — formulas, inclusions, exclusions, owners, and sources — to a standard that withstands external review.
  • Describe our finance data in plain business language — what each field means, who owns it, and how sensitive it is — for our shared meanings layer, so that colleagues and our AI assistants can use it correctly without having to ask you first.
  • Automate what is manual today: turn recurring spreadsheet work, audit packs, and month-end routines into repeatable processes that largely run themselves.
  • Improve the finance processes and system configuration that create the data, working with the finance team and our ERP specialists, so that issues are fixed at source rather than corrected every month.
  • Help the finance team get more from the tools through training and self-service, so they can answer their own questions.

Requirements

What You’ll Need

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Finance, Accounting, Controlling, Economics, or a related field.
  • A genuine finance background is essential — experience in external or internal audit, controlling, financial reporting, or FP&A. This is not a data role with finance on the side; you need to understand the accounting behind the figures.
  • Confident with general ledger and subledger structures, trial balances, accounts payable and accounts receivable, bank reconciliations, intercompany transactions, and the principles of IFRS.
  • Strong expertise in Power BI (data modeling, DAX, dashboard design, troubleshooting), complemented by advanced Excel skills.
  • Comfortable querying data with SQL and working in a lakehouse or data warehouse environment; experience with Microsoft Fabric or a medallion (bronze/silver/gold) architecture is a plus. You will not build the pipelines — you need to know what to ask for and how to check what comes back.
  • Able to explain data to finance colleagues and accounting logic to technical ones — and to get both sides to agree on one definition.
  • Hands-on experience with Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance is a strong advantage — the general ledger, accounts payable and accounts receivable modules, and the data structures underneath them. We run on D365, and someone who already knows it will be effective months earlier. An interest in improving how the system is configured and used matters as much as knowing where to click.
  • A track record of simplifying or automating a process, not only reporting on it.
  • Experience supporting an external audit, or working in a multi-entity, multi-currency international group, is a strong advantage.
  • Fluent in English; additional European languages are a plus.
  • Experience in a start-up or scale-up environment is preferred.

Who You Are

You are precise, and you are curious about where a number came from before you are comfortable reporting it — whether that means reading the ledger or querying the lakehouse. You know the difference between a figure that looks right and a figure that can be traced back to its source, and you care about the second one.

You are not content to rebuild the same report every month. When something is manual, repetitive, or fragile, your instinct is to go upstream and fix it rather than absorb it. You enjoy working with finance colleagues who ask hard questions, and you would rather be challenged on a detail than have it slip through.

Above all, you want your work to be relied on, by the CFO, by the board, and by anyone who audits it.

23c2646e0d8d01fd.title: GTM Financial Services Director
23c2646e0d8d01fd.description:
GTM Director
We're looking for a commercially driven Go-To-Market leader to own how Treatwell takes its Financial Services products to market across Europe. Working closely with our sales teams and leaders, and with Product, you'll turn our roadmap into revenue, with a particular focus on growing our financial services product line. 

At Treatwell we don't just sell software: we help Europe's best salons and spas digitalise their business, grow their revenue and improve the experience they offer their clients.

You'll be the strategic owner of go-to-market for Treatwell across Europe. With a strong commercial mindset and a highly collaborative approach, you'll define how we position, price, package and launch our products, and partner with Sales to turn them into real, measurable revenue.

You will be responsible for:

  • Commercial go-to-market strategy: Own and lead Treatwell's European go-to-market strategy for its new suite of Financial Services products, defining target segments, positioning, pricing, packaging and commercial priorities, with a clear focus on revenue growth.
  • Financial services revenue: Own and lead projects that drive revenue for the financial services product line, from payments to new financial solutions, setting clear targets and taking accountability for results.
  • Sales partnership: Work closely with our sales teams and sales leaders across markets to shape commercial plans and targets, and turn go-to-market strategy into pipeline, deals and revenue.
  • Sales enablement & playbooks: Build scalable playbooks, pricing guidance, sales narratives and training that help local market teams sell our products and drive adoption on the ground.
  • Product launches: Partner with Product to bring new products and features to market, from validation and pilots through to full European rollout, bringing the commercial and customer perspective into the roadmap.
  • Product-led growth: Alongside our sales teams, build in-app and self-serve sales motions that help adoption and revenue scale efficiently.
  • Cross-functional leadership: Partner with Product, Supply, Finance, Operations, Legal and local market teams to embed payments into acquisition, onboarding, account management and retention.
  • Strategy into execution: Translate strategy into clear execution plans with owners, timelines and KPIs, proactively removing blockers and driving accountability across teams that don't report directly into the role.
  • Commercial performance & optimisation: Track and drive adoption, revenue and margin across markets, using data and customer insight to optimise pricing, packaging and the sales funnel.
  • Stripe partnership: Manage Treatwell's strategic partnership with Stripe, acting as the senior commercial point of contact and aligning joint go-to-market plans and growth priorities.

About you

  • Proven experience in go-to-market, commercial strategy or sales strategy roles within a fast-growing digital or tech company (marketplaces, SaaS, delivery, fintech or similar)
  • Strong commercial focus, with a track record of owning revenue targets and driving measurable growth
  • Multi-market experience is a must: you've worked closely with sales teams and sales leadership across multiple markets
  • Experience leading commercial strategy across multiple markets, ideally in a central or group-level role
  • Strong analytical skills and confidence building business cases, commercial models and senior leadership updates
  • Excellent stakeholder management and the ability to influence and drive accountability without direct authority
  • Exposure to payments, fintech or embedded finance products is a plus

About Treatwell

We're a team of 800+ people working every day to transform the beauty industry across Europe. We've built the leading salon management software, connected to Europe's number one marketplace, helping thousands of professionals run and grow their business.

The numbers speak for themselves:

  • Over 95,000 partner salons
  • Present in 14 countries
  • More than 23.5 million bookings every year

And the best is yet to come. If you want to join an international, innovative and fast-growing company where your work has a real, visible impact... join us!

We’ll treat you with:

💰Compensation: A competitive base salary and bonus package.

🌍Location & flexibility: Based in London, Milan or Amsterdam, working closely with teams across all our European markets.

💻Work tools: All the tools and technology you need to do your best work.

🚀Impact: A rare opportunity to build and own a new growth engine for Treatwell from the ground up.

Salary: €90K – €140K (depending on experience)

Equal opportunities

At Treatwell we're committed every day to creating and maintaining an inclusive workplace, built on mutual respect and valuing everyone's uniqueness. We offer equal opportunities to all our candidates and employees, without any form of discrimination.
