3aca150c344e5621.title: Programmatic Advertising Specialist - BENELUX
3aca150c344e5621.description:
Programmatic Advertising Specialist (Dutch Speaking)

Publisher Success | Amsterdam, Netherlands (Onsite) | Full Time | Permanent

About Refinery89



Refinery89 is a Dutch AdTech company headquartered in Madrid, working with premium publishers worldwide to optimize programmatic advertising performance.

Through advanced, data-driven technology, we help publishers maximize advertising revenue, improve monetization efficiency, and gain greater transparency across their advertising operations.

Our international team brings together specialists in programmatic advertising, publisher monetization, technology, and account management to deliver measurable results for our partners.

About the Role



Are you currently working in Programmatic Advertising, Ad Operations, Campaign Management, or Publisher Monetization and looking to take the next step in your career?

We're looking for a Dutch-speaking Programmatic Advertising Specialist to join our Publisher Success team in Amsterdam.

This opportunity is ideal for someone with a solid understanding of digital advertising who wants to move beyond campaign execution and take on a more strategic, publisher-facing role.

You don't need previous Account Management experience. We're particularly interested in candidates who understand the programmatic advertising ecosystem, enjoy analyzing performance, solving technical challenges, and communicating with clients.

You'll work directly with Dutch publishers, helping them optimize their advertising performance, maximize revenue, and develop long-term partnerships with Refinery89.

You'll collaborate closely with our Technical Account Managers, AdTech specialists, Product, and Sales teams to deliver the best possible experience for our publishing partners.

Key Responsibilities



Publisher Relationship Management

  • Build and maintain strong relationships with publishers in the Netherlands.
  • Serve as a primary point of contact for publisher inquiries, performance discussions, and ongoing support.
  • Develop a deep understanding of each publisher's business needs and monetization objectives.
  • Build trust through proactive communication, responsiveness, and problem-solving.


Programmatic Performance & Revenue Optimization

  • Monitor and analyze advertising performance, including revenue, eCPM, fill rates, and other relevant programmatic metrics.
  • Identify opportunities to improve publisher monetization and overall advertising performance.
  • Translate advertising data into clear insights and actionable recommendations.
  • Collaborate with technical specialists to implement and evaluate optimization initiatives.


Technical Coordination & Troubleshooting

  • Help publishers identify and resolve advertising-related issues.
  • Work closely with internal AdTech and Technical Account Management teams to investigate technical challenges.
  • Coordinate solutions and ensure publishers receive timely updates.
  • Develop a strong understanding of Refinery89's advertising technology and monetization solutions.


Strategic Growth & Publisher Success

  • Identify opportunities to grow existing publisher accounts.
  • Support publisher performance reviews and strategic discussions.
  • Share insights about market trends, advertising technologies, and monetization opportunities.
  • Contribute to long-term publisher satisfaction, retention, and growth.


Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Work closely with Publisher Sales, Technical Account Managers, AdTech, Product, and Finance teams.
  • Communicate publisher feedback and market insights internally.
  • Help improve processes, workflows, and the overall publisher experience.


What We're Looking For



Must-Have Qualifications

  • Native-level Dutch proficiency, with professional working proficiency in English.
  • 1 to 3 years of experience in programmatic advertising, AdTech, digital advertising, campaign management, or publisher operations.
  • Familiarity with the programmatic advertising ecosystem, including technologies such as Google Ad Manager, SSPs, DSPs, or ad exchanges.
  • Comfortable working with advertising performance data, reports, and dashboards.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent communication skills and the ability to explain technical concepts clearly.
  • Proactive, organized, and comfortable working in a fast-paced environment.
  • Interest in working directly with publishers and developing long-term business relationships.


Nice to Have

  • Experience with Google Ad Manager or other advertising platforms.
  • Knowledge of header bidding, Prebid.js, or publisher monetization strategies.
  • Previous experience working with publishers, media owners, or advertising technology companies.
  • Experience in campaign optimization, yield management, or programmatic trading.
  • Previous client-facing or Account Management experience.


Previous Account Management experience is NOT required.

Who Should Apply?



We encourage applications from professionals currently working in roles such as:

  • Programmatic Advertising Specialist
  • Programmatic Trader
  • Ad Operations Specialist
  • Campaign Manager (Programmatic)
  • Publisher Operations Specialist
  • Yield Optimization Specialist
  • Digital Advertising Specialist
  • Technical Account Specialist (AdTech)


If you have a technical understanding of digital advertising and want to develop your career in publisher relationship management, we'd love to hear from you.

Why Join Refinery89?

  • Work at a growing international AdTech company with Dutch roots.
  • Develop expertise in publisher monetization and programmatic advertising.
  • Transition into a more strategic, client-facing position while building on your existing technical knowledge.
  • Collaborate with experienced AdTech professionals across multiple departments.
  • Gain exposure to premium publishers and advanced advertising technologies.
  • Build your career in a dynamic and rapidly evolving industry.


Interview Process



Our recruitment process consists of four stages:

  1. Initial Screening: Introductory call with our Talent Acquisition team.
  2. First Interview: Video interview with members of the Publisher Success team.
  3. Second Interview: Interview with the Hiring Manager and/or senior stakeholders.
  4. Final Interview: In-person meeting with the Hiring Manager and key team members (location to be confirmed).


Ready to Take the Next Step?



Whether you're currently managing advertising campaigns, optimizing programmatic performance, or supporting publisher monetization, this could be your opportunity to take on greater responsibility and develop your career in AdTech.

Apply today and join Refinery89's Publisher Success team in Amsterdam.

54cf785ba3446661.title: Campaign Analyst
54cf785ba3446661.description:
Onze missie is helder: beter eten voor meer mensen bereikbaar maken. Als Campaign Analyst in het Customer Retention team speel je hierin een cruciale rol door onze klanten beter vast te houden. Jij zorgt ervoor dat we al onze verhalen, over al onze producten, op de juiste manier aan de juiste klant vertellen. Je bent continu, datagedreven op zoek naar verbetering; zodat we het volgende verhaal nóg beter vertellen.

Wat je gaat doen

Onze retentiestrategie wordt steeds geavanceerder. We sturen niet simpelweg 'een korting' naar alle klanten maar werken met gelaagde acties, inspirerende verhalen en gepersonaliseerde extra’s.

Enerzijds ben jij de analytische drijfkracht achter de executie van onze campagnes. Je bouwt, beheert en verbetert de analytische tooling en dashboards zodat we kunnen blijven leren. Daarmee creëer je begrip van - en grip op - de commerciële impact van campagnes, en alle onderliggende onderdelen (zoals kanaalstrategie, product-samenstelling of klantdoelgroep). Vervolgens vertaal je de verworven inzichten effectief naar succesfactoren, verbeteringstrajecten en/of toekomstige experimenten. Anderzijds werk je inhoudelijk mee. Je bepaalt samen met de Campaign Specialist welk aanbod naar welke klanten gaat, via welk kanaal en met welke verwachting en zet je ook (nieuwe) acties zelf op.

Een aantal van jouw verantwoordelijkheden:

  • Je bent verantwoordelijk voor de performance van campagnes. Je analyseert de impact, en je gebruikt inzichten om toekomstige campagnes te verbeteren, zodat we kunnen blijven innoveren in onze retentiestrategie.

  • Je werkt actief mee met het team: je levert niet alleen de inzichten, maar bent ook zelf verantwoordelijk voor de implementatie van campagnes.

  • Je bepaalt en draait de experimentagenda: welke hypotheses testen we over aanbod, doelgroep en kanaal, en wat leren we ervan?

  • Je bouwt, onderhoudt en verbetert zelf de datamodellen (SQL/dbt) en dashboards (Data Studio) waarop het team stuurt.

Dit ben jij

  • Je hebt een afgeronde WO of HBO-opleiding op zak.

  • Je hebt 2-5 jaar ervaring met marketing (intelligence) en data/business analytics.

  • Je spreekt en schrijft vloeiend Nederlands.

  • Je bent analytisch sterk en je werkt datagedreven en gestructureerd. Je kunt vloeiend SQL, hebt ervaring met het maken van dashboards en datamodellen en je gebruikt graag AI-tools om je werk efficiënter te maken. Ervaring met dbt is een pré.

  • Je hebt ervaring met A/B-tests, holdout-tests en hypothese gedreven werken.

  • Je hebt commercieel gevoel: je denkt net zo graag mee over het aanbod als over de cijfers erachter.

  • Je bent een sterke sparringpartner: je daagt collega’s uit met data en laat je zelf ook uitdagen.

  • Je bent kritisch, hands-on en niet bang om de status quo uit te dagen.

Wat wij bieden

  • Werken bij een B Corp gecertificeerd bedrijf, waarbij je de kans krijgt om je stempel te drukken op het Europese voedselsysteem.

  • 27 vakantiedagen om bij te komen en op te laden.

  • Een extra vrije dag per jaar om je in te zetten voor vrijwilligerswerk en iets goeds te doen.

  • Aandacht voor je mentale gezondheid met online begeleiding van erkende psychologen via OpenUp.

  • Voor straks een perfect pensioen via BPFL.

  • Elke maand food for thought, met workshops en talks via de Crisp University.

  • Regelmatig tastings of workshops op kantoor of bij een van onze leveranciers, om te zien hoe onze lekkerste producten worden gemaakt – en natuurlijk ook te proeven.

  • Dagelijks een uitgebreide, georganiseerde lunch op kantoor.

  • Enthousiaste, slimme collega’s en tijd om elkaar te leren kennen tijdens sport, events en proeverijen.

  • En... fikse korting op je Crisp boodschappen, omdat je thuis natuurlijk ook goed wilt eten.

Onze selectieprocedure

Solliciteer via onderstaande button. Hoe meer je kunt delen over jezelf en de reden dat je solliciteert, hoe beter.

Bij Crisp streven we naar een inclusieve en diverse werkomgeving waarin iedereen welkom is, ongeacht hun achtergrond, geslacht, leeftijd, etniciteit, seksuele geaardheid, religie of beperking. Wij moedigen sollicitanten met diverse perspectieven en achtergronden aan om te solliciteren en geloven in gelijke kansen voor iedereen. We waarderen de unieke bijdragen die elke medewerker kan leveren en zijn vastbesloten om een inclusieve werkplek te creëren waarin iedereen wordt gerespecteerd en gewaardeerd.

e0f40a1035beb60f.title: Enterprise Account Executive
e0f40a1035beb60f.description:
At Deeploy, we help organisations roll out AI they can trust. Banks, insurers and pharma companies have to show they control their AI use, and most don’t yet have the tooling to do so. Deeploy gives them that control. We work with dozens of enterprise customers in finance, insurance and healthcare.

You’ll own deals from first outreach to signed contract, with a focus on the Netherlands and Northwest Europe. Most of our buyers have never bought AI governance before, so much of the work is helping them define the problem and build the internal case. You report to the COO, and the founders stay involved in deals.

What you’ll do

  • Deals: run enterprise deals from qualification to close. Deals typically take 6 to 12 months and involve risk, compliance, legal, IT and a business sponsor. The GRC (governance, risk and compliance) function is often the way in.

  • Pipeline: build a large part of your own pipeline through outbound, your network, our partners and events. Marketing runs campaigns with you.

  • Visibility: speak at events and roundtables for risk, compliance and AI governance audiences.

  • Feedback: bring back what buyers respond to, how they compare us with alternatives, and what they miss in the product.

  • Process: help set up how we qualify, forecast and run deals, and later how we onboard new sellers. We’re a small team that works with AI daily, so you’ll also build some of your own tools and agents.

After 12 months

  • You’ve closed at least 4 new enterprise accounts and built €1m+ of qualified pipeline.

  • AI Governance officers know Deeploy, and know you.

  • You have proven to yourself as part of our team, culture and processes.

Who we’re looking for

  • You’ve closed complex enterprise deals with long cycles and several stakeholders, ideally in financial services, insurance, pharma or life sciences.

  • You know how risk, compliance or IT buyers think, from selling GRC, security, data or AI software, or from working on the buyer side.

  • You have a network among these buyers in the Netherlands or elsewhere in Northwest Europe.

  • You can discuss the EU AI Act and how AI systems are built and monitored with some confidence. You don’t need to be an engineer.

  • You’ve worked at an early-stage company or founded one, and you’re comfortable building pipeline from scratch.

  • Fluent English. Dutch or German is a strong plus.

What the role is, and what it is not

It is a builder role. Deal ownership comes first, commercial process a close second.

It is not a lead-execution seat, and you don’t carry the number alone. The founders stay close to deals and are responsible for the commercial function.

What we offer

  • Competitive base and bonus

  • Share plan from day 1

  • Pension plan and other benefits

  • Hybrid working from The Stack in Amsterdam, home to around 40 AI startups

  • The chance to be part of an early stage startup, building the sales function and grow with it

Hiring process

  1. Application: your CV or LinkedIn, and something you’ve worked on that you’re proud of

  2. Introductory call (30 minutes)

  3. Conversation with two people you’d work with closely (60 minutes)

  4. Case study (3 hours, timeboxed), presented to two team members

  5. Offer

a43906547f01e394.title: Senior Customer Success Manager - Dutch-speaking
a43906547f01e394.description:
About the Role 🎯

As a Senior Customer Success Manager at DataSnipper, you will play a pivotal role in ensuring our customers achieve their goals using our innovative, AI-powered solutions. You will own the customer journey, from onboarding to driving long-term value and retention, fostering strong relationships built on trust and collaboration. You’ll help customers unlock their potential value while contributing to the growth and success of our business.

This role offers a unique opportunity to work closely with professionals who are the backbone of global capital markets, deliver exceptional service, and build a thriving community for our customers. If you’re passionate about customer success and ready to own the moment, we’d love to hear from you!

 
 

About DataSnipper

We believe trust is essential to how society works. Every day, we rely on information that's been independently verified, from financial statements to the products we buy, to the sustainability claims companies make. Behind that trust are audit and finance professionals who examine evidence, verify information and hold organizations accountable.

At DataSnipper, we build AI solutions that empower those professionals to make those judgements. With Alwin by DataSnipper, our new agentic platform, AI agents now take on end-to-end audit and finance procedures, while every conclusion stays traceable to its source. That frees professionals to focus on the judgment and expertise that make their work so important.

We're trusted by Fortune 500 companies, government agencies and all Big Four audit firms. Today, more than 600,000 professionals across 3,000+ organizations in 175 countries rely on our platform, and in 2025 alone DataSnipper delivered more than $1.4 billion in productivity savings to its customers.

Backed by a $100 million Series B led by Index Ventures, at a $1 billion valuation, we've built a strong foundation for what's next. And as proud members of 1% for the Planet, we care about how we grow, not just how fast.

For our Customer Success teams, this is where things get exciting.

Alwin has just launched, demand is growing, and we're expanding into new markets and segments. With a product customers already rely on, there's a huge opportunity to make your mark.

 

What You Will Do

 

  • Act as a Trusted Advisor: Serve as a strategic partner to key stakeholders including Audit Partners and Managers, Controllers, Finance Directors, and IT decision-makers, guiding them through business transformation enabled by DataSnipper.

  • Drive Business Transformation: Help customers reimagine their workflows and processes, demonstrating how DataSnipper’s AI-powered capabilities can deliver measurable efficiency gains, cost savings, and quality improvements across audit and finance functions.

  • Deliver Strategic Consultative Solutions: Provide expert guidance tailored to each customer’s unique business challenges, helping them optimise audit and finance workflows and achieve their strategic objectives using DataSnipper.

  • Champion Product Adoption and Value Realisation: Conduct comprehensive training sessions, establish regular Business Reviews, and develop success plans that ensure customers adopt DataSnipper features and realise maximum business value.

  • Build Deep Customer Relationships: Cultivate strong, long-term partnerships built on trust, deep industry understanding, and a genuine commitment to your customers’ success and business outcomes.

  • Collaborate Cross-Functionally: Partner with Product, Engineering, Sales, and Solutions Engineering teams, sharing customer insights on workflow challenges, use cases, and technical requirements to drive product innovation.

  • Advocate for Customer Success: Deeply understand your customers’ audit methodologies, compliance requirements, and business goals, providing feedback internally to ensure DataSnipper addresses real-world needs.

  • Support Strategic Growth: Identify and drive expansion opportunities within your portfolio, working with Sales to demonstrate ROI, facilitate pilots, and expand adoption across teams and service lines.

  • Ensure Seamless Technical Implementation & Platform Expertise: Partner with customers on onboarding, including setup, AI configuration, and workflow customisation, while staying current on DataSnipper’s platform, AI capabilities, and automation best practices.

  • Lead Strategic Engagements: Plan and facilitate in-person and virtual sessions with audit and finance teams to drive adoption, share transformation best practices, and address challenges that could impact retention.

  • Develop Comprehensive Success Plans: Create strategic roadmaps for each customer, outlining transformation goals, adoption milestones, expansion opportunities, engagement tactics, and success metrics.

  • Monitor Health and Business Impact: Track and forecast key metrics including user engagement, feature utilisation, business value delivered, expansion opportunities, retention risks, and technical health indicators.

     

What You Bring

 

  • Customer Success Experience: 5+ years of experience in Customer Success, Account Management, Solutions Consulting, or another client-service role in B2B SaaS, with a strong grasp of the customer success motion (onboarding, adoption, renewals, and expansion).

  • Trusted Advisor Mindset: Passion for being a strategic partner to customers, building deep trust-based relationships, and driving business transformation that delivers exceptional value.

  • Business Transformation Focus: Proven ability to help customers reimagine processes and workflows, demonstrating how technology can drive measurable business outcomes.

  • Accountability and Ownership: Strong sense of ownership and the drive to master your craft, take initiative, and ensure no detail is overlooked.

  • Collaborative Spirit: Thrives in cross-functional teamwork and builds meaningful partnerships with customers and internal stakeholders.

  • Adaptability and Growth Mindset: Learns quickly and thrives in a dynamic, fast-paced environment where customer needs and priorities evolve.

  • Excellence in Communication: Professional fluency in English and Dutch is a must

  • Audit Background: Hands-on experience in external or internal audit, or assurance is nice to have

     

What we offer

 

  • Be part of one of the fastest-growing, profitable unicorn scale-ups in the Netherlands with a global impact.

  • Equity (Stock Appreciation Rights) to share in the company’s success and growth.

  • Pension plan with a 6% contribution on top of your base salary.

  • 28 vacation days per year (full-time) to support your work-life balance.

  • Hybrid work model with at least 3 days onsite in our dynamic Amsterdam office.

  • Daily, freshly prepared lunches to keep you energised.

  • NS business card for easy commuting to the office.

  • A structured onboarding programme designed to set you up for success, including dedicated time to learn our product and customers before you hit the ground running.

  • Access to continuous learning and development initiatives to grow your skills.

  • Engage with a vibrant international team spread across seven global offices.

  • Company-wide events like DataSnipper GO, where global teams come together.

  • Access to Nilo, a mental health and wellness platform supporting your wellbeing.

     

Recruitment Process

  1. Recruiter Screen (30 minutes, online)

  2. Hiring Manager Interview (30 minutes, online)

  3. Assessment Interview (1 hour, on-site)

  4. Final Interview (30 minutes, online)

     

At DataSnipper, we believe great ideas come from different perspectives, experiences, and backgrounds. We are committed to building an inclusive workplace and providing every candidate with a fair and equitable hiring experience.

Our hiring decisions are merit based and grounded in the skills, experience, potential, and capabilities relevant to the role.

We welcome applicants regardless of age, race, ethnicity, nationality, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, disability, or any other characteristic that makes you, you.

What matters to us is what you can bring to the role, the team, and DataSnipper

c7a9048e5f7b3d98.title: Quantum Processor Development Lead
c7a9048e5f7b3d98.description:
About Us

QuantWare is building the world’s most powerful quantum processors to solve humanity's greatest challenges. We do this with our unique VIO™ technology, the only QPU architecture that breaks the hardware barriers that have held quantum computing back, unlocking the path to MegaQubit quantum processors.

With VIO, we are paving the way for the hyper-scale quantum computers that will change the world. And delivering on that vision demands people who don’t shy away from tackling the hardest challenges of our time. That’s where you come in!

As a Quantum Processor Development Lead you own people management and project leadership for our quantum processor developement. You rapidly grow the team by recruiting key members, while maintaining a high level of care and support for the team members. You report to the VP of Product and work closely with them to shape the team that defines the direction of key technical development at QuantWare. You will work with some of the smartest and most passionate people in the field, helping us build the world's most powerful quantum processors, as fast as possible.

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Own and drive processor development

    • Manage development work - particularly chip design and cryogenic measurement.

    • Run smaller, self-contained projects within your team - supporting both department and company-wide initiatives.

    • Partner with assigned Program Managers on larger, cross-department programs, particularly regarding technical execution and requirements compliance of QPUs.

  • Manage uncertainty and technical risk

    • Identify technical risks and bottlenecks early

    • Plan for potential failure modes and contingencies

    • Adapt experimental strategies dynamically based on new information

  • Develop engineering practices within the team

    • Develop a deep technical understanding of quantum processor technology to guide sound, well-informed decisions.

    • Implement strong and lean technical processes that support sound decision making processes. For example: requirements flowdown, trade studies, root cause corrective action methods, etc.

  • Support growth and development of the team

    • Contribute to defining role profiles and act as hiring manager for new roles across the programme.

    • Mentor engineers and project leads in programme execution and collaborative leadership.

    • Manage the engineers in your technology area: hire, coach, review performance, and grow careers.

Your Profile

  • Technical background

    • MSc, PhD, or equivalent experience in physics, electrical engineering, microwave/RF engineering, semiconductor technology, or a related field.

    • Understanding of the development lifecycle for chip-level technologies; experience with superconducting qubits or cryogenic systems is a strong plus.

  • Leadership experience

    • 4+ years delivering complex, research-intensive chip hardware projects in a project management capacity.

    • Show people-management experience: hiring, coaching, and performance management.

    • Lead projects as part of a larger program, with control over one’s own domain.

    • Run smaller projects directly, without needing dedicated program-management support.

    • Proven ability to work with highly specialised technical experts.

    • Experience working in a fast-moving start-up or scale-up environment balancing hands-on technical leadership with growing a team, as a strong plus.

  • Approach

    • Translate a long-term technical strategy into an execution plan for your team.

    • Strong analytical skills with the ability to make pragmatic, informed decisions under uncertainty.

    • Draw a clear line between technical leadership and program management, and partner with Program Managers instead of duplicating their function.

  • Communication

    • Excellent communicator who can motivate teams, facilitate alignment, adept at communicating technical ideas.

    • Communicate fluently in English.

Don't tick every box? Apply anyway! Research shows women often self-select out if they don't meet every requirement. Here's our take: nobody ticks every box. This is a description of our ideal candidate, not a filter. If most resonates and you're keen to learn the gaps, apply. We hire for trajectory, not perfection.

What We Offer:

At QuantWare, you’ll be part of a high-performing team of world-class experts in an ambitious, fast-moving environment. From day one, you’ll have the trust, tools, and support to do your best work. Here’s what you can expect:

Competitive salary - A salary that reflects the impact and importance of the role (and of course 8% holiday allowance)

Pension that’s built to last - A generous and future-proof pension plan that includes partner and dependent coverage.

Flexibility built on trust - We focus on outcomes. Work flexibly, in a hybrid setup, with an open vacation policy that lets you manage your time

Personal growth - We invest in your L&D, with a budget available to each team member, dependent on their individual ambitions, development needs, and performance

A connected team - We make space to celebrate wins together, with team events, offsites, and spontaneous moments that bring us closer

Diversity & Inclusion at QuantWare

We’re an ambitious company, not only for our goals but also to become an even more diverse and inclusive team. We know great candidates don't always follow a straight path, and we value diverse experience, perspectives, and ways of thinking. We know this helps us make better decisions, drives more innovation, and strengthens our culture.

As part of our recruitment process, candidates may be required to undergo pre-employment screening.

1c1ae912a0a09cfd.title: Model-Based Systems Engineer
1c1ae912a0a09cfd.description:
About Us

QuantWare is building the world’s most powerful quantum processors to solve humanity's greatest challenges. We do this with our unique VIO™ technology, the only QPU architecture that breaks the hardware barriers that have held quantum computing back, unlocking the path to MegaQubit quantum processors.

With VIO, we are paving the way for the hyper-scale quantum computers that will change the world. And delivering on that vision demands people who don’t shy away from tackling the hardest challenges of our time. That’s where you come in!

Our Systems Integration Team is seeking a Model-Based Systems Engineer to build the tools and framework we use to design the systems that operate our VIO and QPU technology. This role is focused on establishing QuantWare’s MBSE methodology and turning knowledge from cryogenics, wiring, control electronics and software into a single, executable system model. You will define how we model our systems and build the libraries, analyses and integrations that make the model useful day to day. Working closely with processor, hardware and software teams, you will play an important role in enabling the design of the large-scale quantum computers built around VIO-powered QPUs.

What are you going to do?

  • Define and own QuantWare’s MBSE methodology, modelling conventions and architecture framework for quantum computing systems, covering the quantum processor, cryostat, signal chain, control and readout electronics, and software stack.

  • Select, set up and maintain the MBSE toolchain (e.g. SysML v2, Capella or Cameo), including version control, model reviews and integration with existing engineering tools.

  • Build reusable model libraries for key subsystems, including QPU interfaces, cryogenic wiring and attenuation, microwave signal paths, and control electronics.

  • Develop automated analyses on top of the model, such as heat-load, signal-integrity and noise budgets, channel counts, scalability, and full-system metrics such as power consumption as qubit counts grow.

  • Establish requirements traceability from customer and system-level requirements down to component specifications and verification tests.

  • Connect the system model to simulation and measurement data, creating a digital thread between design and test.

  • Support system architecture and trade studies for new VIO and QPU generations and customer system integrations.

  • Drive adoption across the company, training and supporting engineers in using the models and tools in their day-to-day work.

Qualifications

Core Requirements:

  • BSc. or MSc. in systems engineering, electrical engineering, physics, mechanical engineering or a related field.

  • 3+ years of hands-on MBSE experience, including building or extending a modelling framework rather than only using existing ones.

  • Hands on experience with hardware system models that encompass multiple subsystems with differing requirements and interfaces.

  • Strong working knowledge of SysML (v1 and/or v2) and at least one MBSE tool, such as Cameo, Capella or equivalent.

  • Proficiency in Python for model automation, analysis and tool integration via APIs.

  • A solid track record in requirements engineering and verification of complex, multidisciplinary hardware systems.

  • Strong organisational and communication skills. You thrive in a cross-disciplinary environment and are comfortable taking ownership from day one.

Bonus Points

  • Experience with cryogenic, RF/microwave or precision instrumentation systems, or direct experience with superconducting quantum hardware.

  • Background in high-tech, semiconductor, aerospace or scientific instrumentation industries.

  • Experience introducing MBSE into an organisation and driving its adoption.

  • Familiarity with SysML v2 APIs, digital thread concepts or co-simulation (e.g. FMI), as well as systems engineering standards such as ISO/IEC 15288.

Don't tick every box? Apply anyway! Research shows women often self-select out if they don't meet every requirement. Here's our take: nobody ticks every box. This is a description of our ideal candidate, not a filter. If most resonates and you're keen to learn the gaps, apply. We hire for trajectory, not perfection.

What We Offer:

At QuantWare, you’ll be part of a high-performing team of world-class experts in an ambitious, fast-moving environment. From day one, you’ll have the trust, tools, and support to do your best work. Here’s what you can expect:

Competitive salary - A salary that reflects the impact and importance of the role (and of course 8% holiday allowance)

Pension that’s built to last - A generous and future-proof pension plan that includes partner and dependent coverage.

Flexibility built on trust - We focus on outcomes. Work flexibly, in a hybrid setup, with an open vacation policy that lets you manage your time

Personal growth - We invest in your L&D, with a budget available to each team member, dependent on their individual ambitions, development needs, and performance

A connected team - We make space to celebrate wins together, with team events, offsites, and spontaneous moments that bring us closer

Diversity & Inclusion at QuantWare

We’re an ambitious company, not only for our goals but also to become an even more diverse and inclusive team. We know great candidates don't always follow a straight path, and we value diverse experience, perspectives, and ways of thinking. We know this helps us make better decisions, drives more innovation, and strengthens our culture.

As part of our recruitment process, candidates may be required to undergo pre-employment screening.

716b0018a8f052f6.title: Director of Pharma Partnerships, Patient Recruitment
716b0018a8f052f6.description:
About myTomorrows 

myTomorrows is a global health tech company dedicated to breaking down barriers for patients seeking treatment options.   

We strive to enable earlier and better treatment access by bridging the gap between those searching for possible options, and the companies who develop them. We work closely with patients, healthcare professionals, trial sites, patient advocacy groups, and BioPharma – connecting key stakeholders in the drug development ecosystem.   

We’ve developed a cutting-edge AI-powered technology platform that simplifies and streamlines access to drugs in development. To support our users and clients, we have a range of industry-expert specialized teams ready to help. Our services include clinical trial patient recruitment, Expanded Access Program management and Real-World Data collection.   

With a global footprint spanning 134 countries, to date we’ve supported over 17,000 patients, 3,000 physicians and 350 sites, earning the trust of 60+ BioPharma companies. In October 2025, we closed a €25M investment with Avego Healthcare Capital to fuel our global ambitions and scale the business.  

Join us in shaping the future of treatment access - making tomorrow’s therapies accessible for people who need them today. 

The opportunity: Director of Pharma Partnerships, Patient Recruitment

As Director of Pharma Partnerships, you will play a pivotal role in driving revenue growth through partnerships with Biopharmaceutical Companies related to myTomorrows' Patient Recruitment products and services for clinical trials. You will be responsible for generating leads and establishing partnerships and alliances that support our business objectives and enhance our clinical trial portfolio.

You will develop and own strategic collaborations with BioPharma companies, from emerging innovators to global leaders, driving measurable revenue growth through our Patient Recruitment solutions and expanding our market footprint. Success in this role requires a sharp commercial mindset and proven expertise in networking, lead generation, proposal and budget development, strategic partnership development, and closing high value deals.

You will be directly accountable for delivering revenue targets through strategic deals and long-term partnerships, effectively managing opportunities from lead generation through contract award, with a clear focus on pipeline conversion, deal velocity and high win rates.

Additionally, you must continually stay informed about our capabilities, as well as industry trends, market developments, and competitor activities. This, collaborating closely with our operations team, marketing team, revenue operations team and as part of the Clinical Trials Business Unit.

Geographic Requirement: This role is open to candidates in The Netherlands, United Kingdom, Canada and USA. For candidates in North America, to ensure seamless collaboration with our teams, applicants must reside within the EST or CST time zones.

What you'll do in this role:

  • Continuously network and generate a high number of leads, supported by a BDR

  • Develop and execute a partnership strategy focused on acquiring new partners and expanding existing relationships within the pharmaceutical industry

  • Own and exceed quarterly and annual revenue targets by driving pipeline conversion, accelerating deal velocity, and meeting or surpassing partnership targets and sales quotas.

  • Qualify deals, negotiate agreements, and close deals that align with company objectives.

  • Manage the end-to-end proposal process from opportunity qualification through contract award, including scope definition and budget development, ensuring submissions are competitive, accurate, and aligned with client needs.

  • Support the development of sales enablement material, working closely with product marketing.

  • Serve as a primary presenter during capabilities presentations, bid defenses and commercial discussions, effectively articulating myTomorrows' value proposition, Patient Recruitment expertise, and differentiated solutions.

  • Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to ensure the successful and seamless implementation and delivery of partnership commitments.

  • Identify upsell/cross-sell opportunities and support contracting related to the expansion services for existing clients

  • Monitor market, industry and competitor trends, as well as customer feedback to identify partnership opportunities and product/service enhancements.

  • Track and manage pipeline activities in HubSpot, ensuring accurate reporting and forecasting.

  • Represent the company at industry events, conferences, and networking opportunities to build brand awareness and expand the company's presence within the pharmaceutical sector.

  • Travel to clients, conferences and prospects across the globe (up to 60% of the time)

What you bring to the table:

  • Master’s degree in Business Administration, Life Science, Healthcare (Bachelor’s degree considered with strong experience)

  • 8+ years of experience in partnership development, business development, or sales roles, with a strong focus on contracting and closing deals within the pharmaceutical industry

  • An existing network within the pharmaceutical industry, preferably within clinical development, clinical operations, and pre-approval access space.

  • Consistent and proven track record of meeting or exceeding sales targets and closing high-value deals.

  • Strong understanding of clinical trials and patient recruitment.

  • Excellent negotiation, communication, and presentation skills in English.

  • Deep understanding of the full sales cycle, from early lead generation to contract negotiation and post-deal expansion.

  • The ability to identify market opportunities and develop actionable plans.

  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced, dynamic environment and lead cross-functional initiatives.

Equal opportunities

myTomorrows is an Equal Opportunity Employer and, beyond upholding discrimination-free practices, we are committed to cultivating a workplace where difference and diversity are protected and celebrated. The best work comes from our best selves, and we go to great lengths in supporting our team members to be just that.

  • 5+ years of experience in partnership development, business development or sales roles, with a strong focus on contracting and closing deals within the pharmaceutical industry.

  • An existing network within the pharmaceutical industry, preferably within medical affairs, market access, regulatory affairs and the Expanded Access space.

  • Consistent and proven track record of meeting or exceeding sales targets and closing high-value deals.

  • Strong understanding of Expanded Access, Named Patient Sales pricing and reimbursement, and the regulatory frameworks for Expanded Access in Europe and other key markets.

  • Excellent negotiation, communication and presentation skills in English.

  • Deep understanding of the full sales cycle, from early lead generation to contract negotiation and post-deal expansion.

ffeea2354e115c6c.title: Internship - Finance (Dec/Jan start, 6 months)
ffeea2354e115c6c.description:
Axelera AI is a fast-growing European AI hardware scale-up building high-performance, energy-efficient AI acceleration for the edge. We are looking for a hands-on Finance Intern to join our team for 5-6 months, starting December 2026 or early January 2027.

You will join at one of the busiest and most interesting moments of the financial year: the year-end close and the FY2026 external audit. You will work directly with our VP Finance and Finance Managers on real day-to-day finance operations, not side projects. You will learn how a high-growth tech company runs its accounts payable, accounts receivable, reconciliations and audit, and get exposure to investor and board reporting.

Location: Eindhoven (hybrid, 2 office days per week minimum)

Start date: December 2026 or early January 2027

Duration: 5-6 months

Hours: Minimum 4 days per week; full-time preferred

What you'll do:

  • Accounts payable: process and match supplier invoices, help clear the AP backlog and handle supplier queries.

  • Accounts receivable: follow up on overdue customer payments and keep the receivables overview up to date.

  • Reconciliations: prepare bank reconciliations and support month-end close reconciliations.

  • Audit support: help prepare PBC (provided-by-client) lists, pull sample support and respond to auditor and external accountant requests during the FY2026 audit.

  • Investor and board reporting: help gather and organise financial information for investor updates, board packs and ad hoc finance projects.

  • Process improvement: help document key finance processes and support our work on automation in NetSuite and AI tools (e.g. AP invoice capture, AR reminders, bank reconciliation matching).

What we're looking for:

Must have

  • Currently enrolled in a Master's programme in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, Economics or a related field, and able to do this internship with an internship agreement (stageovereenkomst) from your university.

  • Solid understanding of bookkeeping basics: debits and credits, accruals, AP/AR and reconciliations.

  • Strong Excel skills (lookups, pivot tables, basic formulas).

  • Interest in automation and using AI tools to improve finance processes.

  • Available for 6 months from December 2026 or early January 2027, for at least 4 days per week (full-time preferred).

  • Fluent in English, written and spoken.

  • The right to work in the Netherlands. We are unable to offer visa sponsorship for this role.

  • Accurate, organised and comfortable working through a high volume of transactions.

Nice to have

  • Experience with an ERP system, ideally NetSuite.

  • Previous finance, audit or accounting experience (internship, part-time job or student role).

What we offer

  • Hands-on experience across the full finance cycle in a high-growth deep-tech company, including a live external audit.

  • Close mentoring from experienced finance professionals, with real responsibility from day one.

  • Exposure to NetSuite and to how finance teams are using AI and automation.

  • A monthly internship allowance.

  • An international, collaborative team and a chance to be considered for future roles.

At Axelera AI, we wholeheartedly embrace equal opportunity and hold diversity in the highest regard. Our steadfast commitment is to cultivate a warm and inclusive environment that empowers and celebrates every member of our team. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds to join us in shaping the future of AI.

Axelera AI may at times work with external parties (such as recruiters, headhunters, or executive search firms) to support both publicly posted and confidential searches. Our hiring process never involves any payment from candidates, and we will never require you to use a particular paid service to be considered for a role. 4fb3eb5d94959711.description:
Get to Know Us

Horizon3 is a fast-growing, remote cybersecurity company dedicated to the mission of enabling organizations to proactively find and fix and verify exploitable attack vectors before criminals exploit them. Our flagship product, the NodeZeroTM platform, delivers production-safe autonomous pentests and other key assessment operations that scale across the largest internal, external, cloud, and hybrid cloud environments. NodeZero has been adopted by organizations of all sizes, from small educational institutions to government agencies and Global 100 enterprises. It is used by ITOps/SecOps teams, consulting pentesters, and MSSPs and MSPs. 

We are a fusion of former U.S. Special Operations cyber operators, startup engineers, and formerly frustrated cybersecurity practitioners. We're committed to helping solve our common security problems: ineffective security tools, false positives resulting in alert fatigue, blind spots, "checkbox” security culture, cybersecurity skills shortage, and the long lead time and expense of hiring outside consultants. Collectively, we are a team of learn it alls, committed to a culture of respect, collaboration, ownership, and results.

 

What you'll do

As our Regional Sales Director, you'll lead enterprise sales across BENELUX and Nordics (NEUR), building a high-performing team and driving durable growth across the region. You will set clear priorities, help sellers win complex enterprise opportunities, and work across the business to strengthen Horizon3’s presence in the market.

  • Develop and execute the NEUR Enterprise sales strategy, translating regional priorities into territory plans, pipeline goals, and measurable revenue outcomes.

  • Hire, lead, coach, and develop Enterprise Account Executives, setting clear expectations and creating the conditions for strong performance, engagement, and growth.

  • Drive new-customer acquisition and expansion by helping the team build qualified pipeline, progress complex opportunities, and engage senior customer stakeholders.

  • Build a partner-led go-to-market motion alongside direct sales: strengthen relationships with channel partners, distributors, and relevant ecosystem partners, and generate partner-influenced pipeline.

  • Stay close to strategic deals and customers, helping sellers shape account plans, navigate buying groups, and communicate the value of Horizon3’s cybersecurity solutions.

  • Partner with Marketing, Sales Engineering, Partner/Channel teams, Customer Success, Product, and Revenue Operations to align plans, campaigns, deal support, and the customer experience.

  • Use market insight, competitive context, and sales performance data to identify opportunities, focus investment, and adapt the regional plan.

  • Share clear forecasts, risks, and recommendations with sales leadership, and bring field feedback into regional and company-level planning.

  • Represent Horizon3 across the NEUR market, building trusted relationships with customers and partners and supporting relevant regional engagements.

 

Required qualifications

  • 3–5 years of experience in sales leadership, ideally in cybersecurity, enterprise SaaS, or a high-growth technology company.

  • A track record of developing and executing sales plans and forecasts to meet or exceed revenue targets and drive sustainable growth in an enterprise segment.

  • Experience recruiting, onboarding, coaching, and developing high-performing sales teams.

  • Demonstrated success building partner relationships and developing a productive channel ecosystem that supports enterprise pipeline and growth.

  • Experience managing complex, multi-stakeholder enterprise sales cycles, from pipeline development and qualification through negotiation and close.

  • Strong pipeline and forecast management skills, including the ability to establish sales practices and ensure effective use of sales tools and systems.

  • Strong analytical skills, with the ability to interpret sales performance data, identify trends, forecast revenue, and turn insights into practical improvements.

  • Excellent communication, negotiation, and relationship-building skills, with confidence engaging senior customer and partner stakeholders.

  • Comfortable representing the company at industry events, conferences, and customer or partner engagements.

  • Bachelor’s degree in business, marketing, or a related field.

Travel Required

We are looking for someone to be based 3 days a week hybrid in our Amsterdam office with some travel required.

Perks of Horizon3

  • Inclusive Team: We value diversity and promote an inclusive culture where everyone can thrive.

  • Growth Opportunities: Be part of a dynamic and growing team with numerous career development opportunities.

  • Innovative Culture: Work in a collaborative environment that encourages creativity and out-of-the-box thinking.

  • Hybrid & Remote Work: We embrace a mix of remote and hybrid work models depending on role and location, including our Chicago office, where some roles require regular in-office presence.

  • Competitive Compensation: We offer competitive salary, equity and benefits. Our benefits include health, vision & dental insurance for you and your family, a flexible vacation policy, and generous parental leave.

Compensation and Values

At Horizon3, we believe that our people are our greatest asset, and our compensation philosophy reflects this core value. We are committed to fostering an environment where all employees feel valued, respected, and rewarded for their contributions. Our compensation structure is designed to be fair, competitive, and transparent, ensuring that every team member is recognized and compensated equitably across roles, levels, and locations.

In accordance with various State’s transparency regulations, we provide the following salary range information for this position:

  • Additional compensation: All full-time roles are eligible for an equity package in the form of stock options.

You Belong Here

Horizon3 is not just an equal opportunity employer - we are a community that values diversity, equity, and inclusion as fundamental principles of our culture and success. We are dedicated to fostering a workplace where everyone feels welcome and respected, regardless of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, hair length or any other legally protected status by law.

Our commitment to diversity and inclusion means we strive to attract, develop, and retain a workforce that reflects the varied communities we serve. We believe that diverse perspectives drive innovation and strengthen our ability to create cutting-edge cybersecurity solutions. At Horizon3, every team member is valued and supported in an environment that encourages personal and professional growth.

We welcome candidates from all backgrounds and experiences, and we encourage all qualified individuals to apply. Come be a part of Horizon3, where your unique contributions are recognized, and your potential is limitless.

Other Duties

179cdab93a9fc179.title: Project Manager - Facility Management
179cdab93a9fc179.description:
Over CBRE Global Workplace Solutions

CBRE Global Workplace Solutions (GWS) is wereldwijd marktleider in geïntegreerd facilitair management, technisch beheer, projectmanagement en vastgoedservices. Wij ondersteunen enkele van de meest toonaangevende organisaties ter wereld bij het creëren, onderhouden en optimaliseren van hun werkomgevingen.

Als onderdeel van CBRE, met meer dan 155.000 medewerkers wereldwijd, combineren wij lokale expertise met de kracht van een toonaangevend internationaal netwerk. Onze teams leveren innovatieve oplossingen op het gebied van technisch onderhoud, facility management, energiebeheer, projecten en werkplekoptimalisatie.

Bij CBRE geloven we dat onze mensen het verschil maken. Daarom investeren we in ontwikkeling, samenwerking en een veilige, inclusieve werkomgeving waarin iedereen kan groeien. CBRE wordt wereldwijd erkend als een van de meest bewonderde en ethische bedrijven in haar sector en staat bekend om haar focus op innovatie, duurzaamheid en talentontwikkeling.

Taken

WAT GA JE DOEN?
Ben jij een ervaren Project Manager met een technische achtergrond en een passie voor het succesvol realiseren van complexe projecten?

Voor ons Projects-team in Nederland zijn wij op zoek naar een Project Manager die verantwoordelijk is voor de succesvolle uitvoering en oplevering van uiteenlopende bouwkundige, technische en facilitaire projecten. Van complete kantoorinrichtingen en fit-outs tot kritische technische upgrades en de realisatie van serverruimtes: jij zorgt ervoor dat projecten veilig, op tijd, binnen budget én naar volle tevredenheid van de klant worden opgeleverd.

Je werkt nauw samen met klanten, leveranciers, onderaannemers en interne stakeholders en hebt de volledige verantwoordelijkheid voor projecten met een waarde van circa €25.000 tot €1 miljoen.

Als Project Manager ben jij de drijvende kracht achter het volledige projectproces, van initiatief en voorbereiding tot uitvoering en oplevering.

Je bent verantwoordelijk voor:

  • Het leiden van bouwkundige, technische en facilitaire projecten van aanvraag tot oplevering
  • Het opstellen en bewaken van projectplannen, budgetten, planningen en risicoanalyses
  • Het vertalen van klantwensen naar concrete projectdoelstellingen en programma's van eisen
  • Het aansturen en coördineren van interne teams, leveranciers en onderaannemers
  • Het bewaken van kwaliteit, veiligheid, contractuele verplichtingen en commerciële doelstellingen
  • Het fungeren als belangrijkste aanspreekpunt voor klanten en stakeholders
  • Het beheren van de dagelijkse operationele aspecten van projecten, inclusief toezicht op locatie
  • Het zorgen voor volledige naleving van CBRE-processen, projectmanagementrichtlijnen en QHSE-standaarden
  • Het voorbereiden en presenteren van projectrapportages aan klanten en interne stakeholders
  • Het signaleren van nieuwe projectkansen en het opbouwen van sterke klantrelaties

Geen dag is hetzelfde. De ene dag leid je een bouwvergadering op locatie, de volgende dag presenteer je een projectupdate aan een stuurgroep of bespreek je innovatieve oplossingen met een klant.

Vereisten

WAT BRENG JE MEE?

Wij zoeken een ervaren professional die techniek, organisatie en stakeholdermanagement succesvol weet te combineren.

  • Hbo-werk- en denkniveau, bij voorkeur in Bouwkunde, Elektrotechniek, Installatietechniek, Infratechniek of een vergelijkbare richting
  • Minimaal 3 tot 5 jaar ervaring met technische of bouwkundige projecten
  • Ervaring binnen de technische dienstverlening, bouw, vastgoed of facility management is een pré
  • Sterke organisatorische, commerciële en communicatieve vaardigheden
  • Ervaring met budgetbeheer, planning en contractmanagement
  • Leiderschapskwaliteiten en het vermogen om meerdere stakeholders effectief te managen
  • Een proactieve, resultaatgerichte en klantgerichte instelling
  • VCA-VOL of de bereidheid deze te behalen
  • Goede beheersing van de Nederlandse en Engelse taal
  • Bereidheid om te reizen naar projectlocaties binnen Nederland

Voldoe je niet volledig aan alle eisen, maar herken je jezelf in het profiel? Dan nodigen we je nadrukkelijk uit om toch te solliciteren.

Benefits

WAT BIEDEN WIJ?

Bij CBRE krijg je de kans om impactvolle projecten te realiseren binnen een internationale organisatie waar ontwikkeling, samenwerking en ondernemerschap centraal staan.

Wij bieden onder andere:

  • Een marktconform salaris dat aansluit bij jouw kennis, ervaring en de verantwoordelijkheden van de functie
  • Een bedrijfsauto inclusief tankpas
  • Flexibele werktijden en hybride werkmogelijkheden waar de functie dit toelaat
  • 8,33% vakantiegeld
  • 25 vakantiedagen en 12 ADV-dagen
  • De mogelijkheid om extra vakantiedagen bij te kopen
  • Een vaste pensioenregeling
  • Collectieve verzekeringsmogelijkheden
  • Een uitgebreid onboardingprogramma
  • Opleidings- en ontwikkelmogelijkheden via de GWS Academy en externe trainingen
  • Internationale doorgroeimogelijkheden binnen CBRE
  • Een professionele, informele en collegiale werkomgeving waarin jouw bijdrage zichtbaar impact maakt

KLAAR VOOR JOUW VOLGENDE UITDAGING?

Solliciteer eenvoudig online met jouw cv en relevante certificaten of diploma’s. Een motivatiebrief is niet nodig.

55d9ff759aabe44b.title: Projectleider Gebiedsontwikkeling
55d9ff759aabe44b.description:
Als projectleider gebiedsontwikkeling bij Waalpartners speel je een cruciale rol in het realiseren van de nieuwbouwopgaven van onze opdrachtgevers. Jij bewaart het overzicht, staat naast de opdrachtgever en draagt bij aan oplossingen voor de uitdagingen die woningbouw met zich meebrengt. Zo hebben we recentelijk meegedacht voor de nieuwe woonomgeving ‘Vlijweide’ in Dordrecht. Bij deze locatie ontwikkeling komt nogal wat bij elkaar. Water, bodem, ecologie, een primaire waterkering én verschillende partijen met ieder hun eigen verantwoordelijkheid en expertise. En dat alles om een toekomstbestendig nieuw woongebied te ontwikkelen.

Dit ga je doen

Met je brede kennis en jarenlange ervaring sta je stevig in een dynamische projectomgeving. Zowel in de voorbereidende als de uitvoerende fase zorg je ervoor dat het proces vloeiend blijft verlopen, ook bij langdurige integrale projecten. Je eigen netwerk zet je in om de dienstverlening van Waalpartners verder te profileren. Als projectleider ben je bovendien de spil in de ontwikkeling van zowel medewerkers als de organisatie.

Dat doe je niet alleen: samen schop je ‘t verder. Je werkt nauw samen met het management en de overige projectleiders over offertes, de bureauplanning en kansen in de markt.

Dit ben jij

Je bent open, nieuwsgierig en staat als leidinggevende stevig in je schoenen. Je omgeving ziet je als collegiaal en je neemt verantwoordelijkheid over je project en de ontwikkeling van de projectteamleden.

Dit bieden wij jou

  • Een salaris tussen €4.500 – €6.900 bruto o.b.v. fulltime dienstverband, afhankelijk van je kennis en ervaring.

  • Groeipad. Met onze Waalacademy bouw je stevig aan je eigen ontwikkeling.

  • Flexibele werktijden. Kom je liever om half 8 binnen, in plaats van half 9? Geen probleem.

  • Hybride werken. We zien je graag op kantoor, omdat we veel met elkaar en onze opdrachtgevers overleggen en samenwerken. Natuurlijk is er ook ruimte om thuis te werken, daarom mag je 2 dagen per week vanuit huis werken (o.b.v. fulltime dienstverband).

  • 27 vakantiedagen

  • Resultaatafhankelijke winstdeling. Draaien we samen een goed jaar? Dan profiteer jij daar ook van!

  • Een goede pensioenregeling onder het oude pensioenstelsel.

  • Een elektrische auto van de zaak, die je ook privé mag gebruiken

  • Plezier. We werken niet alleen aan de ontwikkeling van onze omgeving en onszelf, maar hebben ‘t ook leuk met elkaar. Onze personeelsvereniging organiseert regelmatig activiteiten, we gaan samen op citytrip of een paar kilometer hardlopen.

Dit breng jij mee

  • Je hebt de drive om een project voor alle belanghebbenden tot een goed einde te brengen.

  • Jij vindt het belangrijk om jezelf, samen met je collega’s, te blijven ontwikkelen.

  • Je hebt een civieltechnische opleiding (hbo werk- en denkniveau).

  • Je spreekt vloeiend Nederlands en kunt jezelf goed verwoorden: In gesprek en op papier.

  • Je hebt de ervaring om complexe projecten te doorzien en te begeleiden.

  • Je hebt gevoel voor thema’s als binnenstedelijke herinrichting, klimaatadaptatie of geotechniek.

0772cfe2312388c4.title: Senior Integration Software Engineer
0772cfe2312388c4.description:
We are looking for an experienced Senior Integration Software Engineer to bring our algorithms and software backend together into reliable, operational solutions, and to take technical ownership of how our software is integrated.

Optics11 is a deep-tech company developing advanced fiber-optic sensing technologies for challenging environments and applications in energy and underwater security. Our systems enable high-performance sensing and monitoring through advanced photonics, signal processing, and data-driven intelligence.

We are expanding our R&D team with an Integration Software Engineer who enjoys building clean, reliable interfaces between components and working where software meets hardware, and who takes ownership of making complex systems work together end to end.

As a Senior Integration Software Engineer, you will support their integration into operational systems: connecting algorithms to the backend through robust APIs, building data connectors, health reporting and control software, and defining and verifying integrations with Command and Control (C2) systems.

You will work closely with domain experts in acoustics, signal processing and machine learning, and with the software engineering team, and hands-on with our monitoring systems at our headquarters and production facility. You will also take technical ownership of work delivered by internal and external engineers and set the standard for good engineering practices.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead software integration engineering for our underwater acoustic sensing systems, ensuring frontend and backend components, algorithms, and hardware systems work together reliably.

  • Integrate the algorithmic toolbox with our system backends, turning research code into maintainable, versioned and deployable software components.

  • Implement data interfaces for our real-time sonar processing pipeline, to ingest multiple sensors (acoustic, heading, temperature, pressure, etc.) from internal and external data acquisition systems. Implement health reporting, logging and monitoring, so that the status and performance of software and system components is visible and actionable.

  • Develop the software control layer for our sensing systems and their hardware components, including APIs for commanding, state handling, error handling and recovery.

  • Implement, align and verify software integrations with external partners and C2 systems, being directly involved in defining interfaces, maintaining interface specifications and running joint integration tests.

  • Testing & debugging: Develop system-level test suites and CI/CD pipelines, diagnose communication failures, and ensure secure, reliable data transfers as the toolbox and backends evolve.

  • Address performance, latency and scalability of the integrated pipeline, together with algorithm and backend developers.

  • Work hands-on with integrated software and hardware systems at our headquarters and production facility, with occasional on-site visits.

  • Review the work of junior engineers and external development partners in depth, promote good practices for packaging, versioning and release, and share integration knowledge across the team.

Why Join Us?

  • Join one of Europe’s most promising deep-tech scale-ups.

  • Shape the future of a rapidly growing multidisciplinary R&D organization.

  • Competitive salary and benefits package.

  • Enjoy regular team activities and company events.

  • Fresh team lunches provided 5 times/week.


Qualifications:

  • BSc or MSc in Computer Science, Software Engineering or a related field.

  • Significant professional experience in software engineering, with a focus on system integration, backend or platform development.

  • Extensive experience developing production software in Python, including packaging, testing, dependency management and writing maintainable, well-structured code.

  • Familiarity with systems programming in C++, or Rust, for the purpose of extending Python for more performance or hardware control.

  • Proven experience designing and implementing APIs and messaging interfaces (e.g. MQTT, WebSocket) and data serialization (e.g. protobuf).

  • Experience with realtime data pipelines, and handling high-throughput or streaming data.

  • Experience with Docker, CI/CD and automated testing in a Linux environment.

  • Experience working with software that interacts with physical systems, and comfort doing hands-on integration and troubleshooting in a lab or production environment.

  • Experience reviewing code and designs, mentoring junior engineers, and setting engineering standards.

  • An outcome-focused mindset, with the ability to own a problem end to end or break it down for others.

  • Ability to work with algorithm developers and translate research code into robust, maintainable software.

  • Flexible and proactive in taking on what needs to be addressed, and comfortable in a fast-paced scale-up environment.

  • Good communication skills in English and the ability to coordinate with internal teams and external partners.

  • Willingness to work primarily from our Amsterdam headquarters, as parts of the role involve classified information and physical systems.

Nice to Have:

  • Knowledge of defense systems or defense standards (e.g. NATO STANAGs, MIL-STD), for example in naval, maritime security or surveillance systems.

  • Experience with the scientific Python stack (e.g. NumPy, SciPy) or integrating signal processing or ML models into production systems.

  • Experience developing software interfaces for controlling instruments or devices.

  • Experience with other messaging or streaming frameworks (e.g. Kafka, ZeroMQ, DDS).

  • Familiarity with observability tooling.

Security & Compliance:

36ec0fa03f34f1ca.title: Stage Office Management (mbo/hbo)
36ec0fa03f34f1ca.description:
Een kerstviering organiseren waar collega's nog lang over napraten? Een externe bijeenkomst tot in de puntjes regelen? Of zorgen dat alles op kantoor lekker loopt?

Bij Zibber krijg je de kans om het allemaal te doen. We zoeken een enthousiaste stagiair Office Management die energie krijgt van organiseren, regelen en dingen voor elkaar krijgen.

Geen stage waarin je alleen maar meekijkt. Hier doe je écht mee!

Over Zibber

Met zo'n 240 collega's in Nederland, België en Duitsland zijn we marktleider in vastgoedmedia. Met fotografie, video en slimme technologie helpen we makelaars om woningen perfect te presenteren.

Op ons hoofdkantoor in Eindhoven werken zo'n 60 collega's samen. De sfeer? Informeel, energiek en altijd in beweging. We werken hard, lachen veel en houden van mensen die initiatief nemen.

De rol

Binnen de stage Office Management werk je nauw samen met onze Executive Assistant en helpt bij alles wat ons kantoor en onze interne projecten nét wat beter maakt.

Denk aan:

  • Het organiseren van Zibber-events, borrels en teamactiviteiten.

  • Het regelen van offsites en externe bijeenkomsten, van locatie tot catering.

  • Zorgen dat alles op kantoor soepel verloopt.

  • Contact met leveranciers en het oppakken van praktische verzoeken.

  • Meewerken aan leuke interne projecten en verbeterideeën.

En zie jij iets dat slimmer, leuker of makkelijker kan? Laat van je horen!

Wat je van ons krijgt

  • Een afwisselende stage waarin je écht iets kunt bijdragen.

  • Ruimte om zelfstandig dingen op te pakken en eigen ideeën uit te voeren.

  • Persoonlijke begeleiding van onze Executive Assistant.

  • De kans om veel te leren over office management, events en projectmatig werken.

  • Een werkplek op ons gezellige hoofdkantoor in Eindhoven.

  • Korte lijnen, enthousiaste collega's en volop Zibber-events, lunches en gezelligheid.

  • Een stagevergoeding van €450,- bruto per maand bij een fulltime stage.

  • Bij een fulltime stage in principe vier dagen meewerken en één dag ruimte voor school.

  • Starten in januari of februari 2027!


Je volgt een mbo 4- of hbo-opleiding en zoekt een meewerkstage.

Verder vinden we vooral belangrijk dat je:

  • Positieve energie meebrengt en graag de handen uit de mouwen steekt.

  • Zelf initiatief neemt en niet afwacht.

  • Makkelijk communiceert en vragen durft te stellen.

  • Houdt van organiseren en overzicht bewaren.

  • Goed Nederlands spreekt en schrijft.

Ervaring? Mooi meegenomen. De juiste instelling? Veel belangrijker!

Klinkt dit als jouw stage?

Ben jij iemand die liever zegt 'Ik regel het!' dan 'Wie gaat dat doen?'?

Dan pas je waarschijnlijk perfect bij Zibber. Solliciteer en laat ons weten waarom jij graag dingen voor elkaar krijgt. We maken graag kennis met je!

65b4ab40524124f0.title: Senior Medewerker Finance & Accounting
65b4ab40524124f0.description:
Krijg jij energie van een financiële administratie die tot in de puntjes klopt? Heb je ruime ervaring met boekhouding en houd je graag overzicht over financiële processen? Bij Normec Foodcare zoeken we een ervaren Senior Medewerker Finance & Accounting die zelfstandig de financiële administratie beheert, afwijkingen signaleert en bijdraagt aan een correcte maand- en jaarafsluiting.

Jouw rol

Als Boekhoudkundig Medewerker ben je verantwoordelijk voor een correcte en tijdige verwerking van de financiële administratie. Je houdt je bezig met debiteuren, crediteuren, cashmanagement en grootboekcontroles. Daarnaast bereid je de maand- en jaarafsluiting voor en werk je nauw samen met de Financial Controller en andere collega's binnen Finance. Je maakt deel uit van een Finance-team van zeven collega's en rapporteert rechtstreeks aan Patricia Pouw, Finance Manager.

Jouw verantwoordelijkheden zijn verder:

  • Debiteuren- en crediteurenbeheer: Je beheert de openstaande posten, verwerkt ontvangsten en inkoopfacturen en onderhoudt contact met klanten en leveranciers over betalingen en factuurverschillen.

  • Cashmanagement: Je verwerkt bankmutaties, bewaakt de geldstromen en bereidt betalingen voor. Ook ondersteun je bij de liquiditeitsplanning.

  • Voorbereiden van de maand- en jaarafsluiting: Je zorgt dat de administratie volledig en tijdig is bijgewerkt. Je bereidt boekingen, reserveringen en balansspecificaties voor en ondersteunt bij de jaarafsluiting en accountantscontrole.

  • Grootboek en financiële controles: Je controleert grootboekrekeningen en financiële aansluitingen, onderzoekt afwijkingen en bereidt correcties voor.

  • Aanvullende administratie: Je houdt je bezig met intercompany-afstemmingen, vaste activa en de voorbereiding van btw-aangiften.

  • Procesverbetering: Je signaleert knelpunten, doet verbetervoorstellen en helpt de kwaliteit en efficiëntie van de financiële administratie verder te verbeteren.

Daarnaast ben je een inhoudelijk aanspreekpunt voor collega's bij complexere boekhoudkundige vraagstukken en ondersteun je hen met jouw kennis en ervaring.

Ons aanbod

Een afwisselende functie bij Normec Foodcare, met ruimte om zelfstandig te werken, mee te denken en jezelf verder te ontwikkelen. Je komt terecht in een betrokken team waarin samenwerking centraal staat. Wat je verder mag verwachten:

  • Een jaarcontract met uitzicht op een vast dienstverband

  • Een salaris tussen € 4.000 en € 4.500 bruto per maand op basis van een fulltime dienstverband, afhankelijk van jouw ervaring

  • Een dienstverband van bij voorkeur 40 uur per week. Een dienstverband van 32 uur per week is ook bespreekbaar

  • Hybride werken en flexibele werktijden: je kunt je werkdag indelen tussen 07.00 en 19.00 uur

  • 25 vakantiedagen en 8% vakantietoeslag

  • De mogelijkheid om extra vakantiedagen te kopen

  • Een goede pensioenregeling

  • Een reiskostenvergoeding

  • De mogelijkheid om deel te nemen aan het fietsplan

  • Een continu ontwikkelprogramma waarin je wordt gestimuleerd om je talenten verder te ontwikkelen

  • Een collectieve ziektekostenverzekering bij VGZ

  • Een actieve personeelsvereniging die het hele jaar door diverse leuke activiteiten organiseert

Jouw profiel

Je bent een positief kritisch ingestelde en betrokken professional, die graag meedenkt en bouwt aan onze Finance-afdeling.

Daarnaast beschik je over:

  • Mbo+/hbo werk- en denkniveau in een financiële of boekhoudkundige richting

  • Minimaal 3 jaar relevante werkervaring als Boekhouder, Financieel Administratief Medewerker of in een vergelijkbare financiële functie

  • Ruime ervaring met zelfstandig boekhouden, debiteuren- en crediteurenbeheer en het voorbereiden van maandafsluitingen

  • Een goed begrip van grootboekadministratie, balansposten, btw en de samenhang tussen boekingen en financiële rapportages

  • Goede vaardigheden in Excel en ervaring met een ERP-systeem. Kennis van Exact Online of Business Central is een pré

  • Je hebt een goede beheersing van de Engelse taal, zowel mondeling als schriftelijk

  • Een nauwkeurige, gestructureerde en proactieve werkwijze. Je voert niet alleen werkzaamheden uit, maar onderzoekt ook zelfstandig afwijkingen en denkt mee over oplossingen

  • Goede communicatieve vaardigheden en het vermogen om prettig samen te werken met klanten, leveranciers en collega's. Je deelt graag je kennis en ondersteunt anderen waar nodig

  • Je bent bij voorkeur 40 uur per week beschikbaar

Over Normec

Normec Foodlab Ede is onderdeel van Normec, toonaangevend in de Testen, Inspectie, Certificering en Compliance (TICC) industrie. Onze expertise raakt essentiële gebieden zoals water-, lucht- en bodemkwaliteit, brandveiligheid en voedselveiligheid, waarbij we de hoogste normen van kwaliteit en veiligheid garanderen in verschillende sectoren. Normec is opgericht in 2016 en is een ambitieuze, onafhankelijke en snelgroeiende organisatie.

We bieden onze collega’s de kans om actief bij te dragen aan onze missie én tegelijkertijd hun eigen carrière te ontwikkelen binnen een dynamische en snelgroeiende organisatie. Samen werken we aan impactvolle oplossingen voor onze klanten en aan een duurzame toekomst. De cultuur binnen Normec is informeel, open, energiek en ondernemend en is verankerd in onze GROWTH-principes. Middels ons The Normec Fit-programma, waarmee de deze principes tot leven brengen, zorgen we ervoor dat niet alleen ons bedrijf groeit, maar ook iedereen die er deel van uitmaakt.

Interesse? Laten we kennismaken!

Ben je geïnteresseerd in deze vacature? Dan kijken we uit naar jouw sollicitatie! We behandelen jouw gegevens vertrouwelijk en zorgen ervoor dat je binnen vijf werkdagen een reactie van ons ontvangt.  Voor vragen over deze vacature kun je contact opnemen met team Recruitment, via . Zij helpen je graag verder.

De procedure:

  • Eerste telefonische screening en verdere bespreking van de vacature

  • Persoonlijk gesprek bij Normec

  • Referentiecheck (na jouw goedkeuring)/ assessment

  • Tweede gesprek/bespreken arbeidsvoorwaarden bij Normec

  • Gefeliciteerd, je hebt je nieuwe uitdaging gevonden

 Op zoek naar een nieuwe uitdaging binnen de voedingsmiddelenindustrie, maar is deze functie niet helemaal wat je zoekt? Volg Careers at Normec Foodcare op LinkedIn en blijf op de hoogte van al onze vacatures.

Ongevraagde acquisitie door bureaus wordt niet op prijs gesteld en zal niet worden beantwoord.
