62a30f1d0268f619.title: Stage: Optimalisatie Processen Industry
62a30f1d0268f619.description:
Over Nedlin

Nedlin is een industriële textielverzorger voor Healthcare, Hospitality en Industry, waar veiligheid, kwaliteit, continu verbeteren en verantwoord ondernemen centraal staan. Als groeiend B-Corp familiebedrijf investeren we graag in jong talent en versterken we de verbinding tussen onderwijs en arbeidsmarkt. Daarom bieden we studenten de kans om praktijkervaring op te doen, zich te ontwikkelen en Nedlin te leren kennen, met waar mogelijk mooie doorgroeikansen na het afstuderen.

De stageopdrachten

Tijdens deze stage binnen Nedlin Industry ga je aan de slag met een actueel vraagstuk uit onze dagelijkse operatie. Je onderzoekt waar verbeterkansen liggen, brengt processen en knelpunten in kaart en werkt jouw bevindingen uit tot concrete verbetervoorstellen.

Afhankelijk van jouw interesse kun je kiezen uit één van de volgende stageopdrachten:

  1. Klantcompleetheid verbeteren
    Onderzoek waar en waarom klantorders niet volledig worden geleverd, breng knelpunten binnen productie en expeditie in kaart en werk concrete verbeteringen.

  2. Transportkosten reduceren
    Analyseer transportkosten en routes, onderzoek de beladingsgraad en leverfrequenties en breng mogelijke kostenbesparingen in kaart.

  3. Doorlooptijden magazijn verbeteren
    Breng de magazijnprocessen in kaart, identificeer wachttijden en onnodige handelingen en werk verbeteringen uit om de doorlooptijd te verkorten.

  4. Gebruik van AI binnen de organisatie
    Onderzoek de mogelijkheden voor AI binnen de organisatie, bepaal kansrijke toepassingen voor de dagelijkse operatie en werk deze concreet uit.

  5. Werkinstructies vouwers en inpak verbeteren
    Beoordeel de huidige werkinstructies en onderzoek hoe deze eenvoudiger, duidelijker en visueler kunnen worden gemaakt voor medewerkers.

Wat bieden wij?

  • Stagevergoeding:

    • € 300,- bruto per maand voor mbo-studenten (op basis van 40 uur per week);

    • € 400,- bruto per maand voor hbo-studenten (op basis van 40 uur per week);

  • Een leerzame stage binnen één van de modernste en duurzaamste wasserijen van Europa;

  • Ruimte en begeleiding om te werken aan jouw (afstudeer)opdracht;

  • Persoonlijke begeleiding en korte lijnen;

  • Een familiaire en positieve sfeer: samen feestdagen vieren, een jaarlijkse familiedag en leuke uitjes;

  • Kans op een (bij)baan bij Nedlin na afronding van je stage, bij wederzijdse match.


Wie ben jij?

  • Je volgt een hbo-opleiding of een mbo-4-opleiding en kunt aantoonbaar zelfstandig werken.

  • Je studeert bijvoorbeeld Technische Bedrijfskunde, Operations Management, Kwaliteitsmanagement, Human Factors, Communicatie of een vergelijkbare richting.

  • Je bent analytisch en oplettend, schrijft helder en kunt informatie eenvoudig en visueel overbrengen.

  • Je werkt zorgvuldig en zelfstandig en legt gemakkelijk contact met collega’s op de werkvloer.

  • Je zoekt een onderzoeks- en implementatiestage, waarbij gedeeltelijk meewerken in de praktijk mogelijk is..

Pak het moment

Wil jij tijdens je stage niet alleen werken aan een interessante opdracht, maar vooral ook leren, ervaring opdoen en jezelf ontwikkelen? Bij Nedlin krijg je de ruimte om jouw kennis vanuit je opleiding toe te passen in de praktijk, mee te kijken binnen onze organisatie en samen te werken met ervaren collega’s. Maak van jouw stage een waardevolle stap richting je toekomst. Solliciteer eenvoudig via de solliciteerknop. Heb je eerst nog vragen over de stage of de opdracht? dee3ac072431a534.description:
About Valiantys

Valiantys helps organizations transform how work gets done across the enterprise, leading with transformation consulting, enterprise service management (ESM), and engineering productivity. By combining deep process expertise with modern collaboration, automation, and value stream practices, Valiantys enables business, IT, and product teams to design connected, efficient, and human-centered ways of working. With a strong focus on the modern workforce, the company helps customers reimagine service delivery beyond IT, streamline cross-functional workflows, and improve flow and throughput for engineering teams. For more information, visit https://valiantys.com.


Job Summary

As a Senior Atlassian Consultant, you shape and lead the delivery of strategic and complex Cloud solutions for our clients.

You act as a trusted advisor to senior stakeholders, while also playing a key role internally as a leader, mentor, and reference for consulting excellence. You combine strategic vision, technical expertise, and leadership to drive impactful outcomes for both clients and Valiantys.

 

What You’ll Be Working On

Shape & Advise

  • Lead discovery phases and identify high-value opportunities for clients
  • Advise senior stakeholders on Cloud strategy, architecture, and transformation roadmaps
  • Design tailored solutions that align with business goals and technical constraints
  • Act as a trusted advisor, guiding clients toward long-term value realization

    • Lead Delivery

    • Lead and oversee the delivery of complex or cross-practice projects
    • Ensure delivery approaches align with client needs, best practices, and Valiantys standards
    • Act as technical lead when required to guarantee quality and consistency
    • Produce and review key deliverables and ensure clear reporting on progress and outcomes

      • Mentor People

      • Mentor team members and support their technical and professional development
      • Contribute to onboarding and enablement of new consultants

        • Drive Consulting Excellence

        • Act as a reference point for best practices, methods, and tools
        • Support consultants in resolving complex or strategic challenges
        • Encourage knowledge sharing and contribute to practice development
        • Contribute to the evolution of methodologies, standards, and service offerings

          • Collaborate & Contribute

          • Work closely with Delivery Managers, Practice Leads, Sales, and Presales teams
          • Support complex presales activities (solution design, scoping, demonstrations)
          • Identify business opportunities and contribute to account growth
          • Strengthen collaboration across teams and practices

            • Ensure Client Success

            • Build and maintain strong relationships with key client stakeholders
            • Ensure high levels of satisfaction and service consistency
            • Support long-term engagement strategies and value realization
            • Act as an escalation point for critical issues and ensure timely resolution
              •  

              Do You Have What It Takes?

              To succeed in this role, you bring:

              • A Master’s degree (or equivalent) in Computer Science or a related field
              • 7y minimum experience in consulting and leading complex projects
              • Deep expertise in Atlassian tools and Cloud environments
              • Proven ability to engage with senior stakeholders and drive strategic discussions

                • Your strengths

                • Strategic thinking combined with strong execution capabilities
                • Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills
                • Strong problem-solving and decision-making abilities
                • Ability to navigate complexity and drive alignment
                • Commitment to quality, client success, and continuous improvement

                  • Languages & Location

                  Fluent in Dutch & English (company-wide working language) 

                  You can be based anywhere in the Netherlands (fullremote possible) but be ready to travel for work. 

                   

                  Why Join Valiantys?

                  At Valiantys, our people are at the heart of everything we do. We are committed to creating an environment where you can grow, lead, and make an impact.

                  Meaning : Drive strategic transformation projects and influence outcomes
                  Learning : Continuous development through training, certifications, and communities
                  Flexibility : Hybrid work model supporting work-life balance

                  Valiantys is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to personal background, identity, or beliefs.

4eb48c7298a9bda3.description:
Over ons

Europa verandert. Steeds meer mensen kiezen voor vrijheid — als zzp'er, freelancer of ondernemer. Ze bepalen zelf wanneer, hoe en met wie ze werken. Maar die vrijheid komt met een keerzijde: onzekerheid.

Bij Insify geloven we dat ondernemers zich geen zorgen moeten maken over verzekeringen. Daarom bouwen we iets wat de verzekeringswereld hard nodig heeft: transparante, eerlijke en volledig digitale verzekeringen, speciaal voor mensen die voor zichzelf werken. Geen ingewikkeld papierwerk, geen gedoe. Vandaag geregeld, morgen verzekerd.

We verzekeren inmiddels duizenden klanten in heel Europa — en we zijn nog maar net begonnen.


Het Operations Team

Wij zijn het gezicht van Insify. Bij elk telefoontje, elke e-mail en elk gesprek bouwen we vertrouwen op. We zorgen ervoor dat klanten zich gehoord, gesteund en goed geholpen voelen — ook als het ingewikkeld wordt. Snelheid en kwaliteit gaan bij ons hand in hand, en we verbeteren continu op basis van wat we leren. Met een groeiend medisch acceptatieteam en uitbreiding naar meerdere Europese landen, speel jij een directe rol in iets wat echt impact maakt.


Jouw rol

Als Medisch Acceptatie Werkstudent ben jij het eerste aanspreekpunt voor onze klanten in een van de meest persoonlijke momenten van hun ondernemerschap. Je werkt nauw samen met medische specialisten en zorgt ervoor dat aanvragen soepel, nauwkeurig en klantgericht verlopen. Dit is geen standaard bijbaan — je draait mee in een snel groeiend team waar jouw bijdrage echt telt.


Wat ga je doen
  • Klantcontact. Je beantwoordt vragen via telefoon, e-mail en chat. Je legt complexe verzekeringspolissen en medische beslissingen uit op een manier die klanten écht begrijpen.
  • Gegevensbeheer. Je vraagt medische dossiers op bij huisartsen en specialisten, controleert de volledigheid en verwerkt alles nauwkeurig in ons systeem.
  • Samenwerken met specialisten. Je fungeert als schakel tussen de klant en de medisch specialist — je vat informatie samen, signaleert complexe vraagstukken en houdt de communicatie helder.
  • Administratie. Je houdt klantgegevens up-to-date, verwerkt poliswijzigingen en bewaakt deadlines.

    • Wat je meebrengt
  • Je studeert momenteel, bij voorkeur in een richting met raakvlakken aan zorg, communicatie of bedrijfskunde.
  • Je bent beschikbaar voor 24 tot 32 uur per week.
  • Je Nederlands is uitstekend — zowel mondeling als schriftelijk. Dit is een harde eis, omdat je dagelijks contact hebt met Nederlandstalige klanten.
  • Je bent georganiseerd, schakelt makkelijk tussen taken en verliest deadlines nooit uit het oog.
  • Je hebt een oprechte klantgerichte instelling — je vindt het fijn om mensen echt te helpen, ook als het niet makkelijk is.
  • Je bent bereid het WFT-examen te halen als onderdeel van je professionele ontwikkeling. Wij betalen het en begeleiden je erdoorheen.

    • Wat wij bieden
  • 💰 Marktconforme vergoeding — we betalen goed, omdat we de besten willen aantrekken.
  • 🏖️ 25 vakantiedagen — plus een extra vrije dag op kerstavond als het een werkdag is.
  • 🏠 Hybride werken — twee dagen per week thuiswerken als je eenmaal ingewerkt bent.
  • 🚆 Reiskostenvergoeding — we helpen je met je woon-werkverkeer.
  • 🎯 €50 netto per maand via Alleo — op te sparen en te besteden aan wat jij wilt, van sportschool tot UberEats.
  • 💻 MacBook van de zaak — zodat je altijd snel en efficiënt kunt werken.
  • 🎉 Echte teamcultuur — maandelijkse borrels, kwartaaluitjes, lunch & learns en meer.
  • 📈 Ruimte om te groeien — bij Insify groei je mee met het bedrijf. Voor de juiste persoon is dit veel meer dan een werkstudentpositie.

4713ddc262dd4776.title: Insurance Product Manager / Underwriter (P&C)
4713ddc262dd4776.description:
Most insurance product roles ask you to perfect one product in one market. This one asks you to build Europe’s SME insurance products: decide what we cover and who we insure, negotiate it with our carriers and get it live, market after market.

Deep in the wording. Fast in the build.

About Insify

Insurance for entrepreneurs is still built the old way: one market at a time, wordings nobody reads, and cover that leaves out the very businesses that need it most.

We're doing it differently.

Insify is a high-growth scale-up backed by €43M in total funding from world-class investors like Accel, Munich Re Ventures, and Formula 1 champion Nico Rosberg. In five years, we've expanded from the Netherlands into France, Germany and Ireland, and we're just getting started. Our mission: become the European leader in AI-powered SME insurance.

We aren't just building a company; we're leading a revolution. Our culture is intense, high-stakes, and mission-driven. We hire smart, ambitious "owners" who possess a relentless drive to win. This is an environment for those who thrive on challenges, value intellectual honesty, and share our mindset of becoming a global category leader.

Our founding team consists of seasoned entrepreneurs who have previously built iconic businesses like HelloFresh, Bloomon, and SumUp. We bring that same bias for speed, scale, and high standards to one of the most structurally broken experiences in financial services. Together, we combine that deep fintech and e-commerce expertise with cutting-edge AI to stay ahead of the curve.


What you’ll own in your first year

You won’t inherit a finished product shelf. You’ll build the engine that fills it.

  1. Build the product engine. Turn how we benchmark a market into a system: compare cover, limits and exclusions across local players, our Dutch home product and our other markets, so every new product starts from facts, not gut feeling.
  2. Make the call on cover. Decide what we cover, what we don’t and who we insure, and turn it into a proposal. The tools do the comparison; the judgment is yours.
  3. Get it signed. Take the proposal to our risk carriers and negotiate it. You know what to push on, what to let go and which clause will set off six red flags.
  4. Get it live. Adapt our wordings to each new market, run the legal review and launch. Less writing from scratch, more making one strong product fit the next market. Then track loss ratios, competition and customer feedback, and sharpen it.
  5. Build what doesn’t exist yet. In the markets where we double down, own custom products from the insurance side, including cover for the trades and businesses others decline.

Who you are

You’re an insurance expert first and a builder second, but a real one.

  • You have 5+ years hands-on in commercial P&C (Property & Casualty) at an insurer, MGA, (re)insurer or specialist broker, across underwriting, product and wordings, ideally for SMEs.
  • You know what is covered, what isn’t and what should be. Hand you a wording from a market you’ve never worked in and you’ll spot the gaps within minutes.
  • You’ve worked across more than one line, product or market, and you can apply what you know to a market you’ve never seen.
  • You’ve sat at the table with insurers or capacity providers and know where the red lines are.
  • You’d rather fix insurance than complain about it. Maybe you already tried: at an insurtech, an MGA, your own startup, or on the carrier side building products with insurtechs.
  • You think like the customer: plain questions, fair cover, and no excluding everything just to be safe.
  • You’re at home in Excel and data, and curious about what automation and LLMs can take off your plate. You don’t need to code; our product and tech teams build the digital journey with you.
  • You work fluently in English; German, French or Dutch is a big plus.

    • What we offer
  • Real ownership. You decide what we cover and work directly with the MT, close to where decisions get made.
  • Range. More products and markets in a year than most people see in a decade at an incumbent.
  • A share in what we build. Equity, so you share in the value you build.
  • A team that cares. We live by four values: Grit, Care, Impact and Entrepreneurship.
  • Growth. Room to grow into leading our insurance product work as we add markets, plus an in-house coaching and leadership program.
  • The package. Competitive salary package + 6% pension, holidays, well-being budget and rich social events (ski trip, summer and winter party).
  • The basics, done well. Office in central Amsterdam, laptop, hybrid working. Relocation support.

    • If you know insurance inside out and you’d rather build products than maintain them, we’d like to meet you. No cover letter needed.

e1ccf415db2b441c.title: Senior Security Operations Engineer
e1ccf415db2b441c.description:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

As a member of our Security Operations Team, you will collaborate with a global team of engineers to monitor and respond to security events, lead security incidents as Incident Commander, and lead digital forensic investigations in support of Employee Relations, Legal, Compliance, or Information Security cases.

Although you will be focused on security incident response, you will also have the opportunity to create and maintain runbooks, and automated workflows, and assist in process refinement and implementation. You will collaborate with a diverse team of engineers, and key stakeholders on security initiatives across the company. Above all, your focus is bringing Security expertise to the table in a collaborative, humble, and practical manner.

Location: This role is open to candidates residing in the UK

You should apply if:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Every phone call you answer and every email you send can affect whether truck drivers deliver goods on time and without accidents, whether students get dropped off safely from school, or whether power gets restored quickly after a natural disaster.
  • You thrive the most when solving problems: Our constantly expanding technology and the complexities faced by our customers provide an exciting range of challenges for our Customer Success teams. With a growth mindset and a desire to learn, you will strategically partner with our customers to find unique solutions to help keep their operations safe, efficient, and sustainable.
  • You are a natural relationship builder: Whether the relationship is with our customers or with cross-functional teams in Samsara, you are in constant communication and collaboration with key stakeholders to win as a team.
  • You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won't be your last at Samsara. This Customer Success team is still shaping its future and you will have plenty of autonomy and opportunities to master your craft in a hyper growth environment.
  • You want to be with the best: At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together and support each other. You will be surrounded by the best and brightest professionals out there.

In this role, you will: 

  • Monitor security events and provide technical analysis on alerts
  • Lead information security incidents and employee insider investigations by developing the incident response strategy, lead the execution through incident closure, while providing incident updates to key stakeholders throughout the incident
  • Deliver security guidance clearly and concisely for incident response and insider threat initiatives
  • Coordinate the building of services, capabilities, integrations, and implementations of technologies to support security operations, incident response, and insider threat
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara's cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices
  • Participate in our on-call rota covering weekends

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • 5+ years of experience in Security Incident Response
  • Ability to communicate investigative findings and strategies to technical staff, executive leadership, and legal
  • Ability to build scripts or tools to support Samsara's investigation processes, with proficiency in Python
  • Mentor and train security operation engineers on data collection, analysis, and reporting technical analysis
  • Practical experience acting as a lead during security incident response, including monitoring and triaging alerts, and coordinating across teams
  • Understanding of analysis and forensics techniques on macOS, Windows, and Linux
  • Experience utilizing SIEM tools to perform log reviews
  • Experience in cloud architecture and security (AWS, GCP) and cloud-based services
  • Participation in an on-call rotation, with the potential to work outside standard business hours, including late evenings, when responding to high-severity incidents as part of our global incident response team.
  • This role will be part of our EMEA so your hours will be aligned to the UK. As an operational time you may be expected to work flexible hours around this to support the load of the team

An ideal candidate also has:

  • 2+ years of experience working on insider threat initiatives or employee investigations
  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Security, or a related field - or relevant industry experience
  • GIAC Certified Incident Handler (GCIH) or similar Certification
  • Familiarity with common security frameworks and standards, including NIST Cybersecurity Framework, ISO 27001, FedRAMP

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you're ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working 

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual's ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations 

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara's Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in ----- ----- or ----- For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here.

6dd1bbe586bb8abb.title: Field Sales Representative - Amsterdam
6dd1bbe586bb8abb.description:
Lightspeed is driven by building the restaurant platform that helps restaurants adapt, take control, and get back to what they do best: building the businesses they love.

As a Field Account Executive, you will be part of a team that is transforming the way restaurants operate. Using a consultative approach, you will prospect, build relationships, and sign up new restaurateurs in your local area. By understanding their unique needs, you will develop a customised solution that helps their business thrive. We need your passion and sales expertise to help us build the Lightspeed brand in your area. 

Your responsibilities:

  • Generate lists of prospective restaurants and manage the entire sales cycle from initial outbound call/ walk in to close (experience with self-sourcing clients is a huge plus)

  • Conduct demos and develop a solution that best meets the prospect’s needs 

  • Partner with teams across the business to ensure that expectations set during the sales process are met in delivery

  • Leverage Salesforce (our CRM) to manage all sales activities

  • Understand the competitive landscape and determine how to best position Lightspeed in the market

What you will bring to the team: 

  • Dutch fluency is a must 

  • Experience in a sourcing or closing customers, restaurant operations, or a relatable field and industry

  • Since this is a field position, you will be out and about on a daily basis in your territory 

  • Strong communication, organisational and presentation skills with the ability to sell and negotiate at all decision-making levels

  • Proven track record of success in meeting and exceeding goals

  • Ability to work in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial and team environment

  • Self-motivated, creative, and flexible

  • General technical proficiency with software

  • Experience with Salesforce CRM is a plus

What’s in it for you?

Come Live the Lightspeed Experience….

  • Genuine career growth opportunities based on performance within a company that's continuously expanding.

  • Uncapped commission

  • Work with highly skilled people who are as passionate about sales & marketing as you are

  • An environment that encourages initiatives and leadership

  • Work in a team big enough for growth but lean enough to make a real impact;

and enjoy a range of benefits that’ll keep you happy, healthy and (not) hungry:

  • Lightspeed equity scheme (we are all owners)

  • Health & Wellness Credit- expense up to 400 EUR per year towards your gym membership, yoga classes, a new bike or whatever else you do for your health 

  • Mental Health Support through the Modern Health App- whether it is meditation, coaching or counseling you need - each employee gets access to this platform 

  • People Experience - Our PX benefit allows you to work from pretty much anywhere in the world for 60 days a year 

  • LinkedIn Learning: At Lightspeed we believe in having a growth mindset, we provide free access to LinkedIn learning along with your career GPS to help you learn & grow

  • Subsidy to annual travel pass if you travel by public transport to the office 

  • Regular breakfast or lunches, drinks & snacks in our Amsterdam office 

To all recruitment agencies: Lightspeed does not accept unsolicited agency resumes. If we have not directly engaged your company in writing to supply candidates for a specific vacancy, Lightspeed will not be responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.

Lightspeed is a proud equal opportunity employer and we are committed to creating an inclusive and barrier-free workplace. Lightspeed welcomes and encourages applications from people with disabilities. Accommodations are available on request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the selection process.

Where to from here?

Obviously, this has to be mutually beneficial: we want you to step into a role you love, and we want to offer you a place you’re proud to come to every day. For a glimpse into our world check out our career page here.

Lightspeed is building communities through commerce, and we need people from all backgrounds and lived experiences to do that. We were founded in 2005, in Montreal’s gay village and our original members were all part of the LGBTQ+ community. The ethos of our business has been about inclusion from the very beginning, and we strive to provide a workplace where everyone belongs.

Who we are:

Powering the businesses that are the backbone of the global economy, Lightspeed's one-stop commerce platform helps merchants innovate to simplify, scale, and provide exceptional customer experiences. Our cloud commerce solution transforms and unifies online and physical operations, multichannel sales, expansion to new locations, global payments, financial solutions, and connection to supplier networks.

Founded in Montréal, Canada in 2005, Lightspeed is dual-listed on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE: LSPD) and Toronto Stock Exchange (TSX: LSPD). With teams across North America, Europe, and Asia Pacific, the company serves retail, hospitality, and golf businesses in over 100 countries.

Lightspeed handles your information in accordance with our Applicant Privacy Statement.

d922ad26b7393bbb.title: Senior Business Controller (Operations)
d922ad26b7393bbb.description:
Would you like to work closely with the business as a Senior Business Controller and use your financial expertise to make a real impact on decisions? You will bring financial structure and insight, while keeping a forward-looking perspective: where can we improve, which decisions will make a financial difference, and what will they mean for our results?

HG is a compact, international organisation. This means considerable responsibility, direct contact with decision-makers and room to drive change yourself. We are therefore looking for someone who takes ownership, works pragmatically and is not afraid to challenge existing ways of working.

You will be based at our head office in Almere. Hybrid working opportunities are limited: regular office attendance is important in this role because of the close collaboration with Finance, Operations and other stakeholders. You will also travel to the United Kingdom or Germany several times a year.

About the role

As Senior Business Controller, you will be responsible for business control within Operations and will also support our subsidiaries in the United Kingdom and Germany. You have a clear vision of what the best operational business control model looks like and have proven experience in realizing this. The Senior Business Controller plays a key role in strengthening financial control, transparency and decision-making across Operations. The scope covers procurement and product costing, as well as warehouse and transport operations. Working closely with Finance, Procurement and Operations, the Senior Business Controller translates operational developments and improvement initiatives into clear financial insights and P&L impact

Our business is undergoing significant change. HG has recently changed its logistics service arrangements, consolidating most local warehouses into one central location as part of a cost-saving initiative. At the same time, a new ERP system is being implemented. This creates an interesting and dynamic environment in which existing budget models, cost allocation models, reporting and financial processes need to be further developed to reflect the new operating model and provide a solid basis for financial control and decision-making.

What you will do

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Owning the operational cost lines between Net Sales and Contribution Margin for the whole group and. act as a strong Finance business partner to the Chief Operating Officer and his team, translating operational developments into actionable financial insights;

  • Identifying and driving continuous improvements to the operational business, improving insights while reducing costs.

  • Being the financial business partner for the country managers in the UK and Germany, including reviewing commercial deals and business cases.

  • Analyzing budget versus actuals and explaining significant variances.

  • Developing a clear understanding of budgeted versus actual purchase prices and identifying the key drivers behind price variances.

  • Providing insight into raw material and purchase price developments and translating these into expected P&L impact.

  • Quantifying and tracking the financial impact of Procurement and product-costing initiatives and other savings programmes.

  • Establishing and further developing standard COGS based on expected cost developments.

  • Build a thorough understanding of the warehouse and distribution budget, operational performance and key savings initiatives. 

  • Track whether the expected savings from the recently implemented warehouse and transport provider change are being realized in the P&L. 

  • Further developing cost allocation models for individual markets, using meaningful drivers, and working towards more complete and reliable management reporting.

  • Ensuring the Operations P&L, budget and actual costs are consistently captured and reported in the same structure.

  • Translating inventory developments into financial impact and creating a clear link between stock levels, budget assumptions and cost allocation.

  • Supporting and improving an efficient month-end closing process, ensuring Operations costs are accurately and consistently booked, allocated and reconciled.

  • Establish or improve proper accounting entries together with Finance Administration and relevant operational partners.

  • Co-lead the annual budget cycle and budget presentations to the Board.

  • Using and improving Power BI, ERP data and financial processes to reduce manual work and increase transparency.

You will report directly to the Chief Financial Officer and work closely with colleagues in Finance, Procurement and Operations. You will also have regular contact with the Germany and UK country managers.

This position requires more than strong analytical skills. You will need to explain your insights clearly, engage stakeholders and constructively challenge where necessary. You will be a knowledgeable sparring partner who asks questions, brings structure and takes responsibility from analysis through to implementation. You proactively identify opportunities to improve financial processes, controls, reporting and transparency across Operations.

HG is a compact, fast-growing and international organization where you can directly see the impact of your work. This requires ownership, initiative and a pragmatic, results-oriented mindset. The team culture is open, pragmatic and focused on results, encouraging you to bring ideas forward, challenge constructively and take responsibility. Everything we do is guided by our three core values: Aim High, Be Brave, Be Connected.


What you bring

2e6c7584e78bf2a3.description:
Are you interested in working with a leading education technology player, the global leader in the assessment and certification of professional skills industry with presence in more than 200 countries worldwide? If so, this is the chance to apply now! 📥

Shape the future of PRINCE2. The home of modern projects, programme, and portfolio management.

PeopleCert is looking for a Product Manager to help take our PRINCE2 portfolio of Best Practice to the next level of success - developing compelling propositions for globally recognised PRINCE2 products that ensure wide adoption among senior audiences, new sectors and markets. You will be responsible for the day-to-day management of key products in the PRINCE2 portfolio – including certifications, official publications and learning materials – making sure they remain high quality, relevant and well supported in market.

As Product Manager for the PRINCE2 portfolio, you will work closely with teams across the business in order to support delivery of the overall roadmap and enable commercial success for your product set within the PRINCE2 portfolio.

As Product Manager PRINCE2 your tasks will be the following:

Product strategy and vision

  • Contribute to the product vision and strategy, and develop and maintain the roadmap for your product set.
  • Conduct market research and analysis to identify trends, customer needs, and competitive landscape that will inform the product strategy.
  • Track agreed product goals and KPIs, and recommend actions to improve performance.

Product management

  • Monitor and analyze product performance, making data-driven recommendations to optimize and enhance your products.
  • Prioritise maintenance and improvement activities for your in-market products, to ensure continued relevance and positive customer experience.

New product development

  • Work proactively and collaboratively with teams across the business to ensure all aspects of product development, launch and in-market support are considered early in the business case and product design phase
  • Support the successful development and launch of new or updated products
  • Participate in all aspects of Product design, including: persona development; full end-to-end user journeys; service blueprints; key content and technical specifications
  • Design and manage the testing strategy for all products in development, to ensure they are consistently meeting the needs of our target audiences

Stakeholder collaboration

  • Contribute key elements to the go-to-market plans developed by Marketing, including positioning, key messaging and more.
  • Contribute to pricing proposals for your product set by providing market, competitor and partner insight, and supporting the relevant internal teams in pricing decisions.
  • Engage with internal and external stakeholders to secure buy-in and understanding of the product vision.

What we look for:

  • Bachelor’s degree in marketing, business, or related field.
  • Minimum of 3 years’ experience in a Product Manager or Product Owner role in one of the following sectors: education, training, professional qualifications (e.g. ACA / CIPD etc.)
  • Knowledge of PeopleCert best practices and ideally familiar with PRINCE2 or other similar PPM (project, programme and portfolio) certification products.
  • Proven track record of managing multiple products and delivering successful outcomes.
  • Demonstrable experience of managing products through their whole lifecycle
  • Familiarity with all elements of product development, from discovery to delivery
  • Proven ability to evaluate product feedback objectively, and propose solutions to address business needs
  • Strong business/commercial acumen
  • Excellent people and management skills to interact with colleagues, cross-functional teams, and third parties around the world
  • Problem-solving and analytical capabilities.
  • Prior exposure in Education, Consulting, Examination/Certification, or Technology sectors will be considered an asset.
  • Excellent command of the English language (C2 level certification desired; LanguageCert C2 LTE or C2 IESOL a plus).
  • Advanced computer literacy required; ECDL Advanced certification desirable. Familiarity with Microsoft Dynamics CRM or equivalent software will be considered an added advantage.

What we offer:

  • The opportunity to shape globally recognized frameworks used by professionals around the world.
  • A collaborative, high-impact international team and a purpose-driven working culture.
  • Flexible working conditions (location and hours).
  • Two free vouchers for all certifications from PeopleCert's Portfolio per year for all employees
  • Competitive compensation and personal development opportunities.
  • A global network of professionals and subject matter experts.

If you want to become a member of our international, dynamic and agile team that creates world leading software products, then we should certainly like to hear from you!

About PeopleCert

PeopleCert is a global leader in assessment and certification of professional skills, partnering with multi-national organizations and government bodies for the development & delivery of standardized exams. Delivering exams across 200 countries and in 25 languages over its state-of-the-art assessment technology, PeopleCert enables professionals to boost their careers and realize their life ambitions.

Quality, Innovation, Passion, Integrity, Clarity, and Velocity are the core values which guide everything we do.

Our offices in UK, Greece, and Cyprus boast a culture of diversity, where everyone is different, yet everyone fits in. All of us at PeopleCert are committed to the reflection of the diversity and inclusion of our customers and the communities in which we do business.

Working on Home Office (HO) Secure English Language Tests (SELTs)

Any person who is engaged by PeopleCert to work on the SELT service must undergo a Background Check (the results of which must be acceptable to PeopleCert and the HO) prior to commencing their SELT duties. All SELT personnel will be required to complete a declaration (provided by PeopleCert) where the existence of any criminal record and/or bankruptcy must be declared.

If working on the SELT service in the UK, background checks will include:

  • A basic or enhanced Disclosure Barring Service (DBS) check
  • Right to Work in the UK check (including nationality, identity and place of residence)
  • HO security check (Baseline Personnel Security Standard (BPSS) or Counter Terrorist Check (CTC)
  • Financial background check
  • Employment reference check.
  • If working on the SELT service anywhere in the world (outside of the UK) personnel will undergo background checks that are equivalent to those stated for the UK.

In addition, if personnel are required to speak to SELT candidates they must be appropriately skilled in English language and, where SELT services are provided anywhere in the world (outside of the UK), the official language of the relevant country.

All applications will be treated with strict confidentiality.

28179a29481f935d.description:
About The Role

We are looking for senior leaders in strategy & operations roles who value learning, growth, and community and who are passionate about developing and coaching people in their field.

We are specifically looking for coaches who have experience in Singapore or Hong Kong serving the SEA region, or experience in market including Japan, India, South Korea, and Australia.

As a Mento coach, you will form 1:1 partnerships with our members to help them identify & track clear goals, become a better leader, communicate more effectively, problem solve issues at work, and help them feel happy, fulfilled, and engaged at work and beyond.

All Mento coaches, regardless of coaching experience, are required to participate in our ICF-certified coach training program to learn Mentoâs coaching methodology prior to working with our members. Our coach training is an immersive, transformational training designed to help you grow as a coach, master the Mento Coaching Methodology, and gain access to proprietary tools that set our coaches apart. This program is ICF-certified, and participants who successfully graduate will earn Continuing Coach Education Units. If youâre ready to elevate your coaching skills, deepen your impact, and become part of a groundbreaking coaching team, we encourage you to apply and take the next step in your journey!

Your routine responsibilities will include:

  • Providing 1:1 coaching to Mento members through virtual sessions using the Mento Platform and Tools

  • Participating in ongoing training sessions to improve coaching abilities and skills

  • Communicating with members via your Mento email or via chat in the Mento App in between sessions

  • Being an integral member of the Mento coaching community by sharing coaching tools and insights â helping enhance our coaching practices and fulfill our mission of empowering people to thrive in jobs that they love

  • Acting with kindness, respect, and empathy as an ambassador of the Mento community

Who are you?

You areâ¦

  • A director, vice president, or other senior strategy & operations leader with 20+ years experience managing strategy & ops teams and coaching individuals (coaching certification is a plus but not required).

  • Someone who wants to turn their people leadership skills into meaningful coaching skills.

  • Passionate about helping people advance in the workplace to build fulfilling careers and lives.

  • A person who is self aware, who has a high emotional IQ, and who cares about creating a safe space for others to risk being vulnerable.

  • Excited about growing your coaching skills, and you bring a growth-mindset to the experience, regardless of how long you have been a coach.

  • Comfortable working in a constantly-changing startup environment.

  • Able to dedicate a minimum of 12+ hours per month to coaching at Mento for the next 24+ months.

At Mento, we invite new coaches to join us on a rolling basis. The time frame on which we add new coaches is based on the particular needs of our clients and their teams. While we may not need to add an Operations & Strategy VP Coach today, we would still be very excited for you to get in touch with us now if this opportunity resonates with you.

Other details

  • This is a contract position in which coaches are paid per hour. On top of a flat hourly rate, we offer select bonuses that incentivizes engagement with our membership and community growth on our platform

  • You must have the capacity to give a minimum of three to five hours per week towards Mento regardless of other commitments and how they may change.

  • You are able to work with Mento for a minimum of 24 months in order to build meaningful relationships with our members.

  • This is a fully remote position. Candidates must be based in North America or Europe.

  • Because this is a part-time growth opportunity, we are looking to hire experienced senior leaders who want to expand their coaching skills.

Our Hiring Philosophy:
All new Mento coaches are required to participate and graduate from our ICF certified coach training program: Mento Coaching 101. This training is rigorous, and our goal is that all participants are able to be matched with members soon after they complete it. We want to make sure that we are both setting our coaches up for success and respecting everyoneâs time. Therefore, we hire based on incoming member demand. While we are constantly looking and interviewing for the best coaches to join our team, we will only send offers to candidates for whom we have an immediate need. Candidates who receive a YES from Mento after the interview process will either be sent an offer to join the next monthly Coaching 101 training or be added to our coach shortlist to join us when the demand is there.

Inclusion Statement:
We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Research shows that candidates from unrepresented backgrounds may not apply to jobs unless they meet 100% of the job requirements. We strongly believe that diversity of experience, perspectives, and background will lead to a better environment for our employees and a better product for our users. We encourage you to apply even if you do not meet all the requirements.

fdcd4296eee4cdea.description:
Why SoftwareOne?

SoftwareOne is a global software and cloud solutions provider and distributor, powered by around 12,000 people across more than 70 countries. But what really makes us SoftwareOne is our people: curious minds, different perspectives, and talented teams working together to solve real challenges and create meaningful impact. Here, you’ll have the opportunity to grow, explore new possibilities, and build a career that’s uniquely yours, while helping shape what’s next in technology.


The role

  • Interested in building a greenfield, modern and forward-looking risk function where data, technology, and independent insight inform strategic decision-making?
  • Looking for a role with meaningful influence across executive leadership, the Board, and the wider business?

Practical Information

Location:Europe | Reports to: Global Head of Internal Audit, with direct access to the Audit Committee and Executive Board | Team:Group Risk Function of 3 FTE initially, will grow to 6 FTE | Language requirements: Fluent English, written and verbal | Learn more: softwareone.com

The Role

We are looking to appoint a Chief Risk Officer to lead SoftwareOne’s second-line Group Risk function and further develop our enterprise-wide approach to risk management. This is a newly established leadership role with a broad global mandate. You will bring an independent, enterprise-wide perspective on risk, ensuring that risk insight is embedded in strategic and commercial decision-making and supports SoftwareOne as the business continues to evolve. A central part of the role is to shape the next stage of SoftwareOne’s risk maturity, building a forward-looking, data-led and technology-enabled function that combines effective governance with practical business partnership and strengthens risk ownership across the organization. You will work closely with executive leadership and the Audit Committee, while collaborating across Finance, Legal, Compliance, Information Security, Data Protection, and Internal Audit. This is a hands-on, high-energy role for a leader who wants to be judged on measurable impact: you will personally shape the models, challenge the numbers, and tell the risk story to the Board.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own and continuously evolve SoftwareOne's enterprise risk management framework, risk appetite, tolerances and taxonomy, maintaining a consolidated view of strategic, operational, financial, technology, regulatory and emerging risks
  • Provide independent oversight and constructive challenge across the Group, monitoring risk exposure against appetite and ensuring timely escalation of material risks and breaches to executive and Board-level stakeholders
  • Strengthen forward-looking risk management through quantitative risk assessment (including financial quantification of principal risks and loss ranges, e.g., Monte Carlo simulation), scenario analysis, stress testing, key risk indicators and horizon scanning, bringing risk insight into strategic decisions, major transformations and significant commercial initiatives
  • Oversee the Group’s ICFR program end-to-end, including reporting on overall ICFR effectiveness to the Executive Board and Audit Committee, and provide second-line oversight of internal control and financial compliance frameworks, working closely with Finance and other control functions
  • Develop and mature SoftwareOne’s business continuity, crisis management, and operational resilience capability, while actively applying risk technology, analytics, automation, and AI to improve risk insight and decision-making
  • Lead and develop the Group Risk function and establish effective risk governance, including the Management Risk Committee, executive and Audit Committee reporting, and collaboration across key business functions

What we need to see from you

  • Significant senior leadership experience in enterprise risk management, including leading a second-line risk function within a complex multinational or similarly governed organization
  • A proven track record of designing, building, or significantly maturing ERM frameworks, risk appetite, governance, and executive and Board-level risk reporting, with specific, quantified examples of impact delivered
  • Strong quantitative and analytical risk capabilities, with hands-on experience in risk modelling, scenario analysis, stress testing, key risk indicators, and data-led decision support
  • Strong knowledge of internal control and financial compliance frameworks, including hands-on experience building, overseeing, or assessing ICFR, SOX, or equivalent programs
  • Sound independent judgement and credibility when engaging and constructively challenging senior executives, Audit or Risk Committees, and Boards, combined with a pragmatic and commercially minded approach to risk
  • An energetic, hands-on and technology-forward approach, with a bias for action and the ability to personally build risk models, drive new capabilities, and apply GRC technology, analytics, automation, and AI to strengthen risk management and decision-making
  • Strong communication and storytelling skills, with the ability to translate complex quantitative, operational, and financial risks into clear, compelling narratives for senior audiences

What's On Offer

  • The opportunity to shape and mature SoftwareOne’s Group Risk function with a mandate covering ERM, risk appetite, financial control oversight, resilience, risk data, and reporting
  • Direct engagement with the Executive Board and Audit Committee, with the independence to provide objective challenge and escalate material risks where required
  • The opportunity to develop a more quantitative and forward-looking approach to risk, incorporating scenario modelling, continuous monitoring, analytics, and risk-sensing capabilities
  • Influence across strategic decisions including M&A and integration, major transformation, new products and markets, large deals, and technology and AI adoption
  • The mandate to advance SoftwareOne’s risk technology environment, including an integrated risk platform, automated KRI feeds, dashboards, continuous monitoring, and responsible use of AI
  • The opportunity to build and develop a multidisciplinary Group Risk team spanning enterprise risk, financial compliance, risk data and reporting, with business continuity and resilience capability planned as the function develops to be added as the functions develops, subject to confirmation

Job Function

Finance

Accommodations

SoftwareOne welcomes applicants from all backgrounds and abilities to apply. If you require reasonable adjustments at any point during the recruitment process, email us at .

Please include the role for which you are applying and your country location. Someone from our organization that is not part of the decision-making process will be in touch to discuss your specific needs and we will make every effort to accommodate you. Any information shared will be stored securely and treated in the strictest of confidence in line with GDPR.

At SoftwareOne, we are committed to providing an environment of mutual respect where equal employment opportunities are available to all applicants and teammates without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws. Additionally, we encourage experienced individuals that have taken an intentional career break and are now prepared to return to work to explore our SOAR program.

Hiring: Full-Time AI Automation Engineer (Voice AI & Middleware Integration) - Remote

🚀 About the Client 🚀

🤖 AI voice employees for the trades– Delivers 24/7 AI voice agents that answer calls and texts, capture qualified leads, and book jobs for home-service contractors.

🔌 Middleware & Field Service Platform Integrations

Review this Doc first!

How to Prepare for the Recruiting Process -

📢 Why Are They Hiring an AI Automation Engineer (Voice AI & Middleware Integration)? 🏢

Our client is hiring an AI Automation Engineer to bring all technical development, deployment, and fulfillment fully in-house, replacing a third-party agency that currently handles it. You'll build and own the custom middleware that connects AI voice platforms (Vapi, Retell, Assistable within GoHighLevel) to field service management systems like ServiceTitan and Housecall Pro, so live phone conversations turn into accurate, booked jobs on a contractor's dispatch board. Beyond the build, your mission is reliability: proactively testing and monitoring voice agents so contractors get zero downtime and high booking accuracy, documenting the systems in clear SOPs, and laying the technical groundwork for upcoming enterprise industry partnerships in 2027. This is a hands-on, high-ownership role where you'll work directly with the founder and grow into technical leadership as the team expands.

If you're a proactive, code-first engineer who loves building voice agents and integrations that actually work in the real world, and you take pride in systems that never miss a call—this role could be a great fit for you. ✨

✅ Qualifications:

Must-Haves:

  • 🎙️ Voice AI Agent Experience– Hands-on experience building and deploying production voice agents with Vapi, Retell, Assistable, and/or ElevenLabs, including prompt tuning, latency optimization, and knowledge base design.
  • 💻 Real Coding Skills– Strong JavaScript and/or TypeScript; you write, review, and debug your own code (no "vibe coding"). Comfort reading .NET / C# / C++ environments is a big plus.
  • 🔌 APIs, Middleware & Integrations– Proven experience building middleware and integrations using REST APIs, OAuth, webhooks, and SDKs.
  • ⚙️ GoHighLevel Expertise– Solid experience building workflows, automations, and sub-account setups in GoHighLevel (GHL).
  • 🤖 Automation & Agent Frameworks– Experience with n8n, Hermes Agents, Composio, OpenClaw, or similar automation and agentic AI platforms.
  • 🔐 Security-Minded– Solid grasp of API security, data privacy, credential vaults, VPNs, and VPS hosting.
  • 💬 Clear Communication & Ownership– Fluent written and spoken English, comfortable supporting clients directly, and able to work independently without constant supervision.

Nice-to-Haves:

  • 🏠 Field Service Management Experience– Direct experience with ServiceTitan or Housecall Pro, or with home service trades (HVAC, plumbing, electrical).
  • 🧠 Advanced AI Concepts– Familiarity with RAG, MCP, and vector databases.
  • 🌐 Web & Marketing Tech– Website builders, hosting, landing pages, Google Business Profile, and AEO/SEO automation.
  • 🧑‍💻 Software Engineering Background– Software engineers or full-stack developers who have moved into AI automation and voice agents are an ideal match.

Responsibilities of the AI Automation Engineer (Voice AI & Middleware Integration):

Your responsibilities include:

🔌 Middleware & Field Service Platform Integrations

  • Build and maintain custom middleware connecting AI voice platforms (Vapi, Retell, Assistable within GoHighLevel) to Field Service Management (FSM) systems
  • Integrate with platforms like ServiceTitan and Housecall Pro using REST APIs and OAuth
  • Write integration logic that interfaces with .NET / C# / C++ backend environments
  • Program and verify end-to-end booking workflows that move live voice conversations straight into contractor dispatch schedules
  • Monitor, diagnose, and resolve sync issues such as duplicate bookings, dropped data payloads, or failed scheduling attempts
  • Code, review, and debug custom application logic in JavaScript and/or TypeScript

🎙️ Voice AI Agent Engineering & Tuning

  • Build, configure, and maintain production-grade voice agents using Vapi, Retell, Assistable, and ElevenLabs
  • Fine-tune latency, test prompt frameworks, design agent harnesses, and curate dynamic knowledge bases
  • Architect multi-step decision trees and parent-child logic (e.g., distinguishing a tenant from a commercial property manager during an emergency call)
  • Run automated tests on conversational accuracy, speech recognition, and intent categorization to catch bugs before clients do
  • Keep after-hours call answering and emergency dispatch agents running reliably

⚙️ Omnichannel & Back-Office Automation

  • Build and manage GoHighLevel workflows across SMS, email, appointment reminders, and estimate follow-up campaigns
  • Implement automations using platforms such as Hermes, OpenClaw, Composio, and n8n
  • Build AI agents that securely log into third-party portals to complete repetitive contractor admin tasks
  • Help build, test, and deploy company-wide automation packages for beta client accounts

🤝 Client Onboarding & Technical Support

  • Join technical onboarding calls with new clients to gather system requirements, parameters, and integration details
  • Execute full client setup and integration during a typical two-month implementation window
  • Connect client information to their respective GoHighLevel sub-accounts
  • Proactively verify that client systems, credentials, and automations stay active, secure, and up to date
  • Handle technical support and troubleshooting when clients report issues
  • Escalate and resolve platform bugs directly with SaaS vendor support teams (including GoHighLevel)
  • Build client-facing and internal dashboards tracking voice minutes, booking volume, and system activity

📋 Internal Operations, Process Automation & SOPs

  • Configure internal GoHighLevel automations (e.g., sending service agreements after payment, kicking off projects when documents are signed)
  • Document technical architectures and create SOPs for internal team execution
  • Recommend technical solutions and collaborate with the founder on system design
  • Work alongside the current fulfillment agency during a short overlap period to absorb existing workflows and system logic before taking full ownership

🔐 Data Security & Credential Management

  • Enforce data privacy, API security, and protection protocols for client records and backend integrations
  • Manage and share sensitive credentials securely using tools like LastPass, NordPass, or One-Time Secret
  • Work through designated secure environments and VPN platforms

🌐 Secondary Technical & Marketing Projects (Nice-to-Have)

  • Implement Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) and automated AI content workflows
  • Support Google Business Profile connections and local marketing automations

5a21e31000663431.description:
About the Opportunity

Speria is looking for a hands-on Cloud Engineer to support customer-facing Microsoft Azure environments across EMEA. This role combines cloud infrastructure engineering, systems administration, production operations, deployment support, and direct customer interaction. You will help build new environments, keep live platforms healthy, troubleshoot customer-impacting issues, and improve reliability through monitoring, automation, documentation, and repeatable operating practices.

This is not a traditional help desk role or a purely architectural position. It is designed for an engineer who enjoys both creating infrastructure and owning what happens after it goes live.

Speria provides enterprise technology that helps the live animal protein industry use real-time information to improve operational insight and responsible production across the supply chain.

What You Will Do

  • Design, deploy, configure, and support Microsoft Azure infrastructure for customer environments.

  • Manage Azure networking, compute, storage, identity, monitoring, security, databases, and application-hosting components within the scope of the role.

  • Support customer onboarding, environment provisioning, implementations, go-lives, production cutovers, and post-deployment stabilization.

  • Monitor environment health, availability, performance, capacity, and cloud cost signals; identify and drive improvement opportunities.

  • Troubleshoot infrastructure, connectivity, database, performance, and Azure platform issues affecting live customer environments.

  • Review logs and monitoring data, identify root causes, resolve issues independently where possible, and escalate effectively when development or other specialists are needed.

  • Automate repetitive operational and administrative work with PowerShell.

  • Improve alerts, monitoring coverage, runbooks, standards, documentation, and repeatable operating procedures.

  • Work directly with customer IT teams on Azure, networking, security, connectivity, deployment, and incident-related needs.

  • Partner across Engineering, Infrastructure, Projects, Product, Development, and customer-facing teams.

  • Participate in occasional after-hours or weekend work when required for approved customer go-lives or production cutovers.

What You Bring

  • 5+ years of experience in cloud infrastructure engineering, systems engineering, infrastructure operations, or a related technical role.

  • Strong hands-on Microsoft Azure experience in production environments.

  • Experience with Azure networking, compute, storage, identity, monitoring, and security.

  • Proficiency with PowerShell scripting and automation, supported by practical examples.

  • Windows Server and systems administration experience.

  • Experience supporting production systems, customer-facing applications, hosted cloud environments, or B2B SaaS platforms.

  • Strong troubleshooting, incident-response, root-cause analysis, documentation, and continuous-improvement skills.

  • Confidence communicating in English with internal stakeholders and external customer IT teams.

  • A proactive operating mindset focused on preventing incidents, not only reacting to them.

Helpful, but Not Required

  • Terraform or another Infrastructure as Code platform.

  • Azure App Insights, Stackify, Redgate, SQL Monitor, or comparable monitoring and observability tools.

  • Azure SQL, SQL Server, Cosmos DB, Databricks, Git, or CI/CD pipeline exposure.

  • Microsoft Azure certifications such as Azure Administrator Associate, Azure Solutions Architect Expert, or similar.

  • Experience in an MSP, consulting, implementation, or multi-customer cloud environment.

  • Python or Bash scripting; cloud cost optimization; SOC 2 or ISO 27001 familiarity.

  • Experience working with globally distributed teams. German language capability is a plus if aligned to the final market strategy.

How Success Will Be Measured

  • Reliable deployment and support of customer Azure environments.

  • Successful customer onboarding, go-live, and post-deployment stabilization.

  • Stronger EMEA cloud support coverage during European business hours.

  • Timely, well-communicated resolution of infrastructure, networking, connectivity, and platform issues.

  • Improved monitoring, automation, documentation, and operational repeatability.

  • Strong collaboration with internal teams and customer IT stakeholders.

EEO Statement
Integrated into our shared values is Speria MTech’s commitment to diversity and equal employment opportunity. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, age, race, color, creed, religion, national origin, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, military service, genetic information, or any other characteristic or conduct protected by law. Speria MTech is committed to being a globally inclusive company where all people are treated fairly, recognized for their individuality, promoted based on performance, and encouraged to strive to reach their full potential. We believe in understanding and respecting differences among all people. Every individual at Speria MTech has an ongoing responsibility to respect and support a globally diverse environment.

df69723e6b08d0e6.description:
Would you like to engage and hire top talent for a premier technology company?

Do you enjoy building diverse and inclusive teams?

Join the Akamai Talent Acquisition team

Our team is passionate about building an inclusive and engaged workforce forming the foundation of Akamai's culture. We're a team of innovative thinkers who are committed to making Akamai a great place to work. Our goal is to bring the very best experience to all colleagues around the globe.

Partner with the best

As a Senior Recruiter you will partner with leaders to establish and execute on creative recruiting strategies. Collaborating with the hiring community you'll become a trusted talent advisor providing guidance throughout the recruiting process. People are our most valuable asset and you will ensure that we hire the best!

As a Senior Recruiter, you will be responsible for:

  • Creating processes and best practices to ensure delivery of diverse talent pools
  • Partnering proactively with the hiring community to understand and plan for hiring needs
  • Influencing and continuously improving on the experience of internal stakeholders, candidates, and new hires
  • Providing regular reporting and metrics updates to hiring community and HR leadership teams

Do what you love

To be successful in this role you will:

  • Have 8 years of relevant experience including full life-cycle recruiting experience, ideally in a corporate environment
  • Demonstrate the ability to partner with business leaders to develop and execute on recruiting strategies
  • Possess knowledge of various recruiting tools such as search engines and social media
  • Have experience with Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS) and knowledge of OFCCP guidelines
  • Be knowledgeable about the labor market and hiring trends, ideally in the technology sector
  • Be passionate about partnering and providing world class customer service to stakeholders across Akamai's business units

About us

At Akamai, we make life better for billions of people, trillions of times a day.
Whether you're streaming live events, scrolling social media, watching your favorite series, or managing your savings, we're the engine behind the scenes. We provide the world's most distributed platform from Cloud to Edge to help the giants of the digital world work faster and stay more secure, making the internet a better experience for everyone.

Our focus is simple:

Cloud and Edge: Running apps closer to users for instant performance.

a61bfac0331b84f7.title: Automation Test Engineer – API & Playwright
a61bfac0331b84f7.description:
ARS is seeking a mid to senior level, detail-oriented QA Automation Test Engineer to join our quality assurance team. The successful candidate will have strong experience in API Testing and testing using Playwright. The ideal candidate will be responsible for testing software applications, identifying defects, and ensuring our products meet quality standards before release.

Why Work with us?

Applied Research Solutions (ARS) is respected as a world-class provider of technically integrated solutions as we deliver premier talent and technology across our focused markets for unparalleled, continuous mission support. Awarded a Best Places to Work nominee since 2020, ARS recognizes that without our career- driven, loyal professionals, we would not be able to deliver state-of-the-art results for our mission partners. We firmly believe that prioritizing our employees is of the upmost importance. We provide a culture where our employees are challenged to meet their career goals and aspirations, while still obtaining a work/life balance. ARS employees are motivated through our industry competitive benefits package, our awards and recognition program, and personalized attention from ARS Senior Managers.

Responsibilitiesinclude:

  • Design, develop and execute API test cases (functional, regression, integration, performance and security tests)
  • Design, develop and execute Playwright test cases
  • Validate API responses for accuracy, performance, reliability and compliance with business requirements
  • Use API tools to automate and execute test suites
  • Analyze API logs, errors and response payloads to identify defects and root causes
  • Collaborate with developers, product owners and Test team members to review API specifications and clarify requirements
  • Create and maintain automated API test scripts using scripting languages
  • Integrate API automation tests into CI/CD pipelines (Gitlab)
  • Document test cases, test results and defects with clear reproduction steps
  • Ensure API quality standards including performance, scalability and security best practices
  • Participate in requirements review meetings to ensure testability and quality considerations
  • Maintain and update test documentation and procedures
  • Support release management activities and deployment testing
  • Perform compatibility testing across different browsers, devices, and operating systems
  • Contribute to test automation efforts when applicable
  • Other duties as required

Qualifications / Technical experience required:

  • Must be a US citizen
  • Active Secret Clearance
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field, or equivalent experience
  • Security +
  • Strong understanding of software testing methodologies and best practices
  • Experience with Playwright and TypeScript/JavaScript, including integrating those tests into CI/CD pipelines
  • Experience testing web applications and APIs
  • Experience with API testing tools (Swagger)
  • Gitlab experience
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Excellent written and verbal communication abilities
  • Attention to detail and commitment to quality

All positions at Applied Research Solutions are subject to background investigations. Employment is contingent upon successful completion of a background investigation including criminal history and identity check.

This regulation prohibits discrimination against qualified individuals on the basis of disability, and requires affirmative action by covered prime contractors and subcontractors to employ and advance in employment qualified individuals with disabilities.

This regulation prohibits discrimination against qualified protected veterans, and requires affirmative action by covered contractors and subcontractors to employ and advance in employment qualified protected veterans.

0fcfba7fe7415104.title: Senior Business Architect – Banking Transformation
0fcfba7fe7415104.description:
📍 Ubicación: Madrid / Barcelona
🏠 Modalidad: Remoto, con visitas puntuales a oficinas.

Sobre la oportunidad

Buscamos un/a Senior Business Architect para incorporarse al equipo de Arquitectura Empresarial de una importante entidad del sector financiero.

La persona seleccionada participará en iniciativas estratégicas de transformación bancaria, conectando la estrategia de negocio con las capacidades organizativas, los modelos operativos y la evolución tecnológica de la entidad.

Se trata de una posición transversal, con alta exposición a stakeholders de negocio, responsables de transformación, arquitectos corporativos y líderes tecnológicos.

Principales responsabilidades

  • Definir y evolucionar capacidades de negocio, procesos y cadenas de valor.

  • Diseñar modelos funcionales y operativos alineados con la estrategia corporativa.

  • Participar en la definición de arquitecturas objetivo (Target Architecture) y modelos operativos (Target Operating Model – TOM).

  • Identificar oportunidades de transformación, simplificación y mejora organizativa.

  • Realizar análisis de impacto, identificación de brechas y definición de hojas de ruta.

  • Facilitar workshops y sesiones de trabajo entre las áreas de negocio y tecnología.

  • Alinear las iniciativas de transformación con los objetivos estratégicos de la organización.

  • Elaborar propuestas, recomendaciones y documentación para comités y órganos de decisión.

Requisitos imprescindibles

  • Más de 5 años de experiencia específica en Business Architecture, Enterprise Architecture o consultoría estratégica y de transformación.

  • Experiencia en banca, servicios financieros o consultoría especializada en el sector financiero.

  • Experiencia en definición de capacidades de negocio, modelos operativos y transformación organizativa.

  • Participación en programas de transformación transversales, con múltiples áreas y stakeholders.

  • Capacidad para conectar necesidades de negocio con soluciones y capacidades tecnológicas.

  • Experiencia interactuando con perfiles directivos y equipos multidisciplinares.

  • Inglés profesional.

Conocimientos valorables

  • Business Architecture y Business Capability Mapping.

  • Value Stream Mapping.

  • Target Operating Model (TOM).

  • Marcos y metodologías de arquitectura empresarial:

    • BIAN.

    • TOGAF.

    • ArchiMate.

    • BPMN.

  • Experiencia en dominios bancarios como banca retail, empresas, riesgos, pagos, onboarding digital o banca privada.

Se valorará especialmente la experiencia práctica con BIAN y marcos de arquitectura empresarial aplicados al sector financiero.

Competencias clave

  • Visión estratégica y capacidad de análisis sistémico.

  • Pensamiento estructurado y resolución de problemas complejos.

  • Comunicación ejecutiva y capacidad de síntesis.

  • Influencia transversal y gestión de stakeholders.

  • Habilidad para facilitar conversaciones entre negocio y tecnología.

  • Autonomía, iniciativa y orientación a resultados.

¿Qué perfiles buscamos?

Profesionales con una clara orientación a la arquitectura de negocio y transformación bancaria, capaces de analizar organizaciones complejas y definir cómo deben evolucionar sus capacidades, procesos y modelos operativos.

No buscamos perfiles centrados exclusivamente en arquitectura de infraestructura, Cloud, software, desarrollo, arquitectura de soluciones tecnológicas o gestión de proyectos IT, ni analistas funcionales sin experiencia en transformación de negocio.
