a33a5f72098be9a9.title: CRA I - Shanghai
a33a5f72098be9a9.description:
CRA I - Shanghai

Syneos Health® is a leading fully-integrated life sciences services organization built to accelerate customer success. We partner with innovators at every point across the drug development and commercialization continuum, helping them navigate complexity, anticipate change and accelerate progress.

Our Clinical Solutions team members act with a drug development mindset, applying their years of experience and deep expertise to truly understand customer needs and represent those in the solutions we shape.

Whether you join us in a Functional Service Provider partnership or a Full-Service environment, you’ll collaborate with passionate problem solvers, innovating as a team to help our customers achieve their goals. We are agile and driven to deliver – for one another, our customers, and, most importantly, for those in need.

Discover what your 25,000 future colleagues already know:

Why Syneos Health

• We are passionate about developing our people, through career development and progression; supportive and engaged line management; technical and therapeutic area training; peer recognition and total rewards program.
• We are committed to building an inclusive culture – where you can authentically be yourself. Central to this is our purpose – Driven to Deliver – which captures the passion of our colleagues to show up each day and shape solutions that have the ability to dramatically impact someone’s life.
• We are continuously building the company we all want to work for and our customers want to work with. Why? Because we know that when we bring together smart colleagues from across the world, we can shape the future of healthcare, driving impact for customers and defining the pace of patient progress.

Job Responsibilities

  • Performs site qualification, site initiation, interim monitoring, site management activities and close-out visits (performed on-site or remotely) ensuring regulatory, ICH-GCP and/or Good Pharmacoepidemiology Practice (GPP) and protocol compliance. Uses judgment and experience to evaluate overall performance of site and site staff and to provide recommendations regarding site-specific actions; immediately communicates/escalates serious issues to the project team and develops action plans. Maintains a working knowledge of ICH/GCP Guidelines or other applicable guidance, relevant regulations, and company SOPs/processes.
  • Verifies the process of obtaining informed consent has been adequately performed and documented for each subject/patient, as required/appropriate. Demonstrates diligence in protecting the confidentiality of each subject/patient. Assesses factors that might affect subject/patient’s safety and clinical data integrity at an investigator/physician site such as protocol deviation/violations and pharmacovigilance issues.
  • Per the Clinical Monitoring/Site Management Plan (CMP/SMP): Assesses site processes. Conducts Source Document Review of appropriate site source documents and medical records. Verifies required clinical data entered in the case report form (CRF) is accurate and complete. Applies query resolution techniques remotely and on site, and provides guidance to site staff as necessary, driving query resolution to closure within agreed timelines. Utilizes available hardware and software to support the effective conduct of the clinical study data review and capture. Verifies site compliance with electronic data capture requirements.
  • May perform investigational product (IP) inventory, reconciliation and reviews storage and security. Verifies the IP has been dispensed and administered to subjects/patients according to the protocol. Verifies issues or risks associated with blinded or randomized information related to IP. Applies knowledge of GCP/local regulations and organizational procedures to ensure IP is appropriately (re)labelled, imported and released/returned.
  • Routinely reviews the Investigator Site File (ISF) for accuracy, timeliness and completeness. Reconciles contents of the ISF with the Trial Master File (TMF). Ensures the investigator/physician site is aware of the requirement of archiving essential documents in accordance with local guidelines and regulations.
  • Documents activities via confirmation letters, follow-up letters, trip reports, communication logs, and other required project documents as per SOPs and Clinical Monitoring Plan/Site Management Plan. Supports subject/patient recruitment, retention and awareness strategies. Enters data into tracking systems as required to track all observations, ongoing status and assigned action items to resolution.
  • For assigned activities, understands project scope, budgets, and timelines; manages site-level activities / communication to ensure project objectives, deliverables and timelines are met. Must be able to quickly adapt to changing priorities to achieve goals / targets.
  • May act as primary liaison with study site personnel, or in collaboration with Central Monitoring Associate. Ensures all assigned sites and project-specific site team members are trained and compliant with applicable requirements
  • Prepares for and attends Investigator Meetings and/or sponsor face to face meetings. Participates in global clinical monitoring/project staff meetings (inclusive of Sponsor representation, as applicable) and attends clinical training sessions according to the project specific requirements.
  • Provides guidance at the site and project level towards audit readiness standards and supports preparation for audit and required follow-up actions.
  • Maintains a working knowledge of ICH/GCP Guidelines or other applicable guidance, relevant regulations, and company SOPs/processes; completes assigned training as required. For Real World Late Phase, the CRA II will use the business card title of Site Management Associate II. Additional responsibilities include:Site support throughout the study lifecycle from site identification through close-out. Knowledge of local requirements for real world late phase study designs.Chart abstraction activities and data collection
    Collaboration with Sponsor affiliates, medical science liaisons and local country staff. The SMA II may be requested to train junior staff. Identify and communicate out of scope activities to Lead CRA/Project Manager. Proactively suggest potential sites based on local knowledge of treatment patterns, patient advocacy and Health Care Provider (HCP) associations.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree or RN in a related field or equivalent combination of education, training and experience
  • Knowledge of Good Clinical Practice/ICH Guidelines and other applicable regulatory requirements
  • Must demonstrate good computer skills and be able to embrace new technologies
  • Excellent communication, presentation and interpersonal skills
  • Ability to manage required travel of up to 75% on a regular basis
  • US ONLY: As part of your employment with Syneos Health, you may be deployed to Sites that require certain medical and other personal information to gain facility access. Pursuant to our Employee Privacy Notice, Syneos Health can provide the Sites with the information necessary for you to gain such access. Further, a Site may ask you for additional information beyond that which Syneos Health has in its possession. You are required to comply with any such Site requests as a condition of your employment with Syneos Health. Please note that failure to provide requested information may result in a Site barring you from entry, which could put your ongoing employment at risk.

Get to know Syneos Health

Over the past 5 years, we have worked with 94% of all Novel FDA Approved Drugs, 95% of EMA Authorized Products and over 200 Studies across 73,000 Sites and 675,000+ Trial patients.

No matter what your role is, you’ll take the initiative and challenge the status quo with us in a highly competitive and ever-changing environment. Learn more about Syneos Health.

Additional Information

Tasks, duties, and responsibilities as listed in this job description are not exhaustive. The Company, at its sole discretion and with no prior notice, may assign other tasks, duties, and job responsibilities. Equivalent experience, skills, and/or education will also be considered so qualifications of incumbents may differ from those listed in the Job Description. The Company, at its sole discretion, will determine what constitutes as equivalent to the qualifications described above. Further, nothing contained herein should be construed to create an employment contract. Occasionally, required skills/experiences for jobs are expressed in brief terms. Any language contained herein is intended to fully comply with all obligations imposed by the legislation of each country in which it operates, including the implementation of the EU Equality Directive, in relation to the recruitment and employment of its employees. The Company is committed to compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, including the provision of reasonable accommodations, when appropriate, to assist employees or applicants to perform the essential functions of the job.

fdfcac0fe9f5d6a0.title: Revenue Cycle Program Manager
fdfcac0fe9f5d6a0.description:
If you're ready to be part of our legacy of hope and innovation, we encourage you to take the first step and explore our current job openings. Your best is waiting to be discovered.

Day - 08 Hour (United States of America)

This is a Stanford Health Care job.

A Brief Overview
The Revenue Cycle Program Manager reports to the Director of Strategic Initiatives and is responsible for development and execution of Revenue Cycle program initiatives. The Program Manager works with stakeholders across the broader Stanford Health Care organization to drive operational and strategic change, and is accountable for leading a portfolio of projects designed to optimize the financial health of Stanford Health Care.

Locations

Stanford Health Care

What you will do

  • Provides program leadership for large strategic and cross-functional workflow initiatives by defining project scope, engaging stakeholders, and managing project timelines and deliverables
  • Builds positive working relationships across the organization; engages effectively with staff, management, and senior leadership in project work
  • Guides Revenue Cycle leadership in identifying program initiatives in alignment with Revenue Cycle strategic objectives
  • Participates actively in strategic committee discussions and activities, and takes a leadership role in organizing projects or initiatives to support committee aims
  • Develops executive-level presentations and statuses for senior leadership
  • Delivers presentations on Revenue Cycle programs and initiatives to a variety of audience levels
  • Performs financial and operational data analysis in support of organizational and project-level objectives
  • Serves as a Revenue Cycle methodology expert, consulting within and outside of the Revenue Cycle department on Revenue Cycle best practices
  • Provides performance improvement methodology guidance to Revenue Cycle operational leaders
  • Provides support for Revenue Cycle strategic planning efforts

Education Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in a work-related field/discipline from an accredited college or university.

Experience Qualifications

  • Five (5) years of progressively responsible and directly related work experience.

Required Knowledge, Skills and Abilities

  • Ability to act as a thought leader for performance improvement and revenue cycle methodologies
  • Ability to communicate effectively at all organizational levels, both orally and in writing
  • Ability to establish and maintain effective relationships with widely diverse groups, including individuals at all levels both within and outside the organization
  • Ability to motivate, influence, and direct the work of others
  • Ability to resolve conflicts and/or negotiate with others to achieve positive results
  • Ability to work well both autonomously and as a team player
  • Flexible and adaptable to change while working in a fast-paced environment.
  • Demonstrated quantitative analytical skills
  • Demonstrated organization and planning skills
  • Demonstrated knowledge and understanding of Lean, project management, and/or Six Sigma principles and their applications
  • Demonstrated familiarity with and understanding of Microsoft Office applications (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Visio, Outlook).

Licenses and Certifications

  • None

These principles apply to ALL employees:

SHC Commitment to Providing an Exceptional Patient & Family Experience

Stanford Health Care sets a high standard for delivering value and an exceptional experience for our patients and families. Candidates for employment and existing employees must adopt and execute C-I-CARE standards for all of patients, families and towards each other. C-I-CARE is the foundation of Stanford’s patient-experience and represents a framework for patient-centered interactions. Simply put, we do what it takes to enable and empower patients and families to focus on health, healing and recovery.

You will do this by executing against our three experience pillars, from the patient and family’s perspective:


  • Know Me: Anticipate my needs and status to deliver effective care
  • Show Me the Way: Guide and prompt my actions to arrive at better outcomes and better health

9a7e8cc617e367e9.title: Lead DevOps Engineer
9a7e8cc617e367e9.location: Belarus, Moldova, Ukraine, United Arab Emirates
9a7e8cc617e367e9.description:
We are hiring for this position to be based in Dubai (UAE) or Eastern Europe.

Praktika is an AI-native education company on a mission to deliver efficient, engaging language learning to billions of people worldwide. We're bridging the gap between traditional learning apps and human tutors through a fully automated tutorship experience powered by generative AI avatars.

Since launching our mobile apps in 2023, we've reached over 30 million learners and grown to over 2 million monthly active users, become one of the world's top-4 learning apps, and recently closed a $30M Series A to accelerate our roadmap. We're a fully distributed team of ~50 people across 4 continents and 15+ countries, working asynchronously to ship fast and operate at a high bar.

We're hiring a Lead DevOps Engineer to own all of Praktika's infrastructure and all access to it. This is a hands-on role with real leadership: you'll set the direction for our infrastructure, build it, run it, and keep it secure, reliable, cost-efficient and fast as we grow.

You'll work with every engineering team and with non-engineering teams too. We are rebuilding how the company works around AI, and infrastructure is where that has to be made safe.

What you'll do

  • Own the infrastructure end to end: design, build and run our AWS-based infrastructure, and be the owner when it fails.

  • Own identity and access for the whole company: cloud accounts, vendors, internal tools, onboarding and offboarding.

  • Own infrastructure security (IAM, networks, secrets, audit logs) and the technical part of compliance: ISO 27001, SOC 2, GDPR.

  • Keep costs visible and under control across clouds and AI vendors.

  • Run the hosting and inference infrastructure for our ML and LLM models.

  • Close repeated operational requests with automation and self-service, not with tickets and manual console changes.

  • Rebuild infrastructure processes around AI: code review, monitoring and observability, alert triage, incident investigation.

  • Build the place where internal tools and apps, built with AI by engineers and non-engineers, are deployed safely, reviewed and monitored. Build your own tools with AI too.

  • Give delivery teams golden paths (service templates, CI/CD, safe deploys, alerts) that make the standard way the easy way, without blocking teams.

What we're looking for

We're looking for outstanding engineers who thrive in a challenging environment, bring a growth mindset, and operate with a high degree of agency, devotion, and autonomy.

Required

  • Ownership mindset: you make decisions and finish work without supervision.

  • Deep hands-on AWS experience in production, including containers on ECS.

  • Infrastructure as code (Terraform) as your normal way of working.

  • A solid security foundation and a real interest in security.

  • You have already built working tools with AI coding agents, and you use AI in your daily work.

  • You have changed how other teams work without formal authority over them.

  • You have set a technical direction and split large projects into deliverable parts.

  • Ability to thrive in an async, distributed, written-first culture.

Bonus

  • DevSecOps experience and an understanding of how attacks work.

  • Hands-on work on SOC 2, ISO 27001 or GDPR.

  • Experience with clouds other than AWS.

  • Experience with infrastructure for ML / LLM inference.

  • Prior experience at an early-stage or high-growth consumer product company.

Our stack

AWS (containers, serverless, managed databases, CDN), Terraform, GitHub Actions, Datadog, SQL and NoSQL databases, event streaming, a data warehouse, hosted ML / LLM inference, and others.

How we work

  • Mission-driven: we're building the #1 language learning app and competing to win.

  • AI-native: AI isn't a feature; it's how we think, build, and scale.

  • Extreme ownership: every project has a clear owner who drives it to success.

  • Less meetings, more outputs: async first; meetings are a last resort.

  • Speed & excellence: move fast without compromising quality.

  • Truly all-in: impactful work, full commitment, real rewards.

  • Data-driven: decisions are based on evidence, not opinion.

  • User-obsessed: if it doesn't improve the learner experience, it doesn't matter.

What we offer

  • Room to grow: as you prove yourself, your scope can grow to Head of Platform (backend team).

  • Equity that grows with your impact (stock options).

  • 26 days of holiday plus bank holidays (34 days per year total).

  • Annual company off-site (last year: Dubai).

  • Health and wellness benefits via SafetyWing.

  • Full AI toolkit access: Claude, Cursor, Codex, and other productivity tools.

  • $1,000 annual education and learning budget.

  • Fully remote, based in Dubai or Eastern Europe.

Interview Process:

  1. Intro interview with our Head of Talent.

  2. Technical interviews with our CTO.

  3. Culture interview with a member of the leadership team.

  4. Peer interview with an engineer from the team.

No take-home task. We will provide you with feedback throughout the interview process.

Product Owner technico-fonctionnel senior — Expert ArcGIS Utility Network ESRI
(
9f242676572400f7.description:
Description et livrables de la prestation

Contexte :

Un grand groupe du secteur des services à l’environnement engage une refonte de son système d’information métier dédié à la gestion des réseaux. Cette transformation couvre les applications métier, le socle SIG et le modèle de données, avec une composante centrale autour d’ArcGIS Utility Network.
Dans ce cadre, le groupe recherche un Product Owner senior pour porter les priorités métier et coordonner leur mise en œuvre avec un intégrateur partenaire.

Votre rôle :

Au sein de l’équipe programme, vous faites le lien entre les métiers, les équipes SI et l’intégrateur. Vous challengez les demandes, décidez des priorités du backlog et veillez à la cohérence fonctionnelle des évolutions.
Votre expertise d’ArcGIS Utility Network vous permet d’évaluer les conséquences des besoins exprimés et de dialoguer avec l’intégrateur sur les choix de mise en œuvre.

Vos principales missions :

1. Cadrer et prioriser les besoins

  • Recueillir et clarifier les besoins des utilisateurs et des parties prenantes.
  • Challenger les demandes au regard des objectifs du programme et des usages opérationnels.
  • Construire, maintenir et prioriser le backlog en tenant compte de la valeur métier, des contraintes techniques et des dépendances.
  • Formaliser les exigences fonctionnelles, les user stories et les critères d’acceptation.

2. Apporter une expertise technico-fonctionnelle

  • Analyser les conséquences des évolutions sur les applications, le socle SIG et le modèle de données.
  • Éclairer les choix entre fonctionnalités standard, configuration et développements spécifiques.
  • Challenger les propositions de l’intégrateur au regard des besoins métier et des capacités d’ArcGIS Utility Network.
  • Contribuer aux travaux de migration et d’intégration sur le plan fonctionnel, en lien avec les experts concernés.

3. Coordonner la réalisation et la validation

  • Assurer l’interface quotidienne entre les métiers, les équipes SI et l’intégrateur.
  • Suivre l’avancement du backlog, identifier les blocages et coordonner leur résolution.
  • Préparer les arbitrages qui dépassent le périmètre de décision du PO.
  • Organiser la validation métier des fonctionnalités livrées et suivre les corrections.
  • Contribuer à la préparation du déploiement et à l’appropriation des nouvelles applications.

Expertise souhaitée

Profil recherché :

Vous disposez d’une expérience confirmée de Product Owner ou de responsable fonctionnel sur des projets de transformation SI intégrant une forte composante SIG et réseaux.

Compétences indispensables :

  • Expertise technico-fonctionnelle d’ArcGIS Utility Network.
  • Expérience concrète d’au moins une mise en œuvre ou migration vers ArcGIS Utility Network, avec un rôle opérationnel clairement identifiable.
  • Compréhension des métiers de gestion et d’exploitation des réseaux.
  • Maîtrise de la priorisation d’un backlog et de la formalisation des besoins.
  • Expérience de collaboration avec un intégrateur et des équipes métier et techniques.

Compétences appréciées :

  • Connaissance des réseaux d’eau et/ou d’assainissement.
  • Expérience de refonte d’applications métier connectées à un SIG.
  • Compréhension des enjeux de qualité des données, de migration et d’interfaces entre applications.
  • Expérience de projets impliquant plusieurs métiers et systèmes interdépendants.

Qualités attendues :

  • Capacité à décider des priorités et à expliquer les arbitrages.
  • Aptitude à challenger les demandes et les solutions de manière constructive.
  • Aisance pour traduire des sujets techniques en conséquences métier.
  • Rigueur, sens de la coordination et capacité de synthèse.

Mobilité

Non renseigné

8a13b4b98de2c6f0.description:
Become a part of our caring community

Humana’s Clinical Innovation and Trend Analytic Team is seeking a Research Scientist 2 (Remote).

Healthcare is rapidly changing, and our members are living longer, often with more chronic conditions. The Clinical Innovation and Trend Analytic team identifies opportunities and builds solutions to improve clinical outcomes and lower costs for millions of Medicare Advantage beneficiaries. This is done through an evidence-based approach using data analytics, clinical expertise, strategic mindset, and rigorous study designs. In this multi-disciplinary team, you will have the opportunity to work closely with strategy partners and clinicians to shape Humana’s clinical strategies and initiatives.

The Research Scientist 2 applies statistical and epidemiologic principles to identify trends, assess cause-effect relationships, and size potential opportunities using high volumes of complex data. The Research Scientist 2 work assignments are varied and require interpretation of data and independent judgement.

Responsibilities


As a Research Scientist 2, you will:


  • Conduct exploratory analysis on populations, trends, and clinical conditions to inform potential opportunities for trend savings and clinical outcomes improvement for our members.
  • Collaborate with clinicians and clinical informaticists to define various clinical concepts and extract clinical information from medical, pharmacy, and lab claims for analytics and modeling purposes.
  • Leverage a wide range of analytics methods from descriptive analysis to epidemiological methods.
  • Design outcomes studies and perform program evaluation using randomized controlled trials, propensity matching, difference-in-difference models, or other experimental/quasi-experimental methods.
  • Conduct literature reviews and intervention research to assess engagement rates and treatment effect sizes of interventions that are in the early stages of design and implementation.
  • Write code in SQL, SAS, and Python to assemble data, create analytic variables/features, design visuals and charts, and statistical models for research/science use-cases.
  • Translate analytic results into key takeaways with actionable insights and communicate to business partners.
  • Understand department, segment, and organizational strategy and operating objectives, including their linkages to related areas.
  • Make decisions regarding research methods, occasionally in ambiguous situations with general guidance.


Use your skills to make an impact

Required Qualifications

  • Master's Degree in a quantitative discipline such as Epidemiology, Biostatistics, Economics, Statistics, Clinical Informatics, Engineering, and/or related fields.
  • 2+ years of experience that includes:
    • Skills to create datasets and analytical variables from large and complex data environments by writing code in SQL, SAS, and Python.
    • Applying research methods to transform high volumes of complex data into actionable insights.
    • Experience with experimental and quasi-experimental methods such as randomized controlled trials, propensity matching, or difference-in-difference models.
  • Experience working collaboratively within a multi-disciplinary team, to deliver quality analytical work, and communicate results and insights clearly to business partners.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Healthcare or managed care working experience.
  • Experience working with medical, pharmacy, and lab claims.
  • Demonstrated familiarity with clinical concepts related to a broad range of clinical conditions and disease states.
  • Demonstrated familiarity with hypothesis testing, statistical methods, and/or comparative effectiveness study design and modeling techniques.
  • Experience using Pyspark, DataBricks, Microsoft Azure, PowerBI.
  • Strong interest in healthcare and desire to make a positive impact on health outcomes.

This role is not eligible for work visa sponsorship.

Work at Home Requirements: To ensure Home or Hybrid Home/Office employees’ ability to work effectively, the self-provided internet service of Home or Hybrid Home/Office employees must meet the following criteria: At minimum, a download speed of 25 Mbps and an upload speed of 10 Mbps is required; wireless, wired cable or DSL connection is suggested. In certain roles, the minimum recommended internet speed required by Humana may not be sufficient for business needs. Humana reserves the right to require associates to upgrade their internet service if necessary. Work from a dedicated space lacking ongoing interruptions to protect member PHI / HIPAA information.Travel: While this is a remote position, occasional travel to Humana's offices for training or meetings may be required.

Scheduled Weekly Hours

40

Pay Range

The compensation range below reflects a good faith estimate of starting base pay for full time (40 hours per week) employment at the time of posting. The pay range may be higher or lower based on geographic location and individual pay will vary based on demonstrated job related skills, knowledge, experience, education, certifications, etc.$78,400 - $107,800 per yearThis job is eligible for a bonus incentive plan. This incentive opportunity is based upon company and/or individual performance.

Description of Benefits

Humana, Inc. and its affiliated subsidiaries (collectively, “Humana”) offers competitive benefits that support whole-person well-being. Associate benefits are designed to encourage personal wellness and smart healthcare decisions for you and your family while also knowing your life extends outside of work. Among our benefits, Humana provides medical, dental and vision benefits, 401(k) retirement savings plan, time off (including paid time off, company and personal holidays, paid parental and caregiver leave), short-term and long-term disability, life insurance and many other opportunities.Application Deadline: 11-19-2026


About us

About Humana: Humana Inc. (NYSE: HUM) is a leading U.S. healthcare company. Through our Humana insurance services and our CenterWell healthcare services, we make it easier for the millions of people we serve to achieve their best health – delivering the care and service they need, when they need it. These efforts are leading to a better quality of life for people with Medicare and Medicaid, families, individuals, military service personnel, and communities at large. Learn more about what we offer at Humana.com and at CenterWell.com.

​

Equal Opportunity Employer

It is the policy of Humana not to discriminate against any employee or applicant for employment because of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, marital status, genetic information, disability or protected veteran status. It is also the policy of Humana to take affirmative action, in compliance with Section 503 of the Rehabilitation Act and VEVRAA, to employ and to advance in employment individuals with disability or protected veteran status, and to base all employment decisions only on valid job requirements. This policy shall apply to all employment actions, including but not limited to recruitment, hiring, upgrading, promotion, transfer, demotion, layoff, recall, termination, rates of pay or other forms of compensation and selection for training, including apprenticeship, at all levels of employment.

d9bbc39b7a420368.title: Account Manager
d9bbc39b7a420368.description:
Arxada is a global leader in innovative solutions that protect our world. Our groundbreaking technologies, in-depth regulatory know-how, manufacturing and process development help our customers to safeguard nutrition, health and infrastructure efficiently through chemistry and biotechnology that enhance sustainability. We offer a broad portfolio of ingredients and services for multiple end-markets that include Human Health & Nutrition, Home & Personal Care, Professional Hygiene, Paints & Coatings and Wood Protection.

With customers in more than 100 countries, the company achieved 2 billion CHF in 2025 sales. Headquartered in Basel (Switzerland), Arxada employs 3,100 associates across 24 production sites and 14 R&D centers, all committed to our customers’ success.


As an Account Manager – NZ Wood in New Zealand, with Christchurch or Bay of Plenty preferred, you will play a key role in growing Arxada’s Wood Protection business by managing valued customer relationships and identifying new opportunities across New Zealand’s wood-processing sector. You will combine commercial expertise with technical understanding to deliver solutions that create customer value, improve operational performance and build long-term partnerships. Working closely with customers and cross-functional colleagues, you will have the opportunity to make a visible contribution to profitable growth in the New Zealand market.


Essential Job Functions:

  • Manage assigned New Zealand wood-sector accounts, acting as the primary commercial contact and building trusted relationships with customer decision-makers, technical teams and site personnel.
  • Deliver sales, margin and account-growth targets by developing and executing effective territory and customer account plans.
  • Identify, qualify and convert new business opportunities with existing and prospective customers across the New Zealand market.
  • Prepare customer proposals, quotations and commercial offers, collaborating with internal stakeholders to deliver strong customer solutions.
  • Provide or coordinate technical support for product introductions, changeovers, process optimisation and troubleshooting, applying technical, engineering or automation knowledge where appropriate.
  • Maintain a disciplined sales pipeline and accurate forecasts while monitoring customer requirements, competitors and market trends to identify opportunities for profitable growth.
  • Collaborate with Customer Service, Technical, Supply Chain, Operations, Finance, Quality and EHS colleagues to deliver reliable customer outcomes.
  • Participate in customer trials, sales reviews, industry events and business-planning activities, with regular travel throughout New Zealand and occasional travel within Oceania.

Qualifications & Experience:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Wood Science, Forestry, Engineering, Chemistry or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant industry experience.
  • Proven B2B account management, technical sales or business development experience within wood processing, sawmilling, forestry, manufacturing, chemicals or a related industrial environment.
  • Strong commercial acumen, including account planning, new-business development, pipeline management, forecasting, pricing, negotiation and value-based selling.
  • Technical aptitude and confidence discussing industrial processes, equipment and product applications; knowledge of sawmilling, wood processing, timber treatment, engineering, automation or industrial chemicals is highly advantageous.
  • Strong relationship-building, communication, presentation and influencing skills, with a collaborative approach to working across commercial, technical and operational teams.
  • Structured problem-solving skills, sound prioritisation and the ability to take ownership and drive opportunities through to successful outcomes.
  • Fluent English, proficiency with Microsoft 365 and CRM or sales-reporting systems, a current full driver licence and willingness to travel regularly throughout New Zealand.

Arxada has world class offering in two distinct areas:

Microbial Control Solutions (MCS) focuses on threats posed by microorganisms to people and planet through five distinct business lines including Professional Hygiene, Home & Personal Care, Wood Protection, Paints & Coatings and Material Protection.

Nutrition, Care & Environmental (NCE), meanwhile, provides materials used to manufacture composites for electronics, aerospace and other markets, as well as vitamins and nutritional ingredients, chemicals and performance intermediates, and raw materials for a wide range of high-performance applications.

Arxada is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, status as a qualified individual with disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

7794674cf72deac4.title: Technical Operations Manager
7794674cf72deac4.description:
The Role
The Technical Operations Manager is the connective tissue between leadership and the teams doing the work every day, and the person who makes those teams faster and smarter through data, automation, and AI. You will serve as the primary manager for our Philippines-based call center team, translating company goals into clear daily direction and holding the team to high performance and compliance standards. Just as importantly, you'll build the systems behind the operation: writing SQL to answer your own questions, building dashboards that give leadership real-time visibility, using AI tools to scale QA, training, and documentation, and automating the manual work that slows teams down. This role is ideal for a builder who is equally comfortable coaching a team lead and writing a query, and who sees every repetitive process as something to improve.

Key Responsibilities

  • Call Center Management: Oversee day-to-day operations of our Philippines-based call center team, including scheduling, staffing, workload planning, and shift coverage. Serve as the primary point of escalation between agents, team leads, and US leadership.
  • Data, SQL & Reporting: Write and maintain SQL queries against our operational and analytics databases to track performance, diagnose issues, and answer business questions independently. Build and own dashboards covering contact rate, conversion, handle time, adherence, QA scores, and other key metrics.
  • AI-Driven Operations: Use AI tools to scale the operation, including call transcription and analysis, automated QA scoring and compliance flagging, agent coaching insights, and AI-assisted drafting of scripts, training content, and documentation. SWIVEL is seeking a talented individual to serve as the primary point of contact for customers, guiding them through onboarding and managing the day-to-day relationship to ensure long-term success with SWIVEL’s schools product. Reporting to the Director of Customer Success, the CSM plays a key role in helping customers achieve their goals by driving product adoption, minimizing implementation risks, and identifying opportunities for growth. This role requires strong collaboration with internal teams and a proactive, customer-centric approach to building trusted, value-driven partnerships.

Why you’ll love this role:

You’ll love this role because it puts you at the heart of meaningful customer relationships, where you’ll serve as the trusted advisor and main point of contact for a portfolio of community-focused clients. From onboarding to ongoing engagement, you’ll guide customers through their journey, helping them achieve real outcomes with SWIVEL’s schools product. You’ll collaborate closely with cross-functional teams, influence product adoption, and play a key role in reducing implementation risks. This position will have opportunity to grow further into communities. If you’re passionate about building strong partnerships, solving problems proactively, and making a tangible impact on both customer success and business growth, this role offers the perfect blend of purpose, challenge, and opportunity.

Essential duties include the following:

  • Serve as the primary point of contact for day-to-day customer needs, building strong, trust-based relationships with school and district stakeholders.

  • Navigate ambiguity with confidence by identifying gaps and implementing solutions that improve customer experience and internal efficiency.
  • Collaborate across teams to establish clear handoffs, develop partner engagement models, and design strategies that empower districts.
  • Champion digital transformation in education by helping schools adopt technology that streamlines payments and enhances operational efficiency.
  • Educate and empower districts on best practices for leveraging EdTech solutions to improve student and parent engagement.
  • Stay ahead of industry trends in K–12 technology, compliance, and payment systems to provide informed guidance to customers.

  • Drive adoption of innovative tools that simplify administrative workflows and improve financial transparency for schools.

  • Identify opportunities for account growth and collaborate with Sales to expand partnerships within the education sector.
  • Track and report on customer success metrics, usage trends, and engagement to inform strategy and continuous improvement.
  • Take initiative to build structure where none exists, laying the foundation for sustainable growth and scalable success.

  • Strong background in SaaS start-ups is essential, with hands-on experience in EdTech, school payment systems, or similar technology-driven industries.
  • Demonstrated track record of sales or account growth within education technology or payment processing markets.
  • Exceptional business acumen, communication, and negotiation skills, with the ability to build trust-based relationships with school administrators and district leaders.
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, evolving environment and adapt strategies to meet changing market and customer needs.

  • Organize launches: hand over offer terms, links and creatives; coordinate tracking checks and first conversions with the technical team.

  • Track record of acquiring and scaling media buying teams and SEO partners, increasing margin and reviving an inactive portfolio.

What we offer:

  • Fully remote work.

  • Competitive salary.

  • Opportunity to work in a fast-growing international iGaming company.

  • Strong Development and Product teams.

  • Minimal bureaucracy and the opportunity to directly influence product quality.

  • Clear career path with the opportunity to grow.

  • Interesting challenges and modern tools.

35e6fd04748f6ee4.title: Hadley Designs LLC: Amazon Brand Manager
35e6fd04748f6ee4.description:
Headquarters: Flower Mound, TX, USA
URL: http://www.hadleydesigns.com

Own Your Catalog Like a Business, and Win on Amazon.

Hadley Designs is seeking an Amazon Brand Manager to take full ownership of a multi-million dollar group of our products on Amazon, as the product manager, the merchandiser, and the CEO of that catalog. This is a high-impact role for an e-commerce brand builder who brings real judgment, reads a market quickly, and knows how to grow net profit, not just sales.

You will report to the leader of our Amazon channel and work as part of a small, high-performing Amazon team. While this role operates deeply within Amazon, we welcome candidates who have built brands across e-commerce, DTC, or marketplace environments and are excited to bring that experience to a scaled Amazon catalog.

 

How You'll Win at Hadley Designs

You bring the judgment. We bring the brand, the catalog, and the team.

  • Learn our brand. Get to know our brand, our expectations, your catalog group, and the standards and SOPs our team runs on.
  • Run your catalog as its CEO. Make the calls on pricing, listings, imagery, promotions, and inventory, and own the net profit that results.
  • Challenge the status quo. Bring better ideas, back them with a clear point of view, and help us raise the bar.

We are looking for thinkers who are coachable and confident, not people waiting for a playbook.

 

What You'll Own

  • End-to-end ownership of your catalog group's performance, including revenue, net profit, pricing, advertising, and inventory
  • Reading the competitive landscape, from merchandising and listings to imagery and pricing, and responding with strategy rather than reacting to every price drop
  • Finding inspiration outside Amazon, on Etsy, TikTok, Pinterest, and in wider trends, and turning it into product and format ideas
  • Product and format relaunches that lift your catalog
  • How your products look and compete on the page, from main images to packaging and format
  • Elevating our brand experience on Amazon so your catalog protects its margin and earns a higher price
  • Advertising, listings, experiments, and inventory planning with our supply chain team, used as levers toward profit
  • AI workflows that handle the routine work, so your time goes to the decisions that grow the catalog
  • Clear weekly reporting on results, risks, and next moves

 

What Success Looks Like

Within your first 90 days, you will:

  • Learn our brand, expectations, catalog group, and SOPs, and share a clear read of your competitive landscape
  • Own your catalog's weekly numbers and make the first judgment calls that protect margin and lift results
  • Bring forward product and format ideas, including ones inspired from outside Amazon, with at least one relaunch in motion
  • Challenge at least one way we do things with a better one, and be measured on the net profit you deliver

Requirements

Who You Are

  • 3+ years of experience owning a product line or catalog on Amazon, in e-commerce, or in marketplaces, end to end as a business
  • A strong visual eye, and you see what wins on the page, not only in the data
  • You read competitors and markets and can explain your reasoning, not just the answer
  • You find ideas outside Amazon and know how to turn a trend into a product or format
  • You know the tactics that grow net profit and you have protected margin and price
  • Deep, hands-on experience with Amazon Seller Central and Amazon advertising
  • AI capability, a CRM and documented SOPs. You use AI every day to get more done with less, which is a must-have here and a capability rather than any one tool, and you are excited to build how we use all three now and going forward
  • Very organized and buttoned up, and you follow through until the job is done
  • Clear, confident spoken and written English
  • Coachable and quick to learn our way, and confident enough to challenge it

 

This is an ownership role for an experienced brand builder, not a virtual assistant position.

 

Benefits

Why You'll Thrive Here

  • Own a multi-million dollar Amazon catalog with a team that's got the tools and trust to help you scale
  • Join a high-growth crew that lives for innovation, data, and collective wins
  • Remote full-time work with a flexible schedule
  • Regular interaction with leadership, including the CEO
  • Personal development and autonomy over your time
  • An established company, 10+ years strong, ready to soar higher with you onboard

To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/hadley-designs-llc-amazon-brand-manager

Are you looking for a place where your work makes an impact? We are seeking a talented Cloud CRM Consultant to join our amazing, fast-paced team of experts in Hungary.
 
The Cloud CRM Consultant is a member of our Commercial Managed Services team who provides ongoing professional service for customers live with Veeva’s commercial solutions.
 
You will  provide application consulting services to the Veeva Commercial Cloud product suite, primarily on the Vault CRM application, but will potentially develop expertise across other Commercial products. You will identify customer requirements, perform configuration changes to the system, activate new product features and act as an advising partner.
 
This is a remote, full-time role with Veeva. Candidates must be legally authorised to be employed in Europe.   • Strong desire to continuously learn and develop
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English
  • Ability to work independently

Nice to Have

  • Technical CRM experience, ideally Salesforce MS, Dynamics, SAP or equivalent

  • Experience working in the Life-Sciences industry

Interviewing with Veeva

ccac39517ac129c4.title: Praxis Precision Medicines, Inc.: Manager CMC Materials Management
ccac39517ac129c4.description:
Headquarters: Mumbai, Maharashtra, India
URL: http://www.praxismedicines.com

Location: India - Remote 

The Opportunity

At Praxis, every material movement matters. We are seeking a proactive, results-driven Manager, CMC Materials Management to own domestic and international logistics supporting our research, development, and manufacturing programs. 

This role ensures critical materials reach the right destination, on time and in the required condition, while maintaining compliance, inventory visibility, and cost efficiency across our global supplier and CDMO network. The ideal candidate anticipates challenges, solves problems with urgency, and takes ownership from planning through delivery. Success requires strong execution, attention to detail, and a commitment to advancing life-altering medicines for patients.

Primary Responsibilities

  • Own end-to-end materials logistics: Plan and execute domestic and international shipments supporting CMC development, technology transfers, and manufacturing. Coordinate suppliers, carriers, freight forwarders, customs brokers, and internal teams to ensure timely, reliable delivery.
  • Ensure shipment integrity and compliance: Manage temperature-controlled shipments, packaging, monitoring, and material-specific handling requirements. Partner with Quality and Regulatory to ensure compliance with applicable procedures and promptly escalate excursions or deviations for assessment and disposition.
  • Drive accurate documentation and execution: Oversee shipping requests, including E-Transparency submissions, commercial invoices, packing lists, customs documentation, and Material Transfer Requests. Ensure complete, accurate, and timely records in the Quality Management System (QMS).
  • Maintain inventory visibility: Track and reconcile material inventories at CDMOs and external partners, monitoring stock levels, expiry dates, and availability. Coordinate replenishment and transfers to prevent disruptions to development and manufacturing schedules.
  • Manage logistics partners: Partner with Quality and Procurement to select, onboard, and oversee service providers. Support negotiations, establish performance expectations, and hold partners accountable for delivery, quality, responsiveness, and cost.
  • Anticipate and resolve risks: Proactively identify transportation, customs, storage, and supply continuity risks. Develop contingency plans, resolve disruptions with urgency, and communicate clearly with stakeholders through resolution.
  • Improve operational performance: Maintain accurate shipment and inventory records in SharePoint, Excel, and other systems. Track delivery performance, temperature excursions, inventory accuracy, and freight costs. Use data and cross-functional collaboration to simplify processes, improve reliability, and reduce avoidable costs.

Qualifications and Key Success Factors

  • Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain, Logistics, Life Sciences, Engineering, or related field, or equivalent experience.
  • Typically 5–8 years of experience in logistics, materials management, or supply chain operations, preferably in biotechnology, pharmaceuticals, or a regulated environment.
  • Experience managing international shipments, customs documentation, freight forwarding, and temperature-controlled logistics.
  • Working knowledge of GxP requirements, quality systems, and pharmaceutical material handling and documentation.
  • Experience coordinating inventory and material movements across CDMOs, suppliers, or external manufacturing partners.
  • Proficiency with Excel, SharePoint, and logistics or inventory management systems; familiarity with E-Transparency, QMS, or ERP systems is a plus.
  • Strong organizational skills, sound judgment, and the ability to manage competing priorities across global teams and partners.
  • Ownership: Takes initiative, follows through, and drives issues to resolution without waiting for direction.
  • Collaboration: Builds trust through clear communication, transparency, and accountability across functions.
  • Curiosity and grit: Challenges inefficient processes, anticipates problems, and delivers results in a fast-moving environment. 

The physical and mental requirements of our roles include but are not limited to regular use of a computer, devices or other office equipment, clear communication, and occasional movement.  You'll need comfort with screen work, basic hand coordination, and focus.  Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform these functions.

We provide annualized base salary compensation in the range listed below. Final salary range may be modified commensurate with job level, education, and experience.

Annualized Base Salary
₹2,580,000—₹2,860,000 INR

Compensation & Benefits

At Praxis, we believe that taking care of our people (and their people) is important, so we provide a world class benefits package to help you thrive.  This includes 99% of the premium paid for medical, dental and vision plans.  We also provide company-paid life insurance, AD&D, disability benefits, and voluntary plans to personalize your coverage. Thinking about the future?  We match dollar-for-dollar up to 6% on eligible 401(k) contributions and sweeten the deal with long-term stock incentives and ESPP.  We provide a discretionary quarterly bonus, an extremely flexible wellness benefit, generous PTO, paid holidays and company-wide shutdowns.  Not to mention, you'll also be joining a phenomenal crew of colleagues who are smart, engaged and inspiring.  We aim high, collaborate hard, and produce results.  Let’s achieve the impossible together! 

Company Overview 

Praxis Precision Medicines is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company translating genetic insights into the development of therapies for central nervous system disorders characterized by neuronal imbalance.  At Praxis we share a common vision of reshaping the human condition into a more freeing and fulfilled existence by developing high impact medicines for patients and families affected by and living with complex brain disorders.  Our core Values of Trust, Ownership, Curiosity and Results are foundational to every aspect of our business and are exemplified by each and every one of our team members.

Diversity, Equity & Inclusion
Guided by our core values, at Praxis Precision Medicines, Inc. we continue to DARE FOR MORE® to advance, promote, and champion diversity, equity, and inclusion by encouraging individuals to bring their authentic selves and perspectives to work each day. We are an equal opportunity employer and committed to providing opportunities to all qualified applicants without regard to race, religious creed, color, gender identity or expression, age, national origin, sexual orientation, disability, genetics, military service and veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws.

Attention: Job Scam Alert
Praxis has recently become aware of fraudulent job recruitment postings from individuals claiming to represent Praxis. These postings seek financial information in connection with fraudulent opportunities for employment. If you suspect any fraudulent activity or misrepresentation in connection with a Praxis job opportunity, please report it to careers@praxismedicines.com.

Praxis does not accept unsolicited submissions from recruitment agencies for open positions. We ask all recruitment agencies to refrain from contacting any Praxis employee regarding any position. All unsolicited resumes submitted by recruitment agencies to any Praxis employee in any form or method will be deemed to be the property of Praxis, and Praxis explicitly reserves the right to hire those candidate(s) without any financial obligation to the recruitment agency.

c4f06ef1adeac4d4.title: MedAmerica: Practice Administrator - Teleneurohospital Medicine
c4f06ef1adeac4d4.description:
Headquarters: Sacramento, California, United States
URL: https://www.vituity.com/about-us/practice-management

Remote, Nationwide – Seeking Teleneurology Practice Administrator

 

Everybody Has A Role to Play in Transforming Healthcare

 

As a Practice Administrator, you play a vital role in our mission to improve lives. Provide direct, business operations support to our medical directors, practice physician partners, advanced providers and scribe (when applicable) employees. At Vituity we know the impact you can have.

 

Join the Vituity Team. At Vituity we’ve cultivated an environment where passion thrives, and success comes through shared purpose. We were founded in a culture that values team accomplishments more than individual achievements, an approach we call “culture of brilliance.” Together, we leverage our strengths and experiences to make a positive impact in our local communities. We foster this through shared goals and helping our colleagues succeed, and we also understand the importance of recognition, taking the time to show appreciation and gratitude for a job well done.

 

Vituity Locations: Vituity has opportunities at 900 practices across the country, serving 14.5+ million patients a year. With Vituity, if you ever need to move, you can take your job with you.

 

The Opportunity

  • Act as the operational administrator for the practice Vituity leadership and as the interface for the practice to the hospital and community.
  • Act as the front-line liaison for the provider team with hospital C-Suite, nursing leadership, nursing staff, and Vituity support team.
  • Provide executive support to the practice medical director and practice management team to meet contract expectations.
  • Provide support for all practice financials to include, but not limited to, contract stipends, expense reimbursements, and practice payroll timecards.
  • Act as the super user for all Vituity software applications and as a point person for hospital software and hardware systems.
  • As appropriate to practice practice, provide support to Vituity providers acting as a percipient witness in criminal or civil disputes including, but not limited to, receiving and routing subpoenas, scheduling depositions and trial testimony as applicable, development of a provider fee schedule, and including malpractice carrier as appropriate.
  • Provide office management to include, but not limited to, all aspects of meeting management, office systems, supplies, practice events, and customer service.
  • As applicable to the practice line, facilitate all aspects of the daily patient census and attend daily multi-disciplinary rounds.
  • As applicable to the practice practice, responsible for all aspects of the practice clinical schedules to ensure adequate coverage with no disruption to patient care.
  • Collect, track, and analyze all practice financial and operational data.
  • Project management as needed of the practice operational programs to include, but not limited to, Operations Meetings, Patient Experience Program, Quality/Performance Improvement Program, Advanced Provider and/or Scribe Programs, and Student or Resident rotations.
  • Ensure all aspects of recruiting and on-boarding are completed for new providers and employees as well as locums and reservists and/or residents and students.
  • Ensure all licensed providers complete their recredentialing timely and appropriately for their licensing, certificates, and credentials required by Vituity and hospital Medical Staff Office.
  • Ensure all practice partners and employees remain in compliance with Vituity and hospital programs and other mandated training or requests.
  • Act as the point person for all Vituity People Operations (Human Resources) relations to include, but not limited to, ensuring accurate practice roster and compliance with employment law and Vituity policies.
  • Develop and maintain practice orientation checklists and manuals.
  • Collaborate with Medical Director and Practice Management Team in developing and maintaining practice practice policies and procedures.
  • As applicable to practice line, responsible for all medical records and data submission to Revenue Cycle Management in a timely manner and responsible for appropriate charge capture in designated system, sending notices and follow up as appropriate.
  • Ensure billing and documentation compliance through completion of practice WIP/TAD lists, answering provider routine questions, and schedule/hosting/participating in the monthly meeting with Revenue Cycle Management billing team.
  • Ensure completion of mandated forms and requests as appropriate to include, but not limited to, death certificates, physician office requests, State specific Workers Compensation and Motor Vehicle Department reporting compliance, and pharmacy requests.

 

Required Experience and Competencies

  • Two to three years of experience in an office or healthcare setting required.
  • Associate or Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Human Resources or related field strongly preferred.
  • Experience working in the healthcare field is preferred.
  • Knowledge of healthcare and medical terminology preferred.
  • Knowledge of general Human Resource principles preferred.
  • Knowledge of Federal, State, and County Agencies who regulate the Healthcare Industry preferred.
  • Intermediate to advanced MS Excel, Word, PowerPoint, and Outlook skills.
  • Strong consultation skills and the ability to seek out information.
  • Strong work ethic, organizational skills, and interpersonal skills.
  • Ability to prioritize and work in a stressful environment.
  • Ability to be self-directed, motivated, and sensitive to deadlines.
  • Ability to express ideas and convey information effectively in verbal and written communications.
  • Able to create a positive environment, clearly understand client / customer relationships, and promotes Vituity positive image.
  • Ability to understand and apply information management principles, data analysis interpretation and continuous quality improvement tools/methodologies.
  • Ability to maintain flexibility, cooperation and participate in cross-organizational performance improvement activities.
  • Ability to use office equipment and automated systems/applications/software at an acceptable level of proficiency.
  • Ability to establish and maintain effective working relationships as required by the duties of the position.
  • Ability to read, understand and communicate in English sufficient to perform the duties of the position.
  • Ability to evaluate and convey information in legible reports to Human Resource, Finance, and Executive groups.

 

The Community

Even when you are working remotely, you are an important part of the Vituity Community. We offer plenty of opportunities to engage with other Vitans through a variety of virtual meet-and-greets, events and seminars.

  • Monthly wellness events and programs such as yoga, HIIT classes, and more
  • Trainings to help support and advance your professional growth
  • Team building activities such as virtual scavenger hunts and holiday celebrations
  • Flexible work hours
  • Opportunities to attend Vituity community events including LGBTQ+ History, Día de los Muertos Celebration, Money Management/Money Relationship, and more

 

Benefits & Beyond*

Vituity cares about the whole you. With our comprehensive compensation and benefits package, we are mindful of what matters most, and support your needs of today and your plans for the future.

  • Superior health plan options
  • Dental, Vision, HSA/FSA, Life and AD&D coverage, and more
  • Top Tier 401(k) retirement savings plans that offers a $1.20 match for every dollar up to 6%25 plus discretionary profit-sharing contributions (eligible January following 18 months of service)
  • Generous paid time off starting 3-4 weeks’ annually
  • Student Loan Refinancing Discounts
  • Professional and Career Development Program
  • EAP and travel assistance included
  • Wellness program
  • Purpose-driven culture focused on improving the lives of our patients, communities, and employees

 

 

We are excited to share the base salary range for this position is $25.74 - $32.18, exclusive of fringe benefits or potential bonuses. This position is also eligible to participate in our annual corporate Success Sharing bonus program, which is based on the company’s annual performance. If you are hired at Vituity, your final base salary compensation will be determined based on factors such as skills, education, and/or experience. We believe in the importance of pay equity and consider internal equity of our current team members as a part of any final offer. Please speak with a recruiter for more details.

 

We are unified around the common purpose of transforming healthcare to improve lives and we believe everyone has a role to play in that. When we work together across practices and specialties as an integrated healthcare team, we exceed the expectations of our patients and the hospitals and clinics we work in. If you are looking to make a difference, from clinical to corporate, Vituity is the place to do it. Come grow with us.

 

Vituity does not discriminate against any person on the basis of race, creed, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, national origin, disability, age, genetic information (including family medical history), veteran status, marital status, pregnancy or related condition, or any other basis protected by law. Vituity is committed to complying with all applicable national, state and local laws pertaining to nondiscrimination and equal opportunity.

 

*Benefits for part-time and per diem vary. Please speak to a recruiter for more information.

 

Applicants only. No agencies please.

aeb57aed0a3fd970.title: Stayd Collective: Cleaning Operations Coordinator
aeb57aed0a3fd970.description:
Headquarters: Argentina
URL: https://stayd.co

Cleaning Operations Coordinator

Haven

Full-time | Remote — LATAM

Department: Housekeeping & Field Ops

Schedule: Monday–Friday, 8:00am–5:00pm ET | Occasional weekend coverage as needed

Reports to: COO, Cleaning

Compensation: USD $1,200–$1,500 / month depending on experience.

About the brand
Haven manages cabins and mountain homes in the Great Smoky Mountains and around Knoxville, Tennessee. Steep driveways, hot tubs, wood stoves, and a season that swings from quiet weeks to a full house every weekend. It is a market where property care is guest experience: a cold hot tub is a ruined anniversary, and a turnover that runs late is a family waiting in the driveway.

The role
You are the person who makes sure every cabin is guest-ready before the next family arrives. You are the main communication point between Haven operations and our Tendwell cleaning teams. Your day starts with the departures, arrivals and cleaning schedule, and from there you follow up with cleaners on progress and ETAs, clear whatever is blocking a turn, coordinate re-cleans and supply fixes, and confirm each home is ready before a same-day check-in.

When a guest checks out late, you work out what it does to the cleaning schedule and tell operations what timing is realistic. It is a role for someone who is highly responsive and calm under same-day pressure. Asking for an update is not the same as getting the home ready. If a turn is yours, you own it until it is confirmed complete.

Where you sit
You sit in Housekeeping & Field Ops and work every day with Tendwell cleaners and Haven’s operations team. This is not a role where you are handed a queue and left alone.

This role is remote and based in LATAM, covering U.S. Eastern Time working hours. Because Stayd runs shared systems across every brand, a process you improve here tends to end up running in six other markets, which is the closest thing we have to a promotion path.

What you’ll own

  • Follow up with cleaners on turn status, ETAs and anything blocking completion.
  • Coordinate re-cleans, missed items and supply fixes.
  • Confirm guest-ready status for every same-day arrival.
  • Assess how late checkouts affect the cleaning schedule and communicate realistic timelines.
  • Relay delays, updates and completion details to Haven operations, escalating urgent issues promptly.
  • Collect and post completion evidence, including photos where required.
  • Keep communication with cleaners, internal teams and stakeholders clear and organized.
  • Spot recurring issues and help improve cleaning workflows and SOPs.

What you bring

  • Experience in short-term rentals, hospitality, housekeeping coordination or field operations is strongly preferred.
  • High responsiveness and the ability to manage urgent, same-day issues without losing track of the rest.
  • Strong attention to detail.
  • Comfort following up with field teams, again and again, until the job is done.
  • Clear written English for communication with cleaners and the operations team.
  • Availability to work U.S. Eastern Time hours, plus occasional weekend coverage.
  • Reliable internet and a quiet place to work.

Compensation & Benefits

  • $1,200–$1,500/month, depending on experience.
  • Fully remote, with flexible scheduling within U.S. time-zone overlap.
  • A path to grow into a broader operations leadership role across the portfolio.

How to apply

Apply here in about four minutes on a phone. There are a handful of questions written to find out what you can actually do, a resume, and a short voice introduction for roles where spoken English is part of the work. There is no cover letter and there is no portal account to create.

You can listen to your recording and try again as many times as you need. If a microphone, privacy, or accessibility issue prevents recording, request another screening option and a recruiter will see it.

Every single applicant hears back from us, including a no. If we are not moving forward we will tell you, and we will tell you why. If you need an accommodation to complete this application, email careers@stayd.co. Asking never counts against you.

By applying, you agree that Stayd may contact you about your application by email and WhatsApp. Reply STOP at any time to opt out.

0503d70580c9bb70.title: EdgeQ Technologies Private Limited: Robotics Software Engineer  Job Title: Robotics Software Engineer
0503d70580c9bb70.description:
Headquarters: United States

Robotics Software Engineer

Job Title: Robotics Software Engineer
Location: United States (Remote)
Work Mode: 100% Remote
Experience: 3–10 Years
Salary Range: $100,000 – $175,000 per year (USD)
Employment Type: Full-Time
Job Category: Robotics Engineering / Software Development / AI & Automation

Job Summary

We are seeking a skilled and experienced Robotics Software Engineer to join our innovative engineering team in the United States. The ideal candidate will be responsible for designing, developing, testing, and optimizing software solutions for robotic systems, autonomous platforms, and intelligent automation applications.

Candidates should have strong programming skills in C++ and Python, experience with Robot Operating System (ROS/ROS2), and knowledge of robotics algorithms, motion planning, and sensor integration.

This position offers a fully remote work opportunity for qualified candidates across the United States.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and maintain software applications for robotic and autonomous systems.

  • Develop robotics algorithms using C++, Python, and ROS/ROS2.

  • Implement motion planning, navigation, localization, and control algorithms.

  • Work with robotic sensors, cameras, LiDAR, GPS, and IMU systems.

  • Develop and optimize real-time robotic software applications.

  • Integrate AI, machine learning, and computer vision capabilities into robotic systems.

  • Perform simulation, testing, debugging, and software optimization.

  • Collaborate with robotics engineers, AI engineers, and cross-functional development teams.

  • Develop software for robotic perception, path planning, and autonomous navigation.

  • Maintain technical documentation and follow software engineering best practices.

  • Participate in Agile development, code reviews, and continuous integration processes.

  • Troubleshoot complex robotics software and system integration issues.

Required Skills & Qualifications

  • 3–10 years of professional experience in Robotics Software Engineering or a related field.

  • Strong programming experience in C++ and Python.

  • Hands-on experience with ROS or ROS2.

  • Strong understanding of robotics algorithms and autonomous systems.

  • Experience with motion planning, path planning, and robot control.

  • Knowledge of Linux-based development environments.

  • Familiarity with computer vision and sensor fusion.

  • Experience with robotic simulation tools such as Gazebo, RViz, or NVIDIA Isaac Sim.

  • Understanding of real-time systems and embedded software development.

  • Strong analytical, debugging, and problem-solving abilities.

  • Excellent communication and remote collaboration skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Robotics, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field.

  • Experience with SLAM (Simultaneous Localization and Mapping).

  • Knowledge of AI/ML frameworks such as TensorFlow or PyTorch.

  • Experience with OpenCV, PCL, and robotic perception systems.

  • Familiarity with Docker, Git, CI/CD, and cloud technologies.

  • Experience with autonomous mobile robots (AMRs), industrial robots, or robotic manipulators.

  • Knowledge of robotics middleware and distributed systems.

  • Experience with robotic hardware integration and testing.

Salary & Benefits

  • Annual Salary: $100,000 – $175,000 USD (Indicative range, depending on experience and technical expertise).

  • 100% remote work opportunity.

  • Flexible working arrangements.

  • Competitive compensation and performance-based incentives, where applicable.

  • Health, dental, and vision insurance.

  • Paid time off and holidays.

  • Retirement savings benefits, where applicable.

  • Professional development and technical certification support.

  • Career advancement opportunities.

Work Location

United States – Fully Remote

  • Candidates from eligible locations across the United States may apply.

  • Must be legally authorized to work in the United States.

  • Remote collaboration with engineering and product development teams.

  • Occasional travel or access to robotics testing facilities may be required, depending on project needs.

How to Apply

Interested candidates can submit their updated resume along with their contact details, relevant Robotics Software Engineering experience, and technical skills.

Equal Opportunity Employer: We welcome qualified candidates from diverse professional backgrounds and encourage applications from eligible candidates across the United States.
