995bb3de30267401.title: Blueprint Technologies: Supply Chain Planner – Hardware
995bb3de30267401.description:
Headquarters:
URL: https://bpcs.com

About Blueprint

Blueprint is a technology solutions firm headquartered in Bellevue, Washington, with teams across the United States. We help organizations turn complex challenges into meaningful outcomes by connecting strategy and execution across AI, cloud, data, product development, and emerging technology.

Our culture is built by people who care deeply about doing exceptional work. We set high standards, take ownership, and continually challenge ourselves and one another to be better. We work hard, support each other, and take genuine pride in what we deliver for our clients, partners, and teams.

At Blueprint, you’ll work alongside talented people with different experiences, expertise, and perspectives. You’ll have opportunities to take on meaningful challenges, expand your skills, and see the impact of what you build.

Bring your perspective. Raise the standard. Build what matters.

In This Role

We are seeking a detail-oriented Supply Chain Planner to support short-term planning for server hardware deployment. In this role, you will help translate customer demand forecasts into actionable supply plans, track hardware availability, and ensure the right equipment is available at the right location and time.

You will work extensively with Excel, planning systems, and operational data to reconcile information, identify supply and demand gaps, monitor inventory, and track deployment requirements. This is a hands-on position that requires strong supply chain knowledge, analytical skills, and a willingness to manage detailed manual processes to keep planning activities accurate and on schedule.

You will collaborate with regional capacity managers and cross-functional partners, independently manage day-to-day planning responsibilities, and follow open actions through resolution. The ideal candidate enjoys working with data, solving operational challenges, and turning supply chain requirements into executable plans.

Responsibilities

  • Support short-term supply chain planning for server hardware deployment, translating customer demand forecasts into actionable supply plans.

  • Partner with regional capacity managers and cross-functional teams to understand hardware requirements, priorities, quantities, and delivery timelines.

  • Analyze demand and supply data to identify capacity gaps, inventory constraints, delivery risks, and potential mitigation actions.

  • Create, update, and maintain demand entries in planning systems, ensuring accuracy across quantities, locations, and required delivery dates.

  • Leverage Microsoft Excel to reconcile datasets, validate planning information, track changes, analyze capacity, and prepare operational reports.

  • Monitor hardware inventory, supply availability, costs, lead times, and deployment schedules to support planning decisions.

  • Perform detailed manual tracking and maintain accurate records of planning inputs, open actions, risks, and delivery progress.

  • Follow up with partner teams to resolve discrepancies, address planning gaps, and ensure requirements progress from initial planning through execution.

  • Independently manage daily planning activities while balancing multiple priorities and deadlines.

Qualifications

  • 5–7 years of experience in supply chain planning, demand planning, capacity planning, inventory planning, or related operations.

  • Strong understanding of supply chain fundamentals, logistics, inventory management, and demand and supply planning processes.

  • Advanced Microsoft Excel skills, including PivotTables, XLOOKUP/VLOOKUP, formulas, data validation, and reconciliation of large datasets.

  • Hands-on experience creating, maintaining, updating, and validating demand or supply plans within planning systems.

  • Experience analyzing supply and demand gaps, tracking inventory, monitoring lead times, and managing deployment schedules.

  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to identify discrepancies, assess risks, and maintain accurate planning data.

  • Comfortable performing detailed, hands-on operational work rather than focusing primarily on project coordination or oversight.

  • Strong communication and follow-through skills, with the ability to work independently and collaborate across multiple teams.

  • Ability to work a consistent Pacific Time (PST) schedule.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain Management, Business, Finance, Operations, or a related field.

  • Experience supporting hardware supply chain operations, server deployment, data center infrastructure, or technology logistics.

  • Experience with capacity planning, resource allocation, and hardware inventory management.

  • Familiarity with Power BI or similar reporting and data visualization tools.

  • Experience working with enterprise resource planning (ERP), supply chain management, or demand planning systems.

  • Experience coordinating supply planning activities across geographically distributed teams.

Salary Range 

At Blueprint, we strive to offer competitive pay that reflects the value of our team members. Compensation for this role is influenced by a variety of factors, including skills, education, responsibilities, experience, and geographic market. For candidates based in Washington State, the anticipated salary range is $33– $36 per hr.  Please note that we typically do not hire new employees at the top of the posted range. Actual starting pay will be determined based on experience, skills, and internal equity. The final salary and job title may vary depending on the selected candidate’s qualifications and could fall outside the stated range.

Equal Opportunity Employer 

Blueprint Technologies, LLC is an equal employment opportunity employer. Qualified applicants are considered without regard to race, color, age, disability, sex, gender identity or expression, orientation, veteran/military status, religion, national origin, ancestry, marital, or familial status, genetic information, citizenship, or any other status protected by law. 

If you need assistance or a reasonable accommodation to complete the application process, please reach out to: recruiting@bpcs.com 

Blueprint believe in the importance of a healthy and happy team, which is why our comprehensive benefits package includes: 

  • Medical, dental, and vision coverage 
  • Flexible Spending Account 
  • 401k program 
  • Competitive PTO offerings 
  • Parental Leave 
  • Opportunities for professional growth and development 

Location :  Remote

 

Benefits

Blueprint believes that healthy, supported employees do their best work. Eligible employees have access to a comprehensive benefits package that may include:

  • Medical, dental, and vision coverage
  • Flexible Spending Account (FSA)
  • 401(k) retirement plan
  • Competitive paid time off
  • Parental leave
  • Professional growth and development opportunities

Benefits and eligibility may vary based on role, employment status, and location.

Applicant Accommodations

If you need a reasonable accommodation to participate in any part of the application or interview process, please contact recruiting@bpcs.com.

f4c9219c0111b640.description:
Headquarters: Manila, Metro Manila, Philippines
URL: https://jobs.workable.com/company/dcaVtKQqXr9FwBNppNCBH9/jobs-at-d2b

Position: CINEMATIC VIDEO EDITOR – REAL ESTATE & CONSTRUCTION

Salary range: up to Php 88,000 Philippine Peso/month (The final amount will be at the the client discretion basing on the candidate’s skills and experience.)

Working Hours: Monday to Friday following New Zealand business time

Work set-up: 100% Remote work (Independent Contractor Agreement)

Holidays: TBC

Recruitment process: possible multiple client interviews and assessment

About the Company & Role

Our client is a creative media production company specialising in producing professional visual content for businesses within the property, building, and construction sectors. The company provides a range of creative services, including photography, videography, aerial footage, and digital content production, helping businesses showcase their properties, projects, and services through compelling visual presentations. They are looking for a talented and detail-oriented Video Editor who can transform raw footage into polished, cinematic, and engaging video content that captures the quality and appeal of each project. The role involves editing various types of footage, including property walkthroughs, architectural spaces, construction developments, and commercial project showcases, while maintaining a consistent and professional visual style. The successful candidate will be expected to produce approximately 2–3 completed videos daily, balancing creative execution, technical quality, and production efficiency. This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced editor who enjoys visual storytelling, understands cinematic editing techniques, and can deliver high-quality content in a fast-paced creative environment.

Key Responsibilities

Video Editing & Post-Production

  • Edit raw video footage into professional, engaging, and cinematic video productions.
  • Produce approximately 2–3 completed videos per day while maintaining consistent quality and creative standards.
  • Create property walkthroughs, real estate promotional videos, architectural showcases, and construction project features.
  • Apply professional editing techniques, including sequencing, transitions, pacing, music integration, and visual storytelling.
  • Perform colour correction and colour grading to achieve a polished and consistent cinematic look.
  • Edit and incorporate drone footage, interior and exterior shots, and other visual assets into cohesive video presentations.
  • Adapt editing styles based on project requirements, target audiences, and creative direction.

AI-Assisted Editing & Content Production

  • Utilise AI-powered video editing and enhancement tools, particularly Higgsfield, to improve production workflows and creative output.
  • Apply AI-assisted effects, enhancements, and visual elements while ensuring the authenticity and quality of the final content.
  • Produce videos in different formats and aspect ratios, including landscape and vertical formats for various digital platforms.
  • Optimise video content for online marketing and social media distribution.
  • Ensure proper audio synchronisation, sound quality, captions, and overall video presentation.

Quality Control & Project Management

  • Review all completed videos to ensure accuracy, consistency, and professional production standards before delivery.
  • Manage multiple editing assignments and consistently meet daily production targets and deadlines.
  • Maintain organised project files, raw footage, editing assets, and completed outputs.
  • Implement feedback and revision requests promptly while maintaining attention to detail.
  • Identify opportunities to improve editing workflows, turnaround times, and production efficiency.

Creative Collaboration & Brand Consistency

  • Maintain consistency with the company's established creative direction and visual standards.
  • Contribute creative ideas and recommendations to enhance the quality and impact of video content.
  • Adjust editing approaches based on project requirements and client expectations.
  • Collaborate with the team to ensure timely delivery and alignment with production objectives.
Qualifications & Requirements

Essential Requirements

  • At least 3 years of professional experience in video editing or post-production.
  • Advanced proficiency in Final Cut Pro.
  • Must have access to a Mac computer capable of running Final Cut Pro.
  • Strong understanding of cinematic editing, storytelling, transitions, and video composition.
  • Demonstrated experience in colour correction and professional colour grading.
  • Proficiency in AI-powered video production tools, particularly Higgsfield.
  • Strong understanding of audio synchronisation, sound design, music integration, and visual aesthetics.
  • Ability to consistently deliver 2–3 completed videos per day without compromising quality.
  • Excellent attention to detail and ability to work independently in a deadline-driven environment.
  • Must provide at least three (3) samples of previously produced landscape videos demonstrating editing skills and creative capabilities.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Previous experience editing real estate, property marketing, architectural, or construction-related videos.
  • Experience incorporating drone footage into professional video productions.
  • Knowledge of motion graphics, captions, sound design, and visual effects.
  • Familiarity with other AI-assisted video editing and content creation tools.
  • Experience working with real estate professionals, property developers, builders, contractors, or commercial clients.
  • Understanding of social media video formats and digital content requirements.

Required Tools & Software
  • Final Cut Pro: Advanced video editing and post-production.
  • Higgsfield: AI-assisted video production, enhancement, and creative effects.
  • Colour Grading Tools: Professional colour correction and grading capabilities.
  • Audio Editing Tools: Sound design, audio synchronisation, and music integration.
  • Video Exporting Tools: Experience preparing videos in landscape and vertical formats.

Skills & Competencies
  • Creative Storytelling: Ability to transform raw footage into visually compelling narratives.
  • Strong Visual Aesthetic: Excellent eye for composition, lighting, colour, and pacing.
  • Time Management: Capable of handling multiple projects and meeting daily production targets.
  • Adaptability: Can work across different video styles and project requirements.
  • Attention to Detail: Ensures accuracy and consistency in every finished video.
  • Coachability: Receptive to feedback and willing to make revisions when necessary.
  • Reliability: Demonstrates accountability, effective communication, and consistency in delivering quality work.

To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/d2b-cinematic-video-editor-real-estate-construction

48770c881353e3c4.description:
Headquarters: South Africa
URL: https://jobs.workable.com/company/dcaVtKQqXr9FwBNppNCBH9/jobs-at-d2b

Position: Sales Development Representative

Salary: 25,000 ZAR to 30,000 ZAR

Working Hours: Aligned with UK Business Hours

Work Type: Independent Contractor




ABOUT THE COMPANY: 

The company is redefining human risk and secure behaviour management in cybersecurity. Trusted by global enterprises and high-growth mid-market organisations—including Vodafone, Merck, Arriva, and Hershey—the company reduces human cyber risk through AI-driven automation and cutting-edge Agentic AI solutions. We are scaling rapidly year-on-year, bringing our UK outbound engine in-house, and investing heavily in a modern, data-backed sales development function built for high performance and high autonomy.

ROLE OVERVIEW:

As UK Outbound Sales Development Representative, you will sit at the very front of our growth engine. This is an autonomous, phone-first, results-driven seat responsible for establishing our in-house outbound presence in the UK market. You will target, engage, and qualify enterprise and mid-market security decision-makers—CISOs, Heads of Security, and IT Security Managers—booking high-value Qualified Held Meetings (QHMs) that directly build Keepnet’s sales pipeline.

Armed with an advanced outbound stack (including parallel diallers like Orum and Nooks, alongside HubSpot CRM), you will operate with freedom, high trust, and end-to-end account ownership.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Drive Phone-First Multichannel Prospecting: Execute outbound campaigns across phone, email, and LinkedIn into UK B2B organisations, maintaining high daily call volumes via parallel dialling tools (Orum, Nooks) to maximise live decision-maker conversations.
  • Deliver Qualified Held Meetings (QHMs): Book meetings that actually take place with verified decision-makers (CISOs, IT Security Managers, and budget holders) in target accounts, operating against a target of your first QHM within 30 days and 10 QHMs per full production month post-ramp.
  • Execute Deep Discovery & Qualification: Apply the company's SDR Playbook (lightweight BANT and MEDDPICC frameworks) to uncover tooling gaps across phishing, vishing, smishing, and quishing, while assessing security awareness maturity.
  • Capitalise on Contract Renewal Windows: Identify current vendor relationships, contract lengths, and renewal dates, leveraging company's buy-back program to convert "in-contract" objections into active sales opportunities.
  • Maintain Channel & Conflict Awareness: Pre-screen accounts for existing partner relationships (MSPs, MSSPs, brokers, and resellers) and existing clients, resolving routing questions collaboratively before initiating outreach.
  • Ensure Seamless Handoffs: Document comprehensive, actionable discovery notes and transition booked meetings to Account Executives within 24 hours of scheduling.
  • Uphold Strict CRM Hygiene: Maintain HubSpot as the single source of truth—logging all interactions, preventing duplicate entries, and populating all mandatory qualification fields.
  • Operate with Built-In Compliance: Adhere strictly to UK GDPR, PECR, TPS/CTPS screening protocols, suppression list governance, opt-out handling, and approved messaging standards.
  • Feed Frontline Intelligence: Share objection patterns, competitor movement, and market feedback with Sales and Marketing to continuously sharpen outreach messaging and value propositions.
  • 2 Years+ of B2B SaaS Outbound Experience: Proven track record in a dedicated SDR or BDR seat carrying quota, generating pipeline, and booking qualified discovery meetings.
  • Phone-First Craftsmanship: Exceptional cold-calling confidence and conversational fluency; skilled at hooking senior prospects in the opening seconds, navigating initial brush-offs, and steering live phone discovery.
  • Enterprise Prospecting Capability: Credibility and commercial acumen to hold substantive, peer-level conversations with senior IT, Security, and Compliance stakeholders in organisations with 1,000+ seats without needing to be an engineer.
  • Parallel Dialler & Tooling Literacy: Practical experience using parallel diallers (such as Orum, Nooks, or equivalent high-velocity calling software) alongside modern sales engagement tools.
  • CRM Discipline: Rigorous data and pipeline tracking habits, with willingness to complete HubSpot certifications if not already held.
  • Flawless Communication: Outstanding verbal and written English skills, capable of composing compelling, error-free executive messaging without supervision.
  • Self-Directed Remote Discipline: Strong operational independence to manage daily activity, pipeline numbers, and metrics aligned strictly with UK business hours from South Africa.
  • Independent Contractor Readiness: Legally set up to operate as an independent contractor or registered entity in South Africa, maintaining a professional home office, high-spec workstation, noise-cancelling headset, and stable fibre internet.

PREFERRED:

  • Direct experience prospecting into the UK B2B market from an offshore/remote setup.
  • Prior background selling or setting appointments within Cybersecurity or related high-compliance technical SaaS sectors.
  • Experience operating as an early or founding SDR, building outbound cadences, lists, and messaging frameworks from the ground up.
  • Familiarity with indirect channel sales models, including MSPs, MSSPs, brokers, and value-added resellers.
  • Active hands-on proficiency with LinkedIn Sales Navigator and HubSpot CRM.

What You’ll Bring:

ccad23e878399d56.title: UX Research Intern
ccad23e878399d56.description:
About baesh

baesh is a social platform connecting people in real life through events, communities, and shared interests.

We’re a small team using AI to move quickly from ideas to working experiences. Research is central to how we decide what to build and whether it’s good enough to ship. Your work will help us stay close to people as the technology moves faster.

You’ll work closely with our Head of Product and UX, an experienced researcher with a PhD in emotional and behavioural research. You’ll get practical guidance across the research process—from deciding what to investigate to helping the team act on what we learn.

This is an unpaid mandatory internship for students whose university programme requires a placement.

  • Location: Mostly remote, with opportunities to join research and events in Berlin.

  • Start date: Flexible, depending on your university requirements.

  • Duration: As required by your university, usually 3–6 months.

What you’ll help with

Usability testing and idea validation

  • Help plan and run usability tests on our app and prototypes, including interfaces built with AI.

  • Explore how easily people can discover events, join communities, and create their profiles.

  • Test whether experiences make sense to real people, beyond looking polished or functioning technically.

  • Validate early ideas and assumptions before the team invests further.

  • Identify confusing moments and recommend improvements that make a meaningful difference.

Exploratory research and interviews

  • Help interview existing users and people who haven’t tried baesh yet.

  • Explore how people make friends, find things to do, and connect with communities.

  • Understand their needs, motivations, habits, and barriers.

  • Help write discussion guides and ask open questions that uncover useful insights.

  • Bring people’s experiences into product decisions, keeping the human connection at the heart of how we build.

AI-supported research

  • Use AI to help draft interview guides, usability-testing scripts, and survey questions.

  • Explore how AI can support research synthesis by organising notes, summarising sessions, and suggesting patterns.

  • Check AI-generated summaries and interpretations against what participants actually said and did.

  • Learn where AI saves time, where it misses nuance, and where your judgement matters most.

  • Help us develop practical ways to combine faster research workflows with thoughtful, reliable findings.

Recruitment and ongoing feedback

  • Help recruit participants and coordinate research sessions.

  • Support Friends of BAESH, our community of early adopters who contribute through interviews, user testing, feedback, and feature suggestions.

  • Help create short in-app surveys about specific parts of the experience.

Making sense of what we learn

  • Analyse feedback and identify patterns across sessions.

  • Turn findings into clear insights and practical recommendations.

  • Share research with the product and development team to shape what happens next.

  • Help organise our research so we can build on previous learning.

You won’t be expected to do all of this independently from day one. We’ll guide you, give you feedback, and gradually help you take ownership of research activities.

What you’ll bring

  • You’re enrolled in a degree programme that requires a mandatory internship.

  • An interest in UX research, psychology, human–computer interaction, design, sociology, or a related field.

  • Curiosity about people and a willingness to question assumptions.

  • Good listening skills and an empathetic, respectful approach.

  • Strong communication skills in English.

  • An organised approach and willingness to take initiative.

  • An interest in using AI thoughtfully, including questioning its output.

Preferred, but not required:

  • German-speaking, so you can support research with German-speaking participants.

  • Some familiarity with interviews, usability testing, surveys, or qualitative analysis—university projects count.

  • Experience experimenting with AI tools for research, writing, analysis, or prototyping.

  • An interest in social products, communities, and how digital experiences support real-life connections.

You don’t need previous professional UX research experience. We’re looking for curiosity, care, and a willingness to learn.

What you’ll gain

  • Research mentorship: Learn directly from an experienced UX and behavioural researcher.

  • Practical experience: Contribute to exploratory interviews, usability testing, surveys, and idea validation.

  • Experience with AI-enabled product development: Learn how to assess and improve products when building is fast and informed judgement matters more than ever.

  • Visible impact: See your findings shape the experiences we build and release.

  • Portfolio experience: Develop research case studies, with guidance on what can be shared.

  • Flexible working: Agree a schedule that fits your university’s placement requirements.

  • A small, collaborative team: Work closely with the people designing and building the product.

Interested?

If you have relevant university work or a portfolio, we’d love to see it—but it’s optional.

7fbece4efca346d4.title: Senior Software Engineer, Inference Performance
7fbece4efca346d4.description:
About Tensordyne 

AI is transforming our world. It can perform cognitive functions that previously only humans could do, such as perceiving interactions across different modalities and environments - with the ability to quickly learn and then solve complex problems. Tensordyne is an AI system solution company that builds very high-performance, low-power generative AI inference systems. Our mission, through the creation of custom silicon, hardware and software, is to enable multimodal Generative AI inference acceleration at scale, with safe, sustainable, high-performance systems for our hyperscaler and neocloud data center customers. We are at the leading edge of advancing the latest research and product improvements for generative Al inference solutions that will make Al even more advantageous for compelling new generative AI applications.Tensordyne is a well funded, fast-paced startup company with headquarters in both Sunnyvale, CA, and Munich, Germany. We also have many talented team members working remotely across North America and Europe. We take care of our people and their families with comprehensive benefits, competitive compensation, flexible spending options, and recognition programs, because building category-defining technology starts with a healthy, supported team. Come join us as we shape the future of multimodal generative artificial intelligence!

The role

You'll build the software stack that takes a model from code down to the hardware: the abstractions, kernels, libraries, and tools that engineers and agents use to reach peak performance. Help optimize the latest AI models on our silicon.

Our hardware is designed to be straightforward to program, so the goal is not to hide it. The goal is to expose the right level of control at each layer, from our compiler-driven Python SDK to our low-level Rust programming stack, and to make every performance gap measurable and every fix permanent.

We're looking for a builder who understands hardware deeply and develops with agents by default. You'll own substantial parts of one of these layers and work closely with engineers across models, compilers, runtime, and hardware. Your focus is performance: where cycles, bandwidth, and communication go, and how to win them back. Number formats and model accuracy are owned by our conversion and emulation team; you'll partner with them where precision and speed meet.

What you'll do

  • Build the stack. Design APIs, kernel abstractions, and libraries in our Python SDK or Rust stack so model engineers and agents can reach high performance at the layer that fits their problem.
  • Make models fast. Take priority workloads, from LLMs to multimodal models, to peak performance on real silicon. Profile, find the bottleneck across kernels, compiler, runtime, and parallelism, and fix it at the right layer.
  • Close the gap between model and measurement. Compare measured performance against analytical models and simulation. Explain every material gap, and turn the explanation into a fix or a better model.
  • Build the agentic performance loop. Give agents the profilers, traces, counters, and benchmark harnesses to form a hypothesis, change code, and measure the result in minutes. Make the results trustworthy enough to act on.
  • Set the bar for performance. Define how we measure, track regressions, and report results.
  • Build for the next chip. Design abstractions that carry forward to future hardware generations. Work with hardware architects to test how architectural choices affect real workloads.

What we need from you

  • You understand hardware performance. You've optimized AI workloads on GPUs or custom accelerators and can reason about compute utilization, memory hierarchy, latency hiding, synchronization, and multi-chip scaling.
  • You build excellent software. You've owned substantial systems from design through production. You're strong in Python and/or at least one systems language such as Rust, C++, or C, and rigorous about interfaces, abstractions, and testing. We care about engineering quality more than a specific language.
  • You understand LLM inference end to end. You can read a new model's implementation and reason about prefill, decode, attention variants, KV caches, MoE, and parallelism, and how they map to compute, memory, and communication.
  • You build with agents. Agentic development is how you work, not an experiment. You'd rather build the loop that finds the optimization than find it by hand, and you know when the loop still needs a human.
  • You build things others succeed with. You've designed APIs, libraries, or performance tooling that other engineers adopted.
  • You drive problems to resolution. You form clear hypotheses, measure, and follow the evidence across software and hardware boundaries. You take ownership of the result.

If you hit a few of those boxes, we'd like to speak to you.

We'd be thrilled if you had

  • Experience with embedded, bare-metal, or low-level runtime programming.
  • Experience with MLIR, other compiler frameworks, or kernel DSLs such as Triton, Pallas, NKI, or CuTe.
  • Contributions to LLM serving stacks such as vLLM or SGLang, or a track record of taking end-to-end inference workloads to competitive performance on a hardware target.

Why join us

Your code will decide how fast models run on our hardware, and how easy it is for the next engineer, or the next agent, to make them faster. You'll own a layer of a new programming model, work directly with the people designing the hardware, and see your decisions tested on real silicon and carried into the next generation.

Tensordyne Values

  • Think big. Pursue ambitious technical and business goals.
  • Aim for excellence. Quality matters in everything we build and deliver.
  • Own it and get it done. Take responsibility and drive results.
  • Operate with integrity. Be direct, transparent, and respectful.
  • Win as a team. Make the people around you more effective.
  • Value different perspectives. The strongest teams challenge assumptions and bring diverse experience to difficult problems.

Tensordyne is an equal opportunity employer. We believe diverse teams are better equipped to solve complex problems and build exceptional technology. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, color, gender identity or expression, marital status, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, race, religion, pregnancy, sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws, regulations, and ordinances.

A note to recruitment agencies: Please do not contact Tensordyne employees or leaders regarding this role. We do not accept unsolicited agency resumes and are not responsible for fees associated with unsolicited submissions.

About Munich Electrification

Munich Electrification is an innovative company founded with the aim of accelerating the transition to electric and connected mobility. We develop innovative electronic control units for electric vehicles and stationary storage systems for our global customers. Our international team is composed of highly motivated and exceptional engineers. As a small and specialized team we are well-aware of the importance of each individual colleague and support and promote each employee according to their abilities and needs. Our office with adjacent prototype and testing lab is located in the heart of Munich at the Heimeranplatz.

This is what we stand for:

- Technological Leadership: We challenge norms, innovate quickly, and anticipate future needs. We take smart risks and learn from outcomes to stay ahead.

- Sustainability: We actively drive change for a sustainable future, aware of our impact and inspiring others to build a better world.

- Team Culture: We believe work should be enjoyable, fostering a spirit of inspiration, celebration, and teamwork across the globe.

- Entrepreneurial Spirit: We embrace change, think big, and push limits with passion.

Über Munich Electrification

Munich Electrification ist ein innovatives Unternehmen, das mit dem Ziel gegründet wurde, den Übergang zur elektrischen und vernetzten Mobilität zu beschleunigen. Wir entwickeln innovative elektronische Steuergeräte für Elektrofahrzeuge und stationäre Speichersysteme für unsere Kunden weltweit. Unser internationales Team setzt sich aus hochmotivierten und exzellenten Ingenieur: innen zusammen. Als kleines und spezialisiertes Team sind wir uns der Bedeutung jedes/r einzelnen Kolleg: in bewusst und fördern jede/n Mitarbeiter/in nach ihren Fähigkeiten und Bedürfnissen. Unser Büro mit angeschlossenem Prototypen- und Testlabor befindet sich im Herzen von München am Heimeranplatz.

 

Das ist es, wofür wir stehen:

– Technologische Führerschaft: Wir stellen Normen infrage, sind innovativ und antizipieren zukünftige Bedürfnisse. Wir gehen bewusst Risiken ein, lernen aus den Ergebnissen und sind so immer einen Schritt voraus.

Ready to put our brand in front of millions of people worldwide? We’re looking for a Data Analyst, Marketing to turn raw campaign and engagement data into decisions — telling us which channels, markets, and customers to target next.

This isn’t a dashboard-building role. You’ll build robust data products, of course — but the real impact comes from the reporting and insight you deliver, and the incremental value that creates for the marketing team.

Let’s shape the future of nutrition together and make Yazio the most successful nutrition app worldwide!

This role is 100% remote and open to candidates based in Germany, Spain, Portugal, or the U.K.

YOUR MISSION

  • Show our Performance Marketing team which campaigns to double down on — and which to scale back.

  • Partner with our CRM team to learn what messaging resonates with each user segment, then run experiments to measure the uplift.

  • Own the data transformation process, from raw channel and MMP data to curated, ready-to-use datasets in our self-service BI tool.

  • Define requirements with Data Engineering to ingest new data sources.

  • Work with the Analytics team to build a data-driven culture across Yazio.

YOUR PROFILE

  • Hands-on experience with performance marketing data for a native mobile app, covering channel-level or MMP data (ideally both).

  • Solid grasp of attribution, incrementality, funnel and cohort analysis, plus marketing performance metrics like iROAS and CAC.

  • High proficiency in SQL and working knowledge of Python.

  • Solid experience in either analytics engineering (e.g., using dbt to transform data) or data science (e.g., geo-lift tests, holdout tests, A/B tests, media mix modeling). You don’t need both, but you should be strong in one.

OUR CORE TECH STACK

We use:

  • Snowflake as our core Analytics data warehouse.

  • dbt & Dagster to transform & orchestrate our data.

  • Growthbook to power experimentation.

  • Omni to provide self-service analytics.

  • Prefect to handle our ML workflows.

WHY US?

ab76c0de4c162307.title: Senior Linux Application Engineer (all genders) – Python & IoT Edge
ab76c0de4c162307.description:
Parking without barriers, tickets or queues. Wemolo builds its own hardware and its own AI to make that happen. More than 7,000 of our scanners run on around 4,000 parking sites across Europe and have processed over 1.3 billion parking events: unattended, outdoors, around the clock.

As Senior Linux Application Engineer (all genders) in our IoT team, you build the software foundation for all our Linux-based devices, on ARM and x86. At its core is a platform layer that unifies shared components such as health monitoring and logging. Every device type then works the same way, and product features build on one solid base.

The role combines architecture and hands-on engineering: clean, object-oriented software, plus ownership of how it is built, deployed, updated and monitored across the fleet. Your code sits close to the hardware but runs on top of Linux.

Kernel development and microcontroller firmware are not part of the job. If well-designed software for Linux devices is your thing, you’ll feel at home here.

As we are looking for a hands-on developer, a live coding session is an integral part of our interview process.

What to expect

  • Unified platform layer: Design and build a platform layer that covers all our device types, both ARM and x86. It provides shared components such as health monitoring, logging, configuration, OTA updates and hardware abstraction.

  • Software architecture: Define clear interfaces between the platform and the applications on top of it. Consolidate the codebase so that new device types and components plug in easily.

  • Application development: Build Python services on top of the platform, inside our dockerized main application.

  • Device integration: Connect peripherals such as modems, watchdogs, cameras and AI accelerators through existing drivers, SDKs and Linux interfaces, behind a clean hardware abstraction.

  • Reliability and observability: Make our fleet secure, resilient and transparent through OTA updates, networking, inter-process communication and fleet-wide monitoring of device health.

  • Debugging: Analyze and solve complex issues at application and system level, such as memory leaks, network instability or service failures.

  • Ownership and mentoring: Take end-to-end responsibility, guide other engineers technically, and raise our engineering standards.

Inspire us by

  • Senior software engineering experience: 5+ years of professional software development, with a strong part of it on Linux-based devices or edge systems.

  • Strong OOP skills: Deep experience with object-oriented design in (preferably) Python. Experience in another OOP language such as C++, Java or Rust is a plus.

  • Architecture know-how: You have designed and evolved software architectures, applied design patterns, and made trade-off decisions you can explain clearly. Ideally you have built a platform, framework or shared library that other teams or services build on.

  • IoT background: Hands-on experience building software for connected devices, ideally operated as a fleet in the field.

  • Linux user-space expertise: Solid knowledge of Linux, systemd, networking, IPC, Bash and Docker, ideally across different hardware architectures (ARM and x86).

  • Debugging skills: Experience troubleshooting system-level issues with tools such as GDB, tcpdump, Valgrind or profilers.

  • Engineering mindset: Degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

  • Language skills: Fluent English (C1).

Strong plus

  • Experience building, customizing and maintaining Linux images with Yocto.

  • Experience operating large-scale IoT fleets, including OTA updates and device monitoring

  • Familiarity with MQTT and Protocol Buffers (ProtoBuf)

  • Knowledge of industrial hardware, cameras, AI accelerators, modems or network devices

  • Experience with edge AI, computer vision or machine learning

What we offer

  • Flexibility & Responsibility: Your workday, your performance – Our hybrid model empowers you to focus from home, get fresh perspectives during workation, and connect in person during our Anchor Days (Tuesday to Thursday)

  • Tailored Mobility: Full speed ahead – Whether it’s sustainable bike leasing or a public transport subsidy, we keep you flexible and on the move

  • Measurable goals: Our agile methods allow you to directly measure your impact on our product and company success

  • Team Culture & Networking: Real connections – also beyond the day-to-day. Celebrate successes with us at legendary team events and OKR parties

  • Productive Environment: Brainfood deluxe – Whether it's portafilter coffee, Bella&Bona online cafeteria, fresh fruit or our muesli bar – your wellbeing fuels your performance

  • Health & Balance: Stay in balance with EGYM Wellpass or Urban Sports Club – access 1,000+ gyms and wellness spots across Germany

  • Top Equipment & Ergonomics: Mac or Windows, in the office or remote – we make sure you’re set up for efficiency and comfort

  • Dress Code? Your Code: What you do matters more than what you wear – dress in whatever makes you feel your best

Innovation through diversity

Regardless of your background, origin, gender identity, or individual circumstances, it's your personality that interests us. That's why we're committed to building a culture of collaboration and respect, where every team member has a voice, can grow, and feels valued with us.

adbc17d77afb082d.description:
We are building Germany's leading tax advisory firm. Many business owners want a tax advisor who acts as a true sparring partner: proactive, responsive and strategic. What they often get is a service provider that books receipts and files returns, with little real advice. We're building the alternative.

Founded in 2025, Taxforce rethinks tax advisory from the ground up: AI-powered and highly automated, yet personal. We're starting with healthcare professionals, a complex and underserved segment, and we grow both organically and through M&A.

This is a €40B market in Germany alone, with processes that have barely changed in decades. AI now enables a fundamental shift, and there are no playbooks yet. We're writing them. We're a small, highly ambitious team in Berlin, backed by €5M from Tenet VC and founded by alumni of Goldman Sachs, Harvard Business School, Bain & Company, Y Combinator and the former Klarna Head of Engineering.

The role

You join the team that finds, evaluates, finances and integrates the tax firms that join Taxforce. You work directly with our founders on live deals and own your workstreams from first screening to closing and beyond.

Tasks

  • Deal sourcing. Build and maintain a pipeline of tax firms that fit our focus, from research and screening to first outreach.

  • Firm analysis. Turn DATEV reports, business analyses, annual accounts and payroll data into a clear picture of revenue, clients, team capacity and profitability.

  • Models and valuation. Build and maintain valuation and financing models in Excel.

  • Due diligence. Prepare and run due diligence workstreams, from data room to question lists.

  • Financing. Prepare materials for banks and financing partners and keep the process on track.

  • Decision papers. Write investment memos and presentations for founders and investors.

  • Post-merger integration. Support the onboarding of acquired firms, from process documentation to cross-firm coordination.

Requirements

  • Strong academic background. You have a very good Bachelor’s degree or are enrolled in a Master’s in business, economics, finance or a related field.

  • First deal experience. You’ve interned in M&A, transaction services, private equity, investment banking, corporate finance or consulting.

  • Financial fluency. You understand P&Ls, balance sheets and cash flows and quickly spot what doesn’t add up.

  • Analytical mindset. You turn incomplete information into a clear recommendation.

  • AI-native. You use AI tools to build analyses and models faster.

  • German language skills. Sellers and banks speak German, so we require fluent German (C2) and English.

Benefits

  • Work directly with experienced founders. Learn first-hand from a team with backgrounds at Goldman Sachs, Harvard Business School, Bain & Company and Klarna, and from a former Y Combinator founder.

  • Buy-and-build from the inside. See how a group of tax firms is built at an early stage.

  • At the table. Meet sellers, banks and investors and present your own analysis.

  • Ownership from day one. Take on real responsibility early, on live clients, deals and projects.

  • Front-row seat to AI in the real world. See how AI transforms a traditional industry and help build it.

  • Steep learning curve. Work on real problems, ship quickly and build skills that prepare you to start your own company.

  • A path to stay. Strong interns get an offer to continue as working student or full-time.

The details

Full-time internship for 3 to 6 months, start any time of the year, on-site in our Berlin office five days a week.

How to apply

Send us your CV and a few lines on why this role fits you. Our process has three steps: a 30-minute intro call, a short live case from our day-to-day work, and a conversation with the founders.

Deine Rolle

Du verantwortest zunächst die IT unserer Berliner Zentrale. Du sorgst dafür, dass Mitarbeitende arbeitsfähig sind, Zugänge sicher verwaltet werden und Geräte sowie Netzwerk zuverlässig funktionieren.

Gleichzeitig entwickelst du Standards und Abläufe, die auch bei der nächsten Hausverwaltung funktionieren. Mittelfristig begleitest du die IT-Integration unserer Tochterunternehmen und arbeitest dabei eng mit unserem externen IT-Partner zusammen.

Du berichtest direkt an unseren Head of Product. Mit wachsender Verantwortung kannst du dich in die Rolle des Head of IT für die Buena-Gruppe entwickeln.

Was du bei uns machst

  • Du hältst unsere IT in Berlin am Laufen. Du unterstützt Kolleginnen und Kollegen vor Ort, löst technische Probleme und betreust unser UniFi-Netzwerk.

  • Du verantwortest Google Workspace. Du verwaltest Nutzer, Gruppen, Berechtigungen, Shared Drives und Lizenzen und setzt verlässliche Sicherheitseinstellungen um.

  • Du organisierst Ein- und Austritte. Neue Mitarbeitende starten mit eingerichteten Konten und Geräten. Beim Austritt kümmerst du dich um Zugriffsrechte, Datensicherung und die Rücknahme der Hardware.

  • Du verwaltest unsere Geräte. Du betreust Laptops und Mobilgeräte mit NinjaOne sowie Apple-Geräte über den Apple Business Manager und die angebundene Geräteverwaltung.

  • Du verbesserst wiederkehrende Abläufe. Du erkennst unnötige Handarbeit, automatisierst sinnvolle Schritte und dokumentierst Prozesse so, dass andere damit arbeiten können.

  • Du begleitest neue Standorte. Du verschaffst dir einen Überblick über deren IT, planst notwendige Anpassungen und setzt sie gemeinsam mit unserem IT-Partner um. Dafür reist du gelegentlich zu unseren Hausverwaltungen.

Was du mitbringst

  • Du hast mehrere Jahre praktische Erfahrung in der Systemadministration und kannst eine IT-Umgebung eigenständig betreuen.

  • Du kennst Google Workspace gut und hast Erfahrung mit Geräteverwaltung, beispielsweise NinjaOne, Jamf oder Intune.

  • Du bist mit macOS, iOS und dem Apple Business Manager vertraut und verfügst über solide Netzwerkgrundkenntnisse, idealerweise mit UniFi.

  • Du hast bereits einen IT-Prozess verbessert, eine neue Lösung eingeführt oder eine Systemumstellung begleitet und kannst deinen eigenen Beitrag erklären.

  • Du gehst Fehlern systematisch auf den Grund und kannst entscheiden, was zuerst gelöst werden muss.

  • Du erklärst technische Themen verständlich und arbeitest verbindlich mit Mitarbeitenden und externen Dienstleistern zusammen.

  • Du möchtest vor Ort in Berlin-Prenzlauer Berg arbeiten, bist zu gelegentlichen Reisen bereit und sprichst sehr gut Deutsch sowie gut Englisch.

Eine Ausbildung als Fachinformatiker für Systemintegration oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation ist hilfreich. Einschlägige Praxiserfahrung zählt genauso. Führungserfahrung ist keine Voraussetzung; du solltest Lust haben, mit der Aufgabe zu wachsen und zunehmend übergreifende Verantwortung zu übernehmen.

Was du bei uns bekommst

  • Verantwortung für einen Bereich, den du aktiv mitgestaltest.

  • Die Perspektive, mit Buena in eine Head-of-IT-Rolle hineinzuwachsen.

  • Direkte Zusammenarbeit mit unserem Head of Integration und kurze Entscheidungswege.

  • Attraktives Gehalt und 500 € „Close-to-Office“-Bonus.

  • MacBook und Studio Display.

  • 110 € Essenszuschuss und 50 € Fitnesszuschuss.

  • Bücher: Buena zahlt jedes Buch, das du lesen möchtest.

  • Tägliches Frühstück und Spezialitätenkaffee im Büro.

Lerne uns kennen.

Im Bewerbungsprozess sprechen wir über Aufgaben und Entscheidungen aus deiner bisherigen Arbeit. Vor Ort lösen wir gemeinsam ein praxisnahes IT-Szenario. Dabei interessiert uns, wie du Probleme eingrenzt, Prioritäten setzt und deine Überlegungen erklärst.

Wir freuen uns darauf, dich kennenzulernen.

18235cf51c5a3b75.title: Full-Stack Engineer (f/m/d)
18235cf51c5a3b75.description:
Please note: For this position, we are unable to offer visa sponsorship or relocation support. Applicants must already hold the legal right to work in Germany (e.g., EU/EEA citizenship or a valid residence/work permit).

 

About us

Zenjob is an AI-powered flexible staffing platform that has efficiently connected companies and temporary workers since 2015. Companies use our platform to book ready-to-work staff in real time, while students use our app to find part-time jobs that conveniently fit around their studies. Over 40,000 students and 1,000 partner companies from logistics, retail, and hospitality in all major German cities share our belief that good work is not a coincidence. It is the result of innovative technology and genuine commitment. Good work starts here.

 

About the role

As a Fullstack Engineer (f/m/d) you'll play a key role in shaping and building our product at Zenjob. Working across the full stack, including event-driven backend services and polished user-facing interfaces, you'll collaborate closely with product managers and stakeholders, set engineering standards, and mentor others along the way. If you thrive in a fast-moving environment and want to make a real impact on a product used by thousands of workers and businesses, we'd love to hear from you.

 

How you will contribute

  • Design, develop, and own end-to-end features-from ideation and technical proposal through to production deployment and ongoing maintenance.

  • Build and evolve backend services and frontend applications using TypeScript and Java, leveraging gRPC as our primary service communication protocol

  • Collaborate cross-functionally with business, product and data to deliver high-value, high-reliability features.

  • Champion continuous value delivery by advocating for quality and elevating engineering practices.

  • Help drive architectural and process decisions, bringing your experience to bear on choices that affect the whole engineering organisation.

  • Mentor and support other engineers, fostering a culture of learning, feedback, and continuous improvement.

  • Enable the organisation through tooling, documentation, and shared libraries that raise the bar for contributions across the codebase.

 

Who you are

 

  • You have a history of consistently delivering complex, high-impact initiatives E2E – from shaping the business case to collaborating cross-functionally towards the finish line and measuring results

  • You have a strong appreciation for observability - you understand the value of structured logging and distributed tracing in production systems.

  • You are collaborative and communicative, with the ability to clearly articulate trade-offs, influence technical direction, and work effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

  • You are self-driven and outcome-oriented, capable of leading complex initiatives from ambiguity to delivery with minimal guidance.

  • You are empathetic and inclusive, with a broad understanding of the different roles and functions within a product engineering team.

 

What we offer

  • Innovative mission: Together we create something new. Work in a dynamic set-up where you learn a lot and your every idea is heard.

  • Unique team spirit: We can rely on each other blindly and celebrate all successes together as a team.

  • Vacation: Recreation and further education is important, which is why we offer 28 days of paid vacation (increased by 1 day for every 2 calendar years of service with us, up to a maximum of 30 days), 1 day of special leave for community service, 5 days of paid educational leave, and the possibility of unpaid leave

  • Hybrid working model: We love our brand new office in Prenzlauer Berg. But sometimes you need a little more flexibility. Zenjob’s flexible working model combines the best of both worlds, so you can work remotely up to 2 days / week (1 day, during the first 6 months, so we can guarantee you the best onboarding).

  • Dog-lover: If you have a dog, feel free to bring it with you. We don’t bite and always have a bowl of water in our range of drinks

  • Personal growth: Ongoing focus on your personal development (annual training budget of EUR 750, mentoring opportunities, constant career development conversations)

  • Healthy mind in a healthy body: With us you will receive a 30 EUR Urban Sports Club grant to keep you fit. In addition, we have a small sports room in the office ourselves.

  • Always mobile: You will receive EUR 40 credit per month for NAVIT, a sustainable mobility tool for public transport, bike sharing and much more.

  • Legendary Events: Quarterly team events, winter and summer parties, budget for birthdays and anniversaries of our employees

     

If this sounds good, then we’d love to find out more about you! Apply and send in your application.

 

🎥 Watch our Office Tour video.

 

We invite you to visit our careers page, follow our LinkedIn page and connect with us on Instagram.

 

We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to judging every qualified individual on their ability, regardless of age, gender identity, ethnicity, sexual orientation, disability status, or religion. There is no need to add your photo and age to the application.

f2ade7f18544e5fa.description:
Who We Are

Having surpassed $300M ARR and continuing to grow, Optro helps enterprises transform risk into opportunity through its AI-powered GRC Intelligence Platform. More than 50% of the Fortune 500, including 7 of the Fortune 10, leverage our award-winning technology to move their businesses forward with greater clarity and agility. And our customers love us: Optro is top-rated on G2.com and Gartner Peer Insights.

At Optro, we inspire each other to innovate and are proud of what we are producing. We spend each day thinking of new ways to help our customers and contribute to the greater good of our company and our surrounding communities. We are all about assisting each other and breaking through barriers to create the most loved audit, risk, ESG, and InfoSec platform by our customers. This is how we have become one of the 500 fastest-growing tech companies in North America for the seventh year in a row, as ranked by Deloitte!

Why This Role is Exciting

At AuditBoard, we empower businesses with award-winning technology that transforms risk into strategic advantage. As we continue our expansion in the DACH region, we are looking for an experienced Enterprise Account Executive to drive meaningful business outcomes with our innovative solutions.

If you are a relationship-driven sales professional with a consultative mindset and a passion for delivering value to enterprise customers, this is your opportunity to shape the future of risk and compliance in one of Europe’s most advanced economies.


Opportunities in This Role

  • Work alongside a mission-driven team that values integrity, excellence, and shared success.

  • Thrive in a collaborative culture that celebrates high performance and continuous improvement.

  • Enjoy flexibility with remote-based working.

  • Be part of a high-growth company recognized as a Great Place to Work, where your impact is visible and rewarded.

  • Access competitive compensation, professional development, and career advancement opportunities

Key Responsibilities

  • Own and grow a portfolio of enterprise accounts—including both publicly listed and privately held companies—across the DACH region.

  • Drive new logo acquisition and existing customer expansion, contributing directly to our growth in a key European market.

  • Operate from your home office in Germany, with travel to clients as needed or our London based AuditBoard office.

  • Report directly to the Director, Sales and work cross-functionally with regional and global teams.

  • Build trusted advisor relationships with C-level stakeholders by understanding their challenges and mapping them to AuditBoard’s platform capabilities.

  • Collaborate across Pre-Sales, Business Value Consulting, and Marketing, leveraging tools, partners, and events to drive pipeline and deal progression.

  • Partner with the strategic alliances to deliver integrated, customer-centric outcomes.

Attributes for a Successful Candidate 

  • 5–7 years of experience in enterprise technology sales, ideally in SaaS or GRC software solutions.

  • Proven success in complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles and closing high-value deals.

  • Demonstrated experience in value-based selling and establishing long-term client partnerships.

  • Native-level German fluency and excellent English communication skills (both verbal and written).

  • A collaborative mindset and experience working cross-functionally with global teams

  • Comfortable leveraging structured sales frameworks (e.g., MEDDPICC, Challenger Sale).

  • A learning-oriented mindset and a desire to grow within a fast-paced, international environment.

  • Familiarity with German regulatory environments and enterprise procurement expectations.

Our Company Values

  • Customer Obsession: Apply relentless focus on listening to and understanding customers as the core of everything we do

  • Win, Together: Drive to be the best while supporting each other’s success

  • Gritty Resilience: Thrive in a fast-paced and dynamic environment, balancing immediate priorities with big-picture strategic goals

  • Personal Improvement: Stay eager to share insights, seek feedback, and continuously learn

  • Constant Innovation: Challenge the status quo and drive improvements

Perks (Germany)

  • Launch a career at one of the fastest-growing SaaS companies in North America and EMEA!

  • 150 EUR monthly work from home allowance

  • 600 EUR monthly car allowance

  • Competitive compensation & bonus program

  • Annual Leave: 30 days

  • Employee resource groups

  • Opportunities for team and company-wide get-togethers!

Forward Deployed Engineer (all genders)

The Opportunity

AI is fundamentally changing how enterprises operate. As AI agents take on increasingly complex workflows, enterprise software needs to integrate seamlessly with existing systems. That’s where you come in.

At Lio, we’re building THE AI workforce for procurement. As a Forward Deployed Engineer, you’ll work at the intersection of Engineering, Product, and enterprise customers, building integrations and turning customer requirements into scalable product capabilities.

What You’ll Do

  • Build enterprise integrations across APIs, SAP, and other business systems

  • Design scalable technical solutions directly with enterprise customers

  • Debug and resolve complex issues in production environments

  • Own customer-driven features from MVP to production, and turn recurring needs into reusable platform capabilities

  • Automate deployment and implementation workflows with Product and Engineering

Your Profile

  • You enjoy solving technical problems across APIs, integrations, and distributed systems

  • Ownership: you build reliable, scalable solutions, not just things that work

  • You like working closely with customers and translating their challenges into product improvements

  • Clear communication across Engineering, Product, and customer teams

  • You thrive in fast-moving environments where you learn quickly and have direct impact

  • Excited about bringing AI into enterprise operations

What’s Not Required

No procurement or SAP experience needed. Strong engineering fundamentals, curiosity, and ownership matter more to us than the perfect CV.

Why Join Lio?

Lio is backed by Andreessen Horowitz (a16z) and built at Y Combinator. We’re bringing Silicon Valley ambition and engineering culture to Munich.

You’ll work with Fortune 500 companies across Europe and the US, with ownership from day one. What you build won’t stay customer-specific: it shapes the future of our platform.

What We Offer

  • A culture shaped by the team, not from the top down: our people define how we work, and our office shows it

  • Brand-new office at Stiglmaierplatz in central Munich, fully equipped and designed by our teams, with no rules on how it has to look. It tells our story.

  • Food & drinks: catered dinner in the office four days a week, plus a cereal bar, snacks and drinks. Protein fan? We’ve got you covered.

  • Regular team events, from beer pong tournaments to team dinners

  • Wellpass or Deutschlandticket: you choose, we subsidize it

  • 30 days of vacation

  • Latest equipment: MacBook and everything you need to do your best work

If you’re excited about building AI systems that run in production at global enterprises, we’d love to hear from you.

203dbb8d21373e7f.title: Finance & Legal Lead
203dbb8d21373e7f.description:
👷🏻‍♀️ What we do 👷🏻‍♀️

At Emidat, we get manufacturers back to manufacturing.

Why it matters. Today, only 11% of employees in Germany are engaged at work, and knowledge workers spend 58% of their day on work about work. We want to live in a world where people do work they enjoy and that creates value. A physical world that improves everyday where manufacturers of physical products who build the world around us focus on making better, more sustainable materials. Today, low-value work is often done by people at a company because they’re the only ones who know where the data is - the current data sheet, the hand-issued declaration. EU regulation adds more every year, and when the paperwork is late, the product cannot be sold. International competition and an ageing workforce increase the problem.

What we do. Emidat connects to a manufacturer’s own systems and builds one verified record per product and plant. On it runs AI applications that produce the documents: Environmental Product Declarations (EPDs), digital product passports, data sheets, tender answers. The experts approve. The software does the typing.

Where we are. 250+ manufacturers in 60+ product groups and 25+ countries, among them Holcim, Sika and a long list of mid-sized family companies. We started automating sustainability data for front runners who already wanted to do the right thing - next is everyone else.

Who we are. 50+ people in Munich, we run on ownership, action over complaint and low ego. We aim to become better everyday and reinvent ourselves quickly.

Find out more about us, the team and our values here.

What you will work on

Your mission

Build Emidat's finance engine and turn our numbers into the decisions that shape how we grow.

As our Finance & Legal Lead, you own both topics at Emidat and take the function forward as we enter our next phase of growth. You make sure finance scales seamlessly with the company and turn our numbers into insights that steer decisions on both the growth and the tech side.

At the same time, you keep the engine running: our books are clean, our contracts protect us and nothing falls through the cracks. You manage our external partners (tax advisors, legal counsel) and when something important is stuck, you're the one who follows up relentlessly until it's done.

This role is about ownership. From day-to-day operations to the high-impact projects that shape how Emidat scales, it starts and ends with you, and you bring an exceptional attention to detail to all of it.

Your core areas

Finance

  • Take our finance function to the next level: set up the processes and tools we need to scale, using automation and AI wherever it makes sense.

  • Own RevOps and our revenue data (ARR, renewals, churn, upsells) and turn it into insights that help our growth, customer success and product teams serve our customers even better.

  • Build and maintain financial planning, dashboards, investor reporting and relations.

  • Own invoicing, contracts and payments with our customers and make working with Emidat smooth and transparent for them.

  • Manage accounting operations and be the main point of contact for our tax advisors. Depending on your experience, you may also take over payroll.

  • Support fundraising efforts: package up metrics, prepare materials and help shape the strategy. Drive non-dilutive funding such as grants.

Legal

  • Handle all non-employee legal matters (customer contracts, supplier agreements etc.) and be the point of contact to our external legal counsel.

  • Own our customer contract framework (T&Cs, DPA) and work with our sales team on contract solutions that give our customers confidence and help close deals faster.

  • Prepare legal due diligence in fundraising and make sure we stay compliant with regulatory requirements together with our information security team.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Language: Fluent in German (C2 / Native) and business proficiency in English (C1+).

  • Finance & Legal Experience: Deep hands-on experience owning operational and strategic finance in a start-up / scale-up environment. You know German accounting and tax basics and are comfortable reviewing and negotiating commercial contracts.

  • RevOps / CRM Experience: You have worked with CRM and revenue data (e.g. HubSpot) and know how deals, contracts and billing data should flow between systems.

  • Analytical & Technical Skills: Demonstrated experience building financial models, dashboards or introducing data-driven decision making, and/or experience implementing AI-driven tools or automations that measurably reduced manual work.

  • Project Execution and Ownership: A proven track record of owning and executing projects from A to Z in a high-ownership, self-managed position, ideally building up processes or a function from scratch.

  • Extreme Detail-Orientation: Demonstrated ability to be in the weeds of the details to ensure success and accuracy. You have experience catching what others miss, making sure nothing falls through the cracks.

Nice to haves

  • Academic Background: Master's degree in business, finance, economics, law or a related quantitative field.

  • High-Growth Experience: Prior experience in a fast-paced startup or equivalent high-performance environment (e.g. B2B SaaS, Consulting, PE, IB, VC).

  • Fundraising Experience: You have been through a fundraise or due diligence process, on either side of the table.

  • Payroll Experience: You have run payroll and worked with DATEV and tax advisors.

How we support you

Your Team Lead will be

  • Florian (Co-Founder and CTO at Emidat)

You will work with

  • Lisa (Co-Founder and CEO at Emidat)

  • Ajay (People & Talent Lead)

  • Isabel (Team Lead, Go-to-Market)

  • Janos (Team Lead, Growth & Sales Development)

  • Sina (Team Lead, Customer Success)

  • Benedikt (Team Lead, LCA)

Your mentors can be

  • Legal and Finance: Lisa Gradow (Co-Founder & CEO at Fides, Sequoia Arc '22, prev. Co-Founder and CPO at Usercentrics)

  • Sales: Theresa Hauck (Co-Founder at econos — sustainable finance, ex-BCG, United Nations)

  • Company Building, Network: Markus Linder (Founder & CEO inoqo, prev. zoovu)

Meet the rest of the team HERE.

See our full benefits HERE, including:

  • 💸 Attractive compensation package including VSOP (for FTEs)

  • 🏖️ 25 days of vacation days per year

  • 📚 €2,000 Learning Budget

Admin

  • Role type: Full-Time

  • Location: Munich, Germany

Werkstudent/in (w/m/d) - Finance Operations

Als Werkstudent/in (w/m/d) - Finance Operations übernimmst Du eine zentrale Rolle beim Aufbau unserer gruppenweiten Finance-Funktion. Du berichtest an unserem VP Finance Operation und arbeitest eng mit unserer Director FP&A, unserem CFO, sowie den Geschäftsführern unserer Tochtergesellschaften zusammen und sorgst dafür, dass gruppenweite Finance-Prozesse, Standards und Projekte erfolgreich umgesetzt werden.

Dabei entwickelst du unsere Finance-Organisation gezielt weiter: Du koordinierst Finance-Projekte, begleitest die Integration neuer Gesellschaften, harmonisierst Prozesse und schaffst die Grundlage für eine skalierbare Finance-Plattform. Dafür brauchen wir deine Unterstützung!


Die Arsipa Gruppe ist eine schnell wachsende, PE-backed Unternehmensgruppe im Bereich Health, Safety & Environment, unterstützt von Warburg Pincus. Mit über 1.000 Mitarbeitenden, 20+ Tochtergesellschaften und 90 Standorten in Deutschland und Österreich bauen wir im Rahmen einer klaren Buy-&-Build-Strategie eine skalierbare Plattform mit nachhaltiger Wertschöpfung. Deine Aufgaben:

Finance Integration & Post-Merger-Integration

Finance Transformation & Standardisierung

Stakeholder- & Projektmanagement

  • Eng arbeitest Du mit unserem VP Finance Operations, Director FP&A, CFO sowie den Geschäftsführungen und Finance-Teams unserer Tochtergesellschaften zusammen.

  • Als zentrale Schnittstelle koordinierst Du die Zusammenarbeit zwischen Group Accounting, Group Controlling / FP&A und den lokalen Gesellschaften.

  • Unterschiedliche interne und externe Stakeholder bringst Du zusammen und sorgst für klare Verantwortlichkeiten, Abstimmungen und nächste Schritte.

  • Relevante Projektfortschritte, Entscheidungsbedarfe und Risiken bereitest Du transparent auf und kommunizierst diese an die beteiligten Stakeholder.

Deine Startvoraussetzungen:

Das bringst Du mit:

  • Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung im Finance-Umfeld mit fundiertem Verständnis von Accounting- und/oder Controlling-Prozessen bildet Deine fachliche Grundlage.

  • Erfahrung in der eigenständigen Steuerung bereichsübergreifender Projekte sowie im souveränen Umgang mit unterschiedlichen Stakeholdern bringst Du mit.

  • Erfahrung in einem PE-finanzierten, Multi-Entity-, Buy-&-Build- oder vergleichbaren Wachstumsumfeld wäre ein Plus.

  • Gestaltungsspielraum in einer Buy-&-Build-Plattform: Du gestaltest Prozesse, Strukturen und strategische Initiativen in einer krisensicheren, rasant wachsenden Unternehmensgruppe aktiv mit und erhältst Einblicke in die Umsetzung einer Roll-up-Strategie – unterstützt durch einen der weltweit führenden Investoren, Warburg Pincus.
