8a589ea155cd0daf.title: Product Manager - Internal Tools and AI
8a589ea155cd0daf.description:
Our mission

We're making Africa the first cashless continent.

In 2017, over half the population in Sub-Saharan Africa had no bank account. That's for good reason—the fees are too high, the closest branch can be miles away, and nobody takes cards. Without access to financial institutions, people are forced to keep their savings under the mattress. Small business owners rely on lenders who charge extortionate rates. Parents spend hours waiting in line to pay school fees in cash.

We're solving this by building financial services that just work: no account fees, instantly available, and accepted everywhere. In places where electricity, water and roads don't always work, you can still send money with Wave. In 2017, we launched a mobile app in Senegal for cash deposit, withdrawal, and peer-to-peer and business payments. Now, we have millions of users across 9 countries and are growing fast.

Our goal is to make Africa the first cashless continent and that's where you come in...

How you'll help us achieve it

Every promise our products make to a user or merchant is kept by an internal team somewhere in the company. When those teams can organise their work, adapt quickly and stay focused, Wave moves fast; when they can't, the company slows down and customers feel it. When we were smaller, organizing work didn't take much more than a quick spreadsheet but that breaks at scale.

Wave is now the largest financial institution in Senegal, Côte d'Ivoire, and the Gambia. We work with millions of users every month, employ thousands of people, and are growing rapidly. Similar processes now run in a dozen countries, but each team has built its own version, either because they don't know a better one exists or because setting it up well is harder than it should be.

AI has made this both better and worse: anyone can now build a workflow in an hour, but many aren't secure, won't scale, cost too much, or automate a process that should have been simplified first. Your job is to think from first principles about how work at Wave should run, give people a consistent and safe way to improve their own workflows, and make the common ones easy to adopt.

We're looking for a product manager who gets a kick out of figuring out how work should actually flow, and who doesn't much care whether the answer is a tool we build, a workflow in something we already pay for, or no tool at all. Someone who enjoys getting into the weeds with operations teams and who turns what they learn there into playbooks and building blocks every team can use.

In this role, you'll...

    • Own how Wave's general work tools get used. You're accountable for tools like Slack, Monday, and AI serving teams well. You work with the People team and other stakeholders to make sure they're set up so that organizing work or finding an answer is easy from day one. You help us make the right calls on major vendor decisions using what you've seen first-hand from users.
    • Help operations teams use AI efficiently and safely. You find the use cases where it truly saves teams time and turn those into shared skills, bots, and templates others can pick up in minutes. You build with these tools every day and teach teams to build in a secure and affordable way.
    • Care about the person, but solve for the company. There are far more problems than you can take on, so you pick the ones that help the most teams. You turn each solution into a playbook, template, or building block, and work through champions in every team to carry it forward.
    • Make sure each problem gets solved the right way. You're the expert on how people organize work in general, but behind every workflow sits domain context, constraints, and sometimes a product tool that already fits. You work with the leaders and PMs in that domain to decide whether a process should be simplified, automated, or shouldn't exist at all.
    • Build the team this work needs, starting with you. In your first few months you'll spend much of your time in-country with our operations teams as an IC, setting up workflows yourself with Slack and Monday.com, creating Claude skills and writing the first playbooks. As you learn more about what the company needs you can help us form a team around you.

Key Details

  • This is a fully remote role. Candidates must be based in one of our talent hub countries (UK, Spain, USA, Canada, Kenya and Ghana) or in one of our operating markets in Africa including Senegal, Côte d'Ivoire, or Burkina Faso
  • Wave is a distributed team, and we fund up to three in-person get-togethers a year, in line with Wave's travel policy.
  • Remote team members are expected to travel to our operational markets (e.g. Senegal or Côte d'Ivoire) at least once per quarter. Exceptions apply, but we've found this key to understanding our users and product.
  • Our salaries are competitive and are calculated using a transparent formula. For this role, depending on your level and location, we offer a salary between $142,200 - $203,300 USD, plus a generous equity package.
  • Major benefits:
    • Subsidised health insurance for you and your dependents, and retirement contributions (both vary from country to country).
    • 6 months of fully paid parental leave and subsidised fertility assistance.
    • Flexible vacation, with most folks taking between 21-30 days per year. 
    • $10,000 annual charitable donation matching.

Requirement

  • 5+ years of experience in product management, or in a similar role where you owned products or processes end-to-end, ideally in high-ownership, fast-paced environments like scale-ups.
  • Proven success in overseeing all elements of the product development lifecycle, such as user research, design, implementation and evaluation
  • Demonstrated hands-on experience designing and improving operational workflows that save teams time, produce accurate results, and run reliably at a reasonable cost.
  • AI-fluent: you've used tools like Claude or ChatGPT to build skills, automations, or workflows that did something meaningful in your actual job, not just experiments.
  • Speak fluent English
  • Bonus if you
    • Speak at least conversational French
    • Have worked with Slack and an enterprise workflow tool like Monday, Jira or Linear.
    • Have worked in or closely with large operations teams (support, field, finance)
    • Are a mobile money user in Sub-Saharan Africa

You might be a good fit if you

  • Resonate deeply with how we do product and have experience working that way.
  • Are a strong communicator that can inspire and lead by influence.
  • Are great at coordinating across teams and excel at communicating across multiple cultures.
  • Have a good nose for user-focused product design and obsess over user experience.
  • Take ownership for outcomes and do whatever you can to make them close to inevitable.
  • Have strong instincts for asking questions that could move the needle.
  • Have the courage and persistence to replan when feedback or new information arrives.
  • Always listen with empathy but ruthlessly prioritize based on impact.
  • Are excited about travel and meet users where they are — your users will be in Senegal, Côte d'Ivoire, and other countries in Africa, and some travel will be essential.

About Product at Wave

Product has always been very important to us at Wave, starting from day one with two very strong product-minded founders. Product Managers play a central role in our organization, impacting large chunks of the company around them, similar to the founders they were shaped after years ago.

Our approach to building products may not be what you've seen in other places. Our processes are lightweight, informed by principles instead of methodologies and our PMs don't just manage backlogs full of polished tickets. Read our write-up on product at Wave!

If you're excited to own a real problem end-to-end, set your own goals, and guide a team toward outcomes that matter for real people, you'll feel right at home here.

If that's you, we'd love to meet you.

 

Our team

  • We have a rapidly growing in-country team in Senegal, Côte d'Ivoire, Mali, Burkina Faso, The Gambia, Uganda, Niger, Sierra Leone, and Cameroon plus remote team members spread across the world.
  • We're deeply passionate about our mission of bringing radically affordable financial services to the people who need them most.
  • We foster autonomy for our employees. You'll own your projects at every stage, from understanding the problem to monitoring your solution in production.
  • We raised the largest Series A in Africa in 2021. Our world-class investors, include Founders Fund, Sequoia Heritage, Stripe, Ribbit Capital, Y Combinator, and Partech Africa.
  • We are on Y Combinator's top companies by revenue.

How to apply

Fill out the form below, and upload a resume in English and a cover letter describing your interest in Wave and the role.

We review applications frequently and recommend that you apply to the role that most closely aligns with your skills, experience and career goals.

Wave is an equal-opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

ca1d97af53082105.title: Product Security Engineer
ca1d97af53082105.description:
Orbital is the AI platform for real estate legal work.

Real estate shapes the world around us: our homes, our workplaces and our cultural landmarks. It’s the infrastructure that powers everyday life and is the world's largest asset class. Yet behind every single deal, real estate and legal teams work hard to navigate decades-old complexity; manually connecting documents, hidden obligations, geo-spatial context, and multiple parties into a path forward. We connect the legal and physical record, so that path is clearer than ever before. Our mission is to make real estate transactions faster, clearer, and less manual.

Here, you'll be part of changing how the deals behind the largest asset class get transacted, and will help shape the future of real estate.

A bit about us:

🚀 We’re building at the forefront of AI technology, without losing the deeply human expertise our clients depend on.

🏢 Orbital is built with former practising real estate lawyers and 250+ years of combined legal expertise. We're purpose-built for the complexity of real estate: accelerating due diligence, drafting and negotiation, and deal coordination with legal-grade precision.

💰 We've just raised a $60m Series B, led by Brighton Park Capital, to accelerate our global expansion – $75m raised to date.

🤝 We're trusted by 5,000+ real estate professionals, spanning UK Magic Circle and US Am Law 100 firms, to household names like M&S. Leading firms like BCLP, Orrick, Goodwin, Womble Bond Dickinson and Clifford Chance rely on Orbital to remove the busywork, freeing legal and real estate teams to focus on sharp judgment, standout client service, and closing deals faster.

💡 Working at Orbital means joining a bold, ambitious team, with the trust to take ownership and make a real impact from day one.

Role Overview 🔎

We're looking for a Product Security Engineer to own the security of Orbital's product: the AI agent our customers use, the platform it runs on, and how we build both.

Our customers are law firms and real estate businesses. They trust us with confidential transaction documents, and they ask hard questions about how we protect them. Our product is an AI agent that reads those documents, calls tools and runs code on a lawyer's behalf. That brings the usual cloud security work and a newer set of risks: prompt injection, agents acting on untrusted input, and attackers using AI to move faster than before.

You'll be our first in-house product security engineer, taking on work we have so far relied on contractors for. You'll build security into the product rather than review it from outside: you'll decide how we rate a vulnerability and how fast we act on it, build the automated systems that find and fix issues before an attacker does, and set the security bar that engineering builds to. You'll work alongside our product engineers, with the authority to require changes across teams on security grounds, independent of any one team's delivery deadlines. An information security lead will own company-wide policy, compliance and customer assurance, and you'll work closely with them.

You won't start from zero. Our AWS environment follows the Well-Architected Framework, with GuardDuty, Security Hub, encryption at rest and scoped credentials in place, and we hold SOC 2 and ISO 27001 commitments to our customers. What we need is someone to own it, find the gaps, and raise the standard as the company and the threat landscape grow.

You'll get a chance to 👩‍💻 👨‍💻

  • Build an automated security harness. Put agents to work on our product: continuous red-team and blue-team loops that probe the agent, the platform and our code, find vulnerabilities, and propose or ship the fix. Manual review should be justified when required and automatic harness improvement is expected.

  • Own vulnerability management end to end. Define how we classify severity and the response time each level demands, so a critical CVE gets fixed the same day. Automate patching, dependency and image scanning, and make sure findings reach an owner and get closed.

  • Secure an AI agent in production. Threat-model how our agent handles untrusted documents, emails and web content, and the tools and sandboxes it uses. Design defences against prompt injection and data exfiltration, and test them.

  • Make security part of how we build. Review designs and changes that touch authentication, tenant isolation, secrets and data handling. Turn recurring findings into automated checks so the protection holds without depending on someone remembering.

  • Respond to security incidents. Lead the technical response when something goes wrong: containment, investigation and the fix. Build the technical side of our breach playbooks with our information security lead, and run the review afterwards.

  • Choose and run our security tooling. Evaluate and roll out a cloud security platform (such as Wiz) and the detection, alerting and logging we need across AWS and Azure. As our only product security specialist, use tooling and AI agents to cover more ground than one person could alone.

  • Test our defences. Run red-team exercises, manage external penetration testers, and run breach drills with engineering so everyone knows their part before it matters.

  • Close the loop on findings. Fix what penetration tests and security researchers report to us, run responsible disclosure, and keep the technical evidence for our SOC 2 and ISO 27001 controls current, working with our information security lead.

  • Make the work visible. Show leadership and engineering what the harness finds, what has been fixed and what risk remains, in plain language, with a recommendation for each open risk.

You should apply if you ✍️

  • You build with agents. You'd rather put an agent loop on a problem than repeat a manual review. You've used AI agents to find, triage or fix security issues, and you aim for automation that leaves people to review only the exceptions.

  • You have deep, hands-on security engineering experience. You've owned security for a cloud-native product or platform and can do the work yourself, from reading code and IAM policies to configuring detection and running an investigation.

  • You know AWS security well. IAM, network design, KMS, GuardDuty, Security Hub, CloudTrail and how they fit together in a real production environment.

  • You've led incident response. You've run a real security incident, including containment, investigation, communication and the follow-up, and you stay clear-headed under pressure.

  • You take application and AI security seriously. You understand OWASP-class vulnerabilities, and you're interested in the new risks that come with LLM agents, such as prompt injection and over-broad tool access.

  • You understand the product and the business. You know why a finding matters to our customers and our commercial position. You can tell a theoretical finding from one that puts customer data at risk, you spend effort where the risk is real, and you don't disappear down technical rabbit holes.

  • You help teams ship safely. You find the secure way to do what the team needs, and you block work only when the risk justifies it. When you do, you explain why clearly enough that engineers understand and agree.

  • You work independently. As our first in-house product security engineer, you'll set your own priorities, build the programme, and know when to bring in outside help.

  • You bring people with you. You can explain a security risk to an engineer, a lawyer and a board member, adjusting the detail for each, and you change how teams work through influence rather than authority.

You'll most likely come from a security engineering, product security or application security role at a fast-growing startup, or from a security consultancy with hands-on delivery. We're open to different backgrounds if you can show the depth, judgement and automation-first approach this role needs.

It would also be nice if you have

  • Experience securing LLM or agentic AI applications, or research into prompt injection and AI-specific threats.

  • Harness engineering experience: building the tooling, evaluation loops and guardrails that let AI agents do real engineering work.

  • Hands-on experience with SOC 2 and ISO 27001 audits.

  • Experience with Azure, Kubernetes or container security, or sandboxed code execution.

  • Familiarity with identity and SSO providers such as WorkOS or Okta.

  • Experience in legal, financial or other regulated industries.

🔒 Security is everyone’s responsibility at Orbital. We ask all team members to follow our security policies, complete regular awareness training, and handle sensitive data with care in line with ISO 27001 standards. Spot something unusual? Reporting risks or incidents quickly helps us maintain the strong culture of security and compliance we all depend on.

💡 At Orbital, we’re committed to building a diverse and inclusive team. We especially welcome applications from people who are traditionally underrepresented in tech. Even if you don’t meet every single requirement, or if the right role isn’t listed yet, we’d still love to hear from you.

454c6341105ed296.title: Sales Development Representative
454c6341105ed296.description:
Job Description:

About Us

Nylon is rebuilding how professional advice gets made. Not built for accountants and lawyers — built with them.

We work alongside firms that cannot afford to be wrong. They expect precision, speed and an answer they can put their name to, and we hold ourselves to the same bar. Our platform turns tax and accounting research that used to take hours into minutes, and powers the end-to-end workflow around it.

We are firmly established in the UK, working with tax and accounting firms across the country, with clients across professional services in Australia and New Zealand and partnerships with the professional bodies our prospects already belong to. We are now opening the United States.

Joining Nylon means three things.

  • We move first: high agency over waiting for permission, outcomes over intentions.

  • We hold the bar: direct, ego-free feedback and standards that do not slip when it is busy.

  • We learn out loud: what you work out on the phone today, the whole team uses tomorrow.

Small team. Real ownership. No passengers.

If you are driven by pace, mastery, and being early to something that is about to get very big — this is the place.

What You'll Do

  • Own the phone. Cold call decision-makers at professional services firms and book qualified meetings for our sales team.

  • Open a new market. Work a UK-led patch that now includes early-stage outreach into the US — all inside a normal Brighton working day.

  • Run a tight rhythm. Call blocks, follow-ups and clean pipeline hygiene, executed the same way every day.

  • Learn the product properly. Our products are new and genuinely complex; knowing how firms actually get value from them is the job, not a nice-to-have.

  • Sharpen the message. Learn our ICP and messaging fast, then make both better through iteration and feedback.

  • Research like an analyst. Use trusted sources to understand prospects, personalise outreach and lift conversion.

  • Feed the machine. Share what you hear on calls so we can tighten targeting and positioning.

What You Bring

  • Extreme motivation to master selling. You want to be the best in the world at this, and you are prepared for what that takes.

  • High agency. You find the way through rather than waiting to be told.

  • A strong verbal game. Clear, concise, human — and comfortable being the first voice a partner hears that week.

  • Resilience. No does not slow you down.

  • Pace. We move fast, so you learn and adapt fast.

  • Coachability. You take direct feedback and apply it the same day.

Your academic background is not essential. What you can demonstrate is.

What's In It For You

  • Warm ground to work from. An established UK client base and professional body partnerships that put our name in front of your prospects before you call them.

  • A market to open, not just a patch to work. You will help build something from nothing rather than maintaining what is already there.

  • Front-row seat to the AI shift in professional services. You will be selling the change, not reading about it.

  • World-class training. Structured onboarding and ongoing coaching on our own AI systems and modern B2B SaaS sales methods.

  • Commission earned on qualified meetings attended.

  • Peer recognition scheme and corporate discounts.

  • An in-person environment. A Brighton office built for people who want to be in the room.

Nylon is an equal opportunity employer

Great teams are built on a range of thought and experience. We welcome people of all backgrounds and do not discriminate on the basis of age, disability, gender reassignment, marriage or civil partnership, pregnancy or maternity, race, religion or belief, sex, or sexual orientation.

Work Location: Brighton, occasionally London

c0ec3fbee75c970e.title: Marketing Lead
c0ec3fbee75c970e.description:
Own marketing at an AI legal research company that already has 1,900+ firms as customers.

Nylon is an AI-native tax and legal research platform used by 1,900+ accountancy and law firms across the UK, Australia and New Zealand. We were the first product accredited by ICAEW in the Legal Information and Research Software category, and we hold an ACCA affiliation. The UK business has been built almost entirely on outbound sales. It works, and it has taken us a long way. Now we want a second engine, and you would be the person who builds it.

This is our first dedicated marketing hire in the UK. There is no team beneath you yet and no playbook to inherit. There is a working sales motion, a product accountants and lawyers actually use, strong accreditation credentials, and a founder-led company that moves quickly. You will set the marketing strategy and then do most of the work yourself.

What you'll own

  • Pipeline. SEO and content, paid search and LinkedIn, email nurture, webinars and free-trial campaigns. Your number is qualified pipeline handed to our SDR and AE team, and you will be measured on it.

  • Brand and content. Sharpen how Nylon shows up in the UK accountancy and legal market: website, thought leadership, case studies, PR and awards, and the marketing side of our ICAEW and ACCA relationships.

  • Product marketing. Own the messaging. Turn what the product does into language that lands with a tax partner or a managing partner, keep our positioning against incumbent research providers sharp, and equip the sales team with battlecards, decks and one-pagers.

  • Events and community. Get us in front of the right people: ICAEW and ACCA events, industry conferences, our own roundtables and customer community. Some travel within the UK.

  • Measurement. Set up attribution and reporting in our CRM (Attio) so we know what is working, and kill what is not.

What we're looking for

  • 5–8 years in B2B marketing, with at least a few of those in SaaS or a subscription product, ideally selling to professional services (accountancy, legal, financial services).

  • You have built something from little or nothing before: a demand-gen function, a content programme, a launch. You are comfortable being the strategist and the person executing at 4pm on a Thursday.

  • Fluent in the tools: SEO and analytics, paid search and paid social, marketing automation and CRM, and the AI tools that make a small team punch above its weight.

  • You write well. Clearly, quickly, without fluff. Most of what marketing produces is words, and ours need to be credible to accountants and lawyers.

  • Commercially minded. You care about pipeline and revenue, not vanity metrics, and you enjoy working shoulder to shoulder with a sales team.

  • Curious about AI and about how professional services firms are changing. You do not need a legal or tax background, but you need to be able to learn the market fast.

Nice to have: experience marketing to accountants or lawyers; familiarity with ICAEW, ACCA or Law Society ecosystems; hands-on experience with webinar programmes or partnership marketing.

What we offer

  • £55,000–£70,000 base, depending on experience

  • Real ownership: you set the strategy, you get the budget, you build the team as we grow

  • A product customers rely on daily and a market that is being reshaped by AI right now

  • A small, fast, international team across the UK, Australia and New Zealand

Please send a CV and, instead of a cover letter, one page on how you would generate qualified pipeline for Nylon in your first 90 days.

Nylon is the trading name of Law Cyborg Limited. We are an equal opportunity employer and welcome applications from everyone. You must have the right to work in the UK.

c245214b84187b42.description:
Who We Are

Having surpassed $300M ARR and continuing to grow, Optro helps enterprises transform risk into opportunity through its AI-powered GRC Intelligence Platform. More than 50% of the Fortune 500, including 7 of the Fortune 10, leverage our award-winning technology to move their businesses forward with greater clarity and agility. And our customers love us: Optro is top-rated on G2.com and Gartner Peer Insights.

At Optro, we inspire each other to innovate and are proud of what we are producing. We spend each day thinking of new ways to help our customers and contribute to the greater good of our company and our surrounding communities. We are all about assisting each other and breaking through barriers to create the most loved audit, risk, ESG, and InfoSec platform by our customers. This is how we have become one of the 500 fastest-growing tech companies in North America for the seventh year in a row, as ranked by Deloitte!

Why This Role is Exciting

We are looking for an intelligent, coachable, hard-working, and driven professional to lead a team of Account Executives to sell Optro products into our Commercial segment. The Area Director, Sales will lead, coach and develop a team of 5-7 sales professionals to proactively generate new opportunities into target accounts, close business to achieve quarterly and annual revenue goals, and will report to the Vice President of EMEA.

Location: London, UK (Hybrid role ~2-3 days/week in the office in central London)


Key Responsibilities

  • Drive customer acquisition, landing net new logos through high-velocity sales motion

  • Recruit and enable top talent at scale, targeting exceptional salespeople who possess high intelligence, robust EQ, character and general coachability

  • Lead AEs in achieving individual, team, and organizational quotas. Build existing accounts to six and seven-figure ARR sizes, spearheading Cross-Sell and Up-Sell campaigns across the team

  • Provide strategic executive leadership for sales forecasting, territory assignments, sales mentorship, and commission planning

  • Ensure the sales team is working cohesively with Operations, Sales Engineering, and other internal/external teams and stakeholders

  • Build out a predictable business focused on the end-to-end value-led sales process

  • Lead pricing and contract negotiations with Executive Buyers, typically CFOs

  • Listen and comprehend customer pain points, goals and objectives to tailor Optro’s products and services

  • Present a compelling solution of the Optro's suite of products to clients using the information found in the discovery phase

  • Engage with C-level prospects to position Optro's strategic value proposition and drive the deal to closure

  • Leverage a values-based sales process to work with multiple client personas to close new business

  • Use a MEDDICC-based sales qualification methodology to manage sales resources and report sales forecasts

  • Stay ahead of industry trends, competitive activity, and client opportunities

  • Attend trade shows, industry events, client meetings, and conferences

  • Engage and build relationships with Optro Partners and Alliances to help drive new pipeline growth and close new business

  • Willingness to embrace the core company values of Customer Obsession, Constant Innovation, Personal Improvement, Gritty Resilience and Win-Together

Attributes for a Successful Candidate

  • 7+ years of related experience including 3+ direct full sales cycle experience selling enterprise B2B software, preferably SaaS GRC, finance, ERP, CRM, procurement, or adjacent sectors with 2+ years of people management experience

  • Experience leading sales in an early-stage, high-growth enterprise B2B SaaS environment

  • Proven line-of-business selling experience and ability to engage at a C-Suite level within enterprise accounts

  • Ability to build and lead a sales organisation, including quota-carrying and multi-product forecasting experience

  • Excellent cross-organization collaboration and partnership skills. A natural desire to build mutually beneficial working relationships at all levels

  • Experience devising sales strategy and contributing to enablement programs

  • A clear understanding of value-based selling with multiple examples of success

  • Strong EQ skills, able to build strong relationships internally and externally while inspiring and driving a team to deliver exceptional results.

Perks (United Kingdom)

  • Launch a career at one of the fastest-growing SaaS companies in North America and EMEA!

  • Live your best life (LYBL)! $200/mo (USD) for anything that enhances your life

  • Comprehensive employee health coverage

  • Pension scheme with company contributions

  • Competitive compensation & bonus program

  • Generous annual leave of 25 days plus bank holidays

  • Time off for your birthday & volunteering

  • Employee resource groups

  • Opportunities for team and company-wide get-togethers!

*perks may vary based on eligibility/location

Our Company Values

  • Customer obsession: It starts and ends here. Consistently ask yourself how what you’re doing creates value for our customers. It’s a mindset.

  • Gritty resilience: Make it happen. Find a way. Move fast, stay positive, and do what it takes.

  • Drive innovation: Create the future. Continuously improve what exists and invent what’s next.

  • Win, together: One team. No silos, no egos. Drive to be the best and support each other’s success.

  • Growth mindset: 10x, not 10%. Think in orders of magnitude, not increments. Seek feedback, learn, and improve.

We love building strong partnerships, but please note that Optro cannot accept unsolicited resumes from agencies. Any submissions without a signed agreement in place will not create a fee obligation.

Privacy Notice for Candidates
When you apply for a role at Optro, we collect and process personal data including your contact details, resume, work history, and application responses to evaluate your candidacy. For full details on how we collect, use, and protect your data — including your rights under GDPR, UK GDPR, and US state privacy laws and other applicable data protection laws — please review our Candidate Privacy Notice.

  • Use of AI in Recruitment: Optro may use artificial intelligence and machine learning technologies to assist in the screening and evaluation of applications, including resume parsing and candidate matching. These tools do not make final hiring decisions — all assessments are reviewed by our human recruitment team. You may opt out of AI-assisted screening at any time without impact to your candidacy by contacting Interview Recording: Optro may use recording and transcription technology during interviews. You will be notified before any recording begins and may opt out at any time without affecting your candidacy.

  • Background Checks: Background checks are required for this role. Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered in accordance with the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act. This role may have access to highly sensitive data, including employee data, customer data, company financials, and proprietary product information.

Optro does not sell candidate personal data.

Questions? Contact Optro's Privacy Team at

59f55e97c04d5dca.description:
Who We Are:
At Omaze, we give our community in the UK and Germany the chance to win luxury homes and other life-changing prizes — all while raising money for the causes they love.

Thanks to our Omaze Community, we’ve raised over £150 million for UK charities in just five years. That’s millions helping organisations like Age UK, the RSPCA, British Heart Foundation and Great Ormond Street Hospital Charity deliver life-saving work.

And the best part? We’re only just getting started. Omaze is building a business and culture committed to growth and creating significant social impact on a global scale.

🔑 About The Job

We’re looking for an experienced, hands-on accounting and finance leader to provide maternity cover of 14 months during a period of continued business development and finance transformation.

This is a broad role combining financial reporting, month-end delivery, cash and debt-facility reporting, corporate governance support and finance-systems ownership. You’ll work closely with the CFO, Finance and Accounting colleagues, business leaders and external advisers to maintain reliable reporting, effective controls and continuity across key workstreams.

You’ll be equally comfortable reviewing accounting entries, explaining budget variances, coordinating an audit and resolving a NetSuite reporting or access issue. Success will mean keeping essential processes running smoothly while progressing agreed improvements and making risks, decisions and dependencies visible.


🥇 What success looks like

  • Month-end close, consolidated reporting and board-reporting inputs are delivered accurately and on time.

  • Lender reporting and compliance requirements are met, with clear oversight of deadlines and dependencies.

  • Budget holders receive useful analysis and timely support.

  • Audit and adviser workstreams progress with clear ownership and well-organised evidence.

  • Finance systems remain reliable, and agreed implementation and reporting improvements continue.

  • Responsibilities, decisions and outstanding matters are documented to support a smooth handover back.

🔧 What You’ll Be Doing

Audit, governance, tax and technical accounting

  • Coordinate audit delivery, acting as a central contact for auditors and internal stakeholders and tracking evidence requests, issues and deadlines.

  • Draft consolidated and entity level financial statements along with relevant footnote disclosures under IFRS and US GAAP.

  • Initiate implementation of IFRA 18 and ASU 2024-03.

  • Support corporate governance processes and associated financial documentation and reporting.

  • Support the CFO with Senior Accounting Officer (SAO) and Corporate Criminal Offence (CCO) workstreams, including documentation, information gathering and follow-through on agreed actions.

  • Coordinate accounting advisory workstreams, ensuring clear briefs, ownership, timely responses and resolution of outstanding matters.

  • Ad hoc technical accounting assessments, documenting agreed conclusions and supporting implementation.

Financial accounting, close and consolidated reporting

  • Deliver assigned month-end close activities, including intercompany eliminations, and coordinate with entity accounting teams.

  • Prepare and coordinate consolidated monthly financial reporting under US GAAP and IFRS, ensuring completeness, consistency and clear explanations of significant movements.

  • Review assigned journals, reconciliations and intercompany activity, resolving issues with the relevant preparers and reviewers.

  • Maintain close timetables, support the resolution of blockers and ensure appropriate documentation and review evidence.

  • Support the preparation and validation of financial actuals and analysis for board reporting.

Equity administration and insurance

  • Administer Carta, including reporting, supporting bookkeeping, maintaining records and coordinating approved changes with relevant stakeholders.

  • Coordinate corporate, office and other insurance matters, working with brokers, Legal and business owners on renewals, coverage questions, policy changes and emerging requirements.

  • Maintain clear records of outstanding actions, approvals and responsibilities across both workstreams.

Finance systems and reporting

  • Act as the day-to-day Netsuite administrator, covering month-end requirements, ongoing maintenance, user access, configuration and issue resolution.

  • Facilitate work with external Netsuite support partners, prioritising requests and coordinating delivery, testing and implementation.

  • Develop and maintain Netsuite reporting for Finance, including reports and saved searches that improve visibility and reduce manual work.

  • Administer and maintain Netsuite Account Reconciliation system, including period roll-forwards, assignments and troubleshooting.

Cash, treasury and loan facility reporting

  • Coordinate monthly, quarterly, and annual reporting, certificates, utilisation requests and other required submissions, including event-triggered reporting.

  • Maintain a clear compliance calendar and work with the CFO, Legal and Accounting teams to ensure timely, accurate reporting and escalation.

🤩 About You

Essential experience and skills

  • A recognised accounting qualification ACA, ACCA, CPA or equivalent.

  • Experience drafting consolidated and entity-level financial statements under both IFRS and US GAAP.

  • Strong experience across financial accounting, consolidated reporting and month-end close in a multi-national environment.

  • Strong hands-on NetSuite experience, including administration, reporting and working with external support partners.

  • Experience coordinating external audits and managing relationships with professional advisers.

  • Confidence managing cash reporting, debt-facility reporting and compliance deadlines.

  • Sound technical accounting judgement, with the ability to identify when specialist advice or escalation is needed.

  • Strong organisational skills and the ability to prioritise competing operational and project demands and supporting Accounting and Finance team members.

  • Clear communication and the confidence to challenge constructively, explain complex issues and drive actions to completion.

Desirable experience

  • UK and US accounting and reporting requirements, including US GAAP and IFRS.

  • NSAR and NSPB administration or implementation.

  • Carta and equity-related accounting or administration.

  • Senior Accounting Officer support (familiarity with Criminal Finance Act), insurance coordination or corporate governance support.

  • Subscription, e-commerce or other high-volume transaction businesses.

🙌 What’s In It For You

  • 25 days annual leave PLUS Bank Holidays

  • Private medical and dental insurance

  • 9% employer pension contributions, when you contribute at least 2%

  • A generous personal learning and development budget each year to use on training courses, conferences and professional memberships

  • Enhanced family leave policies

  • Life assurance of 4x your salary

DEI Statement

We actively seek out diversity of thought and experience to drive innovation. We welcome all backgrounds, identities, and perspectives and work hard to ensure that every Omaze employee can bring their authentic self to work at all times.

f8c4b27d0cf20836.title: Senior Data Scientist
f8c4b27d0cf20836.description:
In 2018, Bitvavo launched the first version of its digital assets trading platform, to bridge the gap between traditional currencies and digital assets. By offering transparent fees, a wide range of assets and an easy to use platform, Bitvavo is making the currency of the future accessible for everyone.

In eight years time, Bitvavo has established itself as the market leader in the Netherlands and one of the largest in Europe, with over two million users exchanging tens of billions of digital assets a year.

About the Opportunity

We are an exchange. The speed of good decisions matter in everything that we do. Our data domain is committed to making sure the decisions this business makes on spend, pricing, product, risk and financial crime rest on evidence rather than intuition. We're seeking exceptional talent to join us in making this a reality.

The Problems You'll Get to Solve

  • Growth & causal inference. Measure true incrementality, own our marketing mix model, and turn that into spend allocation under a budget.

  • Product & personalization. Rank and surface what is relevant to each customer's behaviour and holdings, from asset discovery to order form defaults, without drowning users in noise

  • Markets, pricing & execution. Model fee and spread elasticity to find the revenue-versus-volume trade-off, and improve execution quality: slippage, order routing, liquidity provider selection.

  • Risk & financial integrity. Model risk exposure across a volatile asset book, forecast liquidation risk, and detect reconciliation breaks across internal ledgers, on-chain data and partner reporting.

  • Financial crime & compliance. Detect account takeover, payment fraud and mule networks in real time, combining business rules and models that work together while staying explainable and auditable.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Own problems end to end: frame the question with the stakeholder, build the model or experiment, ship it, and follow it into production.

  • Work backwards from the decision. Start from what someone needs to decide and what it costs to get it wrong, not from the data that happens to be available.

  • Stay accountable for your models once they are live: monitoring, drift, retraining, and the day they start behaving differently.

  • Tell senior stakeholders things they do not want to hear, including that a campaign, a feature or a rule did not work.

  • Support your teammates in growing every day by setting the standard for how we do causal inference, reviewing their work, and sharing knowledge.

What We Look For

  • Strong applied experience turning a messy business question into a model or a measurement: causal inference where that fits, predictive and ranking models where it does not. You know when a result is not real.

  • Fluency in Python and SQL, and comfort working independently rather than waiting for data to be handed to you. We use Snowflake, dbt, Airflow and Looker, on top of technologies like MySQL, Druid, Kafka and Flink.

  • A track record of models that made it into production and changed a decision, not just notebooks and slide decks.

  • Sound statistical judgement, and the honesty to quantify and communicate uncertainty rather than hide it.

  • Exceptional communication skills. We expect you to talk to various stakeholders to derive requirements, drive discussions, and facilitate decision-making processes effectively.

  • Extraordinary sense of ownership. We are committed to empowering people with freedom and accountability.

Nice to have:

  • Experience building with agentic tooling such as MCP or agent frameworks, or automation platforms like n8n.

At Bitvavo, we believe that diverse perspectives drive innovation, foster creativity, and lead to better outcomes. We are committed to building a team that reflects the diversity of the communities we serve and creating an inclusive environment where everyone can thrive. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds, identities, and experiences. Regardless of race, ethnicity, gender, sexual orientation, age, religion, ability, or any other characteristic. Join us and be part of a team that values and celebrates your unique contributions.

Bitvavo does not accept resumes from staffing, search, or recruitment firms without a signed agreement. If you send us a resume without such an agreement, we may contact the candidate directly without any obligation whatsoever and no fee of any kind will be paid should we hire the candidate.

What We Offer

At Bitvavo, we believe in attracting, motivating and retaining talented people through market-competitive offerings that go beyond compensation alone. To learn more about our total rewards package and the benefits we offer, visit our Life at Bitvavo page.

cae4bcbf960137dd.title: Graduate Sales Development Representative (Life Sciences)
cae4bcbf960137dd.description:
Graduate Sales Development Representative (Life Sciences)

 

➡️ Have a degree in Life Sciences and looking for an alternative to the lab where you can still use your scientific knowledge every day?

➡️ Excited by the opportunity to work with leading pharmaceutical, biotech and medical device companies, helping them accelerate innovation through AI?

➡️ Want to build a rewarding career in tech sales with exceptional training, uncapped commission and a clear path to becoming an Account Executive?

If this sounds like you, we'd love to hear from you.

Role Summary:

We're looking for ambitious graduates and early-career professionals with a background in Life Sciences to join PatSnap as a Sales Development Representative (SDR).

This is your chance to take your scientific knowledge beyond the lab and apply it in a commercial role, working with some of the world's most innovative pharmaceutical, biotech and medical device organisations.

You'll become a trusted first point of contact for R&D and innovation leaders, introducing PatSnap's AI-powered platform and helping organisations accelerate research, reduce development risk and bring life-changing innovations to market faster.

We're not looking for experienced salespeople, we're looking for curious, ambitious graduates who are eager to learn. We'll provide structured training, ongoing coaching and mentorship to help you develop into a high-performing SaaS sales professional.

This is a fast-paced, target-driven role where your success will be determined by your resilience, curiosity and willingness to learn. If you're motivated by personal growth, enjoy speaking with people and want to build a career with exceptional earning potential, this could be the perfect opportunity.

This is a hybrid role based in our London office, with the flexibility to work either hybrid (Monday, Tuesday and Thursday in the office) or fully office-based if you prefer.

 

Who are we?

PatSnap is a global, Series E, unicorn SaaS platform that transforms the way organizations harness their Intellectual Property and Research & Development productivity. Our user-friendly platform revolutionizes how IP and R&D teams collaborate across the entire innovation lifecycle — using industry-leading, domain-specific AI to generate and validate ideas and bring innovative products to market faster, better, and cheaper. More than 12,000 R&D and IP teams worldwide use and trust PatSnap to innovate and commercialize new products.

 

As the leading global Life Sciences intelligence platform, PatSnap helps pharmaceutical, biotech, medical device, and life sciences organisations make better innovation decisions. By connecting patents, scientific literature, clinical trials, regulatory data, and market intelligence, we enable our customers to identify white spaces, reduce R&D risk, and accelerate breakthrough innovation.

 

We have a vibrant and diverse team with offices in Toronto, London, Shanghai, and Singapore. Our hyper-growth trajectory is powered by our people, and we are extremely proud of our company-wide vision, work ethic, and entrepreneurial spirit. We are committed to fostering an inclusive environment where talent thrives and ideas bloom.

What You'll Be Doing:

As an SDR, you'll be on the front line of PatSnap's growth, helping us connect with the world's leading pharmaceutical, biotech and medical device organisations. This is a true business development role where you'll learn how to identify opportunities, build relationships and create commercial value. Sales isn't about having all the answers, it's about asking great questions. Your scientific curiosity will help you understand customer challenges, while we'll teach you the commercial skills to build a successful career in SaaS sales.

You will:

  • Develop a hunter mindset, proactively identifying and engaging new prospects through phone, email and LinkedIn.

  • Use your scientific background to build credibility with senior R&D, innovation and scientific leaders.

  • Create and qualify new sales opportunities, turning cold prospects into valuable commercial conversations.

  • Build resilience by handling rejection positively and consistently achieving ambitious activity and pipeline targets.

  • Work closely with experienced Account Executives, helping convert qualified opportunities into revenue while learning every stage of the sales process.

  • Develop the commercial skills needed to progress into a closing role, including influencing, negotiation and relationship building.


What We'd Love From You

You don't need previous sales experience – we're looking for people with the attitude, curiosity and ambition to build a successful career in SaaS sales.

We're looking for someone who:

  • Has a degree (or equivalent experience) in Life Sciences or a related scientific discipline.

  • Is excited by the idea of applying your scientific knowledge in a commercial, customer-facing role.

  • Ambitious and motivated by success, with the drive to excel in an uncapped commission environment.

  • Confident and proactive, comfortable starting conversations and building relationships with new people.

  • Resilient and determined, with the mindset to overcome challenges and thrive in a target-driven environment.

  • Naturally competitive, with a strong desire to achieve goals and progress quickly in your career.

  • An excellent communicator, able to explain complex scientific concepts in a simple, engaging way.

  • Curious, coachable and eager to learn, always looking for ways to improve.

  • Organised and self-motivated, with the ability to manage your time and priorities effectively.

  • Passionate about technology, AI and innovation, and excited by the impact they have on R&D and scientific discovery.

  • A natural problem solver who enjoys understanding customers' challenges and helping them find solutions.

  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced, collaborative environment where no two days are the same.

Benefits & Perks:

A genuinely strong sales culture we’re really proud of. High-performing but low ego, social, and dynamic. It’s a team that supports each other, shares best practice, raises standards, and celebrates wins properly together. Alongside a great product, it’s one of the best parts of working here.

Additional benefits

  • 25 days annual leave plus bank holidays

  • Two paid volunteering days

  • Private healthcare with AXA

  • Pension with Scottish Widows

  • Enhanced parental leave policies

  • Work from home stipend

  • Cycle to Work scheme

  • Life assurance

  • Payroll giving options

  • Eyecare vouchers

Base Salary: £28,330

Commission: £18,887

On-Target Earnings Total (OTE): £47,217 (60/40 split)

High achievers regularly exceed target, with earnings of £60k+

2c752afeef2436c1.title: Freelance Influencer Marketing Manager
2c752afeef2436c1.description:
We are looking for a French-speaking Freelance Influencer Marketing Manager to support our Relationships team in Paris for remainder of 2026!

The 1000heads Relationships team is a proud, powerful collective of influencer and advocate specialists. You will work closely with a whole host of departmental specialists, from Accounts, Insights, to Strategy to deliver transformational social-first work for our clients.

You will work across the business and help manage influencer relationships for a variety of brands and will help the agency to deliver world-class influencer and advocate work. This includes: strategy, influencer identification, outreach, relationship management, activations, and insights.

 

Responsibilities

  • Manage the day-to-day operations of the Influencer activations. This includes: influencer management and outreach, meetings/status updates, timing plans, talent identification and negotiation, contracting and invoicing for payment.
  • Keeping clients informed of campaign/project progress
  • Using 1000heads’ research methodologies to identify influencers and creators for our clients to build relationships with.
  • Developing strong relationships with talents across different platforms and agencies.
  • Developing ideas and strategies for promoting campaigns, product launches and events on social presences in a social way
  • Assessment, analysis and interrogation of existing methods and processes
  • Reporting and presenting trending themes and strategies to clients
  • Creation of materials for presenting/pitching to clients
  • Providing suggestions to improve strategy based on reported insight
  • Being culturally attuned to clients’ brand and social trends to inform strategy and social content
  • KPI tracking and reporting
  • Influencer seeding fulfilment: assisting the the picking / packing of product, liaison with courriers, and logistics tracking / management

Requirements

  • A great passion, understanding and experience within the influencer industry
  • Experience of running projects from brief to delivery working with multiple people and deadlines.
  • Work well in a busy, fast-paced environment as part of a team
  • Ability to create eye-catching decks and documents
  • Understanding how to communicate with different audiences
  • Ability to work under pressure whilst keeping an eye for details
  • Can do attitude – act before someone suggests you to
  • Be solution driven
  • Drive templates and process innovation to increase efficiency
  • Excellent written and verbal communication– this includes but is not limited to clear communication when drafting brief, taking and sharing notes and liaising with clients and talent.
  • Outstanding attention to detail
  • Possesses full professional proficiency in both French and English.

 

About 1000heads

Company values:

Live in tomorrow

Our clients should expect the unexpected. We are steered by ideas and a burning desire to tread new ground. Aim to surprise someone every day J

 

Be bold be brave

Do things that have never been done. Take risks; don’t be afraid to make mistakes, but learn from them.

 

Do the right thing

We put trust in our people to take decisions so do what you think is the right thing. Be honest, be authentic, be transparent.

 

Be passionate

Care about what you do. Be obsessively proud of your work, whatever your role. You are making a difference.

1000heads is a social transformation company. We help global brands adapt to rapid and continual shifts in media, technology and culture. The company delivers social-first data, insights, strategic consultancy and creative services to clients around the world including Google, Intel, Diageo, Lenovo, Ancestry, Isuzu and UNIQLO. 1000heads has offices around the world in New York City, Los Angeles, London, Berlin, Dubai, Sydney and Melbourne. 

 

1000heads is an Equal Opportunities Employer, we are passionately committed to working together to promote an inclusive environment which celebrates and promotes diversity. We are committed to our belief that diversity in our team generates better and bolder ideas, creativity, understanding and respect. We welcome applicants irrespective of age, sex, race, ethnicity, disability and other factors that have no bearing on an individual’s ability to perform their job.

 

For more information on 1000heads, visit www.1000heads.com

 

This job description is not intended to cover everything that will be expected of you but rather to act as a guide and you maybe required to get involved in other and reasonable ad hoc projects.

457c12b9554d559f.title: Principal Software Engineer - XTM One
457c12b9554d559f.description:
🌀 The Company

Founded in 2022, Filigran is a global cybersecurity company on a mission to empower defense teams to be proactive through open-source solutions that uncover threats and drive action.

Filigran stands out in the cybersecurity ecosystem through its open-source, AI-powered and threat-informed approach to Continuous Threat Exposure Management (CTEM). Our eXtended Threat Management (XTM) platform brings together threat intelligence, exposure validation and cyber risk reduction, enabling organizations to better understand their threat landscape and take action.

At the heart of Filigran is our open-source approach. Our vision is to unite defenders into a global community to make security more open, resilient and collaborative.

As Filigran continues to scale globally, we are building the organization, infrastructure and capabilities needed for our next stage of growth. How we scale matters just as much as how fast we scale: our CORE values: Cohesion, Openness, Responsibility and Equity shape how we work together, make decisions and build for the future.

 

🎯 The Role

We're looking for a Principal Software Engineer to define and drive the technical direction of XTM One, Filigran's AI platform for threat informed defense and the agentic core of the XTM Suite.

XTM One creates and runs cybersecurity expert AI agents and dispatches their intelligence across OpenCTI, OpenAEV and OpenGRC. It also hosts the suite's shared commons (unified authentication, consolidated datasets, configuration) and ships both as SaaS and on premises. Every XTM product connects to it, which makes its architecture one of the most structuring technical decisions at Filigran.

This is not a management role: no headcount, no sprints. You own the technical craft, standards and vision of XTM One, and you carry them into the XTM Foundation, where the engineering principles shared by all products are set for the 60+ engineers at Filigran.

💼 Your Responsibilities

Vision & architecture

  • Define and carry the technical vision of XTM One over the long term, with technical and product leadership.

  • Own the platform architecture: agent runtime and orchestration, tool and MCP integrations, data and context layers, APIs, permission model, shared commons.

  • Design for SaaS and on premises from day one: multitenancy, isolation, upgrade paths, configuration, operability in customer environments.

  • Arbitrate key decisions on scalability, resilience, security, maintainability and cost, including LLM latency and inference cost.

Standards & quality

  • Define the team's technical principles (architecture patterns, code quality, tooling, CI/CD, testing, development with AI assistants) and get them applied through docs, reviews, pairing and example.

  • Set the bar for observability and reliability of nondeterministic AI workloads: metrics, logs, traces, evaluations, and guardrails that make agent behavior measurable and debuggable in production.

  • Keep the right balance between features, technical debt and innovation.

Integration across products & XTM Foundation

  • Define how OpenCTI, OpenAEV, OpenGRC and future products integrate with XTM One: contracts, authentication, data exchange, versioning.

  • Be a full member of the XTM Foundation: bring the XTM One perspective in, carry its decisions back, and keep coherence with the other Principal and Staff Engineers.

In the code

  • Write production code, prototype new approaches before the team adopts them, review critical PRs so that feedback teaches, and unblock engineers.

🤝 Who You'll Work With

  • Reports to: VP of Technology

  • Key collaborators: XTM One engineering team and its verticals; XTM Foundation (Principal and Staff Engineers across OpenCTI, OpenAEV, OpenGRC); Product leadership; open source contributors.

  • Working model: embedded in the XTM One team, with regular XTM Foundation work.

🧬 Profile We're Looking For

  • 10+ years in software engineering, with technical leadership on complex production platforms.

  • Strong fullstack background, with a backend and architecture focus. You master TypeScript and Python, the core languages of XTM One, and you can take a feature from the data model all the way to the UI.

  • Strong system design: distributed systems, scalability, performance, security, observability.

  • A 360° view of software engineering: product need, design, code and tests, CI/CD, packaging and release, infrastructure and deployment, production operations, monitoring, incident response. A container image or an upgrade path is as familiar to you as an API contract.

  • Built and operated platforms delivered both as SaaS and on premises, including multitenancy and enterprise constraints.

  • Strong AI affinity. You've been building with LLMs by choice for a year or two, with LLM systems in production: agent frameworks, tool calling, MCP, RAG and vector search, evaluation, and the discipline to make them reliable.

  • Technical watch is part of the job. You keep up with your craft deliberately (reading, experimenting, prototyping) and turn what you learn into concrete proposals.

  • You define and carry technical standards: you raise the bar on a team, you don't just follow it.

  • Excellent written communication in English: design docs, ADRs and review comments that others learn from.

  • Autonomous and at ease in a remote, asynchronous culture; you drive problems to resolution and enable others instead of becoming a bottleneck.

  • Bonus: cybersecurity domain knowledge (CTI, CTEM, MITRE ATT&CK, STIX/TAXII); extensible plugin or tool ecosystems; open source contributions or maintainership.

🛡️ About XTM One

XTM One is Filigran's AI platform for threat informed defense. It is dedicated to creating and running cybersecurity expert AI agents and dispatching their intelligence across the products of the XTM Suite.

Every product of the XTM Suite is connected to XTM One to leverage AI agents for a more proactive platform that is easier to use. Within XTM One, agents can use and correlate data across products to make the most meaningful assessments and take the most relevant actions. XTM One also hosts shared commons such as unified authentication and consolidated datasets and configuration.

🌱 Why Join Filigran? More than just a job.

We are a fast-growing, global and remote-first company, and we believe the best work combines purpose, impact and innovation. You’ll work alongside talented people across the world who care about what they build, how they build it, and the impact they make on the broader cybersecurity ecosystem.

⭐ Be part of something bigger

We believe we do work that matters. Our open-source approach means that work extends beyond Filigran. You’re contributing to technology and ideas that strengthen a global community of defenders and help make cybersecurity more open and collaborative.

💻 Work at the edge of what’s next

We bring together cybersecurity, open source and AI — giving you the opportunity to work with emerging technologies, experiment with new ways of working, and contribute to how they are applied in practice.

🌍 Global opportunity without borders

Be part of a fast-growing, truly international team — collaborating across Europe, North America, APJ and beyond, with the flexibility of a remote-first environment. As we grow, you’ll have opportunities to expand your scope, take ownership, learn quickly and grow with us.

🧭 A culture grounded in CORE

Cohesion, Openness, Responsibility and Equity define how we work together — with openness, ownership, collaboration and respect. These are the principles that guide how we make decisions, treat people and grow together, especially when no one’s watching.

💰 What you can expect

  • Competitive compensation + equity — everyone shares in our success

  • Remote-first flexibility — work from wherever you’re based, with flexibility built into how we operate

  • 25 days PTO baseline — real time to disconnect, recharge and enjoy life outside work

  • Volunteer days — paid time to contribute to causes that matter to you

  • Set up for success — choose the equipment that works for you, with additional support for your remote work and development needs as our programs evolve

  • Two annual in-person get-togethers — one global company get-together and one team get-together, creating dedicated time to connect, collaborate and strengthen our culture beyond the screen

🌍 Equal Employment Opportunity

We enable cybersecurity through inclusion — from code to culture.

f73e40ded7344885.title: Conversion Rate Optimisation Manager
f73e40ded7344885.description:
At Jellyfish, we believe in the power of diverse perspectives and inclusive collaboration. We welcome individuals who excel in collaborative, varied teams and value the unique contributions that each person brings to the table.

Jellyfish is a global digital marketing agency; a unique fusion of tech enthusiasts, creative minds, and media and data experts all united to empower our clients along their digital journey. Our commitment to embracing diverse perspectives fuels our innovation and strategies that challenge the status quo, reinvent media activation, and craft influential stories for our global clients and their customers. Join us in shaping a future where business growth and personal fulfilment go hand in hand.

Job Description

Reporting to the Experience Optimisation Director, you will play a key role in developing and implementing experience optimisation and conversion rate optimisation (CRO) strategies for a French multinational holding company specialising in luxury goods.

We take pride in delivering data-led experimentation, personalisation, and deep analytical insights for premier global brands, setting us apart in the industry. At Jellyfish, we are committed to fostering professional growth. Your career path could lead to progression into a CRO Senior Manager position with future potential to lead the practice.

This is a hybrid position, based out of our Paris office. The gross annual salary range for this position is between EUR 38,000-42,000, and the final offer is dependent on experience.

Responsibilities

  • Lead client meetings with a key luxury account to translate their business needs into strategic optimisation roadmaps aligned with their goals, driving measurable value and high client satisfaction.

  • Be the subject matter expert in conversion rate optimisation (CRO), experience optimisation, measurement, and marketing analytics across the client's brands.

  • Execute full-lifecycle user journey audits, research, continuous experimentation, and cross-channel activation campaigns to deliver actionable insights.

  • Define custom reporting and data-mapping requirements, collaborating cross-functionally to align technical solutions and timelines with strategic rationale.

  • Provide mentorship and escalation support for junior team members to foster professional growth and resolve operational challenges.

Qualifications

  • Fluency in French and professional-level English is required given the scope of work and the client teams.

  • Over 2 years of experience in end-to-end experience optimisation or CRO, including defining, launching, and evaluating A/B and Multivariate Testing (MVT) Campaigns using A/B testing platforms or website optimisation tools.

  • The ability to analyse user behaviour and map customer journeys from initial discovery to final measurement, ideally within the luxury, beauty or fashion industries.

  • Proficiency in web, app and product analytics combined with qualitative research tools (heatmapping, form analytics, live user testing) to uncover user behaviour insights.

  • Analytical and strategic mindset, with the ability to translate complex quantitative and qualitative data into actionable findings, recommendations, and optimisation roadmaps.

  • You love getting to know your clients, developing long-lasting relationships and adding value to their business.

  • When faced with a problem, you collaborate with the appropriate people to evaluate different options find practical solutions.

Note: We emphasise skills, expertise and behavioural attributes over years of experience and traditional degrees. If you want to join our collaborative team, we invite you to apply today with your resume in English.

Additional Information

Join Jellyfish and experience a workplace where we prioritise your growth, celebrate your contributions, and empower you to tailor your work environment to suit your needs.

💫 Custom Work Environment: Work remotely for up to 60% of your days and shape your day between 8am. and 6:30pm with flexible working hours.

👪 Family Support: Enjoy 14 weeks of paid leave for primary caregivers and 4 weeks of paid leave for secondary caregivers. We also provide £1000 (or equivalent) towards courses for returning primary caregivers to support your transition back into work.

Unfortunately, there has been an increase in fake recruiters impersonating Jellyfish and unlawfully using our brand name. If you are unsure if an email with a job offer you have received is genuinely from Jellyfish, or if you suspect any fraudulent activity, please report it to

  • • €38K – €42K

94efaa83547f8de3.title: Data Scientist H/F - Paris
94efaa83547f8de3.description:
AVISIA, qui sommes-nous ?

Vous souhaitez donner du sens aux données et développer des modèles prédictifs qui répondent à des enjeux métiers concrets ? Rejoignez AVISIA et participez à des projets Data Science à forte valeur ajoutée !

Créée en 2007, AVISIA est une société de conseil spécialisée en Data, Intelligence Artificielle et Digital. Avec plus de 320 collaborateurs répartis dans 5 agences en France, nous accompagnons nos clients dans la valorisation de leurs données et le développement de solutions innovantes, de la stratégie jusqu’à la mise en production.

Nos équipes interviennent sur l’ensemble de la chaîne de valeur de la donnée, avec une forte expertise en Data Science, Machine Learning, Data Engineering et Intelligence Artificielle. Chez AVISIA, nous associons excellence technique, proximité humaine et projets stimulants pour faire de la donnée un véritable levier de transformation.

Nous accompagnons des clients issus de secteurs variés, notamment le Luxe, le Retail, les Télécoms, la Banque, l’Assurance et l’Industrie. Cette diversité vous permettra de découvrir différents environnements métiers et de travailler sur des problématiques allant de l’analyse exploratoire des données à la conception, l’évaluation et l’industrialisation de modèles de Machine Learning.

Nos missions en Data Science

Chez AVISIA, nous vous proposons des missions qui allient expertise technique, Data Science et compréhension des enjeux business. Selon votre profil, vos compétences et vos affinités, vous pourrez intervenir sur des projets variés, de la conception de modèles prédictifs à leur déploiement en production, en passant par l’analyse des données et l’optimisation des performances.

L’objectif : concevoir des solutions concrètes, exploiter pleinement le potentiel des données et contribuer directement à la prise de décision de nos clients.

Quelques exemples de sujets de Data Scientist du moment :

  • Conception de modèles de prévision du chiffre d'affaires généré sur le site e-commerce d’un retailer. #Prévision

  • Création et industrialisation d’un moteur de recommandation destiné à optimiser la conversion des visiteurs du site web. #Recommandation

  • Création d’un score d’attrition afin d’identifier les clients d’un acteur de la grande distribution en perte de vitesse lente, #Churn

  • Mise en œuvre d’une segmentation client permettant d'optimiser les actions marketing & commerciales d'une enseigne (ciblage, rétention, en fonction des appétences de canaux de contact). #SegmentationClient


Les qualités humaines

Chez AVISIA, nous recherchons avant tout des talents curieux, impliqués et désireux de progresser. Vous vous reconnaissez dans les qualités suivantes ?

  • Vous avez un excellent relationnel et appréciez le travail en équipe comme les échanges avec les clients.

  • Vous aimez vous impliquer dans les projets et contribuer concrètement à la réussite des missions.

  • Vous disposez d’un bon esprit d’analyse et de synthèse, avec la capacité de prendre du recul sur les résultats obtenus.

  • Vous êtes attentif(ve) à la qualité de vos livrables et savez présenter et vulgariser des résultats complexes auprès d’interlocuteurs non techniques.

  • Vous êtes curieux(se), vous vous intéressez aux évolutions de la Data Science et du Machine Learning et aimez explorer de nouvelles approches.

Les compétences techniques :

Vous êtes diplômé(e) d’une formation data à l’université ou en grande école et :

  • Disposez d’une bonne connaissance des principales techniques de modélisation statistique ou de machine learning (Random Forest, XGBoost, K-means, …),

79af6e5edd33deb5.title: Stage: Développeur Logiciel (F/H)
79af6e5edd33deb5.description:
Nous recherchons un stagiaire développeur logciel (F/H) pour une durée de 6 mois à partir du 1er trimestre 2027 au sein de la division Land & Sea sur le site d’Angoulême.

Missions :

Nous développons un logiciel superviseur en C++/Qt permettant le contrôle à distance de différents équipements. Dans le cadre de l'amélioration de notre environnement de développement, nous souhaitons automatiser et accélérer la création de nouvelles fonctionnalités.

L'objectif du stage sera de concevoir et de développer un outil permettant de générer automatiquement du code à partir d'interfaces graphiques préalablement conçues avec Qt Designer.

Pour cela, le stagiaire sera amené à :

  • Comprendre l'architecture existante du logiciel superviseur et ses différents composants.

  • Analyser les besoins et définir une solution adaptée à l'architecture logicielle.

  • Étudier le format des fichiers d'interface Qt Designer (.ui) afin d'en extraire les informations nécessaires à la génération de code.

  • Concevoir et développer un outil capable de générer automatiquement :

    • Les classes associées à la partie graphique du logiciel superviseur.

    • Les classes d'interface assurant la communication entre la partie graphique et le cœur du logiciel.

    • Les classes d'implémentation de ces interfaces dans le cœur du logiciel.

  • Tester et valider la solution développée, puis évaluer son intégration dans l'environnement de développement existant.

Le stagiaire disposera également d'une certaine liberté dans ses propositions techniques et pourra explorer d'autres approches permettant d'atteindre cet objectif.

Profil:

  • Étudiant en dernière année d'école d'ingénieur ou de Master (Bac+5), à la recherche d'un stage de fin d'études.

  • Bonne maîtrise du langage C++ indispensable.

  • Des connaissances du framework Qt sont appréciées. Une première expérience ou des notions de base constituent un atout, le stage reposant principalement sur la manipulation de composants propres à Qt (fichiers Qt Designer, Q_PROPERTY, classes et mécanismes du framework).

9c842a951c803c0c.title: Stage: Évaluation et intégration d’algorithmes de détection et suivi d’objets par deep learning (F/H)
9c842a951c803c0c.description:
Nous recherchons un stagiaire pour évaluer et intégrer des algorithmes de détection et de suivi d’objets basés sur le deep learning (F/H) pour une durée de 6 mois à partir du 1er trimestre 2027 au sein de la division Land & Sea sur le site d’Angoulême.

Contexte :

Les algorithmes de détection et de suivi basés sur l’apprentissage profond évoluent vite, et leurs performances annoncées se transposent mal à de nouveaux capteurs ou de nouvelles conditions. Notre équipe développe des solutions de vision temps réel et dispose d’une bibliothèque modulaire de pipelines de traitement (C++).

Il manque une méthode fiable pour comparer les approches et choisir celles à intégrer.

Objectif :

Mettre en place une plateforme d’évaluation reproductible, puis intégrer les solutions les plus pertinentes dans la bibliothèque.

Missions :

  • Reprise de l’existant. Analyser le module actuel de détection et de suivi, diagnostiquer ses limites de généralisation sur d’autres capteurs et en rendre compte.

  • Données et protocole d’évaluation. Constituer des jeux de données infrarouges et visibles, avec découpage par séquence, tests inter-datasets et métriques normalisées (mAP, HOTA, IDF1, vitesse d’exécution).

  • Benchmark de l’état de l’art. Comparer des détecteurs et des trackers récents, avec entraînement ou fine-tuning, augmentation de données et résultats reproductibles.

  • Intégration. Intégrer les solutions retenues dans la bibliothèque C++ et réaliser des démonstrations.

  • Documentation. Rédiger un guide de décision par cas d’usage et la documentation technique.

Profil:

  • Étudiant en informatique spécialisé intelligence artificielle / vision par ordinateur / génie logiciel avec :

    • Python et PyTorch, et de bonnes bases en deep learning et en évaluation de modèles ;

    • C++ et de CMake ;

    • De la rigueur, de l’autonomie et un esprit critique argumenté.
