854a9c40127e85e8.title: LEAD ANALYST, GLOBAL OPERATIONS (ITAM SAM & CMDB Lead Administrator)
854a9c40127e85e8.description:
Responsibilities

1) ITSM, ITAM, SAM, CMDB & Discovery Platform Administration

  • Administer Freshservice, Device42, or equivalent ITSM, ITAM, SAM, CMDB, discovery, and asset data platforms.
  • Configure platforms from scratch or redesign existing configurations, including modules, asset types, software models, license types, CI classes, fields, forms, workflows, automation rules, notifications, dashboards, roles, permissions, and governance settings.
  • Set up and maintain discovery sources, scan ranges, schedules, credentials, collectors, agents, probes, API connections, synchronization jobs, software recognition rules, and reconciliation rules in accordance with security and change management requirements.
  • Configure request, approval, assignment, reclamation, retirement, and exception workflows for hardware assets, software assets, and CMDB updates.
  • Troubleshoot platform configuration, integration, discovery, synchronization, data import, software normalization, and data quality issues.
  • Maintain platform administration documentation, configuration standards, data dictionaries, CI class definitions, software model standards, license data standards, discovery runbooks, and operating procedures.

2) CMDB Architecture, Data Model & Governance

  • Design, configure, and maintain the CMDB structure, including CI classes, asset attributes, software and application records, lifecycle states, ownership fields, relationship types, business service mapping, and dependency structures.
  • Define and enforce CMDB standards for naming, classification, required fields, ownership, support groups, relationship mapping, lifecycle status, environment, criticality, and authoritative data sources.
  • Establish reconciliation processes between discovery tools, endpoint management systems, software inventory sources, procurement records, identity systems, ITSM records, ITAM repositories, and SAM records.
  • Identify and resolve duplicate, incomplete, stale, orphaned, incorrectly classified, or conflicting asset, software, and CI records.
  • Ensure CMDB data supports incident, request, change, problem, security, audit, vulnerability, software compliance, and service management processes.
  • Maintain CMDB governance documentation, data ownership rules, exception-handling processes, and quality metrics.

3) Discovery & Application Dependency Mapping

  • Configure and maintain discovery capabilities for endpoints, servers, network devices, virtual infrastructure, cloud resources, databases, application components, and discovered software installations.
  • Set up or support ADM and service dependency mapping by enabling discovery methods, validating discovered relationships, and coordinating with application and infrastructure owners.
  • Coordinate discovery prerequisites such as service accounts, credentials, network access, firewall allowlisting, agents, probes, collectors, and access approvals with Infrastructure and Security teams.
  • Monitor discovery coverage, credential failures, scan errors, synchronization status, relationship completeness, software recognition gaps, and unmapped or unknown assets.
  • Continuously tune discovery settings, mapping rules, software normalization logic, reconciliation logic, and dependency rules to improve CMDB accuracy, ADM coverage, and SAM visibility.

4) Hardware Asset Lifecycle & Inventory Management

  • Oversee hardware and infrastructure asset lifecycle data from request, receiving, deployment, assignment, transfer, return, decommissioning, disposal, and retirement.
  • Ensure lifecycle updates are accurately reflected in ITAM, ITSM, CMDB, discovery, endpoint inventory, and reporting platforms.
  • Reconcile purchased, deployed, discovered, retired, and disposed hardware assets across procurement records, endpoint tools, discovery platforms, and ITSM/ITAM systems.
  • Maintain accurate inventory data including owner or custodian, location, serial number, model, status, environment, support group, business purpose, warranty or support status, and related CIs or services.
  • Coordinate inventory audits, physical verification, exception handling, discrepancy investigations, disposal evidence, and asset record cleanup.

5) Software Asset Management (SAM) & License Governance

  • Establish, administer, and maintain software asset records, software models, publishers, versions, editions, categories, license records, entitlement data, subscription records, renewal dates, approved software status, and software lifecycle status within ITAM, SAM, CMDB, and ITSM platforms.
  • Reconcile discovered software installations, SaaS usage, endpoint inventory, purchase records, subscriptions, entitlements, and approved software records to support license accuracy and compliance visibility.
  • Track software assignments, usage, ownership, business justification, license position, approval status, renewal risk, retirement status, and compliance status.
  • Identify unused, underused, duplicate, unauthorized, unsupported, end-of-life, or potentially non-compliant software and coordinate remediation, reclamation, renewal, or retirement actions with the appropriate owners.
  • Support software request, approval, assignment, deployment, reclamation, renewal, retirement, and decommissioning workflows in coordination with IT Support, Security, Procurement, Finance, Legal, and Application Owners.
  • Maintain software-related CIs and relationships in the CMDB, including links between applications, software products, users, devices, servers, business services, application owners, support groups, and dependency records.
  • Prepare dashboards and reports for software compliance, license utilization, renewal risk, unauthorized software, software lifecycle status, SaaS/application inventory, reclamation opportunities, and cost optimization opportunities.
  • Support software audits, true-ups, renewals, vendor reviews, and internal compliance reviews by providing accurate asset, entitlement, deployment, and usage data. Contract negotiation and legal interpretation remain owned by Procurement, Finance, and Legal.

6) Integrations, Automation & Reporting

  • Configure and maintain integrations between ITSM, ITAM, SAM, CMDB, discovery platforms, endpoint management tools, procurement sources, identity systems, SaaS sources, and reporting tools.
  • Build workflows, automation rules, validation rules, notifications, exception reports, and data quality controls to reduce manual effort and improve reliability.
  • Create and maintain dashboards and reports for inventory health, lifecycle status, CMDB completeness, discovery coverage, ADM coverage, software compliance, license utilization, renewal exposure, aging assets, reconciliation exceptions, and audit readiness.
  • Analyze data quality metrics, discovery gaps, synchronization failures, software normalization issues, license gaps, and process issues to identify corrective actions and improvement opportunities.
  • Support automation, API, import/export, bulk update, and low-code workflow activities where appropriate and approved.

7) Stakeholder Coordination, Governance & Process Ownership

  • Serve as the primary administrator and subject matter expert for ITAM, SAM, CMDB, discovery, and related ITSM configurations.
  • Partner with Infrastructure, Security, Service Desk, Procurement, Finance, Legal, Compliance, vendors, and application teams to align asset, software, license, CI, and service data with operational, audit, compliance, and business requirements.
  • Document and improve processes for asset intake, software intake, CI creation, discovery onboarding, license record maintenance, ownership validation, dependency mapping, lifecycle updates, reclamation, and decommissioning.
  • Provide guidance and training to IT teams on asset, software, license, CMDB, discovery, and platform update requirements.
  • Support audit, compliance, risk, security, and governance activities related to hardware assets, software assets, software licensing, CMDB reliability, discovery coverage, and administrative access controls.

Qualifications

Required

  • 3-5+ years of experience in ITSM, ITAM, SAM, CMDB administration, IT operations, systems administration, infrastructure support, software asset management, or a related technical platform administration role.
  • Hands-on administration experience with ITSM, ITAM, SAM, CMDB, discovery, endpoint inventory, or asset data platforms such as Freshservice, Device42, SCCM/MECM, Intune, or equivalent tools.
  • Experience configuring asset models, software models, CI data models, fields, forms, workflows, automations, dashboards, relationships, discovery settings, synchronization rules, data imports, or system integrations.
  • Practical understanding of CMDB concepts, CI relationships, lifecycle states, service mapping, configuration management governance, and ITIL-aligned service management processes.
  • Experience with Software Asset Management processes such as software inventory, license tracking, entitlement management, software normalization, license reconciliation, usage reporting, reclamation, and compliance reporting.
  • Familiarity with common software licensing concepts such as named-user, device-based, subscription, SaaS, concurrent, enterprise agreement, server, core, processor, and usage-based licensing models.
  • Hands-on experience with discovery or inventory tools, including scan configuration, credential management, discovery troubleshooting, data normalization, software recognition, reconciliation, connector setup, or integration management.
  • Working knowledge of infrastructure environments such as Windows and Linux servers, endpoints, basic networking, virtualization, cloud resources, databases, application services, and endpoint management platforms.
  • Ability to analyze data quality issues, resolve discrepancies, and establish repeatable governance, reconciliation, exception-management, and audit-readiness processes.
  • Understanding of administrative access controls, change management, credential security, least-privilege access, and separation-of-duties expectations for ITSM, ITAM, SAM, CMDB, and discovery platforms.
  • Strong documentation, reporting, dashboarding, communication, and stakeholder-management skills.
  • Ability to work cross-functionally with technical teams, non-technical stakeholders, vendors, auditors, procurement, finance, legal, security, and compliance partners.

Preferred

  • Direct administrator experience with Freshservice and/or Device42, including ITAM, SAM or software inventory, CMDB, discovery, integrations, dashboards, or ADM/service dependency mapping.
  • Experience implementing, rebuilding, or significantly improving ITAM, SAM, CMDB, discovery, or ITSM modules from scratch.
  • Experience with Application Dependency Mapping, service mapping, business service modeling, or infrastructure dependency validation.
  • Experience with software compliance audits, license true-ups, renewal support, vendor audit preparation, SaaS inventory, software rationalization, or cost optimization initiatives.
  • Experience with SAM or license management tools such as ServiceNow SAM, Device42 software inventory, Lansweeper, or equivalent platforms.
  • Familiarity with enterprise software licensing and administration data for platforms such as Microsoft 365, Adobe, Autodesk, Oracle, VMware/Broadcom, Atlassian, Salesforce, Zoom, or similar vendors.
  • Expe

4a458a7737afafd4.title: Senior Fraud Strategist
4a458a7737afafd4.description:
Overview

The Senior Fraud Strategist is responsible for developing, testing, and optimizing fraud strategies, policies, rules, thresholds, treatment paths, and decision logic within assigned onboarding and monitoring workflows in RealPage’s payments ecosystem. This role will focus on development of policies and rules across new account onboarding, tenant payments, vendor payments, owner draws, funding instrument verifications, limit management, transaction monitoring, and payer anomalies. The successful candidate will take part in building RealPage’s next generation of fraud controls. This is a hands-on strategy role for someone who can independently identify the right data, write and troubleshoot SQL, connect fraud signals across systems, and translate analysis into practical decisions. They will test hypotheses, quantify fraud exposure and customer impact, evaluate strategy performance, and recommend policies, rules, thresholds, and controls that reduce fraud while protecting the customer experience and enabling business growth.

Responsibilities

Fraud Strategy, Policy & Controls

  • Responsible for the development, maintenance, and optimization of fraud risk policies, strategies, rules, thresholds, decision logic, treatment paths, and control documentation across onboarding and monitoring workflows.
  • Develop data-backed recommendations for auto-approval criteria, manual-review routing, payment holds, restrictions, limit treatments, step-up verification, account monitoring, and escalation thresholds.
  • Document strategy rationale, rule logic, data sources, expected impact, monitoring plans, policy considerations, change history, and recommended follow-up actions.
  • Design and optimize controls for payment fraud, onboarding risk, account takeover, business email compromise, counterparty fraud, tenant payment fraud, synthetic identity, first-party misuse, bust-out behavior, stolen payment instruments, refund or dispute abuse, and emerging typologies.
  • Monitor launched strategies and recommend tuning on an ongoing basis.

Analytics, Data Science & Rule Performance

  • Independently source, query, and analyze data using SQL to validate hypotheses, identify fraud patterns, assess false positives and false negatives, and evaluate loss exposure, operational impact, and customer friction.
  • Write and troubleshoot SQL queries using multi-table joins, aggregations, date windows, common table expressions, window functions, and segmentation logic to investigate fraud patterns and measure strategy performance.
  • Apply analytical and data science methods to support feature exploration, cohort analysis, segmentation, model output evaluation, threshold setting, experimentation, champion/challenger comparisons, back-testing, and post-launch performance monitoring.
  • Partner with Risk Data Science & Analytics to translate dashboards, models, features, risk scores, and analytical insights into practical fraud decision strategies and operational controls; assess and provide feedback on whether those outputs are effective for fraud strategy use cases, with guidance on complex cases.

Operational Feedback & Cross-Functional Execution

  • Partner with Onboarding Risk Operations and Risk Monitoring Operations to incorporate case outcomes, queue trends, investigator feedback, alert quality, and operational pain points into strategy improvements.
  • Review themes from Trust and Safety escalations to identify control gaps, recurring fraud signals, product or process vulnerabilities, or policy needs requiring durable remediation.
  • Collaborate with Product, Engineering, Payment Operations, Compliance/AML, Legal, and Operational Excellence on tooling, workflow, data availability, rule implementation, and control monitoring.
  • Provide concise updates on fraud trends, strategy performance, emerging risks, rule effectiveness, false positive impact, and recommended actions to fraud leadership and cross-functional stakeholders.
  • Share fraud findings and trends with fraud operations, monitoring, and escalation teams to inform how case learnings translate into policies, rules, thresholds, or monitoring improvements.

Qualifications

Required:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Data Science, Analytics, Statistics, Finance, Economics, Risk Management, Criminal Justice, Computer Science, or related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 5+ years of full-time experience in fraud strategy, fraud analytics, payments risk, data science, financial crime, risk operations strategy, or a related technical risk function.
  • Advanced, hands-on SQL experience is mandatory. Candidates must be able to independently write, troubleshoot, and explain SQL queries used to source data, validate hypotheses, identify fraud patterns, assess false positives, and evaluate rule or control performance; dashboard-only experience is not sufficient for this role.
  • Demonstrated experience developing or optimizing fraud rules, thresholds, decision logic, treatment paths, controls, or monitoring strategies based on independently sourced and analyzed data.
  • Exposure to data science, statistics, experimentation, model evaluation, Python/R, feature development, segmentation, or analytical methods used in fraud or risk decisioning.
  • Experience working with fraud operations, risk analytics, data science, product, engineering, compliance, or payment operations stakeholders.

KNOWLEDGE/SKILLS/ABILITIES

Required:

  • Advanced analytical curiosity and ability to connect fraud signals across disconnected tools, imperfect data, evolving processes, and multiple product or payment workflows.
  • Strong ability to translate independently sourced data findings into clear fraud strategy recommendations, rule changes, threshold adjustments, control improvements, monitoring plans, and policy considerations.
  • Strong working knowledge of fraud typologies such as synthetic identity, first-party misuse, counterparty fraud, business email compromise, onboarding fraud, stolen payment instruments, tenant payment fraud, account takeover, refund or dispute abuse, or bust-out behavior.
  • Ability to evaluate fraud strategies using metrics such as loss exposure, fraud capture, precision, false positives, customer friction, queue impact, and post-launch performance trends.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to summarize technical findings for fraud, product, operations, data science, and leadership audiences.
  • High ownership, sound judgment, attention to detail, and ability to balance fraud mitigation with customer experience, operational capacity, compliance considerations, and business growth.
  • Preferred experience with property management, rent payments, real estate technology, B2B payments, vendor payments, bill pay, embedded payments, merchant acquiring, fraud platforms, payment processor portals, device/identity signals, or decisioning platforms such as Oscilar.

Physical Demands and Working Conditions

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is occasionally required to stand; walk; sit; use hands to finger, handle or feel objects, tools or controls; reach with hands and arms; climb stairs; talk or hear. The employee must have the ability to operate a personal computer and express or exchange ideas by means of the spoken word. May be required to sit and/or stand for long periods of time. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and ability to adjust focus. May be required to lift or move 10+ pounds.

SALARY AND BENEFITS RealPage provides a competitive salary package along with a comprehensive benefit plan that includes:
  • Health, dental, and vision insurance.
  • Retirement savings plan with company match.
  • Paid time off and holidays.
  • Professional development opportunities.
  • Performance-based bonus based on position.
Compensation may vary depending on your location, qualifications including job-related education, training, experience, licensure, and certification, that could result at a level outside of these ranges. Certain roles are eligible for additional rewards, including annual bonus, and sales incentives depending on the terms of the applicable plan and role as well as individual performance. Equal Opportunity Employer: RealPage Company is an equal opportunity employer and committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

Pay Range

USD $94,700.00 - USD $161,300.00 /Yr.

b947d776f5d664ec.description:
Overview

Work arrangement: Remote

Work schedule: Mid/night shift

Reporting to Sr. Manager, Corporate Talent Acquisition

Job Summary

We are seeking an experienced Corporate Recruiter to join our in-house talent acquisition team in the Philippines. This strategic role requires a sophisticated recruitment professional who can execute both external talent acquisition and internal mobility initiatives while bringing a global perspective to our hiring practices. The ideal candidate will serve as a strategic partner to leadership, driving talent pipeline development that aligns with organizational growth objectives across multiple markets and business units.

Responsibilities

Strategic Talent Acquisition

  • Partner with senior leadership and hiring managers to develop comprehensive recruitment strategies for both external hiring and internal mobility programs, ensuring alignment with business objectives and workforce planning initiatives
  • Design and implement global sourcing strategies to attract top-tier talent across diverse markets, leveraging international recruitment channels and best practices
  • Build and maintain robust talent pipelines proactively, anticipating future hiring needs and market trends to minimize time-to-fill for critical positions
  • Drive employer branding initiatives with a global perspective, positioning the organization as an employer of choice in competitive talent markets

Full-Cycle Recruitment Management

  • Manage end-to-end recruitment processes for multiple departments and sites simultaneously, from workforce planning through onboarding
  • Conduct sophisticated candidate assessments including competency-based interviews, behavioral assessments, and cultural fit evaluations
  • Oversee internal talent mobility programs, partnering with HR Business Partners to identify high-potential employees for advancement opportunities
  • Coordinate recruitment activities across different time zones and cultural contexts for global hiring initiatives

Stakeholder Management & Consultation

  • Serve as a trusted advisor to hiring managers and executives on talent acquisition strategy, market intelligence, and recruitment best practices
  • Provide data-driven insights and recommendations to inform hiring decisions and optimize recruitment effectiveness
  • Facilitate calibration sessions with stakeholders to ensure consistent evaluation standards and decision-making

Systems, Analytics & Compliance

  • Administer and optimize the Applicant Tracking System (ATS), ensuring data integrity, compliance, and workflow efficiency
  • Generate and analyze recruitment metrics and KPIs to measure effectiveness, identify improvement opportunities, and inform strategic decisions
  • Ensure compliance with local labor laws, company policies, and global recruitment standards across all hiring activities

Talent Market Intelligence

  • Monitor and analyze talent market trends, competitive intelligence, and industry benchmarks to inform recruitment strategies
  • Represent the organization at industry events, career fairs, and professional networks to enhance brand visibility and candidate engagement
  • Cultivate relationships with external partners, universities, and professional organizations to strengthen talent pipelines

Qualifications

Experience

  • 4+ years of corporate recruiting experience with demonstrated progression in responsibility and scope
  • Proven track record in both external recruitment and internal talent mobility/succession planning
  • Global recruiting experience across multiple countries or regions, with understanding of diverse talent markets and cultural nuances
  • Experience in BPO, contact center, or high-volume recruitment environments (strongly preferred)
  • Multi-site and multi-department recruitment experience managing complex stakeholder landscapes

Skills & Competencies

  • Strategic thinking with ability to translate business objectives into actionable talent acquisition plans
  • Exceptional stakeholder management and consulting skills with C-level and senior leadership
  • Advanced proficiency with Applicant Tracking Systems and recruitment technologies
  • Strong analytical capabilities with experience using data to drive recruitment decisions and strategy
  • Excellent communication and influencing skills across diverse audiences and cultures
  • Proven ability to thrive in fast-paced, high-urgency environments while maintaining quality standards

Knowledge

  • Deep understanding of talent acquisition best practices, including diversity recruiting and candidate experience optimization
  • Knowledge of global recruitment trends, employment laws, and compliance requirements
  • Familiarity with various sourcing channels including social media platforms, professional networks, and passive candidate engagement strategies

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Psychology, Business Administration, or related field
  • Professional HR certifications (e.g., SHRM-CP, PHR) or recruitment certifications
  • Experience with HRIS systems and HR analytics tools
  • Background in organizational development or workforce planning

647b72723cf1916e.title: MANAGER, FINANCE
647b72723cf1916e.description:
Overview

The Finance Manager is the senior finance partner to CES regional and operational leadership. The role converts financial and operational data into decisions that improve revenue quality, gross margin, operating expense discipline, and EBIT. It leads the financial cadence for an assigned portfolio of clients, programs, and sites, while directing the work of Operations Analysts and coordinating with Workforce Management, Accounting, Pricing, Commercial, and other enabling teams.

Responsibilities

Regional Financial Leadership

  • Own the regional financial narrative through EBIT, including actuals, forecast, budget, risks, opportunities, and corrective actions.
  • Lead financial performance reviews with regional, site, and program leaders, focusing discussion on business drivers and decisions.
  • Translate operating performance into financial outcomes across revenue, labor, delivery costs, gross margin, operating expense, and EBIT.
  • Maintain a balanced portfolio view and prioritize finance support according to revenue, complexity, margin risk, client commitments, and strategic importance

Planning, Forecasting, and Decision Support

  • Lead the regional annual plan, rolling forecast, long-range outlook, and scenario analysis in partnership with operating leaders
  • Challenge assumptions using operational drivers, historical performance, contractual economics, pipeline changes, inflation, foreign exchange, and site-level cost dynamics.
  • Ensure risks and opportunities have quantified financial impact, accountable owners, specific actions, and expected realization dates.

Client and Commercial Finance

  • Partner with Commercial, Pricing, and Operations on renewals, scope changes, minimum commitments, and margin improvement opportunities.
  • Escalate structural issues in pricing, contractual terms, billing mechanics, or delivery design that could prevent achievement of financial commitments.

Team Leadership and Governance

  • Set priorities, allocate portfolios, coach, and review the work of assigned Operations Analysts; maintain backup coverage for critical programs and billing cycles.
  • Establish consistent standards for forecasts, variance explanations, management reporting, invoicing controls, data quality, and stakeholder follow-through.
  • Coordinate with Workforce Management to ensure staffing, productivity, scheduling, and capacity inputs are timely and financially coherent.
  • Partner with Accounting on close quality, accruals, revenue recognition inputs, cost classification, reconciliations, and resolution of recurring data issues.
  • Maintain documented approvals for invoicing, journal-entry support, forecast changes, and financially significant assumptions.

AI, Automation, and Data Enablement

  • Sponsor standardized, scalable reporting and analysis across the regional portfolio; eliminate lowvalue manual work where controls can be preserved or improved.
  • Partner with the Automation Analyst to prioritize use cases, define requirements, validate outputs, and measure adoption and realized value.
  • Use AI-assisted analysis for anomaly detection, driver identification, scenario generation, and management narratives while retaining human review, source traceability, confidentiality, and financial control.
  • Promote self-service insights for operational stakeholders and ensure that automated outputs lead to clear decisions and actions.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in finance, accounting, economics, business, or a related field; advanced degree or CPA/CMA credential preferred.
  • Typically 7–10 years of progressive finance, FP&A, commercial finance, or operational finance experience, including leadership of analysts or cross-functional workstreams.
  • Demonstrated ownership of a multi-client or multi-site P&L and the ability to explain performance from revenue through EBIT.
  • Strong planning, forecasting, scenario modeling, business case, and executive communication capabilities.
  • Experience in BPO, contact center, outsourced services, or another labor-intensive service environment strongly preferred.
  • Advanced spreadsheet and business-intelligence capability; practical experience improving finance processes through automation, analytics, or AI-enabled tools.

  • Provide technical leadership and mentorship to engineering teams
  • Drive technical decisions and promote best practices across the organization
  • Design and implement scalable solutions, including e-commerce and content management systems

82648d0133c3bee7.description:
About the role...

Our Audit team are on the lookout for keen and ambitious newly qualified Auditors CA (SA) / Audit Sem-Seniors to come and join the team as we enter our next phase of growth.

There has never been a better time to join us! So, if you have a passion for what you do, keen to get stuck in the mix, keep learning and strive to be the best you, then we want to hear from you.

About the team…

Our award-winning Audit team cover various specialities:

  • Big Business - focus on larger and more complex clients. Covering a wide range from private equity backed businesses to AIM listed businesses as well as others who report under the IFRS
  • Private business - A broad, multi-industry client base; we service more privately-owned firms in the Midlands than anyone else
  • Tech & High Growth – fast scaling tech companies, these are growing companies who face many challenges and complexities

About the day to day…

You'll be working with varied clients and as a newly qualified Auditor / Audit Semi-Senior, you’ll be getting stuck into a diverse range of tasks and responsibilities, including;

  • Work as part of a team to meet deadlines and contribute to help the team as a whole to meet its objectives and ensure client demands are exceeded
  • Manage a number of priorities to deliver high quality results
  • Proactively follow up on review points raised by the manager and completing them in a timely manner
  • Plan and organise effectively to ensure all client work is carried out within the appropriate timescales set by the manager and providing regular updates to the manager without being prompted
  • Provide technical expertise to ensure audit procedures performed are conducted to correct standard and accounts preparation is accurate
  • Be confident to seek guidance and support from colleagues and managers when required
  • Have the ability to problem solve to clear audit issues and be flexible to meet manager and client expectations
  • Manage your feedback and development, seek support from your line manager, and be open and honest

The role will also be designed to help you grow and develop through your career journey. With access to a wide range of knowledge to help push yourself further - from Managers to Partners, the team are always happy to support you.

About you...

At Cooper Parry, we’re in it together. All we ask of our people is that they play all in. You’ll continuously strive to keep learning – whether you’re a trainee or a Partner – and you’ll be brave, stepping out of your comfort zone to tackle new challenges. Above all, be nice. A simple notion, but an irreplaceable part of what makes CP, CP.

In addition to those core values, as an Audit Semi-Senior, you should;

  • Be newly qualified or time qualified with only 1 exam remaining
  • Experience in Private Owned Businesses, large and complex businesses or mixed portfolio
  • A top-notch problem solver, never settled with base level information and always ready to dig for the facts and find resolutions to problems
  • Approach your work with a positive attitude to perform above and beyond expectation

About us...

We’ve been dubbed ‘the rebels of accountancy’. We’re straight-talking. Never afraid to share our opinions. We put people and relationships before products and services, and deliver a streamlined, client-focused service – free from unnecessary red tape.

Check out our recent achievements:

  • Best Companies’No.1 Accountancy Firm & No.30 Best Large Company to Work For in the UK
  • Became B CorpCertified in 2023 and we’re still the UK’s largest accountancy B Corp, measuring and improving our impact beyond business for a brighter tomorrow
  • Achieved 5 awards at the Inspiring Workplace Awards in 2025: winner in the Large Business category and best in class for inspiring People & Culture, Wellbeing, Inclusion and Employee Experience

What's in it for you?

Our people are the beating heart of our culture. We know that if you love working here, and you’re given the trust and autonomy to work in a way that best suits you, you’ll produce amazing results.

That’s why we offer things like:

  • Remote working
  • A generous holiday entitlement
  • No dress code – just “wear something!”
  • A multi-award-winning wellbeing offering to support your physical, mental, spiritual, and financial health
  • Volunteering opportunities to work closer with local communities and charities
  • Access to Cooper Parry's South Africa Social Network

Feeling supported and welcomed is such a big part of bringing your whole self to work. As an equal opportunities employer, we’ll work with you to ensure you have everything you need to develop your skills and achieve your best.

Get in touch if you have any questions about our commitment to Diversity & Inclusion or about accessibility/accommodations during your application process.

For the attention of agencies - unsolicited CVs will not be honoured. We will only accept CV submissions for roles briefed to you by our Talent Acquisition team.

6594911b06af992a.description:
Regional Account Manager – Public Sector – Central Germany

Location: Fortinet Frankfurt office OR home office in the region

Join Fortinet, a cybersecurity pioneer with over two decades of excellence, as we continue to shape the future of cybersecurity and redefine the intersection of networking and security. At Fortinet, our mission is to safeguard people, devices, and data everywhere. We are currently seeking a dynamic Account Manager to contribute to the success of our rapidly growing business.

As a Regional Account Manager at Fortinet, you will

  • Learn and demonstrate a fundamental understanding of Fortinet’s technology in order to articulate our value proposition to decision-makers.

  • Manage and drive direct sales engagements into mid-market accounts (typically from 250-3,000 users) and strategic partners in your assigned territory.

  • Create and implement account plans focused on attaining deployments of Fortinet products and services.

  • Develop executive relationships with key buyers and influencers and leverage these during the sales process.

  • Coordinate with appropriate internal groups to generate and deliver winning Contract Bids, Proposals, RFI/RFP Responses, and Statements of Work.

  • Negotiate terms of business with clients to achieve win/win results that provide the basis for strong ongoing relationships.

  • Generate business opportunities and managing the sales process through to closure of the sale.

  • Generate a sales pipeline, qualifying opportunities, and accurately forecast pipeline.

Apply if you

  • Have a proven track-record of selling IT solutions to mid-size enterprise accounts.

  • Have experience of selling IT solutions to Public Sector customers across the Central region, including Lower Saxony, Hesse, Thuringia, Bremen, and Saxony-Anhalt.

  • Possess a consistent track-record of quota (over) achievement and demonstrated both career stability and growth.

  • Have experience in closing large deals.

  • Possess excellent presentation skills to Executive level audiences.

  • Are a highly motivated self-starter with a competitive personality, strong attention to detail, and a hunger to win.

  • Have exceptional communication skills, both oral and written, coupled with excellent listening skills.

586a36de741779b8.description:
🏆 Great Place to Work® Certified | USA

Harbor Compliance is a leading technology platform for entity compliance, helping more than 80,000 businesses and nonprofits manage licensing, tax registration, and legal entity requirements nationwide. Founded in 2012 and recognized repeatedly by the Inc. 5000 and Deloitte Technology Fast 500, we've grown through five strategic acquisitions — and are now backed by a 2026 majority growth investment from Bregal Sagemount to accelerate product, AI, and customer experience. We're a passionate team making compliance simpler and smarter for every organization we serve.

The Engineering Manager leads a team of software engineers building Harbor’s next-generation compliance platform. This is a player-coach role: you will ship code, build proofs of concept, and review code in the details, while owning predictable delivery, service reliability, and team growth. You will translate product priorities into executable technical plans, guide architecture and AI-assisted workflows, and develop a mature, high-ownership team. The work includes a massive agentic orchestration layer and an evergreen data problem, and it will reach tens of thousands of organizations from day one.

Responsibilities

  • Lead a team of engineers building Harbor’s next-generation platform in TypeScript and Go, including a large-scale agentic orchestration layer and a complex, evergreen data problem.
  • Ship code. Build proofs of concept, contribute to the codebase, and review code in the details alongside your team.
  • Drive delivery of team commitments by planning, scoping, and unblocking work, giving engineers ownership and trusting them to run with it.
  • Coach, mentor, and manage engineers through regular feedback, clear expectations, and performance management, including lifting up struggling performers and managing out when needed.
  • Hire and develop high-caliber engineers, and create growth paths for internal talent.
  • Shape how the team builds with AI, including agentic coding tools and harnesses, and drive adoption across your team.
  • Own the reliability and quality of your team’s systems, including incident response and postmortems.
  • Partner with Product, Operations, and other engineering leaders to align priorities and resolve trade-offs, and manage distributed team members who work asynchronously (including in Prague).

Requirements

  • About 1+ year of people management experience in an engineering organization, with a clear philosophy of leadership and management and concrete examples of applying that philosophy.
  • Hands-on engineering depth with modern languages (TypeScript, Go, or similar), and the polyglot appetite to pick up new languages, stacks, and legacy code (PHP) as the problem demands.
  • Active use of agentic coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, or similar)
  • Comfort managing engineers who may be more senior or higher paid than you, such as staff-level individual contributors.
  • Strong passion for building and ongoing learning, with a habit of staying current on how technology and AI are evolving.
  • Based in the U.S. with availability aligned to Eastern core business hours (9a-5p). West Coast candidates should expect some early mornings when managing team members in other time zones.

Preferred Skills

  • Experience with modern database technology (such as SurrealDB) and distributed systems.
  • Experience leading agentic transformation of existing code.
  • Experience managing distributed teams in different time zones, including asynchronous collaboration.

Salary is one part of Harbor Compliance’s total compensation package. These tools assist our recruitment team in reviewing qualification trends and scheduling, but all final employment decisions are made solely by humans on our Talent Success team, and all tools are subject to human oversight.

5737341a5471a3bb.description:
Job Title: Systems Analyst

Role Summary

The Systems Analyst provides expertise regarding systems development implementation, maintenance and support activities to a wide range of business and technical situations throughout the SBU / SSU support area. The Analyst is responsible for leading, planning, and analyzing complex business requirements and implementing technology enabled solutions to address multi-facetted business opportunities and challenges.

The incumbent is Accountable for executing conceptual frameworks, implementation strategies and plans for recommended changes within SBU / SSU support area. The Analyst proactively contributes toward the development of the Technology team's tactical plans in support of business initiatives and occasionally offers directional guidance to clients and other applicable audiences.

Key Accountabilities

1.Provides technical expertise and consulting services in the development and implementation of new bank delivery systems, in order to achieve and maintain a competitive edge. Mentors system developers. Conducts and delivers analysis that presents comprehensive views on business challenges. Recommends and develops application architecture for assigned business application.

2.Completes complex systems development assignments, with minimal supervision, within budget and to client expectations, as required, which may include but is not limited to the following:

oCodes or makes modifications to programmes according to detailed business requirements and specifications, including the execution of team and operability testing.

oProvides the required documentation including software unit test strategy, plan, matrix, scripts, execution completion report, software impact analysis, back-out and recovery procedures, technical implementation procedures, computer run sheet updates, system documentation, data dictionary updates and system user guide.

oConducts feasibility studies of multi-discipline business opportunities and challenges, assuming the responsibility for the development of business proposals.

3.Delivers products and functionality that fully meets business requirements, that may include but is not limited to the following:

oEnsures compliance with established policies, standards and methodologies, e.g., project planning, security etc.

oEnsures that no outages / problems are identified during user acceptance, operability and / or stress and performance testing or product implementation.

oParticipates in post-implementation reviews as required.

4.Maintains a comprehensive knowledge of current and the future direction of financial and computer industries, as required, which may include but is not limited to the following:

oProvides expertise in areas of speciality, e.g., become the specialist in one or more information technology disciplines, commensurate with the current state of technologies.

oForecasts future trends, anticipates problems and conditions (e.g., volumes, new developments, turnover, etc.).

oConducts highly complex evaluations for product releases, standalone products, etc.

5.Partners and collaborates with Solution Architects, Solution Designers and Application Developers as required, striving towards high success levels in implementation of solutions and ongoing support.

6.Contributes to the realization of complex solutions that capitalize on business and technology developments by monitoring industry-wide standards and the development of new vendor products for applicability to the organisation.

7.Participates in the development, maintenance and implementation of policies, standards and guidelines on all aspects of technology architecture within the Technology team.

Role Specifics – Cyber Risk

Responsible for the technical analysis, maintenance, optimization, and support of key cybersecurity and data protection platforms across the Cyber Risk Programs. The role includes:

Maintaining, configuring, monitoring, and troubleshooting EOS ITPM, Rubrik M365 Backup, and Digital Crown Jewel protection.

Implementing system upgrades, resolving technical and connectivity issues, analyzing logs, and optimizing platform performance and security controls.

Supporting business analysts and project teams with technical expertise and operational troubleshooting.

Analyzing system requirements, technical capabilities, integration points, and design specifications for M365 Backup/Rubrik, Project OHM, SharePoint Data Governance scanning, and Advanced Server Protection.

Supporting requirements and design deliverables, documenting technical decisions, reporting on system health and security posture, and recommending improvements to strengthen security, segmentation, backup, and data protection capabilities.

389cacf1e3173c11.title: Itechra Inc: Outbound Sales Representative
389cacf1e3173c11.description:
Headquarters: United States
URL: https://workforcenow.adp.com/mascsr/default/mdf/recruitment/recruitment.html?cid=f67f7ff8-709a-4bcc-9c67-48e44a5e71e6



Outbound Sales Representative (Inside Sales) – Remote, U.S.

Location: 100% Remote – United States
Schedule: Full-Time, Monday–Friday, 8:00 a.m.–4:30 p.m. Central Time
Employment Type: Hourly, Non-Exempt
Base Pay: $24.00–$28.85 per hour (approximately $50,000–$60,000 annually), plus uncapped FTA bonuses and commission opportunities
On-Target Earnings (OTE): Approximately $75,000+ annually, based on performance
Reports To: VP of Sales

100 Dials a Day. Real Coaching. Get Paid When Your Appointments Convert.

We're looking for an experienced outbound sales professional who enjoys prospecting, tracks their numbers, and wants to be rewarded for results.

At Itechra, you'll make the calls, build relationships, and book qualified meetings. We'll train you on IT, support you through a structured 30/60/90-day onboarding plan, and provide ongoing coaching to help you succeed.

You'll earn a bonus for every qualified First Time Appointment (FTA) that converts to a Second Time Appointment (STA), plus commission on qualifying deals that close and generate client payment.

You don't need an IT background. You do need outbound sales experience, resilience, confidence on the phone, and the motivation to consistently achieve your goals.

This is a fully remote, phone-based sales position focused on generating business opportunities for our sales team.

What You'll Do

As an Outbound Sales Representative, internally classified as an Inside Sales Representative (ISR), you'll open doors for our sales team by connecting with business owners and IT decision-makers at companies with 25 or more computers.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Prospect every day. Make high-volume outbound calls, send emails, and use LinkedIn to reach business owners and decision-makers.

  • Do your homework. Research target companies, identify decision-makers, and gather relevant business information before reaching out.

  • Qualify opportunities. Ask thoughtful questions to understand each prospect's IT needs, company size, and purchasing authority.

  • Book qualified appointments. Schedule First Time Appointments (FTAs) that create opportunities for Second Time Appointments (STAs) with our sales team.

  • Manage your pipeline. Consistently follow up with prospects, nurture relationships, and keep opportunities moving forward.

  • Maintain accurate CRM records. Document calls, prospect details, activities, and follow-up information in HubSpot.

  • Track and report results. Provide weekly updates on activity, pipeline development, and conversion metrics.

  • Continuously improve. Participate in role-playing, call reviews, sales training, and one-on-one coaching.

How We Measure Success

We're a metrics-driven sales organization. You'll have clear expectations, ongoing feedback, and visibility into your performance.

Our established performance goals include:

  • Outbound Calls: 500+ per week (approximately 100 per day)

  • Decision-Maker Conversation Rate: 5% of outbound dials

  • Qualified First Time Appointments (FTAs): 12+ per month

  • CRM Accuracy: Complete and accurate documentation of calls, activities, notes, and next steps in HubSpot

If you enjoy measurable goals, friendly competition, and the opportunity to see your hard work translate into results, you'll fit right in.

Your First 90 Days: Training, Coaching & Performance

We believe strong salespeople deserve clear expectations, quality training, and consistent coaching.

Our structured 30/60/90-day onboarding program is designed to help you learn our business, build confidence, develop your skills, and understand exactly what success looks like.

Days 1–30 | Learn

  • Complete onboarding and training on Itechra's services, ideal clients, sales processes, and technology solutions.

  • Learn our prospecting tools, talk tracks, objection-handling strategies, and HubSpot CRM.

  • Participate in daily role-playing and coaching before and during your first live calls.

Days 31–45 | Ramp

  • Build toward and achieve 500+ outbound dials per week.

  • Participate in weekly call reviews and coaching sessions.

  • Demonstrate consistent prospecting, follow-up, and CRM documentation.

Days 46–90 | Perform

  • Maintain established outbound activity expectations.

  • Demonstrate consistent prospecting, qualification, and pipeline management.

  • Work toward the monthly goal of 12 qualified FTAs.

  • Meet individual ramp-up milestones outlined in your onboarding plan.

You'll always know where you stand. If you're coachable, accountable, and committed to improving, we'll invest in helping you succeed.

What You'll Earn

Your effort and results should create opportunity.

Itechra offers competitive hourly base compensation along with performance-based bonuses and commission opportunities.

  • Base Pay: $24.00–$28.85 per hour, equivalent to approximately $50,000–$60,000 annually based on a 40-hour workweek, depending on experience and qualifications.

  • FTA-to-STA Bonus: $250 for every qualified FTA that converts to an STA, with no stated cap. The bonus is earned when the qualifying STA is scheduled with a confirmed date and time, subject to the sales compensation plan.

  • Closed-Won Commission: 10% of the first month's recurring revenue for qualifying deals originating from your FTA. Commission eligibility is based on the applicable client invoicing and payment requirements outlined in Itechra's sales compensation plan.

  • On-Target Earnings: Approximately $75,000+ annually, including base pay and performance incentives. Actual earnings vary based on individual performance.

What Qualifies as an FTA?

A qualified First Time Appointment is a meeting you schedule with an IT purchasing decision-maker at a company with 25 or more computers.

Here's an Example of Your Earning Potential

If eight of your FTAs convert to STAs in one month, you would earn $2,000 in FTA-to-STA bonuses. Maintaining that performance for 12 months would generate $24,000 in annual bonuses.

If one qualifying appointment also results in a new client generating $4,000 in monthly recurring revenue, the associated 10% first-month commission would be an additional $400.

Bonuses and commissions are paid according to Itechra's applicable sales compensation plan.

Examples are for illustration only and do not represent guaranteed earnings. Actual compensation depends on individual performance, qualifying transactions, and plan requirements.

Where This Role Can Take You

We believe in recognizing performance, developing talent, and promoting from within.

Successful ISRs may have opportunities to pursue two career paths:

Inside Sales Team Lead

Lead, coach, and develop a team of Inside Sales Representatives. This potential advancement opportunity may be available to qualified remote employees throughout the United States.

Outside Sales Representative

Advance into a client-facing sales position focused on conducting Second Time Appointments, managing opportunities, and closing new business.

This career path requires residing in or relocating to one of Itechra's local markets, currently in Minnesota or Wisconsin.

Advancement opportunities depend on business needs, performance, qualifications, and position availability.

What Makes You a Great Fit?

Required Qualifications

  • At least 3 years of professional experience in outbound B2B sales, inside sales, business development, lead generation, or a closely related role.

  • Demonstrated experience with cold calling, prospecting, appointment setting, and CRM management.

  • Confidence engaging business owners, executives, and decision-makers and asking for the appointment.

  • Resilience and persistence when handling rejection and objections.

  • A competitive, self-motivated mindset with a focus on achieving measurable sales goals.

  • Willingness to receive coaching, apply feedback, and continuously improve.

  • Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and accurate CRM documentation.

  • Ability to work independently, remain accountable, and maintain productivity in a remote environment.

  • A quiet, professional home workspace with reliable internet access.

Preferred Qualifications

  • An associate degree or higher in sales, business, marketing, or a related field.

  • Experience selling or prospecting within managed IT services, technology, or another consultative B2B industry.

  • Familiarity with HubSpot, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, ZoomInfo, or similar sales tools.

  • Experience prospecting to business owners or C-level executives.

This Role May Not Be the Best Fit If You:

  • Prefer working exclusively with inbound leads.

  • Are uncomfortable with daily activity targets and measurable performance expectations.

  • Prefer a highly scripted sales environment with constant supervision.

  • Are not interested in ongoing coaching, feedback, and professional development.

Benefits & Perks

At Itechra, we believe taking care of our employees is just as important as taking care of our clients.

Our benefits package for eligible full-time employees includes:

  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance

  • Health Savings Account (HSA) options, subject to plan eligibility

  • 401(k) retirement plan with company matching contributions, subject to plan requirements

  • Paid time off and paid holidays

  • Employee assistance and wellness resources

  • Ongoing sales training and professional development

  • Employee recognition and performance incentives

  • Remote work opportunities within the United States

Benefits eligibility and effective dates vary by benefit and are governed by applicable plan documents and company policies.

About Itechra

Since 2001, Itechra has been a strategic technology partner to growing businesses.

We don't just keep the lights on. We help business leaders put IT, cybersecurity, AI, and automation to work at the core of how they operate,

0b7424398e1f1f87.description:
Headquarters:
URL: http://www.thrivemarket.com

ABOUT THRIVE MARKET 

Thrive Market was founded in 2014 with a mission to make healthy and sustainable living easy and affordable for everyone. As an online, membership-based market, we deliver the highest quality healthy, and sustainable products at member-only prices, while matching every paid membership with a free one for someone in need. Every day, we leverage innovative technology and member-first thinking to help our over 1,700,000+ members find better products, support better brands, and build a better world in the process. We are also a Certified B Corporation, a Public Benefit Corporation, and a Climate Neutral Certified company.

Join us as we bring healthy and sustainable living to millions of Americans in the years to come.

THE ROLE

A contractor (30-40 hrs per week) who helps keep the paid social performance creative engine running: first-round ad review, QA and delivery, performance data, builds and decks, and ad hoc support for our creative strategist.

RESPONSIBILITIES

1. First-round creative review

  • Review ads against the brief: does the concept, message, and offer answer what was asked?

2. Creative QA & delivery

  • Check aspect ratios (1:1, 4:5, 9:16, etc.) and file specs (format, size, video length, safe zones, captions)
  • Check ad naming against convention
  • Confirm all assets are in (nothing missing) and the correct, approved version is used
  • Deliver to channel managers with a standard handoff note (batch contents, launch date, links)

3. Coordination & Workload Balance

  •  Keep track of what is due, what is ready, and what is at risk in Wrike and build out a 8-12 week rolling calendar
  •  Balance competing projects and flag blockers or slipping deadlines early
  •  Proactively contact the right people when a new project starts (designers, editors, copywriters, channel managers, brand/legal)
  •  Move work along on Sabrina's behalf (follow-ups, nudges), with signoff as described below

4. Ad hoc support

  •  Slot in last-minute asks and triage them by urgency, telling Sabrina what gets bumped
  •  Own small edit and resize requests end to end without Sabrina stepping in: no editing skills required, but coordinate with the project manager to find bandwidth on the editing team, brief the editor, and track the request through delivery

5. Performance data & reporting

  •  Pull performance data (Motion, Meta Ads Manager) and build recurring reports (top and bottom performers, spend by concept)
  •  Tag and categorize creatives (hook, format, angle, offer)
  •  Keep a testing learnings log
  •  Surface early takeaways to inform briefs and next rounds

6. Decks & strategy support

  •  Help build decks: test readouts, performance recaps, creative reviews
  •  Research competitor and inspiration ads
  •  Draft first-pass briefs or test summaries for Sabrina to review

Headquarters: San Francisco, California, United States

Marketing & Content Intern (Part-Time)

Remote (US)

 

About Kinelo

Kinelo is an early-stage AI startup building technology that helps companies work faster by keeping company knowledge current and making it available to both people and AI. Our proactive AI Coworkers use that knowledge to take on work, coordinate across teams, and keep people informed.

We're looking for a marketing intern to help us build and grow Kinelo's presence in the market. The role covers a wide range of marketing activities, from content, social media, and creative production to market research, partnerships, and campaigns.

You'll work directly with our founding GTM lead and have plenty of opportunities to come up with ideas and execute them.

On a given day or week, you might

  • Come up with content ideas for X, LinkedIn, and other channels, then help turn those ideas into posts, articles, videos, or visual content.
  • Develop creative video concepts, plan and edit short-form videos, and experiment with different styles and formats.
  • Design graphics, social assets, and other visuals for our website, content, and marketing campaigns.
  • Research AI trends, competitors, and relevant industry conversations to identify interesting topics, market opportunities, and new ideas worth exploring.
  • Find relevant creators, influencers, newsletters, and communities, research their audiences, and help coordinate potential collaborations.
  • Support marketing campaigns, from researching target audiences and developing content to coordinating distribution and tracking results.
  • Help create website content, customer stories, presentations, and other marketing materials.
  • Research journalists, podcasts, events, and other opportunities to get Kinelo in front of relevant audiences.
  • Experiment with different marketing ideas, see what works, and bring recommendations for what we should try next.

We're looking for someone who

  • Is currently studying marketing, communications, journalism, media, or a related field.
  • Has previous marketing/content internship experience OR has built and managed their own social media accounts. 
  • Writes well and has a good instinct for what makes content interesting, useful, or worth sharing.
  • Has experience creating and editing videos, especially short-form content, and is comfortable developing creative concepts from scratch.
  • Has a good eye for visual design and experience with tools like Canva, Figma, CapCut, Adobe, or similar.
  • Understands social media platforms, follows relevant creators and trends, and has opinions about what makes good content.
  • Is a strong researcher who can dig into unfamiliar topics, find useful information, and turn it into ideas or recommendations.
  • Is actively using AI tools in their own work, studies, or creative projects, and enjoys experimenting with new tools and finding ways to get better results. You don't need a technical background, but you should be excited about what AI makes possible.
  • Is resourceful, organized, and comfortable figuring things out independently.

Logistics

  • Part-time, approximately 10-20 hours per week
  • $25/hr
  • Remote (US)

Northpoint Recovery Holdings, LLC began 2009 as Ashwood Outpatient and officially launched the Northpoint platform in 2015. Now celebrating 10 years of growth in 2025, Northpoint is a leading behavioral healthcare provider offering evidence-based treatment for adults with substance use and co-occurring disorders through the Northpoint Recovery brand, and mental health treatment for adolescents through Imagine by Northpoint. Operating under an in-network, commercial insurance model, Northpoint has grown exclusively through de novo expansion—from two facilities to seventeen across the Western U.S.—with more planned in both existing and new markets. We’re guided by core values of humility, heart, inspiration, and conviction. Our mission is simple: saving lives and restoring relationships by helping people get their lives back, and treating every individual with empathy and respect.

 

POSITION SUMMARY: As a key member of the Northpoint team, the Admissions Representative is responsible for overseeing the patient/client admissions lifecycle and consistently driving the census at each facility. This person will be managing a large amount of inbound and outbound lead generation activities including telephone calls, email communications, and online chats to prospect and develop leads. The Admissions Representative will work with multiple departments and outside vendors to ensure all goals are accomplished. As an ambassador of Northpoint, adhering to our Core Values while assisting all potential clients is paramount.

 

ESSENTIAL RESPONSIBILITIES AND DUTIES:

• Maintain cleanliness of the Admissions office

• Adhere to all Company policies and procedures

• Performs other related duties and special projects as assigned

 

QUALIFICATIONS/REQUIREMENTS:
• Must be at least twenty-one (21) years of age
• 1+ year of sales experience in a call center setting preferred
• Experience with a growing company with multiple entities preferred
• Action-oriented with the ability to: adapt to change, work independently, prioritize tasks, and drive to finish

 

PREFERRED KNOWLEDGE AND SKILLS:
• Excellent critical thinking skills
• Excellent organizational abilities
• Strong mentoring, and coaching experience to a team with diverse levels of expertise; ability to influence and engage employees and peers
• Exceptional written, oral, interpersonal, and presentation skills and the ability to effectively interface with senior management, board of directors, and staff
• Ability to operate as a practical tactical as well as a strategic thinker
• Comfortable analyzing information and dealing with complexity
• Quickly and effectively identify and resolve problematic situations
• Able to handle confidential material in a reliable manner
• Ability to perform several tasks concurrently with ease and professionalism
• Ability to effectively prioritize workload in a fast-paced environment

  • 100% Employer Paid Employee Assistance Program

  • Generous Paid Time Off plan
  • Employee Referral Bonuses

28ce226536361387.description:
Headquarters: La Canada Flintridge, California, United States
URL: https://workforcenow.adp.com/mascsr/default/mdf/recruitment/recruitment.html?cid=ad225930-56eb-4a0f-ab89-0b646ff0cf17

Location: Canada

Work model: Remote

Expected compensation: Base salary starting at $85,000 CAD per annum

Vacancy status: This posting is for an existing vacancy.


About AudienceView

AudienceView is passionate about helping live event organizations bring people together through unforgettable experiences. Our unified event commerce platform helps organizations better understand, engage, and grow their audiences while creating stronger relationships and more connected experiences across the entire event journey.

We support organizations across performing arts, music, athletics, higher education, fairs, festivals, attractions, and more. By combining technology, audience intelligence, and deep industry expertise, AudienceView helps organizations make informed decisions, simplify operations, and build sustainable growth.


Four core values set the tempo for how we work:

  • We are people first.
  • We are innovative.
  • We are results-driven.
  • We are transparent.

AudienceView is made up of people who believe wholeheartedly in the power and magic of live events. Come transform live entertainment with us.


Why we'd want to work with you

We are looking for a Digital Marketing Manager to own and scale our B2B demand generation engine. In this role, you will drive pipeline growth and lower customer acquisition costs (CAC) by orchestrating high-impact paid campaigns, targeted ABM programs, and sophisticated marketing automation workflows. If you are a data-driven marketer who loves connecting the dots between paid media, email nurtures, and sales execution, we want to talk to you.


What you'll do:

  • Paid Search & Paid Ads: Own Google Ads and LinkedIn campaigns end-to-end—including strategy, budgeting, bidding, keyword research, audience building, and creative testing—to drive pipeline and optimize CAC. Expand into review platforms (G2, Capterra) where it makes strategic sense.
  • Email Marketing & Nurture: Design and execute email programs in Pardot, focusing on precise segmentation, multi-touch nurture tracks, trigger-based sends, and lifecycle campaigns tailored to key buyer personas.
  • Account-Based Marketing (ABM): Own the tooling, account scoring, and 1-to-many ABM framework. Partner with Sales and Revenue Operations to build tiered target account lists and deliver personalized, programmatic campaigns.
  • Marketing Automation & CRO: Build, maintain, and troubleshoot workflows, lead scoring models, and routing rules to ensure leads reach Sales quickly and accurately. Improve website conversion rates through landing pages, form optimization, and CRO experiments.
  • Reporting & Attribution: Track performance across paid, email, ABM, and automation. Report on spend, conversion rates, pipeline velocity, and CAC by channel to guide data-driven budget allocation.
  • Test & Optimize: Continually run experiments across channels, messaging, and funnel paths to scale what works and cut what doesn't.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with Sales, BDRs, RevOps, and Product Marketing to ensure airtight alignment on targeting, messaging, and lead handoffs.


What you'll need:

  • 4+ years of B2B digital demand generation experience, with a proven track record of scaling inbound pipeline.
  • Paid Media Expertise: Hands-on experience managing and optimizing Google Ads and LinkedIn Ads with a focus on efficiency (CAC) and revenue generation.
  • Marketing Automation: Strong command of Pardot (or similar enterprise automation tools), email compliance, segmentation, and lead-scoring frameworks.
  • Technical Stack: Proficiency with Salesforce, Google Analytics / GA4, and WordPress (or equivalent CMS).
  • Analytical Mindset: Exceptional problem-solving skills with a deep understanding of marketing attribution models and funnel metrics.
  • Project Management: Strong cross-functional collaboration skills across Marketing and Sales teams.
  • Mindset: A curious, self-starting operator who thrives in a fast-paced environment and loves continuous learning.


Key Performance Indicators (KPIs):

  • High-Intent MQLs: Volume and lead quality by channel and segment.
  • Marketing-Generated Pipeline: Total opportunity value created.
  • Pipeline Velocity & Conversion Rates: Website, funnel, nurture, and trial-to-paid conversion performance.
  • Engagement & Progression: Email engagement metrics and target account movement through the ABM funnel.

Few people tick every box on a list like this. If most of it sounds like you and the rest sounds like something you'd love to learn, we still want to hear from you.


Why work at AudienceView

  • Our work helps bring live experiences to life. From Broadway tours and symphony performances to music festivals, museums, universities, attractions, and community events, our software helps organizations of all sizes connect people with unforgettable experiences every day.
  • We're fans, not just vendors. Our teams include former box office staff, front-of-house crew, local musicians, season ticket holders, arts advocates, and lifelong eventgoers. That shared passion for live experiences is at the heart of everything we do.
  • You'll solve meaningful challenges at scale. Supporting over 2800 organizations and millions of ticket buyers means working on complex, rewarding problems. Whether it's powering major on-sales, improving the patron experience, or helping clients grow their audiences, you'll see the impact of your work firsthand.
  • We're remote-first with a live-events heart. Work alongside globally based colleagues who share a genuine passion for the arts, culture, sports, entertainment, and live experiences that bring people together.
  • Diversity and inclusion are paramount to building our culture. The data is abundantly clear that diverse teams are more successful because they offer different perspectives, increased innovation, faster problem-solving and higher employee engagement among other benefits.


How we hire — our run of show

No black holes and no endless rounds. Here's the run of show, so you know exactly what's coming and when:

  • Screening & Resume Review: Our Talent Acquisition team will evaluate all resumes and select candidates for a video screening call for 30 minutes.
  • Hiring Manager Interview (30 minutes): Meet with the hiring manager to speak in detail about your relevant experience and learn more about the role.
  • Meet More of the Team (60 minutes): Meet more team members to learn more about the work culture and expectations.
  • Case Study Interview (45 minutes): Meet with the hiring manager again to complete a quick case study.

Every interview is held face to face over Microsoft Teams with a member of our team on camera. If we interview you, we will tell you whether a hiring decision has been made for this role within 45 days of your last interview.


How we use artificial intelligence in hiring

We use AI in one place only. Our hiring team may use Microsoft Copilot to transcribe interviews and draft interview notes, so that interviewers can concentrate on the conversation instead of typing. You will always know before any recording or AI note-taking begins, and you can ask us to take notes manually instead — it will not affect your application.

We do not use AI to screen, assess, rank or select applicants, and no automated system makes a hiring decision at any stage. Every shortlisting, interview and offer decision is made by people on our hiring team.


Equal opportunity, inclusion and accessibility

Diversity and inclusion have always been at the core of our values at AudienceView. A diverse workforce with wide perspectives and creative ideas benefits our clients, the communities where we operate, and all of us as colleagues. We welcome applications from qualified people of every background.

We are committed to an accessible hiring process and provide accommodations and adjustments to applicants with disabilities on request, at every stage of recruitment and employment.


How to spot a genuine AudienceView offer

AudienceView does not offer employment to anyone without first ensuring that qualified candidates speak directly with a member of the hiring team. All qualifying conversations take place face to face over Microsoft Teams. We do not make offers of employment without meeting candidates, we never make an offer by text message, and we never ask candidates to pay a fee. If you are asked for personal or financial information by text, or before you have met a member of our hiring team, please disregard it.


Ready to join the show?

If this role sounds like your kind of show and your experience lines up with what we’re looking for, we’d love to hear from you. We’re grateful for every application we receive; however, only qualified candidates selected to move forward in our hiring process will be contacted.

To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/audienceview-digital-marketing-manager

Saving the World!  Help Wanted…

Budderfly is a fast-growth, private equity-backed energy management outsourcing company that is committed to reducing global carbon emissions for small to medium sized enterprises.  We are the premier sustainability partner for businesses with repeatable footprints such as restaurant chains, assisted living facilities, retail franchises, and more. Budderfly installs, monitors, and manages a combination of patented technologies, equipment upgrades, and proprietary energy software to help deliver complete energy saving solutions for our customers.

Celebrating 5 years on Inc. 5000 America’s Fastest-Growing Private Companies list. Recognized in Time Magazine’s Best Inventions of 2025.

We are an energetic and dedicated team working together to make a positive impact on the environment while providing an excellent customer experience.   We are growing quickly and looking to add talented people who are passionate about making the world a better place!

We have an opportunity for a motivated individual to fill the role of Customer Success Manager. In this position, the successful candidate will be responsible for acting as the liaison to our customer’s executive teams to build strong relationships and ensure that their requests are met with a focus on positive customer experience.

Why this Role is Important:
Budderfly is committed to ensuring that all our customers’ needs are understood and addressed while dramatically reducing their carbon footprint and significantly lowering their energy costs. The Customer Success Manager will take the handoff from the Account Executive who sold the business and continue to grow and enhance the customer relationship at the highest levels of the organization.
