66d48825a6aeee9a.title: Paleovalley & Wild Pastures: Customer Service Agent (US, Remote)
66d48825a6aeee9a.description:
Headquarters: United States
URL: https://jobs.workable.com/company/v4p85bFUauGzY3y7Pyo6Go/jobs-at-paleovalley-%26-wild-pastures

Reports to: Customer Service Supervisor

Department: Customer Service

Location: This is a fully remote U.S.-based position. Candidates must reside and work in one of the following states due to tax and compliance requirements: AR, AZ, CA, CO, FL, GA, ID, IL, LA, MD, MO, NC, NJ, NV, NY, OH, TX, VA, WA, WI, or WY.

FLSA Classification: Hourly, Non-Exempt

Compensation: This position has geographic-based pay ranges. Final compensation and geographic tier placement are determined based on the candidate's primary work location, skills, experience, and qualifications.

Tier 1 (Higher Cost Markets): $20.50 - $24.00

Tier 2 (National Markets): $19.00 - $22.00

Tier 3 (Lower Cost Markets): $17.00 - $19.50

About the Company

Paleovalley and Wild Pastures were born from a simple but radical idea: real food can heal — people, animals, and the planet. When Paleovalley co-founders Autumn and Chas Smith saw how industrialized food was affecting human health and the health of the land, they refused to play along. Autumn’s own journey of healing through nutrient-dense foods lit a fire that became Paleovalley. From there, the mission grew roots, sprouted wings, and eventually expanded into Wild Pastures to bring regeneratively raised meats directly to families nationwide.

Today, Paleovalley crafts deeply nourishing snacks and supplements made with organic ingredients and honorable sourcing. Wild Pastures connects small American farmers practicing regenerative agriculture with customers who believe better food is worth fighting for. Every product, every partnership, and every decision is guided by a commitment to real ingredients, regenerative practices, and the belief that health is built from the soil up.

We’re a team of grounded doers, curious thinkers, bold builders, and warm humans who like to laugh while doing meaningful work. We're growing quickly, fueled by purpose and a shared desire to repair the food system one thoughtful choice at a time. If you feel energized by impact, drawn to mission, and ready to join a company rewriting the future of food, we’d love to meet you!

About the Opportunity

For this position, as the first point of contact for our Wild Pastures customers, this person will provide friendly, accurate, and timely support through email, live chat, and phone. 

In this role, you’ll help customers navigate common questions about their accounts and orders, bringing empathy, professionalism, and attention to detail to each interaction. 

You’ll work assigned shifts as part of a coordinated team schedule that helps us stay available for customers and share the workload. This role is responsible for being available during your scheduled hours and communicating promptly when your availability changes. This helps the team plan coverage, support one another, and provide a consistent customer service experience.

What You’ll Do

  • Respond to customer inquiries via email and live chat in a timely and professional manner.
  • Assist customers with order status, shipping updates, account access, subscription management, and product questions.
  • Cover scheduled daily phone support shifts, handling inbound calls and callbacks while meeting call-volume goals.
  • Deliver a warm, clear, and efficient experience over the phone, knowing when to escalate longer or complex calls.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve basic customer concerns independently.
  • Accurately document customer interactions in the support platform.
  • Utilize internal knowledge bases and saved replies to ensure consistent and accurate responses.
  • Escalate complex or sensitive issues to Tier 2 or leadership when appropriate.
  • Maintain a high standard of customer satisfaction, empathy, and professionalism in all interactions.
  • Follow internal processes and SOPs to ensure consistent service quality.
  • Meet or exceed productivity and quality expectations for response time and ticket resolution.
  • Be available and responsive during assigned shifts, and communicate absences or scheduling changes to your manager as early as practicable so the team can plan coverage and customer handoffs.

What You’ll Need to Succeed

  • 1-2 years of experience in customer service, preferably in eCommerce or a high-volume support environment.
  • Experience handling email, live chat and/or phone support.
  • Strong written communication skills with excellent grammar and tone.
  • Ability to manage a high volume of customer conversations efficiently.
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to follow processes.
  • Comfort using customer support platforms and learning new tools quickly.
  • Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote environment.

Bonus Points

  • Experience with customer support platforms such as Zendesk, Richpanel, or similar systems.
  • Familiarity with subscription-based eCommerce businesses.
  • Interest in health, nutrition, or wellness products.

What Success Looks Like

  • Resolve most customer inquiries without escalation.
  • Maintain high-quality responses while managing ticket volume.
  • Communicate clearly and empathetically with customers.
  • Contribute to a positive and supportive team environment.

Our Commitment to You 

  • Medical, dental, and vision coverage with 100% employer-paid dental/vision and a small monthly medical premium for employees; dependents may be added at employee cost
  • Generous Paid time off to support balance and rest
  • Paid sick time for when you need it
  • Six (6) paid holidays each year
  • Paid parental leave for growing families
  • 100% company-paid Short-Term Disability, Long-Term Disability, and Life Insurance
  • 401(k) with up to a 4% company match after one year of service
  • Monthly product stipend or access to perfectly imperfect damaged product so you can enjoy the nutrient-dense foods you help bring to others

Compliance & Employment Practices 

Paleovalley and Wild Pastures are proud to be equal opportunity employers. We make  employment decisions based on qualifications, merit, and business needs, and we do not  discriminate based on any status protected by applicable federal, state, or local law. We’re also  committed to providing reasonable accommodations throughout the hiring process. If you need  assistance or an accommodation at any point, please reach out to HRteam@paleovalley.com.  

All applicants must be authorized to work in the United States. At this time, Paleovalley and  Wild Pastures are unable to sponsor or assume sponsorship of employment visas, including but  not limited to H-1B, TN, or OPT. Any offer of employment is contingent upon completion of  Form I-9 and verification of work authorization. We participate in E-Verify to confirm eligibility  to work in the U.S. 

To support an efficient and consistent application review process, we may use technology assisted tools to help organize and review applications; however, these tools do not make  hiring decisions. All final hiring decisions are made by our team. 

This role is open until filled.

c6269c60c9e37697.description:
Headquarters: United States
URL: http://www.henrymeds.com

About Henry Meds:
Henry Meds is a direct-to-consumer telehealth company on a mission to create a world where everyone has the health to live fully– regardless of insurance status or plan. As a telehealth organization delivering virtual health care to patients in 40 states and DC through a professional corporation–management services organization (“PC-MSO”) model, clinical care is delivered by physician-owned professional entities, and Henry Meds provides administrative, technology, and business support services under management services agreements.

We’re headquartered in Las Vegas, Nevada, with a largely remote U.S. team. We work under a guiding principle that puts patients first, driven by five values: Integrity Always, Own It, Be Relentless, Stay Curious, and Win Together. We are driven to fulfil our mission and create a great place to work.

Enjoy the casual culture, remote-first workplace, and generous PTO/benefits! 

Apply today to make a direct, daily impact in one of the fastest-growing startups in the country - we are excited to meet you!

 

Position Overview: 

The Patient Advocate I is a primary frontline contact for Henry Meds patients. This role resolves standard non-clinical needs through phone, voicemail, email, chat, and other approved channels. The Patient Advocate I owns the patient interaction, completes authorized actions, coordinates internal help when needed, and keeps the patient informed through resolution.

 

Duties and Responsibilities:

Patient Support

  • Communicate with patients by phone, email, and chat using timely, empathetic, and ownership-driven service.
  • Work as a generalist across phone, email, chat, voicemail, billing, account support, subscriptions, scheduling, refill support, portal navigation, order support, and other approved non-clinical workflows.
  • Accept channel and work-type assignments based on patient needs, volume, staffing, and operational priorities rather than individual preference.
  • Resolve standard questions involving accounts, subscriptions, billing, scheduling, refill processes, portal use, intake forms, and order status.
  • Guide new and existing patients through Henry systems and established care processes.
  • Troubleshoot basic platform and account-access issues.
  • Use approved retention and service-recovery options when appropriate.

Case Ownership and Coordination

  • Own assigned patient needs from first contact through documented resolution.
  • Complete authorized actions in the CRM, EHR, billing platform, and related systems.
  • Manage the non-clinical portion of requests that also require clinical action.
  • Explain next steps, expected timing, and any action required from the patient.
  • Escalate stalled or unresolved work through the defined operating path.

Clinical Boundaries and Compliance

  • Recognize possible symptoms, side effects, medication questions, and other clinical content.
  • Route clinical matters to Patient Safety or the appropriate licensed team without providing clinical advice.
  • Protect patient confidentiality and follow HIPAA, privacy, security, and documentation requirements.

Quality and Improvement

  • Follow approved daily work assignments, queue priorities, coverage direction, and workflow guidance issued by the Manager or a designated Patient Advocate Leader.
  • Meet established quality, accuracy, productivity, timeliness, attendance, and schedule expectations.
  • Stay current on approved process, policy, product, pricing, and system changes.
  • Identify unclear procedures, broken workflows, and recurring causes of repeat patient contact.

 

You will likely have:

  • Experience in telehealth, healthcare, pharmacy support, subscription services, or regulated customer service.
  • Experience with Zendesk, Zoho, an EHR, or billing platforms.

 

You may have:

  • Previous experience in customer service, healthcare support, care coordination, a call center, or another high-volume service environment.
  • Clear and compassionate verbal and written communication skills.
  • Strong active listening, problem-solving, organization, and follow-through.
  • Comfort learning and working across CRM, EHR, billing, and communication systems.
  • Ability to work independently in a remote environment while collaborating with a distributed team.
  • Ability to maintain clinical boundaries and follow escalation requirements.
  • Commitment to patient privacy, accurate documentation, and continuous learning.

Company Offers:

  • Platinum PPO Healthcare + Vision & Dental (Henry covers 99% for employees and 50% for their qualified dependents).
  • 401(k) with matching contributions beginning your first day.
  • Unlimited PTO (target of 4 weeks), 6 floating holidays, and 4 company observed holidays.
  • Fully remote position with occasional travel.
  • Impactful, rewarding work as part of a fast-growing brand helping thousands of people every day.

 

Equal Opportunity Statement:

Henry Meds is committed to promoting an inclusive work environment free of discrimination and harassment. We value a diverse and balanced team where everyone can belong.

 

Applicants must be authorized to work for ANY employer in the U.S. We cannot sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment Visa at this time.

Salary Range: $23.00 - $25.00

This salary represents Henry Med's good faith and reasonable estimate of the possible compensation for this role at the time of posting, and Henry Meds may ultimately pay more or less than the posted salary. The final salary for this position will be determined by Henry Meds sole discretion, consistent with applicable law, and based on a variety of factors, including but not limited to the employee’s work experience, skills, and qualifications for the role, as well as the needs of Henry Meds business and other operational considerations.

3285eca5e066aff0.title: Founder Associate
3285eca5e066aff0.description:
Über YLAB

Wir bauen die KI, die wir unseren eigenen Kindern geben würden.

Kinder wachsen heute mit KI auf. Wir sorgen dafür, dass diese KI neugierig macht statt süchtig, sicher ist statt datenhungrig und für Kinder gebaut wird statt für Erwachsene.

Wir sind YLAB, ein kleines KI-Lab aus Köln-Ehrenfeld. Wir entwickeln Software und Hardware aus einer Hand, vom Sprachmodell bis zum Gehäuse. Unser erstes Produkt ist Onoo, ein Lernbegleiter ohne Bildschirm für Kinder ab vier. Onoo fragt zurück, lässt raten und denkt mit. Er hat keine Kamera und kein Display, zeigt keine Werbung und verkauft keine Daten.

Warum YLAB

Deine Arbeit landet im Kinderzimmer, nicht in einem Dashboard.

Software & Hardware: KI, App, Firmware und Gerät entstehen bei uns zusammen. Du siehst, wie aus Code etwas wird, das ein Kind in die Hand nimmt.

Du arbeitest an echten offenen Fragen, zum Beispiel wie KI Kinderstimmen versteht und Fünfjährigen die Welt erklärt.

Tech, Pädagogik und Forschung sitzen bei uns an einem Tisch.

Ehrlichkeit statt Hochglanz: Vieles bauen wir zum ersten Mal. Wenn dich das reizt, sollten wir reden.

Was wir bieten

  • Verantwortung ab Tag eins: Du bekommst echte Themen und Probleme statt Tickets, und deine Entscheidungen haben Gewicht.

  • Top Arbeitsmaterial: Du arbeitest mit dem Setup und den Tools, die du brauchst.

  • Flexible Weiterbildung: Konferenz, Kurs oder Workshop – du sagst uns, was dich weiterbringt.

  • Hybrid mit Herz: Remote, wenn du Ruhe brauchst, und im Office, wenn wir gemeinsam tüfteln.

Über die Rolle

Du arbeitest direkt mit den Gründern, näher dran geht nicht. Founder Associate heißt bei uns: Du bist die Feuerwehr. Wo es brennt, bist du zuerst da, egal ob Investor-Update, Prototypen-Logistik oder der Messestand am Freitag.

Dafür bekommst du den ehrlichsten Crashkurs in Company Building, den wir kennen: Du sitzt in den Entscheidungen, nicht im CC. Was du hier in einem Jahr siehst, sehen andere in fünf.

Geht in Vollzeit oder als Werkstudent:in. Uns ist egal, was auf deinem Vertrag steht, solange du Verantwortung willst.

Wie du uns helfen kannst

  • Du räumst weg, was die Gründer bremst: Recherchen, Entscheidungsvorlagen, Angebote, Ämterpost, Orga.

  • Du springst dahin, wo es gerade brennt, von Operations über Events bis zum Support für unsere Testfamilien.

  • Du bereitest Entscheidungen vor: Zahlen ziehen, Optionen sortieren, klare Empfehlung dazuschreiben.

  • Du baust kleine Prozesse und Tools, damit dasselbe Feuer nicht zweimal ausbricht.

  • Du hältst die Fäden zu Partnern und Lieferanten zusammen, wenn es schnell gehen muss.

Melde dich, wenn:

  • Du willst in einem Jahr mehr lernen als andere in fünf.

  • Du erledigst Dinge, bevor jemand fragt, ob sie schon erledigt sind.

  • Chaos macht dich nicht nervös. Du machst Listen draus.

  • Du schreibst klar und schnell, auf Deutsch und auf Englisch.

  • Du bist Generalist:in aus Überzeugung und lernst Neues schneller, als Stellenprofile es erlauben.

  • Du studierst noch oder bist gerade fertig? Passt. Erfahrung schlägt Etikett.

Eher nicht, wenn: du eine Jobbeschreibung brauchst, die stimmt. Deine ändert sich hier jede Woche. Oder wenn du Feuer lieber meldest, als es zu löschen.

a7051353b25ce97c.title: Praktikum AI & Automation – Virtual Power Plant (m/w/d)
a7051353b25ce97c.description:
Unser Ziel ist eine Solaranlage auf jedem Dach, ein Speicher in jedem Haus und ein E-Auto in jeder Garage. Enpal macht das möglich mit einer integrierten Gesamtlösung für dezentrale Energie – von Solaranlage und Batteriespeicher über Wallbox, Smart Meter bis zur Wärmepumpe. Herzstück ist unsere KI-gestützte Plattform Enpal.One+, die tausende Systeme intelligent vernetzt und Strombezug sowie -einspeisung effizient am Energiemarkt optimiert.

Omniwatt Energy ist die Strom-Unit von Enpal und macht saubere Energie für jeden Haushalt zugänglich – vom günstigsten Stromtarif Deutschlands bis hin zu intelligenten Energielösungen, die Erzeugung, Speicherung und Verbrauch optimal vernetzen.

Mit ambitionierten Wachstumszielen und einem schnell wachsenden Kundenstamm bauen wir ein Team, das den deutschen Energiemarkt aktiv mitgestaltet. Dabei verbinden wir Startup-Geschwindigkeit mit der Skalierung eines Marktführers – über alle Bereiche hinweg, von Operations und Technologie über Finance und Customer Support bis hin zu Produktentwicklung.

Deine Aufgaben

Als Praktikant:in im Tech Venture Development bei Enpal Energy arbeitest du an einer zentralen Frage: Wie können wir unser Geschäft mit smarter Technologie skalieren? Im Mittelpunkt steht unser Virtual Power Plant. Wir vernetzen Haushalte mit ihren Solaranlagen, Speichern und Wärmepumpen zu einem intelligenten Kraftwerk und handeln ihren Strom smart am Energiemarkt. Du arbeitest an der Schnittstelle von Business, Ops und Tech. Dabei bringst du AI-Lösungen, die unser virtuelles Kraftwerk skalierbar machen, vom Prototyp in den echten Betrieb.

  • Eigene Projekte: Du übernimmst End-to-End-Verantwortung für eigene Projekte, von der Problemanalyse über die Lösungsfindung bis zum Go-live.

  • AI Agents & Automatisierung: Du übersetzt Business Needs in konkrete Lösungen. Du baust Agents, Workflows und Automatisierungen mit No-Code-, Low-Code- und AI-Tools und bringst sie in den Betrieb.

  • Impact messbar machen: Du bereitest Daten auf, baust Dashboards und lieferst damit die Grundlage für Entscheidungen.

  • Zusammenarbeit: Du arbeitest eng mit verschiedenen Abteilungen zusammen, unter anderem Ops und Tech, und treibst Initiativen über Teamgrenzen hinweg voran.

Dein Profil

  • Du studierst an der Schnittstelle von Business und Tech, z. B. Wirtschaftsinformatik oder Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen, oder hast in Studium und Praktika beide Welten kennengelernt.

  • Du hast mindestens ein relevantes Praktikum abgeschlossen, z. B. in einem Start-up, in der Beratung oder im Venture Building.

  • Du arbeitest gern mit Tools wie Claude, Cursor, Airtable, Make, n8n, Power BI, Snowflake oder SQL oder arbeitest dich schnell in neue Technologien ein.

  • Du denkst analytisch und findest pragmatische Lösungen, die auf Fakten beruhen.

  • Du übernimmst Ownership und wartest nicht auf perfekte Rahmenbedingungen.

  • Du kommunizierst sicher auf Deutsch und Englisch.

  • Du bist mindestens 4 Monate verfügbar.

Du bist interessiert, auch wenn du nicht alle Anforderungen erfüllst? Bewirb dich trotzdem! Wir freuen uns darauf, dein Potenzial zu entdecken - unabhängig davon, ob deine Erfahrung jede einzelne Voraussetzung erfüllt. ☀️

Darauf kannst Du Dich freuen

  • Arbeite in Deutschlands erstem grünen Unicorn - Gestalte aktiv die solare Energiewende mit.

  • Die Sonne scheint auf der ganzen Welt - Bei Enpal arbeitest du mit einem hochmotivierten, diversen Team aus über 65 Nationalitäten.

  • Grown-up Business & Startup Spirit - In unserem modernen Office in Berlin-Friedrichshain findest du von höhenverstellbaren Tischen, Tischtennisplatte bis gefüllten Getränkekühlschränken und Barista-Coffee alles was das Herz begehrt.

  • Dein Kick-start bei Enpal - Onboarding-Tag mit Welcome Bag, Buddy-Programm und einem Team, das dich wirklich abholt.

  • Bleib auf dem Laufenden & gestalte mit - Transparente All-Hands, kurze Entscheidungswege und eine offene Feedback-Kultur, denn ohne Fehler gibt es keinen Fortschritt.

  • Energiewende geht nur gemeinsam - Bei Enpal erwartet dich ein legendärer Teamspirit und unvergessliche Team- und Companyevents.

  • Dein Extra-Boost - 20 + 2 Urlaubstage, vergünstigte Mitgliedschaft bei Wellhub und Corporate Benefits. Alles, was dir hilft, Arbeit und Leben gut zu verbinden.

10c7b8ba4f344724.title: Head of Solutions Engineering - DACH & Nordics
10c7b8ba4f344724.description:
Head of Solutions Engineering - DACH & Nordics

About Neural Concept

Engineering is at an inflection point. The teams defining the next generation of aircraft, electric vehicles, and consumer products are not just designing faster, they are designing fundamentally differently, with AI embedded at the core of their workflows.

Neural Concept builds the Engineering AI platform that makes this possible. We help the world's leading engineering teams accelerate development, improve product outcomes, and scale engineering capacity, turning months of simulation into days, and engineering intuition into data-driven insight.

We work with elite engineering teams in Automotive, Aerospace, High-Tech and Electronics, and advanced manufacturing, where the stakes are high, the complexity is rising, and the pressure to innovate has never been greater. We are changing how engineers work. Come build that future with us.

About the Role

This is a high-bar role for a leader who has operated in technically complex, high-stakes environments and is ready to take on a larger mandate.

As the Head of Solutions Engineering (DACH & Nordics), you will lead the technical direction of NC’s most important customer engagements across the region. You will uncover the problems worth solving, shape AI transformation roadmaps, and turn technical possibility into a credible path to adoption.

You will also build and develop the regional Solutions Engineering team, setting the standard for technical consulting and raising the quality of every engagement.

What You’ll Do

  • Lead discovery with engineering and executive stakeholders, turning complex challenges into clear technical strategies.

  • Define customer-specific AI roadmaps connected to real engineering priorities.

  • Shape and co-own technically rigorous Statements of Work, grounded in customer workflows, data, and adoption plans.

  • Build, coach, and lead the regional Solutions Engineering team, managing standards, capacity, and complex escalations.

  • Partner with Sales and Forward Deployed Engineering to move from technical strategy into delivery.

  • Bring customer insight back to Product and R&D.

Who You Are

You have built credibility by taking responsibility for difficult problems and finding a way forward when the obvious path fails.

  • You have an engineering background with deep familiarity with CAD, CAE, simulation, and real engineering workflows.

  • You earn trust with simulation engineers and executive leaders because you understand their problems and communicate with precision.

  • You create structure in ambiguity, challenge assumptions, and move complex work forward with urgency.

  • You are a proven people leader who builds strong teams, gives direct feedback, and raises the bar.

  • You have 8+ years of experience in solutions engineering, technical consulting, pre-sales, or a related client-facing role.

  • You are professionally fluent in German and English.

What Will Set You Apart

  • Hands-on experience across the simulation workflow, from CAD through post-processing and automation.

  • Strong Python skills and experience with ML or deep learning workflows through deployment.

  • The ability to conduct technical discovery at a level respected by simulation engineers.

  • Experience building end-to-end engineering workflow prototypes.

  • Experience shaping enterprise transformation programs or leading Solutions Engineering teams.

What You Get

  • Work with a world-class technology team: our engineers are top-notch, and we always aim for excellence.

  • Benefit from a competitive salary and rewarding opportunities as we continue to scale.

  • Thrive in a collaborative, multicultural environment where your work is visible and recognized.

  • Develop professionally alongside talented colleagues who share knowledge freely and support one another.

  • Make a global impact by helping customers shift to AI-assisted design, making innovation faster, smarter, and more sustainable.

  • Balance life and work with a hybrid model and flexible hours—we care about results, not rigid schedules.

We're proud to be an equal opportunity employer, and we're committed to building a diverse and inclusive environment where you can thrive.

dcc59616624480dc.title: Senior Engineering Manager, Product Engineering
dcc59616624480dc.description:
Location: Remote (EMEA) · Germany/Munich preferred - CET/CEST time zone

Hi — I'm Grigory, co-founder and CTO at Secfix.

At Secfix we're building security compliance systems for teams and agents to become and stay compliant with less effort. We're already the category leader in Europe. AI is changing how software gets built, and we're shaping the tools this new era requires.

I've spent most of my career believing that the best engineering leaders aren't the ones who run the most meetings. They're the ones who make everyone around them faster, clearer, and more proud of their work — and they can do that because they've been through the hard technical problems themselves.

Since we started, I've done the engineering management myself: 1:1s, hiring, design reviews, performance conversations. The team is 8 engineers and 2 product designers, and I'm spread across too many things. If we were a football team, we'd be a good regional side that just made it to the Bundesliga — talented, hard-working, winning quite a few games. Now we need a coach who's played at Champions League level and can take us there to win every week.

That means a strong engineering manager who can still ship. Someone who owns the technical decisions, sets the pace, and has product taste — who notices when a feature takes three weeks that should take one, and when it ships on time but isn't good enough. You won't ship weekly — you'll need focus — but you'll build with the team often enough to know the playbook still works.

You'll work directly with me. Two things matter most here: speed and taste. Most teams pick one. We need both to win.

— Grigory


Why Secfix exists

Over 1.78 million SMBs in Europe need to comply with security frameworks — ISO 27001, GDPR, TISAX, SOC 2 — just to sell to enterprise customers. The process is manual, painful, and takes over a year. We automated it.

Our platform integrates with a company's full tech stack — AWS, Azure AD, Jira, GitLab, GCP, and more — automatically extracts compliance evidence, and guides teams to certification in weeks instead of months. Our fastest customer was certified in 4 weeks instead of the industry-standard 12+ months.

We've raised €17M in total (€12M Series A), backed by Alstin Capital, Neosfer (Commerzbank), and Bayern Capital. We're on a profitable trajectory, growing fast, and building the team that will take us to own European market from SMBs to mid market.

This space is not threatened by AI; it's amplified by it. Compliance requires deep domain expertise combined with automation. Our new AI product (CISO AI) is just getting started, and there's a huge amount of engineering work ahead: agentic workflows, intelligent evidence collection, context-aware policy generation, and more.


What you'll actually do in the first 3 months

This isn't a role where you show up and start running standups. There are no standups. Here's how the first quarter goes:

Month 1: Ship. Get into the codebase and ship a meaningful feature with AI alongside the team. You don't need to be the fastest engineer in the room, but the team needs to see that you can build at the level you'll ask of them and can ask the right questions.

Month 2: Make the team faster. Find where features take three weeks that should take one, and fix it — in tooling, in how we review and test, or in who's working on what. Start regular 1:1s with each engineer, focused on weekly output, quality, and how well they use AI.

Month 3: Own hiring. Take over engineering interviews and build a process that runs without my oversight. Design the technical challenges, run the screens, make the calls. The next people we bring in should raise the pace again. I will be there but switch my focus to final interviews.


What will the role look like beyond the first 3 months?

After the first quarter, the job is management and the technical decisions. You own how the team builds: how engineers test, how they review each other's code and security, how the team is organised, and who we hire next. We're 8 engineers and 2 product designers today and plan to be around 16 within 12 months — most of that hiring is yours to run.

You won't ship weekly, but you'll build something with the team now and then, because that's how you know the playbook still gets things out the door. Our CS and Sales leaders work the same way — they still own a small slice of the IC work, so they have skin in the game.

Here's what you'll be close to in the next months:

  • Speed. You’ll refine our software development processes to keep the team operating at high velocity. Cycle time from spec to production is your number and accountability. Tooling, review flow, how work is split, who's on what — whatever moves it.

  • Quality. Improve how engineers test and automate, how they review each other's code and security changes, and how the zero-bug policy survives a team of 20.

  • Team and hiring. Team structure, growth conversations, the hiring process, and eventually the next manager.

  • AI in the craft — and in the management. Engineers already work with an established set of encoded skills and rules — there's a whole playbook; you keep pushing that. Same for your own work: hiring, 1:1s, the recurring stuff.

What success looks like

At 6 months: The hiring process runs without me, and we've added 2 engineers through it. Sales, CS, and product all feel the difference in how fast we ship — and in quality. Our agentic engineering playbook is noticeably better because of you — you’ve added or rewritten the skills, rules, and AI review checks the team uses every day, and you lead by example in how you ship with agents.

At 12 months: The team is around 12-16, the zero-bug policy is still holding at that size, and I'm not in the engineering critical path anymore. You've found and/or coached the EM Nr. 2 to support growth.


How we work

We've written in depth about our engineering culture. Here's the short version — read the full articles linked below if you want the real picture.

  • Focus is sacred. Engineers are in fewer than 2 hours of meetings per week. We write before we meet. We use Loom for async walkthroughs, Notion for specs, Gather for pairing, and Slack only for what's urgent or lightweight. We don't do status theatre. We wrote about our thoughtful communication and our remote culture; give it a read.

    To drive it home, here's a recent calendar of an engineer who has been with us for over a year:

  • Small, temporary teams. A designer and two engineers. A backend engineer and a CS person. The group forms around the problem, ships, and dissolves. No standing squads, no permanent team structures — at least not yet. The people closest to the problem usually shape the solution.

  • AI is already part of the craft. We use Claude for product design exploration and spec drafting. Engineers work in Cursor with encoded skills and rules that live in the codebase — component patterns, folder structure, architecture choices, and the path from Figma to Angular code. AI checks code against architecture rules before human review. We have a dedicated design QA skill that compares Figma against coded output. We don't use AI to lower the bar; we use it to reach the bar faster with more iterations behind us. In case you’re interested, we wrote a piece about it here.

  • Zero-bugs. We take this seriously - this helps us to gain customer trust faster. Especially serious customer-facing problems don't sit in a backlog competing with roadmap work. Critical issues get fixed immediately. High-severity within 48 hours. Every bug has an owner. Weekly quality review as part of Monday planning. Quality as identity, in compliance, being correct isn't a nice-to-have; it's the entire value proposition. We care about edge cases, data integrity, and getting the details right. Customers notice the speed and polish before they can name it. That kind of quality builds trust. In our category, trust is the product.

  • We build what customers need, not what they ask for. Customer feedback is signal, not instructions. Best products are built by people with great taste who treat feedback as signals, not KPIs. We stay close to customers — CS check-ins, support tickets, Mixpanel events, onboarding calls — but none of these sources makes the decision for us.

This role is for you if:

  • You've managed a real team and made it ship faster. You've hired for it, run the hard conversations, and know what breaks as it grows — and you can point to where cycle time dropped because of you.

  • You know what great engineers look like. You've thought deeply about what makes them productive, what holds them back, and how to move them forward — and you can spot one in a single interview.

  • You have an exceptional IC track record before becoming a manager. You were a senior/principal engineer before you started managing — you didn't skip into management early because coding wasn't working out.

  • You have product taste. You notice when a feature ships on time but isn't good enough, and you say so.

  • You hold people to a high standard. You're comfortable giving direct feedback and having hard conversations about performance.

  • You're hands-on with AI-assisted development. You've used Cursor and Claude Code in real production work, not just toy projects. You have opinions about how AI changes the engineering workfl

Legora is redefining how legal work gets done. Not built for lawyers, built with them. We work alongside the world’s best legal teams, who expect excellence, precision, and speed, and we hold ourselves to the same bar.

  • We fight for excellence: high standards, direct, ego-free feedback.

  • 2+ years of experience in management consulting, sales or operations, or a commercial role in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.

  • Strong analytical instincts and comfort working with data, dashboards, and metrics.

  • Comfort engaging and communicating with senior stakeholders on complex commercial, technical, and strategic topics.

  • A proactive, low ego mindset, you take ownership, ask smart questions, and get things done.

  • Comfort working cross-functionally with Sales, Marketing, Product, and Customer Success.

f409e4d41e7c0a6e.title: Delivery Manager - Generation Flex
f409e4d41e7c0a6e.description:
Help us use technology to make a big green dent in the universe!

Kraken powers some of the most innovative global developments in energy.

We create the technology that redefines utilities and unlocks a new energy system of the future. By optimising renewable generation, building a more intelligent grid, and empowering utilities to deliver an exceptional customer experience, our operating system is transforming the industry worldwide.

It’s an incredibly exciting time to work in energy. Join us on our mission to improve the lives of ONE BILLION humans within the decade and shape a cleaner, better future for everyone.

Kraken Generation Flex
The energy industry is undergoing the largest transformation since industrialisation at an unprecedented rate of change and we are positioning ourselves to be at the heart of that change.

Our aim is to be the leading global provider of solutions that enable customers to release £30bn of value per annum from distributed energy resources (DERs). We are building a Software as a Service (SaaS) subscription business with a global addressable market of £2.4 billion per annum, by digitally connecting hundreds of thousands of DERs with energy markets.

We have already attained a market leading position and Kraken is a recognised thought leader and innovator in the industry.

🏠 Where you'll fit in:

As we enter a stage of rapid commercialisation and growth, we're looking for a Generation Flex Delivery Manager to own the successful onboarding of flexible generation and energy assets onto KrakenFlex across the EU with a focus on Germany.

This is a customer-facing delivery role with a strong technical bias. You'll manage an asset through the full onboarding journey, from initial discovery and technical analysis, through site design and gateway installation, to commissioning, testing and handover into live service.

You'll sit at the intersection of our customers, Electrical Engineering, Product and Customer Success Engineering teams. You'll need to understand both the connectivity and control architecture of our customers' assets and how those assets connect to and operate through the KrakenFlex SaaS platform.

You won't be expected to design the details of the integration solution or write the software yourself. Instead, you'll need enough technical depth across both areas to understand how they fit together, identify gaps and risks, challenge incomplete information and drive the right conversations to get a site successfully integrated.

Your role is to bring together three perspectives throughout onboarding:

Customer: What is the customer trying to achieve, and what do we need from them?

Product: How will the asset operate within KrakenFlex, and what product capabilities and configuration are required?

Engineering: How does the physical asset need to be integrated, connected and commissioned to make that solution work?

Your job is to make sure those three come together as one successfully delivered customer solution.

🚀 What you'll own:

  • Own the end-to-end onboarding and delivery of Generation Flex assets BESS (grid-scale and C&I) and RES (Wind and Solar), from initial onboarding through analysis, site design, installation, configuration, commissioning, testing and handover into live service.

  • Build a strong understanding of the Generation Flex product and SaaS platform, including how assets are represented, configured, monitored and controlled within KrakenFlex.

  • Understand how the physical site and its electrical/control systems connect into the KrakenFlex software architecture, and bring those two worlds together throughout onboarding.

  • Work closely with Product and Software Engineering teams to understand the relevant GenFlex capabilities, product modules, configuration requirements and technical constraints for each customer and asset.

  • Translate between customer requirements, electrical engineering requirements and SaaS/product requirements, making sure each group understands what is needed from the others.

  • Understand the end-to-end data and control path from the physical asset through site controls, meters, PPCs, gateways and communications infrastructure into Kraken Flex, and from Kraken Flex back to the asset where control is required.

  • Ensure that the customer's intended use of the GenFlex product is reflected in the technical onboarding solution, including the required telemetry, controls, configuration, integrations and product modules.

  • Be able to explain to customers how their site will interact with KrakenFlex, both from a physical integration perspective and from a software/product perspective.

  • Work with Product teams to identify where customer or asset requirements do not fit current product capabilities, and ensure gaps, constraints or product dependencies are surfaced early.

  • Feed recurring onboarding challenges, customer requirements and technical integration pain points back into Product and Engineering teams to help improve and scale the GenFlex proposition.

  • Be the primary delivery point of contact for customers during site onboarding, setting clear expectations around what we need from them, what Kraken is delivering and what needs to happen next.

  • Work closely with our Electrical Engineering and Customer Success Engineering teams to ensure the technical information required to integrate a site is complete, accurate and available at the right stage of delivery.

  • Review and interpret customer technical documentation including:

    • Electrical Single Line Diagrams (SLDs)

    • Network and communications diagrams

    • Site and asset specifications

    • PPC and controller documentation

    • Modbus register maps

    • IP addressing and network information

    • Functional Design Specifications

    • Metering and telemetry information

    • Hardware and connectivity requirements

  • Be confident discussing technical site architecture with customers and engineers, understanding how equipment such as generators, batteries, meters, PPCs, controllers, gateways and site networks fit together.

  • Identify missing, inconsistent or technically unclear customer information early and drive it to resolution before it becomes a delivery blocker.

  • Coordinate the preparation and review of Kraken integration documentation, including gateway architecture, communications diagrams, Kraken SLDs, integration designs and site configuration information.

  • Coordinate the Kraken Gateway delivery and installation process, ensuring prerequisites such as power, networking, connectivity and installation arrangements are understood and ready.

  • Manage readiness for key commissioning and testing activities, including:

    • Gateway installation and connectivity

    • Operational acceptance testing

    • Kraken market and service testing

  • Proactively manage delivery risks and communicate issues and mitigation plans clearly to internal and external stakeholders.

  • Surface blockers early and drive the right people together to resolve them rather than allowing issues to sit between teams.

  • Maintain clear visibility of the status and health of each site, including technical readiness, product readiness, customer actions, Kraken actions and upcoming milestones.

  • Continuously improve the Generation Flex onboarding process, identifying recurring technical, product or customer blockers and working with Engineering, Product and Operations teams to remove them.

🧠 What you'll bring to the party:

  • A strong technical background and the confidence to work closely with electrical, control systems, and networking.

  • A practical understanding of industrial networking and communications, including concepts such as IP addressing, LANs, routers, switches, VPNs and site connectivity.

  • Enough electrical engineering knowledge to understand concepts such as metering, breakers, transformers, generators, inverters, batteries and asset control systems.

  • Experience delivering technical projects involving the integration, commissioning or onboarding of physical assets, ideally within energy, renewables, utilities, industrial automation, controls or a similar environment.

  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to take a complicated technical problem and clearly explain the issue, impact, owner and next action.

  • A customer-centric mindset and a drive to provide an outstanding onboarding experience without compromising technical quality.

  • A pragmatic, collaborative approach and the confidence to operate in a fast-moving environment where processes and products are still evolving.

bcaa346c049130f1.title: Director - Business Development
bcaa346c049130f1.description:
ABOUT ROCKET LAB

Rocket Lab is the end-to-end space company building rockets, spacecraft, and critical subsystems that keep the world connected, protected, expand humanity's reach to the Moon, Mars, and beyond. We move fast, build real hardware for meaningful missions, and make the impossible routine. Come shape the future with us.

SPACE SYSTEMS

At Rocket Lab, we're not just launching rockets — we're building the future of space. Our Space Systems team builds everything from complete spacecraft, precision payloads to the components and subsystems that allow them to thrive in space, like solar panels, flight software, star trackers, optical systems, separation systems, radios, and more. 

Our Space Systems team has enabled more than 1,700 missions, ranging from interplanetary exploration, in-space manufacturing to national security and defense initiatives. The team has built spacecraft, payloads, and components for missions to the Moon and Mars, working with partners including NASA, the Space Development Agency, and the U.S. Space Force. Whether it's a single high-performance spacecraft, constellation, or the vertically integrated components that help them get to space — our world class Space Systems team is empowering some of the boldest and most ambitious space missions.  

DIRECTOR - BUSINESS DEVELOPMENT, SPACE SYSTEMS  

Based in Munich, Germany, as the Director - Business Development, you will drive Rocket Lab's growth in the European satellite market, with a primary focus on Germany and strategic opportunities across Europe. You will work with a range of customers, including government, defense, civil space, commercial, and prime contractor organizations, with a particular focus on national security and sovereign European space capabilities. Your role will involve identifying and engaging with potential clients, developing strategic partnerships, and leading efforts to secure contracts that expand our market share in this rapidly growing sector.

WHAT YOU'LL GET TO DO:

  • Lead business development initiatives focused on satellite solutions for defense, national security, civil space, and commercial applications across Germany and Europe
  • Develop and execute capture strategies for securing large defense, civil space, and government contracts, including opportunities with German and European government agencies, defense organizations, space institutions, and prime contractors
  • Engage with key customer stakeholders, government officials, policymakers, and industry leaders to build and maintain long-term relationships, ensuring Rocket Lab's solutions align with their evolving mission requirements and strategic priorities
  • Develop and maintain relationships across the German and European space and defense ecosystem, including government organizations, prime contractors, industry partners, and relevant European institutions
  • Collaborate closely with Government Affairs and cross-functional teams to support market expansion, customer engagement, and pursuit of government-funded programs
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to prepare and deliver compelling proposals that meet customer requirements and win new business
  • Monitor German and European industry trends, government priorities, procurement initiatives, policy developments, and competitor activities to inform and adapt our business development strategies
  • Grow existing business opportunities and nurture relationships with existing customers to develop additional business opportunities
  • Create new business opportunities and relationships by presenting Rocket Lab's capabilities/experience to provide satellite solutions – including bus offerings and complete satellites to meet mission requirements
  • Identify and pursue opportunities associated with European sovereign space and defense capabilities, dual-use technologies, and evolving European procurement priorities
  • Lead and/or participate in proposal activities, including generation of technical, management, cost, schedule, and proposal content for new business
  • Develop strong relationships across all levels of the business to ensure alignment, efficiency, and collaboration, including coordinating with stakeholders across Business Development, Government Affairs, Engineering, Program Management, and Operations
  • Represent Rocket Lab at industry conferences, government forums, industry associations, and customer meetings across Germany and Europe
  • Build awareness of relevant European government programs and procurement pathways, including opportunities involving ESA, the European Union, EUSPA, the European Defense Agency, DLR, and German defense and space organizations 
  • Support Rocket Lab's positioning within the evolving European space and defense landscape, including launch sovereignty, European sovereign capability, dual-use technology, and defense modernization priorities
  • Develop an understanding of relevant export control and regulatory considerations affecting Rocket Lab's ability to pursue European opportunities, including ITAR/EAR and applicable German and European requirements
  • Travel as needed for business opportunities, customer meetings, industry events, and capture activities
  • Other duties as assigned or required

YOU'LL BRING THESE QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Bachelor's degree in engineering or other technical discipline
  • 12+ years of experience in business development, program management, or systems engineering within the aerospace, space, defense, or related technology sector
  • In-depth knowledge of government acquisition processes, government contracting, and the national security landscape within Germany and/or Europe
  • Proven track record of securing large (>$20M) contracts and managing strategic relationships within the aerospace, space, or defense industry
  • Demonstrated experience building and managing relationships with senior government officials, defense organizations, policymakers, prime contractors, and other public- and private-sector stakeholders
  • Professional fluency in German and English
  • Strong understanding of German and European defense priorities, civil space programs, government procurement processes, and the broader European space and defense ecosystem
  • Ability to support frequent domestic and international travel (up to 50%) to meet with clients, attend industry events, and support capture efforts
  • Ability to obtain and maintain any required German or European security clearance, if applicable to assigned programs

THESE QUALIFICATIONS WOULD BE NICE TO HAVE:

  • Master's degree in aerospace engineering or related engineering field; or business
  • Specialization in German or European government business development, with deep experience selling to German or European national security, defense, civil space, or government customers
  • Demonstrable record of success in business development, sales, program management and/or engineering of satellite systems, payloads, or platforms
  • Extensive awareness of current and ongoing German and European government national security, defense, civil space, and satellite programs
  • Experience working with or within organizations such as DLR, Bundeswehr, BAAINBw, German federal government entities, ESA, EUSPA, the European Defense Agency, EU defense bodies, NATO, or other European space and defense institutions
  • Experience pursuing European government-funded programs and navigating German or EU defense and space procurement pathways
  • Familiarity with European sovereign space and defense initiatives, including the European Defense Fund (EDF), European Defense Industry Program (EDIP), EU Space Program initiatives, and related European defense modernization priorities
  • Familiarity with NATO space and defense structures and European security and resilience priorities
  • Understanding of export control regimes and regulatory considerations relevant to European business development, including ITAR/EAR and German/EU requirements
  • Excellent verbal and written communication and presentation skills in both German and English
  • Experience leading, managing, and growing geographically dispersed teams on fast-paced projects
  • Proficient in all Microsoft Suite products, including MS Project
  • General knowledge of industry specific technical requirements and quality requirements
  • Experience using customer relationship management (CRM) software
  • Experience with proposal development, writing, and best practice capture processes, and ability to independently complete cost and technical proposals
  • Experience working with subject matter experts to collect and create compelling proposal content and detailed responses

WHAT TO EXPECT 

We're on a mission to unlock the potential of space to improve life on Earth, but that's not an easy task. It takes hard work, determination, relentless innovation, teamwork, grit, and an unwavering commitment to achieving what others often deem impossible. Our people out-think, out-work, and out-pace. 5abe673c329943dd.title: Operations Intern - Renewable Supply
5abe673c329943dd.description:
Operations Intern - Renewable Supply

Festanstellung, Vollzeit · Berlin (HQ)

Unsere Mission für dich

Gestalte mit uns die nachhaltige Energieversorgung von morgen und werde Teil unseres wachsenden Operations-Teams! trawa baut Europas führende B2B-Plattform für saubere Energie auf. Unsere Mission ist es, Industriekunden mit nachhaltigen Energielösungen zu versorgen. Mit einem innovativen Ansatz, der Energieversorgung, fortschrittliche Energiemanagementsoftware und intelligente Optimierung von Energieverbrauchsdiensten kombiniert, helfen wir Unternehmen dabei, erfolgreich zu bleiben und den Weg in eine klimafreundliche Energiezukunft zu ebnen.

Das Team

Du wirst Teil eines kleinen, eingespielten Onboarding-Teams mit vier Personen. Als Teil des Business Operations Departments arbeitest du in einem Bereich mit insgesamt rund 20 Kolleginnen und Kollegen, zu dem auch das Customer Success Team gehört. Im Alltag verbindet uns eine enge, cross-funktionale Zusammenarbeit, mit der wir gemeinsam die bestmöglichen Ergebnisse für unsere Kunden erzielen. Wir unterstützen uns gegenseitig, denken mit und packen gemeinsam an. Gleichzeitig pflegen wir eine Teamkultur, die über den Arbeitsalltag hinausgeht – und eine Company Culture, auf die wir wirklich stolz sind.

Als Operations Intern (m/w/d) spielst du eine Schlüsselrolle im Aufbau von Prozessen und Strukturen eines aufstrebenden und schnell wachsenden Technologie-Startups. Wir stellen fortlaufend für eine Praktikumsdauer von 3–6 Monaten ein.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Ownership für operative Prozesse: Du führst entscheidende operative Aufgaben in Eigenverantwortung durch und trägst dazu bei, dass unsere Organisation in allen Kernbereichen reibungslos läuft.

  • Automatisierung von Prozessen: Du entwickelst Ansätze zur Effizienzsteigerung und Automatisierung von Prozessschritten.

  • Begleitung beim Onboarding: Du unterstützt bei der Einführung unserer Neukund:innen in das trawa-Universum und sorgst für eine exzellente Kundenerfahrung.

  • Beitrag zur Weiterentwicklung der Organisation: Du gestaltest Prozesse aktiv mit und hilfst uns dabei, als Unternehmen weiter wachsen zu können.

  • Daten im Blick behalten: Du übernimmst die Datenpflege in unseren Systemen (z. B. CRM) und stellst durch sorgfältige Arbeit eine hohe Datenqualität sicher.

Nach wem wir suchen

  • Du bist Student:in, im Bachelor-Studium, Gap Year, Master-Studium oder Absolvent:in mit guten akademischen Leistungen.

  • Erste praktische Erfahrungen in Startups, anderen schnelllebigen Umfeldern oder der Energiewirtschaft sind ein starkes Plus.

  • Du denkst analytisch, fühlst dich wohl im Analysieren von Zahlen und kommunizierst datenbasierte Erkenntnisse sicher.

  • Organisationstalent zeichnet dich aus – du arbeitest strukturiert, behältst den Überblick und kannst Aufgaben effizient priorisieren.

  • Du besitzt eine generelle Affinität für digitale Tools wie z. B. CRM-Systeme, Notion, Google Workspace oder n8n.

Deine ersten 90 Tage:

Die ersten sechs Wochen – Orientierung und Einarbeitung

  • Lerne unsere Prozesse kennen – vom internen Handover der Neukunden von Sales, über die Anmeldung von Lieferstellen bis hin zur Marktkommunikation im komplexen Energiemarkt.

  • Mache dich mit den wichtigsten Tools, Systemen sowie internen und externen Ansprechpartnern vertraut, die beim Onboarding unserer Neukunden eine Rolle spielen.

  • Führe deine ersten Kunden-Onboardings eigenständig durch: Stelle die „Handover-Readiness" durch Sales sicher, richte das Kundenportal ein, initiiere den Kundenkontakt, melde Lieferstellen an und löse Probleme in der Marktkommunikation.

Bis zum dritten Monat – Verantwortung übernehmen und Prozesse weiterentwickeln

  • Übernimm Kunden-Onboardings eigenständig und verantworte Timelines sowie die Kommunikation mit allen Beteiligten.

  • Entwickle ein belastbares Verständnis für Marktkommunikationsprozesse und werde zur verlässlichen Ansprechperson bei Problemen in deinem Bereich.

  • Erkenne wiederkehrende Muster in typischen Fehlern und bring eigene Ideen ein, um unsere Onboarding-Prozesse gezielt zu verbessern.

Warum wir?

Gestalte mit uns die Zukunft der Energiewirtschaft und treibe eigenverantwortlich Projekte voran, die echten Einfluss haben – auf unsere Produkte, unsere Kundinnen und Kunden und die Umwelt. Das erwartet dich bei uns:

  • Dein Impact: Du übernimmst Verantwortung in unserem dynamischen Team und gestaltest aktiv innovative Produkte, die die Energiewende vorantreiben und zur Dekarbonisierung des Mittelstandes beitragen.

  • Flexibles Arbeiten: In unserem schönen Office fördern wir eine lebendige Unternehmenskultur. Homeoffice ist ebenfalls eine Option. Mit flexiblen Arbeitszeiten, 30 Urlaubstagen und 10 Tagen Workation unterstützen wir deine Work-Life-Balance.

  • Attraktive Benefits: Neben einem wettbewerbsfähigen Gehalt erhältst du Essensgutscheine, eine Urban Sports-Mitgliedschaft, reichlich kostenlose Snacks und ein persönliches Produktivitätsbudget.

  • Persönliche Entwicklung: Du bist Teil eines tollen Teams, wo Coaching und Mentoring groß geschrieben wird, und arbeitest mit Spitzentechnologien und lernst von Branchenexpert:innen.

  • Vielfalt & Inklusion: Bei uns sind alle willkommen – wir engagieren uns für einen integrativen Arbeitsplatz, der Vielfalt wertschätzt. Wir ermutigen Menschen unterschiedlichen Geschlechts, Alters, sexueller Orientierung, ethnischer Zugehörigkeit, sozialer Herkunft und körperlicher oder neurodiverser Vielfalt zur Bewerbung.

Über uns

Willkommen im trawa-Universum! Wir haben es uns zur Aufgabe gemacht, das grüne Versorgungsunternehmen der Zukunft von Grund auf aufzubauen. Wir schaffen einen direkten Zugang zu erneuerbarer Energie für B2B-Industrieunternehmen, entwickeln Software und Technologie, um die Volatilität des Energiemarktes zu bewältigen, und professionalisieren die Energiebeschaffung auf der Käuferseite.

f018d72090919f73.description:
Director of Laser Engineering (m/f/d)

Location: Darmstadt, Germany
Travel: Approximately 20%

About Focused Energy

Focused Energy is building the engineering organization and laser systems needed for laser-driven fusion energy. We bring together specialists across laser engineering and adjacent teams to tackle a complex, long-term technology challenge.

The opportunity

As Director of Laser Engineering, you will own the delivery of our laser functions at fusion machine and system level. You will lead a team of managers and technical leaders, , establish a single technology and functional roadmap, ensuring coherence of the sub-functions, , and build the operating practices that help the organization scale from individual expertise to coordinated industrial engineering.

You will connect immediate technical priorities to long-term FPP goals, make sure technology risks have clear owners and retirement plans, and represent Laser Engineering in technical reviews and executive-level forums. The role has a global scope, with most of the team and work based in the Darmstadt area.

What you will do

  • Own and maintain the technology and functional roadmap of the laser function, linking critical work to long-term system goals.

  • Lead and develop a team of five direct reports and a broader organization of 15+ indirect FTEs and students; delegate outcomes, coach managers, and build leadership capacity; scale the team by a factor 2-3x in the next 12 months. .

  • Establish clear ownership, decision rights, technical review processes and practical operating rhythms as the organization scales.

  • Steer partnerships and outsourcing strategies for laser technology development. Act as an escalation step in those relationships.

  • Build a current picture of technology maturity, dependencies, gate reviews, and technical risks; maintain a risk register and drive actions that retire risks systematically.

  • Strengthen technical documentation and working practices so that important context is visible, maintained, and usable across teams.

  • Lead system-level architecture discussions by testing assumptions, weighing evidence and trade-offs, and surfacing gaps or decision points.

  • Work closely with Laser Systems Engineering, Program, Lab Infrastructure, Digital Twin, Supply Chain, and the Reactor team to maintain alignment and resolve cross-functional issues; work closely with Legal and business development on IP strategy. .

  • Represent the function at fusion-machine-wide technical review meetings and executive forums, communicating outcomes, risks, and decisions clearly.

What you bring

  • A technical background in engineering, physics, photonics, or a related discipline, gained through a relevant degree or equivalent experience.

  • Proven experience leading managers or senior technical leaders. You have developed leaders, not only managed projects or individual contributors.

  • A record of building and delivering technology or engineering roadmaps in a complex environment.

  • Strong first-principles reasoning: you can challenge expert views constructively, separate data-backed conclusions from assumptions, and make sound decisions when information is incomplete.

  • Experience managing technical risks, dependencies, and cross-functional delivery.

  • Clear, concise, outcome-focused communication with senior and technical audiences.

  • High EQ, adaptability, and comfort working in an organization where priorities and structures may evolve.

  • Willingness to maintain a consistent presence in the Darmstadt area and travel approximately 20%. Full relocation is welcome but not required; the on-site cadence can be agreed with the team.

  • Fluent English. German is a plus, not a requirement.

  • Experience in laser engineering, photonics, or complex hardware—or building structure in a scaling organization—is a plus, but not required. A PhD is not required.


Focused Energy is an equal opportunity employer committed to creating an inclusive environment. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender perception or identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, or disability status.

Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, Focused Energy will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

Compensation offered will be determined by factors such as location, level, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Certain roles may be eligible for incentive compensation, equity, benefits.

fa09679ac722cb3a.title: PMO Operations Specialist (f/m/d)
fa09679ac722cb3a.description:
About Focused Energy

Focused Energy is building the future of clean energy through laser-driven inertial fusion. Backed by our $240M Series A - the largest fully secured Series A in the global fusion industry we are scaling rapidly across multiple geographies.

Based in Germany and the US, we have brought together the top scientific and engineering minds using proven technologies to unlock fusion power at commercial scale. Focused Energy is working to realize game-changing scientific innovation that promises to deliver a clean, sustainable and abundant source of power globally.

Your Role

As a PMO Operations Specialist, you'll play a central role in building and running the operational foundation of our growing Project Management Office (PMO). Working closely with the PMO Lead, you'll turn newly developed processes into practical, well-documented ways of working that are consistently adopted across dozens of active initiatives.

You'll own the day-to-day operating rhythm of the PMO, from weekly project reporting and portfolio data quality to project lead onboarding, training, and process improvement. You'll work across teams, including scientists, engineers, and project leads, helping make project management processes simple, effective, and accessible to everyone.

Focused Energy is building the future of clean energy through laser-driven inertial fusion. Backed by our $240M Series A — the largest fully secured Series A in the global fusion industry — we are scaling rapidly across multiple geographies.

Based in Germany and the US, we have brought together the top scientific and engineering minds using proven technologies to unlock fusion power at commercial scale. Focused Energy is working to realize game-changing scientific innovation that promises to deliver a clean, sustainable and abundant source of power globally.

Your Role

Focused Energy is looking for a Principal Software Engineer to define and own the Core Software architecture that will operate and integrate our fusion power plant. Sitting within the Software Department and reporting to the Head of Software, this is a foundational technical role: you will set the direction for how controls, hardware interfaces, calibration systems, data infrastructure, and human-machine interfaces come together into one coherent system.

You will design and implement critical parts of the Core Software stack, stand up reliable automated calibration workflows, and set the engineering standards the rest of the department will build on. This is a rare opportunity to shape the software backbone of a fusion power plant and operate as a technical lead within the Software Department.

What You'll Do

  • Define and maintain the end-to-end Core Software architecture for the fusion power plant, including device interfaces, calibration, data handling, data storage, and HMI.

  • Design and implement critical parts of the Core Software system using languages such as C++ and Python.

  • Define clear interfaces between software, control hardware, diagnostics, plant equipment, data systems, and operator tools.

  • Design reliable automated calibration facilities and workflows that produce traceable and repeatable results.

  • Set practical standards for architecture, coding, testing, observability, documentation, release, reliability, security, and fault tolerance.

  • Lead technical decisions across teams, mentor engineers, resolve difficult trade-offs, and grow into a lead within the Software Department.

Who You Are

Must-Haves

  • Extensive experience designing and implementing control software for complex physical or industrial systems.

  • Extensive experience with hardware and software interfaces, including device integration and system-level troubleshooting.

  • Experience designing and implementing automated calibration facilities or automated calibration workflows.

  • Strong experience with data handling, data pipelines, metadata, and reliable data storage.

  • Experience designing and implementing HMI for operators or technical users.

  • Strong software design and implementation skills in C++, Python, or similar languages.

  • Ability to define architecture for complex, mission-critical systems under changing requirements and strict physical constraints.

  • Strong communication skills — you can explain technical decisions, risks, and trade-offs to software, hardware, science, and operations stakeholders.

  • Strong leadership skills — you can guide decisions, mentor engineers, build alignment, and take ownership without relying on formal authority.

  • Experience applying thorough testing, observability, reliability, fault tolerance, security, and documentation practices.

Nice-to-Haves

  • Experience with real-time or distributed control systems and high-throughput data acquisition.

  • Experience defining shared frameworks, API conventions, configuration management, or communication systems for multiple teams.

  • Experience writing architecture decision records or technical proposals and leading architecture reviews.

  • Experience growing into a department-level technical lead or coaching senior engineers.

  • Fluency with AI-assisted software development, or strong enthusiasm for using approved AI tools responsibly to improve quality and delivery.

9caa099670ebb262.title: Machine Learning Engineer (f/m/d)
9caa099670ebb262.description:
Focused Energy is building the future of clean energy through laser-driven inertial fusion. Backed by our $240M Series A — the largest fully secured Series A in the global fusion industry — we are scaling rapidly across multiple geographies.

Based in Germany and the US, we have brought together the top scientific and engineering minds using proven technologies to unlock fusion power at commercial scale. Focused Energy is working to realize game-changing scientific innovation that promises to deliver a clean, sustainable and abundant source of power globally.

Your Role

This role sits at the intersection of ML engineering and computational physics, working within our Software Engineering & Digital Twin environments. You'll collaborate closely with optical engineers, laser and fusion physicists, simulation scientists, and systems engineers to embed data-driven intelligence directly into our Digital Twin architecture. You’ll be reducing design risk, shortening development timelines, and unlocking system-level optimization that purely physics-based approaches can't achieve at the speed we need.

You will design, build, and deploy machine learning models that enhance, accelerate, and augment our multiphysics simulation environments across our high-energy laser systems, target injection and tracking system, target manufacturing system, and fusion chamber. This will enable faster design cycles, predictive system optimization, and real-time decision support across our laser, targetry, and fusion programs.

What You'll Do

  • Surrogate & reduced-order modeling: Design and deploy surrogate and reduced-order models (ROMs) that replace or accelerate high-fidelity multiphysics simulations in the Digital Twin environment

  • Physics-informed ML: Develop physics-informed machine learning (PIML) and physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) that embed physical constraints (Maxwell's equations, thermodynamics, fluid dynamics) directly into model architectures

  • ML pipelines: Build and maintain ML pipelines for training, validation, uncertainty quantification (UQ), and continuous model refinement against experimental and simulation data

  • Active learning & Bayesian optimization: Implement active learning and Bayesian optimization workflows to intelligently guide design space exploration and reduce costly simulation runs

  • Digital Twin integration: Integrate trained ML models into the broader Digital Twin framework, interfacing with HPC simulation outputs (COMSOL, ANSYS, custom solvers) and real-time sensor data

  • Anomaly detection: Develop anomaly detection and predictive diagnostics models to monitor system health and identify off-nominal behavior in laser subsystems

  • Autonomous optimization: Apply reinforcement learning and Bayesian control approaches to support autonomous or semi-autonomous optimization of laser operating parameters

  • Cross-functional collaboration: Collaborate with Digital Twin architects, systems engineers, and optical simulation scientists to ensure ML models meet fidelity, latency, and uncertainty requirements

  • Engineering rigor: Establish best practices for model versioning, reproducibility, testing, and documentation in a fast-moving research environment

Who You Are

Must-Haves

  • Master's or PhD in Machine Learning, Computational Physics, Applied Mathematics, Data Science, Computer Science, or a closely related field

  • Proven experience building, training, and deploying ML models for complex physical systems; strong command of deep learning (PyTorch, TensorFlow/JAX), probabilistic models, and uncertainty quantification

  • Expert-level Python; proficiency in C++ or Fortran a plus; experience with HPC environments (batch schedulers, MPI/OpenMP parallelization)

  • Fluency working with PDE-based simulation outputs, time-series sensor data, and high-dimensional parameter spaces typical of multiphysics environments

  • Hands-on experience with Gaussian processes, neural network surrogates, reduced-order models, or equivalent metamodeling techniques

  • Experience building robust ML pipelines for scientific data — including preprocessing, feature engineering, model validation, and deployment

  • Ability to communicate model behavior, confidence intervals, and limitations clearly to physicists, engineers, and non-ML specialists

  • Strong cross-functional team skills; comfort working in an interdisciplinary environment spanning physics, engineering, and software

Nice-to-Haves

  • Experience with physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) or neural operators (DeepONet, FNO) applied to physical systems

  • Background in laser physics, plasma physics, high-energy-density science, or related complex physics domains

  • Experience with digital twin platforms and live integration of ML models with simulation environments (e.g., NVIDIA Omniverse, Siemens Xcelerator, ANSYS Twin Builder)

  • Familiarity with multidisciplinary design optimization (MDO) workflows, including Design of Experiments (DoE), sensitivity analysis, and uncertainty propagation

  • Experience applying reinforcement learning to physical system control or optimization

  • Familiarity with Monte Carlo methods and statistical uncertainty quantification frameworks

  • Experience with MLOps tooling (MLflow, Weights & Biases, DVC) in a scientific computing context

  • Interest in fusion energy, advanced laser systems, or high-energy-density physics

Team Core is our platform team. Its job is to make all our other engineering teams more productive and to improve our codebase and infrastructure as a whole. You’ll:

54bce888ea9b9653.description:
About Us

At LangChain, our mission is to make intelligent agents ubiquitous. We build the foundation for agent engineering in the real world, helping developers move from prototypes to production-ready AI agents that teams can rely on. We began as widely adopted open-source tools and have grown to also offer a platform for building, evaluating, deploying, and operating agents at scale.

With $125M raised at Series B from IVP, Sequoia, Benchmark, CapitalG, and Sapphire Ventures, we’re at a stage where we’re continuing to develop new products, growth is accelerating, and all team members have meaningful impact on what we build and how we work together. LangChain is a place where your contributions can shape how this technology shows up in the real world.

Today, our platform includes LangSmith (Observability, Evaluation, Deployment, Fleet, and Sandboxes), our open source frameworks (LangChain, LangGraph, and Deep Agents), and the newly launched LangSmith Engine for autonomous agent improvement. We have 100M+ monthly open source downloads, 6,000+ active LangSmith customers, and 5 of the Fortune 10 use LangSmith in production (+ 35% of the Fortune 500 overall), including teams at Klarna, Clay, Coinbase, Workday, Lyft, Cloudflare, Harvey, Rippling, Vanta, LinkedIn, Monday.com, Nvidia, and Bridgewater.

About the Role:

We’re looking for an experienced Account Executive to join our growing GTM team and drive the next wave of growth at LangChain. In this role, you’ll own the full sales cycle helping technical teams at cutting-edge enterprise companies discover, evaluate, and adopt LangChain’s products.

This is a high-impact, high-visibility role where you’ll collaborate closely with engineering, product, and customer success teams to shape how GenAI is adopted across different domains. If you're a relationship-driven seller who thrives in fast-paced, unstructured environments and wants to be part of building the go-to-market motion from the ground up, we’d love to hear from you.

What You’ll Do:

  • Own and manage the full sales cycle, from lead stage to close with a strong bias for follow-up and follow-through

  • Act as a trusted advisor to prospects and customers, learning their needs and demonstrating how our products can solve real problems

  • Drive proof-of-concept efforts, working with sales engineers and product experts to demonstrate tangible value

  • Stay on top of product updates and industry trends to educate customers and shape the conversation around GenAI adoption

  • Build long-term customer relationships and support post-sale success in partnership with our deployment and support teams

  • Negotiate pricing and deal terms and work with legal to redline contracts

  • Bring customer insights back to product and engineering teams to inform the future roadmap and improve the user experience

  • Help define and iterate on our sales playbook - your input will help shape our go to market strategies

What You Will Bring:

  • 5+ years of experience selling complex software to enterprise customers

  • A relationship builder that garners trust quickly and approaches sales with empathy and curiosity

  • Excellent communication and storytelling skills

  • Technical acumen with the ability to establish credibility with technical decision makers.

  • You thrive in fast-paced start-up environments and are energized by impact - you want to help evolve the playbook, not just follow one

  • Driven and solutions-oriented; you know how to navigate roadblocks and keep deals moving forward

  • Passionate about generative AI and excited to help customers navigate a rapidly evolving industry

Compensation:

Annual salary range: $225,000-$350,000 OTE USD + equity

Location:

  • Germany, Munich

Compensation Philosophy:

We offer competitive compensation that includes base salary, variable compensation for relevant roles, meaningful equity, benefits, and perks.

We are hiring for this role across a range of scope, and the compensation band reflects that. Your offer depends on what we learn about your impact, craft, leadership, and communication during the interview process. We will tell you early where you’re tracking and talk comp with you before offer stage. Team members in the EU, UK, and APAC receive locally competitive benefits aligned with regional norms and regulations.

Benefits

Benefits include medical, dental, and vision coverage, flexible vacation, a 401(k) plan, meals on in-office days in the US and more.
