c2afd73b2319e113.title: Principal Product & Brand Designer (m/f/x)
c2afd73b2319e113.description:
Build something that truly matters

At Cortea, we envision a world where every audit is proactively managed by humans and AI agents collaboratively. Where auditing professionals have superhuman capabilities at their fingertips to strengthen the trust in the world's most critical systems.

We're not just improving auditing workflows, we're redefining how audits are done from the ground up. With a rapidly growing, global customer base and backing from world-class investors, the market is ready. What we ship next decides how big this gets.

This is your chance to join a team of sharp, ambitious and kind builders extremely early. Shape the company at its pivotal moment and build something that truly matters.

About the role

At Cortea, design earns trust, and we sell to an industry that exists to produce it. Auditors are paid to be skeptical, and people judge quality by what they can see: the product, the website, the deck a partner opens in a boardroom, the newsletter someone reads with their first coffee. All of it is Cortea.

This is a role for someone with great taste in designing software and AI systems. You'll find novel patterns for problems that haven't existed in software before, and you'll own how Cortea looks and feels to the outside world.

Roughly 70% product, 30% brand. The product work is deep, expert-facing and systems-heavy. As we are doubling down on design, you'll be working on taking the core flows to the next level. The brand work is yours to own outright: website, marketing and sales visuals, newsletter, event and content assets. It'll be on screen in a Big4 boardroom, in every customer's inbox, and on the wall at the events we host. A lot of surface for one designer, and all of it yours.

We're not looking for someone to ask whether the logo goes left or right. We're looking for someone with opinions.

What you'll do

  • Work directly with our founders, engineers, and customers to turn audit flows into intuitive, delightful interfaces

  • Work with Jonas on product design and design strategy overall

  • Own our brand designs and visuals

  • Evolve our visual identity and design system

  • Take increasing ownership of brand direction. Website, marketing and sales material, content and event assets

  • Help shape the product vision, roadmap, and user experience standards

  • Run usability tests, build user feedback loops, and bring a systems mindset to design decisions

You'll be great at this if you

  • Have product design experience in B2B / SaaS, ideally in fast-moving startups.

  • Think in experiences, not screens. With taste you can defend. Product and brand are one surface; you can explain why details work, and you call out when they don’t.

  • Want to create a unique brand, which auditors love. Identify, marketing, web should be a draw, not a tax. Taste and passion matter more than volume.

  • Can hold complexity without losing clarity. You turn configuration-heavy, expert workflows into clear systems.

  • Use AI without sacrificing quality. You've worked out which parts of the job benefit from automation and which need your judgment.

  • Work well in ambiguity. You take rough direction and deliver great work without handholding.

  • Have low ego. Best idea wins. You give and take feedback without making it about you.

Titles are fuzzy. If you're operating at principal level, or you're currently freelancing and curious rather than actively looking, talk to us anyway.

What you will get

  • Full brand ownership, shape how the product feels. Work face-to-face with experienced founders and learn directly from customer insights.

  • Real influence on strategy. In a small team of excellent engineers and operators with high autonomy, you will shape product direction. Best idea wins, regardless of seniority.

  • Fast, ambitious, and fun team. Decisions get made in hours, not weeks. Rapid experimentation is the default.

  • Meaningful equity and competitive salary. You are one of the first to build this, and you share in the upside.

  • A mission that matters. Building intelligent systems for a $200bn industry from Berlin, with AI at the core

Interview process

  • First Call — Intro on what we do with Liza

  • Second Call — Portfolio walkthrough with Jonas

  • Third Call — Get to know our product and culture with our Co-Founder Valentin

  • On-site Day — Meet our full team in our Berlin office and work on a real problem together with us.

aeb28ce9d5542029.title: Senior Technical Product Manager - Compliance & Recording
aeb28ce9d5542029.description:
About Us

1GLOBAL is a technology-driven global mobile communications provider helping enterprises and consumer brands deliver seamless connectivity worldwide. Powered by a best-in-class telecom platform, proprietary eSIM technology, and its own mobile core network across 15 countries, 1GLOBAL operates as a fully regulated telecommunications provider in 43 countries.


Founded in 2022, 1GLOBAL has rapidly become one of Europe's fastest-growing telecom technology companies, connecting more than 80 million people and devices globally. Our customers include leading banks, multinational enterprises, global retailers, travel companies, payment service providers, and digital-first businesses.


Headquartered in the Netherlands, with R&D hubs in Lisbon, Berlin, and São Paulo, 1GLOBAL employs over 550 professionals across 16 countries. With annual revenues exceeding US$200 million and a strong track record of profitability, we continue to invest in innovation, infrastructure, and international expansion as we redefine the future of global mobile connectivity.

About the Team

The Compliance & Recording team owns 1GLOBAL's products for regulated enterprises. We capture mobile voice, SMS and data at network level, with no app on the device, and deliver it to wherever our customers need it: their own on-site recorders and archives, or our Cloud Compliance service built on Verint Financial Compliance. On top of the recordings we offer Communications Analytics, which brings AI transcription, summaries and risk insights to compliance teams.

Our customers include 8 of the world's 10 largest banks. They rely on us for a complete, auditable record of every regulated call and message, so reliability and precision are at the heart of everything the team builds. We work closely with engineering, network, security, service delivery and commercial teams.

We are looking for a Senior Technical Product Manager to own how recorded communications are captured, delivered and analysed. This is an API-first, backend role: there is little UI at its core, because for our customers the integration is the product.

About the Role

You will lead product strategy and delivery for Compliance & Recording, from the APIs and delivery channels that move recorded data into customer environments to the AI capabilities we build on top of it. 

  • Own the vision, roadmap and backlog for Compliance & Recording, covering customer-managed (on-site) recording, Cloud Compliance and the integrations that connect them to customer systems.
  • Define and evolve how recorded voice, SMS and data reach customers through APIs, SFTP, SMTP and S3 bucket pushes, choosing the right mechanism for each use case.
  • Write precise technical requirements: API contracts, payload and metadata schemas, delivery guarantees, retry and failure handling, security controls and acceptance criteria.
  • Lead large projects for our biggest compliance customers, onboarding their engineering and compliance teams with proper documentation, from scoping through rollout.
  • Define and track success metrics such as delivery success rate, latency, capture completeness and time to integrate, and keep the roadmap aligned with regulatory change and the competitive landscape.

Requirements

About You

Must Have

  • 6+ years in product management, with end-to-end ownership of API-first, backend or platform products where there is little or no UI.
  • Deep, hands-on knowledge of APIs: REST design, authentication, versioning, webhooks, pagination, error handling and idempotency. You read OpenAPI specs, test endpoints yourself and hold your own in design discussions with engineers.
  • Solid understanding of file and message-based integrations such as SFTP, SMTP and object storage (for example AWS S3), including batch versus near real-time delivery, encryption and access control.
  • A track record of leading large, cross-functional projects for enterprise customers with demanding technical, security and reliability requirements.
  • Clear, precise writing: requirements, acceptance criteria and edge cases that engineering teams can build from without guesswork.
  • A genuine interest in compliance products and enterprise integrations. You want to understand how regulated firms capture, retain and supervise communications, and why every record matters.
  • Confident communication with engineers, customer technical teams, compliance officers and executives, in fluent written and spoken English.


Nice to Have

  • Telecom experience, for example mobile voice and SMS, MVNO platforms, SIP, call recording or CDRs.
  • Compliance or regtech experience, such as communications recording, archiving or surveillance.
  • Experience shipping AI features in production, such as speech-to-text, LLM evaluation or human-in-the-loop review.

Benefits

Why 1GLOBAL?

  • Growth Opportunities: Advance your career in one of the fastest growing telecommunications companies, expanding over 50% year-on-year under the leadership of successful tech entrepreneurs.
  • Major Transaction Exposure: Be in the driver’s seat for transactions that will have an impact on the future telco industry.
  • Work with a Talented Team: From the Board and the Founders to the Senior Management Team, you will collaborate daily with the most capable and renowned external advisors and constantly being exposed to talented and driven individuals.
  • Dynamic Work Environment: Thrive in a collaborative, fast-paced workplace where innovation is encouraged, and every contribution counts.
  • Professional Development: Work alongside industry experts to enhance your skills and knowledge in a cutting-edge field.
  • International Experience: Gain opportunities to work in different 1GLOBAL offices around the world as you grow within the company.
  • Open Communication Culture: Join a team where your ideas are heard, and open dialogue is encouraged, fostering a supportive and transparent work environment.
  • Get Things Done Attitude: Be part of a results-driven team that values efficiency, creativity, and the drive to make a tangible impact in the industry.


1GLOBAL is an equal opportunity employer, we value your character as much as your talent. Diversity drives our innovation, and we offer a collaborative, dynamic, and international work environment. We are excited for you to join our mission to revolutionise connectivity globally.

b924f4b7ef85091c.description:
About Us

1GLOBAL is a technology-driven global mobile communications provider helping enterprises and consumer brands deliver seamless connectivity worldwide. Powered by a best-in-class telecom platform, proprietary eSIM technology, and its own mobile core network across 15 countries, 1GLOBAL operates as a fully regulated telecommunications provider in 43 countries.


Founded in 2022, 1GLOBAL has rapidly become one of Europe's fastest-growing telecom technology companies, connecting more than 80 million people and devices globally. Our customers include leading banks, multinational enterprises, global retailers, travel companies, payment service providers, and digital-first businesses.


Headquartered in the Netherlands, with R&D hubs in Lisbon, Berlin, and São Paulo, 1GLOBAL employs over 550 professionals across 16 countries. With annual revenues exceeding US$200 million and a strong track record of profitability, we continue to invest in innovation, infrastructure, and international expansion as we redefine the future of global mobile connectivity.

About the Team

The Enterprise team owns 1GLOBAL's products for businesses: global mobile connectivity for multinational enterprises, delivered through one platform, one contract and one invoice. Our customers manage their entire mobile estate in the Enterprise Portal, from subscriptions, usage and invoices to orders such as SIM swaps and suspensions, spend alerts, user roles and single sign-on.

We recently retired two legacy portals and moved every enterprise customer onto our new Enterprise Portal. That has created strong demand and a steady flow of requests from customers and internal teams, with a lot of exciting work ahead. We work closely with engineering, design, customer support, customer success, account management, operations and commercial teams.

We are looking for a Product Manager to shape the next chapter of the Enterprise Portal: what we show, how we show it, which reports and analytics we offer, and which actions customers can take themselves. This is a UI and UX-heavy role, where design judgement matters as much as sharp prioritisation.

About the Role

You will lead discovery and delivery for the Enterprise Portal, turning a high volume of customer and internal requests into a clear roadmap and a portal that enterprise customers enjoy using.

  • Own the vision, roadmap and backlog for the Enterprise Portal, deciding which dashboards, reports, analytics and self-service capabilities come next.
  • Run customer and UX research: talk to portal users directly and gather the voice of the customer from support, customer success, account management and operations.
  • Work hands-on with design from first concept to final UI, shaping flows, wireframes and prototypes and holding a high bar for UX and UI quality.
  • Shape the portal's integrations with mobile device management (MDM) platforms such as Jamf and Microsoft Intune, so enterprise IT teams can manage devices and connectivity together.
  • Prioritise work of every size, from small fixes and quick improvements to large multi-quarter projects, and communicate decisions and trade-offs clearly to every stakeholder.
  • Use analytics and data to understand how customers use the portal, spot friction and measure the impact of what we ship.

9dbf108c9760b499.description:
About Us

1GLOBAL is a technology-driven global mobile communications provider helping enterprises and consumer brands deliver seamless connectivity worldwide. Powered by a best-in-class telecom platform, proprietary eSIM technology, and its own mobile core network across 15 countries, 1GLOBAL operates as a fully regulated telecommunications provider in 43 countries.


Founded in 2022, 1GLOBAL has rapidly become one of Europe's fastest-growing telecom technology companies, connecting more than 80 million people and devices globally. Our customers include leading banks, multinational enterprises, global retailers, travel companies, payment service providers, and digital-first businesses.


Headquartered in the Netherlands, with R&D hubs in Lisbon, Berlin, and São Paulo, 1GLOBAL employs over 550 professionals across 16 countries. With annual revenues exceeding US$200 million and a strong track record of profitability, we continue to invest in innovation, infrastructure, and international expansion as we redefine the future of global mobile connectivity.

About the DevOps department

Our DevOps department has three teams. Each owns one layer of the platform:

  • Foundations (ROOT): machines, operating systems, virtualisation, VPNs and databases.
  • Cloud-Native Infra (CLOUD): cloud accounts, Kubernetes clusters, networking, identity and shared platform services.
  • Developer Experience (DEVX): pipelines, GitOps, internal tooling, observability and APIs used by engineering teams every day.

    About the Team

DEVX builds the tools and workflows our engineering teams use to ship software. That covers pipelines, GitOps, internal CLIs, observability and API management. Our tooling is written in Go.

We own: GitLab CI pipelines, Stack CLIs and internal tooling, Argo CD, Crossplane Compositions, metrics, logs, tracing, profiling, alerts and dashboards, API management, OAuth2 clients and the Governance API, our internal developer platform

We don't own: cloud accounts, clusters, networking, the service mesh, Crossplane providers and XRDs (CLOUD), GitLab instance upgrades and VMs.

Your first 6 months

  • Improve observability across the platform: alert quality, performance and data-transfer optimisation.
  • Take ownership of our Internal tools and the shared pipeline templates our developers use.
  • Help migrating the remaining deployments to GitOps with Argo CD.

About the role

  • Develop Internal tools in Go.
  • Own metrics, logs, alerts and dashboards, and help teams decide what to measure.
  • Build and maintain GitLab CI pipelines and shared templates.
  • Run Argo CD and GitOps workflows across environments.
  • Write Crossplane Compositions on top of XRDs.
  • Manage APIs, OAuth2 clients and the Governance API.
  • Help shape our internal developer platform.

Requirements

Requirements

About You

Must Have

  • 5+ years in DevOps, infrastructure or platform engineering, including ownership of production systems and on-call.
  • You write design docs, reason about trade-offs, and mentor other engineers.
  • Fluent English, written and spoken. Please send your CV in English.
  • Solid fundamentals in compute, networking and storage, and you're at home on Linux.
  • Go as your main language: production code with tests and releases, and CLIs or services you maintain.
  • Observability: Grafana, Prometheus, Thanos, Loki, Tempo, Pyroscope and alerts that people actually trust.
  • GitLab CI at scale: shared templates, includes, runners, pipeline security.
  • Helm and Kustomize.
  • Kubernetes from the workload side: CRDs and debugging deployments.
  • You treat developers as customers, with clear docs, feedback loops and attention to adoption.


Nice to Have

  • OpenTelemetry or distributed tracing (Tempo, Jaeger).
  • Argo CD/GitOps: ApplicationSets, sync strategies, promotion between environments.
  • OAuth2/OIDC, JWTs, API management.
  • Python as a second language.
  • Crossplane Compositions
  • Multi-stage Docker builds and image hygiene.
  • Writing Operators (kubebuilder/controller-runtime)
  • REST API design

Benefits

Why 1GLOBAL?

  • Growth Opportunities: Advance your career in one of the fastest growing telecommunications companies, expanding over 50% year-on-year under the leadership of successful tech entrepreneurs.
  • Major Transaction Exposure: Be in the driver’s seat for transactions that will have an impact on the future telco industry.
  • Work with a Talented Team: From the Board and the Founders to the Senior Management Team, you will collaborate daily with the most capable and renowned external advisors and constantly being exposed to talented and driven individuals.
  • Dynamic Work Environment: Thrive in a collaborative, fast-paced workplace where innovation is encouraged, and every contribution counts.
  • Professional Development: Work alongside industry experts to enhance your skills and knowledge in a cutting-edge field.
  • International Experience: Gain opportunities to work in different 1GLOBAL offices around the world as you grow within the company.
  • Open Communication Culture: Join a team where your ideas are heard, and open dialogue is encouraged, fostering a supportive and transparent work environment.
  • Get Things Done Attitude: Be part of a results-driven team that values efficiency, creativity, and the drive to make a tangible impact in the industry.

cd908a29ecd3542e.title: Executive Assistant
cd908a29ecd3542e.description:
Powering Great Work

We started as the place to find a trusted trade. Now, as we shape the future of home improvement, we're building the tech to transform that landscape for everyone - better products, smarter data, AI where it actually helps - so trades can spend less time on admin and consumers can find someone they trust, first time. That's Powering Great Work, and it's why every team here exists:

🔧 Trades spend less time on admin and more on winning work and growing their business

🏠 Homeowners get a trusted trade, first time, every time

🚀 We get to build products that change homes and lives across the country

As our next Executive Assistant to the CEO, you'll keep the day-to-day running smoothly so they can focus on the big calls. You'll own the diary, the priorities and the details in between, with a seat close to the decisions shaping Checkatrade's next chapter. It's a 12-month fixed-term contract covering maternity leave.

The job, unfiltered:

  • Own the CEO's diary end to end: prioritise what matters, protect focus time and make sure every meeting has a clear purpose and the right people in the room.

  • Coordinate board and leadership meetings: pull the papers together, chase actions and make sure nothing falls through the cracks between sessions.

  • Manage complex travel and itineraries, so the CEO turns up ready and without the faff.

  • Be the first point of contact for the CEO, handling sensitive and confidential information with discretion and representing them well with senior stakeholders, investors and the exec team.

  • Keep the leadership team's rhythm on track by coordinating offsites, leadership meetings and the cross-team moments that keep everyone aligned.

  • A sharp eye for detail, and the judgement to know what's urgent, what's important and what can wait.

  • Total discretion with confidential and sensitive information. People trust you with the details that matter.

4689afc924afd0f2.title: Enterprise Account Manager Team Lead - UKI
4689afc924afd0f2.description:
About Us

Perk (formerly TravelPerk) is the intelligent platform for travel and spend management. Built to tackle the time-consuming, manual work that gets in the way of real work, our tools automate everything from travel bookings to expenses, invoice processing, and more. By eliminating this shadow work that wastes hours, erodes morale, and saps innovation, we're on a mission to power real work, with real impact.

We're trusted by more than 12,000 companies worldwide, including Bolt, GoCardless, and Fabletics, and we're tackling the 7 hours of lost productivity per employee each week, a $1.7 trillion problem.

Founded in 2015, Perk has grown into a global company of more than 1,800 people across 12 offices globally, with headquarters in London and Boston. We combine innovation, control, and simplicity to transform how businesses work and how people feel at work.

At Perk, we're driven by our values, like being an owner, delivering a 7-star experience, and working as one team. We value curiosity, purpose, and mindset, not just knowledge, to unlock the power in your potential. Our talent team brings together leading minds from the travel, fintech, and SaaS industries, representing over 70 countries. If you're excited about having a real impact and shaping how millions of people experience work, we'd love you on the team.

Visit www.perk.com to learn more.

About the Role

Enterprise Team Leader, Account Management (UKI Market)

We are looking for an experienced and motivated person to step into a Team Leader role within our Account Management team, focusing on the UKI market.

 

As a Team Leader, you will manage a team of Enterprise Account Managers, guiding them in enhancing client satisfaction within the UKI region. You will be accountable for your team’s KPIs, targets, and the establishment of best practices. We value a candidate with a strong strategic mindset and a passion for developing their team.

 

Are you an experienced manager with a proven track record in Account Management and a desire to further your leadership career? If so, we encourage you to apply!

 

What You’ll Do

  • Lead and manage a team of Enterprise Account Managers, focusing on customer retention and growth within the UKI market.

  • Have a strong emphasis on People Management and Performance Development.

  • Be responsible for setting and achieving team KPIs.

  • Guide the team in strategic negotiations with key clients.

  • Enhance materials and deliverables tailored to Perk’s UKI customers.

  • Drive automation of Business-as-Usual (BAU) tasks.

  • Define team roles and responsibilities.

  • Oversee the onboarding of new clients in coordination with the implementation and sales teams.

  • Manage the onboarding and training of new Account Managers.

What We’re Looking For

  • Proven experience in a managerial role.

  • Previous experience in Account Management at Enterprise Level. Commercial experience is a plus.

  • Ability to thrive in a dynamic and fast-paced environment.

  • Excellent organizational and structuring abilities.

  • Strong problem-solving skills.

  • Strong commercial acumen.

  • Ability to analyze data and provide concise summaries.

  • Numerical literacy and ability to perform forecasts, with strong Excel proficiency.

  • Fluency in English, written and spoken.

Important Information

  • This role is based in Birmingham or London and will require a 3 day week attendance

  • This is a permanent position.

 

What We Offer

  • Receive competitive compensation and equity ownership in Perk

  • Rest and recharge with 25 days of annual leave plus bank holidays

  • Take control of your physical health with private medical cover and voluntary dental insurance from Bupa, and discounted gym memberships with GymFlex

  • Plan for your future with our qualifying earnings company pension plan with Aviva

  • Know that your loved ones are protected financially through your Life Insurance if the worst were to happen

  • Rest assured that you’re covered by income protection in case you experience a long-term sickness or absence

  • Leverage tax-efficient cycle and electric car schemes with Cycle2Work & Octopus

  • Join our unforgettable Perk events, including our spectacular annual summer party

  • Always feel supported with Spring Health, our market-leading wellbeing partner, providing fast, comprehensive access to 12x therapy and 12x coaching sessions for you and your loved ones

  • Focus on your family with 12-16 weeks’ paid parental leave

  • Contribute to your community with 16 paid hours per year to spend volunteering for your dearest charitable causes

  • Broaden your horizons with up to 20 "Work from Anywhere" days per year

  • Stay savvy with access to a wide variety of discounts and rewards

  • Follow your passions and take a four-week, fully paid sabbatical once you reach 5 years

  • Let us help you move to one of our hubs with relocation support

The Process

  • Talent Acquisition Interview - 30mins Virtual

  • Interview with the Hiring Manager - 30mins Virtual

  • Assessment interview with two Mangers in the hiring team - 1hr onsite

  • Values interview - 30mins virtual

 

AI at Perk
AI is embedded in how we work across every function. The tools you'll use day-to-day are AI-enabled so you can move faster and spend more time on the work that matters. In practice, that means using AI to research and prioritise accounts, draft and refine outreach, handle customer interactions more effectively, synthesise information, and cut through shadow work - the invisible tasks that pull people away from the work only they can do - so you can focus on relationships and outcomes.

How We Work

At Perk, we take an IRL-first approach to work, where our team works together in-person 3 days a week. As such, this role requires you to be based within commuting distance of our hubs. We fundamentally believe in the value of meeting in real life to improve connectivity, productivity, creativity and ultimately making us a great place to work.

For certain roles, we can help with relocation from anywhere in the world, English is the official language at the office. Please submit your resume in English if you choose to apply. Do not forget to submit an updated portfolio and/or resume.

Perk is a global company with a diverse customer base, and we want to make sure the people behind our product reflect that. We’re an equal opportunity employer, which means you’re welcome at Perk regardless of how you look, where you’re from, or anything else that makes you, well, you.

Protect Yourself from Recruitment Scams

All official communication from Perk will always come from email addresses ending in @perk.com or @externalperk.com, our verified social media channels, or recruiters listed on our official LinkedIn page. We will never ask you to pay for equipment, training, or fees, request sensitive personal information such as bank details early in the process, or communicate through unofficial apps like WhatsApp, Telegram, or Signal. If you receive a message claiming to be from Perk that seems suspicious, please do not respond. Forward it to security [at] perk .com, and we will confirm whether it is legitimate.

8b15756985d5e253.title: Marketing Lead
8b15756985d5e253.description:
About Flock

Road accidents kill and injure people, damage vehicles, and cost businesses fortunes. But traditional insurance does nothing to prevent them - it just pays out claims when they happen. At Flock, we’re changing that. Using telematics, AI, and real-time data, we proactively help our fleet customers prevent crashes. We obsessively focus on keeping drivers safe, and we put our money where our mouth is - paying out millions of pounds per year to fleets that get safer over time.

We were acquired by Admiral in May 2026. Now we combine the backing of the UK’s leading motor insurer with startup energy and speed. We’re growing fast with bigger plans than ever, and we’re hugely optimistic that our approach will save many more lives in the decade ahead.

We’re on a mission to make the world quantifiably safer. Join us!

 

About the role

Flock is on a hypergrowth trajectory, coming off a record-breaking Q3 and on track for Q4, and we're looking for someone to take the reins of marketing and drive the next stage of that growth. You'll do it at the frontier of AI in fleet insurance, in a heavily AI-powered business where AI is driving impact in every team.

You'll own Flock's marketing strategy, brand and budget, reporting to our co-founder and Chief Commercial Officer. We've dramatically increased the marketing budget because we're planning to go big, and you'll have a Marketing Manager reporting to you who owns events and content delivery. You'll set the direction, but this is still a hands-on role for someone who gets things done, with a run-until-tackled mindset and the drive to show how far a small, AI-native team can go.

Brand and launches. Flock has been through its acquisition by Admiral, and the Flock and Admiral Business propositions will become increasingly connected from here. You'll be central to taking that joined-up offer to market, owning how Flock by Admiral looks and sounds everywhere and leading every launch end to end. It's the best of both worlds, a fun, high-energy brand combined with the strongest name in UK insurance.

Growth. Every fleet we insure comes to us through an insurance broker, so brokers sit at the centre of how we grow. You'll build the campaigns, events strategy and broker programmes that grow both, alongside distribution, underwriting and product, and show what each pound returns.

AI. Our marketing is already heavily AI-powered, across design, web, email and video. You'll take it much further, building tools, agents and workflows so a team of two produces the output of ten, and you'll be the person Flock and Admiral turn to when they want to see what's possible next. Brokers and fleets still buy from people, so your craft and judgement stay at the centre of it.

 

What you’ll be doing

  • Set the strategy. Turn company OKRs into a marketing plan, own the budget and report the return in pipeline and broker growth.

  • Lead the team. Manage and develop the Marketing Manager, and brief our agencies and suppliers.

  • Lead the brand. Act as the owner and protector of the Flock brand on every single touchpoint.

  • Launch and grow. Take products and propositions to market end to end, and run the broker campaigns, lifecycle emails and sales collateral that help our BDMs win business.

  • Shape the events strategy. Choose events where Flock should have presence and come up with bold and creative ideas, with the Marketing Manager running delivery.

  • Build with AI. Create tools and workflows, and share them so the whole business moves faster.

 

What you’ll need

  • 5+ years B2B marketing experience, including leading a function or major programme end to end, ideally in insurance, insurtech or fintech.

  • Product launches and campaigns with commercial results you can point to.

  • Strong brand instinct and craft, shown in your writing, your art direction and your eye for work that isn't good enough yet.

  • Experience owning a budget and showing senior stakeholders what it returned.

  • Experience managing people or agencies and raising the standard of their work.

  • An AI-native way of working, with tools, workflows or campaigns you've built with AI to show for it.

  • Ambition and ownership. You want to build something big, you move without waiting for a brief, and you can present to founders, Admiral leadership and a room of brokers with equal confidence.

Nice to have: insurance, fleet, telematics or broker distribution experience

 

Benefits

  • 25 days of holiday (+ Bank Holidays) 🏖

  • Share Incentive Plan 📈

  • Workplace Pension 💰

  • Private Medical Insurance 🏥 (including Dental 🦷 Optical 👓 & Mental Health 💆‍♀️ support options)

  • Various Salary Sacrifice Schemes - Holiday Purchase, Tech, Gym, Cycle to Work, Electric Vehicle, Private Medical Insurance for families 💵

  • Enhanced Parental Leave and Pay 🐣

  • £1000 toward relevant professional qualifications 🎓

  • £500 per annum towards learning and development 🌱

  • 3 days paid leave for L&D purposes 🌻

We work hybrid, typically three days a week in our Central London office (fewer office days can be accommodated for longer commute times), a few minutes from Moorgate and Liverpool Street. Visits to client sites, conferences and broker offices count towards office days.

Making the world quantifiably safer takes more than good data. It takes a team where different perspectives are heard, and that’s a priority here. We insure fleets and drivers from every background, and we know a team built the same way makes sharper decisions and a better product for our customers. So we hire on merit, full stop, and we actively encourage applications from everyone. If you don’t tick every box, apply anyway. Just come as your genuine self: the qualities and experiences only you bring are exactly what we want.

ceb49a77853cbad1.description:
About the role

Neural Concept's Vertical Solutions team turns the most common engineering use cases into streamlined, production-grade workflows empowered by leading AI technologies.

As an AI Workflows Engineer, you will own the design and delivery of AI-powered, Python-first engineering solutions for a specific industry application. You will collaborate with the Vertical Solutions Product Manager and key customers to define the roadmap and build workflows that integrate design, simulation, and machine learning—helping to shorten product development cycles and amplify impact.

As the primary developer, you will work closely with CAD and CAE specialists to implement, maintain, and evolve these solutions. You will also identify reusable components that can be integrated into the Neural Concept platform, ensuring consistency, driving innovation, and accelerating adoption across applications.

 

What you will do

  • Lead the design and delivery of AI-powered engineering workflows for specific industry applications and integrate them into the Neural Concept platform for scalable adoption.

  • Build & integrate: act as primary Python developer — define clean interfaces with CAD/CAE specialists; own coding, testing, CI, packaging, and releases

  • Upstream reusable components to the Neural Concept platform.

  • Standardize: stay close to active projects; spot recurring pain points and patterns, and turn them into reusable templates, presets, and best practices.

  • Engage reference customers and end users to gather feedback, and drive adoption.

  • Help define and review documentation, playbooks and hands-on training sessions.

 

Who you are

Must have:

  • Experience building and shipping production Python tools in fast-moving, cross-functional teams.

  • Hands-on Python engineer with strong software practices: packaging, testing (pytest), CI, code review, docs, and git.

  • Hands-on 3D CAE experience: 3D CFD and/or FEA (e.g., STAR-CCM+, Fluent, OpenFOAM, Abaqus, ANSYS Mechanical, LS-DYNA, NASTRAN)

  • Contribute to technical direction and architecture while acting as a hands-on developer for vertical workflows; comfortable integrating external tools and defining clean data/interfaces for specialists.

  • Background in physics or engineering, or equivalent experience.

  • Clear, concise communicator who collaborates effectively across teams.

  • Location: Cambridge (UK), or willing to relocate; hybrid setup with up to 2 remote days/week.

Nice to have:

  • Industry exposure in an engineering-intensive sector (e.g., turbomachinery, energy, aerospace, automotive) and familiarity with product design processes is a strong plus.
    Familiarity with CAD

  • Familiarity with ML and common libraries (scikit-learn, PyTorch, Tensorflow...)

  • Experience with agentic AI orchestration

 

What You Get

  • Work with a world-class technology team – our engineers are top-notch, and we always aim for excellence.

  • Benefit from a competitive salary and rewarding opportunities as we continue to scale.

  • Thrive in a collaborative, multicultural environment where your work is visible and recognized.

  • Develop professionally alongside talented colleagues who share knowledge freely and support one another.

  • Make a global impact by helping customers shift to AI-assisted design, making innovation faster, smarter, and more sustainable.

  • Balance life and work with a hybrid model and flexible hours—we care about results, not rigid schedules.

We're proud to be an equal opportunity employer, and we're committed to building a diverse and inclusive environment where you can thrive.

9b14ec8e16aa5032.title: Sales Operations Manager
9b14ec8e16aa5032.description:
Relay is fundamentally reshaping how goods move in an online era. Backed by Europe’s largest-ever logistics Series A ($35M) led by deep-tech investors Plural, and a recently closed Series B ($95M), Relay is scaling faster than 99% of venture-backed startups. We're assembling the most talent-dense team the logistics industry has ever seen

Relay’s Mission is to free commerce from friction. Today, high delivery costs act as a hidden tax on e-commerce, quietly shaping what can be sold online and limiting who can participate. We envision a world where more goods move more freely between more people, making the online shopping experience seamless and accessible to everyone.

THE TEAM
• ~160 people, around half in engineering, product and data
• 45+ advanced degrees across computer science, mathematics and operations research
• Thousands of data points captured, calculated, analysed and predicted for every single parcel we handle
• An intellectually vibrant culture of first‑principles thinking, tight feedback loops and relentless experimentation

About the Role

Relay sells through two core motions. The first is our new-business engine: a B2B enterprise sales motion winning large retailers and brands with significant parcel volumes — and, in time, extending down-market into Small medium enterprises (SME) as that segment opens up. The second is our field engine, which grows Relay's network of "Pitstops" — local shops and businesses that act as pick-up and drop-off points where consumers can collect parcels and return items.

Both motions depend on the systems and processes this role will build and own: the account universe and TAM, lead scoring and prioritisation, outreach, CRM architecture, governance, and sales tooling.

You'll be both architect and operator, and AI-native in how you work. You'll define what great looks like across the systems and processes underpinning both sales motions, then take ownership of making it happen. You’ll also be highly fluent in metrics — using dashboards and funnel data to identify where performance is breaking down, where opportunities are being lost, and where we can drive greater efficiency.

What You'll Do

  • Build the new-business engine: own TAM, account scoring and weekly prioritisation, plus a top-of-funnel (enrichment, multi-threaded contacts, sequencing, signal-based triggers) that lets sales spend their time pitching, not hunting.

  • Own the CRM and deal desk: architect Pipedrive around the selling rhythm, govern deal terms, stages and approval gates from pitch to activation, and raise the quality and speed of pitches and proposals.

  • Scale the Pitstop engine: run the field team's scoring, territories, targets and dashboards, manage pricing levers and CPA, and keep lead-to-live data clean, pushing toward a self-running engine with algorithmic assignment, referrals and AI-handled inbound.

  • Automate relentlessly: own the tooling stack and build-vs-buy calls (defaulting to building), strip manual work out of the sales day, and design systems that extend to SME and self-serve through configuration, not a rebuild.

  • Diagnose and fix the funnel: use funnel data to find where deals stall and pipeline leaks, then ship the fixes.

Who Will Thrive in This Role

  • Systems thinker. You build systems rather than one-off fixes, and you take ideas all the way to a shipped, working solution yourself.

  • Proven RevOps experience. You've run sales or revenue operations in a fast-moving environment and know what best-in-class looks like across top-of-funnel, CRM, deal desk and process.

  • CRM owner, not just admin. You've implemented and evolved Pipedrive (or similar) so it fits the selling motion, rather than bending the motion to fit the tool.

  • Native AI builder. You're fluent with Claude and have shipped real tooling and automations in a live business.

  • Fast, practical delivery. You implement quickly and are comfortable scoping work for engineering when you need their help.

  • High bar for quality. You insist on clean data and tight processes

  • Equally strong in detail and with people. You're comfortable refining a workflow in depth and equally at ease talking pipeline quality with sales.

Compensation, Benefits & Workplace

  • Generous equity, richer than 99% of European startups, with annual top-ups to share Relay's success

  • Private health & dental coverage, so comprehensive you'd need to be a partner at a Magic Circle law firm to match it

  • 25 days of holidays

  • Enhanced parental leave

  • Hardware of your choice

  • Extensive perks (gym subsidies, cycle-to-work, Friday office lunch, covered Uber home and dinner for late nights, and more)

  • Located in Shoreditch, our office set-up enables the kind of in-person interactions that drive impact. We work 4 days on-site, with 1 day remote.

Who Thrives at Relay?

  • Aim with Precision: You define problems clearly and measure your impact meticulously.

  • Play to Win: You chase bold bets, tackle the hard stuff, and view constraints as fuel, not friction.

  • 1% Better Every Day: You believe that small, consistent improvements lead to exponential growth. You move quickly, deliver results, and learn from every experience.

  • All In, All the Time: You show up and step up. You take ownership from start to finish and do what it takes to deliver when it counts.

  • People-Powered Greatness: You invest in your teammates. You give and receive feedback with care and candour. You build trust through high standards and shared success.

  • Grow the Whole Pie: You seek out win-win solutions for merchants, couriers, and our customers, because when they thrive, so do we.

    If these resonate, and you combine strong technical fundamentals with entrepreneurial drive, let’s connect.

Relay is an equal-opportunity employer committed to diversity, inclusion, and fostering a workplace where everyone thrives.

b03766e2ec0834a5.title: Senior Backend Engineer (Data serving)
b03766e2ec0834a5.description:
About Pleo

Messy spend management is tricky business. And tedious processes are a lose-lose situation for all involved, not just finance. At Pleo, we're changing that. We build spend solutions that make managing money seamless, empowering, and surprisingly effective for finance teams and employees alike - with a vision to help all businesses ‘go beyond’.

The word ‘Pleo’ actually means ‘more than you’d expect’, and living by that mantra has been the secret to our success over the last 10 years.

Now, we’re at a pivotal moment in our journey; every move we make has a direct impact on our 40,000+ customers, our business, and our collective success. We need people who take pride in uncovering customer needs, who turn complex problems into simple solutions, challenge the way things are done (respectfully), and always aim high. With great ambitions driving us forward, we can’t say we’ve got this whole thing figured out. And frankly, that’s half the fun! What we can say is that we’re a driven, progressive, and, importantly, a kind bunch of 850+ people from over 100 nationalities, all committed to delivering the future of business spending, together.

Please note: applications will be open until Tuesday 13th October 2026 at 08.00 CEST.
We will not review any application before the closing date so please use this time to submit a high quality application.

About the role

We're looking for a Senior Backend Engineer to join the Data Serving team that owns the production-grade boundary between Pleo's raw product data and everyone who consumes it, including internal product teams, AI agents, and customers directly accessing their own data. This Senior Backend Engineer role builds and owns that boundary: APIs and the low-latency serving layer underneath it. You will build customer-facing infrastructure where contract stability and latency are non-negotiable, and where the clean abstraction you maintain is what lets every downstream consumer trust the data without ever touching a raw source.

Who you’ll be working with and reporting to

You will report to our VP of Data, and work closely with our Staff Data Platform Engineer, Data Engineers, Product Managers and others Engineers across the business. You'll also coordinate closely with the GenAI Platform and Data Infrastructure teams.

What you’ll be doing

As a Senior Backend Engineer, you will:

  • Build and own the Data API boundary: delivering clean, versioned, and performant endpoints for internal dashboards, customer-facing features, and third-party tools (e.g., Fivetran connectors via incremental syncs and cursor pagination).

  • Design and optimise the read models, indexes, and caching strategies in Postgres (and future OLAP stores) to guarantee low-latency query performance.

  • Build reliable integrations with Pleo’s Kotlin-based product backend services to ensure the serving layer surfaces the correct data required for a customer facing feature.

  • Own the reliability and performance of the services you build: monitoring, incident response, and SLOs appropriate to customer-facing infrastructure.

  • Partner with Data Engineers to define clean contracts between the ingestion/aggregation layer and the serving DB, ensuring read patterns match storage schemas.

  • Partner with the Authorization team to secure APIs using industry-standard authentication and authorization protocols.

  • Build a near-real-time data aggregation service to collect and unify data across Pleo services.

  • Design metadata, lineage, and governance capabilities that make the serving layer explainable, auditable, and trustworthy.

  • Own access control and permission management services, including row and column-level data access with full audit trails.

To put things into context, you can expect to work with the following tech stack: AWS (product side), GCP (data side), Docker, Kubernetes, BigQuery, PostgreSQL dbt, Kafka, Airflow, Python, Kotlin and more!

What you bring

You’ll thrive in this role if you have:

  • Strong backend engineering experience building and owning reporting and analytics API services and serving-layer infrastructure.

  • A mindset focusing on reliability, latency, and SLOs.

  • Experience owning API boundary layers including clean endpoint design, versioning, contract stability, and ensuring downstream consumers are never exposed to raw data sources.

  • Strong expertise designing performant read-heavy systems, including relational database optimisation, indexing strategies, materialised views, caching, and API performance tuning.

  • Solid database fundamentals (SQL and non-SQL) and strong SQL querying skills, as well as deep expertise in Kafka.

  • Deep experience with a JVM-based language (Pleo's product backend is Kotlin-based).

  • AWS or GCP with Kubernetes experience. You must be familiar with configuring, deploying and operating containerised applications in a k8s environment.

  • Experience working at the boundary between data systems and product backend services, with a real understanding of the operational differences between the two.

  • Experience in fintech, payments, or other regulated product environments.

  • You understand what it means to design, build and maintain services with high performance, availability and reliability requirements.

  • You have a very deep understanding of the data world and know how to bridge the gap between data and engineering.

This role is not a good fit for you if:

  • You need to operate within very large and structured teams with clear hierarchy. This role sits within a small and specialist team with a lot of autonomy.

  • You do not wish to be responsible for services with high availability requirements. You will be held accountable for the quality and availability of those services alongside your team.

  • You prefer to be handed over clearly defined scope of work. You will be expected to define and design the solutions as much as building them.

How you’ll develop in this role

In your first 6 months at Pleo, you will:

  • Get deep into the current state: the upstream Kotlin services the serving layer will pull from, the internal consumers already waiting on the API (Data & AI Products, GenAI Platform), and any prototype serving logic that needs to be replaced or formalised.

  • Ship the first production version of the Reporting API (a defined set of endpoints with agreed contracts, versioning, and SLOs) with at least one internal consumer live against it.

  • Establish the access control, tenant isolation, and row/column-level security model for the API. You will have proven out low-latency query performance on Postgres, with clear metrics around reliability and SLOs, and established a clear architectural benchmark to understand when (or if) an OLAP layer would ever be necessary.

Please note: We can hire on a remote, hybrid or in-person set-up in any of the locations listed on the advert but you will need to be physically based in the country of your choice with a valid right to work. We are unable to offer visa sponsorship for this role in any of the listed locations.

The Role

This is our first Director of Employee Relations & Compliance for EMEA: a senior, hands-on role owning ER casework, employment law compliance and jurisdictional risk across Germany, the UK, Sweden, Italy, Spain and France.

Based in London, you'll be the standing authority on ER practice in the region. You'll own complex casework end to end, build dedicated ER capability where none exists today, and extend the strength we already have in Stockholm. You'll report to the EMEA People Director, with a path to running an independent function reporting to the CHRO as it scales.

What You'll Do

ER leadership and casework

  • Own complex casework end to end across every market: investigations, grievances, disciplinaries, PIPs and terminations for cause, to a consistently high, legally sound standard.

  • Be the escalation point when a matter turns complex, contested or legally weighted, for Local People Advisory and the wider People org.

  • Hold the bar on case handling: written scoping, contemporaneous documentation, balance-of-probabilities findings, and independent second review of any outcome that could end employment.

Compliance and jurisdictional risk

  • Own employment and ER compliance across all six markets: statutory notice and consultation, works council and union engagement, mandatory filings and register-keeping, and local implementation of the EU Whistleblowing Directive (disclosures run through a separate channel).

  • Maintain the EMEA jurisdiction playbook and horizon-scan for legal changes, flagging implications to leadership early.

  • Engage Employment Counsel at the right moment with a clear written scope, not as a late rescue.

  • Note: comp-related compliance (pay equity, gender pay gap, benefits) sits with Rewards.

Team and capability building

  • Build dedicated ER capability across EMEA, prioritised by risk and case volume, on the foundation of the Stockholm team.

  • Certify and calibrate anyone running a formal ER process, keeping casework consistent as the team grows.

Stakeholder partnership and consistency

  • Act as the quality check for Local People Advisory across EMEA (who sit in People Operations), signing off local ER and compliance work without managing those roles day to day.

  • Partner with People Partners, People Operations, People Tech and Rewards so policy and tooling reflect what EMEA markets need.

  • Turn case patterns into a regular, actionable view for People leadership.

  • Work with your NORAM and APAC counterparts on one shared case taxonomy, system and calibration forum, representing EMEA's regulatory and cultural nuance in global standards.

What You'll Bring

  • Significant experience leading ER, HR compliance or similar at a fast-scaling company, ideally across multiple EMEA jurisdictions.

  • Deep, practical knowledge of employment law and ER practice across several of these markets, and comfort working outside your home jurisdiction.

  • A track record of investigations, disciplinaries and terminations that hold up to scrutiny: calm, neutral and thorough under pressure.

  • Experience building an ER or compliance function from the ground up: process, hiring, and getting a distributed team to one standard.

  • Confidence as a senior, independent voice, comfortable escalating to and influencing leadership.

  • Based in or willing to relocate to London, able to travel across EMEA.

What Success Looks Like

  • Every formal ER matter across the region handled fairly, consistently and to a legally sound standard.

  • A resourced, capable EMEA ER team, built out from London to the markets that need it.

  • The wider People org treats this function as the standing authority on ER and compliance, not a bottleneck.

  • A function ready to stand on its own, with a credible case for direct CHRO reporting.

Mission before ego. Everyone contributes. No one coasts.

This is the most senior seat on the advisory ladder and the person our largest clients trust when it matters most. In legal AI, that trust is hard-won: matters run to fixed dates, data is privileged, and clients hold Legora to the same standard of care they apply to their own work. Part technical advisor, part incident lead, part operating model owner, you hold the technical health of Legora's most complex client relationships and define the playbook the whole function runs on.

What you’ll do

  • Own the relationship: Hold the technical health and escalation outcomes for our Strategic Accounts, serving as their primary point of escalation and continuity, and read usage and adoption signals to get ahead of risk.

Carry technical context from implementation into the live relationship so nothing is lost in the handoff and the whole account team can rely on it.

  • Coordinate escalations: Align the Platform Consultants and the Technical Platform Expert around a single resolution path, holding customer-facing ownership while technical root cause is driven in parallel.

What you bring

  • Global collaboration: Partner with teams and clients across regions, on work that crosses every major legal market.

About Lendable

Lendable is on a mission to build the world's best technology to help people get credit and save money. We're building one of the world’s leading fintech companies and are off to a strong start:

  • One of the UK’s most exciting unicorns with a team of over 800 people

  • Among the fastest-growing tech companies in the UK

  • Profitable since 2017

  • Backed by top investors including Balderton Capital and Goldman Sachs

  • Loved by customers with the best reviews in the market (4.9 across 10,000s of reviews on Trustpilot)

So far, we’ve rebuilt the Big Three consumer finance products from scratch: loans, credit cards and car finance. We get money into our customers’ hands in minutes instead of days.

We’re growing fast, and there’s a lot more to do: we’re going after the two biggest Western markets (UK and US) where trillions worth of financial products are held by big banks with dated systems and painful processes.

Join us if you want to

  1. Take ownership: you are trusted to make decisions that drive a material impact on the direction and success of Lendable from day 1

  2. Work in small teams of exceptional people: Lendies are relentlessly resourceful. We challenge the status quo to solve problems and find smarter solutions

  3. Build the best technology in-house: we use new data sources, machine learning and AI to make machines do the heavy lifting

About the role

The Front-Line Operations Agent plays a vital customer-facing role, responsible for delivering high-quality support for a designated Lendable product, encompassing both general customer service and financial support. You will follow established processes to resolve a variety of complex customer queries, ensuring interactions are efficient, accurate, and empathetic—applying your cross-functional expertise across general service needs and more intricate financial support situations. By taking ownership of every enquiry from first contact to final resolution, you will not only deliver exceptional customer outcomes but also provide actionable feedback and insights to help improve our automated tools and AI-driven customer journeys. This role is key in ensuring our service continually evolves to better meet the needs of all customers. You’ll be based in our London office, joining the team on-site three days a week. You’ll work two weekends a month, but to keep your work-life balance in check, you’ll get a day in lieu the week before to ensure you never work more than five days a week.

Key Responsibilities

  • Deliver exceptional support for a designated Lendable product, expertly handling a full spectrum of customer service and financial support queries via multiple channels, efficiently executing established processes.

  • Listen actively and provide clear, accurate responses, adapting communication style to each customer's needs, including those in vulnerable situations or with complex financial queries including customers in financial difficulty to ensure appropriate support solutions are implemented.

  • Take end-to-end ownership of customer interactions, ensuring every query is managed through to effective resolution or appropriate escalation.

  • Build rapport and trust while maintaining control of conversations, ensuring positive and compliant customer outcomes.

  • Ask effective probing questions to understand a customer’s financial circumstances and identify appropriate support options.

  • Work flexibly within your designated product area, adapting fluidly between general customer service and financial support requirements, and responding to varying service needs and complex customer queries.

Operational Excellence & Process Execution

  • Meet and exceed targets and KPIs related to customer satisfaction, quality, and compliance by consistently following key operational procedures and applying appropriate judgement to specific customer circumstances.

  • Effectively use AI and digital tools to streamline customer interactions and deliver faster, more accurate service.

  • Identify blockers, process gaps, or recurring issues and communicate these to relevant teams, supporting continuous improvement initiatives.

  • Log all interactions accurately and ensure data integrity for audit and learning purposes.

Continuous Improvement & Feedback

  • Provide clear, actionable feedback from frontline experiences to enhance our knowledge base, training resources, and AI systems.

  • Participate in process reviews and contribute suggestions to enhance the customer journey, automation, and operational efficiency.

  • Remain up to date with ongoing system, product, and process changes, readily adapting to evolving procedures.

Learning & Development

  • Respond positively to coaching and feedback, using it to improve performance and customer outcomes.

  • Demonstrate initiative in learning new tools, products, and procedures as they are introduced.

  • Share knowledge and support colleagues, helping to create a culture of collaborative learning.

Experience & Skills

  • Previous experience in a contact centre environment, with demonstrated experience in both customer service and financial support roles (or a combined equivalent), particularly within financial services.

  • Demonstrated ability to handle complex queries with empathy, accuracy, and ownership.

  • Confident in following structured processes and able to identify opportunities to improve them.

  • Strong communication, rapport-building, and conflict resolution skills.

  • Skilled in using digital tools and comfortable adopting new technologies, including AI-driven platforms.

  • Organised and able to manage multiple tasks in a fast-paced setting.

  • Proactive in offering feedback and participating in process and AI improvement initiatives.

Behaviours & Approach

  • Customer-focused, with a passion for delivering consistent, positive outcomes.

  • Resilient, adaptable, and open to constant change and learning.

  • Collaborative, supportive team player committed to shared success.

  • High level of accountability and personal ownership for customer outcomes and process execution.

  • Constructive, solutions-focused approach with willingness to challenge the status quo.

Perks & Benefits

  • More Time to Unwind Start with 25 days of holiday, plus extra days to reward your loyalty! Hit your 1-year milestone and get 26 days, or 27 days after 2+ years.

  • Own a Share of Our Growth We want you to have skin in the game. You’ll receive Company Equity, meaning as we scale, you directly share in our financial success.

  • Health & Wellbeing Peace of mind comes standard with comprehensive private medical and dental insurance from day one.

  • Smash Targets, Get Rewarded Earn up to a £4,000 annual performance bonus based on hitting key team metrics and KPIs.

  • Perks & Recognition via Reward Gateway Access hundreds of exclusive employee discounts, alongside our brand-new recognition programme tied to our core competencies. Plus, enjoy dedicated team budgets for ad hoc, monthly, quarterly, and annual awards!

  • Legendary Socials & Summer Events We love to celebrate our hard work! From team get-togethers to our epic annual Summer Day Event, featuring great food, a BBQ, and plenty of fun, there are always opportunities to connect and unwind with colleagues across the business.

Our Interview Process
We want to get to know you, and we want you to get to know us! Here is what you can expect:

  • Step 1: Talent Screening Call and Mock CRM/Email Exercise A quick chat with a member of our Talent Acquisition team to talk through your experience, what you are looking for, and answers to any initial questions you have. You will also complete a quick task where you will be navigating through a mock - CRM system and replying to some email enquiries

  • Step 2: Onsite Interview & Role Preview A 1-hour interview at our London office. To give you a true feel for our environment, you will also have the optional chance to jump on a live call-listening session to experience the role firsthand!

Life at Lendable

  • Winning team: the opportunity to scale up one of the world’s most successful fintech companies

  • Flexible working: flexible approach tailored to each role. Hybrid roles require three days in-office weekly; fully remote roles include regular opportunities for in-person connection through socials and off-sites

We're looking for a Senior Accountant to join our management accounts and controllership function. This is the team that delivers the monthly close for the UK group companies and owns the accuracy of what sits behind it.

We're a high-transaction-volume lending business scaling across the UK, US and Mexico. This is a hands-on role for someone who wants to own real deliverables early and help automate and improve the processes within the Financial Reporting team.

What you'll be doing/impact on objectives

  • Deliver monthly close for the UK group companies, accurately and within set timelines

  • Partner with the wider finance team and business stakeholders to prepare product-level P&Ls that support commercial decision-making, help with queries and month-end inputs

15fd1c900759da1d.description:
About Lendable

Lendable is on a mission to build the world's best technology to help people get credit and save money. We're building one of the world’s leading fintech companies and are off to a strong start:

  • One of the UK’s most exciting unicorns with a team of over 800 people

  • Among the fastest-growing tech companies in the UK

  • Profitable since 2017

  • Backed by top investors including Balderton Capital and Goldman Sachs

  • Loved by customers with the best reviews in the market (4.9 across 10,000s of reviews on Trustpilot)

So far, we’ve rebuilt the Big Three consumer finance products from scratch: loans, credit cards and car finance. We get money into our customers’ hands in minutes instead of days.

We’re growing fast, and there’s a lot more to do: we’re going after the two biggest Western markets (UK and US) where trillions worth of financial products are held by big banks with dated systems and painful processes.

Join us if you want to

  1. Take ownership: you are trusted to make decisions that drive a material impact on the direction and success of Lendable from day 1

  2. Work in small teams of exceptional people: Lendies are relentlessly resourceful. We challenge the status quo to solve problems and find smarter solutions

  3. Build the best technology in-house: we use new data sources, machine learning and AI to make machines do the heavy lifting

About the role

As we grow, we’re looking to expand our Complaints handling team. As an excellent communicator, you will quickly build relationships with customers and other departments across Lendable to understand customer friction points and come to fair and objective decisions.

If you have experience of either handling complex complaints (preferably motor or secured product related) or have worked in the automotive finance sector and have the following skills we’d love to hear from you:

  • Problem solving and decision making skills - putting the customer at the heart of everything you do

  • The ability to assess and critique evidence coming to a fair and comprehensive decision

  • Be able to shift focus and re-prioritise workloads based on business and customer needs

  • Great phone and written communication skills, being clear and concise to promote customer understanding.

  • The ability to build rapport and manage multiple third parties including ensuring that customer expectations are managed.

Also, even better if you have:

  • Experience of working in a regulated motor finance environment

  • An understanding of the Consumer Rights Act 2015

  • An understanding of Motor related policies and industry standards

  • The ability to comprehend complex Satisfactory Quality-related complaints

  • Strong experience working with the Financial Ombudsman Service (FOS).

Your team’s objectives

Lendable aims to resolve all complaints promptly, ensuring that they are investigated diligently and fairly for customers. Lendable is committed to providing excellent customer service and ensuring that it reaches the right outcomes for our customers.

Feedback is an important part of how we can evolve as a business to ensure that we are meeting our customers' expectations and continuously improving our service and the team is encouraged to speak up, take each complaint on its own merits and provide valuable insights to the business in order to improve and grow.

Our ability to handle complaints effectively for our customers, and therefore to the benefit of us as a business, has never been more important than now; as we expand our existing products in the UK and US financial markets.

How you’ll impact those objectives

The ideal candidate will have experience of resolving complaints or customer disputes within a regulated environment and have an aptitude for investigating, analysing, problem-solving and dispute resolution.

  • You will be able to self manage a varied and complex caseload, identifying best contact mechanisms for customers and prioritising cases where appropriate to be highly productive and efficient, and to maintain the required level of performance against our KPI minimum standards.

  • You will champion using our AI tools and technology to bring a first class service to our customers.

  • You will work well under pressure and be adaptable, being able to turn your hand to other areas of operational need, as the business may require.

  • You will ensure that you follow our complaint handling standards, have good record keeping skills and ensure that all decisions made are backed up with demonstrable evidence and rationale.

  • You will work closely with the Complaints Team, to resolve complaints about our loans, cards and auto-finance products, as well as be responsible for feeding back to both frontline and product teams on product and process improvements across the Operations Team and wider Lendable business.

  • You will be responsible for communicating with the complainant, either in writing or by phone and will enjoy finding solutions to issues raised, managing customer expectations and handling difficult situations with tact and professionalism.

  • You will have a good knowledge and understanding of FCA regulation as well as DISP complaint handling rules and guidance.

  • You will also ensure that you maintain up to date knowledge of Lendable’s products through effective use and review of policies, procedures and business tools made available to you.

  • You will have strong letter writing skills, being able to create professional final response letters which break down complex issues into comprehensible information for consumers to understand.

2835f2ad33372571.description:
About Lendable

Lendable is on a mission to build the world's best technology to help people get credit and save money. We're building one of the world’s leading fintech companies and are off to a strong start:

  • One of the UK’s most exciting unicorns with a team of over 800 people

  • Among the fastest-growing tech companies in the UK

  • Profitable since 2017

  • Backed by top investors including Balderton Capital and Goldman Sachs

  • Loved by customers with the best reviews in the market (4.9 across 10,000s of reviews on Trustpilot)

So far, we’ve rebuilt the Big Three consumer finance products from scratch: loans, credit cards and car finance. We get money into our customers’ hands in minutes instead of days.

We’re growing fast, and there’s a lot more to do: we’re going after the two biggest Western markets (UK and US) where trillions worth of financial products are held by big banks with dated systems and painful processes.

Join us if you want to

  1. Take ownership: you are trusted to make decisions that drive a material impact on the direction and success of Lendable from day 1

  2. Work in small teams of exceptional people: Lendies are relentlessly resourceful. We challenge the status quo to solve problems and find smarter solutions

  3. Build the best technology in-house: we use new data sources, machine learning and AI to make machines do the heavy lifting

About the role

We’re entering a once-in-a-company moment: a major step-change in our D2C marketing investment, a full rebrand of the company and product under the Zable brand, and a marketing function being built out at pace. This is one of the most exciting marketing builds in UK fintech right now, with the financial strength, customer base, and product depth to back it up.

Direct Mail is one of our highest-potential channels and we’re hiring a leader to turn it into a scaled, precise, and defensible growth engine. We’re looking for a Head of Direct Mail to own the channel end-to-end: creative, sends, logistics, offers, and reporting, sourcing the data pipeline and user-data enrichment that let us target the right customer, with the right offer, at the right moment.

You'll lead the channel's dedicated analysts and work with our creative team. Your job is to set the direction: decide who we mail, with what offer and when, commission and challenge the selection and response models, and hold every campaign to CAC and LTV targets.

Standalone direct mail roles with this kind of budget and autonomy are rare. If you've got significant experience in acquisition mail and want to build a channel your own way, at a profitable business with the product range and analytical capabilities to make it work, this is the role.

What we’re looking for:

Essential:

  • 5+ years in direct mail, including at least 2–3 years owning an acquisition DM programme end to end: strategy, budget, data, production and results.

  • A track record of mailing cold prospects at meaningful scale. You'll be able to talk through the volumes, budgets, response rates and CPAs you've been accountable for.

  • Experience procuring data: working with data suppliers on list selection, screening, enrichment and cost.

  • Deep knowledge of the DM supply chain: print, lettershop, Royal Mail products (Advertising Mail, Mailmark, partially addressed, door drops) and suppression (MPS, goneaways, deceased).

  • A strongly commercial approach. You build the business case, forecast volumes and returns, own the channel P&L, and measure spend on CAC, ROI and payback rather than pieces mailed.

  • Strong analytical judgement. You design test cells and holdouts, read results critically, and understand response and propensity modelling well enough to brief analysts, challenge their work and turn it into mailing decisions.

  • Experience managing suppliers: tendering, negotiating, setting SLAs and keeping several partners to schedule.

  • The ability to run a multi-drop campaign calendar across products, segments, creative, compliance sign-off, production and mail dates.

  • Experience leading analysts and working closely with creative teams.

  • A clear communicator who earns the trust of finance, risk, compliance and data teams.

  • Demonstrable use of AI in your workflow.

Desirable:

  • Experience in acquisition mail in financial services, especially credit cards or loans, including prescreened or pre-approved offers and risk-based targeting.

  • Experience standing up a data pipeline or enrichment stack (first-party + third-party / bureau data)

  • Experience building a channel or function from scratch

  • Background hiring and developing an analytics or design team

You’re a good fit if you’re:

  • Acquisition-minded: you're energised by finding new customers, not re-contacting existing ones.

  • Commercially driven: you measure success in incremental LTV and payback, not response rate alone.

  • A first-principles thinker: you argue from data and clean experiments, not received wisdom

  • Organised: you can run several drops across multiple suppliers and still hit mailing deadlines.

  • Energised by greenfield: you’d rather build the engine than tune someone else’s

What you’ll be doing

Strategy and commercials

  • Own the direct mail strategy and set volume, response and payback targets anchored to LTV.

  • Own the channel P&L: forecasting, budget and CAC/LTV discipline.

  • Decide how far and how fast to scale, based on the economics.

Data and targeting

  • Source and buy prospect data from bureaus and brokers, and combine it with our first-party data.

  • Direct the analysts building the response and propensity models that decide who we mail, with what offer and when.

  • Work with risk analysts to shape offers around eligibility and lifetime value.

Campaigns and supplier management

  • Plan and run the campaign calendar, from data selection to the mail landing on doormats.

  • Select, negotiate with and manage print and postal suppliers on cost, quality and turnaround.

  • Brief the creative team on packs, copy and offers, and take them through compliance sign-off.

Reporting & Team

  • Build the reporting that ties sends to funnel, revenue and LTV and report on channel performance

  • Partner with data, product, risk, finance and the creative team to unlock targeting and offers

  • Hire and develop the team as the channel scales, and use AI to let a small team punch above its weight

Life at Lendable

  • Winning team: the opportunity to scale up one of the world’s most successful fintech companies

  • Flexible working: flexible approach tailored to each role. Hybrid roles require three days in-office weekly; fully remote roles include regular opportunities for in-person connection through socials and off-sites

  • Socials & connection: opportunities and events to come together, socialise, and get to know each other beyond the office walls

  • Health coverage: support for your physical and mental wellbeing, including private health cover

  • Retirement & savings: long-term financial wellbeing through retirement savings plans

  • Employee referral programme: earn a competitive bonus when you refer successful new team members

  • Office meals & snacks: enjoy a fully stocked kitchen, plus complimentary lunches prepared by in-house chefs on in-office days at select locations

  • Sustainable commuting: cycle-to-work and electric vehicle salary sacrifice schemes available in select locations

Please note: The availability and details of specific benefits vary by location and role. For more information, please speak to your Talent Partner.
