9edf8fb6a77f266a.title: Customer Service Specialist
9edf8fb6a77f266a.description:
About Lendable

Lendable is on a mission to build the world's best technology to help people get credit and save money. We're building one of the world’s leading fintech companies and are off to a strong start:

  • One of the UK’s most exciting unicorns with a team of over 800 people

  • Among the fastest-growing tech companies in the UK

  • Profitable since 2017

  • Backed by top investors including Balderton Capital and Goldman Sachs

  • Loved by customers with the best reviews in the market (4.9 across 10,000s of reviews on Trustpilot)

So far, we’ve rebuilt the Big Three consumer finance products from scratch: loans, credit cards and car finance. We get money into our customers’ hands in minutes instead of days.

We’re growing fast, and there’s a lot more to do: we’re going after the two biggest Western markets (UK and US) where trillions worth of financial products are held by big banks with dated systems and painful processes.

Join us if you want to

  1. Take ownership: you are trusted to make decisions that drive a material impact on the direction and success of Lendable from day 1

  2. Work in small teams of exceptional people: Lendies are relentlessly resourceful. We challenge the status quo to solve problems and find smarter solutions

  3. Build the best technology in-house: we use new data sources, machine learning and AI to make machines do the heavy lifting

About the role

The Front-Line Operations Agent plays a vital customer-facing role, responsible for delivering high-quality support for a designated Lendable product, encompassing both general customer service and financial support. You will follow established processes to resolve a variety of complex customer queries, ensuring interactions are efficient, accurate, and empathetic—applying your cross-functional expertise across general service needs and more intricate financial support situations. By taking ownership of every enquiry from first contact to final resolution, you will not only deliver exceptional customer outcomes but also provide actionable feedback and insights to help improve our automated tools and AI-driven customer journeys. This role is key in ensuring our service continually evolves to better meet the needs of all customers. You’ll be based in our Chatham office, joining the team on-site three days a week. You’ll work two weekends a month, but to keep your work-life balance in check, you’ll get a day in lieu the week before to ensure you never work more than five days a week.

Key Responsibilities

  • Deliver exceptional support for a designated Lendable product, expertly handling a full spectrum of customer service and financial support queries via multiple channels, efficiently executing established processes.

  • Listen actively and provide clear, accurate responses, adapting communication style to each customer's needs, including those in vulnerable situations or with complex financial queries including customers in financial difficulty to ensure appropriate support solutions are implemented.

  • Take end-to-end ownership of customer interactions, ensuring every query is managed through to effective resolution or appropriate escalation.

  • Build rapport and trust while maintaining control of conversations, ensuring positive and compliant customer outcomes.

  • Ask effective probing questions to understand a customer’s financial circumstances and identify appropriate support options.

  • Work flexibly within your designated product area, adapting fluidly between general customer service and financial support requirements, and responding to varying service needs and complex customer queries.

Operational Excellence & Process Execution

  • Meet and exceed targets and KPIs related to customer satisfaction, quality, and compliance by consistently following key operational procedures and applying appropriate judgement to specific customer circumstances.

  • Effectively use AI and digital tools to streamline customer interactions and deliver faster, more accurate service.

  • Identify blockers, process gaps, or recurring issues and communicate these to relevant teams, supporting continuous improvement initiatives.

  • Log all interactions accurately and ensure data integrity for audit and learning purposes.

Continuous Improvement & Feedback

  • Provide clear, actionable feedback from frontline experiences to enhance our knowledge base, training resources, and AI systems.

  • Participate in process reviews and contribute suggestions to enhance the customer journey, automation, and operational efficiency.

  • Remain up to date with ongoing system, product, and process changes, readily adapting to evolving procedures.

Learning & Development

  • Respond positively to coaching and feedback, using it to improve performance and customer outcomes.

  • Demonstrate initiative in learning new tools, products, and procedures as they are introduced.

  • Share knowledge and support colleagues, helping to create a culture of collaborative learning.

Experience & Skills

  • Previous experience in a contact centre environment, with demonstrated experience in both customer service and financial support roles (or a combined equivalent), particularly within financial services.

  • Demonstrated ability to handle complex queries with empathy, accuracy, and ownership.

  • Confident in following structured processes and able to identify opportunities to improve them.

  • Strong communication, rapport-building, and conflict resolution skills.

  • Skilled in using digital tools and comfortable adopting new technologies, including AI-driven platforms.

  • Organised and able to manage multiple tasks in a fast-paced setting.

  • Proactive in offering feedback and participating in process and AI improvement initiatives.

Behaviours & Approach

  • Customer-focused, with a passion for delivering consistent, positive outcomes.

  • Resilient, adaptable, and open to constant change and learning.

  • Collaborative, supportive team player committed to shared success.

  • High level of accountability and personal ownership for customer outcomes and process execution.

  • Constructive, solutions-focused approach with willingness to challenge the status quo.

Perks & Benefits

  • More Time to Unwind Start with 25 days of holiday, plus extra days to reward your loyalty! Hit your 1-year milestone and get 26 days, or 27 days after 2+ years.

  • Own a Share of Our Growth We want you to have skin in the game. You’ll receive Company Equity, meaning as we scale, you directly share in our financial success.

  • Health & Wellbeing Peace of mind comes standard with comprehensive private medical and dental insurance from day one.

a0b82cfdcaf211df.description:
🚀 About WRITER

WRITER is the AI platform built for the world’s most ambitious marketing and revenue teams, bringing the frontier of AI to the people who drive enterprise growth. With WRITER, autonomous agents work across the buyer journey, continuously executing on market signals and enterprise intelligence to grow revenue faster. Every agent action and asset is grounded in trust, built on an Enterprise Brain that unites brand, product, and company knowledge with fiduciary-grade governance and compliance.

 

Fortune 500 companies are transforming how they go to market with WRITER, including 3 of the top 5 US banks, 2 of the 5 largest global CPG conglomerates, and 4 of the top 5 US healthcare insurers. Founded in 2020, WRITER is backed by investors including Insight Partners, ICONIQ, Radical Ventures, Premji Invest, Balderton, B Capital, Salesforce Ventures, Adobe Ventures, Accenture, Citi Ventures, IBM Ventures, WndrCo, and others. Learn more at WRITER.com.

 

📐 About the role

Every company grows differently, and at WRITER, our growth is directly tied to empowering our users to create better content, faster, and at an unprecedented scale. As a strategic solutions architect, you'll be at the forefront of this mission, working directly with our largest and most strategic prospects to identify, validate, and build innovative generative AI solutions that unlock massive business value. This isn't just about selling a product; it's about deeply understanding complex enterprise needs and architecting a future where AI transforms how our customers operate. You'll be instrumental in shaping how the world's leading companies adopt and scale AI, making a tangible impact on both their success and WRITER’s continued leadership in the enterprise generative AI space.

This is a full-time, hybrid role based out of our London hub. You will report directly to the Director of solutions architecture.

 

🦸🏻‍♀️ What you'll do

  • Drive strategic technical discovery with Fortune 500 prospects and customers, translating complex business challenges into clear, impactful technical solutions for AI-powered work

  • Architect and design robust, scalable, and secure generative AI solutions for enterprise clients, leveraging WRITER's platform, APIs, and custom applications to solve critical business problems

  • Lead the development and execution of compelling proofs of concept (PoCs) and demonstrations, building custom templates and integrating WRITER's capabilities to showcase transformative value and accelerate time-to-value for customers

  • Serve as a trusted technical advisor to C-suite executives, VPs of Engineering, and AI leaders, guiding their generative AI strategy and collaborating to define enterprise-level architecture roadmaps

  • Partner closely with WRITER's product and engineering teams, providing critical feedback from customer engagements to influence our product roadmap and ensure our solutions meet evolving market needs

  • Champion the adoption of WRITER's platform and APIs, educating prospects and partners on the art of the possible with generative AI and empowering them to build their own innovative solutions

 

⭐️ What you need

  • 5+ years of experience in technical customer-facing roles such as solutions architect, enterprise architect, or sales engineering, ideally within a high-growth, B2B SaaS company serving Fortune 500 clients

  • Deep expertise in generative AI principles, large language models (LLMs), and prompt engineering best practices, with a passion for staying ahead of the curve in this rapidly evolving field

  • Experience in Python, proficiency with APIs, and end-to-end orchestration, to augment AI workflows and integrate AI capabilities into complex enterprise systems

  • Exceptional communication and presentation skills, able to simplify complex technical concepts into clear, compelling business language for diverse audiences, from technical teams to executive leadership

  • A highly versatile and tenured problem solver, capable of leading multi-stakeholder discovery sessions, uncovering root causes, and architecting innovative solutions to complex business and technical challenges

  • A builder's mindset and a proven ability to connect deeply with customer needs, challenge the status quo with innovative AI solutions, and own the technical success and impact of client engagements

🍩 Benefits & perks (UK full-time employees):

  • Generous PTO, plus company holidays

  • Comprehensive medical and dental insurance

  • Paid parental leave for all parents (16 weeks)

  • Fertility and family planning support

  • Competitive pension scheme and company contribution

  • Annual work-life stipends for:

    • Wellness stipend for gym, massage/chiropractor, personal training, etc.

    • Learning and development stipend

  • Company-wide off-sites and team off-sites

  • Competitive compensation and company stock options

775a72ba84c2089f.title: Executive Assistant
775a72ba84c2089f.description:
📍 Manchester, UK (Hybrid 1 day WFH) | 💰 £50,000 - £55,000

Street Group is a fast moving B2B SaaS business - grown in Manchester but on a UK wide mission to make moving house as easy as buying a car. We’ve recently raised strategic growth investment, and are scaling fast toward an ambitious growth plan - and we’re looking for an experienced Executive Assistant to support our Co-CEOs, so they can spend their time on growing the business.

This is an opportunity for someone to join a scaling business during one of our most exciting chapters yet, and to build close relationships with Founders who both value and reward excellence.

If you are organised, trustworthy, and dependable, and know what separates exceptional EAs from good ones - we think you might do great work here.

How you’ll make a difference

  • You make sure the Co-CEOs are spending their time on things that only they can do. You run their diaries and inboxes, delegate work where possible, and say no to people when a day is already full.

  • You’ll make sure meetings with them are worth having - e.g. there's a defined agendas, people turn up prepared, and actions get followed up on. Before board and investor meetings, you’ll make sure they know the numbers and what’s in the board pack.

Who we’re looking for

  • You’re an experienced EA, have worked with a CEO or founder before and understand the appropriate level of support for stakeholders at this level.

  • You’re super organised, and can juggle requests coming in from multiple people with different ways of working.

  • You’re trustworthy and reliable.

  • You have exceptional attention to detail.

  • You can build good relationships with people, and are able to say no to protect the founder’s diaries without souring relationships.

  • Bonus points if you’re comfortable using AI tools - but it won’t rule you out!

Why you might not want to apply

We'd rather be honest up front, because this role won't be for everyone.

  • If you'd rather work for one person. You'll be balancing two founders' priorities, plus travel for our senior leaders - so you’ll be juggling different requirements and ways of working.

  • If you want to work mostly from home. This role is 4 days a week in our Manchester office, so you're on hand when people need you.

If that sounds like your kind of role, please apply and let us know why!

Who are Street Group?

We’re an award-winning PropTech business based in Manchester, founded in 2015 by brother and sister duo, Tom & Heather Staff. Most of us have personal experience of how painful moving can be, and Tom and Heather saw an opportunity to change this: utilising technology, as well as our incredibly talented team, to improve the industry for everyone.

Our products, Street.co.uk, Spectre & Cortex form a powerful trio, working harmoniously together to transform an agent’s job. From securing more leads and winning new instructions to streamlining business operations and growing market share, our products are supercharging 1,000s of agencies across the UK.

Why join Street Group?

🏠 Hybrid-working - you can work from home 1 day per week
🏖️ Guilt-Free R&R - £1000 towards a holiday after your first year with the team (we'll even cover the tax!)
💪 Structured career growth and ongoing professional development
📚 £500 yearly L&D budget
🎂 Your birthday on us - we pay, you stay away
🙋 ‘Give something back’ - 2 paid days volunteering on us
👶 Enhanced maternity, paternity & adoption pay
🧠 Mental health & well-being support via Health Assured
🧘 Regular well-being initiatives
🚂 Public transport season ticket loans
🌷 Paid menopause leave
🌞 Holiday buying scheme
🚀 Joining a new team in an exciting business with huge ambition
👥 Be a part of something bigger - everyone in our team is passionate about improving the entire property industry! It's a huge goal, but it motivates us to do better every single day
👩🏿‍💻 A chance to work on cutting-edge technology
🐶 Comfortable, relaxed office space - office dogs welcome!
🍻 Fully stocked fridge and beers (or an alternative) on us every Friday afternoon
🎊 Company and team off-sites, events and happy hours
🚴 Cycle to work scheme
🚗 Electric car salary sacrifice scheme
🌍 Feel good about sustainability - we're a climate-positive company!

Salary

£50,000 - £55,000, depending on experience. However, sometimes the perfect person is far more or less experienced than we anticipated. In these situations, planned ranges go out the window. If you think that might be the case, please apply and just let us know.

We care deeply about helping the tech industry become a more inclusive and diverse place, and we work hard to lead by example. We are committed to Equal Employment Opportunity through attracting and retaining a complementary team of employees and building an inclusive environment for all. Candidates must be eligible to live and work in the UK and be able to perform the work specified.

Interview Process

2 stages = 45-minute video call with our Head of People > In-person interview with our Co-CEOs.

We want to make our interviews as inclusive as possible, so if you need any adjustments made or if there's anything you think we should be aware of during the interview process, please do let us know.

A note on using AI in your job application

As a fast-moving and rapidly evolving tech company, we embrace the advantages of AI and encourage its use throughout our application process. However, our goal is to get to know and hire the authentic you - your skills, experience, and values. We don’t want to hire an AI-generated version of you. We consider AI to be a valuable tool, not something that should overshadow you as an individual.

How we use AI in the hiring process

Candidate experience is really important to us, and our Talent team use AI notetakers during interviews so they can focus purely on their conversation with you. All hiring decisions are made by humans - not AI. Let us know if you have any questions!

7efb9391d1ee7155.description:
📍 Manchester (Hybrid) | 💰 £70,000 - £90,000

Street Group is one of the fastest-growing PropTech companies in the UK. We want to be the leading creator of delightful experiences for everybody involved in buying, selling, renting and letting property, and we're doing that by giving UK estate agencies world-class technology.

Our Product team is at the heart of that mission. We find the most valuable problems to solve, ship quality solutions, and measure the impact along the way. As we grow, we're bringing in a Product Lead to own a significant product area and help raise the standard of product across the team. You'll have real ownership, a team that collaborates well, and the freedom to make decisions, not just ship someone else's roadmap.


What you'll be doing

In this high-impact role, you will oversee a core domain that spans multiple product lines. You will drive strategy across critical functional areas, while directly managing and developing a team of Product Managers.

  • Own the strategy, roadmap, and outcomes for your product area, with autonomy from day one to deliver commercial success.

  • Line-manage and develop Product Managers in the team: 1:1s, coaching, and helping people grow.

  • Set the standard for discovery, prioritisation, and stakeholder communication across the product function.

A bit about you

  • Have owned an (ideally B2B) software product end to end, and are able to evidence measurable outcomes (revenue, retention, adoption or conversion).

  • Experience managing and mentoring other PMs. You know what good looks like and you help others get there.

  • Confidence working without a lot of direction. You can set your own course and bring people with you.

  • Are customer obsessed, love spending time with customers and have run discovery directly with them, working alongside a product designer or UX researcher.

  • Strong communication skills - you can explain what you built, why you built it, and what it achieved.

  • A drive to improve not just your product area, but how the whole team operates.

You should apply for this role if...

  • You want a real domain to own, not a feature set.

  • You want to keep building product while growing people.

  • You like a blank page. It is a new role, so you define what the Product Lead role looks like here and set the standard for discovery, prioritisation and stakeholder communication.

  • You work better without close direction. You will have autonomy from day one and are expected to set your own course.

  • You have already made AI part of how you work - or are experimenting with it in your personal life. Day-to-day and strategically, AI usage at Street Group is an expectation.


You should not apply for this role if...

  • You are used to working within strict guidelines and are not used to autonomy.

  • You want to be solely hands on or off, as this roles requires both at various points.

  • You have not managed, mentored, or coached PMs before.

Why Street Group
Product actually matters here. You'll have real ownership, a team that collaborates well, and the freedom to make decisions, not just ship someone else's roadmap.


Why join Street Group?

A boutique law firm is seeking a senior debt finance attorney to lead bespoke secured lending and private credit transactions. This role offers substantial autonomy and the opportunity to help shape and grow the firm's debt finance practice.

About the role

 

Kraken Analytics are the team who lead on data and analytics products, workflows, and analyses in the Kraken world. We build and maintain core, curated datasets–A “Unified Data Layer” comprising tables, a semantic layer, and dashboards–that Kraken’s clients and internal teams use for a broad range of analytical use cases.

 

Industry is at the beating heart of the business for Kraken's clients, with massive amounts of data being passed around and complex processes occurring every day. Your focus will be on building the data assets our clients need to understand their business, in close collaboration with our Product and delivery teams. You’ll focus especially on the data models that underlie clients’ mission-critical financial and regulatory reporting.

 

Our data stack:

We run a modern cloud data platform using key technologies such as:

  • Postgres source databases

  • AWS cloud infrastructure

  • Databricks Delta Lake for data lake and warehouse storage and querying

  • dbt(™) for data modelling and transformations

  • Python as main scripting language

  • Airflow for task scheduling

  • Kubernetes for orchestration

  • Github and Circle CI for version control, deployment and monitoring

What you'll do:

  • Become a subject matter expert on the Kraken data model, especially regarding financial and regulatory reporting.

  • Lead on building models, data flows, and metrics specific to your expertise.

  • Work with Data and Product leadership to prioritize projects across our clients.

  • Be exposed to new technologies and tools, and receive guidance on developing your skills.

  • Build and maintain dashboards and data apps for senior stakeholders.

  • Contribute to the development of the Kraken Analytics team and to our coding standards, continuous integration testing, and AI readiness.

  • Lead and own major strategic projects end to end.

  • Work closely with a broad range of teams at Kraken.

  • Continue to develop your analytics engineering skills.

What you'll have:

We’re looking for someone who combines market industry knowledge and experience with a passion for working with data.

  • Strong level of data skills/analytics experience. Comfortable with energy/utilities and other relevant subject areas.

  • Learns fast and is enthusiastic about learning new technologies & processes.

  • Has strong experience with SQL, dbt, and a modern cloud warehouse (Databricks preferred but not required).

  • Experience building data pipelines and working with engineering teams.

  • Curious and self driven - when faced with a new problem is capable of seeking out an answer without lots of help and support.

  • Highly data literate and numerate - can make sense of lots of data and shape it into a coherent story.

  • Great communicator, can explain complex technical problems to non-technical teams.

  • Comfortable working with AI tools to automate rote work, but does not offload critical thinking or professional judgement.

fb5534576a234902.title: Associate
fb5534576a234902.description:
Why Faculty?


We established Faculty in 2014 because we thought that AI would be the most important technology of our time. Since then, we’ve worked with over 350 global customers to transform their performance through human-centric AI. You can read about our real-world impact here.

We don’t chase hype cycles. We innovate, build and deploy responsible AI which moves the needle - and we know a thing or two about doing it well. We bring an unparalleled depth of technical, product and delivery expertise to our clients who span government, finance, retail, energy, life sciences and defence.

Our business, and reputation, is growing fast and we’re always on the lookout for individuals who share our intellectual curiosity and desire to build a positive legacy through technology.

AI is an epoch-defining technology, join a company where you’ll be empowered to envision its most powerful applications, and to make them happen.

 

About the team

 

Our Energy, Transition and Environment business unit is pioneering meaningful change in the clean energy revolution. Our vision is to accelerate the transition to net-zero emissions and drive efficiencies for a new era of utility companies.

 

We believe that the responsible, and intelligent, deployment of AI is critical to the success of this mission. We partner with a wide range of clients - from major energy operators, to GreenTech startups, and national infrastructure providers - to build solutions which return measurable impact and move us towards a smarter, cleaner, and more sustainable world.

 


About the role

 

As an Associate, you’ll be part of a close-knit team - scoping, building and delivering impactful AI projects for our clients in the industry.

We’ll look to you to build trusted client relationships, analyse requirements and feedback, stay on top of workflows and help to ensure our bespoke AI tools are optimised for real-world operations.

This is an exciting, new role for an individual motivated to build their knowledge of AI transformation in the Energy value chain.

 
 

What you'll be doing

 

  • Managing individual work streams to support the successful delivery and implementation of bespoke AI solutions

  • Working side-by-side with Government stakeholders to understand critical mission challenges and user needs

  • Conducting open-source analysis to support the development of cutting-edge AI tools

  • Translating complex operational requirements into clear user stories for delivery and engineering teams.

  • Designing and testing workflows that support user-centric decision-making in high-stakes environments

  • Collaborating closely with technical teams to ensure projects run smoothly and solutions meet customer needs

  • Contributing to internal thought leadership, strategy, and capability development across the team

     

Who we're looking for

 

  • You demonstrate analytical thinking, can clearly communicate ideas, and synthesise complex information

  • You have some experience working on AI/data intensive projects in the Energy sector

  • You have external client-facing experience and have built trusted relationships which have contributed to the overall success of projects/products

  • You’ve worked with technical teams

  • You understand Agile and related methodologies and the basis of iterative development and continuous delivery

  • You are thoughtful and proactive in ambiguous situations, with examples of when you’ve taken initiative and owned finding solutions to challenges

  • You’re excited and knowledgeable about the possibilities for innovation in Government technology

 
 

Our interview process

  1. Talent Team Screen (30 mins)

  2. Introduction Interview (60 mins)

  3. Case Study Interview (60 mins)

Our Recruitment Ethos

We aim to grow the best team - not the most similar one. We know that diversity of individuals fosters diversity of thought, and that strengthens our principle of seeking truth. And we know from experience that diverse teams deliver better work, relevant to the world in which we live. We’re united by a deep intellectual curiosity and desire to use our abilities for measurable positive impact. We strongly encourage applications from people of all backgrounds, ethnicities, genders, religions and sexual orientations.

If you don’t feel you meet all the requirements, but are excited by the role and know you bring some key strengths, please don't hesitate in applying as you might be right for this role, or other roles. We are open to conversations about part-time hours.

A note on AI: we're happy for you to use it for research and interview prep, but please don't use it to generate answers during live interviews. We also use an AI note-taker (Metaview) in interviews so interviewers can stay present (which you can opt out of just let us know,) and every application is reviewed by a human, never decided by AI.

cef0f0d7863c01bc.description:
About Us

Legora is redefining how legal work gets done. Not built for lawyers, built with them. We work alongside the world’s best legal teams, who expect excellence, precision, and speed, and we hold ourselves to the same bar.

Our AI-native workspace lets legal professionals move faster, think more clearly, and operate with sharper precision. By analysing thousands of documents in minutes and powering end-to-end workflows, we cut through complexity, teams can focus on what matters: judgment, strategy, and outcomes.

2,100+ customers across 80+ countries trust us, including Cleary Gottlieb, Goodwin, Linklaters, White & Case, Dentons, and Barclays. We’ve scaled to $200M+ in ARR, with teams across Europe, North America and APAC, and continue to expand through acquisitions including Qura, Walter AI, Graceview, Cadastral, and Wexler.

We partner with world-class performers: including Aaron Judge and the New York Yankees, Ludvig Åberg (and his caddie), and campaigns featuring Jude Law.

Joining Legora means three things.

  • We lean in: ownership over titles, outcomes over intentions.

  • We fight for excellence: high standards, direct, ego-free feedback.

  • We grow together: as a team and with our customers.

Mission before ego. Everyone contributes. No one coasts.

If you’re driven by impact, pace, and raising the bar. This is the place.

The Role

As a Solutions Engineer at Legora, you’ll act as a technical and strategic partner to our sales team, engineering team and prospective clients. You’ll help customers understand how Legora’s solutions solve their most complex technical challenges, lead technical discovery, create custom demonstrations, and support the end-to-end sales process.

This role is ideal for someone with strong technical expertise, excellent communication skills, and a passion for working with customers to drive value. Your work will directly influence Legora’s growth and customer satisfaction.

What You'll Do

  • Lead technical discovery discussions to understand customer pain points, use cases, and requirements.

  • Collaborate with our Legal Engineers to create demos and proof-of-concepts that clearly illustrate how Legora’s solutions address customer challenges and create value.

  • Facilitate technical workshops and proof-of-value sessions.

  • Respond to technical questions, security concerns, RFI/RFP responses, and implementation feasibility discussions.

  • Act as a trusted advisor and technical liaison throughout the sales cycle from early engagement to contract negotiation.

  • Design and propose scalable technical solutions based on customer needs and Legora’s product capabilities.

  • Translate complex requirements into clear architecture diagrams, implementation roadmaps, and proposal documentation.

  • Collaborate with Product and Engineering to validate feasibility, share customer feedback, and influence roadmap priorities.

  • Partner with Go-to-Market teams to shape deal strategy and shape technical strategy early in the sales process.

  • Support onboarding of technical sales content (demos and demo scripts, battlecards, case studies) that improve sales efficiency.

  • Work closely with Technical Delivery and Customer Success to ensure smooth transition from pre-sale to implementation.

What You Bring

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical discipline (or equivalent experience).

  • 5+ years of experience in technical pre-sales, solutions engineering, sales engineering, or a customer-facing technical role (preferably B2B).

  • Experienced with having technical delivery discussions, responding technical questions coming from clients.

  • Experience delivering technical presentations and demos to both technical and business decision-makers.

  • Strong communication skills with the ability to explain complex technical topics clearly.

 

Legora is an Equal Opportunity Employer

At Legora, we believe great teams are built on diversity of thought and experience. We’re proud to be an equal opportunity employer and committed to creating an inclusive, high-performance culture where everyone can do their best work. We welcome people of all backgrounds and don’t discriminate based on race, color, religion, national origin, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

Compensation: €75K – €115K

Le rôle principal de l'Alternant - Gestionnaire Administratif RH est d'assurer la gestion courante du service des ressources humaines : établissement des déclarations auprès des organismes sociaux, des contrats de travail, suivi administratif des dossiers du personnel (contrats, congés), mises à jour des procédures administratives et sociales.

Vous serez en appui de l’ensemble de l’équipe RH et sous la responsabilité du Responsable Administration.

Votre périmètre d’action sera Eurostar Group en France pour le personnel contractuel et mis à disposition (Personnel détaché venant de la SNCF).

Nous cherchons quelqu’un pour…

  • Rédiger les contrats de travail et avenants (CDI, CDD)
  • Faire la mise à jour des tableaux des effectifs  
  • Gérer les dossiers administratifs du personnel
  • Gérer les visites médicales (prise de rendez-vous, suivi, déclarations annuelles)
  • Faire le suivi des congés

  • Faire le suivi des dossiers Accident de travail
  • Planifier les visites médicales de sécurité du travail et psychologique

  • Avez une expérience dans l'administration et la gestion du personnel
  • Avez une maîtrise des outils de bureautique (maîtrise Excel souhaitée : TCD et formules basiques)

  • Avez un niveau B1 en Anglais

9436f82e7ef39f10.title: Talent Sourcing Associate
9436f82e7ef39f10.description:
About Us

Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces.

Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected.

About the Role

As a Talent Sourcing Associate on the Harmattan AI Talent Acquisition team, your mission is to uncover the engineering minds powering our autonomous defense platforms.

Integrated directly in active searches from day one, you’ll receive an intensive introduction to deep-tech hiring, how to dissect complex technical domains, map hidden talent, and lead proactive talent outreach. Working alongside recruiters and engineering leaders, you’ll learn how to leverage modern AI tools, build market intelligence, and run precision outreach that cuts through the noise.

You can quickly evolve into a go-to specialist on technical talent pools across our global hubs, serving as a key driver of hiring velocity, culture advocacy, and company-wide growth.

 
 

Responsibilities

  • Talent Discovery: Partner directly with hiring managers and lead recruiters globally to identify top-tier talent across hardware, software, and specialized engineering domains.

  • Market Intelligence: Leveraging AI tools to accelerate market mapping and quality candidate discovery to become a subject matter expert in talent insights in Defense-Tech.

  • Candidate Outreach: Craft highly personalised messaging campaigns that cut through candidate noise, and drive elite response rates from passive talent.

  • Build experience in Recruitment & Talent Acquisition: Gain hands-on, high-velocity experience across the full recruitment lifecycle, building foundational expertise in technical headhunting, stakeholder management, and talent strategy.

  • Build Talent Pipelines: Proactively build and nurture talent communities to fuel our continuous hiring waves and project manage high-impact hiring programs.

  • Harmattan AI Culture Advocacy: Act as the first champion of our mission and technical DNA, articulating our high-performance culture to turn passive talent into engaged candidates.

 

Candidate Requirements

  • Educational Background & Recruiting Interest: Early-career profile (0-2 years of experience, internships count) with a degree in Business, Sales, HR, or a related field. Clear interest in breaking into recruiting and talent acquisition.

  • Deep Tech Curiosity & Technical Aptitude: Genuine interest in robotics, defense tech, or aerospace, with the curiosity and fast-learning capacity to grasp complex engineering domains.

  • Communication & Target-Driven Mindset: Written and verbal English skills to craft effective candidate outreach, combined with strong self-direction, high personal agency, and the drive to consistently hit weekly outreach goals.

  • Commitment: 100% dedication to Harmattan AI’s mission, vision, and ambitious growth plans, ready to go the extra mile to ensure operational excellence.

We look forward to hearing how you can help shape the future of autonomous defense systems at Harmattan AI.

294af7ed41f68723.title: Employé(e) Polyvalent(e) - Saint-Ouen 35h
294af7ed41f68723.description:
Employé(e) Polyvalent(e) 35h - ST Ouen

Rejoignez-nous dans notre mission visant à transformer la façon dont les gens achètent et mangent, où l'impact, l'innovation et la croissance motivent tout ce que nous faisons. Notre équipe Commerciale est au cœur de la marketplace de Deliveroo : elle façonne la manière dont nous servons les restaurants, les commerçants et les nouveaux secteurs à travers le monde. De la négociation de partenariats clés au déblocage de nouvelles sources de revenus, en passant par l'élaboration de stratégies de croissance basées sur les données, nous relevons des défis majeurs qui font progresser l'entreprise. Si vous aimez les environnements commerciaux dynamiques et que vous souhaitez influencer l'avenir d'une marque mondiale, cette équipe est faite pour vous.

Nous recherchons un(e) Employé(e) Polyvalent(e) CDI - 35h pour rejoindre notre équipe à Saint-Ouen. Dans ce rôle, vous aiderez à maintenir le flux fluide de nos cuisines réservées à la livraison "Editions", en veillant à ce que chaque commande parvienne au client de manière parfaite et dans les délais.

 

Ce que vous ferez

Vous rejoindrez l'équipe Editions. Nos sites Editions sont des hubs dédiés exclusivement à la livraison qui permettent aux meilleurs restaurants de se développer dans de nouvelles zones. En tant qu'Agent d'Exploitation, vous êtes le cœur du site, coordonnant les partenaires en cuisine, les livreurs et les clients pour garantir l'excellence opérationnelle.

Voici un aperçu de votre quotidien :

  • Gérer le Dispatch : Superviser la remise rapide des plats aux livreurs tout en résolvant proactivement les problèmes en direct entre les cuisines et les partenaires.

  • Garantir la Sécurité Alimentaire : Réaliser les contrôles HACCP et de sécurité quotidiens, en veillant à ce que nos normes élevées d'hygiène alimentaire et de sécurité du site ne soient jamais compromises.

  • Résoudre les Problèmes en Temps Réel : Être le premier point de contact pour les réclamations clients, en utilisant nos processus internes pour garantir un parcours client réussi.

  • Viser l'Excellence du Site : Collaborer étroitement avec le Site Manager et l'Assistant Manager pour atteindre les indicateurs clés de performance (KPI) et maintenir un service de haute qualité.

  • Piloter le Terrain : Assurer les procédures d'ouverture et de fermeture, en faisant preuve de la polyvalence nécessaire pour assumer tous les rôles sur le site selon les besoins.

Ce dont vous aurez besoin pour réussir

Essentiel :

  • Forte capacité de polyvalence : Aptitude avérée à gérer des volumes importants d'informations et à jongler avec plusieurs défis opérationnels simultanément.

  • Excellente communication : Compétences claires et efficaces à l'oral comme à l'écrit pour assurer la liaison avec les partenaires et les clients.

  • Esprit d'initiative : Une mentalité proactive avec une capacité démontrée à anticiper les besoins et à agir de manière autonome.

  • Sens de la sécurité : Une solide compréhension (ou une volonté de devenir référent) des normes de sécurité alimentaire et HACCP.

Souhaité :

  • Expérience en restauration : Une première expérience opérationnelle dans un environnement de cuisine ou de restaurant.

  • Certifications de sécurité : Formation en premiers secours, sécurité incendie ou sécurité alimentaire (bien qu'une formation puisse être dispensée).

  • Compétences linguistiques : La maîtrise de l'anglais est un plus pour collaborer avec nos équipes internationales.

Pourquoi nous rejoindre ?

Chez Deliveroo, vous ferez un travail qui compte, en résolvant des problèmes concrets dans une marketplace tripartite en constante évolution. Nous sommes des passionnés de cuisine, des solveurs de problèmes et des créateurs de liens, unis par une volonté commune d'améliorer les choses. En travaillant ici, vous pouvez vous attendre à :

🔧 Avoir un impact visible chaque jour Votre travail améliore directement l'expérience des clients, des partenaires et des livreurs.

🌱 Apprendre vite dans un environnement entrepreneurial Travaillez au plus près du marché avec autonomie, rapidité et de réelles responsabilités.

🧠 Construire une carrière, pas seulement un poste Dépassez-vous, développez de nouvelles compétences et évoluez en même temps que l'entreprise.

🌎 Réussir ensemble dans une culture inclusive Des équipes collaboratives et guidées par des valeurs, qui soutiennent votre façon de travailler.

Nous visons à créer un processus équitable qui laisse briller vos compétences — notre parcours de recrutement comprend généralement 3 à 4 étapes. Pour en savoir plus sur notre façon de recruter, cliquez ici.

Notre structure mondiale

Deliveroo fait désormais partie de DoorDash, réunissant des équipes avec une portée, une échelle et une ambition encore plus grandes. Selon votre rôle, vous pourrez collaborer avec des collègues, des systèmes et des dirigeants à travers DoorDash et Wolt. Ensemble, nous débloquons de nouvelles possibilités en tant qu'équipe mondiale unique.

Diversité, Équité et Inclusion

Chez Deliveroo, nous savons qu'un lieu de travail exceptionnel reflète le monde qui nous entoure et que la diversité et l'inclusion nous rendent plus forts, plus créatifs et meilleurs dans ce que nous faisons. Nous nous engageons à favoriser un environnement où chacun peut donner le meilleur de lui-même et se sentir à sa place.

Nous croyons en l'égalité des chances et accueillons des candidats de tous horizons, quels que soient leur âge, leur sexe, leur origine ethnique, leur handicap, leur orientation sexuelle, leur identité de genre, leur milieu socio-économique, leur religion ou leurs convictions.

Si vous avez un handicap ou une condition de santé de longue durée et que vous avez besoin d'aide pour postuler, ou si vous avez besoin d'ajustements raisonnables pendant le processus de recrutement, veuillez contacter notre équipe de recrutement à ----- Nous serons ravis de vous aider pour vous garantir une expérience juste et équitable.

Si vous êtes enthousiaste à l'idée d'avoir un impact réel dans une marketplace en mouvement rapide et de développer votre carrière aux côtés d'équipes ambitieuses et solidaires, nous serions ravis de vous entendre !

0e773a772fb5fa9d.title: Senior Project Manager
0e773a772fb5fa9d.description:
About Sidetrade

Sidetrade (Euronext Growth: ALBFR.PA) is an AI-native company dedicated to Order-to-Cash (O2C). Its platform combines O2C applications, autonomous AI agents, and Aimie IQ, an intelligent natural-language interface that helps multinationals accelerate their cash generation, all built on SAFE, the Sidetrade Agentic Framework for Enterprise. Sidetrade operates the world's largest proprietary O2C Data Lake, built on $9 trillion in B2B transactions and millions of buying companies. We use this data to train specialized AI models that monitor, analyze, decide, and act autonomously throughout the O2C cycle. Sidetrade supports companies in 85 countries with 450 employees across Europe, North America, and Asia-Pacific.

We’re proud of our 38 nationalities, and these diverse perspectives drive our innovation, one-team culture, and customer-first mindset. Sidetrade has been positioned as a Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ Leader since 2022. We value passion over perfection. So, if you’re eager to learn and bring great energy, we want to hear from you. Be you. Grow with us. 

Curious about Sidetrade? Catch Aimie in motion: Aimie Video

The role

As a Senior Project Manager, you run enterprise Order-to-Cash implementations from contract signature to go-live and into run. You own the plan, the coordination and the project governance. You deliver on time, on budget, and with a customer who is ready to use what we built.

You join a Customer Experience team that holds its accounts from signature into renewal, alongside a Functional Expert, a Data Engineer and a Customer Success Manager. The customer keeps the same team throughout. You also arrive as we redesign implementation with AI, so you help shape how we deliver, not just follow it.

Requirements

What you will do:

  • Run the project from kickoff to hypercare: plan, governance, weekly status calls and steering committees with finance leadership up to CFO.
  • Deliver workshops on data mapping, integration and process design, train the customer to run UAT, and coordinate cutover, go-live strategy and business hypercare.
  • Deliver against the baseline date agreed with the customer and the SOW budget, and keep the burn visible.
  • Keep the commercial hygiene tight: billing milestones raised on time, change requests spotted and priced, effort tracked against the SOW.
  • Coordinate the customer's finance, IT and ERP teams with our Functional Experts and Data Engineers through integration, testing and go-live.
  • Lead complex programs, including multi-entity and phased rollouts, with several projects running in parallel at different phases.
  • Raise risks early and bring a plan with them. Take the hard conversation on a slipped date or a scope dispute.
  • Hand over to the Customer Success Manager at the transition into run, with the context Support needs.
  • Keep phase, risk and milestones accurate in Salesforce and our project tools.
  • Work with the AI agents that speed up our implementations, and check what they produce.

What you will bring:

  • 6+ years managing B2B SaaS, ERP or finance-system implementations, with enterprise projects that went live and stayed live.
  • A strong command of project economics: SOW, budget, burn, change requests, billing milestones.
  • Comfort in front of finance leadership, up to CFO, with good news and bad.
  • Order-to-Cash, credit, collections or accounts receivable knowledge, or the proven ability to pick it up fast.
  • The ability to hold several projects at different stages at once without dropping any of them.
  • The candor to say the uncomfortable thing early, to the customer and to Sidetrade.
  • Fluent English and French. German or Spanish is an advantage.
  • Willingness to travel up to 50%.
  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in a related field.

Why Sidetrade

  • AI-native. We are not a software vendor bolting AI onto a legacy product. Aimie IQ and our AI agents are built on the largest proprietary Order-to-Cash Data Lake.
  • Measurable impact. You work with enterprise finance teams on problems tied directly to cash and working capital.
  • Build the method. You join as we redesign implementation with AI, so you help shape how we deliver, not just follow it.

Benefits

  • Hybrid work model – a flexible mix of in-office and remote days
  • Great culture – active Social Club organizing regular team events and activities
  • Health & wellness – medical coverage, life insurance, and other wellness programs
  • Time off – competitive paid holidays plus public holidays
  • Career growth & compensation – competitive salary, equal opportunities, Edenred card, learning & mentorship programs, and advancement support

Because when you thrive, we all succeed! 

We’re committed to providing a welcoming and inclusive experience for every candidate.

If you need any accommodation during the hiring process, just let us know. 

Agencies 

We only accept applications from invited agencies via our Workable portal. Unsolicited CVs sent to managers or HR won’t be subject to fees.

2ec386c89f88dde6.title: Ingénieur(e) Intégration & Validation Cryogénique
2ec386c89f88dde6.description:
Quandela est un leader mondial de l’informatique quantique, qui conçoit, développe et déploie des solutions quantiques de pointe à destination de la recherche et de l’industrie.

Son offre comprend notamment les ordinateurs quantiques les plus économes en énergie pour les data centers, des solutions complètes de calcul quantique accessibles via le cloud, ainsi que des services d’accès à des algorithmes pour les acteurs académiques et industriels.

Avec une feuille de route pragmatique et progressive, Quandela déploie depuis 2023 des systèmes de niveau industriel, tout en développant les futures générations d’ordinateurs quantiques tolérants aux pannes, capables de passer à l’échelle grâce à l’intégration de milliers de composants photoniques.

Quandela ambitionne de rendre l’informatique quantique accessible au plus grand nombre afin de contribuer à résoudre les défis industriels et sociétaux les plus complexes.

En savoir plus : Quandela | Leading Photonic Quantum Computing Solutions

Rejoignez-nous à la pointe de l’innovation en informatique quantique 🚀

À propos du poste

Dans le cadre du développement de nos activités de production et d'intégration de processeurs quantiques photoniques (QPU), nous recherchons un(e) Ingénieur(e) Intégration & Validation Cryogénique pour rejoindre notre équipe Assemblage & Production, basée à Massy.

Vous interviendrez principalement sur l'intégration et la validation des équipements et sous-ensembles au sein des cryostats utilisés dans nos systèmes. Ces opérations impliquent la manipulation de composants sensibles et délicats, nécessitant une grande précision, de la méticulosité et une attention particulière aux conditions de montage et d'intégration.

Vous réaliserez les opérations de montage, de câblage, de thermalisation, de mise en service et de contrôle, en veillant au respect des contraintes cryogéniques et des protocoles de validation.

Vous participerez également au suivi du fonctionnement et des maintenances des équipements cryogéniques, notamment les cryostats et leurs compresseurs associés. La compréhension et l'utilisation des systèmes de vide et de pompage feront partie de vos activités, en tant qu'éléments nécessaires au bon fonctionnement des installations cryogéniques.

Au-delà de l'application des procédures, vous devrez être capable de comprendre le comportement des systèmes, d'analyser les anomalies et de contribuer à l'identification des actions nécessaires à leur résolution, en collaboration avec les experts techniques concernés.

Selon les besoins, vous pourrez apporter un support technique à distance ou intervenir ponctuellement sur les systèmes installés chez nos clients, en France ou à l'international.

Le poste s'inscrit dans un environnement de production en petite série, avec des équipements complexes et multidisciplinaires. La montée en échelle de la production est déjà engagée, notamment à travers la structuration progressive de nos méthodes et processus d'industrialisation. Une première base documentaire est déjà en place, et vous contribuerez à son amélioration afin de rendre les opérations plus robustes, reproductibles et adaptées à l'augmentation des volumes de production.

Vous bénéficierez d'un accompagnement et de formations internes pour approfondir votre connaissance des équipements cryogéniques spécifiques à Quandela, avec la possibilité de devenir progressivement un interlocuteur technique de référence sur ces systèmes.

Missions principales

Intégration et validation des équipements dans les cryostats

Vous réalisez l'intégration de composants et sous-ensembles, parfois sensibles et délicats, au sein des cryostats. Ces opérations nécessitent une grande précision et le respect des exigences de propreté, de manipulation et d'assemblage.

À ce titre, vous :

  • Préparez les cryostats, les composants et les équipements nécessaires aux opérations d'intégration.
  • Manipulez et assemblez avec précision des composants sensibles, en appliquant les précautions et méthodes adaptées à leur fragilité et à leurs contraintes d'intégration.
  • Réalisez le montage et l'intégration des composants et sous-ensembles dans les chambres de cryostats.
  • Assurez le passage, le cheminement et la fixation des câbles et connexions à l'intérieur des enceintes cryogéniques, en veillant à préserver l'intégrité des composants et des connexions.
  • Réalisez les opérations de thermalisation des câbles et composants, en tenant compte des contraintes thermiques et mécaniques.
  • Veillez au respect des contraintes d'intégration : encombrement, interfaces mécaniques, compatibilité des matériaux, propreté et contraintes thermiques.
  • Appliquez les bonnes pratiques de manipulation, de protection et de contrôle des composants tout au long des opérations d'intégration.
  • Réalisez les opérations de contrôle et de validation de l'intégration selon les protocoles définis.
  • Analysez les résultats des contrôles, identifiez les éventuelles non-conformités et participez à leur résolution.
  • Rédigez les rapports de validation associés et assurez la traçabilité des opérations réalisées.
  • Identifiez les difficultés d'intégration et proposez des améliorations adaptées.

Requirements

Compétences techniques – Indispensables

  • Titulaire d’un diplôme Bac+5 (Master ou diplôme d’ingénieur) en photonique, optique, électronique, mécanique, physique appliquée, physique de la matière condensée ou dans un domaine connexe. Un doctorat (PhD) serait apprécié.
  • Bonnes connaissances pratiques en cryogénie et compréhension des contraintes associées aux basses températures.
  • Connaissance des principes de transfert thermique, de thermalisation et des contraintes mécaniques liées aux environnements cryogéniques.
  • Capacité à réaliser des opérations de montage et d'intégration de composants dans des systèmes cryogéniques.
  • Expérience dans la manipulation et l'assemblage de composants sensibles ou délicats, nécessitant précision et précautions particulières.
  • Maîtrise des bonnes pratiques de manipulation, de propreté et de protection des composants lors des opérations d'intégration.
  • Compréhension du fonctionnement général des cryostats et de leurs équipements associés.
  • Connaissance des principes de mise sous vide et du fonctionnement des équipements de pompage nécessaires aux applications cryogéniques.
  • Capacité à réaliser des opérations de mise en service, de refroidissement et de validation selon des procédures établies.
  • Capacité à réaliser et valider des opérations d'intégration selon des protocoles définis, à analyser les résultats et à rédiger les rapports associés.
  • Capacité à interpréter des mesures de température et de pression pour analyser le fonctionnement d'un système.
  • Capacité à réaliser les premières investigations techniques, à analyser les symptômes observés et à contribuer à l'identification des causes d'un dysfonctionnement, en collaboration avec les experts lorsque nécessaire.
  • Capacité à suivre des procédures tout en sachant identifier les situations nécessitant une analyse complémentaire ou l'intervention d'un expert.
  • Capacité à assurer le suivi des échéances de maintenance et des interventions réalisées.
  • Capacité à lire, appliquer et rédiger des procédures techniques et des rapports d'essais.
  • Sensibilisation aux risques associés aux systèmes cryogéniques et aux équipements sous vide.

Qualités recherchées

  • Méticulosité et précision : capacité à réaliser des opérations d'assemblage délicates avec soin, patience et une attention constante aux détails.
  • Rigueur et respect des procédures : attention portée à la qualité des montages, à la propreté des équipements et à la protection des composants sensibles.
  • Autonomie et esprit d'initiative : capacité à prendre en charge les activités confiées, à identifier les difficultés et à solliciter les bons interlocuteurs lorsque nécessaire.
  • Esprit d'analyse et de résolution de problèmes : capacité à comprendre le comportement des systèmes, à analyser les anomalies et à mener des investigations méthodiques.
  • Pragmatisme et sens pratique : goût pour les manipulations techniques, l'intégration et la résolution concrète de problèmes.
  • Organisation et traçabilité : capacité à documenter les opérations, suivre les essais et maintenir des historiques techniques fiables.
  • Curiosité technique et volonté d'apprendre : intérêt pour le fonctionnement des équipements et l'acquisition progressive d'une expertise approfondie.
  • Esprit d'amélioration continue : capacité à contribuer à la structuration des processus et à l'amélioration des méthodes de travail.
  • Capacité à travailler en équipe avec des profils techniques variés et à solliciter les experts appropriés.
  • Pédagogie et communication : capacité à transmettre des connaissances et à accompagner d'autres intervenants.
  • Respect des règles de sécurité et conscience des risques associés aux systèmes cryogéniques et aux équipements de vide.

Benefits

Ce que nous offrons :

      • Un rôle à fort impact, avec de réelles responsabilités dès votre arrivée
      • Une équipe qui a envie de collaborer, de partager et de grandir avec vous

For most people, hotels are places you only visit when you travel.

Yet, most of these spaces remain invisible to the people who live just a few streets away.

Staycation was born from a simple belief: the most inspiring places in your city shouldn’t be reserved for tourists. They should be part of your everyday life, an alternative to a dinner-date at a restaurant, a spontaneous midweek escape, or a unique way to celebrate a special moment.

Our mission is to transform hotels into a new form of urban entertainment.

Places people turn to when they want to feel, connect or recharge. Whether it’s 24 hours, 48 hours, or just a few hours, we’re reinventing the way people experience the cities they call home.

Today, Staycation means:

  • 🌍 5 million users in France, the UK, Spain, Belgium and Switzerland

  • 🏨 4,000 partner hotels among the best 4★, 5★ and iconic palaces

  • ⭐️ 9.3/10 average rating for our experiences

Joining Staycation means becoming part of a passionate, creative, and ambitious team on a quest to redefine what hospitality and city life can be.

On cherche un(e) stagiaire Account Manager Junior pour accompagner nos partenaires hôteliers au quotidien, et faire de chaque expérience un succès. Tu apprendras à piloter un portefeuille de clients B2B, analyser leur performance et tester des stratégies de croissance. Tu verras l’impact concret de ton travail toutes les semaines. ⭐️ Missions

  • 🧪 Mettre les mains dans les données : extraire, analyser, synthétiser pour mieux prioriser les actions terrain.

  • 🛠️ Améliorer les process : tu identifieras ce qui coince, tu proposeras des solutions, et tu les mettras en œuvre. Vraiment.

À nos côtés, vous contribuerez à faire de Staycation le partenaire de référence des meilleurs hôtels de France et d'Europe.

🔍 Profil recherché

Disponible à partir du janvier 2027 et pour 6 mois.

  • Vous êtes polyvalent(e) et savez vous adapter à un environnement de jeune start-up

  • Évoluer dans un environnement stimulant et palpitant

  • Avoir de vraies responsabilités : liberté d’action, cycles de décision courts

1d4627cb69bb0db3.title: Senior Cloud Infrastructure Engineer
1d4627cb69bb0db3.description:
About Voodoo

Founded in 2013, Voodoo is a tech company that creates mobile games and apps with a mission to entertain the world. Gathering 800 employees, 7 billion downloads, and over 200 million active users, Voodoo is the #3 mobile publisher worldwide in terms of downloads after Google and Meta. Our portfolio includes chart-topping games like Mob Control and Block Jam, alongside popular apps such as BeReal and Wizz.

Team

The Engineering & Data team builds innovative tech products and platforms to support the impressive growth of their gaming and consumer apps which allow Voodoo to stay at the forefront of the mobile industry. The Engineering & Data team plays a key role in Voodoo's long-term strategy. It enables Voodoo to both accelerate product diversification and provide a state of the art growth-engine to distribute and scale our games. They create innovative solutions that drive growth with a pragmatic approach, ranging from simple searching to complex machine learning systems.

Role

We’re looking for a Senior Cloud Infrastructure Engineer interested in creating something bigger to join our Engineering & Data team! In this role, you’ll be working on highly scalable solutions, used by millions of people and will solve complex problems including challenges like scalability, high availability, performance, optimization & automation. You will use best-in-class services and technologies, including AI-assisted development tools and agentic workflows, and will contribute to improving the technical stack.

  • Design and implement availability, scalability, and performance plans for the services environments

  • Continual re-evaluation of existing stack and infrastructure to maintain optimal performance, availability and security

  • Develop security capabilities and encourage adoption of security best practices and architecture changes throughout the company via evangelism and education

  • Take ownership of automating infrastructure deployment and configuration, lead the creation of CI/CD pipelines for applications, and develop CI/CD best practices across the team

  • Leverage AI coding assistants (e.g. Claude Code or similar harnesses) to accelerate infrastructure development, automate repetitive engineering tasks, and raise the team's overall velocity

  • Design, deploy, and scale autonomous or semi-autonomous agents to handle infrastructure operations, incident response, and internal tooling workflows

  • Perform development, automation, and deployment assignments without close supervision

  • Provide application development and cloud technology leadership, guidance, and assistance to other team members, including best practices for integrating AI tools into engineering workflows

  • Control costs and be able to propose and implement new solutions in coordination with dev teams

Profile (Must Have)

  • 5+ years of Linux experience including experience with scripting, networks, storage, and release

  • 3+ years building and maintaining continuous integration environments and working with AWS

  • 3+ years working with Kubernetes

  • Strong understanding of the infrastructure as code and immutability principles including Terraform

  • Experience with high traffic, distributed systems architectures, and related tools (service discovery, config/secret management, etc.)

  • Experience designing and managing AWS Landing Zone architectures (multi-account strategy, org-level guardrails, centralized networking/logging/security)

  • Experience in any scripting language (python, bash, …)

  • Practical experience incorporating AI-assisted coding tools or agentic frameworks (such as Cursor, Claude Code, or similar solutions) into production software development workflows

  • Ability to adapt to multiple stakeholders and demonstrate strong cross-teams cooperation

Profile (Nice to Have)

  • Supporting data pipeline orchestration (ETL, Spark, Airflow)

  • Running a distributed message broker at scale (Kafka, NATS)

  • Running GPU workloads on Kubernetes

  • Supporting ML workloads

  • Hands-on expertise in designing, deploying, and maintaining agentic systems in production environments (including multi-agent orchestration, tool integration frameworks, and comprehensive agent observability and monitoring)

  • Experience in golang is a plus

Our Stack

AWS; Terraform; Kubernetes; Prometheus; ArgoCD; Circle-Ci; Github Actions; Atlantis; Grafana; Claude Code (or similar AI coding harnesses)

Benefits

  • Competitive salary based on experience

  • Swile Lunch voucher

  • Gymlib (100% covered by Voodoo)

  • Premium healthcare coverage with SideCare, 100% covered for you and your family

  • Wellness activities in our Paris office

  • Remote Fridays

We were backed by Goldman Sachs, Tencent and GBL along the way.

Team

Our Gaming team is made up of hybrid-casual, casual and mid-core experts. Our 'Core' games team supports internal and external studios worldwide in creating, developing and launching new hit games, whilst our 'Live' games team focuses on delivering higher engagement on our existing and successful games.

This is an opportunity to bring your ideas to life, to create your games, in an enjoyable and benign working environment among gaming lovers. Your games will be published by the worldwide leader in this field. You will get the chance to join a newly created small studio, focusing on creating and testing new hyper casual game prototypes to be published by Voodoo. You will have autonomy, a strong impact on the ideation, and a unique opportunity to reach hundreds of millions of players. Thanks to your creativity and your teamwork, let’s entertain millions of people with your hit games.


Our studios are looking for people who bring their own ideas and are always willing to compromise to move forward.

Profile

  • Proficient in Figma and Photoshop

  • Comfortable handling the implementation of UI and assets into Unity.

  • Experience building and maintaining UX/UI framework libraries within a game project

  • Comfortable using AI tools to accelerate prototyping and asset creation

  • Proactive mindset — able to identify product needs, source references, and drive solutions independently

  • Strong portfolio showcasing excellent UI art, visual polish, readability, and attention to detail.

  • Ability to work independently in a small team, organize your own work, and move features forward without heavy process.

  • Experience working with multiple stakeholders and driving alignment around the visual quality and direction of UI.

  • Strong collaboration and communication skills.

  • AI-first mindset: Comfortable using AI daily and building custom agents or reusable automations to speed up your work

  • Passion for mobile games.

Benefits

• Best-in-class compensation

• Other benefits according to the country you reside

2b11516b28a358cc.title: Junior Logistics Executive (Netherlands)
2b11516b28a358cc.description:
Important Information

This role is a full time, permanent, in office position.

Working hours: M-F, 10AM - 6:30PM

Location: Oude Meer, North Holland, 1438 BC

Contract: 6 month FTC

About Nivoda

Nivoda is the leading global B2B jewellery marketplace, Nivoda’s growth trajectory has skyrocketed over the past 12 months, and we continue to expand across new regions at an unprecedented pace. Our DNA centers on understanding our customers' needs and offering them a seamless experience. With a growing team based in major cities worldwide, including London, New York, Hong Kong, and Mumbai, Nivoda is becoming the go-to marketplace for the global jewelry industry.

We aim to be bold, innovative, and relentless in our pursuit of excellence as we transform an industry steeped in tradition.

The Role

As a Junior Logistics Executive, you'll be a key player in a tight-knit team. Working alongside highly experienced logistics professionals at one of our largest international hubs, you'll handle and repack incoming and outgoing diamond shipments with precision and care.

This is a hands-on, detail-oriented role that sits at the heart of our operations. You’ll be responsible for maintaining the smooth day-to-day flow of the office while upholding our high standards of accuracy and security. With our rapidly growing company, the opportunities for personal and professional growth are enormous.

If you're looking for a fast-paced, highly supportive environment where your attention to detail and reliability will truly shine—this is your moment.

What you'll do:

  • Shipment Handling & Repacking:

    Accurately handle, inspect, and repack incoming and outgoing diamond shipments in accordance with company protocols and international shipping standards.

  • Operational Support:

    Work closely with your two team members to manage the daily operations of the office, ensuring all logistics processes run smoothly and efficiently

  • Precision & Security:

    Maintain the highest level of precision, confidentiality, and security when dealing with high-value goods—attention to detail is non-negotiable in this role.

  • Team Collaboration:

    Collaborate with senior team members to align on priorities, share insights, and uphold our collective standards of excellence.

  • Process Improvement:

    Contribute ideas to improve workflows and increase operational efficiency as the company continues to scale rapidly.

  • Growth Mindset:

    Be proactive, reliable, and open to learning. This role offers strong internal growth potential for individuals who show initiative and dedication.

What you'll need for this entry-level role:

  • Strong Attention to Detail

  • Ability to repack/handle goods

  • Team-Oriented Mindset

  • Basic Administrative Skills

  • Trustworthiness & Discretion

Highly desirable

  • Experience working in high-security logistics environments, preferably with luxury goods, jewelry, or diamonds.

  • Familiarity with international shipping regulations and customs procedures.

  • Proficiency in basic logistics software or ERP systems (e.g. SAP, NetSuite, or similar).

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills in English; additional languages are a plus.

  • Physically fit and able to handle small manual tasks as part of the shipment handling process.

  • A proactive, solution-oriented attitude with a willingness to grow within a fast-scaling organization.

What you'll get:

💸Competitive compensation

🍎Free lunch

🧠 Plenty of opportunities for growth and learning

🚀 Chance to join and contribute to a company during its exponential expansion phase

 

Nivoda is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace dedicated to promoting diversity. We don’t discriminate on the basis of race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status or disability status.
Even if it seems you don't meet 100% of our musts don't let it stop you, we are all about finding the best talent out there! Skills can be learned, and embracing diversity is invaluable.

Please note: Our Talent Acquisition Team is international coming from across the world. We kindly ask you to please submit your CV and application in English so that it can be reviewed correctly.

This is a full time position that's 100% on-site in Oude Meer. Unfortunately, we are unable to offer sponsorship at this time.


*If after reading this job description you believe this is not the best fit for you, we’d encourage you to join our Talent Pool so we can keep you in mind as new roles open up.
You can sign up here: Nivoda Talent Pool

This ensures you're among the first to hear about openings aligned with your skills and interests.

d97ced2bd12052ba.title: Director Contact Center Operations
d97ced2bd12052ba.description:
Key Responsibilities

Operations Leadership & Service Delivery

  • Oversee inbound and outbound call handling, staffing coverage and service delivery across frontline teams.
  • Step in hands-on when volume or staffing requires it to protect service levels and the participant experience.
  • Hold teams accountable to clear service, quality and productivity standards.
  • Troubleshoot escalations and remove barriers that affect responsiveness and resolution.

Enterprise Operating Model

  • Design and implement a scalable, enterprise-wide approach to call handling across state programs.
  • Partner with local and program leaders to transition teams into the new model without disrupting service.
  • Assess the current structure and identify opportunities to reduce fragmentation and improve staffing efficiency.
  • Set up governance for how skills, queues and call-handling practices are added, changed and maintained.

Process Standardization & Continuous Improvement

  • Establish consistent standard operating procedures (SOPs), scripts, escalation paths and best practices across frontline teams.
  • Drive continuous improvement through root-cause analysis of call drivers, repeat contacts and workflow breakdowns.
  • Partner with quality and training teams to make sure standards are applied consistently.

Contact Center Technology

  • Configure and continually improve IVR (interactive voice response), call flows, routing, skills, callbacks and self-service options.
  • Work with Operations teams, IT and vendors to optimize the contact center platform and supporting tools.
  • Make sure routing and skills design connects each caller with the right agent quickly and efficiently.

Workforce Management

  • Lead forecasting, staffing models, scheduling and real-time management.
  • Match staffing to demand across intervals, days and peak periods while optimizing cost to serve.
  • Use historical volume, handle time, service-level targets, shrinkage and occupancy data to set staffing requirements.

Performance Metrics & Reporting

  • Define and report KPIs for service, quality, efficiency and customer experience.
  • Build executive-level reporting that gives leadership clear visibility into performance, capacity and cost.
  • Use data to identify trends, set priorities and measure the impact of operational changes.

AI, Automation & Self-Service

  • Identify and implement AI, automation and self-service tools that improve responsiveness and reduce manual work.
  • Evaluate opportunities such as virtual agents, agent assist and call summarization.
  • Build business cases that quantify the operational and financial return of technology investments.

Team Development

  • Recruit, coach and develop managers, supervisors and frontline staff.
  • Build a culture of accountability, empathy and continuous improvement across remote and multi-site teams.

Required Qualifications

  • 8+ years of contact center operations experience, including 5+ years leading multi-site or remote teams in a high-volume environment.
  • Deep call center operations expertise, including:
    • IVR, call flow, skills and routing configuration
    • Workforce management and staffing optimization
    • Inbound and outbound call handling
    • Performance metrics and KPIs
  • Strong hands-on experience with enterprise telephony and cloud contact center platforms.
  • A track record of standardizing processes and improving performance across multiple teams or locations.
  • Strong analytical and financial skills, including KPI reporting, staffing models, business cases and ROI.
  • Excellent communication and cross-functional partnership skills.
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Genesys Cloud or another top-tier contact center platform.
  • Experience implementing contact center AI (virtual agents, agent assist, call summarization).

Work Environment

  • Remote, home office-based role.
  • Leads remote and multi-site frontline teams supporting multiple state programs.
