1e7b07f3e87cf1d0.title: Group Product Manager II - Venda Direta ·
1e7b07f3e87cf1d0.description:
Um dos maiores grupos de beleza do mundo, o Grupo Boticário é uma empresa brasileira presente em mais de 40 países. É dono das marcas O Boticário, Eudora, Quem Disse, Berenice?, Vult, O.U.i, Dr. JONES, TRUSS, e do marketplace Beleza na Web, além de atuar com produtos licenciados como Australian Gold, Bio Oil, Nuxe, e Pampers e sua divisão para o mercado B2B. Essa interação entre diferentes marcas, ativos, plataformas, rede de franqueados, representantes, distribuidores, varejistas, sellers e fornecedores formam o ecossistema de beleza do Grupo Boticário que oferece, ainda, soluções digitais de gestão de negócio para o varejo brasileiro por meio das suas marcas Mooz e GAVB. São mais de 19 mil colaboradores diretos, com mais de 4 mil lojas em 1.780 cidades brasileiras.

Vem fazer beleza com a gente!



O que é o nosso time de Venda Direta?

No time de Venda Direta temos a missão de cada vez mais trazer beleza para a vida de nossas representantes, entendemos que a venda direta é também uma forma de empoderar pessoas que sonham em empreender, e por isso queremos fornecer a melhor experiência possível para nossas pessoas empreendedoras e franqueados. Em mundo cada vez mais digital, transformar esse canal de venda através da tecnologia é assim construímos o maior e melhor ecossistema de beleza para o mundo!

Como será o seu dia a dia?

* Você irá liderar um time de PMs definindo a estratégia e visão de alguns dos nossos produtos do ecossistema do GB;

* Criar alianças e formar parceria com diversas áreas internas para gerenciar todo ciclo de desenvolvimento de produtos, buscando construir soluções sustentáveis para atender o mercado que estamos inseridos;

* Conduzir as discussões estratégicas dos produtos sob sua responsabilidade, garantindo objetivos, roadmap e visão claras;

* É esperado que você seja uma liderança orquestradora, tendo habilidade de delegar e engajar o time direto e indireto em busca dos objetivos da equipe, estando, ao mesmo tempo, próximo e com profundo conhecimento do que estamos trabalhando;

* Criar e manter nossos produtos competitivos se utilizando de seu profundo conhecimento de mercado;

* Experimentar pequeno, errar rápido e evoluir a partir dos aprendizados;

* Desenvolver uma equipe de alta performance, referência na disciplina de Product Management;

* Estar confortável com um ambiente dinâmico e em transformação.

O que você precisa ter ou saber?

* Sólida experiência com gestão de pessoas como Group Product Manager;

* Ter trabalhado anteriormente como Product Manager, contribuindo individualmente para entrega de produtos e features de sucesso;

* Profunda experiência na definição e acompanhamento de métricas e objetivos de produto e negócios;

* Experiência prévia na concepção de produtos digitais;

* Conhecimentos de Growth e funil de resultados aplicados a produtos digitais;

* Experiência com metodologias ágeis.

* Pratica no uso de dados para tomada de decisão

Informações adicionais

Benefícios que cuidam e se diferenciam:

No Grupo Boticário, o cuidado é a nossa base para atingirmos resultados exponenciais. Temos um portfólio com mais de 20 benefícios para cuidar da sua saúde, bem estar e família. Confira abaixo.

Saúde:

  • Plano médico e odontológico flexíveis
  • Auxílio medicamentos e vale saúde para familiares
  • Sessões de psicoterapia gratuitas e telemedicina 24h
  • Programas contínuos de prevenção, cuidado mental e vacinação

Alimentação & bem-estar

  • Vale Refeição (ou restaurante local) e Vale Alimentação (com vale extra no Natal)
  • Desconto de até 40% nas marcas do nosso ecossistema
  • Gympass/TotalPass para academias e estúdios esportivos
  • Auxílio Home Office para modalidades híbrida e remota
  • Day off de aniversário para celebrar do seu jeito
  • Plano de saúde pet, vantagens em convênios e programas de viagem/hospedagem

Para sua família

  • Licença parental estendida (180 dias para mães e 120 dias para pais)
  • Suporte para Pais Atípicos e auxílio babá / educação infantil
  • Auxílio material escolar e crédito nutrição infantil
  • Orientação jurídica, psicológica e social dedicada

Seguridade para proteção e tranquilidade financeira

  • Previdência Privada e Seguro de Vida
  • Apoio ao falecimento de pais e empréstimo consignado
  • Vale Transporte e Estacionamento (conforme o modelo de trabalho)

Nota: Os pacotes de benefícios são adaptados de acordo com a elegibilidade de cada cargo e modelo de trabalho.

Notice: This position is contingent upon JCTM receiving a contract award and authorization to proceed. Employment opportunities and anticipated start dates are dependent upon contract award, government approval, and satisfaction of applicable onboarding and suitability requirements.

The Challenge

What if your application development and systems analysis expertise could help improve the reliability and effectiveness of technology supporting millions of USCIS customer interactions? JCTM is seeking an Applications Systems Analyst/Programmer to support the continued operation, maintenance, testing, and enhancement of critical federal data and reporting systems.

Build Your Career

At JCTM, we value knowledge, experience, integrity, and commitment. Joining our team means becoming part of an organization that empowers individuals, prioritizes ethical practices, and fosters a culture of collaboration and growth.

Challenging Projects

As an Applications Systems Analyst/Programmer with JCTM, you will support the analysis, testing, maintenance, and enhancement of the USCIS Centralized Data Repository (CDR) and the OAIS Centralized Reporting System (OCRS) user interface. You will contribute to maintaining system functionality, improving application performance, documenting technical changes, and ensuring authorized users have dependable access to operational reporting information.

Key Responsibilities

  • Application Analysis and Maintenance: Analyze, test, troubleshoot, and maintain the CDR and OCRS user interface to support ongoing operational requirements.
  • Application Enhancements: Implement and test application improvements and system modifications requested and approved by USCIS.
  • System Integration: Support the integration of CDR/OCRS with reporting data sources, underlying databases, and associated applications.
  • Cloud Environment Support: Assist with application and database maintenance within the AWS-hosted environment.
  • User Access and Authentication: Support OCRS user interface functionality, including integration with USCIS Identity, Credential, and Access Management (ICAM) Single Sign-On (SSO).
  • Troubleshooting and Issue Resolution: Identify application defects, investigate system performance issues, and coordinate appropriate corrective actions.
  • Security Maintenance: Support the identification and remediation of application security findings, including required patches and upgrades.
  • Testing and Quality Assurance: Perform functional testing, regression testing, and user acceptance testing in coordination with USCIS and other technical stakeholders.
  • Technical Documentation: Develop and maintain application documentation, technical procedures, user guides, and records of system modifications.
  • Change Management: Document and coordinate approved technical changes using USCIS project management and collaboration systems, including Jira, Confluence, and SharePoint.
  • System Support: Collaborate with technical teams, government personnel, and external vendors to maintain continuous system functionality and support operational improvements.

State-of-the-Art Technology

Expand your expertise through hands-on support of AWS-hosted applications, cloud-based data repositories, SQL databases, identity and access management integrations, and enterprise reporting interfaces.

New Skills

Collaborate with application developers, systems administrators, business analysts, and government technical personnel while gaining experience in federal enterprise systems, cloud application support, system security, and software lifecycle management.

Room to Grow

You will have opportunities to grow your career and contribute to the company's strategic goals, supported by mentorship and a collaborative work environment.

You Have

  • Associate's degree or higher.
  • Minimum of 5 years of experience in the Information Technology field.
  • Ability to analyze, test, troubleshoot, and maintain information technology applications.
  • Ability to support application enhancements, technical documentation, and system maintenance activities.
  • Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and communication skills.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with technical teams and government stakeholders.

Nice to Haves

  • Experience supporting web-based applications and enterprise reporting systems.
  • Familiarity with AWS cloud infrastructure and Amazon S3.
  • Experience with SQL databases, queries, or database maintenance.
  • Familiarity with application development, debugging, and software testing methodologies.
  • Experience integrating applications with SSO or ICAM solutions.
  • Experience using Jira, Confluence, or SharePoint.
  • Familiarity with federal information security requirements, Section 508 accessibility standards, and application change management.
  • Previous experience supporting DHS, USCIS, or other federal government IT environments.

Clearance

Applicants selected will be subject to a security investigation and must meet eligibility requirements for access to applicable government information and systems. This position requires a satisfactory USCIS Enter-on-Duty (EOD) determination prior to beginning work and the ability to obtain and maintain the required government suitability determination.

Compensation

JCTM is committed to fair and transparent compensation practices. The anticipated compensation for this position will be determined based on a variety of job-related factors, which may include the candidate’s relevant education, training, certifications, security clearance and access requirements, years and depth of relevant experience, specialized skills and qualifications, position level, assigned responsibilities, work location, applicable contract or customer requirements, internal equity, and the approved compensation budget for the position. Where required by applicable state or local law, JCTM will include the applicable good-faith salary or hourly pay range, along with any required information regarding benefits and other compensation, in the job posting.

Equal Opportunity Employer Statement

JCTM is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

b774623dc431d691.title: Supervisor, Loss Mitigation Finalization
b774623dc431d691.description:
POSITION SUMMARY:

Supervise a team of Finalization Specialist to achieve maximum performance and ensure compliance objectives are met in for the finalization, post-closing, and reporting processes related to Loan Modifications (“MOD”) and/or Partial Claims (“PC”). Work on various projects for the Department related to reporting, change management, compliance, quality assurance/quality control, and vendor/third party communication. Perform all duties in accordance with Company guidelines and applicable federal, state and local regulations. The target starting pay for this fully remote position is $70-$90k/yr.

WHAT YOU’LL DO:

• Carries out Supervisor responsibilities in accordance with the organization’s policies and applicable laws. Responsibilities include training employees; planning, assigning, and directing work; monitoring performance, rewarding, and disciplining employees; and addressing complaints and resolving problems.

• Request timeline extension variances from applicable insurer/agency as needed to ensure compliance to program requirements.

• Manage employees in such areas as workout technique, account recognition and customer service.

• Supervise the processing and completion of all MOD/PC reversal requests received.

• Troubleshoot and correct all systematic errors related to MOD/PC.

• Supervise the verification of PC amounts and posting ticket submissions to Cashiering Department

• Work with Client Relationship Managers to validate terms and secure PC Funds from prior servicers as necessary.

• Supervise and validate the closing out of terms within investor portals as necessary for FNMA and FHLMC workouts.

• Prepare reports and track results and trends within the Loss Mitigation Department.

• Oversee daily team operations; provide guidance and direction in daily workflow and volume.

• Communicates to the group the daily work goals, expectations, and any policy and/or process changes.

• Monitor employees on quality control guidelines and job performance through group training, one on one interaction and role play.

• Minimal travel supporting business operations may be required.

• Supervise the finalization of all MOD/PC workouts in LoanServ, which includes providing investor reporting summary data.

• Prepare, manage, and send Month End Reports for MOD/PC to Senior Leadership, Default and Investor Reporting Departments and Loss Mitigation Operations Management.

• Perform other projects and duties as assigned.

WHAT YOU’LL NEED:

• Knowledge of Microsoft Suite at an intermediate level preferred.

• Ability to interact with mid-level and senior management as an advisor on projects as well as be considered a business level subject matter expert (“SME”). Ability to make decisions that have significant impact on the department’s credibility, operations and services.

• Ability to organize and prioritize work schedules of others on long-term basis.

• Ability to compute, analyze and interpret complex statistical data and/or to develop forecasts and computer models for strategic planning.

• Ability to make informal presentations, inside and/or outside the organization and speak in front of groups.

• High school diploma or equivalent required; college degree preferred.

• Five (5) years of mortgage servicing experience.

• Four (4) plus years of loss mitigation or document recording experience required.

• Knowledge of, FHA, VA, USDA, FNMA, FHLMC and Ginnie Mae Loss Mitigation document requirements, deliverables, and timelines required.

• Two-plus years of supervisory or management experience preferred.

Our Company:

Carrington Mortgage Services is part of The Carrington Companies, which provide integrated, full-lifecycle mortgage loan servicing assistance to borrowers and investors, delivering exceptional customer care and programs that support borrowers and their homeownership experience. We hope you’ll consider joining our growing team of uniquely talented professionals as we transform residential real estate. To read more visit: .

What We Offer:

  • Comprehensive healthcare plans for you and your family. Plus, a discretionary 401(k) match of 50% of the first 4% of pay contributed.
  • Access to several fitness, restaurant, retail (and more!) discounts through our employee portal.
  • Customized training programs to help you advance your career.
  • Employee referral bonuses so you’ll get paid to help Carrington and Vylla grow.
  • Educational Reimbursement.
  • Carrington Charitable Foundation contributes to the community through causes that reflect the interests of Carrington Associates. For more information about Carrington Charitable Foundation, and the organizations and programs, it supports through specific fundraising efforts, please visit: carringtoncf.org.

Notice to all applicants: Carrington does not do interviews or make offers via text or chat.

dbf2d88eec85b656.title: Architectural Designer/Draftsperson
dbf2d88eec85b656.description:
ABOUT BBS

BBS Architects, Landscape Architects & Engineers, P.C. is a NY-based, ENR New York Top 100 design firm that continually strives for excellence in providing integrated architectural, landscape architectural, Civil and M/E/P engineering solutions to help our clients successfully plan, design, and build their projects.

BBS is a multi-disciplined firm with a wide range of consulting services located in-house, successfully delivering building and site projects for clients predominantly with K-12 / Higher Educational and Municipal backgrounds for over 50 years. With 75% of our valued staff being employed at BBS for over 10 years, and many for over 20 years, our vision is long term, and it includes the most talented individuals in the industry. At BBS you will contribute to a wide range of projects that help our clients understand the challenges placed before them today while connecting them to the future. We support a workplace culture that encourages innovation, creativity and camaraderie.

WHO ARE WE LOOKING FOR?

We are looking for an ambitious and dedicated Architectural Designer/Draftsperson. The selected candidate should have several years of experience in K-12, higher educational, and other municipal projects. The candidate will have experience in working in teams with other professionals including Senior Architects/Project Managers, and project-level architects and engineers. He or she should primarily possess strong design, rendering, and communication skills with detailed technical knowledge of building systems being secondary.

DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

Duties and responsibilities may vary according to the experience level of the candidate, which may be from existing conditions documentation through design development, renderings, presentations, and construction documents. We expect you will:

  • Meet clientele and work with them to establish program and needs.
  • Generate designs and renderings, both interior and exterior, to the client’s approval.
  • Bring those designs into Construction Drawings alongside the project team under supervision of a Senior Architect/Project Manager.
  • Follow production schedules and meet multiple simultaneous deadlines.
  • Contribute to growing our practice through new business development initiatives including but not limited to assistance with new client outreach, follow-up, and marketing.

SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

  • Strong design and graphic skills, with ability to work in Sketch-Up, Revit, and other modeling/presentation software packages.
  • Bachelor of Science in Architecture (4-year degree), Bachelor of Architecture (5-year degree) preferred.
  • Proficiency in AutoCAD, Microsoft Word and Excel, and Adobe.
  • Excellent verbal, written and visual communication skills.

BENEFITS INCLUDE:

  • Comprehensive, competitive compensation package.
  • Group health insurance, dental insurance, and vision insurance plans
  • Health and Dependent Care Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA)
  • Company-paid group life insurance.
  • Supplemental life, spousal and dependent life and AFLAC plans available.
  • 401k plan.
  • Company-paid holidays, vacation and sick/personal time.
  • Professional development program, professional licensing/certifications reimbursement.

If interested, please send your resume to Joseph Rettig, AIA, LEED AP,

BBS is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants are encouraged to apply and will be considered without regard to age, race, creed, color, national origin, ancestry, marital status, affectional or sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, disability, nationality or sex.

2e28e2ab35b61456.title: Senior Financial Analyst
2e28e2ab35b61456.description:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

Samsara is looking for a Senior Financial Analyst to partner with our R&D organization. Samsara's R&D organization creates the industry-leading IoT products and features that power our customer experience. You will partner with our engineering leaders, driving quantitative and qualitative analysis to identify cost optimization opportunities. You will help build the reporting and attribution frameworks needed to track and govern AI spend, support month-end close procedures, and drive forecast models that give our leaders and investors accurate guidance. The ideal candidate is highly self-motivated, analytical, and thrives in a fast-paced environment.

This is a remote position open to candidates residing in the US. Relocation assistance will not be provided for this role.

You should apply if:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact – helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, reduce emissions, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
  • You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won’t be your last at Samsara. We set up our employees for success and have built a culture that encourages rapid career development, countless opportunities to experiment and master your craft in a hyper growth environment.
  • You’re energized by our opportunity: The vision we have to digitize large sectors of the global economy requires your full focus and best efforts to bring forth creative, ambitious ideas for our customers.
  • You want to be with the best: At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together and support each other. Youwill be surrounded by a high-calibre team that will encourage you to do your best.

In this role, you will:

  • Partner closely with leaders across our Software and Firmware Engineering teams to manage Headcount, Software and AI vendor spend.
  • Analyze financial results, prepare monthly and quarterly management reporting, and support financial review meetings with R&D and Finance leadership.
  • Partner with Accounting on month-end close activities, cost classification, and reporting requests.
  • Collaborate with R&D teams to drive AOP planning.
  • Improve the accuracy and scalability of existing financial reporting and forecasting models.
  • Develop new mechanisms, analysis, or KPIs to inspect business performance.
  • Leverage AI tools to streamline financial reporting, forecasting, and ad hoc analysis workflows.
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara's cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices.

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • 3+ years of experience in FP&A/Strategic Finance/Big 4 Accounting/Investment Banking.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field.
  • High aptitude and enthusiasm for complex problem solving utilizing financial modeling and analysis, including advanced Excel and Google Sheets skills.
  • Experience at a high-growth tech company.
  • Ability to work collaboratively and cross-functionally in a fast-paced, often changing environment.
  • Strong communication and presentation skills; comfortable presenting to senior management.
  • Proactive and highly organized self-starter, able to work independently under tight deadlines while maintaining attention to detail.

An ideal candidate also has:

  • Familiarity with Headcount & SaaS cost modeling and management.
  • Proficiency with AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, Glean, Cursor, etc.), Databricks, and FP&A tools such as Workday Adaptive Planning (or similar planning systems) and NetSuite.
  • Prior partnership with software engineering teams.
  • Passion for building new models, processes, and mechanisms.

The compensation range shown spans approved pay zones for this role. Your primary work location determines the range applicable to you, which may be narrower than the full range displayed.

The range of annual base salary for full-time employees for this position is below. Please note that base pay offered may vary depending on factors including your city of residence, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Learn more about our total rewards and benefits below.

Annual Base Salary
$83,300—$140,000 USD

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email or click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara’s Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in @samsara.com, @us-greenhouse-mail.io or @mail3.guide.co. For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here.

0439dbffbd124a40.title: Pacific Market Lead (Business Development)
0439dbffbd124a40.description:
HOW YOU’LL MAKE AN IMPACT

As the Market Lead for the Pacific market, you'll have the opportunity to advance USGBC and GBCI's mission by increasing the adoption of green building products, services, and solutions while delivering measurable revenue growth.

The Market Lead is a revenue-generating sales role accountable for meeting or exceeding annual sales and revenue targets within a defined territory. You'll develop and execute territory-specific sales strategies, business development plans, and commercial activities to expand USGBC membership, LEED registrations and certifications, and other USGBC/GBCI products and services.

You'll work independently to build and manage a qualified sales pipeline, develop strategic relationships, negotiate and close new business, and achieve assigned revenue and product performance targets.

This position is responsible for one defined territory or market within the United States region. Commercial accountability, customer engagement, and sales execution will focus on that assigned territory, while collaborating with regional and global support teams as needed.

You'll represent USGBC and GBCI within your assigned market, cultivate relationships with members, customers, prospective buyers, and industry stakeholders, and convert those relationships into increased product adoption and revenue growth.

You'll lead business development across priority sectors and geographic areas within your territory, promoting USGBC/GBCI offerings such as membership, sponsorship, education, professional credentials, performance verification, project registration, and certification.

You'll also adapt approved marketing campaigns to local market conditions, strengthen strategic relationships, represent the organization at industry events, and contribute market insights and content that highlight sustainability leadership.

You will report to the regional director for United States Market Development and work closely with sales operations, customer account management, channel partner account management, client solutions, marketing and communications, and product teams to support effective commercial execution.

This role is ideal for a self-starter who thrives in an externally facing, growth-oriented environment and is motivated by purpose, performance, and measurable results.

Key Responsibilities

85a7e8d5b0e4d273.title: Software Architect
85a7e8d5b0e4d273.description:
Harris Digital Learning helps school districts build and run successful digital learning programs. At the heart of our work is eSchoolware™, our proprietary learning management system. It brings together everything districts need to manage, deliver, and support online and hybrid learning in a single platform.


eSchoolware serves students, teachers, parents, and administrators alike. It offers age-appropriate learning experiences for middle and high school students, mastery-based course progression, tools for communication and collaboration, and a reporting system with more than 200 standard reports, so educators always have the data they need to support student success. Our mission is simple: empower educators and engage every learner at every stage of their education.

What you will own


Year one

  • Define the target architecture and the sequence to reach it. The platform has no module seams today, so this is strangler-fig work around functional verticals on a shared foundation.
  • Specify and accept our modernization partner’s deliverables against defined criteria. You are the technical counterpart holding a fixed-price statement of work to account.
  • Lead the data-layer modernization: retire the XDoclet-generated Hibernate mappings in favour of JPA, and oversee the Oracle to PostgreSQL conversion alongside a specialist contractor.
  • Stand up the REST API façade and the identity, organization and enrollment foundation that everything else depends on.
  • Establish engineering practice from close to zero — CI/CD, code review, and characterization tests on a system with almost no test coverage today.
  • Recommend the shape of the team, and help us hire it.

Ongoing

  • Architecture standards, design patterns and technical governance
  • Mentoring engineers and contractors
  • Making AI-assisted development a normal part of how the team works
  • Ensuring quality, maintainability, accessibility and security are built in rather than retrofitted

WHAT GOOD LOOKS LIKE AT 90 DAYS


A validated target architecture and a sequenced roadmap that leadership can fund · acceptance criteria agreed in writing with our modernization partner · your recommendation on the team we should build and in what order.

What we need


MUST HAVE

  • 8+ years building enterprise software, including 5+ leading engineering teams or owning architecture on significant programs
  • You have actually modernized a large legacy system — decomposed a monolith, replaced a data layer, migrated a platform off an unsupported stack. We care far more that you have done it than which technologies it happened to be.
  • Strong Java and Spring Boot, and genuine comfort in a modern front-end stack. We are targeting Angular, React, and TypeScript.
  • Relational database depth — schema design, ORM behaviour, query performance. Oracle and PostgreSQL are both in play.
  • Experience owning a vendor or systems-integrator relationship: writing the specification, defining acceptance, and holding the line when delivery drifts.
  • Cloud-native delivery on Azure or equivalent — CI/CD, infrastructure as code, monitoring and observability.
  • Building to WCAG 2.2 AA. Accessibility is a contractual obligation passed to us by the districts we serve, not a nice-to-have.
  • Experience working with Linux servers

GENUINELY HELPFUL, AND NOT REQUIRED

  • K–12 or higher-education technology, and the 1EdTech standards — LTI 1.3, Common Cartridge and Thin Common Cartridge, OneRoster, QTI
  • Oracle-to-PostgreSQL migration, ora2pg, cutover planning and rollback strategy
  • Establishing test coverage on systems that have none
  • Remediating security findings in legacy code — secrets management, dependency CVEs, audit logging
  • Student data privacy: FERPA, COPPA, and district data-protection agreements
  • Portal frameworks such as Liferay. We are migrating away from it, so we are interested in the experience rather than a plan to keep it.
  • Gamified learning experiences and engagement mechanics
  • Fluent use of AI-assisted development tools in real delivery work, not just experimentation

A NOTE ON THE LIST ABOVE


We do not expect one person to bring all of this. If the first list describes you and two or three items in the second look familiar, please apply — we would rather talk to you than guess.

Education


Bachelor’s degree in software engineering, computer science or a related field, or the equivalent in demonstrated experience. We mean the second half of that sentence.

Salary range: $115,000 - $125,000 USD per year.

3ef2b34d8ca17213.description:
Job brief

Our client, a well-funded, early-stage startup revolutionizing B2B payments, is looking for a Software Development Engineer to join their Platform team as a key technical contributor. The successful candidate will design, build, and maintain the core systems — including Spring Boot microservices, a Spring Boot BFF, and Kubernetes-based cloud infrastructure — that power secure, scalable payment processing for enterprise customers worldwide. They will own backend services and APIs, drive integrations with banking partners, and mentor other engineers while helping shape the platform architecture.

Responsibilities

  • Own and evolve the platform's core architecture, including service boundaries, data models, and the shared libraries and infrastructure other teams build on.
  • Design and implement secure, well-documented backend services and REST APIs, shaping API contracts and OpenAPI specifications.
  • Design database schemas, caching strategies, and event-driven, message-based workflows that keep high-volume transaction processing consistent, performant, and resilient.
  • Champion system reliability and security across the platform, including monitoring, alerting, error handling, data encryption, and secure API design that meets the standards of a regulated financial environment.
  • Build and maintain secure, scalable integrations with major financial institutions and payment networks, translating complex banking protocols into robust, reusable platform capabilities.
  • Implement high-volume transaction processing systems with the accuracy, idempotency, and auditability that financial operations require.
  • Partner with Product, Architecture, and Engineering teams to translate business requirements into platform solutions, drive technical decisions, and advocate for reliability and security in architectural discussions.
  • Mentor mid-level and junior engineers on backend best practices, code quality, system design, and platform engineering principles.
  • Lead code reviews, establish coding standards, and help shape engineering culture as the team grows.

Requirements

  • 7+ years of software engineering experience with a strong focus on backend and distributed systems.
  • Expert proficiency in Java and the Spring framework (Spring Boot), with a track record of building complex, high-scale backend systems.
  • Deep experience designing and building microservices and REST APIs, including OpenAPI-driven contracts and generated clients.
  • Hands-on experience with containerization and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes) and cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure).
  • Strong system design skills across distributed systems, including database design, caching strategies, and message queues or event-driven architectures.
  • Solid understanding of authentication and security best practices (OAuth2/OIDC, data encryption, secure API design) in a financial services context.
  • Proven ability to debug complex issues, optimize performance, and architect solutions for high-scale, high-availability systems.
  • Strong proficiency with modern AI coding assistants (e.g., Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, or similar), with a track record of using them to boost engineering speed, quality, and impact.
  • Excellent communication skills and experience collaborating in cross-functional agile teams.
  • Professional fluency in English (written and verbal); all engineering collaboration, documentation, code reviews, and stakeholder communication are conducted in English.

Nice to have

  • Experience with real-time payment systems or high-frequency transaction processing.
  • Knowledge of banking APIs, SWIFT messaging, or ACH processing.
  • Experience with event-driven architectures and stream processing.
  • Background in fintech, payment processing, or B2B financial platforms.
  • Familiarity with enterprise DevOps practices and infrastructure as code.
  • Experience building multi-tenant SaaS applications with organization-scoped data access.
  • A track record of leading backend architecture decisions and establishing engineering standards.

What's on offer

  • Foundational technology ownership — they'll own core platform services that process millions in B2B payments, directly powering how enterprise customers manage counterparties, execute payments, and maintain compliance.
  • A real technical voice — their opinions on service architecture, API contracts, and data design will directly shape how the stack is built; this is a role that defines systems, not just maintains them.
  • A modern stack — a thoughtfully chosen technology stack that values simplicity and pragmatism over hype, with new tools adopted where they add real value.
  • Early-stage impact — a well-funded startup where their contributions will shape both the product and the engineering culture from the ground up.
  • An AI-forward culture — AI is embraced as a tool for innovation and efficiency, with curious, adaptable engineers welcome to bring it into their work.
  • A strong, growing team — a diverse team, including engineers from SAP and fintech innovators, who value technical excellence, continuous learning, and work-life balance.

About Rippling

Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system.

Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365—all within 90 seconds.

Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1.4B+ from the world’s top investors—including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes.

We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @Rippling.com addresses.

About the role

We are seeking a Tax Compliance Specialist to manage the tax compliance obligations across multiple jurisdictions in EMEA and LATAM. The ideal candidate will have a strong understanding of corporate income taxes and indirect taxes (GST/VAT), particularly in LATAM. This role will involve close collaboration with colleagues within the Tax and various other corporate functions in addition to the management of external advisors in various jurisdictions to ensure full compliance with local and international tax regulations.

The successful candidate will also play a pivotal role in maintaining the various processes and controls required to ensure Rippling continues to meet its compliance obligations as we continue to grow internationally.

What you will do

  • Manage the direct and indirect tax compliance requirements across LATAM jurisdictions, ensuring timely and accurate tax filings and payments including the preparation of corporate tax returns for income tax and GST/VAT.
  • Manage the direct tax compliance requirements in various EMEA jurisdictions, ensuring timely and accurate tax filings and payments including the preparation of corporate tax returns.
  • Monitor and implement changes in tax laws, reporting requirements, and regulatory obligations.
  • Maintain tax records, statutory filings, and supporting documentation for audits and compliance reviews.
  • Coordinate with external tax consultants, auditors, and advisors to ensure smooth tax compliance processes.
  • Assist with liaising with regulatory authorities (tax offices, government agencies) for tax filings, disputes, and queries as required.
  • Maintain best in class compliance process for the EMEA and LATAM entities.
  • Assist with the annual and interim US GAAP income tax provision as required.
  • Identify tax efficiencies and planning opportunities across our tax compliance processes where applicable.

What you will need

  • CPA, CA, Master’s degree in Taxation, Accounting, or Finance.
  • Tax compliance experience in LATAM.
  • Advanced English proficiency (CEFR C1 or higher, or equivalent demonstrated proficiency), with the ability to communicate complex information clearly in writing and conversation, lead professional discussions, and produce clear, well-structured written materials in English.
  • Ability to collaborate, ensure accountability, and drive results in a fast-paced, constantly changing environment with a high level of integrity.
  • 6+ years of relevant experience.
  • Experience in a public accounting firm and tax department of a multinational public company.
  • Experience in direct and indirect tax compliance.

We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce and do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, ancestry, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, sexual orientation, veteran or military status, or any other legally protected characteristics, Rippling is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities who need assistance during the hiring process. For office-based employees (employees who live within a defined radius of a Rippling office), Rippling considers working in the office, at least three days a week under current policy, to be an essential function of the employee's role.

f6193fd3ee4de285.title: Content Marketing Specialist
f6193fd3ee4de285.description:
About Us

We are a modern marketing collective built for scale, efficiency, and impact. As the parent company, Agital supports three specialized agencies: Go Fish Digital, REQ, and WDG, with shared infrastructure, advanced technology, and deeply experienced people, allowing each brand to do its best work.

Go Fish Digital is an engineering-forward performance marketing agency specializing in SEO, Generative Engine Optimization (GEO), its Barracuda AI platform, social commerce, and conversion-focused creative.

WDG designs and builds complex enterprise web experiences for associations, nonprofits, foundations, universities, and other mission-driven organizations.

REQ is a digital marketing and communications agency specializing in brand, reputation, and advocacy for global organizations across technology, healthcare, finance, hospitality, and real estate.

Together, we operate as one collaborative ecosystem, combining deep expertise, AI-powered capabilities, and a culture of curiosity to help ambitious brands grow while creating meaningful opportunities for our people.

About the Role

This role is based within Go Fish Digital, Agital's engineering-forward performance marketing agency. The Content Marketing Specialist creates high-quality, focused content that supports Go Fish Digital’s product marketing and demand generation initiatives. Reporting to the Product Marketing Leader, you’ll execute assigned content initiatives, including research, copywriting, client stories, thought leadership, and campaign materials within established positioning, messaging, audience priorities, and campaign objectives.

This is a hands-on individual contributor role focused on producing high-quality content that supports established marketing priorities. Product Marketing sets product positioning, messaging, content priorities, and offer narratives, while Demand Generation owns campaign strategy and performance. The Content Marketing Specialist translates that direction into accurate, compelling, and timely content across campaigns, client stories, thought leadership, and sales enablement materials.

This role does not own the company’s overall content strategy, corporate brand strategy, editorial calendar, or demand generation programs. You will be responsible for the quality, accuracy, and timely delivery of assigned content, not for setting the broader strategy or managing the overall marketing program.

This is an opportunity to build a portfolio of substantive B2B content with direct access to agency specialists, client results, and commercial leaders. You’ll receive direction and editorial feedback from the Product Marketing Leader while developing your skills in client storytelling, thought leadership, and campaign copy. Your work will help prospective clients understand our expertise and give commercial teams stronger materials to use with buyers.

What You'll Do

Write Campaign and Conversion Copy

  • Write landing page copy, marketing emails, outbound copy, webinar descriptions, and other campaign assets.
  • Apply Product Marketing's established positioning and messaging guidance to specific buyer needs, industries, and stages of the buying process.
  • Develop clear headlines, relevant offers, and calls to action that help buyers take the next step.
  • Partner with Demand Generation to revise copy based on campaign results, buyer feedback, and structured tests.

Develop Client Stories and Commercial Proof

  • Interview account teams, subject matter experts, and clients to understand the client challenge, our approach, and the results.
  • Write client stories that connect our work to measurable business outcomes and explain why those outcomes matter.
  • Gather supporting evidence, verify claims with the relevant teams, and coordinate required reviews and client approvals before publication.
  • Adapt client stories into campaign assets, website copy, sales materials, and short proof points.

Turn Expertise into Thought Leadership

  • Independently prepare for and conduct subject matter expert interviews, using follow-up questions to uncover specific insights and examples.
  • Translate technical concepts into clear, credible content for senior marketing and business decision-makers.
  • Draft articles, research summaries, executive bylines, and other thought leadership based on briefs, content priorities, and messaging established by Product Marketing
  • Research priority industries and buyer challenges, evaluate sources, and distinguish supported findings from opinion.

Repurpose Content for Distribution and Sales

  • Turn substantial research, client stories, and thought leadership into useful assets across email, social, website, and sales channels.
  • Collaborate with Product Marketing and Sales on content that addresses common buyer questions and objections.
  • Prepare clear briefs for design and web specialists, and review produced assets for content accuracy.
  • Maintain consistent voice, terminology, and messaging across formats.

Manage Content Quality and Delivery

  • Manage assigned content deliverables from brief through draft, review, and approved handoff, ensuring deadlines and dependencies are communicated.
  • Maintain interview notes, source references, supporting metrics, and version control for assigned content.
  • Edit for clarity, accuracy, specificity, and relevance; avoid unsupported claims and generic marketing language.
  • Seek and incorporate feedback from Product Marketing, Demand Generation, and subject matter experts.

What You Will Need

  • Relevant experience: 2–4 years of experience in B2B content marketing, copywriting, journalism, or a related writing role, or equivalent demonstrated experience.
  • Strong writing portfolio: Samples demonstrating clear storytelling, persuasive commercial writing, and the ability to explain complex topics. Relevant work may include client stories, articles, email copy, or landing pages.
  • Interviewing and research: Able to prepare for and conduct interviews independently, ask useful follow-up questions, evaluate sources, and verify facts.
  • Commercial judgment: Able to connect capabilities and results to a buyer’s business problem and adapt writing to a defined audience.
  • Execution and collaboration: Able to work from a brief, manage deadlines, incorporate feedback, and produce publication-ready content with editorial review.

What Will Help You Succeed

  • Experience writing for an agency, professional services firm, or marketing technology company, ideally targeting senior marketing decision-makers.
  • Familiarity with digital marketing services, including SEO, GEO, and paid media, or a demonstrated ability to learn technical subject matter quickly.
  • Experience developing quantified client stories, original research content, or copy supporting demand generation campaigns.
  • Familiarity with content performance metrics and using campaign feedback to improve writing.

Why Join Us
You'll work alongside talented people who are passionate about solving problems, helping clients grow, and delivering meaningful results. We're a collaborative, fast-moving team where curiosity is encouraged, ideas are welcomed, and great work is recognized.

We believe the best work happens when people are trusted to take ownership, supported in their growth, and empowered to bring their unique perspectives to the table. Whether you're just getting started or bringing years of experience, you'll have the opportunity to make an impact while continuing to learn and grow.

Benefits & Compensation 

We believe great people deserve great support. Our company offers competitive compensation and a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your health, well-being, and career growth, including:

  • Competitive compensation
  • Flexible work environment
  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance
  • Unlimited paid time off
  • 401(k) with company match
  • Company-paid life and disability insurance
  • Paid parental leave
  • A collaborative culture with autonomy and ownership
  • Employee wellness programs and additional perks

Additional Information

No agencies, please.

We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone feels respected, valued, and empowered to succeed. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

Please note that this job description is intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed. It is not intended to be a comprehensive list of all responsibilities, duties, or qualifications, which may change based on business needs.

At this time, we are unable to sponsor or transfer employment visas for this position.

da6f8b8fdaffd22a.description:
A FCamara está em busca de um(a) Desenvolvedor(a) FullStack Senior para atuar em parceria com uma empresa do segmento educacional.

Sobre a Posição

Buscamos um(a) Desenvolvedor(a) Fullstack com domínio sólido noecossistema .NET e React para atuar na construção e evolução deplataformas escaláveis, distribuídas e nativas em nuvem.

Mais do que dominar a stack tradicional, procuramos umprofissional com mentalidade AI-First: alguém que utilize ferramentas deInteligência Artificial de forma estratégica e contínua para acelerar o ciclode desenvolvimento (SDLC), elevar a qualidade das entregas, automatizar tarefasrepetitivas e focar na resolução de problemas arquiteturais complexos.


Desenvolver, manter e evoluir aplicações web utilizando .NET (C#) no back-end e React no front-end. Projetar e implementar APIs RESTful seguras, performáticas e bem documentadas. Participar da definição da arquitetura de soluções e tomar decisões técnicas com autonomia. Escrever código limpo, testável e seguindo boas práticas (SOLID, Clean Code, design patterns). Realizar code reviews e apoiar tecnicamente pessoas desenvolvedoras mais júniores. Colaborar com times de produto, design e QA em um ambiente ágil. Identificar e resolver gargalos de performance, segurança e escalabilidade.

Responsabilidades

  • Desenvolvimento Backend & APIs: Projetar, desenvolver e manter microsserviços e APIs RESTful/GraphQL de alta performance utilizando .NET (C#), aplicando princípios de Clean Architecture, SOLID e DDD.
  • Arquitetura Frontend & Microfrontends: Construir interfaces modulares, reativas e escaláveis em React, estruturando e mantendo arquiteturas baseadas em Microfrontends (ex: Webpack Module Federation, Single-SPA) para garantir independência de deploy entre múltiplos times.
  • Desenvolvimento Cloud-Native: Desenvolver e operar soluções orientadas à nuvem (AWS, Azure ou GCP), utilizando containers (Docker/Kubernetes), arquitetura serverless, mensageria assíncrona e pipelines de CI/CD.
  • Engenharia Aumentada por IA (AI-Driven Development): Utilizar assistentes de IA no fluxo diário para geração de código boilerplate, refatoração assistida, criação automatizada de testes unitários/integração, documentação técnica e revisão de código (Code Review).
  • Qualidade, Segurança e Observabilidade: Garantir a saúde das aplicações em produção por meio de práticas de testes automatizados (TDD/BDD), análise estática de código, monitoramento de performance (APM) e logs distribuídos.
  • Colaboração Técnica: Participar ativamente de discussões de arquitetura, refinamentos técnicos e mentorias, compartilhando boas práticas de desenvolvimento e novos fluxos de produtividade com IA com o restante do time.

Requisitos Técnicos (Obrigatórios)

  • Backend: Experiência consolidada com .NET Core / .NET 6, 7 ou 8+ (C#), Entity Framework Core / Dapper, criação de APIs RESTful e integração com sistemas de mensageria (RabbitMQ, Apache Kafka, Azure Service Bus ou AWS SQS/SNS).
  • Frontend: Forte domínio de , TypeScript, gerenciamento de estado complexo (Redux Toolkit, Zustand, React Query) e estilização moderna.
  • Microfrontends: Experiência prática no desenho, implementação e orquestração de Microfrontends, compreendendo estratégias de roteamento distribuído, compartilhamento de dependências, Design Systems e comunicação entre módulos.
  • Cloud & DevOps: Vivência prática no desenvolvimento e deploy de aplicações em provedores de nuvem (Azure, AWS ou GCP), uso de Docker, Kubernetes e configuração de esteiras CI/CD (GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps ou GitLab CI).
  • Banco de Dados: Domínio de bancos relacionais (SQL Server, PostgreSQL) e NoSQL (MongoDB, Redis, DynamoDB).
  • Proficiência em Ferramentas de IA: Experiência comprovada no uso diário de ferramentas de IA aplicadas à engenharia de software (ex: GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Claude, ChatGPT) e técnicas de Prompt Engineering voltadas para geração de código, debugging avançado, migração de código e criação de testes.

Informações adicionais

Diferenciais Competitivos

  • Experiência na integração de LLMs e APIs de IA diretamente nos produtos desenvolvidos (ex: OpenAI API, Semantic Kernel, LangChain, RAG).
  • Conhecimento em padrões de arquitetura orientada a eventos (EDA) e estratégias de modernização de sistemas legados.
  • Certificações em Cloud (Microsoft Certified: Azure Developer Associate, AWS Certified Developer, etc.).
  • Vivência com ferramentas de observabilidade como Datadog, Grafana, Prometheus ou OpenTelemetry.

O que esperamos do seu perfil comportamental

  • Pragmatismo e Foco em Valor: Capacidade de equilibrar excelência técnica com velocidade de entrega, usando a tecnologia (e a IA) como alavanca de eficiência.
  • Pensamento Crítico sobre IA: Saber auditar, validar e refinar o código gerado por IA, garantindo que a velocidade não comprometa a segurança, a manutenibilidade ou a arquitetura do sistema.
  • Comunicação Clara: Habilidade para traduzir requisitos de negócio complexos em soluções técnicas elegantes e bem documentadas.

Remuneração e benefícios:

  • Remuneração: a combinar + Bonificação mensal e trimestral com base no MRR Contratado + Bonificação anual com base na lucratividade da empresa.
  • Saúde física e mental:créditos na plataforma Keiken e acesso à plataforma Wellhub.
  • Plano de saúde:reembolso.
  • Recesso:uma semana de recesso nas semanas de Natal ou Ano Novo (definição de escala junto ao time).
  • Descanso: 15 dias úteis de descanso remunerado ao ano.

Sobre a GIRO.TECH>GIRO.TECH

Conheça nossa visão nas palavras doRonaldo, fundador e líder da empresa:

[Clique para acessar o vídeo]

A GIRO.TECH>GIRO.TECH é uma plataforma detecnologia e serviços especializados para o mercado de crédito. Unimos tecnologia de ponta à inteligência regulatória e operacional para estruturar produtos de financiamento e operações de securitização. Somos resolvedores de problemas complexos e nosso combustível diário é descomplicar o mercado de crédito: transformamos regras complexas em soluções fluidas que simplesmente funcionam.

Aqui, você vai entender na prática a engrenagem que move o mercado de capitais e de financiamento, desde formalização de CCBs e arranjos com correspondentes bancários até a estrutura de securitização e FIDCs.

Através de nossas unidades de negócio desenvolvemos soluções que operam de forma integrada e escalável. Por meio de APIs robustas, plataformas proprietárias e estrutura operacional especializada, conectamos originadores de crédito, investidores e esteiras completas de originação com precisão. Cada parceiro tem desafios e dinâmicas próprias, e nossa missão é arquitetar e sustentar a infraestrutura tecnológica exata para cada um deles.

Como pensamos (Nosso DNA)

Valorizamos quem tem BRIO!

Somos uma empresa formada por NERDs apaixonados por resolver problemas complexos com tecnologia inteligente. Atuamos com uma mentalidade de jogo infinito: não focamos em ganhar uma partida isolada, mas em permanecer no jogo, buscando desafios cada vez maiores e manter um aprendizado contínuo para ser cada dia melhor.

Na GIRO.TECH>GIRO.TECH, mérito e entrega real andam juntos. Quem gera impacto e fortalece o time será sempre recompensado. Nossas lideranças e time sênior são formadas majoritariamente por profissionais que começaram como estagiários ou em cargos júnior. Aqui, novas vagas importantes são prioritariamente preenchidas com pessoas da casa.

Nossos processos seletivos buscam futuros parceiros e sócios para a empresa. Para ir rápido, melhor ir sozinho. Se queremos construir algo grande, precisamos nos juntar a mais gente boa que pense como a gente. Dedicamos muito tempo nos processos seletivos para achar essas pessoas e entregamos desafios constantes para promover crescimento. Temos hoje comosócios da empresa, muitas pessoas que começaram em posições de base e mostraram que têm vontade de ser mais.

Fundadores [nossa base]

Uma empresa é a extensão dos valores e sonhos de seus sócios fundadores. A GIRO.TECH>GIRO.TECH foi fundada por quatro sócios, que têm como primeira formação a tecnologia, e são apaixonados por servir os outros usando seu conhecimento e por resolver problemas complexos.

Isso é GIRO.TECH>GIRO.TECH

  • Liderança e mentoria:aqui não temos "chefes", mas líderes que caminham lado a lado, incentivam e ensinam.
  • Voz ativa:a melhor ideia prevalece, não o maior cargo. Oferecemos espaço para testar, errar e aprender.
  • Autonomia e responsabilidade:valorizamos o trabalho remoto e a autonomia. Você tem liberdade para trabalhar de onde preferir e vestir o que for mais confortável; em troca, esperamos responsabilidade total com as entregas.
  • Evolução contínua:priorizamos nosso time para ocupar novas vagas e posições mais desafiadoras. Temos muitas pessoas que iniciaram como estagiários e hoje evoluíram para o nível sênior, alguns, inclusive, passaram a ser sócios da empresa.
  • Excelência técnica:nossa principal estratégia comercial é possuir a melhor tecnologia e um produto de alta performance. O resultado é a satisfação dos nossos clientes, que nos avaliam constantemente com notas acima de 9.

Isso NÃO é GIRO.TECH>GIRO.TECH

  • Não somos uma instituição financeira tradicional de "terno e colete puffer".
  • Não valorizamos hierarquias rígidas ou burocracias excessivas para tomada de decisão.
  • Não somos os donos da verdade; somosinquietos, curiosos e abertos a mudanças.

Perfil que buscamos

Buscamos pessoas capazes de se adaptar a cenários dinâmicos e com sede de conhecimento. Valorizamos a inquietude: a busca constante por evoluir processos e construir resultados melhores a cada dia.

Se você é apaixonado por solucionar problemas com excelência, busca desafios que te tirem da zona de conforto e nunca está satisfeito com o mediano, seu lugar é aqui.

Venha construir o futuro da infraestrutura de crédito com a gente!




Sobre a vaga:

Estamos em busca de um(a) Sales Engineer (SE) para liderar e executar todo o ciclo de vendas complexas para contas Enterprise na GIRO.TECH.>GIRO.TECH. Para nós, vender não é usar discursos genéricos de vendedor tradicional. Unindo inteligência comercial à capacidade técnica avançada queremos garantir que os negócios avancem com previsibilidade e segurança técnica desde o primeiro contato até o fechamento do contrato.

Nessa cadeira híbrida (comercial + técnica), você atuará no diagnóstico das dores operacionais e de crédito de potenciais clientes, desenhando soluções customizadas a partir da infraestrutura da GIRO.TECH>GIRO.TECH e traduzindo o valor técnico do produto em retorno financeiro (ROI) para os tomadores de decisão (Sócios, C-Level e Diretores).

Cada cliente Enterprise tem uma operação complexa com suas próprias particularidades, e estamos sempre buscando as melhores soluções para gerar eficiência e margem, mantendo o rigor e a excelência que marcam o nosso jeito de fazer.

Se você quer entender como nossa infraestrutura de crédito e bancarização se conecta ao ecossistema de grandes empresas, e possui uma mentalidade de jogo infinito — focado na construção de valor contínuo e parcerias de longo prazo —, queremos você no nosso time!

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Gestão de Vendas e Conversão

  • Atendimento consultivo de novos leads qualificados e condução de reuniões de deep-dive técnico e de negócios.
  • Qualificação de leads gerados pelo Inbound, Parceiros e Eventos
  • Diagnóstico aprofundado dos sistemas atuais do potencial cliente (ERPs, motores de crédito, Administradores de FIDCs) envolvidos na operação.
  • Realização de reuniões personalizadas e simulações financeiras de ganho de eficiência tributária comprovando o ROI da solução.
  • Execução de follow-up e gestão ativa do próprio funil de vendas (pipeline) para garantir o avanço das negociações.
  • Desenho da arquitetura de solução inicial (como o produto da GIRO.TECH>GIRO.TECH irá se integrar ao ecossistema do cliente).
Estratégia, Crescimento e Retenção
  • Prospecção de Novos Parceiros e Manutenção dos Parceiros homologados na base, incentivando novas indicações de leads
  • Identificação e geração de oportunidades de Upsell e Cross-sell dentro da carteira de clientes ativos.
  • Responsabilidade direta pelo atingimento da meta anual de crescimento de MRR.
  • Acompanhamento próximo aos clientes para garantir satisfação e evitar churn.
  • Garantia da integridade dos dados de vendas, interações técnicas e mapeamentos de sistemas no CRM (Hubspot).
  • Fornecer previsões de fechamento de novos contratos baseadas na maturidade técnica da negociação (Forecasting).
  • Análise crítica de métricas de vendas e performance de funil para correção de rotas.

O que buscamos (requisitos):


Formação:Ensino Superior Completo em Engenharia, Ciência da Computação, Sistemas de Informação, Administração ou áreas correlatas (com viés técnico/comercial).

Experiência:Vivência comprovada em Vendas B2B Complexas (Enterprise) ou em posições de Sales Engineering / Solutions Architecture nos setores de tecnologia ou mercado financeiro.

Conhecimento Técnico (Hard Skills):

  • Domínio prático de arquitetura de sistemas: APIs REST, webhooks, computação em nuvem (cloud vs on-premise), bancos de dados e segurança da informação.
  • Desejável conhecimento sobre o ecossistema de Crédito e Banking (motores de decisão, birôs, fluxos de originação, bancarização, Securitizadoras e FIDCs).
  • Uso de CRM avançado (Hubspot), ferramentas de Sales Engagement e IA para automação de processos.
  • Capacidade de análise de dados e projeção de cenários (Forecasting).
Perfil Comportamental e Adaptabilidade (Soft Skills):
  • Comunicação Executiva e Didática: Capacidade de transitar com facilidade entre o "tequinês" (conversando com o time de produto do cliente) e a linguagem de negócios (conversando com o CFO/CEO do cliente).
  • Perfil Consultivo e Escuta Ativa: Curiosidade para entender a fundo o fluxo operacional do cliente antes de propor uma solução.
  • Organização Extrema e Foco em Resultados: manter o CRM atualizado e ser guiado por processos automáticos, não somente por instinto e reativo. Ter sistemas e organização que tornem impossível esquecer um follow ou deixar um lead sem resposta.
  • Negociação de Alto Nível: facilidade para lidar com tomadores de decisão (C-Level) e fechar contratos complexos.
  • Resiliência Comercial: Capacidade de lidar com objeções técnicas e longas jornadas de negociação típicas de clientes de grande porte.

8a55dbef046f78a4.title: Regional Sales Director, Enterprise Solutions - New Logo
8a55dbef046f78a4.description:
Overview:

Our Culture and Impact

Cvent is a leading meetings, events, and hospitality technology provider with more than 6,000+ employees and 34,000+ customers worldwide, including 60% of the Fortune 500. Founded in 1999, Cvent delivers a comprehensive event marketing and management platform for marketers and event professionals and offers software solutions to hotels, special event venues and destinations to help them grow their group/MICE and corporate travel business. Our technology brings millions of people together at events around the world. In short, we’re transforming the meetings and events industry through innovative technology that powers the human connection.

Cvent's strength lies in its people, fostering a culture where everyone is encouraged to think like entrepreneurs, taking risks and making decisions confidently. We value diverse perspectives and celebrate differences, working together with colleagues and clients to build strong connections.

AI at Cvent: Leading the Future

Are you ready to shape the future of work at the intersection of human expertise and AI innovation? At Cvent, we’re committed to continuous learning and adaptation—AI isn’t just a tool for us, it’s part of our DNA. We’re looking for candidates who are eager to evolve alongside technology. If you love to experiment boldly, share your discoveries, and help define best practices for AI-augmented work, you’ll thrive here. Our team values professionals who thoughtfully integrate AI into their daily work, delivering exceptional results while relying on the human judgment and creativity that drive real innovation.

Throughout our interview process, you’ll have the chance to demonstrate how you use AI to learn, iterate, and amplify your impact. If you’re excited to be part of a team that’s leading the way in AI-powered collaboration, we’d love to meet you.

Cvent’s Enterprise Sales team is growing, and we’re looking for a Regional Sales Director to drive net-new enterprise customer acquisition. This is a new-logo-focused, quota-carrying role: you’ll identify and develop target accounts, create opportunities from the ground up, and lead consultative sales cycles through close.

You’ll engage enterprise prospects, understand their business priorities, and connect those needs to Cvent’s solutions. You’ll work closely with your Sales Development Representative to turn targeted outreach into qualified pipeline, and partner with Account Management and Client Services to support a strong handoff after a new customer is won. Your primary focus is landing new customers and achieving your new-booked business quota.


In This Role, You Will:

  • Build and execute focused account plans to identify, prioritize, and penetrate target enterprise accounts.
  • Create new opportunities through proactive prospecting, including cold outreach, and develop relationships with prospects who can become Cvent customers.
  • Lead consultative discovery to understand business needs, buying priorities, decision processes, and potential fit for Cvent solutions.
  • Present and demonstrate Cvent products and services to enterprise prospects, tailoring the conversation to their needs and stakeholders.
  • Own new-logo sales opportunities from initial engagement through qualification, proposal, negotiation, and close.
  • Build and maintain relationships with key decision-makers and other stakeholders throughout complex enterprise buying processes.
  • Partner effectively with your Sales Development Representative to focus prospecting efforts, develop qualified opportunities, and convert pipeline into new customers.
  • Consistently achieve or exceed established revenue targets for new software business.
  • Maintain an accurate, well-managed pipeline; forecast opportunities reliably and keep sales activity current in the system.
  • Collaborate with Account Management and Client Services to ensure a thoughtful transition and a positive customer experience after the sale.
  • Contribute to team initiatives and perform other duties as assigned.

Here's What You Need:

  • Bachelor’s degree.
  • At least 5 years of revenue-generating software sales experience; additional experience is preferred.
  • Experience in one or more of the following areas is highly preferred: SaaS, mobile applications, or analytics.
  • Ability to prospect, run consultative sales conversations, deliver product demonstrations, and close contracts.
  • Strong business acumen and the ability to understand how products, operational processes, and customer needs connect.
  • Strong organizational and detail-orientation skills, with the ability to manage multiple opportunities in a dynamic, fast-changing environment.
  • Initiative and personal leadership, with the ability to work independently and contribute to team goals.
  • Strong ethics, integrity, and commitment to customer relationships.

This job posting is intended to comply with all applicable laws. If we learn during the course of our recruitment process that, due to an applicant’s location, further information about the position is required, including certain salary information, this information in this posting will be supplemented accordingly.


The estimated annual on-target earnings (OTE) range for new hires into this role is $186,000-$287,000. This includes a base salary range of $81,000-$134,000 plus target commission. Please note that base salary reflects fixed annual pay, while OTE reflects total target cash compensation. The above OTE range represents the targeted earnings; commissions are determined by individual results and may be earned in excess of the target. Actual compensation will depend on factors such as job-related knowledge, relevant experience, and location. We also offer a competitive benefits package, and details can be found on our Benefits page.

Physical Demands
Multiple positions may be filled from this announcement.
We are not able to offer sponsorship for this position

d8387d8d6311e9ca.title: Customer Service Supervisor - Remote
d8387d8d6311e9ca.description:
Join our collaborative team where effort and work ethic get noticed. Enjoy a positive, friendly, energetic work environment with accessible leadership, where you will have the opportunity to learn the insurance industry and valuable skills while we invest in your future career with us.

Why Stillwater?Stillwater Insurance Group is a mid-sized national insurance provider offering a variety of home, auto and commercial insurance products in 50 states. We are headquartered in Jacksonville, Florida, with additional offices in New York and Omaha, Nebraska. We offer an up-beat and supportive environment for a new team-member who brings a positive attitude, reliable work habits, attention to detail and an interest in learning. Our employees consistently describe Stillwater as a great company with great people where honesty and integrity are high priorities. Coaching and development, recognition and growth opportunities are some of the benefits of working in our small team environment.

The Customer Service Supervisor leads and supports a team of Customer Service Representatives to deliver exceptional service experiences. This role is responsible for overseeing daily operations, coaching and mentoring staff, resolving escalated customer issues, and ensuring service standards and performance goals are met. The Supervisor serves as a key liaison between frontline staff and leadership, driving continuous improvement in customer satisfaction and team performance. This is a remote work from home opportunity.

Key Responsibilities

  • Supervise and support Customer Service Representatives, ensuring consistent service quality
  • Review and evaluate employee performance; provide ongoing coaching and individual feedback
  • Identify training needs and conduct or coordinate training as necessary
  • Complete annual performance reviews
  • Coordinate recruiting and onboarding of new team members
  • Approve weekly timecards and support scheduling needs
  • Serve as the primary point of escalation for customer complaints, concerns, and inquiries, ensuring timely resolution
  • Prepare and deliver weekly and monthly performance and service metrics reports to the AVP, Customer Service
  • Promote a positive, collaborative, and service-oriented team culture
  • Support department initiatives and perform additional duties as assigned by the VP, Customer Service

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree or university program certificate
    OR
    Six (6) or more years of related experience and/or training
    OR
    An equivalent combination of education and experience
  • P&C Agent license

Required Skills and Abilities

  • Strong customer service orientation with the ability to manage difficult or escalated situations
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills
  • Ability to read, interpret, and write procedural documentation and reports
  • Strong mathematical and analytical skills, including the ability to interpret metrics and performance reports
  • Proven problem-solving and decision-making skills
  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines
  • Proficiency with customer service software, reporting tools, and standard word-processing applications
  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively across teams and levels
  • Demonstrated attention to detail and sound judgment
  • Flexibility and adaptability in a fast-paced, changing environment

Knowledge, Skills, and Competencies

  • Problem Solving: Gathers and analyzes information, develops alternative solutions, and applies sound reasoning
  • Interpersonal Skills: Resolves conflict constructively, maintains confidentiality, listens actively, and remains open to new ideas
  • Customer Service: Responds promptly, manages emotional situations effectively, and meets service commitments
  • Teamwork: Encourages collaboration, builds morale, and supports team success above individual interests
  • Managing People: Develops staff, provides regular feedback, includes team members in decisions, and improves processes
  • Adaptability: Manages change, competing demands, and unexpected challenges with professionalism
  • Dependability: Follows through on commitments, meets deadlines, and demonstrates accountability
  • Ethics: Acts with integrity, treats others with respect, and upholds organizational values

Why Consider This Role?

This is an excellent opportunity for experienced customer service professionals looking to grow their leadership skills, influence service strategy, and make a meaningful impact on both customer experience and team development.

Apply today to grow your career with Stillwater Insurance Group. Employment offers are contingent upon successful completion of a background investigation and pre-employment drug screening. Stillwater Insurance Group is a drug-free workplace and an equal opportunity employer.
