09bf37edeac90cdf.title: Support Systems & Programs Lead | Europe Remote
09bf37edeac90cdf.description:
The AI orchestration of your wildest imagination.

n8n is the open workflow orchestration platform built for the new era of AI. We give technical teams the freedom of code with the speed of no-code, so they can automate faster, smarter, and without limits. Backed by a fiercely inventive community and 500+ builder-approved integrations, we’re changing the way people bring systems together and scale ideas for impact.

Since our founding in 2019, we’ve grown into a diverse team of over 260 - working across Europe and the US, connected by a shared builder spirit and with our centre of gravity in Berlin. Along the way, we’ve:

  • Cultivated a community of more than 650,000 active developers and builders

  • Earned 190K+ GitHub stars, making us one of the world’s Top 40 most popular projects

  • Backed by top investors, from Sequoia’s first German seed to our SAP's recent strategic investment - bringing us to a $5.2bn valuation


That’s the company we’ve built. Now we’d love to see what you can build. If you’re applying, try n8n out - whether you’re technical or not - and share a screenshot of your first workflow with us. The easiest place to start is here: app.n8n.cloud/register.

We’re in a defining moment of an incredible journey. Come and build with us.

Your main goal will be to build and scale the systems, automations, and AI-powered processes that enable n8n's Support teams to deliver exceptional service at scale, while leading and developing the engineers who make it happen.

To achieve this, you'll take ownership of four key areas:

Lead and grow the Support Systems team

  • Lead, coach, and develop our Systems & Programs engineers, helping them grow their technical expertise and careers.

  • Establish a clear team scope, planning processes, and delivery rhythm to ensure consistent execution against priorities.

  • Support hiring and onboarding while staying close to technical decisions and hands-on problem-solving.

Own the Support tooling strategy and roadmap

  • Own the Support tooling portfolio and build a prioritised roadmap that enables Reactive and Proactive Support to scale efficiently.

  • Establish structured project intake, scoping, and prioritisation processes to focus engineering efforts on the highest-impact opportunities.

  • Partner with Support leaders and stakeholders across Product, Engineering, Cloud, Security, Legal, Data, Customer Success, Sales, and Partnerships to align priorities and deliver improvements.

Drive AI-first Support and automation

  • Lead the expansion of Nate, our AI-powered Support solution, across Support tiers to increase the share of tickets handled through AI.

  • Guide the development, maintenance, and adoption of reliable automations, AI agents, and integrations that reduce repetitive work and improve Support efficiency.

  • Measure the impact of AI and automation through metrics such as time saved, AI-handled ticket share, and cost per AI ticket.

Build scalable processes and operational foundations

  • Rebuild and optimise foundational Support processes, ensuring workflows are efficient, documented, and scalable.

  • Establish strong governance for standard operating procedures (SOPs), tooling ownership, and automation reliability.

  • Drive continuous improvement by tracking tooling adoption, SOP compliance, operational efficiency, and capacity freed up for Support teams.

REQUIREMENTS

Must-haves

  • Hands-on n8n expertise: You have practical experience building and maintaining complex workflows and automations using n8n.

  • Strong technical foundations: You're comfortable working with APIs, HTTP, authentication, webhooks, and SaaS architecture.

  • Support systems ownership: You've owned and improved technical Support systems, tooling, and automations in a B2B SaaS environment.

  • Engineering leadership: You have at least 5 years experience leading or mentoring engineers, helping them develop their skills and deliver high-quality work.

  • Roadmap and stakeholder management: You can translate business needs into clear technical priorities and align cross-functional stakeholders around a shared roadmap.

  • AI and automation expertise: You have hands-on experience implementing AI agents or AI-assisted Support tooling to improve operational efficiency.

Nice-to-haves

  • Technical product background: You've worked as a developer, in DevOps, or on an automation-focused technical product.

  • Support analytics: You're familiar with Support performance metrics and have experience using analytics or dashboarding tools such as Hex or Metabase.

  • Open-source ecosystem: You have experience working in open-source or community-led SaaS environments.

  • Remote-first experience: You've worked in distributed, remote-first teams, ideally within a European startup or scale-up.

Why join us?

At n8n, you'll have the opportunity to shape a growing Support Systems function and define how we scale customer support through AI, automation, and better tooling. You'll lead a team of talented engineers, own a high-impact technical roadmap, and work closely with teams across the company to turn ambitious ideas into real operational improvements.

You'll join one of Europe's fastest-growing startups, where your work will directly influence how we deliver exceptional customer experiences as we grow. With a remote-first culture that values autonomy, experimentation, and continuous learning, you'll have the freedom to build the foundations of an AI-first Support organisation.

Sound like a challenge you're excited to take on?

Apply now — and help us build the future of automation.

n8n is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

We can sponsor visas to Germany; for any other country, you need to have existing right to work.

Our company language is English.

You care about diversity and inclusion? We do too! Check out our Diversity, Inclusion and Belonging initiatives at n8n (https://www.notion.so/n8n/Diversity-inclusion-and-belonging-n8n-c1bec2fff536422d868b1a438d990e35).

Location disclaimer: If you see multiple job postings for the same role, it is most likely because we're hiring remotely for this role and posting in different locations to make sure every potential candidate can see the role. Please apply to the location you're the most likely to work from in the future.

Benefits

  • Competitive compensation 💸 – We offer fair and attractive pay.

  • Ownership 💪 – Our core value is to “empower others,” and we mean it—you’ll get a slice of n8n with equity.

  • Work/life balance 🏖️ – We work hard but ensure you have time to recharge:

    • Europe: 30 days of vacation, plus public holidays wherever you are.

    • US: 20 vacation days, 8 sick days, plus public holidays wherever you are.

  • Health & wellness 🩺 –

    • Europe: We provide benefits according to local country norms.*

    • US: Multiple low-premium, low-deductible medical plans with coverage for individuals and families—plus a no-cost premium HDHP option with a pre-seeded HSA—along with dental and vision coverage.

  • Future planning 💰 –

    • Europe: We provide pension contributions according to local country norms.*

    • US: 401(k) retirement plan with a 4% employer match.

  • Financial security 🛡️ –

    • Europe: We provide benefits according to local country norms.*

    • US: Company-paid short-term and long-term disability insurance, plus life insurance to support you and your loved ones.

  • Career growth 📈 – We hire rising stars who grow with us! You’ll get €1K (or equivalent) per year to spend on courses, books, events, or coaching to level up your skills.

  • A passionate team 🤩 – We love our product, and we prove it with regular hackathons where we see who can build the coolest thing with it!

  • Remote-first 🌏 – Our team works remotely across Europe, with regular off-sites for team bonding. Some roles, like sales in the US, are hybrid—please check the job description.

d91d4ae595b66760.title: Sales Development Representative DACH
d91d4ae595b66760.description:
The AI orchestration of your wildest imagination.

n8n is the open workflow orchestration platform built for the new era of AI. We give technical teams the freedom of code with the speed of no-code, so they can automate faster, smarter, and without limits. Backed by a fiercely inventive community and 500+ builder-approved integrations, we’re changing the way people bring systems together and scale ideas for impact.

Since our founding in 2019, we’ve grown into a diverse team of over 260 - working across Europe and the US, connected by a shared builder spirit and with our centre of gravity in Berlin. Along the way, we’ve:

  • Cultivated a community of more than 650,000 active developers and builders

  • Earned 190K+ GitHub stars, making us one of the world’s Top 40 most popular projects

  • Backed by top investors, from Sequoia’s first German seed to our SAP's recent strategic investment - bringing us to a $5.2bn valuation


That’s the company we’ve built. Now we’d love to see what you can build. If you’re applying, try n8n out - whether you’re technical or not - and share a screenshot of your first workflow with us. The easiest place to start is here: app.n8n.cloud/register.

We’re in a defining moment of an incredible journey. Come and build with us.

3 days per week in our Berlin office

Build your enterprise sales career at n8n

n8n is growing rapidly at the intersection of AI, automation and enterprise software. More than 1.7 million active builders use n8n each month, and we’re scaling our enterprise business as more organisations look for ways to connect AI with the systems, data and workflows that run their businesses.

We’re building our SDR team in Berlin and looking for an Enterprise Sales Development Representative to join us.

You’ll partner closely with Enterprise Account Executives to break into some of the largest organisations in the DACH region. This isn’t about maximising email volume. You’ll take a thoughtful, account-based approach: researching strategic companies, identifying the right stakeholders, understanding their priorities, and creating relevant conversations around automation and AI.

If you’re succeeding in an SDR/BDR role and want greater exposure to enterprise selling, strategic account planning, technical buyers and a genuine path towards AE, this could be a great next step.

Why n8n?

🚀 Serious momentum. n8n has grown rapidly into a major player in workflow automation and AI, with more than $100M in ARR, 1,400+ enterprise customers, and a $5.2B valuation following strategic investment from SAP.

📈 Build towards AE. We want the SDR role to be a platform for your next step. High-performing SDRs can develop through our structured SDR → AE programme, with live deal exposure, discovery and MEDDPICC coaching, call reviews, and opportunities to take greater ownership of real opportunities alongside experienced AEs.

✏️ Learn enterprise selling. Work alongside Enterprise AEs on account strategy, stakeholder mapping, messaging, discovery and opportunity creation - gaining exposure to how complex enterprise deals are built from the start.

🤖 Sell where the market is going. You’ll engage technical and executive buyers around AI, automation and some of the most important technology challenges businesses are tackling today.

⚡Use AI to sell smarter. Experiment with AI, n8n and modern sales technology to research accounts, understand buyers, personalise outreach and improve how you work. You don’t need to be an engineer - but you should be curious about technology and excited to learn.

What you’ll do

  • Build enterprise pipeline: Prospect into a focused set of strategic accounts and create qualified opportunities.

  • Develop account strategies: Partner with Enterprise AEs to identify priority companies, stakeholders, challenges, use cases and engagement strategies.

  • Research your prospects: Understand the business and technical priorities of stakeholders across IT, DevOps, SecOps, Engineering and related teams.

  • Create outreach that gets attention: Develop thoughtful, personalised messaging tied to real account priorities rather than generic sequences.

  • Prospect across channels: Engage prospects through email, phone, LinkedIn and other relevant channels.

  • Lead early-stage discovery: Understand business needs, technical environments, priorities, urgency and potential fit with n8n.

  • Continuously improve: Use Salesforce, Outreach, Apollo, AI tools, coaching and performance data to sharpen your approach.

What we’re looking for

We’re looking for someone with a strong SDR foundation who wants to develop into an excellent enterprise seller.

You’ll likely be a good fit if you have:

  • SDR or BDR experience in B2B SaaS, software or technology

  • Experience generating pipeline through outbound prospecting within mid- market or enterprise accounts

  • A strong sales track record against your targets

  • Fluency in German (C1 level- fluent or bilingual)

  • Confidence engaging senior business and technical stakeholders

  • A thoughtful approach to account research, personalisation and qualification

  • Curiosity about technical products, automation and AI

  • Resilience, consistency and ownership of your results

  • The ability to work from our Berlin office three days per week

Bonus points if you have: experience prospecting into technical audiences; familiarity with buying committees, Salesforce, Outreach, Apollo or MEDDPICC; experience using AI or automation in your own sales workflow.

What success looks like

Success here is about quality, not just activity.

You’ll build a deep understanding of your accounts, identify the right stakeholders, create messaging that earns attention and generate qualified enterprise opportunities that can turn into meaningful revenue.

Along the way, you’ll build experience in enterprise account strategy, technical selling, discovery, AI and automation, and complex B2B sales - giving you a strong foundation for the next stage of your career.

Interested?

You don’t need to meet every requirement to apply.

If you have a strong foundation in outbound sales, you’re curious about technology, and you’re excited by the opportunity to help build n8n’s enterprise business while developing towards your next step in sales, we’d love to hear from you.

d876f923be0a0b52.title: Senior Talent Acquisition Partner
d876f923be0a0b52.description:
About Parloa

Parloa's mission is to make every customer conversation feel effortless for both customers and the companies serving them. As agentic AI accelerates, Parloans are shaping the foundation of a new era in customer experience, one where customer support is no longer transactions, but meaningful exchanges. It is not just a vision; Parloa has powered over ONE BILLION interactions between global enterprise brands and their customers, with companies like Booking.com, HealthEquity, Allianz, SAP, BarmeniaGothaer, and TUI already deploying Parloa at scale.

About the role:

As a Senior Talent Acquisition Partner at Parloa, you'll own hiring for the engineers building the core of our agentic AI platform. You'll act as a strategic partner to Engineering leadership and lead complex, senior, and business-critical searches across Backend, Platform, Infrastructure, AI/ML, and Product Engineering. You'll help us grow our engineering organization with speed, rigor, and a candidate experience that reflects the quality of the product we build.

This role is for someone who speaks engineers' language, earns the trust of technical leaders, and independently drives hiring outcomes in one of Europe's most competitive talent markets. You won't just fill roles. You'll help shape how we attract, assess, and close the engineers defining the future of AI-driven customer experience.

Areas of ownership:

  • Own full-cycle recruiting for Software Engineering roles from Senior to Staff/Principal level, including hard-to-fill AI/ML and infrastructure searches

  • Partner closely with Engineering Managers, Directors, and VPs to define profiles, calibrate levels, and align on market realities

  • Build and maintain high-quality pipelines through proactive sourcing, market mapping, and targeted outreach across Europe

  • Advise on leveling and compensation positioning, helping hiring teams make confident, well-calibrated decisions

  • Deliver against key recruiting metrics, including time-to-fill, pipeline conversion, offer acceptance rate, and quality of hire

  • Run structured, fair technical hiring processes in partnership with interviewers and bar raisers

  • Create a thoughtful, engaging candidate experience from first touch through close

  • Manage relocation and visa-related hiring conversations alongside our People team for international candidates

  • Share talent intelligence on competitor landscapes, compensation trends, and hiring hotspots to influence strategy

  • Serve as a senior member of the Talent team by raising the bar on execution and technical hiring quality

Who you are:

  • Someone who has extensive experience in the software engineering recruitment industry

  • Proven experience closing senior and Staff-level engineers in a startup, scale-up, or high-growth SaaS environment

  • Strong technical fluency: you understand engineering disciplines, tech stacks, and levels well enough to hold credible conversations with candidates and hiring managers

  • Excellent sourcing ability, with a track record of building pipelines in competitive European markets

  • Experience leveraging AI tools and recruiting technology to improve sourcing, engagement, and efficiency

  • Strong stakeholder management skills, with the confidence to advise, challenge, and influence engineering leaders

  • Data-driven approach, using funnel metrics and market data to improve outcomes

  • Hands-on experience with Greenhouse and/or Ashby

  • Experience hiring internationally, including relocation and visa processes, is a strong plus

  • Fluent English; German is a plus

Our recruiting process:

Talent Acquisition → Hiring Manager → Technical Interview(s) → Bar Raiser

Why Parloa?

We're at the beginning of a new era in customer experience, one where AI doesn't just respond, but understands, reasons, and takes action. We're building agentic AI that enterprises trust with their most important customer moments: complex questions, high volumes, real stakes. When millions of people reach out to a brand, those interactions aren't just support tickets; they're defining experiences. We're here to raise the standard: making every conversation seamless, intelligent, and genuinely helpful. If you care about shaping how businesses and customers connect at scale and want your work to matter in real, everyday moments, this is where you do it.

At Parloa, ownership isn't a buzzword; it means being accountable for outcomes, not just tasks. We operate in a category that's evolving fast, where the bar is high, and the problems are complex. We hire people who think in solutions, communicate with clarity, and follow through. People who are comfortable making decisions, taking responsibility, and raising the standard for themselves and those around them.

We've grown beyond the earliest startup phase, but we've kept the intensity: fast execution, direct feedback, and a strong expectation to contribute meaningfully from day one.

Backed by leading global investors like General Catalyst, EQT Ventures, and Altimeter Capital, we're scaling with a clear ambition: to become the global category leader in enterprise-grade conversational AI.

Parloa is committed to upholding the highest data protection standards for our clients' and employees' data. All our employees are instrumental in ensuring the utmost care, GDPR, and ISO compliance, including ISO 27001, in handling sensitive information.

7bc04b888eca174d.title: Team Lead Functional Analyst (all genders)
7bc04b888eca174d.description:
tonies is the world’s leading interactive audio platform for children, with over 12 million Tonieboxes and 173 million Tonies sold globally. Our intuitive, screen-free system empowers children to learn and play independently in a safe and engaging way.

With a presence in over 100 countries and a diverse portfolio of ~1,500 Tonies across multiple languages, we continue to redefine how children experience storytelling and learning. Since our IPO in 2021, our global team of 630+ colleagues is united by a shared mission: shaping the future of play, learning, and imagination.

Team Lead Functional Analyst (all genders)

Your Role & Impact

We are seeking a strategic, people-focused Team Lead Functional Analyst to head our Functional Analysis & Process Design chapter within the Enterprise Applications & Integrations department. As tonies undergoes a company-wide transformation from a distributed landscape to a harmonized, global operating model powered by SAP S/4HANA Public Cloud, our IT and business functions are moving toward a product-oriented organization.

In this pivotal role, you will provide horizontal leadership to our team of Functional Analysts -the vital translation bridge between our business value streams (Operations, Finance, Sales) and our technical delivery teams. The ideal candidate combines a deep understanding of end-to-end business processes with a strong mentoring mindset, setting methodology standards and empowering the team to translate operational needs into scalable, standard-first enterprise solutions.

What you'll do

As Team Lead Functional Analyst, you will act as the Chapter Lead for Functional Analysis, providing both disciplinary leadership and methodological governance for your team.

Your responsibilities include:

  • Team Leadership & Development: Providing horizontal leadership to the Functional Analyst team, overseeing personal skill development, coaching, and managing capacity allocation across various value streams.

  • Methodology & Standards: Setting and enforcing best-practice methodology standards for the chapter, including process modeling (BPMN 2.0), agile requirements engineering, user story writing (Jira/Confluence), and User Acceptance Testing (UAT) protocols.

  • Strategic Governance: Empowering your team to act as "The Bridge" that effectively translates business pain points into structured functional specification documents (FSDs) while strictly enforcing Fit-to-Standard and Clean Core principles to prevent unnecessary custom complexity.

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partnering seamlessly with Business Product Owners (who prioritize the "WHAT & WHY"), SAP Consultants (The Solution), Solution Architects (The Gatekeepers), and App Engineers (The Build) to ensure a unified end-to-end delivery lifecycle.

  • Process Integrity: Ensuring your team upholds strict Segregation of Duties (SoD) guidelines and four-pillar controls during process design (e.g., keeping functional analysis strictly separated from system configuration, master data creation, and security mapping).

  • Transformation Stewardship: Driving the organizational shift from reactive project delivery toward proactive product ownership, helping the business eliminate shadow processes and friction points across boundaries like Order-to-Cash, Procure-to-Pay, and Record-to-Report.

What You Bring

You combine a deep understanding of process modeling and enterprise platforms with a consultative leadership mindset, and you enjoy empowering teams in complex transformation initiatives.

You bring:

  • Several years of experience in functional analysis, business process design, or requirements engineering within modern enterprise suites (e.g., SAP S/4HANA Cloud, Salesforce, Microsoft Business Central).

  • Proven experience in a leadership or chapter lead role, with a strong passion for mentoring, team development, and resource management.

  • Deep methodological expertise in BPMN 2.0, Design Thinking, process decomposition, and defining end-to-end test scenarios.

  • Advanced tooling proficiency in Jira, Confluence, Signavio/Lucidchart/Miro, and UAT management platforms.

  • A solid understanding of core business domains such as accounting, supply chain, procurement, or digital retail.

  • Exceptional diplomatic and analytical facilitation skills; the confidence to constructively challenge business requests and guide stakeholders toward standard solutions.

  • A structured, independent, and solution-oriented way of working with a clear understanding of cross-system architecture boundaries.

  • Fluent English; German is a plus.

Why Join Us?

  • Global Teamwork: We collaborate across departmental and country borders. You’ll be part of a truly international community where every voice is heard.

  • Come as you are: This applies to the dress code and everything else. We believe you give your best when you feel truly comfortable being yourself.

  • Competitive Package: We offer a competitive salary and a range of comprehensive benefits tailored to your specific location, which we’ll share during the recruiting process.

  • Collaboration & Community: We’re big on "we." You’ll join a team that values connection and celebrates wins together, no matter the time zone.

  • Continuous Learning: Benefit from internal/external training and an individual learning budget to keep your skills as sharp as a Tonie’s ears.

  • Tonie Discounts: Enjoy attractive discounts on our entire range of products. You’ll quickly become the favorite guest at every birthday party!

  • Rest & Recharge: Great work requires a clear head. You’ll enjoy generous paid time off to ensure you have plenty of time for your own stories.

As part of our principles, we are committed to supporting inclusion and diversity at tonies. We actively celebrate our colleagues’ different abilities, ethnicities, faith and gender. Everyone is welcome and supported in their development at all stages in their journey with us.

We look forward to hearing from you!

9073e15bdc98fb05.title: Social Media Manager (Working Student) // AI Music Video Platform
9073e15bdc98fb05.description:
Neural Frames is a leading AI music video generator, turning any song into a fully produced music video in minutes. We’re bootstrapped, profitable, and generating more than $7M in annualized revenue. Our ambition is to build a category-defining company that helps tens of millions of audio creators visualize and promote their work.

Our product makes video and our users make thousands of them, so we’re never short of material. Our own social channels don’t show it yet. They’re shared between a few people on top of their other work, and we think they could be much better with one person who owns them.

As our working student for social media, you’ll own our social channels day to day: posting on TikTok, Instagram and YouTube Shorts, writing captions in our voice, bringing ideas for what we post next, and replying to our users in the comments and on Discord and Reddit. You’ll work closely with the founder and with our marketing team across content, creators, design and paid.

Within weeks you’ll see whether your ideas show up in the numbers, and you’ll learn how content turns into signups and revenue at a fast-growing startup.

Tasks

  • Currently enrolled at a university in Germany, and able to work around 20 hours per week during the semester

  • You spend a lot of time on TikTok and Instagram and know what's going on there: you notice trends early and can tell why one video gets 400 views and another gets 4 million

  • You write well in English: short, clear and funny when it fits, and you pick up a brand voice quickly

  • You're full of ideas: show you our product and a few user videos, and you'll have ten things we could post

  • You've run a social account before, your own or one for a club, band or small brand, and can show it to us

  • You can do basic video edits in CapCut or similar. You don't need to be a video editor

  • Reliable: your hours are flexible and you plan them around university, but you check in on our channels once a day and keep a steady posting schedule

  • You like talking to people online, and you're friendly and patient when someone needs help

  • AI tools are a normal part of how you work

  • You're into music, AI and internet culture

  • You're based in Berlin and can join us in the office at least one day per week

Requirements

  • Currently enrolled at a university in Germany, and able to work around 15-20 hours per week during the semester

  • You already make content: you've run your own account or one for a club, band or small brand, and can show what you made

  • Strong instincts for short-form content: you can tell why one video gets 400 views and another gets 4 million

  • You can make the content yourself: script, edit, caption and post (CapCut, Premiere or similar)

  • Reliable and organized: you can plan your hours around university and keep a steady posting schedule

  • Curious about numbers: you want to know which posts lead to signups, not just likes

  • AI is part of how you work: you use AI tools to ideate, edit and repurpose faster

  • Genuinely into music, AI and internet culture

  • You're based in Berlin and can join us in the office at least two days per week

Bonus points:

  • You've grown your own or a club's account to a real audience

  • You study marketing, media, communications, film or music

  • You make music, or you're close to the music scene

  • You're comfortable on camera

  • You edit video well, beyond the basics

How we measure success

Our channels post on a steady schedule, sound like us, and pick up on what's happening while it still matters. Users who comment or ask for help get a friendly, useful answer within a day.

Over time, we want channels musicians follow, share and talk about, and that make them want to try Neural Frames themselves.

Benefits

Flexible hours around your studies, bi-weekly team lunches, regular team events, an annual summer offsite, learning & development support, productivity tools, and a real path into a full-time growth role after graduating.

Neural Frames is dedicated to creating an equitable, inclusive, and supportive work environment that brings people together from diverse backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. Our strength is in our differences. We're proud to be an equal opportunity employer and welcome all applicants as we're committed to promoting a culture of opportunity for all.

f219c27e9836c35b.title: Business Development Representative, German speaking
f219c27e9836c35b.description:
Company Description

We’re Checkout.com. You might not know our name, but companies like eBay, Spotify, Klarna, Uber, and Sony do, because we’re behind many of the digital experiences you use every day.


We are where the world checks out, enabling over 10 billion transactions yearly for more than one billion global shoppers.

Whether you want to book a holiday, order food, renew a subscription, or check out online, there’s a good chance our tech powers the payments behind the scenes. Our platform helps the most ambitious businesses deliver effortless digital experiences, at scale.

If you want to do career-defining work, you’ve come to the right place. We move fast, think globally, and believe great teams are built by hiring exceptional people with conviction, curiosity, and the desire to make an impact.

With 20 offices across six continents and London as our HQ, we’re shaping the future of fintech – and we’re just getting started.

The Mission:

 

We are looking for a proactive business builder who wants to become an expert in the global payments landscape. In this role, you aren't just a "lead generator" - you are a strategic partner to Sales. You will use a blend of highly relevant, strategic outreach, AI-driven insights, and deep technical research to open doors at the world’s most prestigious brands. We expect you to master the complexities of the payments industry to source and support high-intent opportunities that drive actual revenue..

 

What You’ll Do:

  • Master the Payments Craft: Rapidly develop a deep, technical understanding of our product suite and global payment trends to act as a consultant to prospective merchants.

  • Strategic Account Mapping: Conduct in-depth research into organizational structures and competitive landscapes to identify and engage high-value strategic accounts.

  • Advanced Discovery: Conduct high-level discovery calls that move past the "pitch" to uncover deep technical and business challenges for the merchant.

  • Drive Growth Momentum: Maintain a high-performing operating rhythm in daily outreach, consistently striving for excellence while contributing to a high-standard team environment.

  • Support the Sales Lifecycle: Partner closely with Sales to move deals through the funnel, providing support on follow-ups and maintaining momentum to ensure successful financial go-lives.

  • Cross-Functional Leadership: Partner with Solutions Engineering, Underwriting, and Product teams to align internal stakeholders and accelerate the sales cycle.

  • Leverage AI & Sales Tech: Proactively use AI-driven systems (e.g., Salesforce, intent-data tools) and advanced analytics to optimize lead generation, territory planning, and pipeline accuracy.

  • Operational Rigor: Maintain a data-backed approach to your territory, utilizing qualification frameworks (like MEDDIC) and keeping the CRM (Salesforce) as a source of truth.

 

What You Bring:

  • German or Polish Native is essential

  • Proactive Ownership: You take end-to-end accountability for your territory and outcomes, proactively plan your quarter to overachieve.

  • Intellectual Curiosity: A relentless drive to learn the mechanics of complex financial technology and industry dynamics.

  • Exceptional Communication & Presence: Excellent listening and communication skills (written, verbal, and in person). You have the confidence and clarity to engage effectively with stakeholders at all levels - from internal product leads to C-suite executives at global brands.

  • Technical & AI Fluency: A desire to leverage the latest sales technology and AI tools to work smarter, not just harder.

  • Exceptional Resilience: A fundamentally positive approach that maintains momentum through setbacks and challenges.

  • Coachability: A track record of actively seeking feedback and immediately implementing it to improve your performance.

  • Persistence & Precision: A high level of attention to detail combined with a steadfast commitment to excellence in a fast-paced environment.

  • Team Impact & Collective Success: You believe in winning as a team and contribute to a supportive, inclusive environment where everyone can perform at their best. You are a positive cultural force who shares feedback respectfully and collaborates cross-functionally to help the entire organization improve.

Additional Information

Bring all of you to work

We create the conditions for high performers to thrive, through real ownership, fewer blockers, and work that makes a difference from day one.

Here, you’ll move fast, take on meaningful challenges, and be recognized for the impact you deliver. It’s a place where ambition gets met with opportunity, and where your growth is in your hands.

We work as one team, and we back each other to succeed. So whatever your background or identity, if you’re ready to grow and make a difference, you’ll be right at home here.

It’s important we set you up for success and make our process as accessible as possible. So let us know in your application, or tell your recruiter directly, if you need anything to make your experience or working environment more comfortable.

Life at Checkout.com

We understand that work is just one part of your life. Our hybrid working model offers flexibility, with three days per week in the office to support collaboration and connection.

Curious about what it’s like to be part of our team? Visit our Careers Page to learn more about our culture, open roles, and what drives us.

For a closer look at daily life at Checkout.com, follow us on LinkedIn and Instagram

6e70cac67bca4698.title: Engineering Manager (m/f/x) Customer Facing Teams
6e70cac67bca4698.description:
We are looking for an experienced Engineering Manager to join our Engineering department and lead two customer-facing teams (7–8 engineers in total), and to support us shaping how the whole department works.

rebuy's engineering teams are stable and well established, and that gives us a strong base to build on. Now we're looking for ways to unblock delivery and get great ideas to our customers faster, with the support of AI.


You are a catalyst: you are there where you are needed most. Sometimes that means being deep in the daily work, supporting the team and even coding along. Sometimes it means making a decision because the team is stuck. And sometimes it means zooming out to improve flows across the whole department. You set direction and pace, and make sure that what we ship reaches customers and moves our quarterly OKRs. You also make room for the bigger picture: business topics, our leveling matrix, and driving AI adoption across engineering together with fellow Engineering Managers.

Ready to become part of the most important mission on this planet? We are rebuy, pioneers in the sustainable reuse of electronics and media, and we are looking for you! Our mission: to make circular living accessible to all, one transaction at a time. By giving products a second chance, we reduce resource consumption and avoid unnecessary e-waste.

Our team of 500 comes from all corners of the world; we drive things forward collaboratively, take personal responsibility, value positive critical thinking, and persistently serve our customers and planet.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Lead two customer-facing teams as a catalyst: zoom in to support the daily work and unblock the team when it’s stuck, zoom out to improve flows across the department

  • Set direction: make sure the teams understand the “why” behind their topics, own them and are motivated to drive them. Make the call when full consensus isn’t possible, and focus everyone on what is truly urgent

  • Own delivery: keep the teams focused on their promise dates, get them to the finish line and course-correct fast. Use modern metrics to track progress and speed

  • Stay close to the tech: pair with engineers, review work, join technical discussions, and challenge estimates and trade-offs

  • Drive AI adoption across engineering with fellow Engineering Managers (tools, workflows, review standards and measuring real impact), starting in your own teams

  • Drive hiring and take care of your people and their growth through regular 1:1s, honest feedback and by evolving our engineering leveling matrix

  • Connect product, design and engineering, keep stakeholders informed early, and work with engineering leadership on cross-team strategy


Requirements:

  • Substantial experience as an Engineering Manager, with a track record of delivering business outcomes. You’re accountable for results, not only team happiness, and comfortable owning and reporting engineering metrics

  • A software engineering background with a strong foothold in at least one of our stacks: Angular/TypeScript, PHP/Symfony or Kotlin/Spring. You don’t need all three, but you can challenge solutions and form an objective view of your teams’ work, even if you don’t code day to day

  • Experience driving or shaping AI adoption in engineering teams, or a strong focus on it

  • High self-organization and drive: you spot what’s urgent among many important topics and act on it without waiting to be told

  • The ability to flex between hands-on support, decisive action and department-level thinking

  • Fast, documented decision-making and direct, transparent communication

  • Fluent English

Nice to have

  • German (a big plus)

  • Experience with customer-facing products or e-commerce

  • Experience building or scaling teams, or evolving career frameworks

Location:

  • Berlin

  • Hybrid model (Must be willing to work from the office at least 1 day per week)

Purpose, a great company culture and incredible benefits - what to expect at rebuy:

  • Work with a friendly team that is passionate about circularity and wants to make the world a little more sustainable, one transaction at a time.

  • Feel comfortable in an environment where independence and new ideas are welcome.

  • Benefit from flat hierarchies and the greatest possible transparency so that things don't take longer than they have to and you always feel well informed.

  • Enjoy our centrally located office in Berlin (Erkelenzdamm 11 - 13, 10999 Berlin).

  • Benefit from our family-friendly, flexible environment and paid child sick leave.

  • Bring your dog to the office: we love animals and want to cuddle yours, too!

  • Use employee discounts on rebuy.de, sustainable products at Futurebens, offers for sustainable micro-mobility and massages directly in our office.

  • Have fun at our legendary team and company events.

  • Use our mental health offers as part of a cooperation with Nilo. 

  • Take care of your work-life balance with 30 vacation days.

  • Stay active with our own gym located directly in the building, making it easy to fit workouts into your daily routine.

  • Benefit from an on-site daycare in the building, supporting a truly family friendly and flexible working environment.

*At rebuy all people are welcome and supported! We would like to talk, regardless of age, disability, national and social origin, skin color, religion, gender identity and sexual orientation. Just be who you are.

b59f1aac7b6c732e.title: Software Engineer (gn) @ Industrial AI Venture, Berlin
b59f1aac7b6c732e.description:
This is an Atlantic portfolio company.

About Marentis

Marentis develops AI-supported software for manufacturing, robotics and complex automated machinery. We turn machine data and operational information into useful knowledge for troubleshooting, decision-making and automation. Our work connects sensor measurements, machine and robot states, quality data, alarms and expert knowledge. These problems require understanding both the data and its context: a fault may originate elsewhere in a production line, and similar symptoms can have different causes. We are a small, early-stage startup where individual contributions directly shape the product. We value curiosity, initiative and people who enjoy understanding difficult problems and making things work.

The Role

We are looking for an experienced, hands-on Software Engineer with strong Python skills and sound technical judgment. You will own backend features from problem definition through implementation, testing, deployment and maintenance.

After onboarding, you should be able to investigate unfamiliar production code and independently review Python/backend pull requests: understand intended behavior, question assumptions, assess tests and failure paths, and identify effects on the wider system.

We actively encourage AI-assisted development. You remain responsible for understanding, verifying and maintaining the resulting software. We value demonstrated delivery, ownership and learning ability more than a fixed number of years in the industry.

What You Will Do

  • Build backend services, APIs and SQL-backed data pipelines for industrial analytics, knowledge retrieval and agent workflows.

  • Read and improve existing code, review pull requests, and make informed decisions about interfaces, data models, state and failure handling.

  • Design meaningful unit, integration and end-to-end tests, supported by continuous integration.

  • Test with representative machine data, recorded streams and simulated device inputs, including missing measurements, duplicate or out-of-order events, invalid values and connection failures.

  • Reproduce bugs, inspect whether test assertions verify the intended behavior, and add useful regression coverage.

  • Understand manufacturing users and equipment, contribute across integration and deployment, and communicate trade-offs and blockers early.

What You Bring

  • Strong practical Python and backend engineering skills, supported by software you personally shipped and maintained.

  • Independent code-review ability: you can investigate a change, assess correctness, maintainability and security, and justify whether it is ready to merge.

  • Practical system-design judgment across APIs, SQL, database design, data validation, state management and concurrency where relevant.

  • Strong testing and debugging skills: you choose useful test boundaries, construct representative data and investigate failures.

  • Experience making imperfect operational, machine, sensor or similarly complex data trustworthy, with an interest in its industrial meaning and consequences.

  • Resourcefulness: you learn unfamiliar code and technologies through documentation, small experiments, focused questions and feedback.

  • Clear written and spoken English, constructive collaboration and reliable follow-through.

We welcome different educational and professional paths. Direct manufacturing experience is especially useful; equivalent engineering depth from adjacent domains is also relevant.

Particularly Relevant Experience

Bring depth in one or more of these areas; expertise in all of them is not expected.

  • Machine data, analytics and machine learning: Time-series or sensor-data processing, curation, feature engineering, anomaly detection, condition monitoring or quality prediction. Explain how you handled timestamps, units, asset identity and data quality, and evaluated whether the result was useful.

  • Knowledge graphs and retrieval: Entity and relationship modeling, graph or relational database design, provenance, versioning and conflicting information. Experience combining identifiers, aliases, lexical search and semantic retrieval, with evaluations of relevance and applicability.

  • Agent systems and workflows: LLM tools, multi-agent coordination, orchestration, context and memory management, validation and failure recovery. Show how you evaluated quality, cost and latency, enforced permissions and chose appropriate execution boundaries.

  • Industrial integration, robotics and automation: Connecting software with production equipment, robot cells or automated machinery through telemetry, device interfaces or protocols such as MQTT and OPC UA. Experience with simulators, physical-device testing and equipment-specific behavior is valuable.

  • Cloud deployment, containerization, observability and operating software across customer environments are also useful.

9e526a90256d0fa0.title: Senior Robotics Engineer (m/f/d) – Drone Port
9e526a90256d0fa0.description:
Quantum Systems is a leading European deep-tech company for unmanned systems across air, land and maritime domains. We develop and scale integrated hardware, software and AI-powered solutions for mission-critical operations. By combining autonomous platforms with intelligent software and AI, Quantum Systems enables customers to operate, understand and act across domains.

At Quantum Systems, we are building the next generation of autonomous aerial systems. The Drone Port is a key element of this vision, enabling fully autonomous launch, landing, charging, health monitoring and mission readiness of our UAV platforms.

As a Senior Robotics Engineer, you will play a central role in developing the intelligence that allows the Drone Port and aircraft to interact seamlessly. You will work on perception algorithms, control systems, embedded software and sensor integration to create reliable autonomous behaviours that operate in real-world environments.

Working closely with experts from Mechanical Engineering, Electronics, Systems Engineering Flight Controls, Embedded Software, AI and Flight Test, you will help shape one of the most advanced autonomous drone infrastructure products on the market. Your work will directly influence the future of fully autonomous BVLOS operations and scalable drone deployments worldwide.

What is your Day to Day Mission:

  • Design and implement robotic capabilities enabling fully autonomous Drone Port operation.

  • Develop perception algorithms for precision landing, docking, localisation and environmental awareness.

  • Design and optimize closed-loop control algorithms for ground-based robotic systems and UAV interactions.

  • Develop embedded software for sensors, actuators and hardware interfaces. 

  • Integrate cameras, ranging sensors, IMUs, encoders and additional perception sensors into the overall system architecture.

  • Develop robust sensor fusion algorithms for reliable operation under varying environmental conditions.

  • Design and validate communication interfaces between the Drone Port, aircraft and cloud infrastructure.

  • Develop software for autonomous system monitoring, diagnostics and fault detection.

  • Several years of professional experience in Systems Engineering, Industrialization, Manufacturing Engineering, Product Engineering or a comparable technical role.

  • Strong experience working with complex multidisciplinary products, ideally involving hardware, electronics, embedded software and mechanical systems.

230169ebd445e74f.title: Senior SRE – OpenStack & Bare Metal (m/f/d)
230169ebd445e74f.description:
At our company, it’s all about #OneTeam! Join gridscale and help shape the future of the cloud together with OVH.

As a leading tech company, we’ve been working for over two decades to reduce our environmental footprint - with innovative solutions and an open cloud designed to be sustainable from the ground up: #SustainableByDesign.

Our Tech Stack 🚀

· OpenStack · Kubernetes · KVM · Linux · Bare Metal · Ansible · Terraform · Go
· FluxCD / ArgoCD · Git· Python · Claude Code · Cursor · Agentic Coding Tooling

Your Role

You will help us build, operate and industrialize OVHcloud's on-premise cloud platform. As part of a small, senior team, you will work on our OpenStack-based infrastructure and the Kubernetes / GitOps stack powering our customer-facing cloud. AI-assisted engineering is a first-class part of how we work – from spec-driven development and agentic coding workflows to incident response and automation. The platform is in active development, giving you real influence on the architecture, automation strategy and how we adopt AI in platform engineering. As a Senior Engineer, you take ownership of your area and shape your focus based on your strengths, with a clear backbone of automation, compute lifecycle, platform engineering and AI substrate work.

Your Responsibilities

  • Design and build our OpenStack-based on-premise cloud infrastructure, with the goal of bringing complete cloud environments from bare metal to production through a highly automated deployment process.

  • Develop and operate Infrastructure as Code with Ansible and Terraform as well as our Kubernetes and GitOps workflows using FluxCD / ArgoCD, supported by LLMs, agentic workflows and automated testing and review.

  • Own the lifecycle of our compute infrastructure – from bare metal, firmware and provisioning through to hypervisors and virtual compute nodes. This includes patching, migrations, host evacuation, capacity rebalancing and the automation required to keep the platform healthy.

  • Build and extend our AI substrate and self-healing capabilities, from structured knowledge bases and agentic workflows for incident triage and capacity planning to gradually turning today's manual runbooks into automated processes.

  • Design tests for non-regression, performance and security, document and package solutions, and continuously improve the platform based on telemetry, operational experience and user feedback.

  • Act as a technical reference and sparring partner for peers across automation, platform engineering and AI tooling.

What we offer you

  • A platform genuinely in build mode, with real room to shape architectural decisions, strong ownership and a senior team where autonomy matters.

  • AI-augmented engineering as a first-class workflow - including Claude Code and comparable agentic tooling, Markdown-based knowledge bases and room to push our engineering practices further.

  • Exceptional team spirit across all departments and national borders; we live #OneTeam.

  • Exciting work in a highly innovative and international environment with cutting-edge technologies.

  • 32 vacation days, increasing with length of service.

  • Flexible working hours, home office options, and a secure permanent position with market- and performance-based compensation.

  • Employer-funded pension plan and an attractive insurance package.

  • OVHcloud covers 50% of public transportation costs.

  • Up to €400 annual financial contribution from OVHcloud towards sports activities, such as gym memberships or sports classes.

  • Through Corporate Benefits, you receive attractive discounts at numerous shops and companies.

  • We contribute to the leasing of your cargo bike.

  • Regular company events and free cold and hot beverages.


  • Several years of hands-on experience as an SRE, Platform Engineer or DevOps Engineer running production infrastructure, with strong experience in OpenStack, Kubernetes and Linux, including bare metal.

  • You have managed compute infrastructure end-to-end, from firmware / BIOS rollouts, bare-metal provisioning and hardware diagnostics to hypervisors, migrations, host evacuation, graceful drains and capacity rebalancing.

  • AI-assisted engineering is already part of your daily work. You use LLMs and agentic tools where they meaningfully support development, testing, reviews, or operations, and you know where AI adds real value and where strong engineering expertise remains essential.

  • You are confident working with Ansible, Terraform and GitOps workflows such as FluxCD or ArgoCD and understand what it takes to turn automation into robust, repeatable production systems.

  • Ideally, you write Go and/or Python and have experience with Claude Code, Cursor, Aider or comparable agentic coding environments. Exposure to observability, networking, compute tuning, auto-remediation, security-critical infrastructure or multi-site clouds is also a plus.

  • You work autonomously, bring a strong sense of ownership and enjoy improving systems rather than simply keeping them running. You also enjoy sharing knowledge and can communicate complex technical topics clearly.

  • You are fluent in English, written and spoken. English is the working language of our distributed team.

5a6554ef7885528e.description:
At our company, it’s all about #OneTeam! Join gridscale and help shape the future of the cloud together with OVH.

As a leading tech company, we’ve been working for over two decades to reduce our environmental footprint - with innovative solutions and an open cloud designed to be sustainable from the ground up: #SustainableByDesign.

As the Cloud Store team, we provide the framework to automate an standardized deployment on top of the OnPrem Cloud Platform. Are you passionate about air-gapped cloud environments and edge technologies? Then you've come to the right place.

Our Tech Stack 🚀

•Kubernetes •GitOps •Ansible •Terraform •Prometheus

•Grafana •Linux •OpenStack•Python, Bash & Go

Your Role💻

As a Site Reliability Engineer, you'll be part of a team responsible for building the framework to package and deploy software solutions on top of OPCP. You'll work on the conception, automation, and operation of our platform and drive continuous improvements. You'll help new teams onboard with the framework and OPCP. We're looking for someone who is comfortable in a security-oriented environment with a high degree of automation (GitOps). You are used to maintaining an overview of ambiguous situations, analyzing systems, and making well-founded decisions based on this analysis

Your Tasks

  • Build the framework for building and deploying Cloud Store packages

  • Drive the ongoing development of our Kubernetes stack and implement GitOps workflows (e.g., with FluxCD)

  • Support other teams and help them onboard with OPCP

  • Actively participate in system analysis and derive improvements, even when initial requirements are unclear

  • Develop and maintain our Infrastructure as Code using tools like Ansible and Terraform

  • Participate in an on-call rotation

What we offer you💼

  • Exceptional team spirit across all departments and national borders; we live #OneTeam

  • Exciting work in a highly innovative and international environment with cutting-edge technologies

  • 32 vacation days, increasing with length of service

  • Flexible working hours, home office options, and a secure permanent position with market- and performance-based compensation

  • Employer-funded pension plan and an attractive insurance package

  • OVHcloud covers 50% of public transportation costs

  • Up to €400 annual financial contribution from OVHcloud towards sports activities (gym membership, sports classes, etc.)

  • Through Corporate Benefits, you receive attractive discounts at numerous shops and companies

  • We contribute to the leasing of your cargo bike

  • Regular company events and free cold and hot beverages


  • Deep knowledge of Linux/Unix system administration and internals

  • Hands-on experience with cloud platforms, especially OpenStack, including infrastructure provisioning and management

  • Proficiency with Infrastructure as Code tools such as Terraform and Ansible

  • Experience with containerization and orchestration technologies, especially Kubernetes

  • Skilled in building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines

  • Hands-on experience with modern observability stacks, including metrics, logs and traces

  • Proficiency in scripting and automation using Python, Bash, and Go

  • Understanding of security fundamentals including IAM, secrets management, hardening and compliance

  • Understanding of distributed systems concepts such as the CAP theorem, consensus and fault tolerance

  • Strong problem-solving skills, adaptability and strict documentation discipline

  • Ability to thrive in collaborative product-team environments with a strong ownership mentality and a blameless culture mindset

  • Strong communication skills and a passion for continuous improvement

329487f49ea1212a.title: Enterprise Account Executive - FR/BNL/SE (m/f/x)
329487f49ea1212a.description:
Account Executive (m/f/x) (French Speaking) 

Location: EU 

(Remote) 

Comp: 120k EUR base 

Territories: France / Benelux / Southern Europe 

 

Who You’ll Work For: 

 

At Makersite, we're pioneering the future of sustainable product development and digital collaboration. As a leading platform for product lifecycle management (PLM), we empower companies to make smarter, more sustainable decisions across their entire supply chain. Our cutting-edge software enables teams to design, prototype, and manufacture with transparency, efficiency, and responsibility—reducing environmental impact while optimizing performance. 

If you're passionate about technology, sustainability, and creating meaningful impact, we’d love to hear from you. Join us and be a part of shaping the future of manufacturing and product innovation. 

 

Who we're looking for: 

 

As part of our growing team, you will play a key role in shaping the future of sustainable product development. We’re looking for innovative, driven Account Executives who are passionate about technology and sustainability to join us in building tools that enable companies to make smarter, more responsible decisions. In this role, you’ll have the opportunity to collaborate with talented professionals, contribute to cutting-edge projects, and help drive the digital transformation of industries worldwide. If you're ready to make an impact and contribute to meaningful change, we want to hear from you! 

This role is a fixed, permanent position. All successful applicants will receive a permanent employment contract regardless of location.  

 

The role:  

 

  • Own and grow a defined territory of named enterprise accounts across France / Benelux / Southern Europe. 

  • Take commercial ownership of the full sales cycle, from identifying and developing new opportunities through to negotiation, closing and account expansion. 

  • Deliver an individual annual revenue target of €1.1M once ramped, driving new business acquisition and growth within existing accounts. 

  • Build and develop a sustainable pipeline of high-value enterprise opportunities, supported by SDRs and strategic partners. 

  • Lead complex enterprise sales engagements, typically involving deal values of €150K–€300K, multiple stakeholders and extended sales cycles. 

  • Develop strategic relationships with enterprise customers, technology partners and consulting firms to drive commercial opportunities. 

  • Position and sell complex, data-driven SaaS solutions to large enterprise organisations, translating technical capabilities into measurable business value. 

  • Support the introduction and commercialisation of new products, helping establish market presence and identify new growth opportunities. 


  • Excellent proficiency in French verbal and written skills. 

  • Proven ability to sell complex, high-value SaaS solutions into large enterprise organisations, managing long sales cycles and significant deal values. 

  • Ability to develop territory strategies, build account plans and identify opportunities for new business acquisition and account expansion. 

  • Strong hunting mentality with the ability to independently identify, engage and convert new enterprise prospects. 

  • Skilled in navigating multi-stakeholder sales processes, coordinating internal and external teams and managing sophisticated commercial negotiations. 

  • Ability to understand complex customer challenges, conduct effective discovery and position solutions around business outcomes rather than product features. 

  • Strong commercial acumen and ability to build business cases, demonstrate ROI and communicate the financial and operational value of technology investments. 

  • Experience working alongside technology, consulting and implementation partners to develop opportunities and close enterprise deals. 

  • Ability to understand and communicate complex data-driven technology, analytics, software and technical solutions to both technical and business stakeholders. 

  • Practical experience applying structured sales methodologies such as MEDDPICC, Force Management or similar enterprise sales frameworks. 

  • Ability to prioritise named accounts, identify whitespace opportunities and develop strategic approaches to maximise territory revenue. 

  • Strong negotiation skills with the ability to manage commercial objections, procurement processes and executive-level discussions. 

  • Comfortable operating in a changing environment, launching new products and navigating ambiguity. 

  • Proficiency with modern sales tools, including HubSpot, Microsoft Office 365 and pipeline forecasting platforms. 

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the confidence to engage and influence senior executives and technical decision-makers. 

  • Nice to have: experience selling services. 

  • Residing in and legally permitted to work in the EU. 

 

What We Offer: 

 

  • Competitive Salary – We reward your skills and experience with a compensation package that reflects your value. 

  • 30 Days Paid Time Off – Take the time you need to recharge and maintain a healthy work-life balance. 

  • Remote-First Flexibility – Work from anywhere in the EU, with the option to collaborate in person at our offices in Stuttgart, Berlin (role dependent). 

  • Generous Learning & Development Budget – We invest in your growth, providing ample resources for personal and professional development. 

  • Choose Your Ideal Work Equipment – Whether you prefer Apple or Microsoft, we’ll equip you with the tools you need to excel.

Im Auftrag unseres Partnerunternehmens im Münchner Westen suchen wir Sie zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt als „Referent Finance und Risikomanagement (m/w/d)“.

Aufgaben

  • Als Referent Finance und Risikomanagement (m/w/d) koordinieren und begleiten Sie die Erstellung von Quartals- und Jahresabschlüssen nach HGB sowie die Durchführung interner und externer Prüfungen
  • Zudem erstellen und übermitteln Sie regulatorische Meldungen und Berichte und stellen die Einhaltung relevanter gesetzlicher und aufsichtsrechtlicher Anforderungen sicher
  • Darüber hinaus entwickeln und pflegen Sie interne Richtlinien, Kontrollmechanismen und Prozesse in den Bereichen Compliance, Risikomanagement und regulatorisches Berichtswesen

  • Dabei fungieren Sie als Ansprechpartner für Wirtschaftsprüfer, Aufsichtsbehörden und Kunden und unterstützen bei Audits, KYC-Prozessen und internen Schulungsmaßnahmen

Qualifikation

  • Sie verfügen über eine abgeschlossene kaufmännische Ausbildung, beispielsweise als Bankkaufmann (m/w/d), Steuerfachangestellter (m/w/d) oder Kaufmann für Versicherungen und Finanzanlagen (m/w/d)
  • Sie bringen 3 bis 5 Jahre Berufserfahrung als Bankkaufmann (m/w/d), Steuerfachangestellter (m/w/d) oder Compliance-Sachbearbeiter (m/w/d) mit, idealerweise im Asset Management, in der Wirtschaftsprüfung oder Steuerberatung
  • Sie besitzen gute Kenntnisse im Rechnungswese - Erfahrungen in Compliance, KYC, Risikomanagement und regulatorischen Vorgaben sind von Vorteil
  • Zusätzlich verfügen Sie über sichere MS-Office-Kenntnisse, insbesondere Excel, sowie verhandlungssichere Deutschkenntnisse
  • Wichtig sind eine strukturierte, präzise und eigenverantwortliche Arbeitsweise, Kommunikationsstärke, Teamfähigkeit und ein hohes Verantwortungsbewusstsein

Benefits

  • Work-Life-Balance: Freuen Sie sich auf flexible Arbeitszeiten bei einer 20-h-Woche
  • Sicherheit: Langfristige Jobmöglichkeit in einem familiären Umfeld
  • Zentrale Lage: Moderenes Büro im Herzen von München mit optimaler Verkehrsanbindung
  • Positive Arbeitsatmosphäre: Sympathische Kollegen und ein wertschätzendes Miteinander
  • Moderner Arbeitgeber: Das Unternehmen bietet Ihnen ein innovatives Arbeitsumfeld

84fb241f0efa63e8.title: Tech Lead (Medical Coding Agents) (m/w/d)
84fb241f0efa63e8.description:
About Recare

As one of the leading German HealthTech companies, we are reshaping discharge management: technology-driven, patient-centered and free from bureaucracy. In addition to our market-leading SaaS platform, we develop AI solutions that radically simplify processes in hospitals and for aftercare providers, relieve healthcare professionals and refocus attention on patients. Today, we already connect two-thirds of all German hospitals with thousands of rehabilitation clinics, nursing and homecare providers. With around 100 employees, we continue to grow, and we’re looking for people with character who want to help us improve the healthcare system.


What you’ll do as our Tech Lead (Medical Coding Agents) (m/w/d):

German hospitals are paid a fixed amount per case, based on the codes assigned to it. Insurers dispute a share of the bills through an external medical audit, and the hospital can appeal when the audit cuts a bill. Recare is building medical coding agents to rebuild this chain: they read the case file, propose codes, assess audit findings and draft appeals. A subject matter expert reviews every result.

You’ll lead the technical development of this product. The role is about 80% hands-on building and 20% leading, and it grows with the platform into areas beyond billing.


  • Technical direction: set the architecture with the team across backend, frontend and a data model built on healthcare standards such as FHIR. Set the technical roadmap with the team and deliver on it predictably.

  • Agent orchestration: design how models, deterministic rules and human review fit together. Work with our AI engineers on system design.

  • Hands-on delivery: build the backend for cases, documents and long-running agent runs, including the append-only decision log that keeps every case audit-proof when an insurer challenges it months later.

  • Product partnership: be the technical counterpart to the product manager and the subject matter experts on planning, specs and trade-offs.

  • Production quality: own reliability, observability and security in a sensitive healthcare context, with an eval harness built from expert-reviewed cases as a CI gate.

How we work:

  • AI coding agents: engineers use them every day and take responsibility for the code we ship. Product managers and designers prototype in our codebase too, and engineers review what goes to production.

  • Human-in-the-loop: agents propose, the expert accepts, corrects or rejects, and every decision is logged with its evidence.

  • Shipping: we release early to development partners and switch features on per hospital.

  • Data protection: EU-only inference and no patient data in logs are hard constraints.

  • Ownership: product owns what we build and why. The tech lead owns how it’s built and that it ships.

  • Stack: TypeScript, Node.js and Go, Python for inference, Postgres, React, AWS Bedrock, Docker and Datadog.

  • Success: measured in revenue hospitals keep, not in usage.



What we’re looking for:

  • Leadership: 6+ years of experience, including leading a small team.

  • Hands-on with LLMs: you’ve built with LLMs yourself and understand where they fail: non-determinism, cost, latency and evaluation. You can design systems around them and challenge our AI engineers’ choices. Experience running an LLM or agent system in production is a strong plus, and strong personal projects count.

  • Evals: you can answer “how did you know it was good enough?” with ground truth, regression tests and a clear taxonomy of error classes.

  • Full-stack depth: you go deep across backend, frontend and data, and you commit code.

  • Other people’s systems: you’re comfortable with asynchronous pipelines, legacy interfaces and code written by others. Hospital experience isn’t required.

  • Communication: you explain decisions and trade-offs clearly in English in a remote team.

  • Nice to have: German, as the catalogues, the coding rules and much of the work with our experts are in German; an ML background, including judgement on when fine-tuning pays off; retrieval and source attribution; healthcare data standards such as FHIR; regulation such as MDR and the EU AI Act.

What we offer

  • Growth: we invest in each person’s development, whether that’s taking ownership of new projects, deepening your technical leadership or exploring new AI approaches, supported by a dedicated learning and development budget and regular feedback. If you grow, we grow.

  • Purposeful work: your work has a real impact on patients, their families and healthcare professionals.

  • Company culture: flat hierarchies, strong team dynamics and a culture of mutual respect, loyalty and recognition. English is our working language across a team of 20+ nationalities.

  • Flexibility: need to pick up your child from daycare or want to exercise at lunch? We support you, with fully remote work, flexible hours and workations by arrangement.

  • Your setup: a work laptop plus a one-off budget to choose and keep your own accessories.

  • Monthly benefit: €50 per month for vouchers or an Urban Sports Club membership (for employees in Germany).

  • Birthday off: your birthday off to celebrate with your loved ones.

  • Together: team meetups and company-wide events.

Location

We’re a remote team, and the role is fully remote within European time zones. We’re hiring in Germany, Austria, Spain, Italy, Portugal, the Netherlands and the United Kingdom.

5ce3605684df5593.title: AI-First Adoption Lead (m/w/d) KI- Einführung und Prozessautomatisierung
5ce3605684df5593.description:
Jobbeschreibung

Wer wir sind

benuta ist eine Designmarke für Wohnräume: eigene Kollektionen, Kundinnen und Kunden in ganz Europa und über 150 Menschen in der Gruppe, vom Design über E-Commerce bis zur eigenen Logistik. Wir bauen unsere Multibrand-Strategie aus und entwickeln neben benuta weitere Marken.

Worum es geht

benuta arbeitet AI-first. Nicht als Projekt, sondern als Betriebsmodell. Jede Marke, jedes Team und jeder Prozess läuft auf derselben Grundlage:

benuta Nexus, dem Betriebssystem, mit dem die gesamte Gruppe arbeitet.

  • Nexus Cortex: Wissen, Prozesse und Entscheidungen. Eine Wahrheit, an einem Ort.
  • Nexus Flow: jede Aufgabe und jeder Ablauf, nachvollziehbar und automatisierbar.
  • Nexus Core: Konten, Zugänge und Ablage als Fundament.

Die Architektur steht, KI-Agenten und Automatisierungen laufen. Jetzt geht es um Adoption: Jedes Team arbeitet vollständig in benuta Nexus, und aus Prozessen werden durchgängige, KI-gestützte Workflows.

Warum wir das machen

Wir setzen KI ein, um besser zu werden: für unsere Kundinnen und Kunden, für unsere Marken und für die Menschen, die bei uns arbeiten. KI nimmt Routine ab und schafft Raum für das, was wirklich zählt. Sie schafft Transparenz: Alle sehen, woran wir arbeiten, was entschieden ist und welche Wirkung unsere Arbeit hat. So wachsen wir schneller, schaffen mehr Wert für unsere Kundinnen und Kunden und sorgen dafür, dass unser Team im KI-Zeitalter vorne mit dabei ist.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Prozesse neu denken: Du nimmst die Abläufe unserer Teams auf, von der Zentrale über die Marken bis zur Logistik, vereinfachst sie und überführst sie in automatisierte, KI-gestützte Workflows.
  • benuta Nexus einführen: Du bringst jedes Team auf unseren Standard, mit klaren Verantwortlichen und verbindlichen Spielregeln, und sorgst dafür, dass sie im Alltag gelebt werden.
  • Befähigen: Du schulst Teams und Führungskräfte, entwickelst kurze, wirksame Formate und machst neue Kolleginnen und Kollegen vom ersten Tag an arbeitsfähig.
  • Anforderungen schärfen: Du übersetzt den Bedarf der Teams in vollständige Anforderungen mit Problem, Ablauf, Nutzen und Abnahmekriterium und bringst sie in die Weiterentwicklung von benuta Nexus ein.
  • KI-Werkzeuge verantworten: Du führst unsere KI-gestützten Lösungen, etwa im Kundenservice und im Bewertungsmanagement, und sorgst dafür, dass ihre Ergebnisse dort ankommen, wo daraus Verbesserungen werden.
  • Transparenz schaffen: Du misst Nutzung und Wirkung, analysierst, wo es hakt, und berichtest ehrlich, was funktioniert und was nicht.

Du berichtest direkt an den CEO und arbeitest eng mit dem COO zusammen. Mittelfristig besteht die Perspektive, die Leitung unseres Tech-Teams zu übernehmen.

Stellenanforderungen

Das bringst du mit

Umgesetzte KI-Projekte: Du hast KI in einem Unternehmen produktiv eingeführt, zum Beispiel mit KI-Agenten, Automatisierungen oder KI-gestützten Abläufen, und kannst den Nutzen in Zahlen belegen.

  • Prozess- und Workflow-Denken: Du denkst in Abläufen über Abteilungsgrenzen hinweg und erkennst, wo Automatisierung den größten Hebel hat.
  • Systemverständnis: Du verstehst, wie Architektur funktioniert, wie Systeme ineinandergreifen und wie Unternehmensprozesse in einer gewachsenen Systemlandschaft orchestriert werden.
  • Analytische Stärke: Du arbeitest sicher mit Daten und Kennzahlen, ziehst daraus klare Schlüsse und berichtest sachlich, auch wenn ein Ergebnis hinter dem Plan bleibt.
  • Leadership: Du gehst voran, schaffst Klarheit, setzt Ziele, lebst Regeln konsequent vor und nimmst die Menschen auf den Weg mit.
  • Starke Kommunikation: Du erklärst Komplexes einfach, überzeugst vor Gruppen und im Einzelgespräch und schreibst präzise.
  • Hands-on und Tempo: Du bist Macher, nicht Verwalter. Du packst selbst an, treibst Themen mit Energie voran und fühlst dich in einem hohen Tempo wohl.
  • Sprache: Deutsch auf sehr hohem Niveau in Wort und Schrift, gutes Englisch.
  • Von Vorteil: Erfahrung in E-Commerce, Handel oder Logistik sowie mit Modellen von Google, OpenAI oder Anthropic. Die Modelle bei uns sind gesetzt; entscheidend ist, was du damit im Prozess erreichst.

Was diese Rolle nicht ist

Wir suchen niemanden, der vor allem neue Tools einführt oder dessen KI-Erfahrung sich auf die Arbeit mit Chat-Assistenten beschränkt. Wir suchen jemanden, der Lösungen baut: Prozesse versteht, automatisiert und messbar besser macht.

Das bieten wir

  • Eine Schlüsselrolle in einer gelebten AI-First-Strategie, mit direktem Draht zur Geschäftsführung und echtem Gestaltungsspielraum.
  • Ein System, das schon steht und jetzt in die Breite muss. Du startest nicht bei null.
  • 60.000 bis 75.000 € brutto im Jahr, davon bis zu 15.000 € erfolgsabhängig nach Zielvereinbarung.
  • Einen Vertrag, der zunächst auf ein Jahr befristet ist, mit dem klaren Ziel der unbefristeten Übernahme.
  • Ein Team vor Ort: drei Tage pro Woche am Standort, an bis zu zwei KI-Arbeitstagen wahlweise im Büro oder zu Hause.

So bewirbst du dich

Schick uns deinen Lebenslauf und eine kurze Beschreibung eines KI-Projekts, das du selbst umgesetzt hast: Ausgangslage, dein Vorgehen, das Ergebnis in Zahlen und was du daraus gelernt hast. Ein Anschreiben brauchen wir nicht. Im Prozess erwartet dich eine Fallaufgabe vor Ort. Start: zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt.

Deine Ansprechpartnerin ist Sonja Bialas (Teamlead HR).

Bei uns zählt der Mensch und seine Motivation, unabhängig von Geschlecht, Herkunft, Religion oder sexueller Orientierung. Bewerbungen von Menschen mit einer Schwerbehinderung oder ihnen Gleichgestellten werden bei gleicher Eignung bevorzugt berücksichtigt.
