9f649acc2a2d0856.title: Principal Solution Architect
9f649acc2a2d0856.description:
Waracle are looking for a Principal Solution Architect for an exciting new role joining our world-class digital technology consultancy and home to a diverse, smart, curious and ambitious community of specialists in technology-driven transformation.

We work with ambitious clients to help them solve their biggest business and customer challenges. We help our clients to innovate and create intelligent digital products and services. We thrive on complex  challenges and deliver business-critical IT transformation projects, moving seamlessly from strategy, design and delivery to operations.


This is a Hybrid role, offering the flexibility to balance your professional and personal life, with 2 days a week spent connecting with colleagues in our London office or on client site 

The Role

Are you a visionary technical leader who thrives on bringing clarity to complex engineering challenges?

In this influential role, you’ll act as the bridge where mobile engineering, product strategy, security, and delivery converge. Partnering with high-profile clients, you will shape resilient, secure, and user-friendly digital mobile experiences that millions rely on daily. You will work ahead of delivery teams to resolve architectural ambiguity, steer platform evolution, and lead with empathy, collaboration, and purpose.

Key aspects of the role include:

  • Strategic Architecture & Vision: Shape and lead end-to-end mobile architecture across iOS, Android, APIs, and cloud services, aligning technical roadmaps with long-term business goals.

  • Platform Governance & Innovation: Define organisation-wide security, resilience, and performance standards while leading proof-of-concepts for emerging technologies.

  • Executive & Stakeholder Influence: Act as a trusted advisor to senior business leaders and client steering boards, effectively translating complex technical strategies into clear, impactful choices.

  • Engineering & Practice Leadership: Drive practice-wide capability growth, build playbooks, and foster an inclusive, high-performing engineering culture by mentoring and empowering teams across multiple squads.

  • Secure & Resilient Design: Champion "secure by design" principles, threat modeling, and robust platform controls to protect customers and maintain platform integrity at scale.

Research shows that underrepresented groups tend to only apply for roles that they believe they meet 100% of the criteria for. At Waracle, we want to buck that trend! We hire for passion, potential and mindset as much as credentials. If you think you'd be incredible in the role, then apply - even if you don't think you tick every box.


What you'll bring

  • Architectural Mastery: Strong expertise designing end-to-end mobile platform solutions, mobile SDKs, shared libraries, and modularised codebases across iOS and Android.

  • Strategic & Inclusive Leadership: Proven ability to influence executive-level stakeholders, resolve organisational challenges, and guide cross-functional teams with clarity and empathy.

  • Security & Resilience Focus: Deep appreciation for secure design principles, threat modeling, authentication, tamper detection, and operational reliability in enterprise environments.

  • Modern Engineering Mindset: Experience in agile delivery, CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, observability, and continuous improvement practices.

  • Collaborative Coaching: Passion for nurturing talent, designing upskilling initiatives, building communities of practice, and establishing reusable organisational accelerators.

  • Domain Exposure (Desirable): Experience within regulated financial services, high-control enterprise environments, or evaluating vendor SDKs and cloud-native services

What to expect from our hiring process

  • 1. First Hello: An informal chat with your dedicated Talent Attraction Partner to talk about Waracle, what you want out of your next move, salary, benefits, and office hybrid working model.

  • 2. Craft Showcase: A chance to demonstrate your real-world expertise. Depending on the role, this will be a focused take-home task (capped at 2–3 hours to respect your time) or a practical presentation.

  • 3. Talking Impact: A collaborative deep dive into how you solve problems, work with others, and raise the bar, guided by our core values and competency framework.

Your Talent Attraction Partner will be in your corner through every step right up to your Welcome Ritual on day one!

Our Benefits

We believe in supporting our team, inside and outside of work. Here's a glimpse of what you can expect:

  • Rest & Recharge: You'll receive 27 days of annual leave, plus 8 bank holidays, totaling 35 days of holiday to unwind and pursue your passions.

  • Financial Future & Security: Plan for retirement with our company-matched 5% pension contribution. For added peace of mind, we also offer a Death in Service benefit, providing 2 x your annual salary for your loved ones.

  • Health & Wellness: Our Medicash Health Cash Plans help cover everyday healthcare costs, complemented by an Employee Assistance Programme for confidential support, and Group Sickness Cover for peace of mind.

  • Flexible Working: We champion hybrid working, providing a home office setup budget to ensure you're comfortable and productive wherever you are.

  • Learning & Development: Invest in yourself with access to Udemy Business and a dedicated learning and development budget for continuous growth.

  • Lifestyle Perks: Make the most of our Cycle to Work Scheme, and enjoy exclusive gym and retail discounts.

  • Family First: Our enhanced parental leave policies include support for fertility journeys, recognising diverse family needs.

  • Community & Connection: We foster a vibrant culture with regular fun meet-ups and lunch on us in the office once a month. You'll also have the opportunity to make a local impact through Spirit of Waracle, our initiative for getting involved in charitable causes locally, building strong team bonds and giving back.

We are an equal opportunities employer and welcome applications from all suitably qualified persons regardless of their race, gender, disability, religion/belief, sexual orientation or age.

21d09a6d2204e5eb.title: Senior GRC Engineer
21d09a6d2204e5eb.description:
Our Global Structure


Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we're unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

About the Team

Come help us build the world's most trusted on-demand logistics engine for delivery! We're building a team of great minds to help us secure and maintain a 24x7, no-downtime, global infrastructure system that powers DoorDash's multi-sided marketplace of consumers, merchants, and drivers.

About the Role

We're hiring a Senior GRC Engineer to help take DoorDash's compliance program from something people run to something the platform runs on its own. Reporting to the Security Compliance Manager, you'll take primary ownership of how regulatory and framework change gets tracked, interpreted, and turned into real controls - one part of a broader GRC function that spans audit, policy, and risk. Day to day, that means less time updating spreadsheets and more time writing the automation, integrations, and control logic that let audit evidence collect itself. You'll also lead major external audits from start to finish and help shape the policies and control standards the rest of the program is built on.This is a hands-on role for someone who already has deep audit and assurance experience, wants to spend more time building than briefing and can move a program forward, and change how people work, without needing the title to make it happen.

You're excited about this opportunity because you will…

  • Build the regulatory and framework change-management process that keeps DoorDash ahead of new obligations, instead of reacting to them.
  • Move manual, point-in-time compliance work onto Compliance-as-Code foundations: policy-as-code, automated control testing, and continuous evidence collection wired into CI/CD, so audit readiness holds up between audits, not just during them.
  • Design and run agentic workflows for evidence analysis, control testing, and audit response preparation, with a human in the loop where assurance demands it.
  • Partner directly with engineering and architecture teams to design controls into new systems at build time and translate that technical work into the narratives auditors actually need.
  • Partner with the Security Compliance Manager to shape and mature the global compliance program. 
  • Design, implement and validate security controls relevant to DoorDash's regulatory environment, not just document them.
  • Support development and refinement of security policies, standards, and guidance. 
  • Mentor other members of the compliance team and help set the technical bar the rest of the function grows into.
  • Ensure policies are actionable, testable, and aligned to real-world controls. 

We're excited about you because you have…

  • 5+ years of experience in security compliance, GRC or technology risk, with a strong track record in high-growth, technology-driven and regulated environments. 
  • Hands-on experience building large language models and agent workflows with daily use of AI in your own work, grounded judgment on what to delegate to agents versus what needs a human, and the ability to evidence both to an auditor. DoorDash is an AI-forward organization and the ability to optimize efficiency using AI is crucial in this role.
  • The ideal candidate brings hands-on experience with frameworks such as DORA, the EU AI Act, NIS2 and CRA. 
  • Real, hands-on experience implementing and assessing controls against frameworks like PCI DSS, SOC 2, ISO 27001 - not just reading them.
  • Demonstrated ability to identify control gaps, assess risk and drive remediation in partnership with cross-functional stakeholders. 
  • Experience developing, implementing and improving security policies, standards, and procedures, ensuring they are operational and effective.
  • Strong understanding of compliance metrics and reporting, with the ability to track control effectiveness, audit outcomes, and risk exposure. 
  • Ability to influence and drive accountability across technical and non-technical stakeholders. 
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to translate complex audit and compliance requirements into clear, actionable guidance. 
  • Comfort owning compliance metrics and reporting - you can show, not just assert, that a program is working.
  • Bachelor's degree in Information Security, Computer Science, or related field, or equivalent practical experience. 

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger, more creative, and better at what we do. We're committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong.

We believe in equality of opportunity and welcome candidates from all backgrounds regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, socio-economic background, religion, or belief.

If you have a disability or long-term health condition and need support to apply for one of our roles, or require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, you'll have the opportunity to let us know once you've submitted your application. We'll share details on how to request support so we can ensure you have a fair and equitable experience.

If you're excited about making a real impact in a fast-moving marketplace and growing your career alongside ambitious, supportive teams, we'd love to hear from you!


Beware of recruitment scams: DASH Brands will never ask you to pay money or share sensitive financial information during hiring — learn more about DASH Brands' legitimate recruiting process at careersatdoordash.com/recruitment-scam-awareness.

0c7029329d0ccd8b.title: Senior Operations Representative Compliance
0c7029329d0ccd8b.description:
Our Global Structure


Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we're unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

About the team

We're looking for a talented individual to join our Rider Onboarding and Compliance Team. This is a bustling and vibrant team that helps applicants become riders to ensure we have enough riders in the fleet to supply customer demand and proactively ensure riders remain in service and compliant during their time with Deliveroo. This is the perfect opportunity to join an exciting, fast-growing business and expand your operational abilities.

About the role

You will report to the Rider Compliance Team Lead and collaborate with the Rider Compliance Team to proactively ensure riders remain in-service and compliant by effectively and efficiently managing compliance pipelines. In collaboration with the Rider Compliance Senior team, you will be responsible for reducing rider downtime resulting from compliance processes and ensuring Deliveroo is compliant with local laws at all times

What you'll be doing:

Accurately load riders to compliance sweeps to ensure we have valid and compliant rider information and documentation

Monitor the rider compliance flows to ensure minimal friction in the process 

Provide SME compliance knowledge to Deliveroo team to ensure we successfully launch in new markets and our fleet remains compliant

Manage vendor compliance queues to ensure that compliance cases are reviewed and actioned efficiently

Develop and provide SME market-specific compliance knowledge to our vendors and internal teams

Respond to internal and external compliance escalations

Ensure the Rider Compliance Team process and training documentation is up-to-date

Provide comprehensive training to new starters and our vendors

Collaborate with the Compliance Team to identify opportunities for reducing inefficiencies within our processes

Collaborate with the broader Rider Compliance Team to achieve KPIs and targets 

Proactively identify, investigate and take appropriate actions to mitigate rider compliance risk within our fleet or processes

Requirements

You are proficient in written and spoken English

You are an excellent and confident communicator

You are highly organised

You are detail-oriented

You are a strong team player

You are happy working in a fast-paced environment and can easily adapt to change

You are self-motivated and eager to learn

You are curious and can challenge processes that aren't working -- you get to the bottom of things

You are familiar with G-Sheets or Excel (can maintain complex spreadsheets).

Experience using Salesforce

Why Deliveroo

Our mission is to transform the way you shop and eat, bringing the neighbourhood to your door by connecting consumers, restaurants, shops and riders. We are transforming the way the world eats and shops by making access to food and products more convenient and enjoyable. We give people the opportunity to buy what they want, as they want it, when and where they want it.

We are a technology-driven company at the forefront of the most rapidly expanding industry in the world. We are still a small team, making a very large impact, looking to answer some of the most interesting questions out there. We move fast, value autonomy and ownership, and we are always looking for new ideas.

Workplace & Benefits

At Deliveroo we know that people are the heart of the business and we prioritise their welfare. Benefits differ by country, but we offer many benefits in areas including healthcare, well-being, parental leave, pensions, and generous annual leave allowances, including time off to support a charitable cause of your choice. Benefits are country-specific, please ask your recruiter for more information.

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger, more creative, and better at what we do. We're committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong.

We believe in equality of opportunity and welcome candidates from all backgrounds regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, socio-economic background, religion, or belief.

If you have a disability or long-term health condition and need support to apply for one of our roles, or require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, you'll have the opportunity to let us know once you've submitted your application. We'll share details on how to request support so we can ensure you have a fair and equitable experience.

If you're excited about making a real impact in a fast-moving marketplace and growing your career alongside ambitious, supportive teams, we'd love to hear from you!


Beware of recruitment scams: DASH Brands will never ask you to pay money or share sensitive financial information during hiring — learn more about DASH Brands' legitimate recruiting process at careersatdoordash.com/recruitment-scam-awareness.

8e03a3b0b86e79ae.title: Talent Acquisition Lead - UK
8e03a3b0b86e79ae.description:
About us

Salience Labs is building an industry-defining approach to optical circuit switching for AI infrastructure, engineered for real latency reduction and cost savings at hyperscale. We’re moving from proven technology to real world deployment at scale, and joining at this stage means genuine ownership over that next chapter, working alongside a small, highly technical team on one of the most consequential problems in AI infrastructure today.

The Role

This is a hands-on, delivery-focused recruiter role. As Talent Acquisition Lead in the UK, you will run recruiting end to end in an early-stage environment. The work is broad and the pace is high. You will go directly into the market to headhunt the best possible candidates for each role opened.

You will report to the Head of Talent and work closely with hiring managers to fill roles based in the UK and Europe.

Responsibilities

  • Run full-cycle recruiting, from intake and sourcing to closing and offer, with limited dedicated support

  • Manage hiring across multiple functions at once, prioritising as needed

  • Build outbound pipeline for hard-to-find talent using research, networks and market mapping as well as LinkedIn

  • Work with hiring managers to define role requirements

  • Sell Salience to candidates with better-known options

  • Give hiring managers regular pipeline updates and fast turnaround on feedback and decisions

  • Align with the US talent team on a shared approach across regions

  • Track time to hire, outbound response and conversion, and act on the results

  • Contribute to tools and processes as the team grows

What We’re Looking For

  • 3 to 5 years of recruitment experience, personally sourcing and closing hires

  • Agency experience, with a record of working at pace and delivering on outbound

  • Early-stage technical start-up experience, moving fast on hard-to-fill roles through headhunting

  • Range across technical, commercial and operational hiring, with the ability to get up to speed quickly

  • Bias to speed, with a clear view of your own time to hire

  • Strong attention to detail across candidate communication, scheduling and offers

  • Strong outbound sourcing, with examples of reaching candidates who were not looking

  • Comfort working with demanding stakeholders and tight deadlines

  • Curiosity and quick learning in unfamiliar technical areas

  • Flexibility across UK and US time zones

  • Comfort using AI tools to work faster

  • A team-first attitude, with no job too small

  • Deep-tech, semiconductor, hardware or photonics experience is a plus

336f75c6cc9f8085.title: AI Platform Engineer
336f75c6cc9f8085.description:
About us

People assume the supply chain is an automated, algorithmic system. It is not. It is a large number of people acting as the glue between organisations and systems, doing work the world depends on with tools that have barely changed in decades. Nexcade builds AI agents for those people, starting in freight forwarding, a $210BN industry.

Our agents are live in production with some of the leading global forwarders, pricing millions in freight every week, and we are expanding the platform deeper into the shipment lifecycle. We have raised $8.5M to make this a reality.

Our founders, Dan and Tasho, spent years at Sedna and Palantir working with supply chain companies on problems like this one. We are backed by top VCs and angels who backed or founded Synthesia, n8n and other world-class companies.

 

How we work

  • Everybody codes, founders included. The whole company is technical, commercial team included, and runs on coding agents.

  • Closely with customers and design partners, so what we ship changes how they operate.

  • At pace. Fast cycles and quick iterations, on the product and on how we work.

  • End to end. If you see something broken or missing, you have the freedom (and the responsibility) to fix it.

  • In person, 4+ days a week in London. We value synchronous communication.

  • Debate rigorously, decide quickly, execute relentlessly.

  • Enjoy the journey. Hard problems, good colleagues.

     

The role

We are building the AI platform for freight forwarding and expanding our product surface, and we are hiring software engineers across product, AI and platform to do it.

You will build products that do freight forwarding work alongside our customers' teams, operating across the entire shipment lifecycle. You will work across the stack in Python, TypeScript and React, and directly with customers and founders on what gets built.

Everyone here works across the stack, but each engineer has a spike: the area where they set the bar for the team. You spend most of your time where yours is, and lean on your colleagues where theirs are.

  • Product: You build best in class products for the core jobs in freight forwarding, one job at a time. You work as a design partner with our customers to understand the work deeply, turn that understanding into a product they would choose over anything else, and feed what you learn back into the platform everyone builds on.

  • AI: You raise the ceiling on what our AI can do and the floor on how reliably it does it. That spans high volume tasks like classification and extraction and deep workflow tasks that run for hours. You design for performance, reliability, explainability and control, set up the gyms and evals to measure them, and build the harness that runs our agents in all of our products.

  • Platform: You own the foundation every product stands on: the runtime for thousands of concurrent agents and workflows, the way they communicate and scale, the controls for how they access data with permissions that hold, and the observability to see and measure all of it. You ensure the rest of the team can move fast without fear.

     

What we look for

  • A spike, with evidence. Something you have been exceptional at and proof of it. We hire on slope rather than years, so there is no experience threshold in either direction.

  • Strong fundamentals. In the AI-assisted era, having good technical judgement is key. You have shipped production systems people depend on, seen them fail and learned from it.

  • High agency and ownership. You take an ambiguous problem, make a call, and see it through.

  • Humility and learning velocity. You want to get better and you change your mind when the evidence says so.

  • Interest in the problem. You do not need a freight background, but you need to find messy real-world operations interesting rather than a chore.

     

Why join

You will shape the product, the architecture and the company, working alongside an engineering team from Palantir, Raft, Faculty, UnlikelyAI and Oxford. You will work directly with the businesses using what you build, on AI applied to an industry that has resisted software for decades. You will get meaningful equity, so when this works you share in it.

1fea449f26ff5240.title: Founding Product
1fea449f26ff5240.description:
About us

People assume the supply chain is an automated, algorithmic system. In reality, hundred of thousands of operators acting as the glue between organisations and systems, doing work the world depends on, with tools that have barely changed in decades and spending hours a day on email. Nexcade is building the agentic operating system for those people, transforming the way people communicate and optimise the $1T spend on logistics every year.

Our agents are live in production with leading global Freight Forwarders, pricing millions in freight every week, and we are rapidly expanding the platform to touch every part of the logistics lifecycle.

Our founders, Dan and Tasho, spent years at Sedna and Palantir working with supply chain companies on problems like this one. We have raised $8.5M to make this a reality from top VCs and angels who backed or founded Synthesia, n8n and other world-class companies.

How we work

  • Everybody builds, founders included. The whole company is technical and runs on coding agents. You will not be asked to write production software, but you will use agents for discovery synthesis, specs, prototypes and data analysis rather than doing them by hand.

  • Closely with customers and design partners, so what we ship changes how they operate.

  • At pace. Fast cycles and quick iterations, on the product and on how we work.

  • End to end. If you see something broken or missing, you have the freedom (and the responsibility) to fix it.

  • In person, in London. We value synchronous communication.

  • Debate rigorously, decide quickly, execute relentlessly.

  • Enjoy the journey. Hard problems, good colleagues.

The role

We’re building the AI platform freight forwarders rely on. We started with quoting and are expanding across the shipment lifecycle. As Product Lead, you will be central to that expansion, helping decide where we focus and turning those decisions into products customers depend on.

What you’ll do:

  • Own product outcomes: Own the roadmap, priorities and performance of specific products, from defining the customer problem through launch, rollout and adoption. Partner with the founders on overall product direction and strategy.

  • Build from customer insight: Work closely with freight forwarders across commercial and operational roles. Understand how they work, identify the problems customers share and build products for those needs rather than one-off solutions.

  • Prototype and build: Turn ideas into working prototypes and early product versions, using AI tools and code to test them with customers. Work hands-on with engineering to take promising ideas into production, not just write specs and hand them over.

  • Drive product expansion: Build a clear view of the market, including where we win, where we do not compete and why customers choose us. Use that understanding to identify the next workflows Nexcade should enter and turn them into products that grow revenue.

  • Raise the standard of product thinking: Define success measures, test assumptions and examine accuracy, edge cases and second-order effects before scaling. Write clear specs and decision documents, including a written recommendation on the hard calls.

  • Build the product operating system: Establish a clear planning and decision-making cadence without adding bureaucracy. Make sure product meetings are well prepared, teams have the context they need and decisions translate into shipped work.

  • Make product and platform trade-offs: Work closely with engineering to decide when to invest in shared capabilities and when a faster, product-specific approach is right.

What we look for

  • Strong product judgement: You have owned meaningful product work in a complex B2B product and can show how your decisions changed customer behaviour or business results. You define success clearly and test assumptions, accuracy and edge cases before scaling.

  • Product taste: You can turn complex workflows into products that feel simple, coherent and trustworthy. You care about the details that make people choose to use them.

  • Technical fluency: You work effectively with strong engineers, understand trade-offs across architecture, AI, data and integrations and bring the customer and product perspective to choices about speed, quality and reuse.

  • Excellent judgement: You get beyond what customers ask for to understand how their work really happens and distinguish repeatable needs from bespoke requests. You use customer and market insight to make product choices that drive adoption, expansion and revenue.

  • High agency and directness: You take ownership, hold a high bar and disagree openly and constructively. You are comfortable with ambiguity, fast iteration and changing priorities.

  • Obsess over the problem: You are drawn to complex, messy problems in industries the economy depends on and want to understand how the people and systems behind them really work. Industry experience is a bonus, but not required.

Why join

The biggest product choices are still ahead: how deep we go, where we expand and how everything fits together. Our product is already live with leading freight forwarders and this role will shape what comes next. You will build AI for the work that keeps global trade moving, alongside a team from Palantir, Raft, Faculty, UnlikelyAI and Oxford. You will get meaningful equity in the company you help build.

e39a9668e3760465.title: Software Engineer
e39a9668e3760465.description:
About us

People assume the supply chain is an automated, algorithmic system. It is not. It is a large number of people acting as the glue between organisations and systems, doing work the world depends on with tools that have barely changed in decades. Nexcade builds AI agents for those people, starting in freight forwarding, a $210BN industry.

Our agents are live in production with some of the leading global forwarders, pricing millions in freight every week, and we are expanding the platform deeper into the shipment lifecycle. We have raised $8.5M to make this a reality.

Our founders, Dan and Tasho, spent years at Sedna and Palantir working with supply chain companies on problems like this one. We are backed by top VCs and angels who backed or founded Synthesia, n8n and other world-class companies.

How we work

  • Everybody codes, founders included. The whole company is technical, commercial team included, and runs on coding agents.

  • Closely with customers and design partners, so what we ship changes how they operate.

  • At pace. Fast cycles and quick iterations, on the product and on how we work.

  • End to end. If you see something broken or missing, you have the freedom (and the responsibility) to fix it.

  • In person, 4+ days a week in London. We value synchronous communication.

  • Debate rigorously, decide quickly, execute relentlessly.

  • Enjoy the journey. Hard problems, good colleagues.

The role

We are building the AI platform for freight forwarding and expanding our product surface, and we are hiring software engineers across product, AI and platform to do it.

You will build products that do freight forwarding work alongside our customers' teams, operating across the entire shipment lifecycle. You will work across the stack in Python, TypeScript and React, and directly with customers and founders on what gets built.

Everyone here works across the stack, but each engineer has a spike: the area where they set the bar for the team. You spend most of your time where yours is, and lean on your colleagues where theirs are.

  • Product: You build best in class products for the core jobs in freight forwarding, one job at a time. You work as a design partner with our customers to understand the work deeply, turn that understanding into a product they would choose over anything else, and feed what you learn back into the platform everyone builds on.

  • AI: You raise the ceiling on what our AI can do and the floor on how reliably it does it. That spans high volume tasks like classification and extraction and deep workflow tasks that run for hours. You design for performance, reliability, explainability and control, set up the gyms and evals to measure them, and build the harness that runs our agents in all of our products.

  • Platform: You own the foundation every product stands on: the runtime for thousands of concurrent agents and workflows, the way they communicate and scale, the controls for how they access data with permissions that hold, and the observability to see and measure all of it. You ensure the rest of the team can move fast without fear.

What we look for

  • A spike, with evidence. Something you have been exceptional at and proof of it. We hire on slope rather than years, so there is no experience threshold in either direction.

  • Strong fundamentals. In the AI-assisted era, having good technical judgement is key. You have shipped production systems people depend on, seen them fail and learned from it.

  • High agency and ownership. You take an ambiguous problem, make a call, and see it through.

  • Humility and learning velocity. You want to get better and you change your mind when the evidence says so.

  • Interest in the problem. You do not need a freight background, but you need to find messy real-world operations interesting rather than a chore.

Why join

You will shape the product, the architecture and the company, working alongside an engineering team from Palantir, Raft, Faculty, UnlikelyAI and Oxford. You will work directly with the businesses using what you build, on AI applied to an industry that has resisted software for decades. You will get meaningful equity, so when this works you share in it.

cb528052e830d4f7.title: Chef de Projet Marketing Digital CDD de remplacement 3 mois H/F
cb528052e830d4f7.description:
À propos de RUN Services

Filiale à 100% d’AXA France, RUN Services, basé à Nanterre (RER A – Nanterre Préfecture / RER E - Nanterre-La-Folie) est un acteur majeur de l’assurance Moto, Cyclo, Véhicules de Collection, Camping-Car et Plaisance.

Connu via les marques commerciales AXA Passion et RUN Assurance, notamment en partenariat avec Direct Assurance, RUN Services allie expertise et dynamisme dans des univers d’assurance orientés passions, et recherche aujourd'hui un.e Chef de Projet Marketing Digital pour accompagner son développement.

À propos du poste

Au sein du département DCE (Digital/Communication/Événementiel) de RUN Services, et rattaché(e) au manager d’équipe, vous prenez en charge l'ensemble des sujets digitaux, de l'élaboration du cahier des charges jusqu'à la gestion de la performance. Vous agissez en véritable interface entre les équipes métier du DCE et le service IT. Vous collectez et analysez les besoins métier pour rédiger des expressions de besoins claires et détaillées, permettant ainsi au service IT de développer les évolutions optimales de nos supports digitaux.

Vous pilotez la performance globale de nos différents supports (sites business, marketing, etc.) en assurant le suivi de nos investissements digitaux et en coordonnant l'ensemble des actions marketing associées.

Vos missions

Performance digitale : Vous pilotez la stratégie SEO/SEA, gérez les relations avec les agences, administrez les tableaux de bord de performance et optimisez les leviers d'acquisition (affiliation, newsletters, partenariats).

Réseaux sociaux et e-réputation : Vous gérez les comptes sociaux d'AXA Passion, coordonnez la stratégie de contenu, assurez une veille active, gérez l'e-réputation et développez des partenariats avec des créateurs de contenu.

Relation adhérents : Vous pilotez les outils digitaux dédiés aux adhérents, notamment l'e-boutique, gérez les prestataires, coordonnez les opérations spéciales et collaborez avec l'IT pour faire évoluer les services clients.

Gestion de projet : Vous agissez en interface avec le service IT pour traduire les besoins métier en expressions de besoins claires, pilotez les réunions de suivi et validez la conformité des livrables digitaux.

Profil recherché

Compétences techniques :

  • Gestion de projet : planification, organisation, suivi et évaluation des campagnes marketing

  • Marketing digital : SEO, SEM, gestion des réseaux sociaux, email marketing, publicité en ligne

  • Outils de marketing : maîtrise des CRM (ex : Salesforce), outils d'automatisation marketing

  • Analyse de données : interprétation des KPI, utilisation d'outils d'analyse (Google Analytics, Tableau)

  • Conception de contenu : rédaction, création graphique, vidéo

Compétences relationnelles :

  • Communication : claire, persuasive et adaptée à différents interlocuteurs

  • Esprit d'équipe : collaboration efficace avec les autres départements (ventes, communication, produit)

  • Créativité : proposer des idées innovantes pour atteindre les objectifs

  • Adaptabilité : s'ajuster face aux changements de marché ou de stratégie

  • Organisation : gestion des priorités et respect des délais

Rémunération

La rémunération proposée pour ce poste est de 41,000€ par an (dont un complément de rémunération variable annualisée qui sera proratisé selon la durée du CDD) et intéressement.

Avantages

De bonnes raisons pour nous rejoindre :

  • Télétravail jusqu’à 3 jours par semaine

  • Tickets restaurants les jours télétravaillés et restaurant d’entreprise

  • Intégrer une structure à taille humaine en plein développement et leader sur son marché

  • Découvrir et intégrer des mondes affinitaires particulièrement dynamiques et attractifs

Processus de recrutement :

  • Pré-entretien RH téléphonique

  • Entretien RH sur site

  • Entretien avec les managers opérationnels

Vous êtes motivés, rejoignez nous !

About Mirakl:

Founded in 2012, Mirakl has been at the forefront of marketplace innovation, empowering every business to compete in the platform economy.

Today, Mirakl's operating system combines an enterprise marketplace solution (Mirakl Platform) that enables retailers and B2B organizations to launch, scale, and operate marketplaces and dropship, AI-powered multichannel selling (Mirakl Connect), retail media (Mirakl Ads) and an agentic commerce infrastructure (Mirakl Nexus).

With dual headquarters in Boston and Paris, Mirakl helps a global ecosystem of 450+ marketplaces (B2C and B2B) and a network of over 100k third-party marketplace sellers. Brands like Macy's, Decathlon, Carrefour, Asos, and Airbus Helicopters use Mirakl to grow their businesses in new and remarkable ways.

For more information: www.mirakl.com.

Mirakl in Numbers:

  • 🗓️ Founded in 2012 | Member of French Tech Next40
  • 👥 750+ employees in 9 offices worldwide: Paris, Barcelona, Bordeaux, Boston, London, Munich, New York, Sydney, Tokyo
  • 🇫🇷 350+ Mirakl Tech teams members mainly based in France
  • ⚙️ 5 Saas Solutions

Our Values:

Working at Mirakl means accelerating your career alongside ambitious, passionate, and supportive colleagues. We're proud of the diversity of backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences that make our teams unique.

Our 5 values guide how we collaborate:

  • 💡 Work Hard Together: Teamwork and collaboration are the foundation of our success
  • 🏆 Get Things Done:  We prioritize action and efficiency for impactful results
  • 🚀 Go Above & Beyond:  We tackle challenges proactively and always aim for excellence
  • 🎓 Succeed Through Expertise: Knowledge sharing and continuous learning are core to our culture
  • 🤝 Satisfy & Empower Clients: We're committed to our clients' success

Mirakl is the leading provider of eCommerce software solutions. Mirakl's suite of solutions provides enterprises with a transformative way to drive significant growth and efficiency in their online business.
Since 2012, Mirakl has been pioneering the platform economy, empowering retail and B2B enterprises with the most advanced, secure, and scalable technology to digitize and expand product assortment through marketplace and dropship, improve efficiency in supplier catalog management and payments, personalize shopping experiences, and boost profits through retail media.
 
In July 2025, Mirakl launched Mirakl Nexus, the first neutral infrastructure designed for agentic commerce. Built on Mirakl's 13 years of expertise and innovation, and powered by an ecosystem of more than 100,000 sellers, Mirakl Nexus connects merchants and AI agents to automate product discovery, payments, and after-sales service.
 
For more information: www.mirakl.com.

You'll be part of our Data Experience squad led by Alexandre Blanchard, Data Engineering Manager within Mirakl's broader Data team of 70 specialists. Together, you'll be building and scaling the ML infrastructure that powers Mirakl's AI-driven products from real-time recommendation inference to LLM fine-tuning pipelines serving some of the world's most innovative e-commerce players.
 

2. Your Impact

  • Design and implement a performant, robust, and scalable ML Platform architecture — covering training, evaluation, and inference — while keeping costs under control
  • Maintain and improve ML production pipelines and real-time inference applications at scale (real-time recommendation inference, 1M+ LLM calls/week, async content moderation)

  • Proven track record of shipping ML applications at scale (NLP, image processing, or classical ML) in high-volume, production-grade systems
  • Background in software development with a strong appetite for data science and machine learning
Skills:
  • Proficiency in Python and the Kubernetes/Docker ecosystem
  • Solid experience with cloud environments (AWS primarily) and Apache ecosystem frameworks
  • Hands-on knowledge of an orchestration tool (Airflow, Prefect, or equivalent)
  • Familiarity with CI/CD practices and MLOps principles (monitoring, model lifecycle, reproducibility)
  • Strong communicator with a knack for mentoring and presenting technical work to diverse audiences
 

4. Tech Stack

Experience with: Python, Databricks, AWS, Kafka, Airflow, Prefect, MLflow, TensorFlow, Triton, PyTorch, vLLM, KServe, Delta Lake, Kubernetes, SQL, Terraform, Apache Spark
 

5. Languages

  • French: Fluent (C2 level required)
  • English: Fluent (B2/C1 level required)

a7a86a6c0266d22b.description:
Société

O’CD est une enseigne spécialisée dans l’achat, la vente et l’échange de CD, DVD, BLU-RAY et JEUX VIDEO. Ses magasins sont présents à LILLE, PARIS, LYON, GRENOBLE, GENEVE, MARSEILLE, MONTPELLIER, TOULOUSE, BORDEAUX, NANTES, TOURS et RENNES.

Depuis presque 30ans, O’CD se construit par passion avec des personnes qui considèrent le partage culturel comme la valeur moteur de leur enthousiasme. Son concept original fait d’O’CD un groupe pérenne et tourné vers l’avenir. Les références sont renouvelées constamment grâce à l’achat, la vente et le troc. A l’heure où le téléchargement occupe une place importante sur le marché, O’CD continue à se développer grâce à ses valeurs solides, son équipe de passionnés, son expertise du produit et sont esprit recycler. Rejoignez-nous pour faire partie de l’aventure !

Descriptif du poste

Rattaché au chef de projets informatiques, le stagiaire participera à la conception et à l'amélioration des interfaces d’applications. Il interviendra sur l'ensemble du processus de conception et pourra, selon son profil, participer à l'intégration front-end des interfaces réalisées. Ses missions principales seront de concevoir des parcours utilisateurs simples et efficaces, réaliser des wireframes, maquettes et prototypes, améliorer l'ergonomie et l'accessibilité d'applications existantes. Ce stage permettra d'acquérir une expérience concrète dans la conception et la réalisation d'interfaces professionnelles au sein d'une équipe de développement.

Finalité du poste

Le.la Customer Success Specialist assure l’accompagnement opérationnel des clients dans l’utilisation des solutions de l’entreprise afin de garantir la qualité de service, la satisfaction client et le bon traitement des demandes utilisateurs.

Il.Elle contribue à la fluidité des opérations clients dans le respect des procédures et des priorités définies par l’entreprise.

Salaire 27 000 à 30 000 euros brut/an

Missions principales

Support et relation client (Customer Success)

  • Répondre aux sollicitations clients (email, téléphone, outils digitaux)

  • Identifier les problématiques rencontrées par les utilisateurs

  • Assurer le suivi des demandes clients jusqu’à leur résolution complète

  • Traiter les demandes en fonction de leur criticité

  • Escalader les situations complexes aux interlocuteurs concernés afin de garantir un haut niveau de satisfaction client

  • Documenter les échanges et mettre à jour les informations dans les outils internes (CRM, outils de ticketing, base de connaissances)

Onboarding et accompagnement utilisateurs

  • Participer aux sessions de démonstrations du logiciel ASKARA auprès des clients et partenaires

  • Accompagner les utilisateurs lors de leur prise en main (présentiel ou distanciel)

  • Réaliser des formations utilisateurs selon les supports définis

  • Adapter sa communication aux différents profils utilisateurs

  • Participer ponctuellement aux congrès afin de présenter la solution

Gestion administrative et logistique

  • Participer au suivi des équipements et expéditions (microphones et équipements associés)

  • Assurer le suivi administratif des opérations logistiques

  • Signaler les anomalies ou incidents identifiés

  • Mettre à jour les outils internes (HubSpot, …) de suivi logistique

Contribution documentaire

  • Participer à la mise à jour de la base de connaissances wiki interne d’Askara

  • Formaliser les retours utilisateurs utiles à l’amélioration des supports

  • Faire remonter les cas concrets afin de contribuer à l’amélioration continue des processus internes et à l’alimentation de la base de connaissances à partir des cas clients traités

(Liste non exhaustive destinée à établir la teneur du poste qui peut être amené à évoluer et s’adapter en fonction de l’évolution des besoins)

Compétences requises

Compétences Techniques

  • Maîtrise des outils de gestion client (CRM, ticketing)

  • Compétences en organisation logistique

  • Connaissance des outils bureautiques et collaboratifs

Compétences Comportementales

  • Sens du service client

  • Rigueur et organisation

  • Capacité d’adaptation et polyvalence

  • Esprit d’équipe

Niveau d’autonomie et responsabilités

Le.la Customer Success Specialist applique les procédures et priorités définies par la direction.

Ses missions contribuent à l’image de l’entreprise auprès de ses clients, elles ont un impact direct sur la satisfaction client.

Le.La titulaire organise son activité quotidienne dans le cadre des consignes et objectifs fixés.

Les situations complexes ou atypiques sont remontées aux équipes concernées afin de garantir une résolution rapide de la demande client et une expérience client fluide.

Askara est une jeune entreprise qui veut changer le quotidien des dentistes. Notre conviction : un praticien devrait passer son temps avec ses patients, pas derrière son clavier. Notre assistant IA écoute la consultation et rédige pour lui comptes rendus, courriers et documents, directement dans le logiciel qu’il utilise déjà. Moins d’administratif, plus de soin.

Nous sommes une équipe à taille humaine, motivée, qui avance vite. Le produit évolue en permanence (une nouvelle version vient d’ailleurs de sortir), et les retours terrain remontés par le Care pèsent directement sur ce que nous construisons.

Vous rejoindrez le pôle Care, déjà composé de 3 personnes qui connaissent le produit et les praticiens par cœur. Vous ne serez donc pas seul·e. Vous aurez une équipe pour vous former, vous épauler et partager les bonnes pratiques, avec de vraies marges pour proposer des améliorations. Vous serez au contact direct des dentistes, au téléphone, en formation ou sur les congrès, et vous verrez concrètement l’impact de votre travail sur leur quotidien.

47000d641985b96d.title: Sales Development Representative (Inbound)
47000d641985b96d.description:
About Kestra

Kestra is the universal orchestration platform: open source, declarative, & designed to orchestrate data pipelines, IT automation, business workflows, & AI/agentic systems.

Trusted by over 10,000 organizations worldwide, including JPMorgan Chase, Bloomberg, FILA, & Crédit Agricole, Kestra orchestrates mission-critical workloads at scale. The open-source project has close to 30,000 GitHub stars, hundreds of contributors, & a fast-growing global community.

About The Role

Most of Kestra's pipeline starts with someone who already found us: a demo request, a Kestra Cloud trial, a webinar sign-up, or an engineer from the open-source community who wants to talk to Sales. We sell Kestra Enterprise, self-hosted in the customer's own infrastructure, & Kestra Cloud, our fully managed edition.

We're looking for our first inbound Sales Development Representative in Europe to turn that interest into qualified pipeline. You follow up on every inbound lead, qualify it honestly against our Ideal Customer Profile, & pass it to the right Account Executive.

You work closely with our Lead Growth Engineering team, who build & run the systems that capture, score, & route our inbound demand. Together you decide which signals matter, tighten routing, & make sure no good lead goes cold. You report to the Head of Sales & hand off daily to our European Account Executives.

Your buyers are technical: data engineers, platform engineers, & the leaders who run those teams. You don't need to be an engineer, but you need to be curious enough to learn the product & talk credibly about orchestration.

What You'll Own

Follow-up

  • Every inbound lead routed to you: demo & contact requests, Kestra Cloud trials & sign-ups, event & webinar follow-ups, & community hand-raises.

  • Speed to lead: a first personal reply within 1 business hour, & at least 4 follow-up attempts over 7 business days before closing a lead out.

  • Messages that read like a person wrote them: short, relevant, & clearly based on what the prospect actually asked for.

Qualification

  • Qualification calls that uncover the prospect's use case, current tooling (Airflow, cron, homegrown scripts, cloud-native schedulers), team, & timeline.

  • Honest qualification against our Ideal Customer Profile: a real business pain Kestra solves, & someone involved in evaluating or buying.

  • Clean disqualification: leads that don't fit go back to nurture with a clear reason, so the team learns which sources bring good demand.

Hand-off to Account Executives

  • Routing each qualified lead to the right Account Executive by territory & segment, or to the account owner when there is already an open opportunity or an existing customer.

  • First meetings that actually happen, with a written brief so the prospect never has to repeat themselves.

  • Accurate records in HubSpot: every lead, call, & disqualification reason logged, so forecasts & routing can be trusted.

Partnership with Lead Growth Engineering

  • Feedback on lead quality by source, campaign, & persona, so scoring & routing keep improving.

  • Shaping the inbound playbook: qualification questions, templates, objection handling, & the hand-off checklist.

  • Spotting gaps early: leads routed to the wrong place, signals the system misses, or steps that slow a prospect down.

What We're Looking For

  • 1+ year as an SDR, BDR, or in a similar customer-facing role, ideally at a B2B SaaS or software company.

  • Inbound experience: you have worked a lead queue against response-time targets & know how to qualify without losing a good prospect.

  • Curiosity about technical products: you enjoy learning how software works & can hold a credible conversation with an engineer.

  • Clear, concise writing: your emails get answered.

  • CRM discipline: you keep records accurate because you know other people rely on them.

  • Fluent in English; a second European language (especially French or German) is a plus.

  • Comfortable working autonomously in a fully remote team, with working hours that cover European business hours.

Perks & Benefits

  • Competitive compensation, performance bonus, & equity

  • Medical, dental, & vision insurance

  • Employer-paid life & disability insurance

  • Fully remote, with home-office & equipment budget

  • Learning & conference budget

  • Paid time off, company holidays, & parental leave

Location

Europe

d907be5b75882216.title: AI Applied Scientist
d907be5b75882216.description:
About the Science and AI Team

The Science and AI team is at the heart of Maki People. It builds the science and AI behind our platform, from job analysis and assessments to AI interviews and predicting performance. Led by our Head of Science, Aiden Loe, and working closely with our COO, Paul-Louis Caylar, the team brings together business psychologists, psychometricians and AI scientists. Together, they make sure every hiring decision on our platform is accurate, consistent and fair.

As Maki grows, the Science and AI team’s job is to show, with evidence, that our approach leads to better hiring decisions.

 

About the Role

The AI Applied Scientist turns our science into results for clients. Most of your time goes on client projects: adapting our AI scoring to each client’s roles, analysing their data, and showing them what it means. The rest goes on improving the scoring systems that every client relies on.

1. Client projects

  • Adapt AI scoring for structured interviews, job-specific skills and multilingual proficiency to each client’s roles and needs.

  • Analyse client assessment and performance data to show how scores relate to job performance and retention.

  • Set and review cut-offs and thresholds with clients, backed by evidence.

  • Present findings and recommendations directly to clients, in a way non-technical audiences can act on.

  • Work closely with implementation and customer success teams from setup to go-live.

2. Testing scoring quality

  • Compare AI scores with expert ratings to check accuracy and reliability before anything goes live.

  • Test robustness to prompt variation, input noise and adversarial behaviour such as prompt injection.

3. Fairness in practice

  • Run bias checks across demographic groups for each client project.

  • Apply mitigation techniques such as reweighting and calibration without losing model performance.

  • Support fairness reports and compliance documentation for clients.

4. Improving our scoring systems

  • Help choose the right models and prompts for production, balancing accuracy, speed and cost.

  • Support the move onto self-hosted open-weight models, including fine-tuning on expert-rated data.

  • Work with engineering to roll out scoring changes safely.

As one of Maki People’s early employees, you’ll help shape the team’s future.


Our Ideal Candidate

Required

  • MSc or PhD in data science, machine learning, psychology or a related field, or equivalent industry experience.

  • Hands-on experience with LLM-based scoring or evaluation.

  • Strong Python or R skills, with solid statistical analysis.

  • Experience presenting data-driven findings to clients or senior business stakeholders.

  • Able to manage several projects at once and keep to deadlines.

Preferred

  • Experience in consulting, people analytics or assessment.

  • Working knowledge of psychometric concepts such as reliability, validity and IRT.

  • Experience testing AI systems for fairness and bias.

  • Experience fine-tuning language models, for example with LoRA.

  • Working knowledge of ethical AI and compliance, such as the EU AI Act.

     

Application Process

  • Stage 1 - Screening assessment (25 min)

  • Stage 2 - Power skill assessment with our AI agent (15 min)

  • Stage 3 - Hiring manager interview (45 min)

  • Stage 4 - Executive interview (45 min)

  • Stage 5 - Deep-dive technical interview (60 min)

  • Stage 6 - Interview with Co-founder (30 min)

5b19b1aeb25a7d7e.title: AI Research Scientist
5b19b1aeb25a7d7e.description:
About the Science and AI Team

The Science and AI team is at the heart of Maki People. It builds the science and AI behind our platform, from job analysis and assessments to AI interviews and predicting performance. Led by our Head of Science, Aiden Loe, and working closely with our COO, Paul-Louis Caylar, the team brings together business psychologists, psychometricians and AI scientists. Together, they make sure every hiring decision on our platform is accurate, consistent and fair.

As Maki grows, the Science and AI team’s job is to show, with evidence, that our approach leads to better hiring decisions.

About the Role

The AI Research Scientist works at the intersection of AI, psychometrics and research, ensuring that Maki’s automated scoring systems are scientifically robust, fair, and continuously improving.

1. Evaluating and testing LLMs for scoring

  • Assess the accuracy and reliability of LLMs used for automated scoring, such as structured grids, job-specific skills and multilingual proficiency (written and spoken).

  • Benchmark closed- and open-source models across assessment types and languages.

  • Test robustness to prompt variation, input noise and adversarial behaviour such as prompt injection.

  • Explore prompt engineering and model optimisation, and recommend which models and prompts go into production.

2. Building our own scoring models

  • Move our scoring onto self-hosted open-weight models, and fine-tune them on expert-rated data where they can beat frontier models.

  • Check every model switch keeps accuracy, reliability and fairness at least as good as today's.

3. Comparing AI with human judgement, and calibrating psychometric models

  • Design studies that compare AI scores with expert ratings, against both individual experts and expert averages, to establish agreement and validity.

  • Develop hybrid scoring pipelines with engineering that combine human oversight with AI scoring.

  • Evaluate and calibrate psychometric models for validity and comparability across populations and test forms.

4. Bias and fairness analysis

  • Detect and analyse bias in AI-generated and psychometric scores across demographic groups, including subgroup analysis.

  • Apply mitigation techniques such as reweighting and calibration without losing model performance.

  • Contribute to fairness dashboards and compliance documentation that support transparent model governance.

5. Predictive analytics and performance insights

  • Model the relationship between candidate scores and job performance and retention, using large assessment and performance datasets.

  • Develop and test models that estimate success probabilities or identify behavioural and linguistic predictors of performance.

  • Work with data science, implementation and customer success teams to turn findings into recommendations for clients and colleagues.

6. Research output

  • Publish reports, papers and conference presentations, internal and external.

  • Explain technical findings clearly to non-technical colleagues and clients.

As one of Maki People's early employees, you'll help shape the team's future.

Our Ideal Candidate

Required

  • PhD or MSc in machine learning, computational linguistics, data science or psychology.

  • A track record of publications, such as peer-reviewed papers or conference papers.

  • Hands-on experience evaluating LLMs: designing benchmarks, measuring agreement with human raters, and testing consistency and robustness of model output.

  • Experience testing AI-driven decisions for fairness and bias.

  • Proficiency in Python or R, with experience in statistical analysis.

  • Clear communication of results to scientific and business audiences.

Preferred

  • Experience with NLP techniques for automated scoring.

  • Experience fine-tuning language models, for example with LoRA.

  • Experience working with cloud databases and large datasets.

  • Working knowledge of psychometric concepts such as reliability, validity and IRT, and how they apply to assessment design and validation.

  • Working knowledge of ethical AI, data governance and compliance, such as the EU AI Act.

  • Experience working with engineering, product and content teams.

Application Process

  • Stage 1 - Screening assessment (25 min)

  • Stage 2 - Power skill assessment with our AI agent (15 min)

  • Stage 3 - Hiring manager interview (45 min)

  • Stage 4 - Executive interview (45 min)

  • Stage 5 - Deep-dive technical interview (60 min)

  • Stage 6 - Interview with Co-founder (30 min)

4a76c8bae84119cc.title: Sales Development Representative (SDR) - Saas Santé
4a76c8bae84119cc.description:
Chez Lifen, nous pensons que les données médicales ont le potentiel de transformer le système de santé. Mais seulement si elles sont accessibles. Plus de données accessibles → moins de charge administrative, une meilleure coordination des soins et des découvertes scientifiques plus rapides.

Depuis 2015, notre mission est de libérer ce potentiel. Nos solutions basées sur l'IA permettent aux professionnels de santé de partager les informations médicales sans effort et aux chercheurs d'accélérer les découvertes cliniques : avec un impact sur des millions de patients en France chaque jour. Alors que nous nous préparons à nous développer en Europe, 2 choses déterminent notre succès : nos équipes et notre mission.

Aujourd'hui, plus de 150 personnes travaillent depuis nos bureaux et à distance pour libérer le potentiel des données de santé. Nous avons connecté 800 hôpitaux et 150 000 professionnels de santé, et nous ne faisons que commencer. Nous recherchons des personnes qui embrassent la complexité, veulent résoudre des problèmes difficiles et sont prêtes à construire le futur de la collaboration en santé.

⚡ Notre équipe Sales Public

L’équipe Sales Public accompagne les établissements de santé dans l’adoption des solutions Lifen, principalement autour de la gestion des documents de santé. Elle compte aujourd’hui 8 Sales Account Executive qui travaillent sur l’ensemble du territoire.

Les Sales concentrent aujourd’hui leur temps sur les plus grands établissements et groupements hospitaliers. À côté, il existe un vivier d’environ 800 structures de santé de plus petite taille.

Nous créons donc notre premier poste de SDR Public. Ton rôle sera de construire ce périmètre : mieux connaître ces structures, trouver les personnes à contacter, qualifier les opportunités et transmettre aux Sales des rendez-vous réellement exploitables. Tu travailleras principalement sur nos offres Lifen Documents et Curecall by Lifen.

🎯 Ce que tu feras chez nous

  • Prioriser un portefeuille d’environ 800 petites structures de santé déjà cartographiée.

  • Entrer en contact avec les prospects, comprendre leur contexte et qualifier les opportunités avant de proposer un échange avec un ou une Sales Account Executive.

  • Générer des rendez-vous qualifiés pour l’équipe Sales, en transmettant les informations utiles pour permettre une prise de relais efficace.

  • Mettre à jour le CRM avec rigueur : contacts, informations sur les structures, niveau de maturité des opportunités et prochaines étapes.

  • Faire progresser les méthodes de prospection sur ce nouveau périmètre : messages, séquences, critères de qualification et priorisation des comptes.

⭐️ Ce que nous recherchons

Must-have

  • Une première expérience de cold call intensive (Stage, Alternance ou CDI), idéalement d’un à deux ans en startup, en SDR, Inside Sales, prospection B2B ou relation client.

  • Une vraie appétence pour la prospection : prendre contact, obtenir les bonnes informations, relancer et transformer une approche en rendez-vous qualifié.

  • La capacité à organiser un volume important de comptes, à prioriser et à tenir un suivi précis dans un CRM.

  • Une communication orale et écrite claire, adaptée à des interlocuteurs de direction de structures de santé.

Nice-to-have

  • Une expérience dans la santé ou auprès de professionnels et d’établissements de santé.

  • La pratique d’outils de CRM et de prospection.

Soft skills

Tu es énergique et tu aimes avancer sur un périmètre à construire. Tu communiques simplement, tu écoutes avant de proposer un rendez-vous et tu acceptes les retours pour ajuster ta manière de faire. L’humilité compte : tu travailleras avec une équipe Sales expérimentée et tu sauras apprendre à ses côtés tout en apportant tes propres observations du terrain.

Nos valeurs

Embrace Complexity. Tu avances dans un secteur de santé complexe et sur un portefeuille encore peu structuré, en transformant progressivement des informations éparses en opportunités qualifiées.

Bienveillance. Tu collabores étroitement avec les Sales, dans une équipe où l’entraide et le partage d’informations font partie du quotidien.

Real Impact. Chaque rendez-vous qualifié peut contribuer à équiper davantage de structures de santé avec des outils qui simplifient la circulation des documents.

👥 Process de recrutement

Le process est volontairement court et se déroulera principalement en visio.

  1. TAM Screening avec l’équipe recrutement - Environ 30 minutes. L’objectif est de comprendre ton parcours, ta motivation pour le poste et d’évaluer les fondamentaux attendus : communication, énergie, organisation et posture commerciale.

  2. Case study avec l’équipe Sales - Un entretien en visio d’1h comprenant la restitution de deux exercices préparés à l’avance et la réalisation de deux exercices en direct. Le cas sera envoyé environ deux jours avant l’échange et demandera environ 1h de préparation. Il permettra d’évaluer ta capacité à prioriser, à structurer une approche de prospection et à communiquer avec clarté.

  3. Final Interview - Un entretien avec un Manager de l’équipe Sales pour valider l’alignement culturel.

Nous nous engageons à te donner de la visibilité tout au long du process et à revenir vers toi sous 72h après chaque étape. Des prises de références pourront être demandées en fin de process, avec ton accord.

Soigner mieux en soignant ensemble, c'est aussi agir avec bienveillance. À l'image du secteur dans lequel nous évoluons, nous favorisons la diversité, l'inclusion et l'équité. Nous mettons en valeur vos compétences et votre savoir-faire, et bannissons toute forme de discrimination, qu'elle soit sexuelle, religieuse ou politique.

1aec208c5be060a1.title: Chef.fe de Projet numérique en santé / Project Manager Healthtech
1aec208c5be060a1.description:
Chez Lifen, nous pensons que les données médicales ont le potentiel de transformer le système de santé. Mais seulement si elles sont accessibles. Plus de données accessibles → moins de charge administrative, une meilleure coordination des soins et des découvertes scientifiques plus rapides.

Depuis 2015, notre mission est de libérer ce potentiel. Nos solutions basées sur l'IA permettent aux professionnels de santé de partager les informations médicales sans effort et aux chercheurs d'accélérer les découvertes cliniques : avec un impact sur des millions de patients en France chaque jour. Alors que nous nous préparons à nous développer en Europe, 2 choses déterminent notre succès : nos équipes et notre mission.

Aujourd'hui, plus de 150 personnes travaillent depuis nos bureaux et à distance pour libérer le potentiel des données de santé. Nous avons connecté 800 hôpitaux et 150 000 professionnels de santé, et nous ne faisons que commencer. Nous recherchons des personnes qui embrassent la complexité, veulent résoudre des problèmes difficiles et sont prêtes à construire le futur de la collaboration en santé.

⚡ Notre équipe Customer Operations

L’équipe Customer Operations accompagne les établissements de santé dans le déploiement et l’usage des solutions Lifen. Son travail conditionne une adoption durable : comprendre l’organisation de chaque client, coordonner les parties prenantes et faire avancer les projets jusqu’à leur mise en service.

En tant que Project Manager, tu piloteras des déploiements de nos solutions auprès de grands comptes, notamment des groupements hospitaliers de territoire (GHT). Tu seras le point de repère côté Lifen pour structurer le projet, donner de la visibilité aux clients et lever les obstacles avec les équipes internes.

🎯 Ce que tu feras chez nous

  • Cartographier les établissements, les services concernés et leurs besoins pour cadrer chaque déploiement.

  • Construire le planning projet, poser les jalons et suivre leur avancement.

  • Animer les réunions de suivi et formaliser les décisions.

  • Coordonner Business Development, Ops Manager et R&D.

  • Suivre les usages après le déploiement et identifier les difficultés rencontrées sur le terrain.

  • Centraliser les bugs et demandes d’évolution, puis communiquer sur les corrections et nouveautés.

  • Tenir la documentation projet à jour et contribuer à faire évoluer les méthodes et processus de l’équipe.

⭐️ Ce que nous recherchons

Must-have

  • Une solide expérience dans la gestion de projets, idéalement dans le déploiement de logiciels ou de solutions numériques.

  • Une bonne connaissance fonctionnelle et technique du secteur de la santé et de l’organisation d’un établissement de santé.

  • Des bases en interopérabilité et en flux de données.

  • La capacité à cadrer en autonomie des projets simples, suivre un calendrier, identifier les blocages et solliciter son manager lorsque nécessaire.

  • Une communication écrite et orale claire auprès de clients comme d’équipes internes.

Nice-to-have

  • Une expérience auprès de grands comptes hospitaliers ou de groupements d’établissements de santé.

  • Une connaissance des enjeux techniques liés à l’architecture d’une plateforme logicielle et aux intégrations entre systèmes.

  • L’habitude de former des utilisateurs sur des outils ou processus fonctionnels.

  • Une bonne maîtrise de Notion, des outils Google ou Office et d’outils de suivi de projet.

Soft skills

Tu sais organiser ton travail sans attendre qu’on te donne chaque prochaine étape, tout en signalant rapidement les risques ou les dépendances. Tu aimes comprendre le fonctionnement concret d’un client avant de proposer une solution. Face à des interlocuteurs aux priorités différentes, tu gardes le cap, tu reformules et tu fais avancer les décisions.

Nos valeurs

Embrace Complexity : tu prends le temps de comprendre les contraintes d’un établissement, les dépendances techniques et les besoins des utilisateurs.

Bienveillance : tu communiques avec clarté, écoutes les difficultés et cherches des solutions avec les parties prenantes.

Real Impact : tu veilles à ce que les solutions déployées soient réellement utilisées et facilitent le travail des professionnels de santé.

👥 Process de recrutement

  1. Échange avec Laura, Talent Acquisition - 30 min. Un premier échange pour comprendre ton parcours, tes attentes et ta motivation pour le poste.

  2. Entretien avec Loïc, Hiring Manager - 45 min. Une première rencontre avec ton potentiel futur manager qui approfondira ton expérience de gestion de projet et de déploiement, ta compréhension des environnements de santé et ta connaissance fonctionnelle des produits déployés.

  3. Étude de cas avec Loïc et un membre de l’équipe Customer Ops - 60 à 90 min. Quelques jours avant l’échange, nous t’enverrons une étude de cas à préparer. Lors de la restitution, tu présenteras ton raisonnement et la façon dont tu cadres un déploiement sur le plan fonctionnel. L’objectif est d’évaluer ta capacité à structurer un plan de déploiement, prioriser les actions et les risques, coordonner les parties prenantes et communiquer avec le client.

  4. Entretien Cultural Alignement avec Raphaël, VP ops - 30 min. Cet échange permet de discuter de ta façon de travailler, de ta collaboration avec les autres équipes et de revenir sur d’éventuels sujets à approfondir après les premières étapes.

    Nous nous engageons à te faire un retour dans les 72 heures suivant chaque étape.

Compensation: €44K – €49K

2bf9cbec3012c88b.description:
Chez Lifen, nous pensons que les données médicales ont le potentiel de transformer le système de santé. Mais seulement si elles sont accessibles. Plus de données accessibles → moins de charge administrative, une meilleure coordination des soins et des découvertes scientifiques plus rapides.

Depuis 2015, notre mission est de libérer ce potentiel. Nos solutions basées sur l'IA permettent aux professionnels de santé de partager les informations médicales sans effort et aux chercheurs d'accélérer les découvertes cliniques : avec un impact sur des millions de patients en France chaque jour. Alors que nous nous préparons à nous développer en Europe, 2 choses déterminent notre succès : nos équipes et notre mission.

Aujourd'hui, plus de 150 personnes travaillent depuis nos bureaux et à distance pour libérer le potentiel des données de santé. Nous avons connecté 800 hôpitaux et 150 000 professionnels de santé, et nous ne faisons que commencer. Nous recherchons des personnes qui embrassent la complexité, veulent résoudre des problèmes difficiles et sont prêtes à construire le futur de la collaboration en santé.

⚡ Notre équipe Marketing

Chez Lifen, nous travaillons à mieux faire circuler les données de santé pour faciliter le travail des professionnels et améliorer la coordination des soins. Cela passe aussi par notre capacité à faire connaître nos solutions aux bons interlocuteurs.

Ce stage rejoint l’équipe Marketing pour renforcer ses actions de visibilité, d’acquisition et de génération de demandes pour les équipes commerciales. Le poste couvre aussi une dimension événementielle : webinaires, salons et autres rendez-vous qui permettent de rencontrer nos audiences et de faire avancer les projets marketing.

Tu interviendras sur des sujets variés, avec un périmètre à construire avec ta manager. L’objectif : faire avancer des actions concrètes, mesurer leurs résultats et proposer les prochaines étapes.

🎯 Ce que tu feras chez nous

  • Faire évoluer le site pour améliorer sa visibilité, son trafic et la conversion des visiteurs en demandes de rendez-vous.

  • Identifier des opportunités marketing : requêtes sur lesquelles Lifen pourrait mieux se positionner, parcours à optimiser, contenus, campagnes ou partenariats à tester.

  • Mettre en place et suivre des actions d’acquisition et de génération de leads : séquences email, campagnes, retargeting, partenariats ou activation de la base existante, selon les priorités.

  • Appuyer l’organisation de webinaires, salons et autres événements : recherche de lieux, coordination opérationnelle, préparation des éléments nécessaires et suivi des actions associées.

  • Analyser le comportement des visiteurs et les résultats des actions menées pour comprendre ce qui fonctionne, ce qui bloque et quoi tester ensuite.

  • Transformer tes analyses en recommandations concrètes, puis les faire avancer avec l’équipe Marketing et les équipes commerciales.

À la fin du stage, tu auras contribué à construire un pipe marketing pour une équipe commerciale, à générer du trafic, à optimiser la conversion et à organiser des actions événementielles.

⭐️ Ce que nous recherchons

Must-have

  • Tu recherches un stage de fin d’études de 6 mois dans le cadre d’un M2.

  • Tu as déjà acquis des bases en marketing, idéalement sur des sujets d’acquisition, de CRM, d’email marketing ou d’événementiel.

  • Une première expérience, un projet personnel ou un travail mené dans le cadre de tes études montre que tu as déjà travaillé sur des sujets marketing.

  • Face à un problème, tu sais chercher, comprendre le contexte, formuler une approche et aller jusqu’à une proposition concrète.

  • Tu as envie de travailler sur des sujets variés, avec de l’autonomie et de la prise d’initiative.

Nice-to-have

  • Des connaissances en référencement, web performance ou acquisition payante.

  • Une première pratique du scraping.

  • Une expérience, même ponctuelle, dans l’organisation de webinaires, de salons ou d’autres événements.

  • L’habitude d’utiliser l’intelligence artificielle pour avancer dans ton travail, tout en restant capable d’expliquer et de challenger ce que tu produis.

Soft skills

Tu es curieux·se, organisé·e et tu apprends vite. Tu ne te contentes pas d’exécuter une demande telle quelle : tu cherches à comprendre le problème, tu vas chercher les informations qui te manquent et tu proposes des pistes utiles. Tu sais tenir un sujet opérationnel dans la durée, coordonner les interlocuteurs concernés et demander de l’aide quand c’est nécessaire. Le diplôme ou l’école ne feront pas la différence : ce qui compte, c’est ce que tu as déjà appris, ce que tu veux comprendre et le soin que tu mets dans ton travail.

Nos valeurs

  • Embrace Complexity : tu sais découper un sujet large, tester des pistes et relier les résultats aux enjeux marketing et commerciaux.

  • Bienveillance : tu échanges simplement avec tes interlocuteurs, tu écoutes les retours et tu construis avec eux.

  • Real Impact : tes actions doivent aider à accroître la visibilité de Lifen, générer du trafic qualifié et créer des occasions de rencontre avec nos audiences.

👥 Process de recrutement

Le process est volontairement court :

  1. Entretien initial - 30 minutes
    Avec Pauline, ta future manager. L’objectif est de comprendre ton parcours, ton intérêt pour le stage, tes premières expériences ou projets marketing, ainsi que ta manière d’aborder un problème.

  2. Use case préparé en amont, puis présentation live - 60 min
    Tu recevras un cas à préparer avant l’échange. Tu présenteras ensuite ton raisonnement, les informations que tu es allé·e chercher et les actions que tu proposes. Nous évaluerons surtout ta curiosité, ton autonomie, ta compréhension des enjeux marketing et ta capacité à faire des choix.

Nous partageons un retour sous 48 heures ouvrées après chaque étape et prenons la décision finale sous deux jours ouvrés après le dernier entretien.
