Descriptif du poste

 

→ Votre mission


En tant que Senior Software & Data Engineer, votre rôle sera de concevoir, développer et industrialiser des solutions technologiques et data de pointe, au service de produits IA à fort impact.
Vous interviendrez à la fois sur :

  • le développement de solutions software sur mesure ou produit

  • la conception et l’industrialisation d’architectures data scalables

  • la mise en place de systèmes IA et MLOps en environnement cloud ou on-premise

Ces solutions s’inscrivent dans des projets clients exigeants, ainsi que dans le développement de nos produits et de notre stack interne.

→ Vos responsabilités

  • Concevoir et développer des applications, APIs et architectures data robustes et scalables

  • Industrialiser des pipelines de données (ingestion, transformation, streaming, batch) sur des volumes importants

  • Participer à la conception de solutions IA / GenAI intégrées dans des produits clients

  • Contribuer à la mise en place et à l’évolution de notre stack MLOps / Data Engineering

  • Participer aux code reviews, challenger les implémentations et partager les bonnes pratiques

  • Prendre part aux cérémonies agiles et sprint reviews en interaction directe avec les clients et équipes produit

f5fd62e40141e65f.title: Business Development Intern (Mandarin Speaker)
f5fd62e40141e65f.description:
Hi, we’re Back Market.

We’re here to help make tech reliable, affordable, and better than new. We're a global marketplace for refurbished devices, helping lower our collective environmental impact by providing trustworthy, affordable tech with 92% less carbon emissions than new.

Yep, you read that right. Turns out refurbished tech is way better for the planet than new. In fact, With every device purchased on Back Market, our positive impact on the planet grows. From our Customer Care representatives to our software engineer, every individual at Back Market cuts the planet — and consumers — a break. Our mission is simple: to do more with what we already have.

Are you ready to join us?

JOB DESCRIPTION:

The Global Sellers Team mission at Back Market is to enable a stable supply of high quality refurbished products to our 17 markets. The team is fast-growing, we onboard and nurture great sellers to unlock the right products that our customers want.

As a Business Development Intern, your main priorities center on qualifying and completing the onboarding journey with Asian sellers. After activation, you will grow sellers’ business including working with sellers to maximize product selection and acting as a trustworthy bridge between internal stakeholder teams and sellers to deliver the best e-commerce experience for customers on Back Market.

You will be able to contribute to overall business by leading BD enablement projects that unleash the potential of sellers to scale up.

YOUR MISSION (IF YOU ACCEPT IT): 🥇

  • Qualify and onboard new sellers to contribute to Back Market’s selection growth

  • Manage newly activated sellers through a hybrid approach of dedicated 1:1 account management and pooled coverage, focusing on Sellers GMV & Quality performance to ensure a profitable and healthy growth for both seller and Back Market

  • Partner with internal functional teams (quality, logistics, finance, legal etc) to support new sellers

  • Constantly explore top sellers on competitors' platforms with global supply origin, including Hong Kong/China/Asia, etc.

  • Support on BD seller communication, including 1) be part of the taskforce to lead on seller recruitment or education webinars; 2) developing Chinese/English content library of BD enablement materials

YOU ARE IN THE RIGHT PLACE IF: ⭐

  • You are looking for a 6-months internship

  • English and Mandarin are no-brainers (fully professional capability in English and Mandarin). If you’re extra cool and speak more languages, bonus points for you!

  • Excellent in time management with great sense of priority and ownership

  • Detail-oriented and active listener

  • Good organization & communication skills

  • You have an analytical and critical thinking mind - strong use of insights for decision making

  • Abilities to work independently with highly self-motivation. Positive learning attitude is must-have

  • Interested in engaging with small to medium-sized businesses and e-commerce, you ideally have a previous experience in a related field

  • Experience in content creation and live broadcasting is a plus

  • Interested in fast-growing start-ups preferred

  • Salesforce, SQL, and/or Tableau experience is a plus, but readiness to learn a must

ABOUT THE INTERNSHIP ℹ️

  • Starting date: January 2027

  • Duration: 6 months

  • Location: Paris, France

  • Contract: Internship agreement provided by your French school is required

RECRUITMENT PROCESS: 📅

  • Skills fit interview with the direct manager

  • Home assignment

  • Cultural fit interview with another person in the team

  • Video-call Interview with the Talent Acquisition Specialist

WHY SHOULD YOU JOIN US ? ✌🏼

At Back Market, we’re committed to hiring and supporting diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives — it’s one of the reasons we’re such a high-scoring certified B Corp company (93.2).

No matter your role and seniority level, you’ll enjoy impact-driven work with hands-on career development in an innovative, driven, and fast-paced environment — with benefits to match, like:

- A mission driven work environment where your day to day makes an impact on the planet. Seriously.

- Hybrid work environment, with 2 remote days a week and 1 remote work week per quarter, plus 3 flex days.

- Employee Resource Groups, including mentorship programs, comprehensive accessibility policies, and cultural competency training.

At Back Market, we strive to create a workplace that embodies the world we’re trying to change. We’ve embedded our diversity, equity, and inclusion principles into our DNA — from dedicated staff to employee resource groups to our company values.

We know that the perfect background for a role doesn’t mean the perfect fit — we encourage you to apply for a role even if you think you may not have all the qualifications.

If reasonable accommodations are needed for the interview process, please do not hesitate to discuss this with the Talent Acquisition Team.

dec141998de2b343.title: Strategic Account Manager – Enterprise Hospitality (Nice)
dec141998de2b343.description:
Lightspeed is looking for an experienced, strategically minded Strategic Account Manager to develop, engage, and closely support our most important enterprise customers in the hospitality segment over the long term. This role is remote-based in Nice, France, with occasional travel to our Paris office.

In this role, you will act as the primary point of contact for our largest hospitality customers in France. You will be responsible for driving growth, product adoption, and stakeholder management within your portfolio, with the goal of building true business partnerships. You will leverage data, customer feedback, and your SaaS expertise to create value at the enterprise level, while collaborating closely with teams across the business.



What you’ll do

  • Act as the main point of contact for our largest and most strategic hospitality customers

  • Develop and execute strategic account plans to drive growth, retention, and product adoption

  • Proactively work on increasing product usage and ensure Net Revenue Retention (NRR) grows across your portfolio

  • Plan and lead quarterly business reviews and success plans

  • Analyze usage data, go-live milestones, and health scores to identify and mitigate risks early

  • Build strong, trusted relationships with C-level and operational stakeholders, positioning Lightspeed as a long-term strategic partner

  • Collaborate cross-functionally with Product, Customer Success, Implementation, and Support teams to deliver an excellent customer experience

  • Collect customer feedback and proactively share it with relevant teams to identify product gaps and optimize the overall customer journey


What you bring

  • 3–5+ years of experience in Account Management or Strategic Customer Success within a B2B SaaS environment, ideally with enterprise customers

  • A strong understanding of SaaS metrics (NRR, product adoption, expansion, renewals, churn) and the ability to use them to manage your portfolio

  • A strong sense of ownership; you are hands-on, data-driven, and highly skilled in relationship management

  • Experience managing complex, multi-level stakeholder structures and confidently engaging with C-level, operations, and technical teams

  • Fluent business-level French and English

  • Experience in the hospitality, POS, or hospitality tech industry is a plus, but not required


What’s in it for you?

Come live the Lightspeed experience…

  • Genuine career opportunities in a company that’s creating new jobs every day

  • Work in a team large enough for growth but lean enough to make a real impact

  • Exposure to modern and proven technology

  • Ability to work and grow in a truly flexible environment

  • Opportunity to learn, expand your skill set, forge wonderful relationships and make your mark within the diverse and inclusive Lightspeed culture, a true Canadian tech success story

… and enjoy a range of benefits that’ll keep you happy, healthy and (not) hungry:

  • Lightspeed equity scheme (we are all owners)

  • Health & Wellness Credit- expense up to 400 EUR per year towards your gym membership, yoga classes, a new bike or whatever else you do for your health

  • Mental Health Support through the Modern Health App- whether it is meditation, coaching or counseling you need - each employee gets access to this platform

  • People Experience - Our PX benefit allows you to work from pretty much anywhere in the world for 60 days a year 

  • Time off to volunteer and give back to your community

  • Health insurance with attractive guarantee plans

 

We know that people are more than what’s on their CV. If you’re unsure that you have the right profile for the role... hit the ‘Apply’ button and give it a try!

To all recruitment agencies: Lightspeed does not accept unsolicited agency resumes. If we have not directly engaged your company in writing to supply candidates for a specific vacancy, Lightspeed will not be responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.

Lightspeed is a proud equal opportunity employer and we are committed to creating an inclusive and barrier-free workplace. Lightspeed welcomes and encourages applications from people with disabilities. Accommodations are available on request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the selection process.

Where to from here?

Obviously, this has to be mutually beneficial: we want you to step into a role you love, and we want to offer you a place you’re proud to come to every day. For a glimpse into our world check out our career page here.

Lightspeed is building communities through commerce, and we need people from all backgrounds and lived experiences to do that. We were founded in 2005, in Montreal’s gay village and our original members were all part of the LGBTQ+ community. The ethos of our business has been about inclusion from the very beginning, and we strive to provide a workplace where everyone belongs.

Who we are:

Powering the businesses that are the backbone of the global economy, Lightspeed's one-stop commerce platform helps merchants innovate to simplify, scale, and provide exceptional customer experiences. Our cloud commerce solution transforms and unifies online and physical operations, multichannel sales, expansion to new locations, global payments, financial solutions, and connection to supplier networks.

Founded in Montréal, Canada in 2005, Lightspeed is dual-listed on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE: LSPD) and Toronto Stock Exchange (TSX: LSPD). With teams across North America, Europe, and Asia Pacific, the company serves retail, hospitality, and golf businesses in over 100 countries.

Lightspeed handles your information in accordance with our Applicant Privacy Statement.

Powering the businesses that are the backbone of the global economy, Lightspeed's one-stop commerce platform helps merchants innovate to simplify, scale, and provide exceptional customer experiences. 9577484b034ffb88.title: Account Executive, France
9577484b034ffb88.description:
NetBox Labs is seeking a Senior Account Executive (AE) to play a pivotal role in the growth and expansion of our business. You will be tasked with proactive outbound prospecting and managing inbound leads. Given the technical nature of our product, a high technical aptitude is crucial to understand and articulate the value proposition effectively to potential clients. You will be responsible for the entire sales cycle, including the initial prospecting, qualification, technical discussions, pricing and contract negotiation, deal closure, and expansion. This role demands a combination of technical understanding, sales acumen, and relationship-building skills to drive significant impact and contribute to the company's success.

 

In this role, you will:

 

  • Proactively build, qualify, and close a new logo sales pipeline, ensuring you meet or exceed quota and drive steady bookings growth.

  • Be responsible for outbound motions to create pipeline.

  • Strategically prospect into Network Engineering management & technical end users, understanding their unique challenges and requirements.

  • Build strong and effective relationships with prospects using a consultative sales approach, leading to increased trust and deal velocity.

  • Work on both the acquisition of net new customers and the revenue expansion of existing customer accounts.

  • Work with the Channel team to develop indirect opportunities.

  • Work with the Customer Success team for expansion into existing accounts.

  • Build and manage accurate forecast and opportunity progress reporting.

  • Partner with our Solutions Engineers to ensure technical alignment and convey NetBox Labs’ value proposition and key differentiators.

  • Continually seek to improve your selling skills and iterate/improve on the sales process.

  • Develop an understanding of the partner ecosystem and competitive solutions.

 
 

Requirements:

 

  • 5+ years of SaaS/Networking Equipment field experience with quota-carrying roles in fast-paced markets, focused on closing net new logos and demonstrating the ability to run complex sales processes. Experience working with open source technology is a plus.

  • 1+ years of experience working in a collaborative startup environment.

  • An entrepreneurial and self-starter mentality with the ability to roll up your sleeves and get involved with many aspects of selling to “get it done”

  • A history of overachievement and consistently hitting or exceeding sales targets.

  • Proficiency in managing both inbound leads and outbound prospecting to build a robust pipeline.

  • Drive and competitiveness, underlined by a strong desire to win.

  • Technical aptitude and exceptional ability to articulate the business value of complex, technical enterprise products built on open source technology. Previous experience as a sales engineer or network engineer is a plus.

  • Specialized knowledge in Networking, Network Engineering, Network Automation would be a significant advantage.

About NetBox Labs:

NetBox Labs helps companies build and manage complex networks. We help customers accelerate network automation by delivering open, composable products and supporting the network automation community.

NetBox Labs is the commercial steward of open source NetBox, the world’s most popular network source of truth, and Orb, the next-generation open source network observability platform. Our products include NetBox Enterprise, a fully supported self-managed NetBox with advanced features, and NetBox Cloud, a secure, scalable, and reliable SaaS edition of NetBox.

NetBox powers thousands of companies, and NetBox Labs is backed by investment from Notable Capital (formerly GGV), Grafana Labs CEO Raj Dutt, Flybridge, IBM, Salesforce Ventures, and Mango Capital.

Our culture and values:

  • We own and solve problems with high attention to detail.

  • Our open source contributors, users, customers & team are all part of our community. When our community wins, we win.

  • We prioritize simplicity and think twice before adding complexity

  • Clear communication helps keep our team aligned and collaborating smoothly.

NetBox Labs is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We believe diverse teams build better software, and we welcome applicants of every race, color, religion, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, and veteran status. If you need accommodation at any point in the process, just let us know.

 

Compensation: €70K – €85K • Offers Equity • €70K – €85K Bonus

e096194366f67c12.title: Responsable comptable adjoint(e)
e096194366f67c12.description:
Vous aimez la comptabilité dans toute sa dimension opérationnelle ? Vous appréciez autant la technicité des travaux de clôture que l'analyse des résultats et la fiabilisation des données financières ?

Nous recherchons notre futur(e) Responsable Comptable Adjoint(e) pour rejoindre notre équipe et accompagner le suivi comptable et financier de notre entreprise et de ses filiales françaises.

Rattaché(e) à la Responsable Administrative et financière, vous occupez un rôle polyvalent et central, associant production comptable, révision des comptes, reporting financier et suivi fiscal. Vous intervenez concrètement dans les opérations du quotidien tout en contribuant aux travaux financiers et aux remontées d'informations destinées au Groupe.

Vos missions

  1. Assurer la gestion comptable au quotidien

  • Réaliser les opérations courantes de comptabilité générale et fournisseurs.

  • Assurer ponctuellement la saisie et l'enregistrement des factures fournisseurs.

  • Effectuer le rapprochement des factures avec les commandes et les réceptions.

  • Contrôler les imputations comptables et analytiques.

  • Participer au suivi et à la justification des comptes.

2. Participer aux clôtures et à la révision des comptes

  • Préparer et contribuer aux clôtures comptables mensuelles et annuelles.

  • Participer à l'élaboration du bilan et du compte de résultat.

  • Réaliser les travaux de révision : justification des comptes, contrôle des écritures, rapprochements et régularisations.

  • Veiller à la fiabilité et à la cohérence des données comptables.

3. Contribuer au reporting et à la consolidation

  • Participer aux travaux de consolidation des comptes du Groupe.

  • Collecter, contrôler et fiabiliser les données financières des différentes entités.

  • Élaborer les reportings périodiques et les tableaux de bord destinés au Responsable Administratif.

  • Participer à l'analyse des résultats et à la préparation des données financières présentées au Groupe.

4. Apporter votre soutien au contrôle de gestion

  • Participer à la préparation et à l'analyse des résultats.

  • Contribuer au suivi des données analytiques et à l'analyse des écarts entre le réalisé et les prévisions.

  • Participer à la fiabilisation des indicateurs de performance.

5. Participer au suivi de la trésorerie et de la fiscalité

  • Contribuer au suivi des flux et des positions de trésorerie des filiales françaises.

  • Participer à l'élaboration des prévisions de trésorerie.

  • Préparer, établir et contrôler les déclarations de TVA et autres déclarations fiscales.

  • Veiller au respect des échéances et des obligations déclaratives.


Vous êtes issu(e) d'une formation supérieure en comptabilité, gestion ou finance, de type DCG, Licence professionnelle ou équivalent (Bac +3 minimum).

Vous justifiez idéalement de plus de 5 années d'expérience minimum en comptabilité générale, acquises de préférence dans un environnement multi-sociétés ou au sein d'une PME structurée.

Vous maîtrisez les mécanismes comptables, les opérations de clôture et de révision ainsi que les obligations fiscales courantes, notamment en matière de TVA.

Une connaissance des processus de consolidation, du reporting financier et du suivi de trésorerie sera particulièrement appréciée.

Vous êtes à l'aise avec les outils informatiques, notamment Excel, et savez exploiter des données comptables pour en tirer des analyses fiables.

Au-delà de votre parcours, nous recherchons une personne :

  • Rigoureuse et organisée, attachée à la fiabilité de son travail.

  • Autonome et impliquée, capable de prendre en charge ses missions de bout en bout.

  • Polyvalente, appréciant autant les opérations comptables concrètes que les travaux d'analyse.

  • Dotée d'un bon esprit d'analyse et de synthèse.

  • À l'aise dans les échanges avec différents interlocuteurs et appréciant le travail en équipe.

3d394606463bfc19.title: Content manager (Stage 3 ou 6 mois)
3d394606463bfc19.description:
QUI SOMMES-NOUS ?

Premier groupe public de grandes écoles d’ingénieurs et de management en France, l’Institut Mines-Télécom (IMT) est un acteur majeur de l’enseignement supérieur, de la recherche et de l’innovation au service du développement économique, industriel et technologique de la France.

Héritier de plus de deux siècles d’histoire scientifique, technologique et industrielle, il fédère huit grandes écoles publiques — IMT Atlantique, IMT Mines Albi, IMT Mines Alès, IMT Nord Europe, Institut Mines-Télécom Business School, Mines Saint-Étienne, Télécom Paris et Télécom SudParis — et deux écoles filiales, EURECOM et InSIC.

Avec près de 5 000 personnels, 150 laboratoires, 500 partenaires académiques dans 70 pays et des milliers d’entreprises partenaires, l’IMT forme près de 15 000 élèves-ingénieurs, managers et docteurs et développe une recherche de pointe qui irrigue ses formations et nourrit l’innovation. Ancré au cœur des territoires, l’IMT fait de chaque école une porte d’entrée régionale vers son offre de formation, sa puissance scientifique et ses plateformes technologiques.

L’IMT articule formation, recherche et transfert d’innovation autour de quatre thématiques stratégiques — Industrie du futur responsable, Souveraineté et sobriété numérique, Énergie économie circulaire et société, Ingénierie de la santé et du bien-être — afin d’accompagner les transformations des entreprises et des filières et de contribuer aux grandes transitions, à la reconquête industrielle et à la souveraineté technologique de la France et de l’Europe.

Pour en savoir plus :

  • Vidéo de présentation de l’IMT :

  • Site carrière de l’IMT : https://institutminestelecom.recruitee.com/

  • Site web de l’IMT : https://www.imt.fr/

QUELLES MISSIONS VOUS ATTENDENT AU SEIN DE L’IMT ? :

L’Institut Mines-Télécom est le premier groupe d’écoles d’ingénieurs et de management en France : 8 grandes écoles, 13 600 élèves dont 30 % d’internationaux, 4 450 personnels.

Le ou la content manager sera intégré(e) à l’équipe de la direction de la communication de l’IMT composée de 7 personnes, au pôle communication numérique.

En rejoignant l’IMT en tant que content manager en apprentissage, vous participerez à la création et à la diffusion de contenus valorisant nos formations, nos projets de recherche et nos expertises scientifiques. Vous interviendrez sur une grande diversité de formats : contenus éditoriaux, visuels et graphiques, sites web, réseaux sociaux, newsletters, infographies, vidéos…  

Sous l’autorité de la directrice adjointe de la communication et du marketing, vous participez à l’élaboration et au déploiement de la stratégie de contenus de l’Institut Mines-Télécom. À ce titre, vous contribuez à la conception du programme éditorial et du planning de production et de publication, pilotez la diffusion des contenus sur les différents canaux digitaux (sites web internes et externes, réseaux sociaux, newsletters) et assurez le suivi et l’analyse des indicateurs de performance.

 

Plus spécifiquement, vous serez amené(e) à :

  • Rédiger et décliner des contenus éditoriaux multilingues sur l’ensemble des canaux de communication de l’IMT : réseaux sociaux, sites web, newsletters internes et externes, supports print.

  • Optimiser les contenus en intégrant les enjeux de SEO, d’accessibilité numérique et d’éco-conception.

  • Concevoir des contenus graphiques à l’aide d’outils de design (Canva, suite Adobe).

  • Gérer le planning de diffusion et contribuer à la définition et à l’évolution de la ligne éditoriale.

  • Produire et assurer la post-production de contenus vidéo (interviews, aftermovies, formats courts).

  • Assurer le suivi régulier des KPI social media et produire les reportings associés.

  • Réaliser une veille sur les concepts, formats et tendances en matière de création de contenus.

  • Valoriser des contenus de vulgarisation et de médiation scientifique issus du média I’MTech.

  • Assurer la couverture de temps forts et d’événements institutionnels (salons tels que VivaTech ou Global Industrie, week-ends Ambassadrices IMT, délégations, inaugurations, cérémonies de remise de prix, etc.).

  • Contribuer à la communication interne : conception d’emailings, gestion de l’intranet, production et diffusion de kits de communication au sein du groupe IMT, appui et conseil auprès des collaborateurs et collaboratrices.

> Retrouvez la description complète de l’offre ici


QUI RECHERCHONS-NOUS ? :

Vous suivez actuellement un master en communication, marketing ou équivalent.

Ce poste s’adresse à un profil curieux, créatif et polyvalent, à l’aise aussi bien avec l’écriture qu’avec la création graphique et les outils digitaux, et intéressé par les thématiques liées aux sciences, à l’innovation et à l’enseignement supérieur et de la recherche.

Compétences attendues :

  • Très bon niveau rédactionnel en français ; avec une bonne aisance en anglais

  • Bonne culture web et compréhension des usages des réseaux sociaux et des formats associés

  • Intérêt pour la vulgarisation de sujets scientifiques, techniques ou institutionnels

  • Appétence pour la création de contenus visuels et graphiques

  • Intérêt pour les formats vidéo (tournage léger, montage simple, sous-titrage).

  • Organisation et travail en équipe et gestion de projet(s)

  • Rigueur dans le suivi des consignes, des délais et des validations.

  • Curiosité, créativité et réactivité

  • Bon relationnel

INFORMATIONS ET MODALITÉS PRATIQUES :

  • Stage conventionné e 3 ou 6 mois (ou plus) dans le cadre d’un master en communication, marketing ou équivalent.

  • Début souhaité : dès que possible

  • Localisation du poste : Institut Mines-Télécom, 19 Place Marguerite Perey - 91120 PALAISEAU

  • Les postes offerts au recrutement sont ouverts à toutes et tous avec, sur demande, des aménagements pour les candidats en situation de handicap

    Si vous êtes intéressé(e) et que vous partagez nos valeurs, n’attendez plus pour nous rejoindre et postulez avant le 11/12/2026.

    ! Pour toute question contactez : Anna DA COSTA, Directrice adjointe de la communication et du marketing :

168ff15b117cf9d0.title: Ingénieur(e) Développement (Projet Phygital) - CDD 12 mois
168ff15b117cf9d0.description:
Rejoindre Mines Saint-Étienne, c’est s’engager dans une institution où la science et l’innovation bâtissent un avenir plus durable. Une école d’excellence où chacun a l’opportunité de révéler son plein potentiel et de contribuer à relever les défis de demain.

Classée parmi les meilleures écoles d’ingénieurs en France et reconnue mondialement, notre école, membre de l’Institut Mines-Télécom, forme les talents de demain tout en contribuant activement à relever les grands défis industriels, numériques et environnementaux. Avec nous, vous intégrez une communauté de 500 collaborateurs, 2500 étudiants, et participez à un projet ambitieux : conjuguer excellence académique, recherche d’avant-garde et impact sociétal positif.

L’Institut Mines-Télécom fédère les grandes écoles françaises autour des défis industriels majeurs, numériques, énergétiques et écologiques. Avec ses 8 Grandes Écoles publiques et 2 écoles filiales, il est le premier institut public dédié aux ingénieurs et managers. Ensemble, nous imaginons et construisons un avenir durable, en formant les acteurs qui façonneront les transitions de demain.

À Mines Saint-Étienne, nos centres de recherche sont le cœur battant de notre École.

Pensés comme de véritables hubs d’innovation, nos cinq Centres de Formation et de Recherche articulent leurs expertises autour de grands enjeux industriels, environnementaux, sociétaux et technologiques.

Leur mission ? Imaginer le monde de demain en alliant excellence académique et impact concret.

🎯Ce que nous attendons de vous

En tant qu’ingénieur(e) de développement, vous êtes au cœur de nos missions en formation, recherche et innovation affecté à l’Institut Henri FAYOL. Au sein de ce centre vous conjuguez passion scientifique et impact sociétal.

Transitions numériques, écologiques, industrielles : les grands défis de notre époque sont aussi ceux de l’Institut Henri Fayol.

Ici se mêlent Informatique, Sciences des données, Management, Sciences humaines et sociales, Génie environnemental pour penser les systèmes complexes de demain : territoires, entreprises, filières industrielles. 

📊 Résilience, performance, durabilité… Nous développons et expérimentons en lien étroit avec les acteurs socio-économique pour répondre aux exigences des transitions actuelles.

✨ Une recherche interdisciplinaire à fort impact, où l’humain est toujours au centre.

A l’heure actuelle, face aux besoins croissants d’acteurs pour accompagner les transitions des entreprises et de leurs écosystèmes territoriaux et industriels, Mines Saint-Etienne, dans le cadre du projet Phygital financé par la région AURA, a décidé de massifier ses formations i) en s’appuyant sur des pratiques innovantes en direction de publics hétérogènes (formation initiale, formation tout au long de la vie, formation par la recherche), et ii) en se basant sur de nombreux cas d’usages technologiques (Intelligence Artificielle, Sciences des données, Jumeaux Numériques, Gestion de production, etc), démonstrateurs des enjeux actuels de l’industrie et des territoires du futur. Ces cas d’usages technologiques sont développés à ce jour sur ses plateformes informatiques et industrielles du laboratoire des transitions, et doivent être déployés à grande échelle :

 

Dans ce cadre, vos différentes missions sont :

  • Intégrer les nouveaux composants connectés (robots mobiles, bras robotiques, convoyeurs, capteurs et actionneurs divers) et assurer leur fonctionnement avec le reste du matériel, notamment en déployant des interfaces interactives pour faciliter leur utilisation.

62861cd3630df11b.title: Post-doctorant.e "Influence de l’irradiation neutronique sur la ségrégation intergranulaire dans un acier faiblement allié" - CDD 24 mois
62861cd3630df11b.description:
Rejoindre Mines Saint-Étienne, c’est s’engager dans une institution où la science et l’innovation bâtissent un avenir plus durable. Une école d’excellence où chacun a l’opportunité de révéler son plein potentiel et de contribuer à relever les défis de demain.

Classée parmi les meilleures écoles d’ingénieurs en France et reconnue mondialement, notre école, membre de l’Institut Mines-Télécom, forme les talents de demain tout en contribuant activement à relever les grands défis industriels, numériques et environnementaux. Avec nous, vous intégrez une communauté de 500 collaborateurs, 2500 étudiants, et participez à un projet ambitieux : conjuguer excellence académique, recherche d’avant-garde et impact sociétal positif.

L’Institut Mines-Télécom fédère les grandes écoles françaises autour des défis industriels majeurs, numériques, énergétiques et écologiques. Avec ses 8 Grandes Écoles publiques et 2 écoles filiales, il est le premier institut public dédié aux ingénieurs et managers. Ensemble, nous imaginons et construisons un avenir durable, en formant les acteurs qui façonneront les transitions de demain.

Bienvenue dans l’univers des matériaux du futur !

Au centre Science des Matériaux et des Structures (SMS), rattaché au Laboratoire Georges Friedel (unité mixte de recherche CNRS), on décortique la matière pour mieux la maîtriser. Alliages métalliques, céramiques, composites… ici, on explore le lien entre procédés, microstructures et propriétés des matériaux.

Grâce à des outils de caractérisation avancée et des modèles multi-échelles, nos enseignants-chercheurs inventent le concept de « Material by design » : concevoir les matériaux dès l’atelier de recherche, pour une performance sur-mesure.

🧠 Vous aimez la science fondamentale qui change le réel ? C’est ici que ça se passe.

🎯 Description du poste - ce que nous attendons de vous

Le Laboratoire Georges Friedel (LGF) est une Unité Mixte de Recherche du CNRS (UMR 5307). Situé à l’École des Mines de Saint-Étienne et porté par deux tutelles (Mines Saint-Étienne et CNRS), le laboratoire regroupe tout le potentiel de recherche de Mines Saint-Étienne dans les domaines des matériaux, de la mécanique et des procédés.

Le centre SMS - Sciences des Matériaux et des Structures - est l’un des cinq centres d’enseignement et de recherche de Mines Saint-Etienne. Au sein du LGF, il développe des recherches en science des matériaux, mécanique et procédés avancés de fabrication, pour le transport et la production d'énergie, avec un objectif d’accroître la durabilité des matériaux.

Ce post-doc s'inscrit dans le cadre de la chaire « SIRA », un partenariat de cinq ans entre Mines Saint-Etienne et les sociétés Framatome et EDF, co-financé par l'Agence Nationale de la Recherche, portant sur le vieillissement des aciers faiblement alliés (16MND5) utilisés dans les composants du circuit primaire des réacteurs nucléaires à eau pressurisée. Les travaux de la chaire incluent plusieurs doctorats et post-doctorats visant à faire progresser la connaissance du phénomène de ségrégation intergranulaire dans les aciers faiblement alliés et de la fragilisation associée, ainsi qu’à développer de nouvelles méthodologies de mesure de la ségrégation intergranulaire, ou à améliorer les méthodologies existantes.

Le post-doc proposé ici, financé par EDF, vise à déterminer l'effet de l'irradiation neutronique sur la ségrégation intergranulaire, pour les matériaux suivis dans le cadre du programme de surveillance des effets de l'irradiation sur les matériaux des cuves REP d'EDF. Il est en effet important de savoir si de la fragilisation intergranulaire peut intervenir à forte fluence pour prévoir correctement l'évolution des propriétés de rupture. C'est donc une caractérisation qui vient en appui de l'interprétation des fragilisations mesurées dans le cadre du programme de surveillance. Le travail consistera à mesurer les états de ségrégation intergranulaire dans les états non irradié et irradié en utilisant la microscopie électronique en transmission (STEM-EDX). Contrairement à la spectroscopie Auger, la microscopie électronique ne nécessite pas l'obtention d'une surface de rupture sous ultra-vide, ce qui constitue un avantage pour des matériaux dont la tendance à la rupture intergranulaire est faible. L'acier de cuve a une certaine hétérogénéité de composition chimique locale à cause de la présence de mésoségrégations enrichies en solutés majeurs et en impuretés fragilisantes comme le phosphore. Pour juger des seuls effets de l'irradiation, les zones d'analyse en microscopie électronique devront donc être équivalentes en termes d'intensité de mésoségrégation dans les états non irradié et irradié. Ceci nécessitera une caractérisation préalable des mésoségrégations et un prélèvement ciblé des lames minces en zone ségrégée ou en zone non ségrégée par faisceau d'ions focalisés (FIB). Les travaux de microscopie électronique seront réalisés à Saint-Etienne (microscope Jeol NeoARM) pour l’état non irradié, et au laboratoire d'analyse des matériaux irradiés d'EDF à Chinon (microscope FEI Osiris) pour l’état irradié. Une méthodologie d'analyse des ségrégations intergranulaires a été développée pour ce type de microscope au cours de la thèse de C.Y. Hsu (2023) et fait actuellement l’objet d’un développement dans le cadre d’un des post-docs de la chaire (mesure de la ségrégation intergranulaire du carbone par STEM-EDX).

Au sein de la direction financière et directement rattaché(e) à la Directrice Financière Groupe, vous encadrez l'équipe comptable et êtes garant(e) de la fiabilité des comptes du groupe, en France comme à l'international.

Vous serez chargé(e) de :

  1.     Production comptable & clôtures

  • Superviser l'ensemble de la production comptable de la société mère (comptabilité générale, fournisseurs, clients, immobilisations, stocks) et en garantir la qualité et l'exhaustivité.

  • Organiser et piloter les clôtures mensuelles, semestrielles et annuelles dans le respect des délais, en lien avec le contrôle de gestion et les équipes opérationnelles.

  • Préparer les états financiers annuels et assurer la justification et la revue des comptes.

2.     Internalisation & structuration de la fonction comptable

  • Porter le projet d'internalisation à 100 % de la comptabilité, aujourd'hui en partie externalisée, en définissant l'organisation cible, le calendrier et le plan de reprise des tâches.

  • Formaliser les procédures, le calendrier de clôture et les contrôles internes, et fiabiliser les flux comptables en provenance des différents systèmes (ERP, e-commerce, retail).

  • Optimiser les process et l'outillage de l'équipe, et contribuer aux projets de transformation de la fonction finance.

 

3.     Comptabilité groupe & filiales internationales

  • Assurer le suivi de la comptabilité des filiales (Europe, Asie, États-Unis) et animer la relation avec les cabinets comptables locaux.

  • Piloter les réconciliations et la facturation intercompany, et préparer les éléments nécessaires à la consolidation du groupe.

  • Contribuer aux sujets fiscaux et réglementaires en lien avec la Directrice Financière Groupe et les conseils externes (liasses, TVA, déclarations, prix de transfert).

4.     Management de l'équipe comptable : vous encadrez, accompagnez et faites monter en compétence l'équipe, en veillant à sa technicité, à son organisation et à son engagement au quotidien.

5.     Interlocuteur privilégié des commissaires aux comptes, vous préparez et coordonnez les audits intermédiaires et annuels, et veillez à leur bon déroulement.

6.     Partenaire des équipes opérationnelles, vous accompagnez les équipes retail, e-commerce, wholesale et logistique sur les sujets comptables et participez aux projets transverses de l'entreprise.

PROFIL RECHERCHÉ

Nous recherchons une personnalité structurante, rigoureuse et engagée, capable de conjuguer expertise technique et sens du management dans un environnement en évolution rapide. Les qualifications et compétences clés incluent :

  • Formation supérieure en comptabilité/finance (école de commerce, Master CCA, DSCG) ; un parcours en audit est un vrai plus.

  • Expérience confirmée de 10 ans minimum en comptabilité, dont une expérience significative en management d'équipe, idéalement dans un groupe international (retail, mode ou luxe appréciés).

  • Solide maîtrise des normes comptables françaises, de la fiscalité et des problématiques de clôture ; connaissance des IFRS et de la consolidation appréciée.

  • Expérience réussie d'un projet de structuration ou d'internalisation d'une fonction comptable et d'amélioration des process.

  • Rigueur, sens de l'organisation, leadership bienveillant, capacité à fédérer et excellentes qualités relationnelles.

  • Anglais courant indispensable, très bonne maîtrise d'Excel et des ERP.

Ce poste est conçu pour un(e) professionnel(le) désireux(se) de construire et de faire grandir une fonction comptable au cœur d'une maison de mode internationale, en jouant un rôle clé dans la fiabilité de l'information financière et la structuration du groupe.

Nous sommes convaincus que la diversité de nos équipes est une force. Nous étudions toutes les candidatures avec la même attention, sans distinction de genre, de handicap, d'origine, d'âge ou d'orientation.

We are seeking a sales leader to drive growth across our enterprise and SMB accounts in Europe. This is a high-impact role for someone who thrives on winning complex, high-value deals with life sciences organisations, while also building a scalable, high-velocity sales motion for small and mid-sized companies. You will own the full sales cycle across enterprise and SMB accounts, from opening executive-level conversations to negotiating multiyear agreements and play a central role in shaping Exeevo’ s growth across Europe.

What You'll Do

  • Define and execute the enterprise and SMB sales strategy across Europe, owning the pan-European new-business revenue target and pipeline
  • Tailor the go-to-market approach to the commercial, regulatory, and cultural nuances of priority markets such as DACH, France, the Nordics, Benelux, Southern Europe, and the UK
  • Identify, pursue, and close large, multiyear platform deals with global and regional pharmaceutical, biotech, and MedTech organisations, and build an efficient, repeatable sales motion for small and mid-sized life sciences companies
  • Develop strategic account plans for target logos and existing customers, driving both new logo acquisition and land-and-expand growth
  • Build trusted C-suite and senior executive relationships, positioning Exeevo as a strategic partner for omnichannel HCP and patient engagement
  • Lead consultative sales cycles, from shorter SMB deals to complex enterprise cycles of 4–8 months, navigating multiple stakeholders across Commercial, Sales Operations, Medical Affairs, IT, Compliance, and Procurement
  • Orchestrate cross-functional deal teams (presales, solution consulting, delivery, legal, and executive sponsors) to deliver compelling, tailored proposals
  • Lead responses to RFPs and formal procurement processes, and negotiate commercial and contractual terms on high-value agreements
  • Develop and leverage partnerships with Microsoft, systems integrators, and other ecosystem partners to co-sell and expand market reach
  • Provide accurate pipeline reporting and revenue forecasting to the executive leadership team, with rigorous deal qualification discipline
  • Act as a senior voice of the market, bringing insight on European customer needs, the competitive landscape, and regulatory considerations (e.g., GDPR, the EFPIA Code, and national industry codes such as ABPI, FSA, and Farmaindustria) to product and leadership
  • Represent Exeevo as a thought leader at industry events, conferences, and executive forums across Europe

Requirements

  • 5 to 10 years of Software / SaaS sales experience across enterprise and SMB segments, including a significant track record selling to life sciences organisations of all sizes across Europe
  • Proven success closing complex, multiyear, high-value deals with pharma, biotech, or MedTech companies across European markets, ideally spanning multiple countries
  • An established, active network of senior decisionmakers (e.g., Commercial, Medical Affairs, IT, and Procurement leaders) within life sciences organisations, with the ability to open doors from day one
  • Proven experience selling across pan-European or multi-country markets within the life sciences sector, with an understanding of the commercial, regulatory, and cultural differences between European markets; additional European languages (e.g., French, Spanish, Italian) a strong advantage
  • Deep understanding of life sciences commercial operations; experience with CRM or commercial technology platforms (e.g., Veeva, IQVIA, Salesforce Life Sciences Cloud, Microsoft Dynamics 365) strongly preferred
  • Experience working with and through partner ecosystems (Microsoft, systems integrators) is a strong advantage
  • Based in Europe with the right to work in your country of residence, and willingness to travel extensively across Europe
  • Bachelor's degree required; MBA or relevant postgraduate qualification preferred

Key Competencies

  • Expertise in consultative and value-based selling methodologies (e.g., MEDDICC, Challenger, Miller Heiman)
  • Exceptional negotiation, commercial acumen, and stakeholder management skills
  • Strong executive presence, with the ability to influence and build credibility at C-suite and board level
  • Strategic thinker who is equally comfortable rolling up their sleeves in a growth-stage environment

Benefits

  • Private Healthcare Plan
  • Leave Package
  • Work From Home
  • Training & Development
  • Paid Time Off

b81f4f0765ac3fa9.title: Strategic Account Manager, SME - France
b81f4f0765ac3fa9.description:
About Airwallex

Airwallex is the AI-native financial operating system for a real-time, intelligent economy. More than 675,000 businesses, including McLaren Racing, Qantas, SHEIN, and TikTok, use us, directly or through our platform partners, to run their financial operations or build and monetize financial products of their own.

We started in Melbourne in 2015 to build the infrastructure global commerce runs on. We're the regulated backbone behind global payments: not by accident, but by design. A decade plus, 85+ licenses, and a financial infrastructure spanning North America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific.

We're co-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore, with more than 2,700 people across 27 offices. We hire builders with founder-level energy, people who move fast with good judgment, dig in with real curiosity, and make calls from first principles rather than waiting to be told what to do. Read our operating principles to see it in full.

 

How you'll make impact

Own growth across a portfolio of 50–100 SME customers, driving expansion, product adoption and strong Net Revenue Retention through a focused, data-led account strategy. You’ll identify the accounts with the greatest potential, build 12-month growth plans with CFOs and Treasury Leads, and create cross-sell opportunities across cards, spend, FX, billing and embedded finance.

  • Drive expansion and product adoption across an existing portfolio, achieving Net Revenue Retention and GMV growth targets.

  • Segment and tier 50–100 accounts to focus your time on the highest-impact retention and growth opportunities.

  • Build strategic account plans and 12-month growth roadmaps with CFOs, Treasury Leads and other key stakeholders.

  • Identify and deliver cross-sell opportunities across cards, spend, FX, billing and embedded finance.

  • Navigate complex KYB and compliance requirements, technical integrations and operational issues during onboarding.

  • Improve customers’ time to first transaction and support long-term product adoption.

  • Retain and grow customers in a competitive market by communicating the value of Airwallex’s broader solution, not just competing on price.

  • Partner with Product, Compliance, Support and other teams on product feedback loops, pricing changes, support enablement and a closed-loop Voice of the Customer process.

You’ll work from our Paris office three days a week.

What we're looking for


Essentials

  • 2–5 years’ experience in Account Management or Customer Success within fintech or payments.

  • A strong understanding of fund flows, acquiring and FX.

  • A proven track record of driving expansion and achieving Net Revenue Retention or GMV growth targets across an existing book of business.

  • Experience managing a portfolio of 50–100 accounts through rigorous segmentation and tiering.

  • Experience navigating complex KYB and compliance requirements, as well as technical or operational issues during onboarding.

  • The ability to map stakeholders, including CFOs and Treasury Leads, and build 12-month account growth roadmaps.

  • Experience retaining and growing customers in a competitive market by selling solution value, not just competing on price.

Preferred

  • Experience managing a senior-level portfolio of the top 50 accounts.

  • Experience contributing to cross-functional projects such as product feedback loops, pricing changes or support enablement.

  • Experience building a closed-loop Voice of the Customer process.

  • Multi-product cross-sell experience across cards, spend, FX, billing or embedded finance.

  • Experience working with multi-entity or international customers.

  • A second language beyond the primary market requirement.


You'll thrive here if

  • You have a track record of hitting your numbers, and you’re motivated by stretch goals.

  • You have experience at a fintech, payments company, or other highly regulated business.

  • You own the outcome and you don't wait for permission to fix what's broken.

  • You connect dots across functions and hold the big picture without losing grip on the details.

  • You’re comfortable making decisions with incomplete information and moving quickly anyway.


Learn more about your team

SME & Growth at Airwallex is about more than closing deals. We help small and mid-market businesses solve real financial challenges across borders: getting paid globally, managing multi-currency accounts, paying suppliers, and running spend across markets from a single platform. You're not selling a feature. You're helping founders and finance leaders replace fragmented financial operations with one global system that actually scales.

It's a function for sellers who like to build, not follow a script: curious, resourceful, and comfortable figuring things out in markets that are still wide open. You get real autonomy to create value, build relationships, and move opportunities forward.

If you want to sell a serious product, solve real problems for ambitious businesses, and build your career fast, this is a place to do it.

Applicant Safety Policy: Fraud and Third-Party Recruiters

To protect you from recruitment scams, please be aware that Airwallex will not ask for bank details, sensitive ID numbers (i.e. passport), or any form of payment during the application or interview process. All official communication will come from an @airwallex.com email address. Please apply only through careers.airwallex.com or our official LinkedIn page.

Airwallex does not accept unsolicited resumes from search firms/recruiters. Airwallex will not pay any fees to search firms/recruiters if a candidate is submitted by a search firm/recruiter unless an agreement has been entered into with respect to specific open position(s). Search firms/recruiters submitting resumes to Airwallex on an unsolicited basis shall be deemed to accept this condition, regardless of any other provision to the contrary.

Equal opportunity

Airwallex is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We value diversity and anyone seeking employment at Airwallex is considered based on merit, qualifications, competence and talent. We don’t regard color, religion, race, national origin, sexual orientation, ancestry, citizenship, sex, marital or family status, disability, gender, or any other legally protected status when making our hiring decisions. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know.

76878671567b8f83.description:
About the Team

OpenAI’s GTM Partnerships team builds a strategic, global partner ecosystem to accelerate customer success, support responsible enterprise AI adoption, and drive durable growth in support of OpenAI’s mission. We work across Sales, Solutions Engineering, Customer Success, Product, Marketing, Operations, and partner organisations to turn strategic partnerships into measurable customer and commercial outcomes.

Cloud providers, global systems integrators, consulting firms, and technology partners play a critical role in helping customers adopt and scale OpenAI’s products. Our Partner Sales & Development team connects these partnerships to the field through joint account planning, opportunity development, coordinated sales execution, and delivery alignment that helps customers move from initial interest to production adoption.

About the Role

We are hiring a Partnerships Lead, Southern Europe to lead our partner sales and development team for Southern EMEA. Reporting to the Head of GTM Partnerships, Europe you will manage and develop a regional team, own the regional partner business, and work alongside OpenAI Sales leadership and strategic partners to generate pipeline, advance complex pursuits, and drive revenue and customer adoption.

This is a people management role that combines team leadership, partner business development, co-sell execution, and operational discipline. You will translate broader partnership priorities into a focused regional plan, set team goals and account coverage, and coach your team to engage the right partners at the right point in the customer journey. You will build relationships with partner field leaders and remain hands-on in priority pursuits, working with technical and delivery teams to turn commercial commitments into sustained customer value.

You will be accountable for both regional business performance and the success of your team. We are looking for an experienced people manager who can hire and develop talent, establish clear expectations, manage performance, and build a culture of accountability, collaboration, and customer focus.

In this role, you will:

  • Own the partner sales and development plan for your assigned region, Southern Europe, aligning team coverage, target accounts, partner priorities, sales plays, and execution milestones with regional Sales leadership

  • Drive regional commercial outcomes across partner-sourced and partner-attached pipeline, bookings, production adoption, and expansion, with clear accountability for business performance.

  • Identify and develop new partner-led opportunities. Evaluate where partners can create differentiated customer value, establish executive sponsorship, and build a path from initial engagement to joint execution.

  • Lead account mapping and joint account planning with OpenAI sellers and partner teams to identify whitespace, qualify opportunities, and prioritize the accounts and use cases with the greatest potential.

  • Orchestrate complex co-sell pursuits, aligning account teams, partner sellers, technical stakeholders, and services organizations around customer needs, clear responsibilities, and mutual action plans.

  • Build trusted relationships with regional partner executives and field leaders, while coordinating with global partner owners to ensure regional execution supports the broader partnership strategy.

  • Partner with Solutions Engineering, Customer Success, Product, and partner delivery teams to address technical and implementation dependencies and help customers deploy, adopt, and expand AI workloads in production.

  • Create repeatable field engagement models, partner enablement, sales plays, and escalation paths that make it easier for OpenAI and partner teams to work together effectively.

  • Establish disciplined pipeline reviews, forecasting, business reviews, and performance reporting. Use evidence to assess partner contribution, diagnose underperformance, and adjust investments and priorities.

  • Navigate complex stakeholder relationships, commercial tradeoffs, and competing priorities with sound judgment, working across Legal, Security, Finance, and other teams as needed.

  • Hire, manage, coach, and develop a high-performing regional partner sales and development team. Set individual and team goals, provide regular feedback, manage performance, and support career growth.

You might thrive in this role if you have:

  • Significant experience in enterprise sales, partner sales, strategic alliances, or business development within cloud, AI, SaaS, or enterprise technology.

  • A track record of owning regional or segment-level business outcomes and delivering measurable pipeline, revenue, and customer growth through partners.

  • Demonstrated direct people management experience in partner sales, enterprise sales, alliances, or a related GTM function, including hiring, coaching, performance management, and team development.

  • Deep familiarity with cloud providers, global systems integrators, consulting firms, or technology partner ecosystems, and an understanding of how their field organizations sell and deliver.

  • Experience creating opportunities and leading complex partnerships or customer engagements from discovery and qualification through commercial execution, launch, adoption, and expansion.

  • Strong enterprise sales fundamentals, including account planning, opportunity qualification, stakeholder mapping, negotiation, pipeline management, and forecasting.

  • The ability to earn trust with Sales leaders, partner executives, technical teams, and peers, and to resolve disagreements constructively in a matrixed organization.

  • Technical-commercial fluency: you can understand customer use cases, translate partner needs into clear requirements, and engage product and technical teams on implementation tradeoffs.

  • Strong operational judgment and a builder mindset. You can create structure where a playbook does not yet exist, adapt as priorities change, and move quickly without sacrificing customer trust.

  • Clear communication, executive presence, self-awareness, and a collaborative approach to feedback and problem-solving.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Experience managing geographically distributed teams and aligning account or territory coverage across a region.

  • Experience building or scaling a regional partner sales or co-sell business at a high-growth technology company.

  • Experience aligning sales and partner delivery organisations to support enterprise implementations and sustained production adoption.

  • Familiarity with AI platforms, modern cloud architectures, cloud marketplaces, and enterprise procurement models.

About OpenAI

OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity. 

We are an equal opportunity employer, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or other applicable legally protected characteristic.

For additional information, please see OpenAI’s Affirmative Action and Equal Employment Opportunity Policy Statement.

Background checks for applicants will be administered in accordance with applicable law, and qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment consistent with those laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act, for US-based candidates. For unincorporated Los Angeles County workers: we reasonably believe that criminal history may have a direct, adverse and negative relationship with the following job duties, potentially resulting in the withdrawal of a conditional offer of employment: protect computer hardware entrusted to you from theft, loss or damage; return all computer hardware in your possession (including the data contained therein) upon termination of employment or end of assignment; and maintain the confidentiality of proprietary, confidential, and non-public information. In addition, job duties require access to secure and protected information technology systems and related data security obligations.

266f89d62d2d11ce.title: Applied AI Engineer, Codex
266f89d62d2d11ce.description:
About the Team

OpenAI’s Applied AI Engineering team helps organizations turn frontier AI capabilities into safe, reliable, and high-impact production systems. For software engineering organizations, this means helping customers adopt Codex and other OpenAI capabilities across the software development lifecycle—transforming how teams plan, build, test, review, and deliver software.

We work directly with engineering leaders and hands-on developers to identify high-value opportunities, design and implement AI-powered development workflows, and scale what works across engineering organizations. We turn lessons from these deployments into better products, reusable architectures, and technical patterns that help developers everywhere get more value from Codex.

About the Role

As an Applied AI Engineer focused on Codex, you will partner directly with leading engineering organizations to design, build, and deploy AI systems that transform how software is developed. You will combine deep technical judgment, hands-on engineering, and customer leadership to take ambitious ideas from workflow and use-case selection through prototyping, evaluation, production rollout, and scaled adoption.

You will work alongside engineering teams to build advanced AI coding workflows, integrations, automations, and evaluation systems—often using Codex itself as part of your development process. You will help customers make technical decisions involving model behavior, agentic workflows, developer environments, security, reliability, evaluation, and operational readiness, while ensuring deployments translate into measurable improvements in engineering productivity and software delivery.

You will work closely with OpenAI Product, Research, Engineering, Security, Sales, and the broader Codex organization, translating real-world deployment experience into high-signal product and model feedback. Success is measured by production systems, sustained developer adoption, and meaningful improvements to how engineering organizations build software—not simply successful demonstrations or enablement activity.

This role is based in our London office. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees.

In this role, you will:

  • Partner directly with engineering leaders and hands-on developers to identify high-value opportunities for Codex and translate them into technical architectures, implementation plans, evaluation strategies, and measurable success criteria.

  • Design, build, and deploy AI-powered software development workflows that improve how engineering teams plan, write, test, review, debug, and deliver software.

  • Work hands-on in code to build prototypes, evaluation harnesses, reference implementations, integrations, workflow automations, and production accelerators—often using Codex as part of your own development process.

  • Help customers progress from promising experiments to reliable production workflows, sustained developer adoption, and scaled impact across engineering organizations.

  • Design systematic approaches for evaluating AI coding systems using representative software engineering tasks, automated graders, production signals, and developer feedback.

  • Make sound technical decisions across models, agents, tools, developer environments, integrations, reliability, observability, latency, cost, safety, security, and operational readiness.

  • Diagnose complex implementation challenges, reproduce failures, test hypotheses, and drive technical blockers toward resolution.

  • Lead technical deep dives, workshops, and hands-on enablement that help engineering teams understand and adopt advanced AI coding workflows effectively and safely.

  • Gather high-fidelity insights from real-world Codex deployments and translate them into clear product proposals, model feedback, and technical requirements for OpenAI Product, Research, and Engineering teams.

  • Create reusable architectures, tooling, examples, guides, and technical patterns—including contributions to resources such as the OpenAI Cookbook—that accelerate future Codex deployments.

  • Influence customer engineering strategy by helping technical leaders understand how AI coding systems can reshape their software development lifecycle, engineering practices, and organizational workflows.

You’ll thrive in this role if you:

  • Have a demonstrated track record of designing, building, and delivering software or AI systems in enterprise environments, including taking systems from prototype to production. Relevant backgrounds may include applied AI or ML engineering, forward-deployed engineering, software engineering, developer tooling, customer engineering, solutions architecture, or technical consulting.

  • Can point to substantial personal contributions in code, architecture, evaluation, debugging, integrations, or production engineering—not only program, enablement, or stakeholder management.

  • Are highly proficient in Python and comfortable working across modern software development environments; experience with JavaScript, TypeScript, or another relevant language is valuable.

  • Are an active user of AI coding tools and have developed a strong point of view on how AI can improve developer productivity and software engineering workflows.

  • Enjoy building high-signal prototypes, integrations, automations, and production solutions that demonstrate and deliver what AI coding systems can enable.

  • Understand how to evaluate AI coding systems systematically, including designing representative tasks, automated evaluations, production signals, and mechanisms for incorporating developer feedback.

  • Have navigated enterprise production requirements such as developer tooling integrations, reliability, observability, security, privacy, data governance, performance, and cost.

  • Can connect technical decisions to developer workflows, adoption, engineering productivity, and measurable business outcomes.

  • Communicate with clarity and credibility across hands-on engineers, engineering leaders, security teams, product leaders, and executives.

  • Are comfortable leading technical workshops and hands-on sessions that help engineering organizations adopt new development workflows and technologies.

8c46a9ac642dd6a3.title: Alternance / Stage - Chargé(e) de Mission Traçabilité et Data RSE (H/F)
8c46a9ac642dd6a3.description:
Il y a vingt ans, les premières sélections Les Composantes voyaient le jour. Une histoire née d’une soif d’indépendance et d’une passion pour le vintage. Une manière instinctive de faire circuler les vêtements, guidée par une attention particulière à ce qui dure.

Dans son prolongement, Sézane prend vie en 2013 : la première marque de mode française née en ligne. Puis sont venus enrichir cet univers : Octobre Éditions pour les hommes, Les Composantes, dédiée cette fois à l’art de vivre, et Petit Sézane pour les enfants.

Tout s’est construit comme on avance dans la vie : par élans, par gestes spontanés avec cette manière d’apprendre en faisant. Une autre relation au détail, au service et au lien. Une autre manière d’habiller le réel, d’abord en ligne, puis à travers nos Appartements.

Nous recherchons aujourd’hui des talents créatifs, structurés et agiles qui partagent l’envie d’améliorer sans cesse tout ce qui peut l’être. Des talents passionnés, autonomes qui conçoivent le travail dans le respect des autres et pour qui rien n'est hors d'atteinte, pour peu qu'on s'en donne les moyens.

Nous recherchons les talents d’un(e) Assistant(e) Chargée de Mission Traçabilité et Data RSE (H/F) pour rejoindre nos équipes à l'occasion d'une alternance d'un an ou d'un stage de 6 mois à partir de Janvier 2027. Ce poste est basé à Paris (75).

Rattaché(e) à la Responsable Conformité Sociale, Droits Humains & Traçabilité au sein du département RSE, vous contribuez directement au déploiement de notre démarche de traçabilité, ainsi qu'au suivi et à l'analyse de nos données RSE pour l'ensemble des marques du groupe (Sézane, Petit Sézane, Octobre Editions)

1. Coordination et suivi de la traçabilité de la chaîne de valeur (80%) 

En lien avec la Responsable Conformité Sociale, Droits Humains & Traçabilité, vous participez activement à garantir l'éthique et la transparence de notre chaîne de valeur pour l'ensemble des marques du groupe (Sézane, Petit Sézane, Octobre Editions)

  • Préparation des données : Préparer les fichiers nécessaires au lancement des collectes de données de traçabilité sur notre outil 
  • Suivi opérationnel : Assurer un suivi des collectes via notre outil, coordonner les actions et relancer les fournisseurs
  • Campagnes de sous-traitance : Participer activement aux campagnes de déclaration de sous-traitance: relance des fournisseurs, vérification des données 
  • Validation : Contrôler les données collectées et faciliter leur validation en lien avec les équipes production
  • Reporting : Aider à la préparation des présentations et des bilans de traçabilité à destination des équipes internes

2. Reporting RSE et projets transverses (20 %)

  • Bilans RSE et reporting : Contribuer aux bilans et reportings RSE internes et externes et à la préparation des données associées (sources, règles de calcul, périmètre…)
  • Bilan carbone : Contribuer à la collecte des données pour le bilan annuel
  • Soutien aux équipes internes : Contribuer ponctuellement à la préparation de dossiers et d'analyses et à des projets sur des sujets transverses à la RSE et aux autres équipes internes

Requirements

  • Étudiant(e) en école de commerce, d'ingénieur ou master universitaire (RSE, Développement Durable), niveau Bac + 4 ou + 5
  • Passionné(e) par les enjeux de RSE et de développement durable, vous cherchez à avoir de l’impact;
  • Particulièrement intéressé(e) par le secteur textile, vous souhaitez mettre vos compétences au service d’une marque engagée;
  • Rigoureux(se) dans vos échanges et vos analyses, vous êtes à l’aise avec la gestion de données et avez une bonne maîtrise d’Excel pour assurer le suivi de nos bases de données;
  • Doté(e) d’un esprit analytique et organisé, vous savez suivre plusieurs dossiers en parallèle avec rigueur et méthode;
  • À l’aise dans un environnement dynamique, vous avez un bon relationnel et aimez travailler en équipe;
  • Vous parlez et écrivez couramment le français et l’anglais

78ca6c4f09a908c6.title: Field Marketing Specialist
78ca6c4f09a908c6.description:
About Dust

Work is being rewritten, and the people holding the pen are the ones who actually run it.

With enterprise-grade governance, flexible model choice, and a collaborative interface for humans and agents to work together, Dust empowers AI Operators at the world’s fastest-moving companies to rewire how work gets done.

With 70%+ weekly active users, people stick with Dust as much as they do with Slack and Notion. We don't get piloted and shelved. We land once, and spread. We're at an exciting stage of our journey, and growing fast.

We're serving great customers like Datadog, 1Password, Cursor, Clay, Vanta and Persona, and aim to x5 our growth by the end of 2026.

Dust is backed by Sequoia with a determined team of optimists (coming from Stripe, OpenAI, and Stanford) who like to focus on users, ship fast, and don't take themselves too seriously while doing so. The Generalist named us among the Future 50.

This Role

The French market is one of Dust’s most important growth levers, and the Marketing team plays a central role in supporting pipeline generation through events, content and account-based activations.

As field marketing specialist, France, you will be the execution owner for Dust’s local Marketing activities. Working closely with the France Marketing Lead, you will turn defined priorities into high-quality events, localized webinars, social media, content and partner marketing activations that support Sales, BDRs and pipeline generation.

The France Marketing Lead owns the strategy, budget, programme selection and priorities. You will own execution, coordination, content delivery and continuous improvement across the French Marketing motion.

You will be part of a growing Marketing team across the US, UK and France, managed by the Global Head of Marketing.

Key Responsibilities

Own the execution of the French event and webinar programme

  • Execute conferences, Dust-owned events and localized webinars selected and scoped by the France Marketing Lead.

  • Coordinate the preparation, stakeholders, content, landing pages and logistics needed for a smooth delivery.

  • Work closely with Sales and BDRs to prepare target accounts, follow-up plans and event-related content.

  • Collect feedback, measure performance and document learnings after each activity.

Own French social media and content activation

  • Own social media execution for Dust around events, campaigns and key French-market topics.

  • Support AEs with relevant content and messaging for their LinkedIn activity.

  • Coordinate with Global Marketing, Product, Customer Success, Design and external media partners to deliver relevant content for French enterprise audiences.

  • Turn events, customer conversations and market insights into reusable content, including customer stories, blog posts, videos, YouTube content and Sales assets.

Support partner marketing and Growth programmes

  • Provide execution and logistical support for regional partner marketing activities within the strategy, selection and budget defined by the France Marketing Lead.

  • Support Growth with French-market content for ABM, webinars and paid campaigns.

  • Produce or reformat assets such as e-books, landing pages, customer content and campaign materials.

  • Connect event, content and partner marketing activities to target account engagement and pipeline generation.

Coordinate cross-functional Marketing initiatives

  • Identify opportunities to automate repetitive Marketing tasks , Build Dust agents and workflows to support research, event preparation, content repurposing, Sales enablement, reporting and follow-up.

Requirements

  • 3+ years of experience in B2B Marketing, ideally across Field Marketing, Event Marketing, Content Marketing or Product Marketing, preferably in SaaS or technology.

  • End-to-end event ownership with the ability to plan and deliver conferences, executive events and Dust-owned events, from preparation through execution and post-event follow-up.

  • Strong content and social media skills with experience creating or repurposing content for enterprise audiences across social media, landing pages, customer stories, YouTube, Sales enablement and executive LinkedIn profiles.

  • Commercial and pipeline mindset with a clear understanding of how events, content and account-based activities support Sales, BDRs, direct pipeline and partner-led growth.

  • Excellent communication skills in French and English, both written and spoken. You can write clearly and accurately, adapt your tone to different audiences and communicate credibly with enterprise executives.

  • Generalist and hands-on approach. You are comfortable moving between event ownership, content creation, Sales preparation, webinars, campaign assets and operational coordination.

  • Strong organisational skills and attention to detail. You anticipate needs, manage deadlines reliably and ensure that projects, events and content are properly prepared before launch.

  • Self-starter mentality. You take initiative, make decisions, solve problems and own outcomes rather than waiting to be told what to do.

  • Strong cross-functional collaboration skills. You know how to find and coordinate the right people across Marketing, Sales, BDRs, Customer Success, Partnerships and external partners.

  • Nice to have: Experience marketing to French enterprise or CAC 40 audiences, working with agencies or media partners, supporting paid campaigns, producing webinars or video content, and working with tools such as HubSpot, Google Workspace and Figma.

  • Location and travel: Based in Paris, comfortable working on-site and willing to travel occasionally for events in France.

What Makes This Role Unique

  • Direct pipeline impact: Your work will directly support Sales and BDRs through events, content and ABM activations.

  • Execution ownership in France: You will turn the priorities defined by the France Marketing Lead into high-quality events, content, social media and partner marketing activations in France.

  • AI-native Marketing: You will use Dust to automate research, preparation, content production, reporting and follow-up.

  • Generalist scope: The role combines events, content, social media, webinars, Sales enablement and ABM.

  • Market-shaping opportunity: Help establish Dust as a leading voice in the French enterprise and agentic AI market.

Location

We're prioritizing building our team with an in-person culture at our offices in Paris, London, San Francisco, and New York because we value the magic that happens when talented people work closely together.

We have an office-first culture. Some of the best things about building at Dust are the energy, the fast decisions, and the unexpected conversations that unlock a hard problem, which happen because we are in the same room. Being together is not a formality, it is how we do our best work, and it is something we actively protect.

That said, we hire people with strong judgement and we extend that trust to how they manage their time. When working from home makes more sense for what you need to get done that day, we trust you to make that call.

Why Dust

The models are powerful enough. What's missing is the product layer where AI meets how companies actually work. That's what we're building: the infrastructure that lets any team turn scattered knowledge and tools into coordinated execution with agents they build, own, and run themselves.

We use Dust ourselves every day. We get to shape how humans and agents collaborate while solving our own problems with the product we ship. That loop is rare, and it's why we move fast.

If you're excited about defining a new category and want to join a determined team of optimists who focus on users, ship fast, and don't take themselves too seriously, we'd love to talk.

Even if you don't check every box in our requirements, we encourage you to apply. We value diverse perspectives and backgrounds, and we're more interested in your potential and passion than a perfect match to our checklist.

Learn how we think and work.

  • Our product constitution, a story about our mission
