d92654f2bca1ee15.title: Inbound Sales 🇫🇷
d92654f2bca1ee15.description:
Health can’t wait.

Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t.

Alan exists to end the wait.

Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way.

So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience.

We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.

⚡ The Inbound Sales 🇫🇷 role

We're growing our Inbound Sales team in France.

Our Inbound Sales team is in charge of closing inbound requests from leads with 1 to 5 employees (Independent workers, very small companies, individuals).

You’ll be in charge of the whole sales cycle from qualification to closing by educating prospects and providing inspiring arguments to transform them into convinced customers.

At the same time, we expect you to understand, embrace and apply the Alan Smart & Soft selling method. This method stems from the concept that the prospect experience is an inseparable piece of the overall Alan customer experience. You are expected to make this experience pleasant, instructive and delightful by leveraging the most relevant messaging and materials (Smart) and by defining the high-touch strategy that suits best each prospect (Soft).

We also expect you to look at the big picture and help us grow and improve as a company. For that, you’ll have to be real team players even beyond your role. You’ll be expected to challenge us to improve our product(s), our methods, and our strategy, and get involved in other projects and initiatives relevant to growing our customer base.

What does make this role exciting :

  • You will close deals every single day of the year, which is very stimulating!

  • The Inbound Sales team is quite recent: You will contribute to building a new practice within the Sales Community, getting involved in tooling and process improvements

  • You will help building the playbook of best practices to close deals in one shot

  • You will contribute to making our products even better by sharing feedback and improving the self-serve experience for our members

  • You will become an insurance expert and learn to master our products in order to confidently answer questions & objections from prospects

  • We invest heavily in AI to transform the Sales practice. You'll have the opportunity to become one of the most modern Sales professionals in the market!

⭐ You will be a great fit for this role if you: 

  • Have 1-2 years of experience in a Sales role including closing experience

  • Have full working proficiency in French (C2 and above), and advanced level in English

  • Are highly organized with exceptional follow-up skills

  • Show a great balance between Active Listening and Assertiveness when interacting with your prospects

  • Have natural empathy and are passionate about understanding and solving prospects' problems

  • Have a positive attitude and ability to collaborate in a small team

  • Have a desire to learn fast and make an impact from day 1

  • Are based in (or willing to relocate to) Paris, Bordeaux, Marseille, Lyon, Annecy, Nantes or Biarritz.

For this opportunity, we are aiming to hire within the A2-B1 level range.

Everything else is a plus. We care about having a diversity of experiences, profiles and backgrounds in our team.

🙌   Perks & Benefits

At Alan, we believe that being in good health is a basic need, and it starts with our employees. This is why Alaners are provided with a stimulating environment and perks ensuring they are happy, efficient and spend only high-quality time with co-workers. 

Therefore, we offer:

  • Fair rewards. Generous equity packages complement your base salary, for permanent contracts only.

  • Flexible office with hybrid setup. Amazing office space at our Paris HQ or sponsored co-working hubs in Bordeaux, Marseille, Lyon, Annecy, Nantes or Biarritz.

  • All the tools you need. Top of the range equipment: Macbook Air, keyboard, laptop stand, monitor, and Bose noise-canceling headphones.

  • Flexible vacation policy and flexible working hours. Organize your time as you wish.

  • Delightful healthcare insurance: Extremely comprehensive health insurance - 100% for you and your children, 90-100% for partners depending on your country (permanent contracts only).

  • Transport. Generous transit benefit

  • Learning & Training opportunities. A highly flexible training policy free books and budget to attend and speak at conferences if the opportunity arises.

  • Personal growth through coaching: At Alan, coaching isn't just a perk - it's core to who we are. Every Alaner is paired with a dedicated coach from day one, who helps maximize their impact, nurture engagement, and navigate Alan's values to develop their full potential. Learn more about our coaching culture.

  • Parental leave. Extended parental leave for all new parents, for permanent contracts only.

Important note: we hire people not roles. 

After reading this job description, if you feel like you don’t have all the necessary prerequisites but that it matches where you are now or what you'd like to grow into in your next position, we encourage you to apply!

Not everybody will enter our recruitment process, but all, no matter how underrepresented, should feel free to apply as it can only bring learnings or success.

🔖 Check out our About Alan and Career pages, as well as our Medium, blog and Glassdoor page for more info.

f8ea5bdb92676b26.location: Paris, France; Bordeaux, France; Lyon, France; Marseille, France; Biarritz, France; Nantes, France; Annecy, France
f8ea5bdb92676b26.description:

Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t.

So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience.

We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.

Disclaimer: We're open to hire Account Executives across our Paris, Bordeaux, Marseille, Lyon, Annecy, Nantes and Biarritz offices.

⭐️ The Enterprise Account Executive job

We’re expanding our Sales team in France and are looking for a ‘full-stack’ Enterprise Sales to engage with prospects and turn them into happy Alan customers. You will join a team that mostly focuses on large companies from Tech, Syntec, HCR, and B2B services, interacting with everyone from HR executives to CEOs.

Why is this segment interesting?

  • Diverse workforce: Mix of 60% cadres / 40% non-cadres, often with subsidiaries or multi-site operations, ranging from highly tech-savvy employees to those requiring digital adoption support.

  • Critical challenges: Multi-stakeholder decision processes involving HRD, CFO, CEO, Payroll, CSE, Legal, Purchasing, Comp & Ben, Accounting, Brokers (creating multiple potential blockers), long sales cycles (multi-year conversations), RFP processes requiring deep audits and product customization, and strong influence from unions/CSE who can co-manage health insurance topics;

  • Company profiles: Flagship companies (widely known brands), groups with standalone entities or subsidiaries, often with focus on employee wellbeing (QVT programs, Great Place to Work), modern company culture, and strategic communication about digitization or employer brand attractiveness;

  • HR priorities: Increasing productivity, obtaining fair and competitive pricing, contributing to employee well-being through customized health plans, simplifying HR processes with digital platforms, and managing change management concerns when implementing new health insurance (biggest fear for large companies)

  • Critical business characteristics: This segment requires breadth & depth of expertise to navigate complex organizations, account-based strategies with Key Account Management approach, early engagement in company roadmaps, face-to-face meetings, co-creation of insurance and digital products (tailored offers considering past results, specific regimes, demographics, payroll system integration), and ability to work through RFPs and with brokers. Sales cycles are volatile with high stakes: 1 deal = 50% of annual target for Enterprise AEs.

Our approach for Enterprise companies positions Alan as a strategic partner in health rather than just an insurance provider, emphasizing our digital platform for fluid UX, customized health plans at fair pricing, and health/well-being services. Success requires leveraging high-level connections, building professional materials, and potentially creating exclusive "Health Clubs" or labels for early adopters.

What will you do with us?

You’ll own the entire sales cycle, from prospecting to closing. In our Enterprise Sales team, you will deal with companies with more than 300 employees, including all CAC40 companies.

At Alan, Account Executives drive deals and close strategic opportunities with prospects. We sometimes handle some customer relationships to ensure the best possible onboarding. You’ll educate prospects, provide inspiring product demos, and onboard key stakeholders, making the transition from prospect to customer seamless.

We expect you to understand and apply the Alan Smart & Soft selling method. This method ensures the prospect experience is an integral part of the overall Alan customer experience—making it pleasant and delightful for everyone. We expect you to be instructive to prospects (Smart), as well as to define the best personalized high-touch strategy that suits best each prospect (Soft).

You’ll also help us grow and improve as a company, challenging us to enhance our product(s), methods, and strategy, and getting involved in initiatives to expand our customer base.

Take a look at this testimonial from Emilie Quellec and watch Julien Plessis, both part of the Enterprise Sales team 👀


⭐ Is it you we’re looking for?

You’ll be a great fit for the Enterprise team at Alan if you:

  • Have at least 8 years of experience in Sales, including at least 2 years managing the whole Enterprise Sales cycle, from prospecting to closing.

  • Have full working proficiency in French (C2 and above) and an advanced level in English.

  • Are highly organized with exceptional follow-up skills;

  • Have empathy and are passionate about understanding and solving prospects' problems;

  • Can influence through persuasion, negotiation, and consensus-building;

  • Have a deep understanding of value drivers in recurring revenue business models;

  • Have a great attitude and ability to collaborate in a small team;

  • Are eager to learn fast and make an impact from day 1;

  • Are based in (or willing to relocate to) Paris, Bordeaux, Marseille, Lyon, Annecy, Nantes or Biarritz.

For this opportunity, we are aiming to hire within the D-F level range.

If you're still wondering whether this could be the best move for you, take a look at this article from Lucie Leflour, our Sales Lead in France.

Alan exists to end the wait.

We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.

Disclaimer: We're open to hire Account Executives across our Paris, Bordeaux, Marseille, Lyon, Annecy, Nantes and Biarritz offices.

⭐️ The Enterprise Account Executive job

We’re expanding our Sales team in France and are looking for a ‘full-stack’ Enterprise Sales to engage with prospects and turn them into happy Alan customers. You will join a team that mostly focuses on large companies from Tech, Syntec, HCR, and B2B services, interacting with everyone from HR executives to CEOs.

Why is this segment interesting?

  • Diverse workforce: Mix of 60% cadres / 40% non-cadres, often with subsidiaries or multi-site operations, ranging from highly tech-savvy employees to those requiring digital adoption support.

  • Critical challenges: Multi-stakeholder decision processes involving HRD, CFO, CEO, Payroll, CSE, Legal, Purchasing, Comp & Ben, Accounting, Brokers (creating multiple potential blockers), long sales cycles (multi-year conversations), RFP processes requiring deep audits and product customization, and strong influence from unions/CSE who can co-manage health insurance topics;

  • Company profiles: Flagship companies (widely known brands), groups with standalone entities or subsidiaries, often with focus on employee wellbeing (QVT programs, Great Place to Work), modern company culture, and strategic communication about digitization or employer brand attractiveness;

  • HR priorities: Increasing productivity, obtaining fair and competitive pricing, contributing to employee well-being through customized health plans, simplifying HR processes with digital platforms, and managing change management concerns when implementing new health insurance (biggest fear for large companies)

  • Critical business characteristics: This segment requires breadth & depth of expertise to navigate complex organizations, account-based strategies with Key Account Management approach, early engagement in company roadmaps, face-to-face meetings, co-creation of insurance and digital products (tailored offers considering past results, specific regimes, demographics, payroll system integration), and ability to work through RFPs and with brokers. Sales cycles are volatile with high stakes: 1 deal = 50% of annual target for Enterprise AEs.

Our approach for Enterprise companies positions Alan as a strategic partner in health rather than just an insurance provider, emphasizing our digital platform for fluid UX, customized health plans at fair pricing, and health/well-being services. Success requires leveraging high-level connections, building professional materials, and potentially creating exclusive "Health Clubs" or labels for early adopters.

What will you do with us?

You’ll own the entire sales cycle, from prospecting to closing. In our Enterprise Sales team, you will deal with companies with more than 300 employees, including all CAC40 companies.

At Alan, Account Executives drive deals and close strategic opportunities with prospects. We sometimes handle some customer relationships to ensure the best possible onboarding. You’ll educate prospects, provide inspiring product demos, and onboard key stakeholders, making the transition from prospect to customer seamless.

We expect you to understand and apply the Alan Smart & Soft selling method. This method ensures the prospect experience is an integral part of the overall Alan customer experience—making it pleasant and delightful for everyone. We expect you to be instructive to prospects (Smart), as well as to define the best personalized high-touch strategy that suits best each prospect (Soft).

You’ll also help us grow and improve as a company, challenging us to enhance our product(s), methods, and strategy, and getting involved in initiatives to expand our customer base.

Take a look at this testimonial from Emilie Quellec and watch Julien Plessis, both part of the Enterprise Sales team 👀


⭐ Is it you we’re looking for?

You’ll be a great fit for the Enterprise team at Alan if you:

  • Have at least 6 years of experience in Sales, including at least 1 year managing the whole Enterprise Sales cycle, from prospecting to closing.

  • Have full working proficiency in French (C2 and above) and an advanced level in English.

  • Are highly organized with exceptional follow-up skills;

  • Have empathy and are passionate about understanding and solving prospects' problems;

  • Can influence through persuasion, negotiation, and consensus-building;

  • Have a deep understanding of value drivers in recurring revenue business models;

  • Have a great attitude and ability to collaborate in a small team;

  • Are eager to learn fast and make an impact from day 1;

  • Are based in (or willing to relocate to) Paris, Bordeaux, Marseille, Lyon, Annecy, Nantes or Biarritz.

For this opportunity, we are aiming to hire within the D-F level range.

If you're still wondering whether this could be the best move for you, take a look at this article from Lucie Leflour, our Sales Lead in France.


Everything else is a plus. We care about having a diversity of experiences, profiles and backgrounds in our team.


🙌 Perks & Benefits

At Alan, we believe that being in good health is a basic need, and it starts with our employees. This is why Alaners are provided with a stimulating environment and perks ensuring they are happy, efficient and spend only high-quality time with co-workers.

Therefore, we offer:

  • Fair rewards. Generous equity packages complement your base salary, for permanent contracts only.

  • Flexible office with hybrid setup. Amazing office space at our Paris HQ or sponsored co-working hubs in Bordeaux, Marseille, Lyon, Annecy, Nantes or Biarritz.

  • All the tools you need. Top of the range equipment: Macbook Air, keyboard, laptop stand, monitor, and Bose noise-canceling headphones.

  • Flexible vacation policy and flexible working hours. Organize your time as you wish.

  • Delightful healthcare insurance: Extremely comprehensive health insurance - 100% for you and your children, 90-100% for partners depending on your country (permanent contracts only).

  • Transport. Generous transit benefit

  • Personal growth through coaching: At Alan, coaching isn't just a perk - it's core to who we are. Every Alaner is paired with a dedicated coach from day one, who helps maximize their impact, nurture engagement, and navigate Alan's values to develop their full potential.

cb8423795e44a937.location: Paris, France; Bordeaux, France; Lyon, France; Marseille, France; Biarritz, France; Nantes, France; Annecy, France
cb8423795e44a937.description:
Health can’t wait.

Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t.

Alan exists to end the wait.

Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way.

So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience.

We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.

We are looking for an experienced Partnership Manager to join our Accountant Partnerships team in France, specifically focused on building and developing relationships with accounting firms and accountant networks.

The core purpose of this role is to turn accounting firms into long-term Alan partners and advocates. You will help them recommend Alan to their clients, improve their day-to-day experience with health insurance and payroll administration, and generate qualified business opportunities for Alan’s Sales teams.

The accountant ecosystem represents a significant growth opportunity for Alan. France has approximately 22,000 accounting firms supporting around 3.5 million companies, and Alan’s existing Accountant Partnership channel has already generated significant ARR through a relatively small number of partners.

The team is now entering a new phase of development. We are hiring new Partnership Manager to help build a scalable, high-performing partner network and contribute to Alan’s ambition to make Accountant Partnerships a strategic growth channel.

Here is how your key outcomes will look like:

  1. Build and grow a strong partner network: Identify, prioritise and develop relationships with high-potential accounting firms and networks.

  2. Drive partnerships from discussion to activation: Lead partnership discussions, onboarding and launch, ensuring that Alan creates value for both accountants and their clients.

  3. Activate partners and generate business opportunities: Build engagement plans, support partner enablement and work closely with Sales to turn recommendations into qualified opportunities.

  4. Help scale the Accountant Partnerships model: Manage partner performance, share insights with internal teams and contribute to the development of scalable playbooks, tools and processes.

⭐ Is it you we’re looking for?

We’re looking for someone who combines strong partnership and commercial skills with the ability to build trusted relationships in a complex and evolving B2B ecosystem.

The ideal candidate will be comfortable managing partnerships from initial contact to activation and long-term development. They should enjoy working autonomously in an environment where there is still a lot to build.

You may be a great fit at Alan if you have/are:

  • 5+ years of experience in partnerships, business development, account management or customer success in a B2B environment

  • Experience managing partnerships throughout the full lifecycle, from prospecting and closing to activation and ongoing relationship management

  • Experience managing a portfolio of partners, ideally in a fast-growing company

  • Strong negotiation, communication, presentation and relationship-building skills

  • A data-oriented mindset, with the ability to track performance and prioritise opportunities

  • The ability to collaborate effectively with Sales, Marketing, Product, Data and Operations teams

  • An entrepreneurial mindset, strong ownership and the ability to work autonomously

  • Full professional fluency in French and professional fluency in English

Experience working directly with accounting firms, payroll providers, HR software or insurance companies would be a strong plus.

We are particularly interested in candidates who have experience with B2B distribution partnerships, where a third party recommends or distributes a solution to its own customers. Experience limited to technology integrations, co-marketing or visibility partnerships would be less relevant for this role.

For this opportunity, we are aiming to hire within the C0-D level.

Everything else is a plus. We care about having a diversity of experiences, profiles and backgrounds in our team.

🙌 Perks & Benefits

At Alan, we believe that being in good health is a basic need, and it starts with our employees. This is why Alaners are provided with a stimulating environment and perks ensuring they are happy, efficient and spend only high-quality time with co-workers.

Therefore, we offer:

  • Fair rewards. Generous equity packages complement your base salary, for permanent contracts only.

  • Flexible office with hybrid setup. Amazing office space at our Paris HQ or sponsored co-working hubs in Bordeaux, Marseille, Lyon, Annecy, Nantes or Biarritz.

  • All the tools you need. Top of the range equipment: Macbook Air, keyboard, laptop stand, monitor, and Bose noise-canceling headphones.

  • Flexible vacation policy and flexible working hours. Organize your time as you wish.

  • Delightful healthcare insurance: Extremely comprehensive health insurance - 100% for you and your children, 90-100% for partners depending on your country (permanent contracts only).

  • Transport. Generous transit benefit

  • Learning & Training opportunities. A highly flexible training policy free books and budget to attend and speak at conferences if the opportunity arises.

  • Personal growth through coaching: At Alan, coaching isn't just a perk - it's core to who we are. Every Alaner is paired with a dedicated coach from day one, who helps maximize their impact, nurture engagement, and navigate Alan's values to develop their full potential. Learn more about our coaching culture.

  • Parental leave. Extended parental leave for all new parents, for permanent contracts only.

Important note: we hire people not roles.

After reading this job description, if you feel like you don’t have all the necessary prerequisites but that it matches where you are now or what you'd like to grow into in your next position, we encourage you to apply!

Not everybody will enter our recruitment process, but all, no matter how underrepresented, should feel free to apply as it can only bring learnings or success.

409434e77b994c17.title: Senior Project Manager Financial Services (m/w/d)
409434e77b994c17.description:
Omnium ist die hybride Finanzberatungsplattform von G+D Netcetera für Schweizer Banken und Versicherungen. Die Lösung verbindet persönliche Beratung mit digitalen Werkzeugen und unterstützt Finanzinstitute dabei, ihre Kund:innen über alle Kanäle hinweg konsistent zu begleiten. So entstehen moderne Beratungserlebnisse und effiziente Prozesse für unsere Kunden.

Für unseren Bereich Financial Advisory suchen wir eine erfahrene Projektmanagement-Persönlichkeit, die anspruchsvolle Digitalisierungsprojekte rund um Omnium von der Planung bis zum erfolgreichen Abschluss steuert. Du verbindest Kund:innenbedürfnisse, fachliche Anforderungen und technische Umsetzung und sorgst dafür, dass unsere Lösungen verlässlich, transparent und mit nachhaltigem Mehrwert realisiert werden.

Dabei arbeitest du eng mit unseren Kund:innen, dem Produktmanagement, der Produktentwicklung und der technischen Integration zusammen. Du schaffst Klarheit über Ziele, Verantwortlichkeiten und Abhängigkeiten und führst interdisziplinäre Teams sicher durch alle Projektphasen.

Requirements

Deine Aufgaben

  • Du planst und realisierst Projekte zur Einführung und Weiterentwicklung unserer Omnichannel-Beratungslösung Omnium und integrierst diese in die Systemlandschaften unserer Kund:innen
  • Du trägst die Gesamtverantwortung für Qualität, Liefertermine, Ressourcen und Kosten
  • Du berichtest transparent über Projektfortschritt und Risiken und leitest frühzeitig geeignete Massnahmen ein
  • Du konzipierst und moderierst fachliche sowie technische Workshops
  • Du führst interdisziplinäre Projektteams mit agilen oder hybriden Projektmanagement-Methoden
  • Du koordinierst Produktmanagement, Produktentwicklung und technische Integration von der Konzeption bis zum offiziellen Projektabschluss
  • Du stellst die strukturierte Übergabe in den Betrieb sicher und begleitest den Kunden auch nach der Einführung. Sei es im Ticketing, Releases und in der Zusammenarbeit mit der IT-Betriebsorganisation

Dein Profil

  • Du hast mehrjährige Erfahrung in der Leitung komplexer Software- oder Digitalisierungsprojekte, idealerweise bei Banken, Versicherungen oder anderen regulierten Finanzinstituten
  • Du fühlst dich an der Schnittstelle zwischen Business und IT, Produktentwicklung und Delivery im Kundenumfeld sicher
  • Du beherrschst Projektgovernance, Budget- und Ressourcenplanung sowie Risiko- und Stakeholdermanagement
  • Du arbeitest routiniert mit agilen oder hybriden Vorgehensmodellen sowie Jira und Confluence
  • Du verfügst über eine höhere Fachausbildung oder ein Studium in Wirtschaftsinformatik, Informatik, Betriebswirtschaft oder einer vergleichbaren Fachrichtung
  • Du überzeugst mit planerischem und lösungsorientiertem Denken, einer strukturierten Arbeitsweise, sicherem Auftreten sowie sehr guten Deutsch- und Englischkenntnissen. Französischkenntnisse sind von Vorteil

Was dich bei uns erwartet

Du triffst auf ein Umfeld, in dem Expertise in Finanzdienstleistungen, Technologie und Beratung zusammenkommt. Wir arbeiten partnerschaftlich, unkompliziert und auf Augenhöhe, mit unseren Kund:innen genauso wie innerhalb des Teams. Eigeninitiative und unternehmerisches Denken sind bei uns ausdrücklich erwünscht. Wissen wird geteilt und gemeinsam suchen wir nach der besten Lösung.

Du erhältst viel Gestaltungsspielraum und übernimmst eine zentrale Rolle bei der erfolgreichen Einführung und Weiterentwicklung von Omnium. Mit deiner Projektführung prägst du nicht nur die Zusammenarbeit mit unseren Kund:innen, sondern auch unsere Delivery-Prozesse und die Weiterentwicklung unserer Projektmanagement-Standards.

Wenn du komplexe Vorhaben gerne strukturierst, Menschen und Themen zusammenbringst und Projekte mit klarem Blick für Kundennutzen und Umsetzungserfolg zum Ziel führst, freuen wir uns darauf, dich kennenzulernen.

Für diese Vakanz berücksichtigen wir ausschliesslich Direktbewerbungen.

Benefits

  • Private Health Insurance
  • Pension Plan
  • Paid Time Off
  • Work From Home
  • Training & Development

606d0a85398efc54.description:
Für ein spannendes Projekt bei unserem Kunden im Raum Zürich (mit Remote-Anteil) suchen wir einen Senior Projektleiter (m/w/d) - IT Service Management (ITSM).

Key Facts
Start: 01.12.2026
Dauer: 6 Monate /
Auslastung: 100 %
Einsatzart:
Einsatzort: Raum Zürich
Einsatzland: Schweiz


Ihre Aufgaben

• Gesamtplanung und operative Steuerung des Projekts von der Initialisierung bis zur Übergabe in den Regelbetrieb; Definition und Überwachung von Scope, Deliverables, Meilensteinen, Ressourcen und Budget sowie Aufbau und Führung der Projekt-Governance und Vorbereitung und Leitung von Projekt- und Steering-Committee-Sitzungen

• Steuerung der fachlichen und technischen Workstreams sowie Koordination der internen Fach- und IT-Stellen, ITSM Process Owner, relevanten Fachbereiche, Softwareanbieter und Implementierungspartner; Management von Risiken, Issues, Abhängigkeiten und Eskalationen sowie adressatengerechtes Reporting an Auftraggeber und Management

• Koordination des ITSM-Prozess- und Lösungsdesigns, Sicherstellung eines pragmatischen Fit-to-Standard-Ansatzes und Überführung der Anforderungen in ein konsistentes Solution Design für die relevanten Prozesse, darunter Incident und Major Incident Management, Service Request, Problem, Change Enablement, Service Catalogue, Knowledge Management, Configuration Management / CMDB, Monitoring und Event Management sowie Reporting und Dashboards

• Steuerung der Konfiguration und technischen Implementierung der Plattform sowie Koordination der Umsysteme und Schnittstellen; Sicherstellung der Integrationen zu Monitoring und Event Management, IAM und relevanten Datenquellen, Koordination des CMDB-Aufbaus beziehungsweise der Übernahme bestehender Konfigurations- und Service-Daten und Berücksichtigung von Architektur-, Security- und regulatorischen Anforderungen

• Planung und Steuerung der Datenmigration aus der bestehenden ITSM-Lösung

• Aufbau und Steuerung des Test- und Abnahmekonzepts, Koordination von System-, Integrations- und User-Acceptance-Tests sowie Planung und Steuerung des Cutovers und Sicherstellung der Operational Readiness

• Koordination von Schulung und Kommunikation sowie Führung der Go-live- und Hypercare-Phase

• Strukturierte Übergabe der Plattform und der zugehörigen Abläufe an die zukünftige Betriebsorganisation



Muss-Anforderungen

• Langjährige Erfahrung im IT Service Management und mit Enterprise-ITSM-Plattformen, idealerweise im Bankenumfeld

• Fundierte Kenntnisse in Incident, Major Incident, Problem, Request und Change Management sowie in Service Catalogue und Knowledge Management

• Fundierte Kenntnisse im CMDB- beziehungsweise Configuration Management sowie in Monitoring und Event Management

• Umfassende Erfahrung mit ITSM-Integrationen und Schnittstellen, komplexen Integrations- und Migrationsvorhaben sowie Datenmigration

• Erfahrung im Test- und Cutover-Management

• Fundierte Kenntnisse in klassischem sowie agilem oder hybridem Projektmanagement

• Erfahrung im Stakeholder-, Risiko- und Vendor-Management

• Ausgewiesene Erfahrung in der Leitung komplexer IT-Projekte, idealerweise mit mindestens 8 Jahren Erfahrung

• Mehrjährige Erfahrung im IT Service Management

• Nachweisbare Verantwortung für mindestens eine End-to-End-Einführung oder Migration einer Enterprise-ITSM-Plattform

• Erfahrung von der Projektinitialisierung und dem Solution Design über Migration und Go-live bis zur Übergabe in den Betrieb

• Sehr versiert in der Steuerung von Softwareherstellern, Implementierungspartnern und weiteren externen Providern sowie in der Zusammenarbeit mit Steering Committees und Senior-Management-Stakeholdern

• Nachweis relevanter Erfahrung anhand konkreter Referenzprojekte mit Angaben zu Rolle, Projektumfang, eingesetzter ITSM-Plattform und Verantwortungsbereich

• Starke Kommunikations-, Moderations- und Eskalationsfähigkeiten

• Offene Persönlichkeit mit einer raschen Auffassungsgabe

• Verhandlungssichere Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift



Kann-Anforderungen

• ITIL 4- oder ITIL-5-Zertifizierung

• PMP-, PRINCE2- oder vergleichbare Projektmanagement-Zertifizierung

• Erfahrung im Banken-, Versicherungs- oder sonstigen regulierten Umfeld sowie Kenntnisse regulatorischer Anforderungen im Schweizer Finanzsektor



Weitere Informationen

- Einsatzdauer: ab sofort für 6 Monate mit Option auf Verlängerung


- Pensum: 80-100%


- Einsatzort: Raum Zürich & Remote - pro Woche

Hier verbinden Sie technische Tiefe mit dem Blick fürs Ganze. Sie bringen Ihre Erfahrung in die Projektgestaltung ein und begleiten durchdachte Lösungen bis zur Realisierung. Dabei arbeiten Sie mit Fachleuten verschiedener Disziplinen zusammen – ein Umfeld für Menschen, die Verantwortung übernehmen, den fachlichen Austausch schätzen und gemeinsam tragfähige Ergebnisse erzielen wollen.

Ihre Aufgaben

  • Anspruchsvolle Projekte im Bereich Unterwerke und Hochspannungsanlagen mit Schwerpunkt Primärtechnik fachlich und kommerziell verantworten, steuern und koordinieren
  • Projekte vom Engineering über die Beschaffung und Realisierung bis zur Inbetriebnahme begleiten und dabei die technischen Zusammenhänge im Blick behalten
  • Fachteams, Lieferanten und Ausführungspartner zusammenbringen und für ein reibungsloses Zusammenspiel an den technischen Schnittstellen sorgen
  • Technische Projektdokumentationen prüfen und die Einhaltung der relevanten Schweizer Normen sowie der Vorgaben der Netzbetreiber sicherstellen
  • Fundierte Entscheidungsgrundlagen erarbeiten und gemeinsam mit den Beteiligten praxistaugliche Lösungen für technische Herausforderungen entwickeln
  • Termine, Qualität und technische Umsetzung verantworten und den Projektfortschritt vorausschauend steuern

Ihr Profil

  • Technische Grundausbildung mit einer Weiterbildung auf Stufe HF oder FH, vorzugsweise in Elektrotechnik oder Energietechnik
  • Fundierte Erfahrung in der Leitung anspruchsvoller Unterwerks- und Hochspannungsprojekte sowie vertiefte Kenntnisse der Primärtechnik
  • Praktische Erfahrung im Engineering, in der Realisierung und in der Inbetriebnahme von Hochspannungsanlagen
  • Vertrautheit mit den Schweizer Normen und regulatorischen Anforderungen sowie den technischen Vorgaben von Energieversorgern und Netzbetreibern
  • Sicheres Urteilsvermögen bei der Prüfung technischer Unterlagen und die Fähigkeit, komplexe Fragestellungen in tragfähige Lösungen zu übersetzen
  • Kommunikationsstärke und fachliche Überzeugungskraft im Austausch mit Kunden, Fachteams und Projektpartnern
  • Fliessende Deutschkenntnisse; Englisch sowie Französisch oder Italienisch von Vorteil

b39b84ba3fb0e6ae.description:

Du hast Ideen. Du hast ein Auge für Ästhetik. Und du setzt um.

Du liebst gutes Essen, besondere Orte und Geschichten, die Menschen begeistern? Du kannst eine Website betreuen, Social Media mit Leben füllen, überzeugende Texte schreiben und gleichzeitig mit der Kamera starke Inhalte produzieren?

Dann möchten wir dich kennenlernen.

Das ACQUA Basel ist mehr als ein Restaurant. In einem ehemaligen Wasserwerk verbinden wir italienische Lebensfreude mit urbanem Lifestyle. Osteria, Bar, Lounge, Garten und Events schaffen einen einzigartigen Ort mitten in Basel.

Damit unsere Welt auch digital begeistert, suchen wir eine kreative, vielseitige und selbstständige Persönlichkeit, die unsere gesamte Kommunikation und unseren Marketingauftritt mitgestaltet.

Aufgaben

Von der ersten Idee bis zur fertigen Umsetzung.

  • Marketing & Kommunikation: Du planst und koordinierst unsere Marketingaktivitäten, entwickelst Kampagnen und sorgst für einen einheitlichen, hochwertigen Markenauftritt.

  • Social Media: Du betreust unsere Social-Media-Kanäle, entwickelst Contentideen, erstellst Redaktionspläne und veröffentlichst Beiträge, Stories und Reels.

  • Foto & Video: Du stehst selbst hinter der Kamera, fotografierst unsere Gerichte, Drinks, Menschen und Events und produzierst eigenständig ansprechende Videos inklusive Schnitt und Nachbearbeitung.

  • Website: Du pflegst und aktualisierst unsere Website, erstellst neue Inhalte und sorgst dafür, dass Angebote, Veranstaltungen und Informationen immer aktuell sind.

  • Grafik & Design: Du gestaltest Flyer, Menükarten, Plakate, digitale Werbemittel und weitere Kommunikationsmaterialien.

  • Events & Promotion: Du begleitest unsere Veranstaltungen kommunikativ, entwickelst Promotionsideen und setzt diese gemeinsam mit dem Team um.

  • Newsletter & digitale Kommunikation: Du erstellst Newsletter, verfasst überzeugende Texte und betreust weitere digitale Kommunikationskanäle.

  • Online Marketing: Du unterstützt bei digitalen Werbekampagnen, analysierst deren Wirkung und entwickelst unsere Onlinepräsenz kontinuierlich weiter.

  • Organisation & Koordination: Du arbeitest eng mit der Geschäftsleitung und dem Gastronomieteam zusammen, koordinierst externe Partner und behältst auch bei mehreren Projekten den Überblick.

Qualifikation

Du bist kreativ im Kopf und stark in der Umsetzung.

  • Du bringst praktische Erfahrung in Marketing, Kommunikation, Social Media oder Content Creation mit.

  • Du kannst selbstständig fotografieren, filmen und Videos professionell schneiden.

  • Du schreibst stilsicher, kreativ und zielgruppengerecht auf Deutsch.

  • Du arbeitest strukturiert, eigenverantwortlich und lösungsorientiert.

  • Du bist flexibel und bereit, gelegentlich auch abends bei Veranstaltungen vor Ort zu sein.

  • Lösungen entwickeln: Sie beurteilen Systemvarianten, legen die Gebäudetechnik aus und verbinden Funktion, Energieeffizienz und architektonische Anforderungen.

Was Sie dafür mitbringen

  • Ingenieur/in FH oder Techniker/in HF Gebäudetechnik mit mehrjähriger Erfahrung in der HLK-Planung

  • Sie verstehen das Zusammenspiel der Systeme und arbeiten gerne an der Schnittstelle zur Ausführung

396b7f86140e01b0.title: Systemtechniker HF Automation (m/w/d)
396b7f86140e01b0.description:
Über ScaleZ GmbH

Hinter jeder Stelle, die wir ausschreiben, steht ein Betrieb, den wir persönlich kennen. ScaleZ ist ein Headhunting-Unternehmen aus Zürich, spezialisiert auf Architektur, Bau, Gebäudetechnik und Industrie in der Deutschschweiz. Wir arbeiten mit Planungsbüros und Bauunternehmen zusammen, die Menschen suchen, die bleiben wollen.

Bei uns sprichst du von Anfang an mit einem Menschen, der dir ehrlich sagt, was hinter einer Stelle steckt, von den Projekten bis zum Lohn. Und wer einmal mit uns gesprochen hat, hört wieder von uns, auch wenn die Nachricht keine frohe ist.

Stellenbeschreibung

Systemtechniker:in HF Automation im Raum Zürich, 80 bis 100 Prozent, mit einem Lohn von CHF 97'500 bis 136'500 pro Jahr. Für einen hoch spezialisierten Technologiebetrieb suchen wir eine Automatisierungsfachkraft, die mit SPS Anlagen zum Leben erweckt, die es so kein zweites Mal gibt.

Jedes Projekt ist hier ein Einzelstück, vom ersten Funktionsbeschrieb bis zum Moment, in dem die Anlage zum ersten Mal sauber anläuft und das ganze Team kurz den Atem anhält.

Seilbahnen und Bergbahnen

Deine Steuerungen bewegen Gondeln über Gletscher und Bergkuppen. Wenn morgens um acht die erste Kabine aus der Talstation fährt, läuft deine Software, und tausende Gäste verlassen sich darauf, ohne je deinen Namen zu kennen.

Pharma und Medizintechnik

Du automatisierst Anlagen, auf denen Medikamente und Medizinprodukte entstehen, mit höchsten Anforderungen an Präzision, Sauberkeit und Validierung. Hier zählt jede Zeile Code, weil am Ende Menschen davon profitieren.

Energie und Wasserkraft

Du steuerst Kraftwerke, Pumpspeicher und Netze, die das Land mit Strom versorgen. Deine Arbeit sitzt im Herzen der Energiewende, irgendwo zwischen Staumauer und Leitstand.

Bahn- und Tunneltechnik

Du automatisierst Lüftung, Beleuchtung und Sicherheitssysteme in Tunneln und Bahnanlagen. Wenn du durch den nächsten Tunnel fährst, weisst du, wer dafür sorgt, dass alles läuft.

Die Stelle auf einen Blick

  • Funktion: Systemtechniker:in HF mit Schwerpunkt SPS und Automation

  • Arbeitsort: Raum Zürich, Inbetriebnahmen in der Schweiz

  • Pensum: 80 bis 100 Prozent, Festanstellung

  • Lohn: CHF 97'500 bis 136'500 pro Jahr bei 100 Prozent

  • Technik: SPS-Programmierung, Visualisierung und Inbetriebnahme

  • Start: nach Vereinbarung

Deine Aufgaben

Du begleitest deine Anlagen vom ersten Konzept bis zur Übergabe und bist dabei Ingenieur, Tüftler und Problemlöser in einer Person.

  • Du entwickelst und programmierst Steuerungen auf SPS-Basis, zum Beispiel mit Siemens TIA Portal oder Beckhoff TwinCAT

  • Du erstellst Visualisierungen und Bedienoberflächen, damit Betreiber ihre Anlagen intuitiv steuern können

  • Du nimmst Anlagen vor Ort in Betrieb, testest sie und optimierst sie bis ins Detail

  • Du arbeitest eng mit Mechanik, Elektroplanung und Kundschaft zusammen und übersetzt Anforderungen in saubere Software

  • Du dokumentierst deine Lösungen so, dass auch in zehn Jahren noch jemand versteht, was du gebaut hast

Das bringst du mit

Du erfüllst nicht jeden Punkt zu hundert Prozent? Bewirb dich trotzdem. Was wirklich zählt, klären wir am besten im Gespräch.

  • Eine Weiterbildung als Techniker:in HF Systemtechnik, Elektrotechnik oder Automation, oder eine vergleichbare Ausbildung

  • Eine Grundbildung als Automatiker:in EFZ, Elektroniker:in EFZ, Elektroinstallateur:in EFZ oder ähnlich

  • Mehrjährige Erfahrung in der SPS-Programmierung und in Inbetriebnahmen

  • Freude daran, technische Herausforderungen zu lösen, für die es noch kein Handbuch gibt

  • Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse und Reisebereitschaft für Inbetriebnahmen in der Schweiz

Deine Vorteile

  • Projekte in einer Nischenbranche, über die du beim Abendessen gern erzählst

  • Echte Gestaltungsfreiheit bei jeder technischen Lösung

  • Moderne Engineering-Tools und Testumgebungen auf dem neuesten Stand

  • Gezielte Weiterbildung, etwa Herstellerzertifikate oder der nächste Schritt in Richtung FH

  • Ein Team aus Spezialist:innen, in dem Wissen grosszügig geteilt wird

  • Ein Lohnband auf Augenhöhe mit deinem Fachwissen

Deine ersten Schritte mit uns

Schick uns deinen Lebenslauf, ein Motivationsschreiben brauchen wir nicht. Innert zwei Arbeitstagen rufen wir dich an und erzählen dir in 15 Minuten alles, was nicht in dieser Anzeige steht.

Passt es für beide Seiten, organisieren wir das Gespräch und begleiten dich bis zur Unterschrift. Dein Dossier geht dabei nur mit deiner Zustimmung weiter.

Du möchtest zuerst reden? Dann buch dir direkt einen kurzen Termin mit Kevin Kigle.

15 Minuten und du weisst, ob diese Anlage deine nächste ist!

1e081bb4be353841.title: Director of Finance - Ecosystem
1e081bb4be353841.description:
Who We Are

You've ordered dinner through Just Eat Takeaway. You've bought and sold on OLX. You've paid with PayU. Chances are, you've already used a Prosus company today.

We are Prosus, a global technology company powering some of the world's leading lifestyle ecommerce businesses. Every day, billions of people across India, Latin America, Europe and beyond use our products and services to buy, sell, pay, connect and discover.

Our AI-driven ecosystem spans 100+ companies across ecommerce, food delivery, fintech and experiences, serving billions of consumers worldwide. AI powers how we operate and innovate, with more than 60,000 active AI agents helping our teams build, scale and move faster. Through our investment team, we also back the founders and technologies shaping the future: From robotics and autonomous systems to synthetic biology and frontier AI.

Guided by our five values Innovation, Results, People, Impact, and Entrepreneurship, culture is our competitive advantage. We thrive with experimentation; we build, we test, we learn, we iterate.

Join us in shaping the future of technology at global scale.

The Opportunity

The Strategic Finance, Planning & Analysis team drives financial performance management across Prosus's global ecosystems - partnering with operating companies and Group Finance to ensure targets are met and capital is deployed effectively. The EU ecosystem team sits at the centre of Prosus's ambition to build a leading lifestyle e-commerce platform in Europe, and this Director role is the financial engine behind that ambition.

You'll own the full Strategic FP&A function for Prosus's European portfolio, managing the annual budgeting, planning, and forecasting cycle across a multi-entity, multi-country ecosystem, and leading the operating cadences that keep business unit CFOs, ecosystem leads, and Group Finance aligned. Within your first 60 days, you'll have established a working rhythm with every BU and minority investment finance team in the region. Within your first quarter, you'll hold full ownership of the EU ecosystem budgeting and forecasting cycle.

This is an active moment for the portfolio. M&A and divestiture activity is ongoing, and you'll be a direct contributor to at least one strategic transaction within your first year, not as a reviewer, but as a hands-on partner to the ecosystem leads driving those decisions. The team you'll lead is five to six direct reports; developing their capabilities and raising the bar on finance practice across the BU finance teams is as much a part of the role as the numbers themselves.

This isn't a reporting function. This is financial leadership for one of Prosus's most strategically significant regions.

Who You Are

You think in systems and act with precision. You're comfortable holding the full picture of a complex, multi-entity portfolio while also rolling up your sleeves on the analysis that makes a business case credible or a forecast defensible. Ambiguity doesn't slow you down - you move forward with the information available, surface the brutal facts clearly, and adjust as the picture sharpens.

You've built trust with senior stakeholders before - CFOs, business leads, Group Finance counterparts, not just by managing up but by being the person in the room who brings clarity. You give direct, evidence-based points of view and create space for the people around you to do the same. You care about the growth of your team as much as the quality of the output, and you understand that both are how a finance function earns its seat at the table.

What You Bring

- Deep experience in finance or FP&A at group or multi-entity level, with a background in digital economy, e-commerce, consumer internet, or a closely adjacent sector

- Proven ability to lead end-to-end budgeting, forecasting, and planning cycles across complex, matrixed organisations - coordinating multiple finance teams toward a single, coherent view

- Hands-on track record analysing financial statements, business cases, and performance data to surface actionable insight for senior decision-makers

- Comfortable partnering directly with business unit CFOs and ecosystem leads on strategic projects including M&A, divestiture, and performance benchmarking with the credibility to challenge and the judgement to know when to align

- Experience managing and developing a finance team, with a genuine investment in building capability at every level

- Fluent English communication, written and spoken, with the ability to translate financial complexity into clear, concise narratives for diverse audiences

- Familiarity with Group Finance functions (tax, treasury, reporting, consolidation) and how a finance function at this level interfaces with each

- Experience with Hyperion or OneStream is a plus

- Background in minority investment oversight or portfolio company finance is a plus

- Exposure to multi-country or cross-border finance environments in Europe is a plus

Your Typical Day

Your day might begin with a performance review call with a business unit CFO - working through the latest actuals, flagging variances, and agreeing on the narrative before it reaches Group Finance. From there, you're likely in the detail: a forecast model that needs stress-testing, a business case for a potential acquisition, or a consolidation question that cuts across tax, treasury, and reporting.

Throughout the day, your team is moving in parallel - running analyses, preparing materials, coordinating with BU finance counterparts across the EU. You check in, unblock, and give direct feedback. By afternoon, you might be in a working session with an ecosystem lead on a live strategic project, or preparing the ecosystem performance summary that feeds into the Group FP&A cycle.

What We Offer

- Global Impact: Play a crucial role in shaping the future of global commerce.

- Growth Opportunities: Expand your expertise through diverse global challenges and unique opportunities.

- Innovative Culture: Join a forward-thinking team that values strategic insights and fosters continuous innovation.

- Creative Environment: Engage in work that encourages creativity and constant improvement.

- Collaborative Atmosphere: Benefit from autonomy and self-management in a supportive and positive workspace.

- Hybrid Work: Experience the satisfaction of our flexible model tailored to balance work and life.

- Competitive Compensation: Enjoy a salary package that reflects your skills and contributions.

- Comprehensive Benefits: From health and wellness to learning, and everyday perks, we offer a well-rounded package designed to help you thrive at work and beyond.

Why Prosus?

At Prosus, your colleagues include 60,000 AI agents… and your job is to figure out what that actually means. We're one of the largest operators of agentic AI on the planet, inside a $100B+ portfolio across 100+ companies and two billion people. The humans here own what AI can't do alone: judgment, creativity, and the call on what gets built next.

Own the impact. Work the ecosystem. Earn your growth. Build with backing.

Curious about our perks and benefits? Take a look at this page.

Our Diversity & Inclusion Commitment

We respect the dignity and human rights of individuals and communities wherever we operate in the world. Building an inclusive workplace where everyone feels welcome and can thrive is critical for us. We provide access to education, which helps everyone understand the important role they play and the positive impact they can have.

Want to know more about life at Prosus? Explore our culture and values.

8dc72996c9cb7990.title: Senior Cyber Security Specialist
8dc72996c9cb7990.description:
Who We Are

You've ordered dinner through Just Eat Takeaway. You've bought and sold on OLX. You've paid with PayU. Chances are, you've already used a Prosus company today.

We are Prosus, a global technology company powering some of the world's leading lifestyle ecommerce businesses. Every day, billions of people across India, Latin America, Europe and beyond use our products and services to buy, sell, pay, connect and discover.

Our AI-driven ecosystem spans 100+ companies across ecommerce, food delivery, fintech and experiences, serving billions of consumers worldwide. AI powers how we operate and innovate, with more than 60,000 active AI agents helping our teams build, scale and move faster. Through our investment team, we also back the founders and technologies shaping the future: From robotics and autonomous systems to synthetic biology and frontier AI.

Guided by our five values Innovation, Results, People, Impact, and Entrepreneurship, culture is our competitive advantage. We thrive with experimentation; we build, we test, we learn, we iterate.

Join us in shaping the future of technology at global scale.

The Problem You'll Solve

As a Senior Cyber Specialist, you'll be part of Prosus' Global Cyber team, helping our businesses identify, understand and manage their most critical cyber and technology risks.

You'll work across a diverse portfolio of businesses, delivering hands-on security testing, advisory and assurance projects that strengthen security.

You will use AI natively in everything you do. Your work will span a broad range of cybersecurity and technology domains, including:

  • Delivering cyber risk assessments, security reviews and controls testing across complex technology environments.

  • Conducting red teaming exercises and long-term Advanced Persistent Threat (APT) simulations to identify vulnerabilities and test organisational resilience.

  • Assessing cloud infrastructure, data platforms, DevOps environments and CI/CD pipelines to identify security weaknesses and opportunities for improvement.

  • Designing and facilitating cyber crisis simulations to test business preparedness and incident response capabilities.

  • Providing practical, constructive recommendations that help management strengthen security without slowing down innovation or business growth.

  • Partnering with technology and business leaders across our global portfolio to translate complex technical risks into meaningful business outcomes.

This is a full-time global role based in our Amsterdam (Zuidas) office, with up to 30% international travel.

Who You Are

  • A hands-on cybersecurity professional with strong technical specialist experience in offensive security, security engineering or red teaming. You enjoy getting into the technical detail, investigating threats and identifying weaknesses rather than focusing solely on governance, risk and compliance.

  • An AI and technology enthusiast who enjoys understanding how systems work, building harnesses and getting hands-on with complex technical environments.

  • Comfortable navigating code, CI/CD pipelines, cloud environments and modern technology architectures.

  • Entrepreneurial in your mindset, with exposure to both fast-moving start-ups and larger, more mature IT organisations, not afraid to use AI to get the job done.

  • A confident communicator who can build trusted relationships, tell compelling stories and translate technical concepts into clear business language.

  • Equally comfortable engaging with CTOs, CIOs, security leaders, architects, developers and system administrators.

  • A global mindset, with interests beyond technology and an openness to travelling internationally, including to less conventional destinations.

What You Bring

  • 3–7 years of relevant professional experience in cybersecurity, with a strong technical foundation in offensive security, threat intelligence, red teaming or related disciplines.

  • Practical experience conducting or supporting penetration tests, security assessments, adversary simulations, threat investigations or other offensive security activities.

  • Hands on work with AI harnesses and offensive AI models.

  • Experience working with cloud technologies, data platforms and modern software engineering environments.

  • Experience working across different organisational environments, ideally including both entrepreneurial and more established technology businesses.

  • Relevant certifications such as CEH, OSCP, CISSP, CISM or CISA are welcome, but we value practical technical expertise and hands-on experience over certifications alone.

Why Prosus?

At Prosus, your colleagues include 60,000 AI agents… and your job is to figure out what that actually means. We're one of the largest operators of agentic AI on the planet, inside a $100B+ portfolio across 100+ companies and two billion people. The humans here own what AI can't do alone: judgment, creativity, and the call on what gets built next.

Own the impact. Work the ecosystem. Earn your growth. Build with backing.

Curious about our perks and benefits? Take a look at this page.

Our Diversity & Inclusion Commitment

We respect the dignity and human rights of individuals and communities wherever we operate in the world. Building an inclusive workplace where everyone feels welcome and can thrive is critical for us. We provide access to education, which helps everyone understand the important role they play and the positive impact they can have.

Want to know more about life at Prosus? Explore our culture and values.

5330ceab0795db46.title: Large Enterprise Account Executive, Nordics & Benelux
5330ceab0795db46.description:
The AI orchestration of your wildest imagination.

n8n is the open workflow orchestration platform built for the new era of AI. We give technical teams the freedom of code with the speed of no-code, so they can automate faster, smarter, and without limits. Backed by a fiercely inventive community and 500+ builder-approved integrations, we’re changing the way people bring systems together and scale ideas for impact.

Since our founding in 2019, we’ve grown into a diverse team of over 260 - working across Europe and the US, connected by a shared builder spirit and with our centre of gravity in Berlin. Along the way, we’ve:

  • Cultivated a community of more than 650,000 active developers and builders

  • Earned 190K+ GitHub stars, making us one of the world’s Top 40 most popular projects

  • Backed by top investors, from Sequoia’s first German seed to our SAP's recent strategic investment - bringing us to a $5.2bn valuation


That’s the company we’ve built. Now we’d love to see what you can build. If you’re applying, try n8n out - whether you’re technical or not - and share a screenshot of your first workflow with us. The easiest place to start is here: app.n8n.cloud/register.

We’re in a defining moment of an incredible journey. Come and build with us.

🎯 Your main goal will be to land and expand n8n inside the world’s largest organisations, closing the biggest deals in our portfolio.

As a Large Enterprise Account Executive covering Nordics & Benelux, you will own a territory of global-scale accounts and lead long, complex deals from first conversation to multi-year commitment:

BUILD STRATEGIC ACCOUNT PLANS

  • Build and execute account strategies for organisations with 5,001 or more employees

  • Open doors with outbound campaigns aimed at CTOs, CIOs and engineering and platform leaders.

  • Turn community adoption inside large companies into sponsored, funded opportunities.

LEAD COMPLEX, MULTI-THREADED DEALS

  • Run deep discovery, quantify business impact and build an executive-level business case.

  • Map and align decision makers across engineering, IT, security, legal and procurement.

  • Partner with Solutions Engineers, Partnerships and Customer Success to prove value and de-risk adoption.

CLOSE AND EXPAND AT SCALE

  • Own the cycle through security, legal and procurement, typically over three to six months or more.

  • Negotiate six-figure deals with confidence and keep clear commercial control.

  • Plan expansion across business units and use cases, and share what you learn with Product and leadership.

REQUIREMENTS

Must-haves

  • 🏢 Large Enterprise sales: You have at least five years of enterprise SaaS sales experience, selling into organisations with 5,001 or more employees, and you can explain customer size, deal complexity and cycle length.

  • 💰 Six-figure deals: You have closed multiple deals of £100k+ ACV in multi-stakeholder cycles of three to six months or more.

  • 🧑‍💻 Technical buyers and executives: You have sold to developers, engineers, CTOs and CIOs, and you can carry a technical conversation and an executive one in the same deal.

  • 🎯 New-logo hunter: You generate your own pipeline through outbound and win new customers rather than relying on expansion or inbound.

  • 📈 Track record: You have consistently hit or exceeded quota over the past two to three years.

  • 🧭 Structured selling: You use a methodology such as MEDDPICC and navigate technical evaluations, procurement, legal and security reviews.

  • 📍 Location: You are based in the Nordics / Benelux. This role involves regular travel to customers in the region.

Nice-to-haves

  • 🛠️ Technical product background: You have sold developer tools, cloud infrastructure, data, AI or automation platforms.

  • 🤝 Partner-led deals: You have worked deals with system integrators or cloud partners.

  • 🚀 Open source or PLG exposure: You understand how community adoption turns into enterprise revenue.

Why join us?

You will close the largest deals in our portfolio and shape how n8n sells to the world’s biggest organisations, with a product technical teams already use and love. You will work closely with Solutions Engineers, Partnerships, Customer Success and Product, and leadership will listen to what you learn in the field. n8n is growing at an exceptional pace, backed by a vibrant community and a remote-first culture built on autonomy, experimentation and high talent density. Apply now and help us bring AI-powered automation to the global enterprise.

n8n is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

We can sponsor visas to Germany; for any other country, you need to have existing right to work.

Our company language is English.

You care about diversity and inclusion? We do too! Check out our Diversity, Inclusion and Belonging initiatives at n8n (https://www.notion.so/n8n/Diversity-inclusion-and-belonging-n8n-c1bec2fff536422d868b1a438d990e35).

Location disclaimer: If you see multiple job postings for the same role, it is most likely because we're hiring remotely for this role and posting in different locations to make sure every potential candidate can see the role. Please apply to the location you're the most likely to work from in the future.

Benefits

  • Competitive compensation 💸 – We offer fair and attractive pay.

  • Ownership 💪 – Our core value is to “empower others,” and we mean it—you’ll get a slice of n8n with equity.

  • Work/life balance 🏖️ – We work hard but ensure you have time to recharge:

    • Europe: 30 days of vacation, plus public holidays wherever you are.

    • US: 20 vacation days, 8 sick days, plus public holidays wherever you are.

  • Health & wellness 🩺 –

    • Europe: We provide benefits according to local country norms.*

    • US: Multiple low-premium, low-deductible medical plans with coverage for individuals and families—plus a no-cost premium HDHP option with a pre-seeded HSA—along with dental and vision coverage.

  • Future planning 💰 –

    • Europe: We provide pension contributions according to local country norms.*

    • US: 401(k) retirement plan with a 4% employer match.

  • Financial security 🛡️ –

    • Europe: We provide benefits according to local country norms.*

    • US: Company-paid short-term and long-term disability insurance, plus life insurance to support you and your loved ones.

  • Career growth 📈 – We hire rising stars who grow with us! You’ll get €1K (or equivalent) per year to spend on courses, books, events, or coaching to level up your skills.

  • A passionate team 🤩 – We love our product, and we prove it with regular hackathons where we see who can build the coolest thing with it!

  • Remote-first 🌏 – Our team works remotely across Europe, with regular off-sites for team bonding. Some roles, like sales in the US, are hybrid—please check the job description.

  • Giving back 🤝 – We're big fans of open source, and you'll get $100 per month to support projects you care about.

  • Transparency 🙏 – We all know what everyone’s working on, how the company is doing—the whole shebang.

*Country and/or State specific details provided in your employment agreement.

3a7e4a6687c26615.title: Security Architect
3a7e4a6687c26615.description:
Are you a security specialist in the OT space looking to expand your expertise into cloud solutions? Are you a cloud security champion passionate about bringing your expertise into OT/IoT space? At Priva Product Development Organisation we are looking for the Security Architect who will shape the security of our products.  

  

Security Architect in Priva Product Development – Why this role matters 

At Priva, we develop hardware products and software services for horticulture and building automation. Seeing the importance of our products for our customers, we recognize the need to continuously keep these secure in the ever evolving, fast-paced world. The security requirements in our landscape span four different areas: 

  1. Physical/embedded device security. 

  1. OT (operational technology) network security. 

  1. OT network to Priva-hosted cloud services communications. 

  1. Priva's hybrid on-prem/multi-cloud platform applications security, including applications, infrastructure, CI/CD pipelines.  

What makes this role truly unique is that our products contain long-lived hardware components that our customers run for years. Engineering future-proofed security solutions and maintaining a security posture at existing sites across all these areas having wide range of varying implementations and security needs creates a great challenge and a great fun. 

As part of the architecture team, you will play a key role in shaping the future of Priva's portfolio offered on the global market. You define security standards, security practices and security designs for our products that are used in tens of thousands of buildings and greenhouses. You work across product, engineering, and operations teams to ensure security controls and adhered to, implemented and tested as you have designed these. That’s real impact. 

What you will be doing 

As a Security Architect, you have a very simple mission: you see to it that Priva's hardware products and software (cloud) services are secured against known and emergent threats in lines with the industry standards and practices. You build upon your strong background in securing device/OT networks, cloud applications, and engraining the security practices in the daily work of Agile teams to achieve consistent security posture across all Priva products, designs, and customer deployments. 

 As a security architect, you are trusted counterpart of Priva Security, Quality, and Compliance officer to define, review, and execute controls arising from ISO9001 and ISO27001 standards and internal initiatives. You are responsible for presenting the necessary evidence of Priva’s compliance with these controls to the auditors. 

  • Security standards, policies, and design patterns library 

  • Security architecture review process 

  • Risk register and residual risk acceptance documentation 

  • Periodic product security implementation reviews, including maintaining non-compliance register 

  • Defined requirements, products and work packages for security-focused projects with 3rd party service providers, reviewing and accepting their deliverables, and supervising the implementation of these deliverables in the Priva hardware products and software services. 

  • Regulatory compliance (IEC 62443-4, ISO 27001, ISO 9001 or other standard that may be applicable in specific geographies) 

  • Threat intelligence briefing relevant to OT/IoT threat landscape 

  • Designing, implementing, and reviewing security controls applied at major customer sites. 

Above all, this is a hands-on role – occasionally writing code is included. You connect the industry’s best practices, ISO standards, product vision with the daily work of the product team. As a security architect, you practice what you preach. You explain, coach, and show by example the implementation of security as Secure SDLC in the developer’s daily work.  

To succeed in this role: 

  • You are passionate about OT security; you have great interest in the application of our products in the field. You are curious to grasp how our products truly work for our customers to find the best balance between security, reliability, and cost. You share the opinion that "if I don't secure Priva’s applications, then no one else will". 

  • You identify and eliminate issues in the development cycle that can jeopardize the security posture. You know and can show by example how to "test securely as well as test security" 

  • You are a great collaborator who can be a valuable sparring partner with product managers to understand and refine customer's needs for security so that you define the right security designs for market segments. Engineering managers rely on your ability to steer security implementations within the product teams. 

  • You are comfortable designing products that our customers will be running for years; comfortable providing guidance to LCM activities for existing customers to update hardware and software components to continuously stay secure. 

  • You share the knowledge about security subjects; you explain why security practices exist and what they achieve in the long run. 

  • You can translate security designs into engineering specifications, appraise implementation designs, conduct code reviews. This role with a strong hands-on component, not just a pure governance role. 

  • You understand and can register, document, and communicate clearly risks and trade-offs between differen t project execution scenarios 

  • You have had hands-on experience implementing security designs using modern programming language and frameworks, and you are able to coach product teams to increase their secure coding maturity e.g. by running threat modelling workshops with the engineering team. 

  • You have vast experience with architecture roles with 3-5 years of experience specifically focusing on security. 

In addition, you have the following technical expertise: 

  • Proven track record across at least two of the three domains: OT/IoT/embedded security, network security, cloud security 

  • You are familiar with modern authentication and authorization frameworks (JWT, OpenID, SAML) and (REST) API security and protection approached 

  • ISO 27001 and IEC 62443-4 understanding at a working level 

  • Working knowledge with or excellent ability to apply the PKI and certificate lifecycle management at scale; also, with the vision how to implement this in OT/IoT deployment contexts 

  • Solid network security understanding: firewall policy, micro-segmentation, DMZ design for IT/OT boundaries 

  • Zero trust architecture principles 

  • Secure SDLC and DevSecOps tools and practices (think about OWASP, SANS25, Snyk, Black Duck, etc) 

  


The following competence is desired: 

  • OT/ICS protocols and architectures (such as BACnet Secure Connect, Modbus, DNP3, MQTT, AMQP) 

  • Embedded device security for industrial PCs, systems-on-chip, and microcontrollers: secure boot, hardware security modules (HSMs), TPM, secure enclave concepts, firmware & data signing, encryption 

  • Cloud security on at least one major platform (AWS, Azure, or GCP) 

  • Container and Kubernetes security 

  • Secrets management and key management systems (HashiCorp Vault, AWS KMS, Az

203a9e77a9fd77bb.title: Talent Acquisition Partner-Europe
203a9e77a9fd77bb.description:
DeepHealth is seeking an experienced Talent Acquisition Partner based in Europe to own high-impact, full-cycle recruiting across European markets and support global hiring as needed. This is a hands-on execution role in a fast-paced, high-volume environment where searches are varied, specialized, and rarely repeatable. The successful candidate will combine a strong B2B SaaS recruiting background with exceptional organization, proactive sourcing, and strategic hiring manager partnership, developing a deep understanding of each position and delivering tailored hiring strategies. This position contributes to continuous improvement of an evolving global Talent Acquisition function but is not responsible for building or leading the function.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Own full-cycle recruitment across multiple European markets, with additional support for US, Canadian, and APAC hiring as business needs require.

  • Manage a high-volume, diverse portfolio of technical, commercial, product, and corporate requisitions while maintaining quality and responsiveness.

  • Lead detailed intake meetings to understand business objectives, essential competencies, technical requirements, hiring priorities, and candidate profiles for each distinct search.

  • Develop tailored sourcing and assessment strategies for niche and business-critical roles; proactively engage passive candidates through direct sourcing, LinkedIn Recruiter, referrals, and professional networks.

  • Build trusted relationships with hiring managers, HR Business Partners, and leaders; advise on talent markets, compensation expectations, hiring feasibility, and selection strategy.

  • Challenge and refine role requirements constructively, distinguish must-haves from preferences, and proactively address obstacles to hiring.

  • Coordinate screening, interviewing, feedback, offer development, negotiation, and hiring handoffs while delivering timely, transparent candidate communication.

  • Independently prioritize competing requisitions, manage calendars and deadlines, maintain strong follow-through, and adapt quickly to changing business needs.

  • Maintain accurate ATS records and provide regular reporting on pipeline health, time-to-fill, sourcing effectiveness, bottlenecks, and hiring progress.

  • Use recruiting technology, AI-assisted tools, and appropriate automation to improve sourcing and execution efficiency while preserving sound judgment and human oversight.

  • Ensure hiring activities comply with relevant country-specific employment requirements, GDPR, data privacy standards, and DeepHealth policies.

  • Partner with the global People and Communications teams to strengthen DeepHealth’s employer brand across European markets.

  • Plan and deliver local talent-attraction initiatives, such as recruitment events, university or professional-community partnerships, networking activities and employee referral campaigns.

  • Build relationships with local universities, professional associations and talent communities to develop pipelines for priority roles.

  • Represent DeepHealth professionally and communicate its mission and employer value proposition throughout the candidate journey.

PLEASE NOTE: This is not an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities and requirements of the position. Other functions may be assigned and management retains the right to add or change duties at any time.


Minimum Qualifications, Education and Experience

  • 5+ years of progressive, hands-on full-cycle Talent Acquisition experience, including substantial recruiting experience within B2B SaaS organizations (required).

  • Demonstrated experience recruiting across multiple European countries and navigating differences in talent markets, employment practices, and hiring processes (required).

  • Proven ability to manage a high volume of varied, complex requisitions across multiple job families rather than repeated hiring for a single profile (required).

  • Experience recruiting technical roles such as Software Engineering, Cloud/DevOps, Product, Data Science, or AI/ML, alongside commercial or corporate functions (required).

  • Strong direct sourcing capability, including passive candidate engagement and role-specific market mapping (required).

  • Demonstrated ability to build strategic relationships with hiring managers and senior stakeholders, advise on hiring strategy, and influence decisions (required).

  • Exceptional time management, prioritization, organization, communication, and attention to detail (required).

  • Experience with applicant tracking systems, LinkedIn Recruiter, recruiting metrics, and modern sourcing tools (required).

  • Professional fluency in written and spoken English and ability to collaborate across international time zones (required).

  • Experience developing employer-brand activity or delivering local talent-attraction initiatives, such as recruitment events, university partnerships, professional-community engagement or employee advocacy (preferred).

  • Experience recruiting into the United States, Canada, and APAC (preferred).

  • Experience in healthcare technology, enterprise imaging, PACS/RIS, radiology software, or clinical AI (preferred).

  • Experience supporting global SaaS organizations, including Employer of Record arrangements, and familiarity with Recruitee or comparable ATS platforms (preferred).

Wat ga je doen?

Tijdens deze meewerkstage Project Engineering werk je mee aan echte klantprojecten binnen de machinebouw. Je ondersteunt bij de technische uitwerking van machineconfiguraties en helpt ervoor te zorgen dat de klantvraag goed wordt vertaald naar Engineering en Productie. Daarbij krijg je te maken met mechanische, elektrische en configuratietechnische aspecten. Deze multidisciplinaire werkwijze sluit aan bij hoe Project Engineering binnen Voortman is ingericht.

Je gaat onder andere:

  • ondersteunen bij de technische voorbereiding van klantprojecten;

  • layouts en machineconfiguraties controleren en aanpassen;

  • klantspecifieke afwijkingen, opties en interfaces beoordelen;

  • afstemmen met mechanische, elektrische en configuratie-engineering;

  • technische aandachtspunten en wijzigingen vastleggen en opvolgen.

Naast het meewerken aan projecten pak je een eigen praktijkopdracht op. Je werkt een kleinere technische verbetering of standaardoplossing uit die binnen meerdere klantprojecten kan worden toegepast. Je brengt de eisen in kaart, stemt jouw voorstel af met de betrokken disciplines en toetst de oplossing binnen een actueel project.
