b34a4fb2d4c41764.title: Senior Cloud Engineer
b34a4fb2d4c41764.description:
At Luscii, we're creating space for care by developing and improving digital healthcare applications that make a real difference in people's lives through several applications. From Luscii Thuismeten, which helps healthcare professionals monitor patients remotely, to OMRON Connect, connecting millions of people with their health data through OMRON devices, and other applications that expand the possibilities of digital healthcare.

Together with healthcare professionals and partners around the world, we're working towards a future where people receive the right care in the right place. As our Senior Cloud Engineer, you'll help shape and modernise the cloud infrastructure behind these applications, building a reliable, scalable and future-proof foundation for millions of users worldwide.

Our applications have different histories, architectures and technical challenges. OMRON Connect, for example, runs on an AWS backend serving several million monthly active users. Parts of its infrastructure still carry legacy, including manual processes, scattered knowledge, inconsistent observability and release processes that make changes slower and riskier than they should be.

We're working towards a more consistent engineering foundation across our applications. Think Infrastructure as Code, cloud-native and event-driven architecture where it adds value, safe continuous deployment and observability by default. We're bringing more senior engineering expertise in-house to turn that ambition into concrete technical decisions, shared standards and a roadmap our teams can own. And that's where you come in 😉

Your role

You will work across our engineering teams, helping shape the cloud infrastructure behind our digital healthcare applications. Your focus will be on making the right architectural decisions, modernising existing platforms and enabling teams to independently build, maintain and improve their systems.

This isn't a greenfield architecture exercise. You will be improving live healthcare platforms while balancing technical improvements with product delivery, security, regulatory requirements and the realities of working with stakeholders across different countries, including the Netherlands and Japan.

What you will be doing, among others:

  • Own and evolve the Cloud & Backend roadmap, translating the engineering vision into clear priorities, trade-offs and next steps.

  • Drive cross-team architecture decisions to a close, making sure decisions are transparent, documented and followed through.

  • Establish shared technical standards and guardrails that allow teams to work autonomously without creating unnecessary dependencies.

  • Work hands-on with engineers on AWS and Terraform, reviewing designs and pull requests and challenging technical choices where needed.

  • Coach and pair with engineers, helping knowledge spread across teams and supporting the growth of seniority and ownership.

  • Work with product owners, QA, engineering leadership and colleagues in Japan to balance technical direction with product, regulatory, security and cost considerations.

  • Help move the platform towards automated infrastructure, safer deployments and stronger observability without relying on a big-bang rewrite.

The responsibilities outlined above reflect how we currently envision this role. As we continue to grow and evolve, the scope and focus of the position may naturally change, influenced by your own ideas and insights. The way we work is built around the belief that everyone's input matters. If you see opportunities to improve the way we do things, or believe a process could be designed differently to achieve a better outcome, we encourage you to bring those ideas forward. Discuss them with your teammates, challenge the status quo, and help shape how we move forward together.

Why Luscii?

Read more about working at Luscii / OMRON and how we work as a team. Together, we are working on a mission to create space for care. Freedom, autonomy and ownership are of great importance in this. You are responsible for your own results and work according to the principles of Holacracy. Luscii is part of OMRON DH; together we built for the long term. To work on making healthcare better.

Most important benefits

  • Salary: An annual maximum remuneration of approximately € 85.000 gross per year is estimated for this position (based on 32 hours per week – that’s full-time at Luscii), depending on the interviews, your experience, background and knowledge.

  • Remote-first: Work from anywhere in The Netherlands. We stay connected through monthly in-person team days called Assemblii.

  • Flexible setup: Create your own ideal workspace. Whatever works best for you - we’ve got you covered here. We do work from Mondays to Thursdays, as 32 hours per week is fulltime.

The ideal candidate…

… probably doesn't exist, but if you can tick most of the checkboxes below, please apply! We are looking for someone who enjoys taking ownership of complex technical challenges, makes pragmatic engineering decisions, and is excited about helping others succeed along the way.

You know when to step up, when to involve colleagues and when to move forward decisively. Working independently does not mean working in isolation for you. You feel at ease being both a self-starter and a committed team player, contributing to shared goals while taking responsibility for your own domain. You value open communication, transparency, and mutual trust.

  • You have at least 5+ years of experience in cloud/backend engineering and multiple years of hands-on experience with AWS and Terraform (Infrastructure as Code).

  • You are comfortable reviewing designs and pull requests. Experience with serverless and event-driven architectures is very valuable. All combined with experience in serverless AWS, Node.js/TypeScript tech stacks.

  • You actively coach, pair, review and share knowledge, with a focus on building ownership and seniority across the teams around you.

  • You understand what matters: the importance of making pragmatic technical choices within clear security, compliance and regulatory boundaries.

  • You are open to working in a Holacratic organization and curious about our way of organizing work, roles, and responsibilities;

  • English is our primary language for all internal communication at Luscii, so you're fluent in that language.

Interested? Apply now!

Would you like more information? Feel free to contact our recruiter Björn Bogerd via

What does the recruitment process look like?

We organise three interviews for each vacancy. It is an extensive process, but we want to ensure that there is a good fit in regards to a potential collaboration, our culture and our way of working. All interviews are conducted online and the entire procedure is planned in advance to keep momentum.

c3c660dc79b50bfc.title: Meewerk Stage Continuous Improvement (Power BI & Power Automate)
c3c660dc79b50bfc.description:
Ben jij analytisch sterk en wil je impact maken binnen een internationale organisatie? Dan moeten we jou hebben!

Jouw rol
Bij Heras krijg je de kans om als stagiair bij te dragen aan het Nimble-programma: een strategisch verbeterprogramma gericht op het vereenvoudigen en automatiseren van bedrijfsprocessen. Als stagiair werk je aan het verbeteren van processen binnen domeinen zoals sales, projecten in nieuwbouw en finance. Je analyseert hoe processen vandaag werken en vertaalt dit naar slimme oplossingen met behulp van Power BI en Power Automate. Je levert concrete procesverbeteringen, procesbeschrijvingen, automatiseringen en Power BI dashboards voor operationele en financiële sturing aan alsmede werkende Power Automate flows. Tenslotte lever je een meetbare bijdrage aan efficiëntie (bijv. tijdbesparing of minder fouten).

Jouw werkzaamheden

  • In kaart brengen van huidige processen en knelpunten.

  • Automatiseren van handmatige processen met Power Automate.

  • Ontwikkelen van dashboards en rapportages in Power BI (zonder daadwerkelijk programmeren).

  • Verbeteren van datakwaliteit en inzicht in KPI’s.

  • Samenwerken met business teams en IT-specialisten.

Benieuwd naar de ervaringen van een stagiair bij Heras? De eerste indruk: dynamisch in plaats van stoffig - Heras Nederland

Wie zijn wij?
Heras is een vooraanstaand Europese totaalleverancier van permanente perimeter protection oplossingen. Wij opereren vanuit meer dan 24 landen en hebben meer dan 1100 hoogopgeleide experts in dienst. Opgericht in 1952, vervult en overtreft Heras de beveiligingsbehoeften van klanten in heel Europa. Het is dankzij deze staat van dienst, samen met het blijvend groeiende vakmanschap van onze medewerkers, dat wij ons experts in perimeter protection kunnen noemen. 

Onze cultuur, werksfeer & waarden
Wij hebben binnen Heras een informele, open en toegankelijke cultuur. We zijn trots op ons werk, producten en dienstverlening. We hebben een no-nonsense mentaliteit, tonen ondernemerschap, zijn energiek en werken allemaal gedisciplineerd volgens de drie kernwaarden; betrokkenheid, betrouwbaarheid en deskundigheid. Heras is gewaardeerd op een Ecovadis Zilveren Ster en dat plaatst ons bij de duurzaamste 15% bedrijven van Nederland. Onze doelstelling is streven naar Goud in de komende jaren en volledig CO2 neutraal zijn in 2050. Wil je hier meer over weten? https://www.heras.nl/over-heras/kwaliteit-en-veiligheid/


Jouw profiel

  • Je volgt een HBO- of WO-opleiding (bijv. Bedrijfskunde, Technische Bedrijfskunde, IT, Data of Finance)

  • Je zoekt een 3e of 4e jaars stage waarbij de nadruk ligt op meewerken of bouwen van dashboarding

  • Je hebt interesse in procesverbetering en data

  • Je hebt basiskennis van of affiniteit met Power BI en/of Power Automate

  • Je bent analytisch, proactief en communicatief sterk

  • Onze voorkeur gaat uit naar een kandidaat die de Nederlandse taal goed beheerst

  • Hoewel het niet zelf programmeren beterft vindt je het wel leuk om zelf oplossingen te verzinnen en te testen

Wat bieden wij jou?
Bij Heras bieden wij jou een meewerkstage binnen een zeer dynamische omgeving waarbij elke dag anders is met veel variatie en afwisseling. Je draagt je steentje bij aan een veilige omgeving en helpt om onze samenleving te beschermen. Tenslotte zijn er volop mogelijkheden om jezelf te ontwikkelen en door te groeien. Wij bieden het volgende:

  • Stagevergoeding van €500,- bruto o.b.v. fulltime

  • 2 verlofdagen per maand

  • Flexibiliteit en vrijheid

  • Reiskostenvergoeding van 0,23ct per kilometer tussen 5- en 60km enkele reis

  • Laptop voor gebruik bij Heras

Iets voor jou?
Als je graag meer informatie wil ontvangen over de vacature of sollicitatieprocedure neem dan contact op met onze Corporate Recruiter Bram Smits via 0629148655.

Voor externe partijen: Acquisitie naar aanleiding van deze vacature wordt niet op prijs gesteld. Heras behoudt hiermee het recht om ingestuurde kandidaten rechtstreeks te benaderen.

At Huzzle, we connect high-performing professionals with global companies across the UK, US, Canada, Europe, and Australia. Our clients include startups, digital agencies, and tech platforms in industries like SaaS, MarTech, FinTech, and EdTech. We match top sales talent to full-time remote roles where they’re hired directly into client teams and provided ongoing support by Huzzle.

Role Type: Full-time

Engagement: Independent Contractor

About the Company

Our client operates in the real estate and home improvement industry, specialising in bathroom remodelling. They help homeowners transform their bathrooms through tailored renovation solutions. They are looking for an experienced Dutch-speaking High-Ticket Sales Closer to join their sales team and convert qualified prospects into customers.

Working directly with prospective customers through video sales calls, you'll be responsible for building rapport, understanding customer needs, handling objections, and closing high-value deals. This is an opportunity for a confident sales professional who knows how to create trust, communicate value, and consistently deliver results in a performance-driven environment.

Key Responsibilities

  • Conduct approximately 4–5 video sales calls per day with qualified prospects who have booked and attended their appointments
  • Handle a target of approximately 45 qualified showed sales calls per month
  • Convert qualified prospects into customers, targeting an average of 1–2 direct sales per day
  • Build strong relationships with prospective customers through excellent communication, active listening, and rapport-building techniques
  • Use mirroring techniques and an adaptable tone of voice to establish trust and connect with different customer personalities
  • Understand customer requirements, present suitable solutions, and communicate the value of bathroom remodelling services
  • Handle objections confidently and guide prospects through the decision-making process
  • Apply culturally sensitive communication and closing techniques when engaging with Dutch-speaking customers
  • Maintain accurate sales activity and follow-ups using the company's systems
  • Work towards revenue generation targets, with a reference target of 400K

Requirements

  • Fluent in both Dutch and English (essential)
  • Proven experience in sales, particularly cold calling and direct sales
  • Demonstrable high-ticket sales and closing experience
  • Strong objection-handling and negotiation skills
  • Excellent verbal communication skills and a confident, engaging tone of voice
  • Strong rapport-building, active listening, and mirroring skills
  • Ability to adapt communication and closing techniques to different customer personalities and cultural backgrounds
  • Comfortable conducting video sales calls and working towards daily sales and revenue targets
  • Reliable, organised, and able to communicate availability consistently
  • Familiarity with GoHighLevel, Slack, and Google Meet

Nice to Have

  • Previous experience in real estate or property-related sales
  • Experience in construction, home improvement, or bathroom remodelling
  • Experience selling high-value renovation or home improvement services

Benefits

💻 Fully Remote: Work from anywhere with international teams

🚀 Career Growth: Join companies in SaaS, MarTech, and B2B services

🤝 Peer Community: Connect with high-performing sales professionals in our network

🧭 Ongoing Support: Receive guidance from Huzzle before and after placement

💰 Tailored Compensation: Salaries vary by client and candidate preference — we’ll match you with options that fit your goals

d1cd36dda1e0fac9.title: Research Engineer Privacy and Anonymization
d1cd36dda1e0fac9.description:
Location: San Francisco or Singapore (on-site), or remote (Singapore or US Pacific time zones)
Start Date: ASAP
Languages: English
Team: Engineering

About the Role

Our client is a fast-growing AI company building reliable, fair and open infrastructure for AI training data. Their marketplace helps the people who create data get value for it, and gives AI labs trustworthy data to train on. It is already used by startups, Fortune 500 companies and frontier labs, and the company is backed by leading venture investors, including Y Combinator. They are scaling quickly to meet strong demand.

We are looking for a Research Engineer, Privacy and Anonymization to build the systems that make sensitive, real-world data safe and still useful for AI training. You will develop methods to detect and remove personally identifiable information, secrets and other sensitive content from raw data before it enters processing and synthetic data pipelines â protecting privacy without destroying the structure and signal that make the data valuable for training agents.

This is a privacy and data-protection engineering seat, not a synthetic-task design role. You will own the pipeline that stands in front of downstream processing, training, evaluation and synthetic generation.

This is a full-time role, starting ASAP. Offices are in San Francisco and Singapore; remote candidates are welcome if their working hours can overlap about 70â80% with either San Francisco (US Pacific) or Singapore business hours. The exact daily schedule will be agreed during hiring.

What You'll Do

  • Build systems to detect PII, quasi-identifiers, credentials and other sensitive information, and design transformations based on the data type and the downstream use case.

  • Develop and benchmark detection approaches that combine rules, statistical models, classifiers and LLM-based methods.

  • Build production pipelines that anonymize raw data before it enters downstream processing, training, evaluation or synthetic data generation.

  • Create evaluation frameworks that measure privacy risk and retained data utility, including recall-weighted metrics, leakage tests and adversarial re-identification attempts.

  • Design systems that stay robust to new data sources, schema drift, unusual formats and sensitive information embedded in unexpected fields.

  • Work with engineering, research, operations and customers to translate privacy requirements into practical technical policies and safeguards.

What We're Looking For

  • Strong proficiency in Python, and experience building reliable production data or machine-learning systems.

  • Experience with information extraction, named-entity recognition, classification, or related methods for detecting rare or sensitive content.

  • Strong experimental instincts, and the ability to compare approaches across recall, precision, latency, cost and downstream data utility.

  • An understanding of the difference between redaction, masking, pseudonymization, anonymization and synthetic data â and when each is appropriate.

  • High attention to detail, and the ability to reason about subtle leakage paths, edge cases and adversarial failure modes.

  • Experience building data-processing pipelines end to end, including where there was no fully prescribed roadmap.

  • Clear written and spoken English, and comfort collaborating across teams and time zones.

  • Strong candidates may also have hands-on experience with privacy-enhancing technologies (such as differential privacy, k-anonymity, secure aggregation or format-preserving encryption); have worked with sensitive data in healthcare, finance or security; have built low-latency or high-throughput ML inference or data-processing systems; or have taken work from early research through to production.

  • Technical aptitude and learning potential matter more than years of experience. Motivated candidates are encouraged to apply even if they don't meet every point above.

Why This Role Matters for You

  • Make real-world data safe to train on: You will build the systems that let sensitive data be used for AI training without exposing people or secrets.

  • Privacy without wrecking utility: The job is not only to redact, but to keep the structure and signal that downstream training and synthetic pipelines need.

  • From detection to production: You will own the full path: detection methods, transformations, evaluation, and the pipeline that sits in front of training and generation.

  • Hard, high-stakes edge cases: Work on leakage paths, schema drift and adversarial failure modes, not only clean benchmark datasets.

  • San Francisco, Singapore, or remote: Work on-site in San Francisco or Singapore, or remotely, with hours that overlap about 70â80% with either US Pacific or Singapore business hours. The exact daily schedule will be agreed during hiring.

e82048a10fccd4fd.description:
About AMBOSS

We are a medical education and clinical support platform dedicated to empowering healthcare professionals worldwide to deliver the best possible care.

Founded in Germany, AMBOSS has grown to over 600 team members, with offices in Berlin, Cologne, New York, and Cagliari. Since entering the U.S. medical education market in 2017 with resources for USMLE and shelf exam preparation, AMBOSS has expanded to include point-of-care clinical support and board preparation across multiple specialties. We are now developing a new Qbank for the ABOG Qualifying Examination and are looking for OB-GYN residents and recent residency graduates to help shape this resource.

Position Summary

We are seeking PGY-4 OB-GYN residents or recent graduates for a remote, part-time freelance role developing a new ABOG Qualifying Examination Qbank. You will use your clinical training and board preparation experience to help identify high-yield topics, define what makes a high-quality board-style question, and review questions for exam relevance, difficulty, and educational value. You may also have opportunities to share your insights with multidisciplinary teams (e.g., Commercial, Marketing, AI, Product, and User Research) to help improve medical education and support the responsible use of AI. This role offers a flexible opportunity to explore meaningful nonclinical work alongside your clinical training or practice.

Responsibilities Include

  • Identifying high-yield ABOG exam topics and gaps in Qbank question coverage

  • Helping define what makes a high-quality board-style question

  • Reviewing questions to assess how well they match the ABOG exam in format, content, and difficulty

  • Evaluating whether questions and explanations are clear, concise, and useful for board preparation

  • Suggesting specific changes to improve questions and their educational value

  • Sharing insights from OB-GYN residency training and board preparation with other teams

Qualifications

  • Medical degree (MD/DO).

  • Current PGY-4 resident or recent graduate of an ACGME-accredited OB-GYN residency program in the U.S.

  • Familiarity with the ABOG Qualifying Examination and OB-GYN board preparation resources

  • Strong clinical reasoning, attention to detail, and written communication skills

  • Ability to provide clear, practical feedback focused on educational value

  • Comfortable working independently and meeting agreed-upon deadlines in an asynchronous remote environment

  • Preferred (not required): Experience with AI and/or LLM applications

Logistics

  • Position type: Freelance, independent contractor (project-based)

  • Location: Fully remote

  • Duration: 3 months (~5â10 hours/week, as needed)

  • Schedule: Flexible and project-based, with agreed-upon turnaround times

  • Compensation: $75-$100/hr for current residents; $100-120/hr for recent graduates and attendings

  • Start date: As soon as possible

Why join us?

  • Use your medical training and board preparation experience to help shape the future of residency education and board preparation.

  • Contribute to the quality and responsible use of AI-powered medical education.

  • Explore meaningful nonclinical work that complements your clinical training or practice, with flexible, fully remote part-time hours.

We believe that diversity is a powerful driver of innovation and progress. Thatâs why we are committed to fostering an inclusive, respectful, and supportive environment where everyoneâregardless of gender, age, ethnic or cultural background, religion, disability, sexual orientation, gender identityâis valued and given equal opportunity to thrive. We warmly welcome people of all backgrounds to help us fulfil our mission: empowering all medical professionals to provide the best possible care!

5dab00105b4fb0d5.title: Senior Data Engineer
5dab00105b4fb0d5.description:
Lemon.io helps companies in the US and Europe hire experienced engineers, from funded startups to teams like Klarna, Retool, and Pinterest. We’ve been doing this since 2015, and more than 1,500 companies have hired engineers through us.

 

New roles for Senior React Full-stack Engineers come in all the time, and several are open right now.

 

Two ways to work with clients

  • Contract: most roles are contract-based. You join the client’s team and work as part of it.
  • Direct hire: some clients hire engineers full-time, and we support you through the process.

 

Because companies trust our vetting, applying through Lemon.io is often a shortcut. You get to the client faster than going through their full hiring process on your own.

 

What you get

  • Competitive rate, based on your seniority and skills
  • We find the projects. No client hunting or rate negotiations. We match you manually based on your skills and preferences.
  • Flexible schedule. Work async or with a small overlap with the team’s hours.
  • No micromanagement, no screen trackers
  • Direct work with clients, most of them with technical backgrounds
  • Ongoing support from your application through every project, plus a community of engineers from 75+ countries

 

Who we’re looking for

Senior Data Engineers with:

  • 4+ years of commercial experience as a Data Engineer

  • Experience with Apache Airflow and Snowflake, or Python and SQL, is required

  • Experience with AWS, GCP, or Microsoft Azure is mandatory

  • You own problems end-to-end: you spot the issue in the data or pipeline, design and build the solution, and ship it to production.

  • You can show the business impact of your work with concrete results (e.g., faster data processing, lower infrastructure costs, fresher data for stakeholders, fewer pipeline incidents).

  • Advanced English: you discuss business tasks, explain your technical decisions, raise risks early, and present yourself and your results well on client calls.

  • You work full-time remotely and deliver without supervision.

The Product Support Associate serves as the primary point of contact for customers across the Africa region requiring technical assistance with Cepheid products and solutions. REMOTO

Sistema.bio, creando valor del desecho

En Sistema.bio, creemos firmemente que la transición a la energía renovable, la reducción de las emisiones globales de gases de efecto invernadero y la adopción de la agricultura regenerativa son cruciales para garantizar un mundo próspero para las generaciones actuales y futuras.

Fabricamos y distribuimos biodigestores rentables y de alta calidad en América Latina , Asia y África. Nuestros biodigestores permiten a los agricultores convertir residuos en energía renovable y fertilizantes orgánicos, lo que les permite reducir su huella de carbono, aumentar la productividad y operar de manera más eficiente.

Al brindar acceso a tecnología innovadora de biodigestores, Sistema.bio se dedica a abordar los desafíos interconectados de la pobreza, la seguridad alimentaria y el cambio climático.

Tenemos la misión de reducir el 1% de las emisiones globa

les de gases de efecto invernadero 🌱 🌏. ¡Sé parte de esta historia de impacto!

¿Cuál será tu misión en Sistema.bio?

Como Practicante de Operaciones técnicas, darás particular soporte al equipo de la región en la generación de propuestas técnicas y sistemas productivos. Tendrás la oportunidad de conocer la relación entre el diseño técnico de sistemas de biogás, el análisis de información de campo y la implementación de soluciones para productores agrícolas.

A través de proyectos reales y en colaboración con los equipos Comercial y TechOps de LATAM y Global, podrá desarrollar habilidades técnicas, analíticas y de coordinación, al mismo tiempo que contribuye a mejorar nuestros procesos y soluciones.

¿Qué harás como practicante?:

Como parte del equipo de Operaciones Técnicas ubicado en México, estas serán algunas de las áreas en las que estarás colaborando, así como tus principales actividades a desarrollar

Como parte del equipo de Operaciones Técnicas, colaborarás de manera remota con los equipos de México y Global en las siguientes actividades:

  • Elaboración de propuestas técnicas: apoyar en la preparación de diseños y propuestas de sistemas productivos de biogás, utilizando la información del proyecto para identificar soluciones adecuadas a las necesidades de cada productor.
  • Coordinación y seguimiento de proyectos: colaborar con los equipos Comercial y TechOps para recopilar información técnica, dar seguimiento a las solicitudes de propuestas y facilitar la comunicación entre las áreas involucradas.
  • Organización y gestión de información: apoyar en la actualización y documentación de propuestas técnicas, utilizando herramientas como Google Drive y Salesforce para mantener la información organizada y facilitar el seguimiento de cada proyecto.
  • Análisis y mejora continua: participar en la recopilación y análisis de comentarios e incidencias identificadas durante la instalación y operación de sistemas productivos, contribuyendo a detectar oportunidades de mejora.
  • Pruebas y desarrollo de nuevos productos: colaborar en actividades de prueba y validación de nuevas soluciones, apoyando en el seguimiento de su desempeño y en la documentación de los comentarios y aprendizajes obtenidos durante las pruebas de campo.

Esta es una práctica profesional formativa no remunerada, enfocada en el aprendizaje, la mentoría y la experiencia profesional. No implica una relación laboral ni responsabilidades propias de un puesto formal. La duración de la práctica es de 3 a 6 meses, de acuerdo con los requisitos de cada institución educativa para la liberación de prácticas profesionales.

Más sobre tí:

En Sistema.bio buscamos estudiantes con ganas de aprender, crecer y dejar huella, que se entusiasmen por formar parte de un equipo diverso, colaborativo y apasionado por generar impacto positivo en el mundo.

  • Estudiante de una carrera relacionada con ingeniería, sistemas productivos, energías renovables, ingeniería ambiental, ingeniería agrícola o áreas afines.
  • Interés en las energías renovables, el biogás, las soluciones para el sector agrícola y la innovación tecnológica.
  • Capacidad para organizar información, analizar datos y dar seguimiento a distintas actividades.
  • Atención al detalle y disposición para aprender sobre procesos técnicos y comerciales.
  • Habilidades de comunicación y colaboración con equipos de diferentes áreas.
  • Manejo básico de herramientas digitales como Google Drive y hojas de cálculo.
  • Inglés funcional (conversacional - indispensable) para colaborar con integrantes de equipos internacionales, idealmente.

Lo que más valoramos:

  • Una actitud proactiva y creativa, con capacidad de análisis y enfoque en resultados.
  • Compromiso genuino con el impacto social y ambiental, alineado con la misión de Sistema.bio.
  • Habilidades organizativas y manejo de herramientas digitales que te permitan trabajar con eficiencia, adaptarte rápido y aportar a la gestión de proyectos.

¿Qué te ofrecemos?

  • Conocimientos prácticos sobre sistemas de biogás y soluciones productivas.
  • Experiencia en la elaboración de propuestas técnicas y el seguimiento de proyectos.
  • Habilidades de análisis de información, documentación y mejora continua.
  • Experiencia colaborando con equipos multidisciplinarios y de distintas regiones.
  • Una comprensión integral de cómo una solución tecnológica pasa de una oportunidad comercial a su implementación en campo.
  • Una curva de aprendizaje intensa y real, trabajando codo a codo con un equipo que está cambiando la forma en que el mundo produce y consume energía.
  • Mentoría y acompañamiento cercano, para que crezcas profesional y personalmente.
  • La oportunidad de vivir cómo se gestiona y fortalece un equipo multicultural en una organización global de impacto.

Modalidad y duración de la práctica profesional

  • Modalidad: Remota.
  • Duración: 3 a 6 meses.
  • Horario: 4 horas diarias.
  • Fecha de inicio: Enero 2027

d18bd5f35b27b0d8.title: Staff Product Designer
d18bd5f35b27b0d8.description:
Who we are

At Twilio, we’re shaping the future of communications, all from the comfort of our homes. We deliver innovative solutions to hundreds of thousands of businesses and empower millions of developers worldwide to craft personalized customer experiences.

Our dedication to remote-first work, and strong culture of connection and global inclusion means that no matter your location, you’re part of a vibrant team with diverse experiences making a global impact each day. As we continue to revolutionize how the world interacts, we’re acquiring new skills and experiences that make work feel truly rewarding. Your career at Twilio is in your hands.

.

Hiring and how we work

We use Artificial Intelligence (AI) to help make our hiring process efficient. That said, every hiring decision is made by real Twilions!

Also, while we are a remote-first company, you may be asked to report in person on an ad-hoc basis for team gatherings, functional off-sites or customer meetings.

.

See yourself at Twilio

Join the team as Twilio’s next Staff Product Designer (Identity UX).

About the job

At Twilio, we’re building the identity layer for both people and the AI agents acting on their behalf. We’re looking for a Staff Product Designer (L4) to define the user experience for Twilio Identity: customer identity (authentication, Hosted Login, and user management) and Agent Identity, which lets developers open their apps and APIs, including remote MCP servers, to AI agents with user consent, scoped access, and human approval for sensitive actions over Twilio channels like SMS and RCS.

You’ll be the lead designer on a small, senior team, working with product and engineering from the first sketch. You’ll own the developer setup experience in One Console, the login and consent flows our customers put in front of their users, and the patterns that make security decisions easy to understand without slowing anyone down. Agent Identity is in private beta and heads to general availability at SIGNAL 2027, so this is a chance to define the core UX of a new product category.

Responsibilities

  • Own Identity UX End to End: Lead the experience for developer onboarding and configuration in One Console, Hosted Login, and end-user authentication flows.
  • Design for Agents and the People Behind Them: Define how AI agents are registered, how users grant and revoke consent, how permissions are scoped, and how users approve sensitive agent actions in real time.
  • Make Self-Serve Fast: Shorten the path from sign-up to a working integration, so developers can evaluate and adopt Twilio Identity without talking to sales.
  • Translate Protocol Complexity: Turn OAuth, tokens, scopes, and approval flows into clear mental models for developers and plain-language choices for end users.
  • Partner Before the PRD: Work with PM and engineering from problem framing through launch, co-owning scope and tradeoffs while holding a high bar for craft.
  • Talk to Customers Directly: Run research and usability testing with design partners and developers, and ground decisions in what you learn.
  • Raise the Bar: Contribute to Twilio’s design system and UX design feedback process, and mentor other designers.

Qualifications

Required:

  • Work schedule: Full-time, US-based, remote.
  • 8+ years of professional product design experience specifically focused on highly technical software products, developer tools, infrastructure, or complex B2B/SaaS platforms.
  • Expert-Level Systems Thinking: Track record designing complex, configuration-heavy products (developer consoles, admin tools, or multi-step setup flows) and unifying them into coherent experiences.
  • Executive Cross-Functional Leadership: Proven success partnering directly with engineering and product leaders (Director/VP level) to navigate organizational complexity, align cross-product touchpoints, and shape multi-year product roadmaps.
  • Comfort with Ambiguity: A self-starter who thrives when thrown into highly complex, loosely-defined technical spaces and is capable of building clear frameworks out of abstract constraints.
  • Designing for Trust and Control: Experience designing permission, consent, approval, or similarly high-stakes flows where users need to understand and control what a system can do on their behalf.

Desired:

  • Design for Developers: Practical experience designing interfaces for technical builders (APIs, SDKs, CLIs, and configuration consoles).
  • Identity & Security Experience: Familiarity with authentication and authorization products (OAuth/OIDC, SSO, MFA, passkeys, CIAM).
  • AI Agent Experience: Experience designing for AI agents or LLM-based products, including human-in-the-loop controls.

Location

This role will be remote and based in the United States,but is not eligible to be hired in CA, CT, NJ, NY, PA, WA.

Travel

We prioritize connection and opportunities to build relationships with our customers and each other. For this role, you may be required to travel occasionally to participate in project or team in-person meetings.

What We Offer

Working at Twilio offers many benefits, including competitive pay, generous time off, ample parental and wellness leave, healthcare, a retirement savings program, and much more. Offerings vary by location. Based on role, employees may also be eligible for additional compensation and benefits, including but not limited to incentive programs, commissions, equity grants, health and wellness benefits, retirement contributions, and paid time off.

Compensation

*Please note this role is open to candidates outside of California, Colorado, Hawaii, Illinois, Maryland, Massachusetts, Minnesota, New Jersey, New York, Vermont, Washington D.C., and Washington State. The information below is provided for candidates hired in those locations only.

The estimated pay ranges for this role are as follows:

  • Based in Colorado, Hawaii, Illinois, Maryland, Massachusetts, Minnesota, Vermont or Washington D.C. : $141,520 – $176,900
  • Based in New York, New Jersey, Washington State, or California (outside of the San Francisco Bay area): $149,840 – $187,300
  • Based in the San Francisco Bay area, California: $166,400 – $208,000
  • This role may be eligible to participate in Twilio’s equity plan and corporate bonus plan. All roles are generally eligible for the following benefits: health care insurance, 401(k) retirement account, paid sick time, paid personal time off, paid parental leave.

The successful candidate’s starting salary will be determined based on permissible, non-discriminatory factors such as skills, experience, and geographic location.

Applications for this role are intended to be accepted until 11/25/2026, but may change based on business needs.

Twilio thinks big. Do you?

We like to solve problems, take initiative, pitch in when needed, and are always up for trying new things. That's why we seek out colleagues who embody our values — something we call Twilio Magic. Additionally, we empower employees to build positive change in their communities by supporting their volunteering and donation efforts.

So, if you're ready to unleash your full potential, do your best work, and be the best version of yourself, apply now! If this role isn't what you're looking for, please consider other open positions.

.

Stay alert to recruitment fraud

We care about your safety. Scammers sometimes impersonate Twilio recruiters through fake job postings, emails, websites, or messages. Please ensure you are engaging with an official @ email address. We will never ask for payment, gift cards, cryptocurrency, or banking information during the recruiting process. We do not make job offers without a formal interview process or conduct interviews exclusively through text-based messaging apps.

.

Twilio is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, reproductive health decisions, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, genetic information, political views or activity, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act. Additionally, Twilio participates in the E-Verify program in certain locations, as required by law.

6a17cc748bedb786.title: Software Developer
6a17cc748bedb786.description:
McKesson is an impact-driven, Fortune 10 company that touches virtually every aspect of healthcare. We are known for delivering insights, products, and services that make quality care more accessible and affordable. Here, we focus on the health, happiness, and well-being of you and those we serve – we care.

What you do at McKesson matters. We foster a culture where you can grow, make an impact, and are empowered to bring new ideas. Together, we thrive as we shape the future of health for patients, our communities, and our people. If you want to be part of tomorrow’s health today, we want to hear from you.

Position Summary

McKesson Corporation is seeking talented Software Developer to join our Supply Chain Technology team with a strong background in microservices architecture, system integrations, CP4D, Apache Kafka, and Artificial Intelligence (AI). This role is ideal for someone with 4+ years of hands-on development experience who thrives in a fast-paced, innovation-driven environment.

You will be responsible for designing and implementing scalable, intelligent systems that power modern enterprise applications and data-driven decision-making.

Key Responsibilities

  • Architect, develop, and maintain microservices-based applications using modern frameworks and cloud-native technologies.

  • Design and implement real-time data streaming solutions using Apache Kafka.

  • Build robust integrations between internal systems and third-party platforms using APIs, messaging queues, and middleware.

  • Collaborate with AI/ML teams to embed intelligent features into applications, including predictive analytics, NLP, and automation.

  • Develop and maintain ETL pipelines using CP4D.

  • Write and optimize SQL and PL/SQL queries, stored procedures, and triggers in Oracle.

  • Ensure high performance, scalability, and reliability of distributed systems.

  • Participate in agile development processes, including sprint planning, code reviews, and CI/CD.

  • Monitor and troubleshoot production systems, ensuring uptime and responsiveness.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Typically requires 4+ years of relevant experience.

Critical Skills

  • Strong proficiency in programming languages such as Java, JavaScript, Python, or Go.

  • Hands-on experience with microservices architecture and containerization (Docker, Kubernetes).

  • Experience with cloud platforms (GCP, Azure, AWS).

  • Proficient in ETL development, Oracle performance tuning, and complex SQL.

  • Deep understanding of Apache Kafka for event-driven and real-time data processing.

  • Experience implementing AI/ML frameworks like TensorFlow, PyTorch, or Scikit-learn.

  • Strong problem-solving skills and ability to work independently and in teams

Preferred Attributes

  • Experience in healthcare or supply chain domain.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

  • Knowledge of API gateways, service mesh, and observability tools.

  • Experience with MLOps and deploying AI models in production environments.

  • Certifications in cloud, Kafka, or AI technologies.

  • Exposure to data engineering and big data tools (e.g., Spark, Flink).

Education

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent experience).

About MMS

McKesson Medical-Surgical (MMS), which is expected to become Wellverse in early 2027, is a subsidiary and publicly reported segment of the McKesson Corporation. MMS distributes medical-surgical supplies, pharmaceuticals, diagnostic equipment and supplies, along with other solutions and services to virtually every type of healthcare setting and provider outside of the traditional hospital. These markets – often referred to as Alternate Care or Non-Acute Care – include physician offices, surgery centers, long-term care providers, laboratories, home health and hospice agencies, health systems, government facilities and online marketplaces and retailers.

Alternate Care markets are growing rapidly, and MMS is proud to be a leader in this space. With a team of approximately 8,000 employees, a network of 15 distribution centers and approximately 900 delivery vehicles, we collaborate with more than 2,200 leading manufacturers and serve over 200,000 customer accounts across the U.S. Our catalog includes more than 270,000 SKUs of branded and private-label medical-surgical products – from bandages to specialty pharmaceuticals and COVID-19 tests.

We are proud to offer a competitive compensation package at McKesson as part of our Total Rewards. This is determined by several factors, including performance, experience and skills, equity, regular job market evaluations, and geographical markets. The pay range shown below is aligned with McKesson's pay philosophy, and pay will always be compliant with any applicable regulations. In addition to base pay, other compensation, such as an annual bonus or long-term incentive opportunities may be offered. For more information regarding benefits at McKesson, please click here.

Our Base Pay Range for this position

$103,500 - $172,500

McKesson has become aware of online recruiting-related scams in which individuals who are not affiliated with or authorized by McKesson are using McKesson’s (or affiliated entities, like CoverMyMeds or RxCrossroads) name in fraudulent emails, job postings or social media messages. In light of these scams, please bear the following in mind:

McKesson Talent Advisors will never solicit money or credit card information in connection with a McKesson job application.

McKesson Talent Advisors do not communicate with candidates via online chatrooms or using email accounts such as Gmail or Hotmail. Note that McKesson does rely on a virtual assistant (Gia) for certain recruiting-related communications with candidates.

McKesson provides equal employment opportunities to applicants and employees, without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status, disability, age, genetic information, or any other legally protected category. For additional information on McKesson’s full Equal Employment Opportunity policies, visit our Equal Employment Opportunity page.

McKesson is committed to being an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer and offers opportunities to all job seekers including job seekers with disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation to assist with your job search or application for employment, please contact us by sending an email to (United States) or (Canada) . Resumes or CVs submitted to this email box will not be accepted.

d2535a0a3fe60cd1.title: Staff Mobile Engineer - Session Replay | Canada | Remote
d2535a0a3fe60cd1.description:
Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale. Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs. We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.

You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.

This is a full-time remote opportunity. We are considering candidates based in the US and Canada only, within the Eastern or Central time zones.

The Opportunity:

We are building Mobile Session Replay: a way for teams to see what users actually experienced in their iOS, Android, Flutter and React Native apps, inside Grafana Cloud.

Session Replay connects frontend signals to session-level evidence, so engineers can investigate production issues faster and with more confidence. Web replay is already available publicly. Mobile replay extends the same story to native apps as part of our Digital Experience Monitoring (DEM) strategy.

We are starting with Android. A working prototype already exists, and you will help turn it into a product customers can trust. The plan is to push ahead from there: iOS next, then our Flutter, React Native and OpenTelemetry mobile SDKs, so customers get a consistent replay experience across platforms.

As a company we are remote-first and global, we embrace people of different experiences and backgrounds to build diverse teams where every person brings a new perspective to the software. We are looking for Staff Mobile Engineers who are passionate about working with data and providing seamless experiences for our customers to join our growing team!

What you'll be doing

As a Staff Mobile Engineer you will be the technical lead for mobile capture and replay, working across the device, the ingest path and the player. Specifically, you will:

  • Own the on-device replay library end to end, starting with Android and extending to iOS.
  • Make privacy a default, designing masking and consent controls so sensitive data never leaves the device.
  • Keep the overhead low and measure it on real devices, protecting startup time, UI responsiveness, battery, memory, network use and disk, and profiling the impact of capture and masking while the app is actively being used. Give customers controls to trade fidelity against cost.
  • Build the integration layer so customers do not copy demo glue code: adapters that tie replay to the active RUM session, sampling decisions and screen or navigation changes.
  • Work across the stack with Frontend and Mobile Observability teams on the capture, upload and storage pipeline, session inactivity handling, the timeline player and the mobile sessions and replay experience in Frontend Observability. Evaluate the format and API tradeoffs rather than assuming the current prototype approach is final.
  • Define quality and compatibility: automated tests, CI, device and OS coverage, and backwards-compatible upgrade paths for an SDK that customers cannot easily update.
  • Engage directly with customers: join calls, gather structured feedback, and help teams instrument and adopt Mobile Session Replay
  • Mentor engineers and help grow technical leadership in the team

We invest heavily in developer productivity. You can use modern AI coding assistants as part of your daily workflow (your choice of tools, within security guidelines), backed by a company-funded usage budget so you can iterate quickly without unnecessary friction. We encourage pragmatic AI-assisted development: faster prototyping, test generation, refactors, documentation, and incident follow-ups—always with strong code review and quality standards. You'll also have access to the latest frontier models from OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google.

Technologies you'll work with

  • Kotlin (primary, Android-first) and Swift (iOS)
  • Android media and graphics APIs (MediaCodec / H.264 encoding, view and window capture, Jetpack Compose and View-based UIs)
  • Faro (Flutter and React Native SDKs) and OpenTelemetry Android and iOS SDKs
  • Go (collector and ingest services) and TypeScript / React (player and Frontend Observability UI), as you partner across the stack
  • OLAP Database / Object storage (S3)
  • Kafka/Warpstream
  • Grafana ecosystem (Mimir, Loki, Tempo, etc.)

What makes you a great fit

  • You are comfortable working in a remote-first, globally distributed company. Communication is key, and you write and speak clearly in English
  • You are collaborative, friendly, kind and respectful. We operate by consensus: you can contribute, disagree constructively, and commit to the team's decision
  • You have deep native mobile engineering experience on Android (Kotlin/Java) or iOS (Swift/Obj-C). We are building Android first, so Android depth is a priority for the first hire. We are hiring across both platforms, and we do not expect you to be an expert in both, but you are willing to learn and contribute across platforms over time.
  • You have built or maintained mobile SDKs or platform libraries used by external developers, and you care about developer experience, API design and safe upgrade paths
  • You have worked on performance-sensitive code (startup time, memory, battery, network efficiency, background execution limits) and make pragmatic tradeoffs
  • You are comfortable with media and rendering pipelines on mobile: capturing screen content, working with frames or bitmaps, and encoding or handling video
  • You are comfortable owning a product from 0 to 1 in ambiguous problem spaces. You can break large problems into increments and work autonomously
  • You take a user-centered approach, and you build understanding of customers' context and goals so you build the right thing
  • You are thoughtful about privacy and security on user devices, including handling of sensitive data
  • You use AI tools as a natural part of your engineering workflow, for exploration, code review or reasoning through design tradeoffs, and you are thoughtful about where they help and where they don't

Bonus points for

  • Prior work on mobile session replay, screen recording, or sampling for mobile telemetry
  • Experience with video encoding (H.264, MediaCodec, AVFoundation) or on-device masking and redaction
  • Familiarity with rrweb or web session replay concepts
  • Experience with OpenTelemetry, crash reporting libraries or other observability open source
  • Experience with cross-platform frameworks (React Native, Flutter) or building native bindings and bridges
  • Experience with observability or debugging tools (Grafana, Datadog, New Relic, Sentry, etc.)
  • Familiarity with mobile privacy, consent and platform policy requirements
  • Experience with Go or TypeScript, since the work crosses into our ingest and player

In Canada, the OTE (On-Target Earnings)/Base compensation range for this role is $192,891 - $231,469 CAD. Actual compensation may vary based on level, experience, and skillset as assessed throughout the interview process. All of our roles include Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), giving every team member ownership in Grafana Labs' success. We believe in shared outcomes—RSUs help us stay aligned and invested as we scale globally.

*Compensation ranges are country specific. If you are applying for this role from a different location than listed above, your recruiter will discuss your specific market’s defined pay range & benefits at the beginning of the process.

Why You’ll Thrive at Grafana Labs:

  • 100% Remote, Global Culture - As a remote-only company, we bring together talent from around the world, united by a culture of collaboration and shared purpose.
  • Scaling Organization – Tackle meaningful work in a high-growth, ever-evolving environment.
  • Transparent Communication – Expect open decision-making and regular company-wide updates.
  • Innovation-Driven – Autonomy and support to ship great work and try new things.
  • Open Source Roots – Built on community-driven values that shape how we work.
  • Empowered Teams – High trust, low ego culture that values outcomes over optics.
  • Career Growth Pathways – Defined opportunities to grow and develop your career.
  • Approachable Leadership – Transparent execs who are involved, visible, and human.
  • Passionate People – Join a team of smart, supportive folks who care deeply about what they do.
  • In-Person onboarding - We want you to thrive from day 1 with your fellow new ‘Grafanistas’ to learn all about what we do and how we do it.
  • Balance is Key - We operate a global annual leave policy of 30 days per annum. 3 days of your annual leave entitlement are reserved for Grafana Shutdown Days to allow the team to really disconnect. *We will comply with local legislation where applicable.

Equal Opportunity Employer:Grafana Labs is an equal opportunities employer. We welcome applications from everyone regardless of race, colour, nationality, origin, caste, sex, gender reassignment identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, religion or belief, disability, veteran status, genetic information, pregnancy, maternity, marital, family or carer status, or any other characteristic which is protected by local law. Job Description

Our client is seeking experienced Student Loan Servicing Specialists to contribute their expertise to an innovative artificial intelligence project focused on improving the accuracy, reliability, and quality of AI-generated guidance related to U.S. federal student loans.

In this remote contractor role, professionals will apply their practical knowledge of federal student loan servicing to evaluate AI-generated responses, identify inaccuracies, and provide detailed feedback that helps improve next-generation AI systems.

No previous experience in artificial intelligence is required. The primary qualification is hands-on expertise assisting federal student loan borrowers.

Key Responsibilities

  • Review and analyze sample inquiries from federal student loan borrowers to assess the accuracy and completeness of servicing guidance.

  • Develop clear, detailed evaluation rubrics defining correct responses to complex borrower questions.

  • Evaluate AI-generated answers for accuracy, completeness, and alignment with current federal student loan policies and regulations.

  • Identify and document errors, omissions, outdated information, and inconsistencies in AI-generated responses.

  • Apply practical knowledge of federal repayment plans, including income-driven repayment options and Public Service Loan Forgiveness (PSLF).

  • Assess complex servicing scenarios involving payment count discrepancies, misapplied payments, loan consolidation, and transfers between loan servicers.

  • Provide precise, actionable written feedback to improve AI system performance.

  • Complete assigned evaluations independently and asynchronously while maintaining high standards of accuracy and quality.

Position Details

  • Job Title: Student Loan Servicing Specialist

  • Location: United States — 100% Remote

  • Employment Type: Independent Contractor

  • Time Commitment: 15–25 hours per week

  • Compensation: USD $30–$50 per hour

This opportunity is ideal for professionals with direct experience in federal student loan servicing who are interested in applying their industry knowledge to innovative AI development projects.

Qualifications

Required Skills and Knowledge

  • Strong working knowledge of U.S. federal student loan programs, including federal loan types and repayment options.

  • Comprehensive understanding of income-driven repayment plans and current federal student loan regulations.

  • Knowledge of Public Service Loan Forgiveness (PSLF), including qualifying payments and payment count calculations.

  • Familiarity with deferment, forbearance, delinquency, default, loan rehabilitation, and consolidation.

  • Ability to identify and resolve student loan servicing issues, including misapplied payments, payment count discrepancies, and loan servicer transfers.

  • Strong analytical skills and attention to detail when reviewing complex borrower scenarios.

  • Excellent written communication skills, with the ability to provide clear, accurate, and actionable feedback.

  • Ability to work independently in a remote, asynchronous environment.

  • Must be based in the United States.

Preferred Qualifications

  • At least 1 year of professional experience working for a federal student loan servicer or contractor supporting borrowers.

  • Direct experience in borrower assistance, loan servicing, default management, collections, or escalations.

  • Experience resolving complex federal student loan servicing problems.

  • Familiarity with recent regulatory changes and evolving federal student loan repayment policies.

  • Demonstrated ability to explain complex financial and regulatory concepts clearly and accurately.

  • Experience evaluating written responses, reviewing documentation, or performing quality assurance assessments.

Important Considerations

  • Previous experience with artificial intelligence or machine learning is not required.

  • Practical, hands-on experience in federal student loan servicing is highly valued.

Work Arrangement: Fully Remote — United States Only
Contract Type: Independent Contractor
Weekly Commitment: 15–25 hours
Compensation: USD $30–$50 per hour
Work Schedule: Flexible, asynchronous assignments

Why Consider This Opportunity?

  • Apply your professional expertise in federal student loan servicing to innovative artificial intelligence projects.

  • Work remotely from anywhere within the United States.

  • Enjoy a flexible, part-time commitment while contributing to the development of next-generation AI systems.

  • No prior experience in artificial intelligence or machine learning is required.

Our client is a U.S.-based organization engaged in innovative artificial intelligence projects, leveraging specialized industry expertise to improve the accuracy, reliability, and performance of next-generation AI systems.

For this project, our client is seeking experienced professionals in federal student loan servicing to contribute their practical knowledge of borrower assistance, repayment programs, loan servicing regulations, and complex borrower cases.

CONFISA Group is supporting the recruitment of qualified professionals for this remote opportunity across the United States.

447eeb9b4521c66a.description:
Built on meritocracy, our unique company culture rewards self-starters and those who are committed to doing what is best for our customers.

Brown & Brown is seeking a Senior Data/EDI Consultant to join our growing team!


The Senior Data/EDI Consultant (SDC) will be responsible for key operational aspects for the National Employee Benefits Technology (EBTech) Department. A key area of focus for the SDC will be working with the configuration team's data/EDI and implementation architects), typically on high complexity customers. This includes mentoring of less experienced teammates to guide them in continuous process improvement and meeting quality expectations and production deadlines. In addition, the SDC will play a key role in EBTech benefits administration software platform implementations across projects, working with managers and implementation teams to ensure delivery of high quality and timely outcomes. You will use your system development knowledge, health and welfare expertise and project management experience in implementing new customers and expanding current customer relationships. You will have the opportunity to grow your supervisory, project management, consulting, customer management, leadership, health and welfare knowledge, and business acumen. As an SDC you are responsible for ensuring that tasks are completed with high quality and timeliness.


How You Will Contribute:


  • Drives implementations. Applies expert benefits administration software implementation knowledge to run several projects at once with consistent, high-quality outcomes.
  • Plans the work. Turns business needs into plans covering objectives, timeline, deliverables, budget, and quality standards for the whole project life cycle.
  • Leads complex customers. Serves as principal project lead and drives results across EBTech, account teams, customers, and carriers.
  • Owns the customer relationship. Keeps account teams and customers clear on tasks, deadlines, and timeline risks. Gives continuous status on new sites and renewals, and builds trusted-advisor relationships.
  • Supervises and mentors. Builds teammate skills, reviews their work, and ensures individual and team tasks are done on time and accurately.
  • Manages resources and escalations. Works with team leaders to secure the right people, and raises issues to leadership or the Director of Operations when customer expectations are at risk.
  • Uses sound judgment on process, protocol, and quality standards in high-complexity situations, and represents EBTech professionally with outside parties.

Skills & Experience to be Successful:


  • Expert knowledge of benefits administration software implementation, with hands-on EDI and data experience (HIPAA 834, carrier connectivity, system development).
  • Project management experience leading multiple concurrent, high-complexity customer implementations (Smartsheet or similar).
  • Health and welfare expertise, including enrollment, eligibility, and open enrollment cycles.
  • Prior supervisory or team lead experience, including mentoring less experienced teammates.
  • Customer-facing: comfortable owning communication, setting expectations, and escalating risks early.
  • Can explain technical issues in plain language to non-technical partners.
  • Direct Employee Navigator experience, or a similar benefits administration platform. (preferred)
  • Zendesk or comparable ticketing experience. (preferred)
  • Automation exposure (Power Automate, Power Query, scripting). (preferred)
  • Experience with joint or multi-team projects. (preferred)

Pay Range

$90,000 - $95,000 Annual

The pay range provided above is made in good faith and based on our lowest and highest annual salary or hourly rate paid for the role and takes into account years of experience required, geography, and/or budget for the role.

Teammate Benefits & Total Well-Being

We go beyond standard benefits, focusing on the total well-being of our teammates, including:

  • Health Benefits: Medical/Rx, Dental, Vision, Life Insurance, Disability Insurance
  • Financial Benefits: ESPP; 401k; Student Loan Assistance; Tuition Reimbursement
  • Mental Health & Wellness: Free Mental Health & Enhanced Advocacy Services
  • Beyond Benefits: Paid Time Off, Holidays, Preferred Partner Discounts and more.

Not reflective of all benefits. Enrollment waiting periods or eligibility criteria may apply to certain benefits. Benefit details and offerings may vary for subsidiary entities or in specific geographic locations.

Any unsolicited resumes submitted to Brown & Brown or its employees become the property of Brown & Brown, and no fees will be paid for such submissions. Additional information regarding this policy can be found on our careers page.

The Power To Be Yourself

NVIDIA is widely considered to be one of the technology world’s most desirable employers. We have some of the most forward-thinking and hardworking people in the world working for us.   • Validate that simulation configurations and features align with real-world physical setups.

  • Review architectural designs and requirements for new product features.

  • Design and implement end-to-end tests for new features, including SW GA and maintenance releases.

  • Report and document bugs, assist in reproducing and debugging issues, verify R&D bug fixes, and raise unresolved issues.

  • Strong automation/scripting skills in Python and Linux Bash.

  • Proficiency in Python OOP and experience writing automation for WebUI, SDK, and API using pytest and Playwright .

  • Ability to handle multiple tasks, prioritize effectively, and execute responsibilities independently.

  • Dedicated, able to work independently, and take ownership of tasks.

  • Confident and effective verbal and written communication skills in English.

  • Strong CCNA and/or ISTQB, or similar certifications.

  • In-depth Linux and Linux kernel knowledge (LPIC-2 level).

You can learn more about our culture in our Culture Handbook, available for you to read.

Brightvision is a B2B growth agency specializing in results-driven marketing for tech companies. We have a team of around 100 employees across the globe, working with some of the largest and most innovative companies in the tech industry. While our main office is in Gothenburg, Sweden, most of our team, including managers, work remotely, giving you the flexibility to live and work from anywhere in the world.

What does the position involve?

We are currently looking for someone to join our team and work with our clients in the Danish market. You’ll be responsible for identifying new sales opportunities for various clients. Your main responsibilities will be to create value for our customers through lead generation, account-based marketing (ABM), creating SQLs (Sales Qualified Leads) and MQLs (Marketing Qualified Leads), as well as inside sales.

We are looking for an enthusiastic, Danish-speaking individual who is well-acquainted with the cultural landscape of Danish businesses. You'll be part of an international team of consultants who are always ready to support you—and we never forget to have fun together!

At the moment, we're hiring for one position, but this ad also serves as an application for our candidate pool. If additional opportunities arise, we will reach out and offer you a position.

Who are you?

  • You have proven experience in B2B prospecting and inside sales, with a strong track record in cold outreach and follow-up using phone, email, LinkedIn, etc.
  • A self-motivated individual with an entrepreneurial mindset and a drive for success.
  • Experience in the IT/technology industry is a plus.
  • Fluent in Danish (both written and spoken) and professional proficiency in English.
  • Eager to learn and grow.
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment where we deliver top-notch services to clients daily.
  • Available to work as a freelancer (invoicing monthly).
  • It's a bonus if you live in Europe, but it's not a requirement.

Why choose Brightvision?

We’re a close-knit group of "humble winners" with a great sense of humor (if we do say so ourselves!). Since our founding in 2000, we've embraced a "remote-first" approach, allowing you to work from home, wherever that may be.

Here’s what our team loves about Brightvision:

  • Strong team spirit with amazing colleagues.
  • Working with some of the biggest and most challenging clients in the tech industry.
  • A decentralized organization with small, agile teams.
  • A focus on skill development and internal coaching.
  • Great company events and social activities.
  • Transparency and excellent communication.
  • An international work environment with colleagues from around the world.
  • A bonus program for everyone.
  • A stipend to help cover home office costs.
  • Health & wellness program
  • Focus on world-class leadership
  • A focus on world-class leadership, with one-on-one meetings with your manager every two weeks.

Check out what life at Brightvision looks like on our Instagram, or learn more about us on our Careers page.

If you feel Brightvision is the right fit for you, please submit your application as soon as possible. We review applications on an ongoing basis.

We look forward to hearing from you!

Our Values

When working with Brightvision, you embrace the values outlined in our Growth Agency Handbook. These values will guide you in making the right choices.

The Solution Sales Manager will oversee market success of ServiceNow's CRM and Industry products. These products are built on our market leading Service Management platform and create a single source of truth that allows enterprise processes to execute with uniform information.

What you get to do in this role:

The Sr Solution Sales Executive - CRM & Industry supports the strategy and solution win for specialty solution areas depending on engagement model. Responsibilities/ activities can vary by solution area given coverage capacity.

  • Provide input to AE during the account planning process based on territory strategy and recommendation

Seeking Breakthrough Makers

Children’s Hospital of Philadelphia (CHOP) offers countless ways to change lives. Our diverse community of more than 20,000 Breakthrough Makers will inspire you to pursue passions, develop expertise, and drive innovation.

At CHOP, your experience is valued; your voice is heard; and your contributions make a difference for patients and families. Join us as we build on our promise to advance pediatric care—and your career.


CHOP does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, sex, national origin, religion, or any other legally protected categories in any employment, training, or vendor decisions or programs. CHOP recognizes the critical importance of a workforce rich in varied backgrounds and experiences and engages in ongoing efforts to achieve that through equally varied and non-discriminatory means.


A Brief Overview
Serves as an expert for the development of data collection tools, aggregation systems and reports and on-going management of data and data systems related to centralized staffing.

What you will do

  • Consults with staff and assists in the development of data collection tools to support measurement plans.

  • Master's Degree - Preferred

Experience Qualifications

  • Experience using data to improve the quality of healthcare - Preferred

Skills and Abilities

  • Ability to convey complex or technical information in a manner that others can easily understand. (Required proficiency)

b913c3de3996c00e.title: Support Engineer
b913c3de3996c00e.description:
Overview

The Support Engineer will assist in managing and coordinating recovery efforts for all events impacting production processes, SLA’s and client satisfaction.

Responsibilities

  • Works and communicates directly with clients and management for any production events, escalating issues as needed while communicating status and risks and producing after outage documentation.
  • Act as a liaison between technical and operational teams, serving as a subject matter expert in troubleshooting to resolve application support and file processing issues, new client activation or expansion or requests from clients including testing and/or additional or non-standard monitoring.
  • Monitor support ticket queue, research and work independently to troubleshoot issues of various technical causes utilizing working knowledge of systems, networks, application functionality and OSI interdependencies. Escalate and collaborate on tickets with appropriate engineering or support groups.
  • Document and improve Production Support processes and add to knowledge base of system problems and resolutions for future reference, including peer knowledge sharing and training.
  • Follows and supports IT business processes using the ITIL framework, including incident, problem, change and release/configuration management with a goal of operational excellence.
  • Supporting disaster recovery and business continuity planning and testing, including actual live fail over and fallback exercises.
  • Interfaces with the Implementations, Development, QA and Configuration Management teams for releases and deployments of all application and services into Production.
  • Develop advanced scripts and tools to help automate tasks, diagnose and troubleshoot application functionality and resolve data accuracy and access issues.
  • Receive escalations from junior team members, providing direction in the execution and monitoring of daily tasks, along with feedback, training and mentoring to junior members.
  • Participates in on-call and/or shift rotations supporting 24x7 enterprise level systems.
  • Completes all responsibilities as outlined on annual Performance Plan.
  • Completes all special projects and other duties as assigned.
  • Must be able to perform duties with or without reasonable accommodation.

Qualifications

  • Requires a bachelor's degree in computer science, information technology, or related technical field or equivalent training, certification.
  • 3-5+ years of experience developing/supporting enterprise -level applications software in multi-node Windows or Linux Server environments.
  • Deep knowledge of application architectures, workflows and monitoring tools.
  • Strong experience working with SQL, Oracle, PL/SQL, MS Access and DB Management tools, proficiency with PowerShell, Bash or VB scripting, plus Java EE and/or.NET frameworks.
  • Ability to work in a cross-functional global team environment, utilizing on-line collaboration tools.
  • Ability to troubleshoot application issues and escalate to supporting engineering teams.
  • Knowledge of commonly used information technology concepts, practices and procedures.
  • Solid written and verbal communication skills, previous Help Desk experience a plus.
  • Familiarity with medical claims processing and practices a plus.

Mental Requirements:

  • Excellent oral and written skills.
  • Must be able to perform daily functions with little or no direct supervision.
  • Communicating with others to exchange information.
  • Assessing the accuracy, neatness, and thoroughness of the work assigned.

Physical Requirements and Working Conditions:

  • Remaining in a stationary position, often standing or sitting for prolonged periods.
  • Repeating motions that may include the wrists, hands, and/or fingers.
  • Must be able to provide a dedicated, secure work area.
  • Must be able to provide high-speed internet access/connectivity and office setup and maintenance.
  • No adverse environmental conditions expected.

Base compensation ranges from $70,000 to $110,000. Specific offers are determined by various factors, such as experience, education, skills, certifications, and other business needs.

Cotiviti offers team members a competitive benefits package to address a wide range of personal and family needs, including medical, dental, vision, disability, and life insurance coverage, 401(k) savings plans, paid family leave, 9 paid holidays per year, and 17-27 days of Paid Time Off (PTO) per year, depending on specific level and length of service with Cotiviti. For information about our benefits package, please refer to our Careers page.

Since this job will be based remotely, all interviews will be conducted virtually.

Applications are assessed on a rolling basis. We anticipate that the application window will close on x/xx/2026, but the application window may change depending on the volume of applications received or close immediately if a qualified candidate is selected.
